title: Summer 2027 Internship
location: New York, New York, United States
description:
Foundation Risk Partners – This internship is located onsite in our New York, NY office.

Foundation Risk Partners, one of the fastest-growing insurance brokerage and consulting firms in the United States, is excited to welcome applicants for its 2027 Summer Internship Program located in New York, NY.

The eight-week program, beginning in June 2027, is designed to provide students with an introduction into the business insurance industry and help prepare them for a career post-graduation. Interns will participate and contribute both individually and as a part of a team working on project-based assignments that involve meaningful professional experiences with case studies through multiple departments of an insurance brokerage firm as well as collaborative sales projects and competitive presentations with other regional internship programs.

Throughout the program, interns will gain hands-on experience and develop professional skills in key areas such as:

  • Employee Benefit Sales and Operations
  • Risk Management Services
  • Partnerships with Key Insurance Carrier and Wholesale Brokers
  • Commercial Property & Casualty Insurance Sales and Operations

Interns will collaborate closely with Regional Division Leaders and be supported by dedicated mentors, engaging in structured training sessions and industry-specific projects. By the end of the program, participants will have a solid understanding of Foundation Risk Partners’ services, internal departments, specialty divisions, along with a broader perspective of the commercial insurance industry.

Education:

  • Candidates must be actively enrolled in college
  • Candidates must be a rising junior and/or senior in their respective major
  • Candidates interested in exploring a career in the insurance industry

Competencies & Attributes:

  • Communication, collaboration and leadership abilities
  • Initiative and motivation to succeed
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
  • Involvement in school organizations and activities
  • Proficient in Microsoft Office products

title: RHEL Administrator III
description:
Patriot, LLC is seeking an accomplished Red Hat Enterprise Linux Administrator to provide expertise in managing and optimizing assets for our federal client's critical operations. As a Red Hat Enterprise Linux Admin, you will be responsible for managing and maintaining the RHEL infrastructure. Your role will involve overseeing system administration, configuration, troubleshooting, and ensuring the stability, security, and performance of the RHEL environment.
Requirements
7+ years of experience working as a system admin on Linux or Red Hat systems is required; related experience is acceptable.
Candidates must reside within a commutable distance for daily onsite work and on-call requirements.
This contract supports systems that require 24x7x365 uptime. Candidates must be willing and able to meet recall requirements, including participation in a rotational on-call schedule.
Responsibilities
Administer, support, and optimize RHEL-based server infrastructure (RHEL 7.x/8.x/9.x), including installation, configuration, upgrades, and patch management.
Perform daily system administration tasks such as user management, permissions, file systems, and network configuration.
Monitor, analyze, and tune system performance; identify and resolve bottlenecks to ensure reliability and efficiency.
Execute backup, restore, and disaster recovery operations to safeguard data and maintain high availability.
Assess, recommend, and implement hardware and software solutions to meet evolving business and technical requirements.
Develop, maintain, and update documentation for system configurations, processes, and troubleshooting procedures.
Conduct vulnerability assessments and remediation using tools such as Tenable, HP WebInspect, and other industry-standard platforms.
Investigate security incidents, assess risks, and design mitigation strategies; implement proactive and reactive security measures.
Manage and apply DISA STIGs and mitigate KEVs (Known Exploitable Vulnerabilities) to ensure compliance and security.

Automate routine tasks and system management using Ansible Automation Platform (AAP), scripting languages (Bash, Python, etc.), and other tools to improve operational efficiency.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams (network, storage, application, and security) to support integrated solutions and resolve complex issues.
Provide technical guidance and support for system integration, migrations, and upgrades.

Patriot, LLC is committed to a drug-free workplace. As such, the Company conducts pre-employment, reasonable cause, random and contract-mandated testing in accordance with federal and state law.

Patriot, LLC is an Equal Opportunity/Affirmative Action employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or veteran status, or any other protected class.

title: Senior Software Engineer, Autonomy Capabilities (R5339)
description:
Shield AI is a venture-backed defense-tech company with the mission of protecting service members and civilians with intelligent systems. Its products include Hivemind autonomy software, V-BAT and X-BAT aircraft, and Aechelon simulation and synthetic reality technologies. With offices and facilities across the U.S., Europe, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific, Shield AI’s technology actively supports operations worldwide. For more information, visit . Follow Shield AI on LinkedIn, X, Instagram, and YouTube.

The Autonomy Capabilities Team develops functionality to automate single- and multi-agent teams of platforms in pursuit of mission objectives and acts as a central discipline-aligned focal-point for encouraging consistent usage of technical approaches across business portfolios. This team operates at all levels of the command-and-control hierarchy (from advanced control laws, through motion planning, and up to advanced tactical behaviors and multi-agent coordination) and across a multitude of mission sets, platform types, and operational domains (e.g., air, sea, space). The team puts a strong emphasis on both fundamentals (e.g., aircraft kinematics/dynamics, trajectory design, optimization, information fusion, efficient algorithms, etc.) and software integration skillsets (e.g. structures, protocols, threading, interface management, etc.) to bring market-differentiating capabilities to customers that seamlessly operate within their integration contexts.

This position is perfect for an individual who enjoys solving complex problems across a diverse set of programs and integration contexts. An ideal candidate is expected to address operational system needs through a multitude of advanced methodologies that blend traditional control system approaches with advanced optimization. Developed solutions are expected to be integrated into real-world platforms with near-term program impacts and rewards and so balancing theory with practice and rigorous implementation is paramount.

What You'll Do:

  • Tactical Autonomy Design – Design tactical autonomy algorithms to enable unmanned aircraft to perform complex missions across air, land, and sea domains with minimal human supervision.
  • High-Performance Software Development – Develop high-performance software modules that incorporate planning, decision-making, and behavior execution strategies for dynamic and adversarial environments.
  • Behavior Architecture Implementation – Implement and test behavior architectures that enable multi-agent coordination, target engagement, reconnaissance, and survivability in contested scenarios.
  • Hybrid Autonomy Integration – Work at the intersection of classical autonomy and machine learning, blending rule-based systems with learning-based methods such as reinforcement learning to achieve robust, adaptive behavior.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration – Collaborate with cross-functional teams including perception, planning, simulation, hardware, and flight test to ensure seamless integration of autonomy solutions on real-world platforms.
  • Deployment & Field Testing – Deploy autonomy capabilities to real platforms and participate in field tests and flight demos, validating performance in operationally relevant conditions.
  • Mission Data Analysis – Analyze mission logs and performance data to diagnose failures, optimize behavior models, and inform iterative development.
  • R&D and Roadmapping – Contribute to the autonomy roadmap by researching and prototyping new algorithms, identifying tactical capability gaps, and proposing novel solutions that advance Shield AI’s mission.
  • Program Support & Adaptation – Support defense-focused programs and customer needs by adapting autonomy solutions to evolving mission sets, compliance requirements, and operational feedback.
  • Travel Requirement – Members of this team typically travel around 10-15% of the year (to different office locations, customer sites, and flight integration events).

Required Qualifications:

  • BS/MS in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, and/or similar degree, or equivalent practical experience
  • Typically requires a minimum of 5 years of related experience with a Bachelor’s degree; or 4 years and a Master’s degree; or 2 years with a PhD; or equivalent work experience.

  • Proficiency in programming languages such as C++ and Python, and familiarity with real-time operating systems (RTOS)

  • Significant background in one or several robotic technology areas related to control systems, motion planning, optimization, tactical behaviors, and/or distributed decision-making

  • Significant experience with unmanned system technologies and accompanying algorithms (ideally in the space domain specifically)

  • Experience with simulation tools and environments (e.g., AFSIM, NGTS, or similar) for testing and validation

  • Strong problem-solving skills, with the ability to troubleshoot and optimize system performance

  • Excellent communication and teamwork skills, with the ability to work effectively in a collaborative, multidisciplinary environment

  • Ability to obtain a SECRET clearance or higher

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience in multiple aerospace domains (e.g., air, land, sea, space)

  • Experience across a breadth of methodologies from classical control through optimization and applied ML/RL

  • Background in collaborative behaviors and swarm robotics

  • Familiarity with domain-relevant DoD or government programs

  • Hands-on experience supporting integration events, customer demos, and/or live exercises

title: English to Spanish (LatAm) Life Sciences Linguist
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for an English to Spanish (LatAm) Life Sciences Linguist based in France.

This role offers the opportunity to contribute to high-quality language solutions supporting global pharmaceutical, clinical research, and medical device operations.
You will translate and review specialized life sciences content where linguistic accuracy, consistency, and regulatory compliance are essential.
The position covers clinical trial, pharmacovigilance, and regulatory documentation across a wide range of document types.
You will work with translation technologies and structured quality processes to deliver accurate content within demanding timelines.
Your expertise will directly support materials used throughout clinical development, safety monitoring, regulatory activities, and commercialization.
The role requires exceptional attention to detail and the ability to maintain terminology, tone, and meaning across complex medical content.
This is an excellent opportunity for an experienced linguist seeking specialized, impactful work within the regulated life sciences sector.

Accountabilities

  • Translate clinical research, regulatory, and pharmacovigilance documents from English into Latin American Spanish with a high level of linguistic and technical accuracy.
  • Perform Machine Translation Post-Editing (MTPE) on machine-translated safety and life sciences content.
  • Review translated and post-edited materials through copy editing to ensure accuracy, consistency, appropriate tone, terminology, and readability.
  • Work across clinical research documentation such as protocols and synopses, Investigator's Brochures, Informed Consent Forms, patient information sheets, and patient diaries.
  • Translate and review regulatory materials including SmPCs, PILs, labels, and CTD modules.
  • Handle pharmacovigilance documentation such as PSURs, DSURs, Risk Management Plans, Serious Adverse Event reports, and Adverse Event documentation.
  • Work within the client's designated CAT tool environment, including XTM or Phrase, following project-specific workflows and instructions.
  • Use Microsoft Word Track Changes effectively when reviewing or editing documents.
  • Meet strict, non-extendable turnaround times for time-sensitive translation and review projects.
  • Follow established quality procedures and project instructions to ensure consistent, reliable, and audit-ready deliverables.
  • Complete the required assessment as part of the onboarding and quality assurance process.

    • Requirements

    • At least two years of practical professional translation experience specifically involving life sciences, clinical trials, pharmacovigilance, and/or medical documentation.
    • A degree in Translation, Linguistics, Language Studies, or an equivalent discipline; alternatively, a recognized graduate qualification in another field combined with at least two years of full-time translation experience.
    • Candidates without the above educational background may qualify with at least five years of full-time professional translation experience.
    • Demonstrated experience translating English into Latin American Spanish, preferably across clinical, regulatory, and pharmacovigilance content.
    • Familiarity with CAT tools such as XTM or Phrase; the required license will be provided.
    • Proficiency with Microsoft Word Track Changes and document review workflows.
    • Strong understanding of life sciences terminology and the ability to accurately handle specialized medical and regulatory content.
    • Exceptional attention to detail, consistency, and linguistic accuracy.
    • Ability to meet strict deadlines and manage time-sensitive assignments reliably.
    • Strong written communication skills and the ability to preserve the intended meaning, tone, and technical accuracy of source materials.
    • Willingness to complete a translation assessment as part of the onboarding and quality process.
    • A degree or academic background in Medicine, Biology, Biochemistry, Clinical Research, Translation, Linguistics, Philology, or a related field is an advantage.
    • Previous in-house experience within a CRO, pharmaceutical company, medical device organization, or related life sciences environment is beneficial.

      • Benefits

      • Opportunity to work on specialized life sciences and medical translation projects with global relevance.
      • Exposure to clinical research, pharmacovigilance, regulatory affairs, and medical documentation.
      • Opportunity to work with professional CAT tools, including XTM and Phrase, with the required license provided.
      • Experience across diverse and technically specialized document types.
      • Structured quality and onboarding processes designed to support high-quality translation delivery.
      • Opportunity to develop deeper expertise in regulated life sciences translation.
      • Work supporting materials that contribute to clinical development, patient safety, regulatory compliance, and global healthcare delivery.
      • Flexible opportunity based in India.

title: Prep Hoops Scout (West Virginia)
description:
About Prep Network

Prep Network () operates websites -- 100+ in total -- aimed at maximizing visibility and value for high school athletes at all levels. Our scouts provide content, player rankings, and event coverage year-round.

Prep Network operates Prep Hoops, Prep Girls Hoops, Prep Redzone, Prep Dig, and Prep Lacrosse. Combined, Prep Network websites have over 300 scouts nationwide that produce 2,500+ articles each month on prep basketball, football, and volleyball. Prep Network also operates 100+ tournaments and showcases that host hundreds of teams and thousands of prospects across the country each year.

Job Description

As a scout, you will create written and social media content. You will attend high school and club games, watch game film, and publish player-driven analysis on Prep Network's website. You will utilize your existing network with high school and college coaches in your community to grow the Prep Network footprint.

We are a rapidly growing sports-focused company where your voice will be heard and you can make a real impact. Aside from helping high school players get recruited, we want someone who fits our culture, work ethic, and, most importantly, our passion for learning and improving.

Responsibilities and Duties

  • Attend high school and club games and publish written and social media content
  • Promote players at all levels of collegiate recruitment
  • Work with other Prep Network contributors to maximize the value added to teams, players, and coaches in your state
  • Network with coaches at all levels to grow the Prep Network brand

We Are Looking For Someone Who Is

  • Entrepreneurial. Help us build the fastest-growing high school sports network in the country
  • A Great Teammate. No job is too small. We need someone willing to do whatever is needed to build something great
  • Driven. You are self-motivated and perform without direct supervision
  • A Strong Communicator. You need excellent interpersonal, verbal, and written skills
  • Experienced with Microsoft & Google. You are proficient with Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, and PowerPoint), as well as Google Apps (Gmail, Google Calendar, Google Docs)

Benefits and Perks

  • Flexibility. We care more about the quality of your work than your location.
  • Awesome Co-Workers. Company culture is important to us. We love hiring curious, self-motivated people who work hard and have a blast doing it.
  • Potential for Growth. Make an impact, and earn the opportunity for an expanded role.

Join the Prep Network team, selected as a 2020 recipient of the Best Employers in Sports Award by Front Office Sports as well as 2023 and 2023 Minneapolis St. Paul Best Places to Work.

title: Køkkenhjælp/pædagogmedhjælper til Børnehuset Stjernen
description:
Børnehuset stjernen søger en køkkenmedhjælper/pædagogmedhjælper til en stilling på 25 timer om ugen, fra 1. oktober 2026 til og med 30. april 2027.

Stjernen er et stort hus med 30-34 vuggestuebørn fordelt på 3 stuer og 60-70 børnehavebørn fordelt på 3 stuer.

I køkkenet vil du skulle arbejde tæt sammen med vores kostansvarlige Stine, som i 1,5 år har lavet dejligt velsmagende mad til os.

I køkkenet vil dine opgaver blandt andet være:
  • Hjælpe med at gøre maden klar.
  • Opvask og rengøring.
I ferier kan der være behov for at man varetager mere af madlavningen.

Vi søger en:
  • Som har gode samarbejdsevner, er struktureret og har overblik i en sjov men til tider travl hverdag
  • Som er omsorgsfuld, empatisk og nærværende
  • Som er god til at skabe relationer og udstråler ro.
  • Som er nysgerrig på at forstå børnenes opfattelse af verden og tager udgangspunkt i børneperspektivet
  • Som er smilende, imødekommende og skaber en god stemning
Vi er et hus med et godt kollegialt fællesskab og vi er gode til at hjælpe hinanden.

Vil du vide mere om stillingen eller måske have en rundvisning i huset er du velkommen til at kontakte vores pædagogiske leder Randi på tlf. 24603077 eller huset på tlf. 46318550

Stillingen er med tiltrædelse 1. oktober 2026

Ansøgningsfrist er 14. september kl. 12

Ansættelsessamtaler afholdes torsdag d. 17. september

Løn- og ansættelsesvilkår er efter gældende overenskomst. Inden ansættelse indhentes der straffe- og børneattest samt referencer.

title: Chauffør til kørsel med liftbil
description:
Vi søger en chauffør med erfaring i kørsel med liftbil.

Du kommer til at køre på hele Sjælland, hvor du skal levere og hjemtage containere hos vores erhvervskunder. Containere kan indeholde klinisk risikoaffald samt farligt affald.

Du begynder dagen på vores adresse i Glostrup og slutter samme sted. Stillingen er på fuld tid (min. 37 timer pr. uge).

Det er en forudsætning for at komme i betragtning til stillingen, at du har kørekort til kategori C samt gyldigt Førerkort og EU-bevis. Det er en fordel, hvis du også har ADR-bevis.

Du skal kunne læse, skrive og forstå dansk. Straffeattest skal forevises. Gode løn- og ansættelsesforhold tilbydes.Tiltrædelse hurtigst muligt.

Vi har en humoristisk og uformel omgangstone, og du bliver en del af et team af gode kolleger.

title: Sanitation Technician (1st Shift)
description:
IRCA is a prominent international provider of semi-finished ingredients for the bakery, pastry, and gelato markets. They cater to independent producers as well as large food manufacturers, including consumer packaged goods (CPG) companies. The company's core product offerings consist of chocolate, chocolate decorations, creams, pastry mixes, gelato ingredients, and various other bakery and pastry ingredients.
Headquartered in Italy, IRCA was acquired by Advent International, a global private equity firm, in July 2022. The company has demonstrated a strong history of growth over the past decade. As part of its growth strategy, IRCA made two bolt-on acquisitions in 2022. They acquired Cesarin, a provider of candied fruits, and Anastasi, a supplier of pistachio ingredients. These acquisitions expanded IRCA's product portfolio and market reach.
More recently, IRCA acquired the leading manufacturer of sweet and cereal products in Europe and the US. The target company focuses on high-value specialty ingredients for the Food Manufacturers segment. Their product range includes sweet particulates, chocolate confections, baked inclusions, variegates, and fruit purées. This deal, successfully completed in March of 2023, is a transformative move for IRCA, establishing them as a global leader in the semi-finished ingredients industry.
We are seeking a Sanitation Technician for 1st shift; Available to work overtime as scheduled on Friday & Saturday.

Essential Responsibilities

  • ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILTIES include the following.
  • Human safety, food safety, adherence to Good Manufacturing Practices, and product quality are the highest priorities. Other duties may be assigned.
  • Replenish supplies, clean restrooms, mop floors, empty trash and replace liners, and all other duties entailing housekeeping.
  • Chemical Inventory reported to Ecolab. If necessary, order email or review with manager.
  • Assist with wash down inspections.
  • Know and use appropriate cleaning chemicals. Use chemical dispensing stations. Knows how to perform titrations and calculate measure concentration.
  • Ability to safely handle full strength chemicals using full PPE.
  • Removing debris from the warehouse and walkways of the facility throughout the shift. Reusable scrap is separated and loaded onto trailers. Bales cardboard and plastic for recycling.
  • Cleans floors using mop and bucket as well as a walk behind or riding floor scrubber.
  • Cleans rooms, hallways, lobbies, lounges, rest rooms, corridors, elevators, stairways, and locker rooms and other work areas.
  • Cleans rugs, carpets, upholstered furniture, and draperies.
  • Dusts furniture and equipment. Polishes metalwork.
  • Washes walls, ceiling, and woodwork. Washes windows, door panels, and sills.
  • Replenishes bathroom supplies. Replaces light bulbs.
  • Performs grounds maintenance in all seasons, this will include removing snow, trash or spillage from plant grounds.
  • Performs all other related duties as required.

Experience, Education & Qualifications Requirements

  • QUALIFICATION REQUIREMENTS: The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required. Reasonable accommodation will be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.
  • EDUCATION and/or EXPERIENCE: Six months to one-year related experience and/or training; or equivalent combination of training and experience.
  • LANGUAGE SKILLS: Appropriate English language ability in order to read and interpret documents such as safety rules, operating and maintenance instructions, procedure manuals, SOPs, and other related documents. Ability to write routine reports and correspondence.
  • MATHEMATICAL SKILLS: Ability to add, subtract, multiply, and divide in all units of measure using whole numbers, common fractions, and decimals. Ability to compute rate, ratio, and percent, and ability to draw and interpret bar graphs.
  • REASONING ABILITY: Ability to apply common sense understanding to carry out instructions furnished in written, oral, or diagram form. Ability to deal with problems involving several concrete variables in standardized situations.
  • PHYSICAL DEMANDS: The physical demands described are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodation will be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.
  • While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to walk; use hands to finger, handle or feel objects, tools or controls; and reach with hands and arms. The employee frequently is required to stand, walk, talk, hear, taste, or smell.
  • The employee must occasionally lift and/or move up to 55 pounds and frequently lift and/or move up to 55 pounds. The employee must frequently bend, twist, and reach. Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision, distance vision, color vision, peripheral vision, depth perception, and the ability to adjust focus.
  • WORK ENVIRONMENT: The work environment characteristics described are representative of those an employee encounters while performing the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodation will be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.
  • While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly exposed to extreme heat. The employee frequently works near moving mechanical parts. The employee is occasionally exposed to fumes or airborne particles. The noise level in the work environment is usually loud. Employees may be required to work outside in the summer and winter months.
Irca Group USA LLC offers career growth opportunities as well as competitive compensation and benefits: Medical, Dental, & Vision, 401(k) matching, Paid Vacation, and Holidays, Employee Education Tuition Reimbursement Program.
Irca Group USA LLC is an equal opportunity employer that is committed to diversity and inclusion in the workplace.
Salary Base Range of $20.00 - $24.50 per hour for Employees Located in Illinois. The “base salary range” provided above is a good faith estimate of what we expect to pay for this position. The range provided is for Illinois employees as Irca Group is required by Illinois State Law to post pay rates. Irca Group reserves the right to pay outside of the given range based on a variety of factors including but not limited to candidate skills and experience, complexity of the job, budgetary factors, and location/geography. Irca Group conducts regular reviews of compensation ranges and therefore reserves the right to alter this range at any given time.

title: PROFESSIONAL COUNSELOR 4
description:
About this Job



Interested in joining our team and helping to serve Acadiana with quality compassionate care?


We are looking for a Professional Counselor in our Crowley Behavioral Health Clinic with experience in providing behavioral health assessments, interventions, and counseling to individuals and their families. In this role as a Professional Counselor, you will serve as the primary counselor to individuals with acute and chronic mental illness, substance-use disorder, and co-occurring disorders.

This is a rewarding opportunity to make a meaningful impact in a supportive, mission-driven environment.

Minimum Qualifications

Possession of a current Louisiana license to practice as a Licensed Professional Counselor (LPC) or a Licensed Marriage and Family Therapist (LMFT) plus two years of licensed counseling experience.

Job Specification

The official job specifications for this role, as defined by the State Civil Service, can be found here.

Job Duties and Other Information

Job Duties:

In this role as a Professional Counselor, you will:

  • Serve as the primary counselor to individuals with acute and chronic mental illness, substance-use disorder, and co-occurring disorders.
  • Provide behavioral health assessments, working closely with other staff members to provide ongoing assessment and treatment planning for clients of the clinic and making referrals to other resources as needed.
  • Documents and updates client information and treatment plans in an EHR (Electronic Health Record) System as needed. Coordinating admissions, discharges and follow-up services within various programs and with other team members to ensure the client receives quality treatment.
  • Works in accordance with the laws, rules, regulations, policies, and procedures of all applicable licensing/governmental agencies, accreditation bodies, and within the guidelines set by the Acadiana Area Human Services District.

Position –Specific Details:

Appointment Type: Probational or Promotional

Work Schedule: Monday – Friday; 40 hours/week

Location: This position is located in the Acadiana Area Human Services District – Crowley Behavioral Health Clinic.

title: Operations Associate (Part-Time) - Summit at Fritz Farm
description:
WHY JOIN ALO?

Mindful movement. It’s at the core of why we do what we do at ALO—it’s our calling. Because mindful movement in the studio leads to better living. It changes who yogis are off the mat, making their lives and their communities better. That’s the real meaning of studio-to-street: taking the consciousness from practice on the mat and putting it into practice in life.

OBJECTIVE

The Operations Associate is critical in the store team and is responsible for driving profitability and efficiency. The Operations Associate will work closely with the Operations & Visual Management team in initiating, completing work, and providing feedback to the team to achieve optimal results supporting total store operations.

JOB RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Execute inventory management processes effectively with a focus om maximizing inventory accuracy & reducing shrink
  • Investigate and root cause inventory accuracy issues, partnering with the General/Store Manager to escalate process or system gaps
  • Support execution of key operational functions including shipment, receiving and processing, reverse transfers, sales floor recovery, intra-day sales floor replenishment, floor set updates, and supply management
  • Maintain and champion strong visual standards for the sales floor
  • Work closely with reporting, budgets, expenses, inventory control, supplies, vendor relationships, technology, and facilities to ensure maintained and maximized
  • Support a safe work environment and efficient operation through strong stockroom standards and processes
  • Move dynamically on the retail floor to assess and fulfill the needs of the business, team and guests
  • Execute company-level operations-focused directives, projects and initiates, in partnership with the Operations & Visual Management team.
  • Assists in processing shipment and ensuring product flow; including but not limited to visual merchandising placement and daily replenishment excellence
  • Demonstrate strong business acumen by leveraging metrics to support business-driving strategies
  • Resolve client needs quickly & effectively ensuring customer satisfaction
  • Identify product concerns and communicate inventory needs to support the business goals
  • Duties require constant movement in and around the store, including the sales floor and back of house. When not actively assisting guests, this position takes initiative to perform other tasks, as needed, to keep store clean, safe, inviting and operating efficiently

OPERATIONS ASSOCIATE QUALIFICATIONS

  • 1+ years prior work experience in a client-centric, sales & operational environment
  • Requires constant movement in and around all areas of store
  • Ability to lift, push, carry or otherwise move up to 50 pounds
  • Ability to lift, bend, kneel, climb, crawl and/or twist, and safely climb up/down a ladder
  • Ability to stand and move for an entire shift
  • Passion for customer service and delivering exceptional experiences
  • Self-motivated with a desire to achieve results and excel individually, and as a team
  • Aligns with and embodies ALO’s Guiding Principles

OPERATIONS ASSOCIATE SCHEDULE

Part-Time non-exempt associates are expected to work up to 30 hours per week, based on the needs of the business, for a shift minimum of 4 hours. All employees without exception are expected to be able to work during the company’s Blackout period, from the week of American Thanksgiving (including Black Friday and Thanksgiving weekend) through the end of the holiday season (the 1st week of January).

As an Equal Opportunity Employer, ALO does not discriminate against applicants or employees because of race, color, creed, religion, sex, national origin, veteran status, disability, age, citizenship, marital or domestic/civil partnership status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression or because of any other status or condition protected by applicable federal, state, or local law.

JUST SOME OF THE PERKS

title: 200 glade børn søger SFO-pædagog med timer i skole til Nr. Jernløse SFO og skole
description:
Som ny SFO-pædagog med timer i skolen er du med til at skabe rammer for det gode børneliv på Nr. Jernløse SFO og skole. Vi har nysgerrige børn, tydelige rammer samt et mangfoldigt og godt kollegafællesskab at byde dig velkommen til.

Velkommen i SFO – velkommen i skole

Nr. Jernløse skole er en stor og levende skole, der rummer knap 500 elever fra 0. – 9. klasse. Vores medarbejderstab spænder bredt og med mange gode kræfter. I skolen arbejder vi i teams på årgange og vægter det tværprofessionelle samarbejde højt.

SFO'en er en del af den samlede skole, og kan benytte alle skolens faciliteter. Omkranset af åbne og luftige områder, god legeplads, multibaner og bålhus, er der god plads til udfoldelse og til et pusterum oven på en aktiv skoledag. Hverdagen er fyldt med forskellige aktiviteter såsom krea, café, activefloor, legorum, udeliv med træværksted, mooncars og bevægelse i hallen.

Vi er 12 medarbejdere i SFO’en, og tager hver dag imod ca. 200 børn fra 0. – 6. klasse.

Vi søger nu endnu en dygtig kollega – måske det er dig?

Kan du skabe inkluderende børnefællesskaber?

Du er uddannet pædagog og sætter det enkelte barns trivsel højt. Du brænder for bevægelses – og udeaktiviteter og du kan derigennem skabe inkluderende børnefællesskaber. Du kan inspirere børn og voksne til at deltage i de aktiviteter, vi sætter i gang i børnenes fritid. Med et positivt menneskesyn og inkluderende samspil, arbejder du ud fra en anerkendende tilgang til menneskerne omkring dig, hvor du som tydelig voksen brænder for det spændende og krævende arbejde med børn – også for de af vores børn, der har brug for ekstra støtte og guidning ind i de små og store fællesskaber.

Du er begejstret for at arbejde i både SFO og skole, og drager fordel af relationerne fra SFO, når der i skolen er behov for støtte og vejledning, og omvendt følger op på dine oplevelser fra skolen, når den står på SFO-tid.

Du er pædagog med noget på hjerte og med noget i rygsækken. Børnenes trivsel skal blomstre i fællesskabet – vi inspirerer hinanden til at lykkes og er nysgerrige på, hvad du kommer med.

Vores nye kollega vil få tilbudt:

  • En delt stilling med timer i både SFO og skole
  • En spændende arbejdsplads, hvor du har rig mulighed for at skabe og få indflydelse i tæt samarbejde med pædagoger og lærere
  • En positiv arbejdskultur med et stort fokus på inklusion og trivsel
  • Et uformelt arbejdsmiljø med højt til loftet og plads til at tænke ud af boksen

Skal vi lave SFO og skole sammen? Kom og besøg os – kaffen er også god!

Kom på besøg og oplev Nr. Jernløse SFO og skole og få svar på dine spørgsmål. Kontakt mellemleder Mette Zander på mail mebis@holb.dk eller tlf. 72 36 20 34 og aftal en tid til et besøg.

Du kan lære os bedre at kende ved at besøge skolens facebookside og på vores hjemmeside kan du blive endnu klogere på både SFO-tid og skoledag.

Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig!

Ansøgningsfrist

25. september 2026.

Samtaler

Uge 40 2026.

Opstart

1.november 2026.

Vi er 4.800 engagerede kollegaer, der hver dag arbejder for at skabe god service og velfærd for vores ca. 75.000 borgere i Holbæk Kommune. Sammen bringer vi vores forskellige fagligheder i spil og skaber løsninger, der gør en reel forskel.

Vi lægger stor vægt på et godt arbejdsmiljø og på at udvikle vores medarbejdere - både fagligt og personligt.

I Holbæk Kommune arbejder vi aktivt for mangfoldige arbejdspladser, hvor der er plads til forskellighed. Alle kvalificerede ansøgere opfordres derfor til at søge stillingen - uanset køn, alder, handicap, etnicitet, politiske og religiøse overbevisninger eller seksuel orientering.

Holbæk Kommunes personalepolitik sætter rammen for vores værdier og måden, vi møder hinanden og borgerne på.

Læs mere om, hvordan det er at arbejde i Holbæk Kommune.

title: SAP CPI Consultant
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a SAP CPI Consultant based in United States.

This is a fully remote opportunity for an experienced SAP integration professional to design and deliver enterprise-grade integration solutions across complex technology environments.
You will connect SAP S/4HANA and other SAP platforms with third-party, cloud, and non-SAP systems.
The role covers the complete integration lifecycle, from requirements and architecture through development, testing, deployment, and support.
You will work extensively with SAP Integration Suite/CPI, iFlows, APIs, messaging, and integration patterns.
Your work will help organizations build reliable, secure, scalable, and maintainable enterprise integration capabilities.
You will collaborate closely with functional consultants, architects, integration partners, and business stakeholders.
This is an environment where strong technical ownership, problem-solving, and clear communication are highly valued.

Accountabilities:

  • Design, develop, test, deploy, monitor, and support enterprise integration scenarios using SAP Integration Suite/CPI.
  • Build and maintain iFlows using Groovy/Java scripting and a broad range of CPI adapters.
  • Connect SAP S/4HANA and other SAP applications with non-SAP, third-party, and cloud-based systems.
  • Apply integration patterns, middleware concepts, API management, and message-based architectures to deliver scalable solutions.
  • Support SAP API Management and event-driven integration architectures.
  • Analyze business and technical requirements and translate them into robust interface designs and implementation plans.
  • Participate in migration initiatives, including transitioning legacy SAP PI/PO interfaces to SAP CPI.
  • Implement secure integrations using standards such as OAuth2, SAML, and certificate-based authentication.
  • Troubleshoot integration issues, monitor production interfaces, resolve incidents, and provide post-go-live support.
  • Create and maintain comprehensive technical documentation for integration solutions, configurations, and operational procedures.
  • Collaborate with functional consultants, enterprise architects, business stakeholders, and integration partners throughout the delivery lifecycle.
  • Contribute to DevOps and CI/CD practices for SAP Integration Suite content transports and deployments.

    • Requirements:

    • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical discipline, or equivalent relevant experience.
    • 5+ years of SAP integration experience, including at least 3 years working with SAP Integration Suite/CPI.
    • Strong hands-on experience developing CPI iFlows, using Groovy or Java scripting, and working with multiple CPI adapters.
    • Solid understanding of enterprise integration patterns, middleware concepts, APIs, and message-based architectures.
    • Experience with SAP API Management and event-driven architecture.
    • Working knowledge of SAP PI/PO, with experience migrating PI/PO interfaces to CPI considered highly valuable.
    • Experience integrating SAP environments such as S/4HANA, ECC, SuccessFactors, Ariba, or Concur.
    • Knowledge of authentication and security standards including OAuth2, SAML, and certificate-based authentication.
    • Strong troubleshooting, analytical, documentation, and problem-solving capabilities.
    • Excellent communication and stakeholder-management skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively across technical and business teams.
    • SAP Integration Suite or CPI certification is preferred.
    • Experience with SAP Event Mesh, SAP Advanced Event Mesh, SAP BTP, or the CAP framework is a plus.
    • Familiarity with non-SAP integration platforms such as MuleSoft or Boomi is advantageous.
    • Experience with DevOps and CI/CD practices for SAP Integration Suite is preferred.

      • Benefits:

      • Salary: $100,000–$150,000 annually.
      • Work arrangement: 100% remote within the United States.
      • Employment type: Full-time, direct W2 employment.
      • Career growth: Opportunity to develop within an established technology consulting and software development environment.
      • Eligibility: U.S. Citizens, Green Card holders, EAD holders, and candidates eligible to transfer an existing H-1B are encouraged to apply.
      • Visa sponsorship: New H-1B visa petitions are not sponsored for this position.
      • Professional development: Opportunity to work with modern SAP integration technologies, cloud platforms, APIs, and enterprise architectures.
      • Inclusive workplace: Equal employment opportunity is provided to employees and applicants in accordance with applicable laws.

title: Audio Technician
description:
Title: Audio Technician
Location: Alexandria, Virginia (On-Site)

Travel: Flexibility in working hours, including occasional evenings and weekends, based on project needs.


Red Carrot is seeking an Audio Technician to join a team supporting our federal government client. The Audio Technician is responsible for setting up, operating, and maintaining audio equipment to ensure high-quality sound recording for music, voiceovers, podcasts, and live broadcasts. This role involves troubleshooting technical issues, managing audio gear inventory, collaborating with producers and clients, and providing technical support for events. Additionally, the technician ensures compliance with safety and copyright regulations while preparing reports on completed tasks, equipment status, and process improvements.

Key Responsibilities:
  1. Recording and Production:
    • Set up and operate audio equipment, including microphones, mixing consoles, signal processors, and recording software.
    • Record music, voiceovers, podcasts, and broadcasts.
    • Ensure high-quality sound during recording sessions by monitoring audio levels, adjusting EQ, and managing signal flow.
    • Collaborate with producers and directors to achieve the desired sound and mood.
  2. Equipment Management:
    • Maintain and troubleshoot audio equipment, ensuring all gear is in working order.
    • Manage inventory of audio equipment and software, recommending upgrades or replacements as needed.
    • Assist in the setup and breakdown of audio equipment for live events and broadcasts.
  3. Collaboration and Communication:
    • Work closely with team members to ensure audio aligns with the overall project vision.
    • Provide creative input during production meetings and contribute to brainstorming sessions.
    • Communicate effectively with clients to understand their audio needs and deliver high-quality results.
  4. Technical Support and Speaker Setup:
    • Provide technical support during recording sessions, live events, and broadcasts.
    • Troubleshoot and resolve any audio-related issues that arise during production.
    • Set up and optimize speaker systems for events, ensuring clear and balanced sound coverage across the venue.
  5. Reporting:
    • Prepare and submit weekly and monthly reports detailing completed tasks, ongoing projects, equipment status, and any issues encountered.
    • Provide insights and recommendations in reports to improve audio production processes and equipment usage.
  6. Compliance and Safety:
    • Adhere to safety protocols for handling audio equipment.
    • Ensure compliance with copyright laws and licensing requirements for audio content.
Qualifications:
  • Experience: 3+ years of experience in a professional recording studio or broadcast environment.
  • Technical Skills:
    • Strong understanding of signal flow, audio routing, and patching.
    • Knowledge of audio processing tools, including EQ, compression, reverb, and other effects.
    • Familiarity with various microphone types, placement techniques, and recording environments.
  • Soft Skills:
    • Excellent problem-solving and troubleshooting abilities.
    • Strong communication and interpersonal skills.
    • Attention to detail and a commitment to delivering high-quality work.
    • Ability to work under pressure and meet tight deadlines.
Work Environment:
  • Must be able to work in a fast-paced studio environment with tight deadlines.
  • Flexibility to work irregular hours, including nights and weekends, depending on project requirements.
Physical Requirements:
  • Ability to lift and move audio equipment as needed.
  • Ability to sit or stand for extended periods during recording sessions.

Benefits at Red Carrot:

At Red Carrot, we empower you to be a leader. We attract and develop talent from all backgrounds because we believe there’s strength in diversity, offering different perspectives and skills. Together, we can solve our client’s biggest challenges. We offer a competitive compensation and benefits package.

  • Training and Development – Tuition reimbursement and professional trainings for eligible employees.
  • Healthcare – Top-tier medical, dental, vision, life insurance and long-term disability coverage.
  • 401(k) Plan – 401(k)-retirement and Roth plan with company matching and no vesting period.
  • Profit Sharing – Discretionary profit-sharing plan to all eligible employees after one year of employment.
  • Paid Time Off – Provides flexible work hours, paid time off, and 11 federal holidays.

About Us:

Red Carrot is an award-winning, woman-owned small business built for the complexity of federal government work. We partner with clients to advance their goals — powered by a team fueled by passion, backed by intelligence, and grounded in expertise.

From day one, we've applied industrial engineering principles and data analytics to solve complex problems with precision. Our approach is research-centric, data-informed, and audience-oriented — and it's how we deliver work that actually moves the needle.

We exist to strengthen the organizations and communities we serve through trusted, purposeful communication. That's not a tagline — it's the standard we hold ourselves to on every engagement.

Headquartered in Miami, Florida, with a strong and growing presence in Washington, D.C., our team works with clients across the country. Distance doesn't dilute our service. We build capacity where our clients need it, delivering Strategic Communications, Customer Experience, Management Consulting, and Human Capital Solutions that fit their mission — and their moment.

We're the partner organizations turn to when communication challenges are real, the stakes are high, and the work has to matter.

title: Skarp tilbudsberegner til Benny Petersen A/S
description:

Vi søger dig, som er en haj til beregning af hoved- fag- og storentrepriser inden for jord-, kloak-, anlægs- og forsyningsarbejder. Du har god mulighed for at sætte dit præg på processer og systemer, og har du en dygtig assistent i ærmet, er vi også åbne for at hyre jer begge to.

Samarbejde på tværs

Du bliver en del af et engageret fællesskab på 65 kollegaer med forskellige kompetencer. Du ser derfor stor værdi i diversitet, og du kan rumme mange forskellige kollegaer.

I dit daglige arbejde kan du trække på vores HR- og arbejdsmiljøtovholder, der bidrager i tilbudsgivningen med de bløde værdier samt vores projektledere, der hver især bidrager med input og teknisk viden til tilbudsberegningen. Du skal med andre ord trives i at samarbejde med forskellige kollegaer for at nå målet på bedste vis. Vi anerkendes af bygherrer og kunder for at mestre komplekse problemstillinger med intelligente løsninger, og dem tænker vi os frem til i fællesskab.

Det vi laver

Vi udfører arbejder i hoved- fag- og storentrepriser inden for anlægsopgaver med vand, kloak og fjernvarme for offentlige og private bygherrer. Som entreprenør på store projekter er fleksibilitet og bygherrens tilfredshed nøgleord. Og vi leverer altid kvalitetsarbejde til konkurrencedygtige priser og prioriterer, at vi til enhver tid overholder aftalte betingelser og leveringstider.

Jobbeskrivelse

  • Du har et strategisk overblik over markedssituationen i forhold til prissætning
  • Du får ansvar for gennemgang af udbud samt kalkulation af tilbud i en størrelsesorden fra 10.000 kr. – 75 mio. kr. og indhenter i den forbindelse bl.a. priser fra leverandører og underentreprenører
  • Du får ansvar for udarbejdelsen af de ”bløde værdier” som tidsplaner, organisationsdiagrammer og løsning af cases i udbudsfasen
  • Du får ansvar for sagen fra første kontakt fra kunden og til sagen overdrages til driften
  • Du laver opsøgende arbejde i forbindelse med prækvalifikationer og tilbud
  • Du arbejder som udgangspunkt fra vores kontor i Jerslev, nær Kalundborg, men her er mulighed for ugentligt hjemmearbejde.

Om dig

Du stortrives i en hverdag, hvor du arbejder selvstændigt, og du er god til at spørge om hjælp og input hos øvrige kollegaer.

Derudover anses du som en person, der:

  • har let ved at danne dig et overblik og gennemskue projekters kompleksitet ud fra beskrivelser og tegninger
  • har kendskab til og interesse for markedet i anlægsbranchen
  • læner dig op ad dine strukturer i en travl hverdag
  • deltager i udvikling og implementering af nye systemer og processer

Dine tekniske specifikationer

  • du har minimum 7 års veldokumenteret erfaring med beregning af jord- kloak- og fjernvarmeprojekter, samt anlægsprojekter generelt.
  • du har en relevant uddannelse inden for anlægsbranchen, fx bygningskonstruktør, ingeniør eller autoriseret kloakmester
  • du har kendskab til lovgivning og sikkerhedskrav i anlægsbranchen
  • du er IT-superbruger, specielt i Sigma og Excel
  • du har gode danskkundskaber og formulerer dig professionelt og velformuleret, især på skrift

Vi tilbyder

  • Indflydelse, ansvar og frie rammer i en virksomhed, hvor dine fagligt funderede meninger og holdninger værdsættes
  • En plads på et stærkt team i en spændende udvikling, hvor du sætter dit præg på fremtidens projekter og løsninger
  • En hverdag hvor vindermentaliteten skinner igennem dine løsninger og arbejdsprocesser
  • Indflydelse på udviklingen af processer og systemer i tilbudsafdelingen
  • Fleksible arbejdstider og mulighed for hjemmearbejde
  • God lønpakke

title: Visitatorer til Københavns Kommune (sygeplejerske, fysio- eller ergoterapeut) til myndighedsafdelingen Syd i Sundheds- og Omsorgsforvaltningen
description:
Vil du være en del af en spændende myndighedsafdeling, hvor der er fokus på forløbskoordinering og tovholderopgaven for at understøtte vores borgere bedst muligt? Vil du være med til at sikre, at borgerne får den rette hjælp på det rette tidspunkt, samt implementere- og udvikle tiltag blandt andet i forbindelse med den nye ældrelov og tværfaglige teams med nærvisitation? Så skal du søge en stilling hos os.

Da vores kollegaer har søgt nye udfordringer, har du nu mulighed for at komme med på holdet i Visitation Syd.

I Visitation Syd arbejder vi med helhedssagsbehandling, der bidrager til at sikre kvalitet og effektivitet i de enkelte forløb. Du vil få kolleger med en bred faglig erfaring og viden. Vi har fokus på vidensdeling, tværfagligt samarbejde og kollegial sparring for at sikre ensartet serviceniveau i forhold til vores sagsbehandling, som oftest er præget af stor kompleksitet. Til at hjælpe os med at understøtte myndighedsfunktionen, søger vi visitatorer til følgende myndighedsopgaver.

De primære arbejdsopgaver vil være

  • at deltage i tværfaglige borgermøder med hjemme- og sygepleje
  • koordination af borgerforløb og medvirken til at sikre kontinuitet
  • sagsbehandling af ansøgninger efter ældreloven og serviceloven indenfor personlig pleje og praktisk hjælp, pleje- og ældreboliger, midlertidige døgnophold, tekniske hjælpemidler, boligindretning og genoptræning m.v.
  • visitationsbesøg i borgers hjem og på midlertidigpladser med henblik på vurdering af borgerens videre forløb
  • administrativ sagsbehandling
  • demensforløbskoordination
  • medvirken til at fremme tværfagligt samarbejde internt i afdelingen og på tværs i organisationen
  • kontakt med interne og eksterne samarbejdspartnere, pårørende og borgere
Vi forventer, at du

  • er uddannet fysioterapeut, ergoterapeut eller sygeplejerske
  • er professionel og fagligt dygtig, gerne med erfaring og/eller kendskab til myndighedsområdet
  • bidrager til et godt arbejdsfællesskab og arbejdsmiljø
  • løbende reflekterer over egen praksis og ønsker at udvikle dine personlige og faglige kompetencer
  • har et godt overblik, kan arbejde selvstændigt, men også agere i en tværfaglig opgaveløsning og i et tværfagligt team
  • kan prioritere mellem flere samtidige opgaver
  • er handlekraftig og beslutningskompetent
  • deltager aktivt i sparring med dine kolleger og samarbejdspartnere
  • har en anerkendende tilgang til vores borgere, dine kolleger og øvrige samarbejdspartnere
  • har gode kommunikationsevner både mundtligt og skriftligt, da du får en stor kontaktflade med mange forskellige samarbejdspartnere
Vi lægger desuden vægt på, at du har fokus på helheden, og at du naturligt inddrager relevante samarbejdspartnere i borgerforløb med udgangspunkt i borgerens ønsker og behov.

Du bliver en del af en afdeling med

  • stor selvstændighed i forhold til opgaveløsning
  • faglig sparring med kollegaer, faglige koordinationer, ressourcepersoner samt ledere
  • høj grad af tværfagligt samarbejde
  • et godt og stærkt arbejdsmiljø, som er baseret på høj faglighed, respekt for hinanden og hjælpsomhed
  • et grundigt introduktionsprogram
  • fleksibel arbejdstid med flekstidsordning
  • en arbejdsplads i udvikling, hvor du inspireres og udfordres i dit daglige virke
  • en organisation, hvor der er fokus på kerneopgaven
Ansættelsesvilkår
Løn- og ansættelsesvilkår efter gældende overenskomst og indenfor rammerne af lokal løndannelse.

Stillingerne er på 37 timer ugentligt – vi arbejder ud fra flekstid og arbejdstiden er fordelt på hverdage i dagtimerne.

Stillingerne er til besættelse 1. november 2026.

Hvis du tidligere har været ansat i Københavns Kommune, gælder desuden
Hvis du kommer i betragtning til at blive tilbudt en stilling på en kommunal enhed, vil vi tjekke, om du inden for de seneste tre år er blevet opsagt eller bortvist fra kommunen og dele relevante oplysninger herom med den ansættende leder. Det kan også være oplysninger om strafbare forhold, der har ført til opsigelse eller bortvisning fra Københavns Kommune, oplysninger om misbrug af rusmidler som fx positiv alkoholtest eller oplysning om sygehistorik, der kan få væsentlig betydning for en ny ansættelse i kommunen. Dette gælder ikke ved ansættelse på selvejende plejehjem. Læs mere om reference-tjek her.

Praktisk information
Ønsker du yderligere oplysninger, er du velkommen til at kontakte afdelingsleder Julia Djenner på 27 22 77 57 eller afdelingsleder Mia Binderup på 51 85 36 92.

Du bedes sende dit CV og ansøgning.

Visitationen Syd er beliggende på Krumtappen 2, 2500 Valby, tæt på Valby Station.

Samtaler vil finde sted i uge 39.

title: Engageret social- og sundhedsassistent søges til dagvagtsstilling på Skovbrynets Plejeboliger
description:
På Skovbrynets Plejeboliger søger vi en engageret social- og sundhedsassistent til dagvagt, som ønsker at være en del af et stærkt fagligt fællesskab, hvor omsorg, kvalitet og livsglæde går hånd i hånd.

Hos os får du mulighed for at bringe din faglighed i spil, tage ansvar og bidrage til udviklingen af plejen for vores beboere. Vi tror på, at høj faglighed skabes gennem samarbejde, nysgerrighed og gensidig respekt, og vi ved, at et godt grin og en positiv tilgang gør selv travle dage lettere.

Om jobbet

Skovbrynets Plejeboliger er hjem for 24 beboere, og vi arbejder hver dag for at skabe en tryg, hjemlig og meningsfuld hverdag med udgangspunkt i den enkelte beboers ønsker, behov og ressourcer.

Stillingen er som udgangspunkt på 37 timer ugentligt i dagvagt, men vi er fleksible i forhold til timetal, hvis du ønsker færre timer.

Som social- og sundhedsassistent vil du i tæt samarbejde med dine kolleger:

  • Planlægge, udføre, evaluere og dokumentere pleje- og omsorgsindsatser.
  • Varetage sygeplejefaglige observationer og opgaver.
  • Bidrage til det rehabiliterende arbejde med fokus på borgernes selvbestemmelse og livskvalitet.
  • Sikre høj kvalitet i dokumentationen og være med til at understøtte den faglige udvikling i hverdagen.
  • Deltage aktivt i tværfagligt samarbejde omkring beboernes trivsel og sundhed.

Ingen dage er ens hos os, og derfor får du en alsidig hverdag med både ansvar, faglige udfordringer og mulighed for at gøre en mærkbar forskel.

Vi forestiller os, at du
  • Er uddannet social- og sundhedsassistent, gerne med erfaring fra ældreområdet.
  • Har faglig stolthed og ønsker løbende at udvikle dine kompetencer.
  • Arbejder ud fra beboernes ønsker og behov og har blik for det hele menneske.
  • Trives med både selvstændigt ansvar og tæt samarbejde med kolleger.
  • Har gode kommunikative evner og bidrager positivt til fællesskabet.
  • Arbejder struktureret og bevarer overblikket i en omskiftelig hverdag.
  • Tænker rehabiliterende og ser muligheder frem for begrænsninger.
  • Er fortrolig med IT og dokumentation og forstår betydningen af høj dokumentationskvalitet.
  • Møder kolleger, beboere og pårørende med respekt, nærvær og godt humør.
Derfor skal du vælge os
  • Skovbrynet er et lille plejecenter med 24 boliger fordelt på to etager, som hører under plejecenter Sjælsø
  • Vi ligger centralt placeret i Holte, tæt på stationen
  • Vi har en dejlig have, egen bus til ture og højt til loftet
  • Vi prioriterer det sunde arbejdsmiljø, en høj faglighed og masser af arbejdsglæde – og så lykkes vi altså bedst i fællesskab.
Vi tilbyder
  • Engagerede og hjælpsomme kolleger, som løfter i fællesskab.
  • Triage og tværfaglige møder med fokus på faglig sparring og kvalitet.
  • Mulighed for at bidrage til kompetenceudvikling og læringsmiljøer.
  • Grundig introduktion og oplæring.
  • En arbejdsplads med plads til humor, forskellighed og godt kollegaskab.
  • En ledelse, der vægter tillid, dialog og medarbejdernes faglige udvikling.
Om os

På Skovbrynets Plejeboliger arbejder vi ud fra en fælles ambition om at skabe de bedste rammer for et godt ældre liv. Vi tror på, at beboernes livskvalitet styrkes gennem nærværende relationer, høj faglighed og medarbejdere, der trives.

Vi søger derfor en kollega, der både vil være med til at skabe gode dage for vores beboere og bidrage til et arbejdsmiljø, hvor vi hjælper hinanden, lærer sammen og har det godt, mens vi går på arbejde.

Om Rudersdal Kommune

I Rudersdal Kommune tror vi på, at vi kun lykkes i fællesskab. Derfor er det vores mål, at alle kommunens medarbejdere og ledere i alle opgaver - og i fællesskab - arbejder for at skabe bæredygtige løsninger, der giver værdi for borgerne, virksomheden og det samfund, vi er en del af. Se vores film om Rudersdal Kommunes strategi og værdier ”Vi lykkes kun i fællesskab” HER

Ansøgning, samtale og kontakt

Du søger jobbet ved at klikke på knappen "Søg stilling" nedenfor.

title: IT Director
description:
IT Director
Charlotte, NC or Buffalo, NY — Hybrid | Full Time | Corporate / Information Technology

About Us

Affinity Group is one of the fastest-growing food sales and marketing agencies in North America. The company represents major food brands and partners with distributors and operators across its Food Service and Retail divisions. Our stated purpose is “Your Bridge to Success.”

Position Summary

The IT Director leads Affinity Group’s day-to-day technology operations, keeping systems, networks, and business applications running reliably across a hybrid, multi-office workforce. This role oversees IT support, infrastructure, security, and vendor relationships, and partners with leadership across the Food Service and Retail divisions to plan and deliver technology that supports the business.

Scope of the Role

  • People Supported: About 850 people across the organization.
  • Offices: 41 offices, each fronted by its own firewall.
  • Wireless & Switching Sites: 36 of those offices with local switching and wireless on site, covering 33 switches and 63 access points.
  • Servers: About a dozen Windows servers on two hypervisors at two sites, plus two domain controllers and a Remote Desktop farm.
  • Team: Two IT technicians as direct reports. MSP
  • Regions: Six U.S. regions, plus Canada, plus two acquired companies that currently keep their own systems.

Key Responsibilities

  • IT Operations: Manage day-to-day IT operations, including network, server, endpoint, and cloud infrastructure across all Affinity Group offices.
  • Support & Help Desk: Lead and prioritize the IT help desk function, ensuring timely resolution of employee support requests and tracking recurring issues.
  • Systems Administration: Administer core business systems and platforms (e.g., Microsoft 365, CRM, and other line-of-business applications), coordinating upgrades, integrations, and access management.
  • Security & Compliance: Implement and maintain data security, backup, and disaster recovery practices; monitor for vulnerabilities and coordinate remediation.
  • Vendor & Third-Party Risk: Manage relationships with IT vendors, the managed service provider, and telecom/internet carriers, including contract renewals, performance, and assessment of third-party security and business risk.
  • Budget & Planning: Plan and track the IT budget, evaluate new tools and equipment purchases, and recommend cost-effective solutions.
  • Projects: Lead technology rollouts (new hardware, software, or office setups) from planning through deployment and training.
  • AI Governance: Own governance of AI-assisted tools and automation used within IT, ensuring their use follows Affinity Group's AI and development policies and gets appropriate review.
  • Strategy & Growth: Partner with senior leadership on the IT roadmap and budget as the business grows, including evaluating what stays in-house versus with outside partners.
  • Cross-Team Collaboration: Partner with Sales, Marketing, and Operations leaders across both divisions to understand technology needs and support regional teams.
  • Documentation & Training: Maintain documentation for systems, processes, and IT policies, and train employees on tools and security best practices.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in information technology, Computer Science, or a related field, or equivalent hands-on experience.
  • Prior experience managing IT operations, systems administration, or a help desk/support function.
Hands-on ability across the following areas:
  • Microsoft 365 and Microsoft Entra ID administration, including Exchange Online, SharePoint, Teams, and licensing.
  • Microsoft Intune and Windows endpoint management.
  • Windows Server, Active Directory, Group Policy, Hyper-V, and Remote Desktop Services.
  • Backup and recovery, and infrastructure monitoring.
  • Business network administration across many small offices, including Cisco Meraki firewalls, Aruba Instant On switching and wireless, and domain name service.
  • Endpoint and email security, multi-factor authentication, and a password vault.
  • Microsoft Azure at a small-business scale, including scheduled automation and secret storage.
  • IT service management in a help desk platform, including assets, change, and a knowledge base.
  • PowerShell scripting, source control, and AI-assisted automation.
  • Vendor and license management for hardware, software, and telecommunications.
  • Strong written and verbal communication, with the ability to explain technical topics to non-technical staff.
  • Proactive, detail-oriented, and comfortable managing multiple priorities across a distributed, multi-office organization.
Nice to Have:
  • Microsoft certifications relevant to this environment (e.g., Microsoft 365 Certified: Administrator Expert, Azure Administrator Associate, or Security Operations Analyst Associate).
  • ITIL Foundation, for IT service management practice.
  • PMP or a similar project management certification.
  • A security certification such as CompTIA Security+ or (ISC)² SSCP/CISSP.

What to Expect

  • Full-time schedule; hybrid work arrangement with in-office days at the assigned location.
  • Availability for occasional after-hours or on-call support for critical system issues.
  • Some travel to regional offices may be required.
  • Prolonged computer work.

Benefits

  • Medical, dental, and vision coverage.
  • 401(k) retirement plan.
  • Paid time off and company holidays.

Equal Opportunity Statement

Affinity Group is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, or other applicable legally protected characteristics. Employment decisions are based on qualifications, merit, and business need.

The Affinity Group is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, gender (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, or other applicable legally protected characteristics. All employment is decided on the basis of qualifications, merit, and business need.

title: Tilkaldevikarer til Huset William
description:
Kunne du tænke dig at prøve kræfter med omsorgsfaget?
Eller har du allerede erfaring og ved, hvor meget det betyder at gøre hverdagen bedre for ældre mennesker?
Så læs videre her.

Hos Huset William i Valby søger vi medarbejdere, der kunne tænke sig at arbejde fast hver 2. eller 3. weekend og tilkaldevikarer, der kan træde til ved sygdom, ferie og lignende i dagvagter og aftenvagter.

Har du lyst til at være med til at skabe tryghed, nærvær og gode stunder for vores beboere, så skriv straks til os. Her er det ikke bare et arbejde – det handler om mennesker, værdighed, respekt og retten til selv at bestemme over sit eget liv. Og bare rolig – du bliver ikke kastet ud på dybt vand uden redningsvest. Hos os får du en god oplæring, hjælpsomme kolleger og en hverdag, hvor vi løfter i flok, tænker kreativt og altid har beboernes trivsel i centrum.

Lidt om jobbet
Vi leder både efter faglærte og ufaglærte – erfaring er et plus, men bestemt ikke et krav. Måske er du i gang med en sundhedsfaglig uddannelse, eller måske holder du sabbatår og vil tjene lidt ekstra (og få noget virkelig meningsfuldt på CV’et samtidig). Det vigtigste? At du er nysgerrig, er omsorgsfuld, møder vores beboere, der, hvor de er, og har lyst til at lære.

Hvorfor vælge os?
Fordi du ikke bare bliver 'vikaren' – du bliver en del af fællesskabet. Her er plads til at stille spørgsmål, prøve ting af og udvikle dig – uanset om du er ny eller erfaren. Hos os får du mulighed for at

  • arbejde tæt sammen med dygtige, engagerede kolleger
  • bruge og udvikle dine kompetencer (ja, vi tror på dig)
  • blive en del af en mangfoldig arbejdsplads
  • opleve en hverdag, hvor værdier ikke bare er noget, vi skriver, men noget, vi gør
  • vi har gratis parkering
Vi håber, at du

  • har lyst til at arbejde med mennesker, der har behov for støtte
  • er ansvarsbevidst, fleksibel og mødestabil (vi lover at være det samme den anden vej)
  • kan tage ansvar, når du er her
Ansættelsesvilkår
Løn- og ansættelsesvilkår i henhold til gældende overenskomst. Vi indhenter straffeattest og referencer fra tidligere arbejdspladser.

Mere information

title: Specjalista ds. Ochrony Środowiska (k/m/n)
description:
Aldesa Polska Services Sp. z o.o.

Jesteśmy częścią globalnej grupy budowlanej Aldesa, która od ponad 50 lat prowadzi projekty budowlane na rynku międzynarodowym. W Polsce od 2007 roku, zrealizowaliśmy ponad 60 projektów! Nasze doświadczenie obejmuje działalność w sektorach: budowlanym, energetycznym, przemysłowym, energii odnawialnej, drogowym, kolejowym (metro i tramwaje) oraz nieruchomości. Kluczem do sukcesu firmy jest znajomość lokalnych uwarunkowań, międzynarodowych standardów pracy, indywidualne podejście do klienta oraz umiejętność adaptacji do zmieniających się wymagań rynku i potrzeb klientów, trafny dobór realizowanych projektów, a także ciągłe poszukiwanie nowych, lepszych rozwiązań. Aldesa tworzy wartość dodaną na każdym projekcie i oferuje klientom bardziej wszechstronne i efektywne kosztowo rozwiązania bez zaniedbywania efektywnego zarządzania terminami.

📍 Lokalizacja : Gdynia
🛠 Stanowisko : Specjalista ds. Ochrony Środowiska (k/m/n)

Twój zakres obowiązków:

  • nadzorowanie przestrzegania wymagań i przepisów dotyczących ochrony środowiska przez pracowników oraz podwykonawców,

  • prowadzenie gospodarki odpadami na projekcie, w tym obsługa BDO i kontrola miejsc magazynowania odpadów,

  • przygotowywanie raportów, zestawień i sprawozdań dotyczących działań środowiskowych,

  • opracowywanie, weryfikacja i aktualizacja dokumentacji z zakresu ochrony środowiska,

title: Senior Staff Product Manager, Browser Control Platform
description:
Why Mozilla?

Mozilla Corporation is the non-profit-backed technology company that has shaped the internet for the better over the last 25 years. We make pioneering brands like Firefox, the privacy-minded web browser. Now, with more than 225 million people around the world using our products each month, we’re shaping the next 25 years of technology and helping to reclaim an internet built for people, not companies. Our work focuses on diverse areas including AI, social media, security and more. And we’re doing this while never losing our focus on our core mission – to make the internet better for people.

The Mozilla Corporation is wholly owned by the non-profit 501(c) Mozilla Foundation. This means we aren’t beholden to any shareholders — only to our mission. Along with thousands of volunteer contributors and collaborators all over the world, Mozillians design, build and distribute open-source software that enables people to enjoy the internet on their terms.

About this team and role:

This role owns the foundation that lets other software drive Firefox: the secure, reliable connection an outside tool or another team uses to act inside the browser, and the building blocks they call to do it. It enables the teams building on it — internal teams, outside AI tools — to create their own products on top. This role owns the shared layer and the strategy for it. It’s a hands-on, technical role in a fast-moving, greenfield space, so it’s as much strategy as execution.

The opportunity is broad: internal teams (Smart Window, New Products’ automated tools), outside AI tools and their users, and web developers. The three share much of the underlying technology, but each reaches its market in a different way. The mandate is to figure out what to go after, and in what order.

What you’ll do:
  • Own the shared foundation and the building blocks it gives other software, and make them reliable and secure.
  • Push the open standard (WebDriver BiDi) forward, and build Firefox-only advantages the standard won’t cover
  • Design the safety controls: let a person approve actions, see when software is acting for them, and take back control.
  • Define the strategy for any major third-party AI assistants people already use.
  • Serve internal teams (Smart Window, New Products) and outside tools through one shared layer.
Measured on:

Adoption across teams and tools, volume of usage through the platform, and sustained reliability and security.

What you'll bring:
  • A product-minded engineer, or a very technical PM who can drive a technical product
  • Developer-space experience, with the range to think about consumers and internal platforms
  • Comfortable setting strategy in ambiguity; own a technical contract other teams depend on
  • Strong instincts on security and trust. Nice to have: web standards, MCP, browser automation

What you’ll get:

  • Generous performance-based bonus plans to all eligible employees - we share in our success as one team
  • Rich medical, dental, and vision coverage
  • Generous retirement contributions with 100% immediate vesting (regardless of whether you contribute)
  • Quarterly all-company wellness days where everyone takes a pause together
  • Country specific holidays plus a day off for your birthday
  • One-time home office stipend
  • Annual professional development budget
  • Quarterly well-being stipend
  • Considerable paid parental leave
  • Employee referral bonus program
  • Other benefits (life/AD&D, disability, EAP, etc. - varies by country)

About Mozilla

Mozilla exists to build the Internet as a public resource accessible to all because we believe that open and free is better than closed and controlled. When you work at Mozilla, you give yourself a chance to make a difference in the lives of Web users everywhere. And you give us a chance to make a difference in your life every single day. Join us to work on the Web as the platform and help create more opportunity and innovation for everyone online.

Commitment to diversity, equity, inclusion, and belonging

Mozilla understands that valuing diverse creative practices and forms of knowledge are crucial to and enrich the company’s core mission. We encourage applications from everyone, including members of all equity-seeking communities, such as (but certainly not limited to) women, racialized and Indigenous persons, persons with disabilities, persons of all sexual orientations, gender identities, and expressions.

We will ensure that qualified individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodations to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment, as appropriate. Please contact us at hiringaccommodation@mozilla.com to request accommodation.

We are an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race (including hairstyle and texture), religion (including religious grooming and dress practices), gender, gender identity, gender expression, color, national origin, pregnancy, ancestry, domestic partner status, disability, sexual orientation, age, genetic predisposition, medical condition, marital status, citizenship status, military or veteran status, or any other basis covered by applicable laws. Mozilla will not tolerate discrimination or harassment based on any of these characteristics or any other unlawful behavior, conduct, or purpose.
