title: Student Assistant for International Partnerships
description:
Team International Partnerships is looking for a student assistant.

You will become part of one of the university’s core support functions: Department for Office for Research, Advice and Innovation in the Partnership Office consisting of about 15 employees. You will work in the team "International Partnerships” consisting of experienced project managers, giving you quality sparring and guidance.

The job
In the team for International Partnerships, we develop DTU’s strategic international co-operation and create contact with new collaboration partners. Thereby giving increased opportunities for researchers and students to collaborate with strong technical universities around the world. For instance, DTU is a member of established alliances like Nordic Five Tech and EuroTech Universities Alliance, in addition we have strong relations with several overseas universities.

As our new student assistant you will mainly assist with tasks connected to DTU’s chairmanship of Nordic Five Tech in 2027 and preparation of this. Moreover, we need support with:
  • desk research for different projects.
  • preparation of presentations and documentation in the department.
  • creation of online surveys and the evaluation of results.
  • workshops/events, hereunder practical tasks.

Our expectations of you
We imagine that you are currently enrolled in a relevant university education program and share our interest in international collaboration. We are looking for a new colleague who:
  • Has an interest in and/or experience with Nordic collaboration
  • Has skills within data analysis and visualization
  • Has experience with using Microsoft office tools
  • Is fluent in English, both written and verbal – knowledge of Danish is an advantage
  • Thrives on making complicated content easy to understand
  • Views new tasks as positive challenges
  • Takes both initiative and responsibility for your assigned tasks

What we offer in return
You will get an interesting and challenging job with a wide variety of tasks on which we offer you ongoing sparring. You will work closely with enthusiastic colleagues with a passion for bringing international collaboration partners and DTU closer together. We are flexible and accommodating in relation to your study program.

Salary and appointment terms
The appointment will be based on the multi-union collective agreement for the Organisations of Public Employees—Denmark (State) (OAO-S) and the trade union agreement for clerical staff, Section 35 (HK/State). The hourly wage ranges from DKK 145,73 - 152,88, depending on seniority.

Working hours are on average 15 hours per week and can be organized flexibly in relation to holidays, exams, etc. Starting date is November 1 (or according to mutual agreement). The employment runs as long as you are an active student.

Students who have completed two years of a medium higher education programme (MVU) or a long higher education programme (LVU) may be granted a qualification allowance of DKK 3.64 per hour.

You will refer to Ulla Høeberg Jørgensen, team lead in Department for Office for Research, Advice and Innovation. Your primary place of work will be DTU Lyngby Campus, Anker Engelunds Vej 1, 2800 Lyngby. Working from home to some extent will also be possible.

Application and contact
Please submit your online application no later than 20 September 2026 (23:59 Danish time). Open the “Apply now” link, fill out the form and attach your motivated application, CV and documentation for study activity. In the application, we would like to hear a little about you, your competencies and why you are applying for the position.

If you would like additional information about the position, please contact team lead, Ulla Høeberg Jørgensen on +45 27 21 59 55. Read more about international collaboration with DTU here.

Applications received after the deadline will not be considered.

All interested candidates irrespective of age, gender, disability, race, religion or ethnic background are encouraged to apply. As DTU works with research in critical technology, which is subject to special rules for security and export control, open-source background checks may be conducted on qualified candidates for the position.

DTU – For the benefit of society since 1829
DTU is one of Europe's leading elite technical universities. Through research and education at an international top level, we create solutions to the major societal challenges of our time and help secure Europe's global leadership in sustainable technological development. Since Hans Christian Ørsted founded DTU almost 200 years ago, our mission has remained the same: We develop and create value through the natural and technical sciences for the benefit of society. DTU has 13,800 students, 1,600 PhD students, and 6,500 employees. We work in an international environment and have an inclusive, stimulating, and informal work culture. DTU has campuses in all parts of Denmark and in Greenland and collaborates with the best universities around the world.

title: Vice President of Contracts
description:
Vice President of Contracts

Work Location: Huntsville, AL

Schedule: Full Time; 40 hours per week remote work not authorized

Position Summary

IronMountain Solutions, Inc. is a premier government contracting company based in Huntsville, Alabama, dedicated to delivering critical services and solutions to the Department of War and other federal agencies. We are seeking a highly strategic and experienced Vice President of Contracts to join our corporate division. This executive will lead our overarching contracts, procurement, and pricing strategies while managing a robust portfolio of major contract vehicles.

The Vice President of Contracts is a critical executive leadership role responsible for the comprehensive oversight of the company’s Contracts, Procurement, Project Control, and Pricing departments. This role demands an expert in government contracting who can champion corporate regulatory compliance, optimize procurement processes, and ensure flawless execution of highly complex DoD proposals. The ideal candidate will bring extensive experience navigating and administering major federal acquisition vehicles alongside strong corporate compliance and negotiation expertise.

Key Responsibilities

Executive Leadership & Strategic Oversight

  • Lead and direct all activities across the Contracts, Procurement, Project Control, and Pricing divisions.
  • Standardize and optimize processes for procuring direct-charge services and materials across all corporate divisions.
  • Provide internal corporate contracts legal and governance oversight.

Supervisory & Team Leadership

  • Provide direct supervision, mentorship, and strategic direction to department directors, managers, and administrative staff across the organization's contracting and pricing verticals.
  • Manage personnel actions, including interviewing, hiring, conducting performance evaluations, and guiding career development for department employees.
  • Lead comprehensive onboarding and compliance education, including issuing and facilitating new hire training for critical programs like Export Compliance.
  • Ensure optimal workload distribution, delegate high-priority assignments, and maintain adequate staffing levels to support seamless contract execution and high-volume proposal development.

Contract Administration & Vehicle Management

  • Oversee, administer, and drive task order growth across IMS’s prime and sub-contract portfolios, managing Multi-Agency Contracts (MACs), Indefinite Delivery Indefinite Quantity (IDIQ) contracts, Government-Wide Acquisition Contracts (GWACs), Blanket Purchase Agreements (BPAs), and Other Transaction Authorities (OTAs).
    • The portfolio includes, but is not limited to: EXPRESS, EWAAC (Eglin Wide Agile Acquisition Contract), GSA (Multiple Award Schedules), MDA Shield, OASIS+ (One Acquisition Solution for Integrated Services Plus), and SeaPort-NxG.
  • Draft, review, and negotiate a high volume of complex contractual documents, including Prime Contracts, Subcontracts, Teaming Agreements, Non-Disclosure Agreements, Consulting Agreements, and Leases.
  • Manage subcontractor pipelines, including issuing funding documents, verifying labor category qualifications, and overseeing monthly deliverables and invoicing.

Compliance & Regulatory Affairs

  • Maintain strict company-wide regulatory and legal compliance with FAR, DFARS, CPSR, SCA, ISO, and CMMI standards.
  • Lead the IMS Export Compliance program across the company, encompassing the submission of licenses to the State Department and Department of Commerce.
  • Develop, implement, and monitor Exporting Policy & Procedures, including the facilitation of new hire training and tracking of export activities.

Proposal Development & Pricing Strategy

  • Partner closely with Business Development, Task Leads, Vice Presidents, and the Pricing department to develop and submit fully compliant proposals for vehicle on-ramps and multi-million-dollar task orders.
  • Ensure all proposals are accurately priced and that all necessary contractual documentation is submitted exactly as mandated by the RFP.
  • Provide robust Cost Volume proposal support, including labor category mapping, utilizing salary survey data, conducting price build-ups, and creating cost narratives.
  • While performing the duties of this job, the employee is occasionally required to stand; walk; sit; use tools or controls; normal physical activity (reach with hands and arms; climb stairs): and communicate effectively with all levels of employees and leadership. The employee must occasionally lift or move office products and supplies up to 25 pounds.

Basic Qualifications

  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in business administration, management, finance, contract management, or a closely related field.
  • Clearance: Active DoD Secret Clearance is mandatory.
  • Experience:
    • 15+ years of progressive leadership experience in government contracts, subcontracts, and procurement within the defense sector.
  • 5+ years of direct supervisory experience managing contracting, procurement, or pricing personnel.
  • Direct experience managing and administering prime contracts and subcontracts across major government-wide or agency-specific vehicles.
    • Deep, demonstrable subject matter expertise in federal acquisition regulations, particularly FAR, DFARS, Contractor Purchasing System Review (CPSR), and Service Contract Act (SCA).
    • Proven experience successfully managing Export Compliance (ITAR/EAR) operations for a government contractor.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Education: Master’s degree or doctorate in business, contract management, acquisition, finance, or related field preferred.
  • Certifications/Licenses/Affiliations:
    • Certified Professional Contract Manager (CPCM)
    • Certified Federal Contract Manager (CFCM)
    • National Contract Management Association (NCMA)
    • Active law license
  • Familiarity with the JAMIS Prime Software ERP/financial system.
  • Procurement and buying experience, including direct management of corporate purchasing capabilities and the development of standardized procurement processes.

IronMountain Solutions is an Equal Opportunity Employer

title: Academy Trainer – Babilou Family Academy
description:
Are You Ready to Make an Immediate Impact?
Babilou Family US is part of the global Babilou Family network and brings a local, community-focused approach to early childhood education through our Little Sprouts, Building Blocks, and Heartworks schools. We are looking for a proactive and collaborative team member who will support our mission and contribute meaningfully to this role.
The Academy Trainer is responsible for delivering high-quality training and development experiences for participants enrolled in the Babilou Family Academy. Working closely with the Academy Director, this role facilitates the majority of Academy coursework, supports participant learning and engagement, evaluates skill development, and helps ensure participants are prepared for successful placement in schools. The Academy Trainer serves as a key resource and mentor throughout the participant journey while reinforcing company culture, educational quality standards, safety practices, and professional expectations.
Our work is guided by our educational approach, Sustainable Education®, which bridges research and daily practice to help children thrive and lay the foundation for lifelong learning. We’re in what we like to call the science of children. Everything we do is rooted in research about how young minds grow—how they learn, connect, and build the skills that last a lifetime. We also lead our HONOR values: Humility, Open-Mindedness, Nurture, Ownership, and Recognition. This guiding framework fosters an environment where educators, children, families, and partners feel valued, empowered, and inspired to grow.

Key Responsibilities

  • Deliver Academy training sessions; facilitate classroom instruction, discussions, activities and practical learning experiences; prepare training materials; support guest facilitators; create an engaging learning environment.

  • Monitor participant progress, attendance and engagement; conduct assessments and observations; provide coaching and feedback; partner with the Academy Director regarding participant readiness and completion recommendations.

  • Build positive participant relationships; support onboarding and orientation activities; foster professionalism, accountability and continuous learning; celebrate participant achievements.

  • Support scheduling, logistics, classroom preparation, school observations and field training; maintain training records and completion tracking.

  • Partner with the Academy Director to improve curriculum, training materials, assessments and learning activities; provide feedback on training effectiveness.

  • Support school-based experiences and gather participant and leader feedback regarding readiness and Academy effectiveness.

Required & Preferred Qualifications

  • High school diploma or GED equivalent, Associate or Bachelor’s degree preferred.

  • 5+ years of experience in training/learning and development, education or related fields.

  • Experience working in an early childhood education center strongly preferred.

  • Demonstrated experience and success in delivering training programs.

  • Excellent facilitation, presentation, public speaking, and verbal and written communication skills.

  • Passion for employee development and workforce readiness.

  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite.

  • Experience with learning management systems a plus.

  • Ability to lift up to 25 lbs. on an occasional basis.

  • Travel to other local schools and Home Office to facilitate trainings/observations, participate in meetings, or perform other Academy-related tasks as needed.

What we offer

We invest in our employees’ health, financial wellbeing, professional growth and family success through:

  • Up to 50% childcare tuition discount.

  • Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision insurance, effective on your first day of employment.

  • Free First Stop Health membership, providing 24/7 access to virtual primary care, urgent care, and short-term mental health support.

  • 401(k) retirement plan with annual discretionary employer match contribution.

  • Optional life insurance and short/long-term disability coverage, helping provide financial protection and peace of mind.

  • Performance-based pay, including increases tied to certification and/or degree completion.

  • Career growth and professional development opportunities, including training, mentorship, and our dedicated CHILD Conference.

  • Generous paid time off and holiday benefits, including an annual Winter Break closure between Christmas and New Year's so employees can enjoy additional time with family and friends.

  • Employee Assistance Program (EAP), offering confidential resources and support for mental health, financial wellness, work-life balance, and other personal needs.

  • Employee referral bonus program, because great people know great people! Earn bonuses for helping us build an exceptional team.

  • Additional lifestyle and fringe benefits, including tuition and professional development reimbursement, pet insurance, and other programs designed to support you and your family.

Closing

Babilou Family US is part of a global network of 1,100 early education and child care centers. We provide quality early education and child care across 42 New England schools. Through the experience and talents of nearly 900 early education professionals and in partnership with nearly 4,000 families, we are on a meaningful journey to create optimal learning spaces where children ages 0-5 can learn, grow, and thrive.
Our teams, whether at our home office or inside our schools, are change makers – they inspire, create, model, and most importantly make this a great place to work. At Babilou Family US we are consistently recruiting, retaining, and promoting a diverse mix of colleagues who are representative of the diversity within the communities in which we operate. Our focus on equity and inclusion allows us to develop a broader scope of ideas and approaches, offering a collaborative and dynamic educational experience for the youngest members of society.

title: Seasonal Ambassador - Westfarms Mall
description:
Position: Seasonal Ambassador

0-39 hours/week

Contract Role

Seasonal Ambassador

Seasonal Ambassadors at Lush are experts in product and brand knowledge, as well as providing exceptional customer consultations and product demonstrations. Seasonal Ambassadors cultivate strong team relationships and contribute to overall shop excellence in both sales and operations. On the shop floor, they consistently surpass daily sales goals while creating a fun and inclusive team environment that keeps customers coming back for more.

We encourage you to put yourself in the customer's shoes and think about what would make their day. Whether it's providing personalized product recommendations or sharing your knowledge and expertise, you have the power to create a unique and memorable experience for every shopper.

For our Seasonal Ambassadors, it's not just about selling soap – it's about making a positive impact on the world, one bar at a time!

Responsibilities:

Sales and Customer Experience:

  • Driving Sales: Utilize StoreForce dashboard results and seek feedback to exceed sales goals. Take ownership of your results and actively work to grow your contribution to the store’s overall sales.
  • Customer Experience: Consistently deliver a world-class customer experience to every customer who walks through our doors. Connect with customers and identify their needs by listening attentively and asking open-ended questions. Show off our amazing products by demonstrating their unique benefits and features. Seek opportunities to make customers' day and leave the world Lusher than we found it.
  • Building the Brand: Educate customers on our brand values including our stance on Fighting Animal Testing, Freshest Cosmetics, Ethical Buying, 100% Vegetarian, Handmade, and Naked Packaging. Expertly articulate these values in the shop and through community engagement by hosting store parties and other initiatives that help bring in more traffic. Spread the word about what makes Lush unique, and inspire others to join us in making a positive impact on the world!
  • Product Passion: Continually expand your product knowledge with ongoing learning and diving deep into all things Lush. Stay up-to-date on our products, ingredients, and unique benefits to confidently and consistently make informed product recommendations for every customer's needs.

Team Involvement:

  • Development: Utilize Lush resources to develop effective sales techniques and product knowledge to improve your performance, support the growth of your team, and increase sales. Take ownership of your development, assess your performance, and actively seek feedback, resources, and opportunities to improve and elevate your skills, knowledge, and abilities.
  • Diversity, Equity, Inclusion, and Belonging: Encourage open communication and actively listen to team members’ perspectives related to diversity, equity, inclusion, and belonging (DEIB). Foster a sense of belonging by promoting teamwork, encouraging collaboration, and recognizing and valuing each employee's unique contributions.

Operational Excellence:

  • Time and Attendance: Be punctual, reliable, and present at work. Actively participate in teamwork, prioritize your wellbeing by taking breaks when necessary, and keep up-to-date with company news and updates.
  • Visuals and Merchandising: Maintain a clean, organized, and visually appealing store to enhance the customer's shopping experience and drive sales.
  • Stock and Inventory: Utilize Visual Merchandising guidelines to make real-time adjustments to product displays based on sales to improve the customer experience.
  • Policies and Procedures: Ensure you are practicing company standards for opening and closing, product integrity, respectful workplace, and health and safety.

Qualifications:

Required:

  • Excellent customer service skills
  • Flexibility to adapt to changing situations and priorities in a fast-paced environment
  • Knowledge and passion for skincare, natural beauty, and ethical business
  • Flexible schedule to accommodate store needs, including evenings, weekends, and holidays

Preferred:

  • Experience with consultation-based customer service models
  • Strong problem-solving skills to address issues that arise in day-to-day operations
  • Experience working in a team environment
  • Experience working in skincare or cosmetics
  • Experience in cross cultural collaboration and DEIB or social justice training
  • Fluency in Spanish, French, or other languages
Westfarms Pay
$17.50—$17.50 USD

Best of luck on your job search, and don't forget to follow us to learn more!

We Are Lush

LinkedIn

title: Senior Coordinator, Sustainability Initiatives & Committee Engagement
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior Coordinator, Sustainability Initiatives & Committee Engagement based in India.

This role offers the opportunity to connect industry professionals with practical sustainability knowledge, trusted experts, and meaningful peer collaboration.
You will coordinate committees and working groups while helping transform their discussions and insights into resources that members can actively use.
The position combines project coordination, stakeholder engagement, research, communication, and a genuine interest in sustainability.
You will monitor emerging environmental and regulatory developments and identify the topics, experts, and resources most relevant to members.
Success in this role depends on keeping multiple initiatives moving while building strong relationships with industry stakeholders and subject-matter experts.
You will have significant exposure to sustainability trends affecting the printing, labeling, packaging, and broader industry ecosystem.
The role also provides a strong growth path toward becoming a recognized voice and trusted resource on sustainability within the sector.

Accountabilities

  • Monitor emerging sustainability and regulatory developments, including EPR, PFAS, EUDR, carbon reporting, EHS, recyclability standards, and packaging regulations, identifying what matters most to members and where relevant expertise can be found.
  • Serve as a primary point of contact for member questions related to sustainability and help encourage participation in committees and working groups.
  • Coordinate committees and working groups by managing schedules, agendas, meeting preparation, follow-up activities, action items, and documentation.
  • Support committee chairs between meetings by keeping initiatives moving, maintaining alignment with broader organizational priorities, and ensuring commitments are followed through.
  • Identify areas of overlap, collaboration, and shared opportunity across committees to reduce duplicated effort and increase the value delivered to members.
  • Develop and maintain practical knowledge resources, including toolkits, best-practice guides, regulatory updates, case studies, and trend reports.
  • Curate, evaluate, organize, and translate information from trusted sources and subject-matter experts into accessible resources rather than creating all content independently.
  • Build strong relationships with converter and supplier members through regular engagement, conversations, and member interviews designed to uncover emerging needs and priorities.
  • Facilitate communication between members, committee leaders, and subject-matter experts to ensure relevant information and perspectives are effectively shared.
  • Continuously identify opportunities to improve committee engagement, member value, sustainability programming, and knowledge-sharing initiatives.

    • Requirements

    • 3–7 years of professional experience in printing, labeling, packaging, project management, sustainability programs, industry associations, or member services.
    • Strong organizational and project coordination skills, with demonstrated ability to manage multiple projects, committees, deadlines, and stakeholders simultaneously.
    • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with confidence facilitating discussions and interacting with executives, industry professionals, and subject-matter experts.
    • Strong relationship-building abilities and an enthusiastic, proactive approach to engaging members and encouraging participation.
    • Genuine interest in sustainability and environmental or regulatory topics, with the curiosity and motivation to continuously develop deeper subject-matter knowledge.
    • Ability to research emerging topics, distinguish relevant information from noise, and communicate complex developments in a clear and practical way.
    • Comfortable working with ambiguity and evolving priorities while maintaining structure, accountability, and momentum.
    • Strong attention to detail and follow-through, particularly when coordinating meetings, documenting decisions, and managing action items.
    • Collaborative, energetic, and solutions-oriented mindset with a willingness to take initiative and identify opportunities without waiting for direction.
    • Ability to develop into a trusted resource and industry voice through continued learning, relationship building, and hands-on experience.

      • Benefits

      • Competitive annual salary of $70,000–$80,000.
      • Full-time, fully remote working opportunity.
      • Competitive benefits package.
      • Opportunity to work at the intersection of sustainability, industry engagement, and regulatory developments.
      • Significant exposure to senior industry stakeholders, members, committee leaders, and subject-matter experts.
      • Opportunity to build expertise in sustainability and emerging environmental regulations over time.
      • Clear professional growth potential, with the opportunity to develop into a recognized sustainability resource and industry voice.
      • Collaborative environment focused on knowledge sharing, member engagement, and practical industry impact.

title: Souschef Administration & Finans
description:
Vil du være med til at lede Administration & Finans afdelingen i Danmarks største kulturinstitution? Stillingen etableres som led i en organisatorisk modernisering, hvor den daglige drift styrkes samtidig med at Teatret får nyt forretningsområde med åbningen af Hurlumhus. Det stiller nye krav til den økonomiske understøttelse af teatrets aktiviteter samtidig med at effektivisering og digitalisering af eksisterende processer og forretningsgange opretholdes. Derfor søger vi en erfaren leder, der kan kombinere stærk økonomifaglighed med personaleledelse og lysten til at være tæt på driften.

Om afdelingen Administration & Finans er en central støttefunktion på Det Kongelige Teater med ansvar for regnskab, finansadministration, indkøb og compliance. Afdelingen understøtter hele organisationen og bidrager til at sikre et solidt økonomisk fundament for teatrets mange aktiviteter.

Om stillingen Som souschef bliver du ansvarlig for den daglige ledelse, koordinering og prioritering af afdelingens opgaver, samtidig med at du selv indgår aktivt i driften, og fungerer som sparringspartner for medarbejderne. Som souschef får du samtidig en vigtig rolle i udviklingen af en moderne, effektiv og serviceorienteret afdeling i tæt samarbejde med Chefen for Administration & Finans. Som leder er du:

  • Synlig, involverende og nærværende
  • Tydelig i dine forventninger og beslutninger
  • Tillidsfuld og anerkendende i din tilgang til andre
  • Udviklingsorienteret med blik for både mennesker, kvalitet og resultater
  • Nysgerrig på nye løsninger og forbedringer
  • God til at skabe engagement og følgeskab
Om dig Vi forestiller os, at du:

  • Har en relevant uddannelse inden for økonomi, regnskab eller finans, samt solid regnskabsmæssig forståelse og erfaring med økonomiske driftsopgaver
  • Har erfaring med samarbejde med andre statslige institutioner, herunder Statens Administration og leverandørstyring af strategiske samarbejdspartnere.
  • Har dybt branchekendskab inden for scenekunst
  • Har erfaring med personaleledelse og motiveres af at udvikle medarbejdere – herunder erfaring med at lede medarbejdere på distancen.
  • Har erfaring med procesoptimering og udvikling af administrative arbejdsgange, herunder hvorledes kunstig intelligens kan bringes i spil
  • Har forståelse for indkøb, compliance og interne kontroller
  • Har dyb erfaring med de statslige systemer som f.eks. Navision Stat, RejsUd, SDI og SBS
  • Er en erfaren bruger af Excel
  • Har erfaring med anlægsbogholderi
  • Er stærk til at skabe relationer og samarbejde på tværs af fagområder
  • Arbejder struktureret, tager ansvar og følger opgaverne helt til dørs
Vi tilbyder Hos Det Kongelige Teater bliver du en del af en arbejdsplads præget af høj faglighed, stærkt engagement og et fælles ønske om at skabe scenekunstoplevelser i verdensklasse. Derudover tilbyder vi:

  • En nyoprettet lederstilling med stor indflydelse på udviklingen af Administration & Finans
  • Et kompetent og engageret team med høj faglighed
  • En spændende kombination af ledelse, drift og udviklingsopgaver
  • Mulighed for både faglig og personlig udvikling
  • En dynamisk arbejdsplads med mange forskellige samarbejdspartnere
  • Fleksible arbejdsforhold med fokus på balance mellem arbejdsliv og privatliv
Løn- og ansættelsesvilkår Løn og ansættelsesvilkår efter gældende overenskomst og med mulighed for forhandling af tillæg på baggrund af kvalifikationer og erfaring.

title: Fagkoordinerende embedsdyrlæge til Rønne, Glumsø og Hvidebæk. Vær med til at sikre dyrevelfærd og fødevaresikkerhed
description:
Har du solid faglighed, blik for helheden og lyst til at koordinere den veterinærfaglige opgaveløsning på tværs af tre slagterier? Så søger vi en fagkoordinerende embedsdyrlæge til Fødevarestyrelsens Kødkontrol i Rønne, Glumsø og Hvidebæk.

Om jobbet

Vi søger en fagkoordinerende embedsdyrlæge til en fast fuldtidsstilling på 37 timer om ugen.

Som fagkoordinerende embedsdyrlæge får du en central rolle i den faglige planlægning og koordinering af dyrlægernes opgaver ved Danish Crown i Rønne, Glumsø Slagtehus og Hvidebæk Slagteri. Du bliver den gennemgående faglige funktion på tværs af de tre kontrolenheder og skal bidrage til en ensartet, professionel og fagligt velfunderet kontrol.

Du arbejder tæt sammen med sektionslederen og de øvrige embedsdyrlæger om blandt andet planlægning, faglig sparring, kvalitetssikring og implementering af nye regler og arbejdsgange. Som fagkoordinerende dyrlæge har du en central rolle i at styrke det faglige fællesskab og samarbejdet. Du skal koordinere det faglige arbejde og være med til at sikre en ensartet faglig retning på tværs af de tre lokationer.

Samtidig indgår du i den daglige myndighedskontrol og arbejder tæt på produktionen med opgaver inden for dyrevelfærd, dyresundhed og fødevaresikkerhed. Stillingen kombinerer således den praktiske opgaveløsning som embedsdyrlæge med et særligt ansvar for den faglige koordinering.

Du bliver en del af et dyrlægeteam, der varetager kontrollen på tre slagterier fordelt på Bornholm og Sjælland. I teamet lægger vi vægt på godt samarbejde, høj faglighed og en uformel omgangstone. Hos os skal det være trygt at spørge om hjælp, dele erfaringer og udvikle sig fagligt.

Samtidig bliver du en del af et større fagligt fællesskab med embedsdyrlæger og øvrige kolleger i Kødkontrollen samt et fagligt netværk på tværs af landet. Vi arbejder aktivt med videndeling, samarbejde og fælles faglig udvikling, både inden for teamet og på tværs af kontrolenheder.

Dine arbejdsopgaver

Stillingen består både af faglig planlægning og koordinering samt opgaver som embedsdyrlæge.

Faglig planlægning og koordinering

  • Ansvar for den løbende faglige planlægning og koordinering på de tre slagterier
  • Udarbejdelse, koordinering og opfølgning på kontrolplaner
  • Sikring af en ensartet faglig praksis på tværs af kontrolenhederne
  • Faglig sparring og understøttelse af embedsdyrlægerne
  • Bidrag til kvalitetssikring af kontrol, dokumentation og sagsbehandling
  • Koordinering og implementeringen af nye regler, instrukser og arbejdsgange
  • Formidling af relevant faglig viden og understøttelse af videndeling
  • Tæt samarbejde med sektionslederen om prioritering og udvikling af den faglige opgaveløsning

Opgaver som embedsdyrlæge

  • Sagsbehandling og udarbejdelse af kontrolrapporter
  • Auditering af virksomhederne
  • Ante mortem-inspektion, herunder vurdering af dyrevelfærd og transportegnethed
  • Kontrol med dyretransporter ved aflæsning
  • Kontrol med fødevaresikkerhed, dyresundhed, dyrevelfærd, hygiejne og eksport
  • Tilsyn og udstedelse af certifikater
  • Veterinærfaglige opgaver på slagtekæden, herunder håndtering af sygemærkede dyr og mistanke om sygdom. Den almindelige båndkontrol varetages hovedsageligt af tilsynsteknikere

Stillingen kræver, at du håndterer myndighedsrollen professionelt og kommunikerer klart og præcist også i pressede situationer. Gennem tydelig kommunikation bidrager du til, at reglerne overholdes, samtidig med at du er med til at bevare et konstruktivt samarbejde med kolleger og eksterne aktører.

Om dig

Det er et krav, at du har eller kan opnå dansk autorisation som dyrlæge inden tiltrædelsen.

Herudover ser vi gerne og lægger vægt på, at du:

  • har relevant veterinærfaglig erfaring, gerne fra kødkontrol, myndighedsarbejde eller fødevareområdet
  • kan skabe struktur og overblik på tværs af flere arbejdssteder
  • kan koordinere, skabe retning og følge op uden at have personaleansvar
  • kan formidle kompliceret fagligt stof klart og anvendeligt
  • tør træffe faglige beslutninger og tage ansvar, også når der er travlt
  • arbejder selvstændigt og samtidig formår at inddrage og understøtte kollegerne
  • har forståelse for balancen mellem myndighedsrollen og et konstruktivt samarbejde med virksomhederne
  • er fagligt nysgerrig og engageret og trives i et team, hvor sparring og erfaringsudveksling er en naturlig del af hverdagen
  • har gode samarbejdsevner og bidrager med godt humør i dagligdagen
  • behersker dansk mundtligt og skriftligt på et funktionelt niveau, da dansk er vores myndighedssprog
  • er rutineret bruger af Office-pakken og har let ved at sætte dig ind i nye systemer
  • er indstillet på fortsat at udvikle dine kompetencer inden for faget

Om os

Fødevarestyrelsen er en statslig organisation med stor samfundsmæssig betydning. Vi arbejder for, at fødevarer er sikre, og at dyr behandles forsvarligt. Kødkontrollen kontrollerer alle slagtedyr på danske slagterier og har fokus på smitsomme sygdomme, dyrevelfærd og fødevaresikkerhed.

Teamet består af 10 tilsynsteknikere og op til 8 embedsdyrlæger fordelt på de tre lokationer. Slagterierne har udelukkende daghold, men arbejdet starter nogle dage tidligt om morgenen.

Derudover er der mulighed for at indgå i forskellige faglige netværk med embedsdyrlæger fra andre slagterier i landet, hvor der løbende afholdes møder med fokus på faglig udvikling, sparring og videndeling.

Det praktiske

  • Arbejdssted: Stillingen omfatter Kødkontrollen ved Danish Crown i Rønne, Haslevej 19, 3700 Rønne, Glumsø Slagtehus, Søvej 5, 4171 Glumsø, og Hvidebæk Slagteri, Industrivej 17 D, 4490 Jerslev. Der må forventes regelmæssig tjenesterejseaktivitet mellem Bornholm og Sjælland. Den nærmere tilrettelæggelse af fremmøde og rejser aftales under hensyn til opgaverne på de tre lokationer.
  • Omfang: Fuldtid, 37 timer om ugen, med tiltrædelse snarest muligt.
  • Arbejdstid: Arbejdstiden ligger inden for tidsrummet mandag-torsdag kl. 04.45-16.00 og fredag kl. 04.45-13.00 afhængigt af lokation og dagens opgaver.

Ansættelsen sker efter gældende protokollat til overenskomst for akademikere i staten om Fødevarestyrelsens dyrlæger ved eksportslagterier mv.

Pr. 1. august 2026 er:

  • Startlønnen (trin 4) i alt 39.123,44 kr. inkl. slagteritillæg og særligt slagteritillæg for en nyuddannet dyrlæge.
  • Slutlønnen (trin 8) i alt 47.434,38 kr. inkl. slagteritillæg og særligt slagteritillæg samt eventuelt kvalifikationstillæg.

Det vil være muligt at forhandle et kvalifikationstillæg afhængigt af den enkeltes kvalifikationer i relation til stillingen. Pensionsbidraget for dyrlæger ved eksportslagterier udgør 18,07 %.

Ansættelsesområdet er Ministeriet for Fødevarer, Landbrug og Fiskeri med tilhørende institutioner.

Vil du vide mere?

Hvis du har yderligere spørgsmål til stillingen eller ønsker at komme på besøg, er du velkommen til at kontakte sektionsleder Lasse Heebøll på telefon 72 27 61 89.

Du kan læse mere om Styrelsen for Fødevarer, Landbrug og Fiskeri på . Du kan også se en film om arbejdet som dyrlæge i Kødkontrollen her.

Overvejer du at flytte til Bornholm?

Så står Bornholms Tilflytterservice klar til at hjælpe dig og din familie godt på plads. De tilbyder rådgivning om bolig, skole, job til ægtefælle og fritidsaktiviteter. Kontakt dem på telefon 31 21 88 80 eller mail tilflytter@bornholm.biz.

Ansøgning

Vi ser frem til at modtage din motiverede ansøgning, CV og eksamensbevis online i vores rekrutteringssystem på snarest og senest 28. september 2026.

Ansættelsessamtaler afholdes løbende, da vi ønsker at ansætte snarest muligt.

Fødevarestyrelsen betragter mangfoldighed som et aktiv og opfordrer alle uanset personlig baggrund til at søge.

title: Læger til natlægevagten i Region Nordjylland
description:
Søger du et meningsfuldt og fleksibelt job/bijob inden for det almene medicinske område så se her

Region Nordjylland er ansvarlig for at bemande lægevagten i tidsrummet 23.00 – 08.00 alle ugens dage året rundt. Der er konsultationssteder i Aalborg, Hjørring og Thisted hvorfra vagtlægerne skiftevis skal telefonvisitere og afholde fysiske konsultationer i løbet af vagten.

Din opgave Opgaverne i natlægevagten er både telefonvisitation, fysiske konsultationer og videokonsultationer. Sygebesøgsopgaven varetages af Den Præhospitale Virksomhed på baggrund af en lægefaglig vurdering af vagtlægen. I løbet af vagten er der adgang til sparring med dine kolleger og derudover er der en lægefaglig ansvarlig for natlægevagten, hvor du vil kunne søge sparring og supervision i dagstid.

Din ansættelse Du bliver organisatorisk ansat i Sundhedsplanlægning i Region Nordjylland og har som udgangspunkt tjenestested på de tre vagtlokationer. For at kunne vedligeholde de faglige kompetencer og kendskabet til lægevagten ser vi gerne, at du som minimum kan tage 1-2 vagter om måneden. Du vil indgå i den faste vagtplanlægning ud fra dine individuelle ønsker og vil derudover løbende kunne byde ind på ledige vagter. Det forventes, at du også kan byde ind i ferieperioder i relevant omfang.

Du bliver ansat efter aftalen for timelønnede læger ansat ved lægevagten, der er indgået mellem RLTN, Yngre Læger og Foreningen af Speciallæger. Du honoreres i overensstemmelse med forhåndsaftale indgået mellem Region Nordjylland, Yngre Læger og Foreningen af Speciallæger. Mere information og eksempler på løn kan findes på

title: Technical Lead - Business Automation & AI Development
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Technical Lead - Business Automation & AI Development based in Brazil.

This role offers the opportunity to help build a new technology and automation practice focused on turning complex business processes into practical digital solutions.
You will operate at the intersection of business strategy, software architecture, automation, and AI-assisted development.
The position combines hands-on engineering with the architectural leadership needed to deliver secure, scalable, production-ready applications.
You will translate existing workflows and business requirements into custom applications that improve operations without requiring disruptive legacy system replacements.
Using AI-accelerated development approaches, you will help deliver solutions efficiently while applying strong technical judgment and engineering standards.
As the practice grows, you will have the opportunity to shape development standards, build a team, and mentor future engineers.
This is an ideal opportunity for an entrepreneurial technical leader who enjoys ambiguity, ownership, and solving real-world operational challenges.

Accountabilities

  • Design and oversee custom business applications, including CRM platforms, project management tools, data integration layers, and other operational software.
  • Translate complex business processes, existing documentation, video walkthroughs, and structured requirements into functional and scalable digital solutions.
  • Lead AI-assisted software development using platforms such as Replit Agent/Builder, ensuring generated solutions meet appropriate standards for architecture, security, maintainability, and scalability.
  • Apply sound architectural judgment to determine when AI-generated solutions require manual intervention, refinement, or redesign.
  • Design integration strategies and workflows that capture client requests, manage project lifecycles, and enable reliable data handoffs into existing legacy systems.
  • Develop solutions that improve operational efficiency while minimizing the need for disruptive replacements of established infrastructure.
  • Ensure deployed applications achieve strong availability, reliability, and performance through appropriate infrastructure management, monitoring, and quality assurance practices.
  • Establish technical and development best practices that support repeatable delivery as the automation practice scales.
  • Over time, identify, hire, mentor, and develop junior developers while building a high-performing team focused on AI-augmented software development.
  • Partner closely with business stakeholders to understand operational challenges and translate them into commercially valuable technical solutions.

    • Requirements

    • Proven experience combining software engineering with business analysis, product management, or a similar business-facing technical discipline.
    • Demonstrated experience using AI coding assistants or AI-powered development platforms such as Replit, Lovable, or comparable tools to rapidly deliver production-ready software.
    • Strong architectural judgment and the ability to evaluate, guide, and improve AI-generated code rather than relying solely on automated development.
    • Strong full-stack knowledge covering frontend and backend architectures, SQL and/or NoSQL databases, APIs, integrations, and application design.
    • Experience building or optimizing business applications such as CRM systems, project management platforms, internal operational tools, or workflow automation solutions.
    • Ability to design systems with a long-term perspective, ensuring solutions can scale from an individual client deployment to a much larger customer base.
    • Strong understanding of business processes and the ability to translate operational requirements into practical technology solutions.
    • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to bridge technical execution and the needs of non-technical business stakeholders.
    • Entrepreneurial and self-directed mindset, with a strong sense of ownership and comfort working in a fast-moving environment.
    • Ability to navigate ambiguous or undefined problems, make sound strategic decisions, and operate effectively without a rigid playbook.
    • Strong organizational and prioritization skills, with the ability to work autonomously and deliver results with minimal supervision.
    • Leadership and mentorship potential, with the ability to establish standards and develop future engineering talent.
    • Experience in professional services, consulting, BPO, legacy system migration, remote team leadership, or startup environments is beneficial but not essential.

      • Benefits

      • Full-time remote engagement.
      • Flexible working hours with required overlap with US time zones when needed for client and project delivery.
      • Opportunity to play a foundational role in launching and shaping a new technology and automation practice.
      • Significant technical ownership across architecture, application development, automation, integrations, and platform reliability.
      • Opportunity to work with AI-accelerated development technologies and modern software engineering approaches.
      • Potential to build, hire, and mentor a development team as the practice grows.
      • Exposure to diverse business processes and operational challenges across multiple client environments.
      • Opportunity to create practical technology solutions that modernize workflows without requiring disruptive legacy system replacements.
      • Entrepreneurial environment with substantial autonomy and opportunities to influence technical standards and delivery practices.
      • Candidates are expected to provide their own laptop and basic equipment, maintain reliable connectivity, and work from a secure environment.
      • Compliance with required security controls, including two-factor authentication.

title: Sygeplejerske søges til afsnit C4, på Psykiatrisk Center København
description:
Er du sygeplejerske og har du lyst til at blive en del af et åbent afsnit med højt fagligt niveau og godt kollegialt sammenhold? Så kan det være en god ide at læse vores opslag.

Du bliver en del af et fantastisk team (afsnit C4) med høj faglighed og mulighed for at udvikle dig som sygeplejerske.

Vores team består af læger, sygeplejersker, og social- og sundhedsassistenter, der i det daglige støttes af en recoverymentor, en socialrådgiver, en ergoterapeut og en fysioterapeut. Vi prioriterer det tværfaglige samarbejde højt, og ser det som en styrke, at vi kan sætte vores forskellige fagligheder i spil.


Hvad er vores forventninger til dig?
Du er autoriseret sygeplejerske, og som person hviler du godt i dig selv, og med dine gode kommunikative evner gør du bevidst brug af deeskalerende kommunikation i hverdagen. Du skal være fleksibel og god til at håndtere uforudsete situationer.
Derudover:

  • har du gode samarbejdsevner, både mono- som tværfagligt, og du kan og har lyst til at arbejde tværfagligt.
  • du er ansvarsbevidst og er god til at danne dig overblik.
  • du er nysgerrig, energisk og vil være med til at udvikle den psykiatriske sygepleje.
  • har du erfaring med og lyst til at arbejde med sygeplejefaglig dokumentation.
  • prioriterer du sikkerheden i afsnittet højt.
Da vi indgår i sikkerhedsnormeringen, skal du være psykisk og fysisk i stand til at indgå i tvangs-episoder.


Hvad kan vi tilbyde dig?
Vi prioriterer at have et sikkert arbejdsmiljø. Sikkerhed i afsnittet er for os et spørgsmål om gensidighed, forudsigelighed og samarbejde.

Vi arbejder aktivt med strukturer for at højne fagligheden, og dermed sikre den gode patientpleje. Vi arbejder med kognitiv adfærdsterapi, safewards og recovery.

Det er vigtigt, at du har lyst til at arbejde ud fra de metoder, og er nysgerrig på at udvikle dig.


Løn- og ansættelsesvilkår
Vi søger en sygeplejerske til en fast stilling i blandede vagter (primært dagvagter), med arbejdsweekend hver anden weekend.

Tiltrædelse ønskes snarest muligt, efter aftale.

Du ansættes i henhold til overenskomst for Ikke-ledende personale på Sundhedskartellets område - 32.17.1


Har du spørgsmål til stillingen, eller kunne du tænke dig at besøge os?
Kontakt oversygeplejerske Lene Svendsen på 20342228.


Søg stillingen via linket her på siden, senest den 16. september 2026.
Medsend din motiverede ansøgning, CV og autorisationsbeviser.
Vi har ansættelsessamtaler efter aftale.


Vil du vide mere om arbejdspladsen
Psykiatrisk Center København er Danmarks største psykiatriske center, og en del af Bispebjerg og Frederiksberg Hospital, med en lang række almene og specialiserede tilbud. Centret er kendt for at være i front med nye behandlingstilbud, som udspringer af den anerkendte forskning, der udføres i centret.

Centret har mere end 1300 ansatte og et optageområde på cirka 430.000 borgere, der dækker københavnerområderne Østerbro, Indre By, Nordvest, Nørrebro, Frederiksberg og Vanløse. Centeret er organisatorisk placeret i Region Hovedstaden, og geografisk placeret på Bispebjerg, Gentofte og Frederiksberg Hospitaler, samt i en række ambulante enheder i optageområdet.

Vi behandler affektive lidelser, skizofreni, andre psykoser, komplekse neuropsykiatriske lidelser samt personlighedsforstyrrelser. Centeret har en række specialområder så som: Psykoterapi, angst, OCD, affektive lidelser, sexologi, neuropsykiatri, herunder psykiatrisk vurdering ved epilepsikirurgi, liaison, ældrepsykiatri og militærpsykiatri.

title: Entry Level Manufacturing
description:
Service Wire Company, a premier supplier of industrial and utility wire and cable, is currently seeking Entry Level Manufacturing and Distribution workers in Phoenix, AZ. If you are looking to join a great organization and a chance to become a part of our growing team, this may be the opportunity for you! No experience required- we provide full training!
Position Summary:
Our Entry Level workers process material cuts according to customer specifications, record distribution data in order to expedite and prepare orders for shipment. They also work to maintain inventory stock and an organized warehouse, and transport wire and materials throughout the facility using a forklift.

Tasks/Duties/Responsibilities:

  • Cut wire to specified length based on customer requirements
  • Palletize and prepare orders for shipment
  • Record all material information to include: item code, damage, reel number, miscuts, location, and cut information, etc.
  • Process orders based on urgency and expedite accordingly
  • Assist with inventory control and maintaining stock levels
  • Maintain safety standards and clean/organized work environment
  • Additional duties as assigned by supervisor

Knowledge/Skills/Requirements:

  • High School Diploma/GED (General Equivalency Diploma) or one year related industrial experience or equivalent training
  • Demonstrate strong basic math and measuring skills
  • Ability to read, comprehend, and respond to general instructions, direction, and correspondence, both oral and written
  • Cooperatively works and interacts with members various departments * Personal protective equipment is required
  • Continuous participation in company safety training
  • Company forklift operation training and certification

Physical Demands/Work Environment

  • Temperatures may be impacted by extreme outdoor weather in plant and warehouse
  • Regularly stands, bends, and reaches for extended periods
  • Regularly moves about the facility
  • Regularly lifts and moves materials up to 50 pounds
  • Regularly uses hand and finger dexterity to adjust and manipulate controls, tools, and objects
  • Occasionally required to move up to 100 pounds by pushing, pulling, or sliding material. Assistance provided as needed
  • Visual inspection of material quality required
  • Must be able to work in hot and cold environments without climate-control.
  • In-person attendance is an essential function of the job

Shift Schedule and Information

Must be available to work one of the following times:
- 1st Shift - 7am - 3:30pm
- 2nd Shift - 3pm - 11:30pm
- 3rd Shift - 11pm - 7:30am

The perks of joining our Team

  • Comprehensive Insurance Options - Competitive medical coverage with a variety of plan choices.

  • 401(k) with Company Match + Profit Sharing - Matching 5% on 6% of employee contributions and annual profit‑sharing contributions.
  • Career Growth & Learning Support - Tuition reimbursement and employee assistance programs.
  • Referral Bonus Program - Employee referral bonuses paid out over the new hire's first year.

title: Bioanalytiker søges til det histologiske laboratorium - Patologi, Sygehus Sønderjylland, Aabenraa
description:
Brænder du for det histologiske speciale, er kompetent inden for området og har du lyst til at være en del af vores fantastiske team i Patologi, så er det lige dig vi søger.
Vi søger en bioanalytiker, der har lyst til at arbejde inden for det patologiske speciale. Én bioanalytiker til varetagelse af en fast stilling på 37 timer/uge, og med tiltrædelse 1. november 2026 (eller efter anden aftale).

Hvem er vi?
Vi er en velfungerende og moderne afdeling, med tværgående arbejdsopgaver inden for det histologiske-, cytologiske- og molekylærpatologiske speciale.
I Patologi arbejder der flere forskellige faggrupper hvoraf størstedelen er bioanalytikere. Vores bioanalytikerteam består af i alt ca. 20 bioanalytikere.
Vi er et laboratorie, der følger den teknologiske udvikling, både inden for digital patologi samt automatisering af arbejdsfunktioner. Bioanalytikerne i afdelingen er langt fremme ift. udviklingsopgaver inden for varetagelse af kompleksudskæring, udførelse af mikroskopi af histologipræparater af colonpolypper og udvikling af molekylærpatologiske analyser.
Vi har en åben og humoristisk omgangstone, hvor tværfaglighed og samarbejde vægtes højt. Alle faggrupper arbejder sammen om kerneopgaverne, som med et patientcentreret fokus omfatter ”Præcis og kvalitetsbevidst diagnostik i sikre og effektive rammer”.

Ledelsesmæssigt arbejdes der tillidsbaseret, og med stærk medarbejderinvolvering på alle planer. Du vil således opleve en afdeling, der er præget af en høj trivsel, og med afsæt af høj faglighed.

Dine arbejdsopgaver vil primært være i det histologiske speciale, hvor du, afhængig af erfaring vil blive ledt gennem en grundig oplæring inden for områder som: udskæring, indstøbning, mikrotomi, farvning af vævssnit samt scanning af objektglas til digital patologi. Skulle du have erfaring inden for kompleksudskæring, eller andre specialuddannelser inden for området, så vægtes dette.

Du vil blive en del af et fleksibelt og dynamisk team, der arbejder tæt sammen i en spændende hverdag. Vi samarbejder i øvrigt tæt sammen med afdelingens øvrige personale, herunder sekretærer, en afdelingsmedhjælper, en molekylærbiolog, vores patologer og øvrige laboratorier på SHS.

Vi tilbyder dig:

  • En spændende og varieret arbejdsdag i et positivt, åbent og fleksibelt arbejdsmiljø
  • En grundig oplæring og on-bording til afdelingen, hvor du bl.a. tilknyttes en mentor
  • En afdeling der prioriterer faglig udvikling og uddannelse
  • Arbejdstider fra mandag til fredag i tidsrummet fra kl. 07:00 til kl. 16:00
  • Et teamsamarbejde med positive og engagerede kolleger, som arbejder sammen om fælles mål og opgaveløsning, med fokus på høj kvalitet.
  • En afdeling med høj medarbejderinvolvering og forventning om, at vi fælles samarbejder om at sætte patienterne først
Dine opgaver:
Dine primære opgaver vil være udførelse af histologiske analyser. Opgaverne afstemmes ift. din faglige profil, dine kompetencer samt erfaring, og kan omfatte:

  • Håndtering af histologiske materialer ved modtagelse
  • Udskæring og indstøbning af vævsmateriale
  • Mikrotomi og farvning af vævssnit
  • Håndtering af vores automatiske skærerobot
  • Indscanning, kontrol af glas og påsætning af glas på vores glasrobot
Vi forventer, at du:

  • Er autoriseret bioanalytiker
  • Har erfaring med og/eller stor interesse for det histologiske speciale
  • Er ansvarsbevidst, har fokus på høj faglig kvalitet og er nysgerrig på egen og andres læring
  • Kan arbejde målrettet og selvstændigt (efter endt oplæring)
  • Evner og trives i en omskiftelig hverdag med høj aktivitet, og hvor det kan være nødvendigt at ændre på arbejdsgange og opgaver
  • Er en god kollega både i eget team men også på tværs af afdelingen, herunder at du arbejder aktivt for opretholdelse af det gode arbejdsmiljø, samt udviser imødekommenhed over for kolleger mhp. at I sammen når i mål med dagens opgaver
  • Er ambitiøs på egne og afdelingens vegne, initiativrig og motiveres af nye udfordringer
Øvrige oplysninger:
Ansøgningsfristen er den 16. september 2026. Samtaler forventes afholdt i uge 39.

Chefbioanalytiker Trine Rasmussen på tlf. 2342 3075 eller e-mail: Trine.Rasmussen@rsyd.dk
Cheflæge Martin Mæng Bjørklund på tlf. 6150 2633 eller e-mail: Martin.Maeng.Bjorklund@rsyd.dk

title: Javanese Speakers - Test Voice Modes of AI Models

title: Leder af Sundhedstjenesten i Rudersdal Kommune
description:
Vil du stå i spidsen for et fag, der gør en forskel helt fra livets begyndelse? Trives du i en lederrolle, der handler om relationer, retning og resultater? Motiveres du af at skabe rammerne for, at både medarbejdere og familier i endnu højere grad kan lykkes? Så er her et godt tilbud om en spændende lederstilling i Sundhedstjenesten i Rudersdal Kommune.

Om jobbet

Vores leder af Sundhedstjenesten i Rudersdal Kommune gennem mange år har besluttet at stoppe sit arbejdsliv og gå på pension. Vi søger derfor en ny engageret leder af Sundhedstjenesten, der kan bygge videre på et stærkt og velfungerende fundament, og vil sætte retning og bidrage til at videreudvikle en sundhedstjeneste med fokus på forebyggelse og tidlige indsatser.

Du bliver leder for et meget kompetent hold af 20 medarbejdere, hvor høj faglighed, stor selvstændighed, lyst til sparring og psykologisk tryghed er fundamentet. Vi har ro på driften, masser af erfaring samt lyst og mod til at prøve nyt af.

Tværfagligt samarbejde er en del af opgaven i vores hverdag. Du bliver en del af større ledergruppe med meget forskellige ansvarsområder, hvor vi har fokus på det tværfaglige samarbejde. Sundhedstjenesten i Rudersdal Kommune er en del af Social Myndighed og Rådgivning, hvor du vil indgå i et lederfællesskab med lederne af PPR, Tandplejen, Beskæftigelse, Ydelse, Myndighed for børn, unge og voksne, og områdechefen.

Om dig

Vi søger en leder, der både står stærkt fagligt og relationelt, og som har mod og vilje til at indtage ledelsesrummet. Vi ser gerne, at du har en uddannelsesbaggrund som sundhedsplejerske, alternativt en sygeplejerskebaggrund med erfaring fra børne- og familieområdet. Du har solid indsigt i feltet og vilkårene, så du kan tilbyde dig som en kompetent og troværdig sparringspartner.

Vi lægger vægt på, at du kommer med ledelseserfaring eller et tydeligt talent for ledelse. Du ved, hvad der skal til for at motivere, understøtte og drive en god sundhedstjeneste.

Det er også vigtigt, at du kan se dig selv i Rudersdal Kommunes værdigrundlag og vision om at støtte alle børn og unges muligheder for deltagelse.

Konkret har vi nedenstående ønsker til de ledelsesmæssige og personlige kompetencer:

  • Du udøver en tillidsbaseret, nærværende og anerkendende ledelsesstil
  • Du brænder for god personaleledelse og ved, hvor vigtigt det er at sikre psykologisk tryghed
  • Du har stærke relationelle kompetencer og lytter, inddrager og inviterer til dialog. Du er socialt anlagt og er ikke bange for at give af dig selv
  • Du har visioner og udsyn, ser muligheder og følger med i samfundsmæssige tendenser
  • Du har mod på at afprøve nyt sammen med medarbejderne
  • Du har gode kommunikative evner, skaber transparens, kan forklare ’hvorfor’ og inviterer til fælles ejerskab
  • Du er tydelig – også om retning og rammer
  • Du er struktureret, skaber hurtigt overblik, har sans for at prioritere og kan sikre fremdrift i blandt andet udviklingsprojekter.


Om Sundhedstjenesten i Social Myndighed og Rådgivning

Social Myndighed og Rådgivning er et område, der er præget af høj faglighed, borgernær ordentlighed og sikker drift med et stort fokus på medarbejdertrivsel. Vi har en spændende og ambitiøs udviklingsdagsorden. Vi vægter kollegial og ledelsesmæssig sparring og har plads til humor og godt humør. Du kommer til at deltage i den videre udvikling af både Sundhedstjenesten og Social Myndighed og Rådgivnings ledergruppe. Du bliver en del af et område, hvor der altid er plads til nytænkning og gode tiltag. Du bliver en del af en organisation, som arbejder fleksibelt og innovativt, og ønsker at sætte medarbejdere og ledere fri til at skabe resultater sammen med familierne.

Vi tror på, at stærke resultater skabes af mennesker, der har det godt sammen. Derfor interesserer vi os oprigtigt for hinanden – både som kolleger og mennesker. Vi gør os umage med at hjælpe, når hverdagen presser på og vi husker at glæde os med hinanden, når tingene lykkes. Vi tror på, at tillid, omsorg og stærke relationer er noget af det vigtigste, vi kan bygge en arbejdsplads på.

Om Rudersdal Kommune

I Rudersdal Kommune tror vi på, at vi kun lykkes i fællesskab. Derfor er det vores mål, at alle kommunens medarbejdere og ledere i alle opgaver - og i fællesskab - arbejder for at skabe bæredygtige løsninger, der giver værdi for borgerne, virksomheden og det samfund, vi er en del af. Se vores film om Rudersdal Kommunes strategi og værdier ”Vi lykkes kun i fællesskab” HER

Ansættelsesvilkår

Stillingen som leder af Sundhedstjenesten er en fuldtidsstilling 37 timer ugentligt. Løn og ansættelsesvilkår efter gældende overenskomst. Stillingen ønskes besat fra 1. december 2026. Du vil få fast arbejdssted i Birkerød på Stationsvej 36.

title: Test Analyst - Senior
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Test Analyst - Senior based in France.

This role offers the opportunity to lead comprehensive testing and business readiness activities for a consumer-facing digital solution.
You will ensure applications meet business requirements, acceptance criteria, quality standards, and end-user expectations.
The position combines hands-on software testing with defect management, data validation, training, documentation, and deployment support.
You will work closely with Product Owners, Business Analysts, subject matter experts, technical teams, and business stakeholders in an Agile environment.
Your expertise will help ensure smooth releases, effective user adoption, and stable post-implementation operations.
You will also explore responsible uses of AI and Generative AI to improve testing, documentation, training, and knowledge-transfer processes.
This is an excellent opportunity for a senior testing professional who enjoys combining technical quality assurance with business-facing delivery and change readiness.

Accountabilities

  • Plan, develop, and execute comprehensive test scenarios, scripts, and test cases aligned with business requirements and acceptance criteria.
  • Perform UAT, functional, regression, enhancement, integration, data validation, and end-to-end testing.
  • Coordinate testing activities with business users, Product Owners, Business Analysts, SMEs, technical teams, and other stakeholders.
  • Identify, document, track, prioritize, and manage defects, including severity assessment and validation of fixes.
  • Validate data and integrations to ensure system functionality and information flows meet expected outcomes.
  • Support testing and delivery activities within Agile and iterative development environments.
  • Work with ServiceNow applications, workflows, stories, and acceptance criteria to support effective testing and delivery.
  • Develop and maintain end-user training materials, user guides, job aids, FAQs, training scenarios, presentations, and knowledge-transfer documentation.
  • Facilitate user walkthroughs, demonstrations, training sessions, and knowledge-transfer activities.
  • Support business readiness, deployment readiness, go-live activities, and post-implementation stabilization.
  • Contribute to solutions involving licensing, regulatory, permitting, or citizen-facing applications and processes.
  • Identify opportunities to use approved AI and Generative AI tools to improve test case creation, coverage, defect analysis, documentation, training, and knowledge transfer.
  • Review and validate AI-generated outputs to ensure accuracy, completeness, accessibility, security, privacy, and compliance.

    • Requirements

    • 5+ years of experience coordinating software testing activities with business users, Business Analysts, SMEs, technical teams, and other stakeholders.
    • 5+ years of hands-on experience with UAT, functional, regression, enhancement, integration, and end-to-end testing.
    • 5+ years of experience identifying, documenting, tracking, assessing, and resolving software defects and validating corrective fixes.
    • 5+ years of experience performing data validation and integration testing.
    • 5+ years of experience working in Agile or iterative software delivery environments.
    • 5+ years of experience developing end-user training materials, user guides, job aids, FAQs, training presentations, and related business readiness content.
    • 5+ years of experience facilitating end-user training, walkthroughs, demonstrations, and knowledge-transfer activities.

    • At least 2 years of experience working with ServiceNow applications, workflows, stories, and acceptance criteria.
    • At least 2 years of experience supporting licensing, regulatory, permitting, or citizen-facing applications or business processes.
    • Experience using AI and Generative AI tools to support testing, test case development, defect analysis, documentation, training, or knowledge transfer.
    • Ability to critically evaluate AI-generated content and validate it for accuracy, completeness, accessibility, privacy, security, and regulatory compliance.
    • Strong analytical, problem-solving, documentation, communication, and stakeholder management skills.
    • Bachelor's degree or equivalent professional experience in a relevant field.
    • Ability to work effectively across technical and non-technical teams while managing multiple testing and business readiness priorities.

      • Benefits

      • Remote contract opportunity.
      • Opportunity to contribute to a consumer-facing digital solution with significant business and user impact.
      • Broad role combining software testing, business readiness, end-user training, documentation, and deployment support.
      • Opportunity to work closely with Product Owners, Business Analysts, SMEs, technical teams, and business stakeholders.
      • Exposure to ServiceNow applications, workflows, and Agile delivery practices.
      • Opportunity to apply AI and Generative AI responsibly to improve testing and business readiness processes.

title: Staff Full Stack Software Engineer
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Staff Full Stack Software Engineer based in the United States.

This is a high-impact, full-stack engineering role for a senior technical leader who enjoys owning problems from initial discovery through production.
You’ll work across a modern Python/Django backend and React/TypeScript frontend, turning ambiguous customer and operational needs into reliable products.
The role offers substantial autonomy within a lean engineering environment where engineers are accountable for outcomes, not simply tickets.
You’ll influence architecture, data models, APIs, integrations, testing, security, and production operations across meaningful initiatives.
AI is embedded into the engineering workflow, giving you the opportunity to accelerate investigation, development, testing, debugging, and review.
You’ll collaborate closely with Product, Design, Operations, and other stakeholders while maintaining strong technical ownership.
This opportunity is well suited to an experienced engineer who combines strong execution, sound judgment, and a systems-level mindset.

Accountabilities:

  • Own full-stack product and operational initiatives from problem framing and planning through implementation, launch, and production validation.
  • Translate ambiguous business and customer needs into practical technical plans, milestones, and shippable increments.
  • Design, build, and maintain reliable applications across Python/Django backend services and React/TypeScript frontend experiences.
  • Make thoughtful architectural decisions spanning data models, APIs, integrations, testing, security, failure handling, and production operations.
  • Use AI tools throughout the software development lifecycle to increase speed, quality, and engineering scope while maintaining accountability for the resulting work.
  • Rigorously validate AI-assisted output and apply engineering judgment when automated approaches are insufficient.
  • Partner directly with Product, Design, Operations, and other stakeholders to understand underlying problems and define measurable outcomes.
  • Communicate project progress, technical decisions, risks, dependencies, and blockers clearly and proactively.
  • Diagnose production incidents using logs, metrics, traces, profiling, and other operational evidence; restore service responsibly and implement improvements that prevent recurrence.
  • Improve engineering systems, tooling, automation, and development practices to help the broader team work more effectively.
  • Contribute to scalable solutions involving integrations, asynchronous processing, third-party services, workflows, and other complex production systems.

    • Requirements

    • Strong backend development expertise with Python and Django.

    • Experience delivering complete features across backend and frontend systems, as well as handling incidents, migrations, concurrency, and data-quality challenges, is a strong plus.
    • Experience transforming successful AI workflows into reusable automation, tooling, or team practices is desirable.
