title: Fagkoordinator søges til Hjemme- og sygeplejen Strøby
description:
Vil du være den faglige motor, der skaber trygge borgerforløb? Hjemme- og sygeplejen i Strøby søger en engageret fagkoordinator til udeområdet.

Brænder du for klinisk lederskab, høj faglig kvalitet og det gode samarbejde på tværs af sektorer? Har du solid erfaring fra primærsektoren, og motiveres du af at skabe struktur i en kompleks hverdag? Så er du måske vores nye fagkoordinator.

I Hjemme- og sygeplejen arbejder vi i Faste Tværfaglige Teams, hvilket vi har gjort i 2 år. Vi arbejder hver eneste dag målrettet for, at borgerne oplever de bærende elementer i Ældreloven: Selvbestemmelse, tillid samt inddragelse af civilsamfundet. Som fagkoordinator på udeområdet får du en nøglerolle i at omsætte ledelsens strategiske mål til daglig praksis, understøtte dine kollegaers kompetencer og sikre den gode, koordinerede udskrivelse af vores borgere.

Du vil referere direkte til lederen af hjemme- og sygeplejen og indgå i et tæt, tillidsfuldt makkerskab om den faglige og ressourcemæssige planlægning.

Dine primære opgaver og ansvarsområder
Som fagkoordinator spænder dine opgaver bredt fra koordinering og kvalitetssikring til daglig planlægning:

  • Koordination og udskrivelser: Du styrer kommunikationen med sygehusene, håndterer PFP'er og koordinerer udskrivelser i tæt samarbejde med visitationen. Du sikrer desuden korrekt overlevering ved fraflytning samt opfølgning på genindlæggelser.
  • Faglig ledelse og kvalitet: Du fungerer som sparringspartner for dine kollegaer, understøtter kompetencevurderingen af nye medarbejdere og planlægger undervisning efter behov. Du går forrest i kvalitetsarbejdet og er ansvarlig for håndteringen af UTH.
  • Superbruger i Cura: Medansvarlig for dokumentation i Cura. Herunder undervisning af kollegaer, faglig sparring samt journalaudits.
  • Daglig planlægning og drift: Du sikrer den daglige opgaveplanlægning i samarbejde med teamets sygeplejersker og kan afløse planlæggerne for hjemmeplejen hvor der er behov for dette.
  • Strategisk brobygning: Du klæder din leder på ved væsentlige ændringer i opgavemængden eller ved særligt komplekse borgerforløb, så vi altid matcher medarbejdernes kompetencer med borgernes behov.
  • Planlægge din egen tid: Du har fleksibelt fremmøde på tværs af dag- og aftenvagten. Du koordinerer selv din kalender i tæt samarbejde med din planlæggerkollega og leder, så det passer med teamets behov.

Hvem er du?
Vi forestiller os, at du er en fagligt velfunderet sygeplejerske med hjertet på det rette sted og blik for den gode struktur.

  • Uddannelse og erfaring: Du er autoriseret sygeplejerske og har minimum 2 års erfaring som hjemmesygeplejerske i primærsektoren.
  • Faglig ballast: Du har stærkt kendskab til både Serviceloven, Ældreloven og Sundhedsloven og formår at bringe det kliniske lederskab i spil i hverdagen.
  • Kommunikative evner: Du kommunikerer klart, anerkendende og brobyggende – både over for borgere, pårørende, kollegaer og eksterne samarbejdspartnere.
  • Udviklingsorienteret: Du har lyst til at præge udviklingen på området og omsætte nye faglige tiltag til virkelighed i den daglige drift.
  • Digitalt stærk: Du har interesse for og kompetencer inden for IT-tekniske løsninger. Vi anvender omsorgssystemet Cura Care og vi kunne ønske os at du har kendskab til dette.

Hvad tilbyder vi dig?

  • Stærke kolleger hele døgnet: Du lander i en personalegruppe med høj faglighed i både dag- og aftenvagten, hvilket sikrer en god synergi og tryghed i opgaveløsningen.
  • Ægte medindflydelse: Vi leder med tillid. Du får reelt indblik i maskinrummet (også det økonomiske) og stor frihed til at forme rollen.
  • Stærkt bagland: Sparring med visitatorer, terapeuter, demenskoordinatorer og et netværk af andre fagkoordinatorer.
  • Løn efter aftale: Løn- og ansættelsesvilkår sker efter gældende overenskomst ("Ny Løn").

Hvad tilbyder vi?
En spændende og central funktion, hvor du får stor indflydelse på rammerne for den faglige sygepleje. Du bliver en del af et engageret ledelsesteam og en personalegruppe, der vægter faglighed, fleksibilitet og et godt arbejdsmiljø højt. Du får rig mulighed for at udvikle dine kompetencer inden for koordination, pædagogisk formidling og klinisk lederskab og beslutningstagen.

Lyder det som noget for dig?
Kom forbi til en uforpligtende kop kaffe, eller ring til os for at høre mere om hverdagen hos os. Funktionsbeskrivelsen sender vi gerne til dig på mail. Du er meget velkommen til at kontakte Leder af Hjemme- og Sygepleje Strøby Helle Buck Nielsen på hellebni@stevns.dk eller på telefon 51 16 18 30 hvis du har spørgsmål til stillingen.

Stillingen ønskes besat pr. 1. november 2026.

Ansøgningsfristen er den 22. september.2026. Søg elektronisk nedenfor.

Vi tilstræber ansættelsessamtaler fredag den 25. september 2026.

title: Skarpe studerende søges til en bred vifte af opgaver i Spillemyndigheden
description:
Søger du et studiejob, hvor du kan bruge dine analytiske og metodiske kompetencer og få erfaringer med arbejdet i en statslig styrelse? Så er et studiejob i Spillemyndigheden måske noget for dig.

Hos os bliver du en del af en styrelse, der agerer inden for en spændende branche, hvor der er politisk bevågenhed og stor udvikling. Du vil få mulighed for at bruge dine erfaringer fra dit studie og samtidig være med til at beskytte spillere og sikre, at spiludbydere efterlever lovgivningen.

Alsidige opgaver og sagsbehandling
I Spillemyndigheden administrerer vi spillelovgivningen og arbejder for at sikre rammerne omkring et ansvarligt, fair og velreguleret spilmarked.

Vi søger tre studerende til at varetage forskellige arbejdsopgaver, som hovedsageligt vil være:

  • Besvarelse af borgerhenvendelser
  • Deltagelse i tilsynsopgaver
Arbejdsdagen i Spillemyndigheden indebærer et tæt samarbejde med kolleger i kontoret og på tværs af organisationen, og vi sætter en ære i at lykkes med vores opgaver på en fleksibel, konstruktiv og uhøjtidelig måde i et positivt arbejdsmiljø.

Du vil blive ansat i et af følgende fagkontorer afhængig af kompetencer og interesser:

Ansvarligt spil og Hvidvask, hvor du vil blive en del af teamet, der arbejder med ansvarligt spil. Kontoret er desuden ansvarlig for Spillemyndighedens forskellige tiltag rettet mod spilafhængighed såsom hjælpelinjen ”StopSpillet” og register over frivilligt udelukkede spillere (ROFUS).

Væddemål og Onlinekasino, hvor du blandt andet vil komme til at indgå i kontorets tilsyn med spiludbydernes markedsføring af spil. Kontoret er desuden ansvarligt for at behandle ansøgninger om tilladelse til at udbyde spil, herunder at foretage den økonomiske vurdering af udbyderne og sikre, at spillene afvikles efter gældende regler.

Ulovligt spil og Markedsanalyse, hvor du vil indgå i arbejdet med kontorets opgaver inden for forebyggelse og bekæmpelse af ulovligt spil og matchfixing. Kontoret er derudover ansvarligt for at udarbejde analyser og statistikker af spilmarkedet samt bekæmpelse af pyramidespil.

Stort overblik og dygtig formidler
Vi forestiller os, at du er jurastuderende. Formentlig læser du på sidste år af bacheloruddannelsen eller er startet på kandidatuddannelsen og du har allerede vist gode resultater. Vigtigst er det, at du er omhyggelig, hurtig til at sætte dig ind i nye opgaver, god til at skabe struktur og system og besidder et godt overblik.

Det er en forudsætning, at du er en god og dygtig formidler samt er velformuleret skriftligt såvel mundtligt på engelsk, da vi samarbejder med eksterne interessenter i ind- og udland.

Du har lyst til at løse varierende arbejdsopgaver samt god til at arbejde selvstændigt og i teams. Med dit gode humør og din positive indstilling til dine kolleger, vores interessenter og opgaver får du fulgt op og afsluttet arbejdsopgaverne.

Kontakt og ansættelsesvilkår
Du skal indsende CV og eksamenspapirer via nedenstående link snarest muligt. Du skal ikke indsende en ansøgning, men i stedet svare på tre spørgsmål, som fremgår af samme link. Fristen for ansøgning er den 20. september 2026. Har du spørgsmål til stillingen, er du velkommen til at kontakte souschef Jeanette Harder von Eyben på tlf. 72 38 91 73 eller på mail JHVE@spillemyndigheden.dk.

Vi forventer at afholde ansættelsessamtaler den 28. september 2026. Opstart er snarest muligt, dog gerne senest den 1. november 2026.

Arbejdstiden er 15 timer i gennemsnit om ugen med fleksibilitet i eksamensperioder. Du ansættes efter gældende overenskomst med HK og Finansministeriet. Tjenestestedet vil være Lerchesgade 35, 6, 5000 Odense C.

Ansættelsesområde
Skatte- og Vækstministeriet med tilhørende institutioner.

Læs mere om os på Spillemyndigheden.dk og følg os gerne på LinkedIn.

title: Senior Staff Product Manager, Browser Control Platform
description:
Why Mozilla?

Mozilla Corporation is the non-profit-backed technology company that has shaped the internet for the better over the last 25 years. We make pioneering brands like Firefox, the privacy-minded web browser. Now, with more than 225 million people around the world using our products each month, we’re shaping the next 25 years of technology and helping to reclaim an internet built for people, not companies. Our work focuses on diverse areas including AI, social media, security and more. And we’re doing this while never losing our focus on our core mission – to make the internet better for people.

The Mozilla Corporation is wholly owned by the non-profit 501(c) Mozilla Foundation. This means we aren’t beholden to any shareholders — only to our mission. Along with thousands of volunteer contributors and collaborators all over the world, Mozillians design, build and distribute open-source software that enables people to enjoy the internet on their terms.

About this team and role:

This role owns the foundation that lets other software drive Firefox: the secure, reliable connection an outside tool or another team uses to act inside the browser, and the building blocks they call to do it. It enables the teams building on it — internal teams, outside AI tools — to create their own products on top. This role owns the shared layer and the strategy for it. It’s a hands-on, technical role in a fast-moving, greenfield space, so it’s as much strategy as execution.

The opportunity is broad: internal teams (Smart Window, New Products’ automated tools), outside AI tools and their users, and web developers. The three share much of the underlying technology, but each reaches its market in a different way. The mandate is to figure out what to go after, and in what order.

What you’ll do:
  • Own the shared foundation and the building blocks it gives other software, and make them reliable and secure.
  • Push the open standard (WebDriver BiDi) forward, and build Firefox-only advantages the standard won’t cover
  • Design the safety controls: let a person approve actions, see when software is acting for them, and take back control.
  • Define the strategy for any major third-party AI assistants people already use.
  • Serve internal teams (Smart Window, New Products) and outside tools through one shared layer.
Measured on:

Adoption across teams and tools, volume of usage through the platform, and sustained reliability and security.

What you'll bring:
  • A product-minded engineer, or a very technical PM who can drive a technical product
  • Developer-space experience, with the range to think about consumers and internal platforms
  • Comfortable setting strategy in ambiguity; own a technical contract other teams depend on
  • Strong instincts on security and trust. Nice to have: web standards, MCP, browser automation

What you’ll get:

  • Generous performance-based bonus plans to all eligible employees - we share in our success as one team
  • Rich medical, dental, and vision coverage
  • Generous retirement contributions with 100% immediate vesting (regardless of whether you contribute)
  • Quarterly all-company wellness days where everyone takes a pause together
  • Country specific holidays plus a day off for your birthday
  • One-time home office stipend
  • Annual professional development budget
  • Quarterly well-being stipend
  • Considerable paid parental leave
  • Employee referral bonus program
  • Other benefits (life/AD&D, disability, EAP, etc. - varies by country)

About Mozilla

Mozilla exists to build the Internet as a public resource accessible to all because we believe that open and free is better than closed and controlled. When you work at Mozilla, you give yourself a chance to make a difference in the lives of Web users everywhere. And you give us a chance to make a difference in your life every single day. Join us to work on the Web as the platform and help create more opportunity and innovation for everyone online.

Commitment to diversity, equity, inclusion, and belonging

Mozilla understands that valuing diverse creative practices and forms of knowledge are crucial to and enrich the company’s core mission. We encourage applications from everyone, including members of all equity-seeking communities, such as (but certainly not limited to) women, racialized and Indigenous persons, persons with disabilities, persons of all sexual orientations, gender identities, and expressions.

We will ensure that qualified individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodations to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment, as appropriate. Please contact us at hiringaccommodation@mozilla.com to request accommodation.

We are an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race (including hairstyle and texture), religion (including religious grooming and dress practices), gender, gender identity, gender expression, color, national origin, pregnancy, ancestry, domestic partner status, disability, sexual orientation, age, genetic predisposition, medical condition, marital status, citizenship status, military or veteran status, or any other basis covered by applicable laws. Mozilla will not tolerate discrimination or harassment based on any of these characteristics or any other unlawful behavior, conduct, or purpose.

title: Pre-Award: MXM- Data Scientist III
description:
Barbaricum is a rapidly growing government contractor providing leading-edge support to federal customers, with a particular focus on Defense and National Security mission sets. We leverage more than 17 years of support to stakeholders across the federal government, with established and growing capabilities across Intelligence, Analytics, Engineering, Mission Support, and Communications disciplines. Founded in 2008, our mission is to transform the way our customers approach constantly changing and complex problem sets by bringing to bear the latest in technology and the highest caliber of talent.

Headquartered in Washington, DC's historic Dupont Circle neighborhood, Barbaricum also has a corporate presence in Tampa, FL, Bedford, IN, and Dayton, OH, with team members across the United States and around the world. As a leader in our space, we partner with firms in the private sector, academic institutions, and industry associations with a goal of continually building our expertise and capabilities for the benefit of our employees and the customers we support. Through all of this, we have built a vibrant corporate culture diverse in expertise and perspectives with a focus on collaboration and innovation. Our teams are at the frontier of the Nation's most complex and rewarding challenges. Join our team.

Barbaricum is seeking an Data Scientist III to directly support the anticipated Naval Surface Warfare Center (NSWC) Crane Division, Model Based Engineering Assessment Division (Code MXM). Code MXM's mission is mission engineering analysis and assessment of complex Naval, DoD, and joint kill chains — with a specialized focus on Electromagnetic Spectrum Operations (EMSO) enabled analysis. As a Data Scientist III, you will apply data science, statistics, and machine learning to Code MXM's EMSO mission engineering — supporting statistical and analytical investigations, data mining, and advanced analytics against large datasets. You will build and maintain the data pipelines and systems that turn EM spectrum data into decision-quality insight.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Support software integration or testing, including analyzing and implementing test plans and scripts.
  • Apply scripting languages such as Python and R, using packages commonly used in data science and advanced analytics.
  • Apply data science, data mining, statistics, or graph algorithms to support analytics objectives.
  • Apply SQL, NoSQL, API building, ETL pipelines, web application servers, or search index.
  • Use tools such as Python, Jupyter Notebook, Pandas, Numpy, and Requests.
  • Apply complex mathematical and statistical concepts and operations research methods and tools.
  • Employ spreadsheets for data manipulation and visualization.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Active DoD SECRET clearance (minimum); U.S. citizenship required.
  • Master's degree.
  • 10 or more years of professional experience with data science.

DESIRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Relevant industry certification such as CompTIA Cloud Essentials, Microsoft Technical Associate (MTA), Certificate of Cloud Security Knowledge (CCSK), CompTIA A+, CompTIA Security+, EMC Data Science Associate (EMCDSA), Cloudera Certified Data Scientist (CCDH), Certified Apache Hadoop Developer (HCAHD), CISSP, Cloudera Certified Professional (CCP), MCPD, MCSD, MCSE / Private Cloud, or Cloudera Certified Administrator for Apache Hadoop (CCAH).

EEO Commitment

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to sex, race, ethnicity, age, national origin, citizenship, religion, physical or mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, pregnancy, family structure, marital status, ancestry, domestic partner status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, veteran or military status, or any other basis prohibited by law.

title: Staff Software Engineer (GenAI Innovation/ Forward deployed)
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Staff Software Engineer (GenAI Innovation / Forward Deployed) based in the United States.

As a Staff Software Engineer, you will lead the development of innovative systems that turn emerging generative AI capabilities into practical, scalable business solutions. You’ll work in a forward-deployed environment where experimentation, rapid prototyping, and measurable business impact are central to the role. The position spans backend services, APIs, databases, cloud infrastructure, and web experiences, giving you broad technical ownership from concept through production. You’ll explore frontier AI technologies while applying sound engineering judgment to determine where AI can—and cannot—create meaningful value. Working across a complex, matrixed organization, you’ll partner with multidisciplinary teams to move ideas quickly from experimentation into reliable production systems. You’ll also leverage AI-assisted development tools to accelerate engineering workflows without compromising quality. This is an opportunity to shape how next-generation AI is applied across large-scale media, entertainment, and consumer-facing businesses.

  • Assess proposed AI use cases critically, distinguishing genuine AI opportunities from problems that are better solved through conventional technology or process improvements.

  • Deploy applications to cloud environments and troubleshoot application, infrastructure, configuration, and networking issues.

  • Collaborate across multidisciplinary and matrixed teams, building alignment through clear communication, technical expertise, and strong interpersonal skills.
  • Translate ambiguous business needs into practical technical requirements, architectures, and scalable implementations.
  • Adapt quickly to changing priorities, incorporate feedback, and continuously improve solutions as new information and technologies emerge.

    • Exposure to fine-tuning, deep learning, model training, or related AI/ML concepts.

    • Ability to work effectively within secured internal networks and complex cloud environments.

    • Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to navigate complex organizational structures and work effectively across teams.

title: Finance Director
description:
Global Gravity is on an international growth journey. Our five-year business plan budgets 15% CAGR, and we are continuing to expand into new geographical markets. Today, we operate through entities and branch offices in Norway, the UK, Australia and Qatar, with further markets expected to follow.

This is a finance leadership role with a strong commercial mandate. Commercial flair, sound business acumen and business savvy are central to the role. We want finance to help the business make better decisions, identify opportunities and improve profitability - not simply define rules, regulations and boundaries. You will combine financial discipline with a practical understanding of how the business creates value and where it should go next.

As the company develops, we expect the scope of the position to develop with it. For the right person, there is a clear opportunity to progress into a CFO role and potentially broader executive responsibility over time.


Main tasks
  • Lead and develop the finance function and take overall management responsibility for its people, priorities, quality and performance.
  • Drive budgeting, forecasting, cash flow and working-capital management and turn financial data into clear commercial insight for management.
  • Act as a close commercial sparring partner to the CEO and management team on pricing, margins, rental models, contracts, investments and growth opportunities.
  • Analyse profitability across customers, projects, products and markets and identify opportunities to strengthen commercial performance.
  • Take responsibility for foreign tax, VAT, transfer pricing and other cross-border finance matters across Global Gravity's international operations.
  • Support the financial and corporate setup of new markets and entities as Global Gravity expands geographically.
  • Manage relationships with local authorities, auditors, banks, lawyers, tax advisers and other external partners.
  • Build scalable finance processes, systems, reporting and controls that support growth without creating unnecessary bureaucracy.

Your profile

You are commercially curious and genuinely interested in the business behind the numbers. You combine strong financial discipline with sound judgement, practical business understanding and the confidence to challenge assumptions constructively.

You are comfortable moving between strategic discussions and hands-on execution. You take ownership, follow through and build useful structure without overcomplicating the business. As a relationship builder, you work effectively across functions, countries and professional backgrounds in an entrepreneurial environment where pace and initiative matter.

a) Education
  • You have a relevant educational background within finance, accounting or business, such as HD(R), Cand.merc., AP Degree in Financial Management combined with relevant experience, or similar.
b) Experience
  • You bring solid experience from a management position within finance in an international company and are comfortable taking overall responsibility for a finance function in a growing business.
  • Experience working across countries and with authorities, auditors, banks, lawyers, tax advisers and other external partners.
c) Competences
  • Strong commercial flair and sound business acumen. You are genuinely interested in the business behind the numbers and use finance to improve decisions, profitability and growth.
  • Commercially savvy and pragmatic, with the judgement to balance opportunity, risk, control and speed.
  • Strong financial foundation with practical experience in budgeting, forecasting, cash flow, financial control and management reporting.
  • Practical experience with foreign tax, VAT and cross-border matters, together with relevant knowledge of transfer pricing.
  • Able to move naturally between strategy and hands-on execution and to build useful structure without overcomplicating the business.
  • Confident working across functions and countries and comfortable challenging assumptions constructively when needed.
  • Fluent in Danish and English, both spoken and written.

We offer
  • Attractive and competitive base salary based on experience and qualifications.
  • Pension and health insurance.
  • Potential company car and performance-based bonus depending on the profile and overall package.
  • Senior management position with the opportunity for the role to develop with the business.
  • Good colleagues and a supportive working environment
  • High professionalism and focus on quality
  • Company canteen and other personnel benefits

Join us

If this sounds like the right opportunity for you, we would like to hear from you. Please send your application and CV through our recruitment system. Interviews are conducted on an ongoing basis, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible.

We look forward to hearing from you.

title: Supervisor, Clinical Laboratory
description:
POSITION SUMMARY:

The Supervisor of the clinical laboratory is a member of the Operations Department whose role is to oversee employees' performance and serve as a liaison between employees and senior management to meet company goals and quality objectives. The supervisor is responsible for daily supervision of lab staff performing duties such as laboratory testing and data review. Duties include but are not limited to coaching, motivating, staffing, evaluating, and training staff. The supervisor works closely with the manager to ensure company and team goals are met while adhering to good manufacturing practices and CLIA/CAP guidelines.

PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES:

• Provides direct supervision to professional individual contributors and/or skilled, support individual contributors

• Ensures production work is consistently completed according to department goals.

• Administers company policies that directly affect subordinate employees.

• Monitors team members to ensure adherence to SOPs and safety procedures

• Oversees training and development of all staff members

• Document nonconformances and all corrective actions taken when test systems deviate from the established

performance specifications as needed. Escalates protocol deviation to lead/supervisor.

• Handles employee issues in collaboration with the department manager and Human Resources.

• Ensures alignment with team for reasoning behind instructions/processes and changes

Ansættelsessamtaler forventes at finde sted i løbet af uge 41.

Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig!

title: Bulgarian Localization QA Tester / Proofreader (Part -time)
description:
About Welocalize

Welocalize, a Welo Global brand, serves localization teams through AI-enabled multilingual content solutions that enable enterprises to operate and scale globally. Welocalize combines AI, automation, and human expertise to support enterprises in more than 300 languages, enabling accurate, culturally aligned, and compliant multilingual content at scale.
Welocalize’s Opal Platform comprises patented technology designed to automate multilingual content and improve workflow performance for enterprises. Opal functions as an agentic system that orchestrates AI, automation, and human expertise to coordinate content workflows across the lifecycle, improving speed, scalability, and operational control for global enterprises. These solutions operate within a secure and compliant environment supported by seven ISO certifications. Welocalize is headquartered in New York with offices worldwide.

ROLE OVERVIEW
We are looking for a part-time Bulgarian Localization QA Tester / Proofreader to join a long-term.
As a Linguistic Tester, you’ll help bring high-quality Bulgarian content to life and ensure it feels natural, accurate, and polished for end users. Your main focus will be reviewing and refining localized content, making sure it reads smoothly and is free from errors. This includes checking grammar, spelling, punctuation, consistency, formatting, and cultural or contextual accuracy.
You’ll also work hands-on with products by executing test cases, identifying localization bugs, and reporting issues through internal bug-tracking systems. Once fixes are implemented, you’ll help verify that they’ve been resolved correctly. From time to time, you’ll also have the opportunity to translate content from English into Bulgarian. In addition, you’ll explore user interfaces to identify localization or functional issues, playing an important role in delivering a seamless and user-friendly experience.
This role is ideal for someone with native-level Bulgarian fluency, strong attention to detail, and an interest in quality assurance within digital products. If you’re looking for a stable, long-term role (no end date) where you can apply both your language expertise and technical skills, this is a great opportunity.
MAIN DUTIES
- Write and report relevant bugs and errors using best practices through the internal database system.
- Ability to understand and prioritize tasks and issues quickly and efficiently.
- Native language skills and cultural awareness of Bulgarian and Bulgaria.
- Good oral and written communication.
- Highly organized with attention to detail and a commitment to quality.
- QA various products by accurately following testing instructions and test cases.
- Discover and report defects (bugs) using client-specific bug-tracking tools.
- Evaluate translations in the context of software, mobile apps, and documentation.
- Be a subject matter expert for linguistic issues in Bulgarian (from Bulgaria); be able to research and resolve linguistic questions.
- Adhere to project-specific quality standards, trademarks, style guides, and client-preferred checklists and glossaries.
- Troubleshoot basic problems; be able to communicate effectively and escalate testing issues.
- Complete assigned tasks in a quality and timely manner.
IDEAL BACKGROUNDS: Marketing, Journalism, Copy Editing, Proofreading, Writing, Translation, and/or Localization

description:
Præsentation af virksomheden:

Vi er et vi-hus i stadig udvikling, hvor vi vægter høj faglig kvalitet, fællesskab og plads til humor.

Hverdagspædagogikken med fokus på legen og børnefællesskabet er omdrejningspunktet for vores pædagogiske arbejde. Vi ser legen og hverdagens mange gøremål og rutiner som vigtige læringsrum, hvor børnene får mulighed for at deltage, udforske, øve sig og opleve sig som en betydningsfuld del af fællesskabet.

Natur og udeliv er en naturlig del af hverdagen i Tjørnehuset. Vi bruger vores legeplads og nærmiljø aktivt som pædagogiske læringsmiljøer med plads til leg, bevægelse, nysgerrighed og fordybelse. Her arbejder vi også med natur, biodiversitet og bæredygtighed i børnehøjde.

Vi vægter den tætte relation til det enkelte barn og dets familie højt, fordi trygge relationer og et godt forældresamarbejde er et vigtigt fundament for barnets trivsel, udvikling og deltagelse i fællesskabet.

I vores pædagogiske arbejde anvender vi Marte Meo, samt elementer fra NUSSA og Små Fødder.

Tjørnehuset ligger lidt uden for Fuglebjerg med naturen tæt på og gode busforbindelser.

Hvem kommer du til at arbejde med:

Stillingen på 35 timer er på den ene børnehavestue med op til 24 børn i alderen 3-6 år. På stuen bliver du en del af et godt team, med en medhjælper og to pædagoger. Derudover har vi endnu en børnehavestue med op til 24 børn, samt en vuggestuegruppe med op til 14 børn. Personalegruppen består af 9 ansatte med diversitet i alder og erfaring, samt daglig leder. Vi er et vi- hus der arbejder sammen på tværs og går op i den gode stemning og det gode arbejdsmiljø.

Hvem leder vi efter:

Vi leder efter en nærværende og engageret kollega til Næstveds hyggeligste børnehave. Vi er en institution der brænder for natur, biodiversitet og udeliv, så det forventer vi også at du gør. Hos os får du nogle fantastiske kollegaer der har fokus på kerneopgaven, arbejder struktureret, lytter til hinanden og går op i at skabe den bedst mulige hverdag for børnene. Vi foretrækker en pædagog der har erfaring med aldersgruppen og ved hvad det pædagogiske arbejde i en børnehave kræver og indebærer.

Vi tilbyder

  • Næstveds hyggeligste legeplads.
  • Fagligt funderede kollegaer.
  • Et hus hvor du kan byde ind med dine kompetencer.
  • Et godt og sundt arbejdsmiljø med højt til loftet.
  • Medarbejdere der har fokus på børneperspektivet og fællesskaberne.

Vi forventer, at du

  • Brænder for udelivet på alle tider af året
  • Har øje for læringsmiljøet, med fokus på det inkluderende børnefællesskab.
  • Byder ind med faglig sparring til dine kollegaer – deltager aktivt og tager initiativ.
  • Har gode samarbejdsevner i.fh.t. børn, kollegaer og forældre.
  • Er fremmødestærk og fleksibel og kan møde i tidsrummet 6.30-17.00.

Løn- og ansættelsesvilkår sker i henhold til gældende overenskomst indgået mellem KL og BUPL.

Oplysninger om startløn og forventet løninterval

Via linket her kan ses oplysninger om relevant løninterval for den konkrete stilling. I oversigten vælges Næstved Kommune, hvilken stillingskategori (overenskomst) du ansøger til og yderligere hvilken stilling du søger. I tabellen derunder kan ses de relevante oplysninger for den konkrete stilling.

Tiltrædelse d.1/10 eller snarest derefter.

Arbejdstid pr. uge 35 timer.

Vil du vide mere, er du velkommen til at kontakte: Du er velkommen til at kontakte Daglig leder Frederikke Thiemke eller pædagog Susanne på 24591879. Vi ser gerne at du kommer forbi og hilser på os, ser huset og mærker den gode stemning inden du sender din ansøgning.

Ansøgningsfrist d.16/9-2026

Ansættelsessamtaler afholdes d.21/9 og d.22/9.

Du søger stillingen ved at sende din ansøgning, CV og anden relevant dokumentation og uddannelsesbevis elektronisk via ansøgerknappen ”Ansøg”.

Vi ser frem til at modtage din ansøgning.

title: Genopslag - Frelloskolen søger dygtig skolepædagog
description:
Brænder du for at udvikle dig som skolepædagog, så er dit næste job måske på Frelloskolen i Varde.

Stillingen er 32 timer/ugentlig. Arbejdstiden er fordelt mellem SFO og skoletid, og du vil blive en del af vores åbne og aktive fællesskab i SFO samt vores indskoling eller mellemtrin. Det betyder at arbejdstiden kan spænde i tidsrummet 6.00-17.00 mandag til torsdag samt 6.00-16.30 fredag.

Som skolepædagog hos os er du en ligeværdig del af et årgangsteam, og du er sikret forberedelsestid samt ugentlig deltagelse i årgangsteammøde samt SFO-møde.

Vi søger ansatte, der stortrives i forpligtende fællesskaber

Du vil møde engagerede kollegaer og ledere, der interesserer sig for dig og dine ideer, og som altid gerne hjælper dig. Du skal brænde for at arbejde tværproffessionelt og kunne se dig selv som en del af et fællesskab, hvor engagement, læring og trivsel er kerneelementerne i teamsamarbejdet omkring børnene, både i skole samt fritidsdelen.

Du skal have følgende med i rygsækken:

  • Et anerkendende børne- og menneskesyn, hvor alle børn og voksne gør det bedste de kan.
  • En tydelighed i din professionelle kommunikation.
  • Et hjerte der brænder for at sætte et præg på børnenes hverdag.
  • Stabilitet, troværdighed og loyalitet i enhver henseende.

Om Frelloskolen/SFO

Frelloskolen er en nybygget skole, der slog dørene op på første skoledag i august 2021. Frelloskolen er beliggende i Varde by, og vi er med vores 840 elever og små 90 medarbejdere den største skole i Varde kommune. Skolen startede som en af de 9 LEAPS-skoler i Danmark i august 2022. Hvert skoleår arbejdes der med 4 projektforløb med en varighed af 6 – 8 uger. Til at støtte os i at udvikle os som projektbaseret skole, har vi indgået aftale med KATA Fonden. Du kan læse mere om LEAPS-skolerne her: https://leapsskoler.dk/

Du vil som nyansat på Frelloskolen modtage kurser, undervisning og sparring, så du er klædt på til samarbejdet med dine kolleger om at skabe engagerende projektforløb.

SFO en er normeret til ca. 275 børn og deler lokaler med indskolingen. Vi baserer vores hverdag på tryghed, åbenhed og samarbejde både internt mellem voksne og børn, men også eksternt med forældre og øvrige samarbejdspartnere. I SFO er der særlig fokus på at tilbyde børnene forskellige aktiviteter der styrker børnene både motorisk, socialt og fagligt. Her er det op til dig at byde ind med aktiviteter som er inspirerende for børnene.

Yderligere information kan findes på hjemmesiden www.frelloskolen.dk.

Løn og ansættelse
Tiltrædelse er snarest – dog senest den 1. november 2026. Løn og ansættelsesforhold er efter gældende overenskomst.

Ønsker du at høre mere om stillingen eller er du interesseret i en rundvisning, er du velkommen til at kontakte afdelingsleder Malene Ostersen på tlf. 60163348 eller skoleleder Morten Møller Jensen på tlf. 30297417.

Ansøgningsfrist er den 14. september kl. 12.00 og ansættelsessamtaler afholdes løbende i perioden.

Send ansøgning: Du sender din ansøgning ved at trykke på knappen "Søg stillingen" og udfylde den formular, der kommer frem. Det er også muligt at vedhæfte bilag som f.eks. ansøgning, uddannelsesbevis og CV.

title: Massør med fleksible arbejdstider i Roskilde og omegn
description:
Brænder du for at hjælpe andre mennesker og gøre en forskel i hverdagen?
Vil du også gerne have balance mellem arbejde og fritid og selv bestemme dine arbejdstider?
Så er det dig, vi mangler på vores team af udekørende behandlere.

Hvem er vi?

RaskRask er et landsdækkende koncept for behandling og velvære. Vi tilbyder massage i hjemmet og på arbejdspladsen. Med mere end 250 engagerede fagpersoner og 10.000 glade kunder, er vi et populært og veletableret koncept. Vi vil gerne gøre det nemt at være selvstændig behandler og give dig frihed og fleksibilitet i din hverdag. Vores dedikerede team på kontoret i Aarhus tager sig af alt det praktiske som hjemmeside, bookingsystem, markedsføring og administration, så du får tid og overskud til at give den bedst mulige behandling til dine kunder og gøre en forskel, hvor det kan mærkes.

Hvad får du ud af det?

  • Fleksible arbejdstider: Hos RaskRask bestemmer du selv, hvornår og hvor meget du gerne vil arbejde.

  • Stærkt netværk af fagpersoner: Du vil blive en del af vores stærke netværk, der består af mere end 250 behandlere med forskellige faglige baggrunde.

  • Profil med gode anmeldelser: Få din egen profil på hjemmesiden med gode anmeldelser og opbyg faste kunderelationer.

  • Minimal administration: Vi sørger for alt det praktiske såsom markedsføring, bookingsystem og administration, så du slipper for at tænke på det.

  • Faglig udvikling: Mulighed for faglig udvikling gennem sparring med andre behandlere, vores samarbejde med At Work skolen samt vores interne læringsunivers.


Hvordan fungerer samarbejdet?

Vi har sørget for hjemmeside, bookingsystem, markedsføring og forsikring, så du kan koncentrere dig om at give en fantastisk massageoplevelse.

Du får adgang til vores partner-app, hvor du kan se dine bookings, kontakte kunderne og vælge det område, du ønsker at dække. I partner-app’en kan du åbne din kalender de dage og timer, du ønsker at arbejde og derved sammensætte din arbejdsdag, præcis som du ønsker. Kunderne har mulighed for at booke en tid med dig direkte gennem vores hjemmeside, nemt og enkelt.


Hvem er du?

  • Du er uddannet massør, kropsterapeut eller fysioterapeut.

  • Du er passioneret for dit fag, og elsker at gøre en forskel for andre mennesker

  • Du er kvalitetsbevidst og serviceminded og nyder at have kontakt med mennesker i din dagligdag.

title: Project Safety Coordinator + OSHA 500, TX
description:
Safety Worxs is seeking a Project Safety Coordinator (PSC) for a heavy civil, parking garage project in Nacogdoches, TX. There is not per diem, so local candidate preferred. The (PSC) is responsible for leading and managing all construction safety activities from project commencement through substantial completion. This role ensures full compliance with federal, state, and project-specific safety standards while fostering a proactive, positive safety culture. The PSC will remain active on the project until the ODR provides written concurrence for removal.

Responsibilities:

  • Administer and oversee the project’s safety program throughout the full construction lifecycle.
  • Implement and manage construction safety processes, including hazard identification, mitigation, and routine field inspections.
  • Conduct incident investigations and prepare documentation with preventive recommendations.
  • Provide documented continuing education and practical training in:
    • Fall Protection
    • Scaffolds
    • Excavation & Trenching
    • Confined Space
    • Crane/Equipment Operations
    • Electrical Safety
    • Incident Investigation
  • Review and approve safety method statements and procedures related to high-hazard activities.
  • Coordinate emergency response planning, including First Aid/CPR/AED requirements.
  • Maintain accurate safety records, compliance documentation, and training evidence.
  • Serve as a liaison with the ODR and project leadership for all safety matters.
  • Ensure subcontractors adhere to project safety standards and regulatory requirements.

Qualifications:

  • 7+ years building construction safety, (NOTE: O&G, industrial, specialty 3rd party contractor will not suffice) or
  • 4-year safety degree and 3+ years of actual field safety experience.
  • Must possess OSHA 500 (Construction Industry Trainer) OR OSHA 502 (Trainer Update).
    • NOTE: OSHA 10 or 30 and OSHA 510 do not satisfy the training requirement.
  • Documented continuing education in the following, dated within the last 5 years:
    • Fall Protection
    • Scaffolds
    • Excavation
    • Confined Space
    • Crane/Equipment Operations
    • Electrical Safety
    • Incident Investigation
    • Other relevant safety/health topics
  • Current certifications in:
    • Emergency First Aid
    • Cardio Pulmonary Resuscitation (CPR)
    • Automatic External Defibrillator (AED)
      (All must be current within 2 years.)
  • Strong, demonstrated experience in incident prevention, field engagement, and enforcing safety compliance.

Benefits:

  • Full-time & OT Available
  • Free Healthcare benefits
  • Dental, vision, life insurance available
  • 401k at 4% match
  • $50 - $55 Depending on Experience

title: Pædagogmedhjælper/PAU til Vuggestue Tornhøjvej - vikartiat
description:
Vi søger en dygtig pædagogmedhjælper/PAU til Vuggestue Tornhøjvej

Stillingen er på 35 timer om ugen.

Om Vuggestuen Tornhøjvej:

Vi er en lille institution med 33 børn fordelt på tre stuer. Vi bor i et nyrenoveret hus i dejlige omgivelser, bl.a. en fantastisk legeplads med buske, træer og høj til himmelen.

Vores ønsker til dig:

Du er en nærværende voksen for børnene på din stue, for det er din vigtigste opgave. Derfor er det vigtigt, at du synes, 0-2-årige er den helt rigtige aldersgruppe for dig i dit arbejde. Du er aktiv og sprudlende i kontakten med børnene. Du må gerne elske alle former for bevægelse, da vi bruger kroppen dagen lang. Vi klatrer, hopper og danser, da det får os alle til at grine og skaber en fantastisk let stemning.

Vi leder efter dig, som har gode relationskompetencer og en forståelse for den børnegruppe, du arbejder med, for det er gennem de gode barn-voksenrelationer, at du kan arbejde udviklende med børnene. Du skal have lyst til at bringe nye initiativer på banen, bidrage til udviklingen af vores fælles faglighed og hjælpe med at implementere nye tiltag, så vi hele tiden gør arbejdet endnu bedre.

Vi kan tilbyde:

En vuggestue hvor udvikling, refleksioner og faglighed vægtes højt. Du garanteres en arbejdsplads, der har gensidige forventninger til hinandens engagement, bidrag og deltagelse i den faglige udvikling.

Hos os bliver du en del af et tæt og godt arbejdsfællesskab. Vi evner at skabe gode forudsætninger for en høj trivsel, der er altafgørende for den gode dagligdag og arbejdsglæden. Arbejdsglæde betragter vi som et fælles og et individuelt ansvar, da det i høj grad handler om indstilling. Derfor forventer vi at møde en ressourceorienteret og smilende kollega, der ser ”glasset halvt fuldt”.

Vil du vide mere om stillingen?

Hvis du har spørgsmål til stillingen eller vil vide mere om Vuggestuen Tornhøjvej, er du mere end velkommen til at ringe til pædagogisk leder Jolanta Olesen på 9982 4250.

title: Barselsvikariat som Familiebehandler i Familiehuset, Center for Børn og Familier
description:
37 timer ugentligt – tiltrædelse den 1. november 2026. Vikariat i 6 måneder med mulighed for forlængelse.

Vil du være med til at skabe varige forandringer for børn, unge og familier?

Brænder du for at arbejde med børn, unge og familier i komplekse livssituationer? Motiveres du af at omsætte faglig viden til konkrete indsatser, der skaber udvikling og håb? Så er det måske dig, vi søger som barselsvikar i Familiehuset.


Om os

Du bliver en del af Familiehuset, som er en afdeling i Center for Børn og Familier i Tårnby Kommune.

I Center for Børn og Familier arbejder vi hver dag for, at børn og unge får de bedste muligheder for trivsel, udvikling og deltagelse i fællesskaber. Vi tror på, at de bedste løsninger skabes sammen med børnene, de unge, deres familier og de professionelle omkring dem.

Familiehuset består af engagerede familiebehandlere, støttekontaktpersoner og psykologer, som arbejder tæt sammen om at skabe helhedsorienterede og virkningsfulde indsatser. Vi prioriterer høj faglighed, refleksion, sparring og en kultur, hvor vi hjælper hinanden og udvikler os sammen.

Hos os møder du kolleger med forskellige faglige baggrunde, et stærkt fællesskab og en ledelse, der vægter tillid, dialog og faglig udvikling.


Om stillingen

Som familiebehandler bliver du en del af et tværfagligt team, hvor du arbejder tæt sammen med børn, unge og deres familier om at skabe positive og varige forandringer.

Du tilrettelægger familiebehandlingen med udgangspunkt i Barnets Lov, familiens ressourcer og de mål, der er opstillet i samarbejde med myndighedsrådgiver. Du arbejder både i familiens hjem, i Familiehuset og i familiens øvrige arenaer, når det understøtter indsatsen.

Dine opgaver vil blandt andet være at:

  • planlægge og gennemføre familiebehandlingsforløb

  • styrke forældres omsorgskompetencer og familiens samspil

  • understøtte børns og unges trivsel, udvikling og deltagelse i hverdagslivet

  • arbejde løsningsfokuseret og inddragende med hele familien

  • samarbejde tæt med myndighedsrådgivere, dagtilbud, skoler og øvrige samarbejdspartnere

  • udarbejde statusbeskrivelser og dokumentere indsatsen løbende

  • bidrage aktivt til den fælles faglige udvikling i Familiehuset.

  • Tilbyde forebyggende familiebehandlingssamtaler

Arbejdstiden er fleksibel og vil efter behov omfatte enkelte eftermiddags- og aftentimer.


Vi søger en kollega, der

  • har en relevant psykolog- eller pædagogfaglig uddannelse

  • har erfaring med familiebehandling eller anden behandlingsindsats for børn og familier

  • kan skabe tillidsfulde relationer og arbejde anerkendende og systemisk

  • har blik for både barnets perspektiv og familiens samlede situation

  • trives med selvstændigt ansvar og samtidig bidrager aktivt til teamets fællesskab

  • arbejder struktureret og har gode skriftlige kompetencer


Vi tilbyder

  • et spændende barselsvikariat med stor faglig variation

  • engagerede og erfarne kolleger, som prioriterer sparring og videndeling

  • løbende supervision og mulighed for faglig udvikling

  • en arbejdsplads med høj faglighed, humor og et stærkt kollegialt fællesskab

title: SOSU-Assistent til P&R, Team Hjortshøj
description:
Har du lyst til at arbejde med længerevarende borgerforløb, hvor du kan opbygge tætte relationer og gøre en forskel i borgernes hverdag?
Bliver du motiveret af at støtte borgere i at vedligeholde deres helbred og funktionsevne, så de i størst muligt omfang kan leve det liv, de ønsker?
Så er det måske dig, vi mangler som vores nye kollega!

Pleje og Rehabilitering har fokus på at skabe sammenhængende og velkoordinerede forløb, der tager udgangspunkt i borgernes ønsker, behov, ressourcer og potentialer.
Da en af vores social- og sundhedsassistenter har ønsket at prøve nye kræfter i et andet erhverv, søger vi nu en ny engageret SOSU-assistent, der har lyst til at blive en del af vores team og være med til at realisere vores fælles visioner.

Vi varetager primært sygepleje, pleje og praktisk hjælp samt træning og rehabilitering for borgere med længerevarende støttebehov.
Vores tilgang er rehabiliterende og sundhedsfremmende, med fokus på forebyggelse, oplæring og borgersikkerhed. Vi arbejder ud fra Sundhed og Omsorgs Forløbsmodel, som giver struktur og sammenhæng i borgerforløbene.

Forløbene spænder fra komplekse forløb med kronisk syge og multisyge borgere til mindre komplekse forløb, hvor der primært er behov for støtte til praktiske opgaver eller lettere pleje.

Som SSA vil du bl.a. have fokus på delegerede sygeplejeydelser som medicindosering, injektioner og sårpleje. Du bliver en vigtig del af et tværfagligt team, hvor samarbejdet med sygeplejersker og terapeuter sikrer høj faglig kvalitet og stærk opgaveløsning.

Du får et tæt samarbejde med en kompetenceudviklende terapeut og sygeplejerske, som klæder dig fagligt på, tilbyder sparring og følgeskab, og støtter dig i at udvikle hjælpernes borgerspecifikke kompetencer – så du får mere tid til de komplekse opgaver.

Vi gør opmærksom på, at stillingen ligger inden for det døgndækkede område. Der vil dog primært være dagvagter med weekendrul hver 4. weekend.

Vi søger en kandidat, der:

  • Er uddannet social- og sundhedsassistent
  • Motiveres af at understøtte borgernes helbreds- og funktionsevne, så de kan forblive mest muligt selvhjulpne
  • Trives i længerevarende relationer og finder glæde i at følge borgernes udvikling
  • Ser værdien i tværfagligt samarbejde og bidrager aktivt til helhedsorienterede borgerforløb
  • Kommunikerer respektfuldt og anerkendende – både med borgere, pårørende og kolleger
  • Har let til smil og ser humor som en vigtig del af en god arbejdsdag
  • Arbejder selvstændigt og tænker gerne kreativt i opgaveløsningen
  • Har gyldigt kørekort
Derfor skal du vælge os

Hos os får du:

  • Høj grad af indflydelse i opgaveløsningen – altid i tæt samarbejde med borgere, pårørende og kolleger.
  • Et team, der vil både opgaverne og hinanden – vi brænder for at udvikle vores faglighed og tør tænke nyt.
  • En arbejdsplads med balance mellem faglighed og humor – vi tager arbejdet alvorligt, men os selv med et glimt i øjet.
  • Frihed under ansvar – et selvstændigt og meningsfuldt job med faglige udfordringer og stor handlefrihed.
  • En arbejdsplads, hvor det er vigtigt, at du har energi og overskud til også at være til stede i dit privatliv.
  • Et team, hvor alle er lige vigtige – vi har forskellige roller og ansvar, men et fælles fokus på kvalitet i opgaveløsningen.
Vi lægger vægt på:

  • Medansvar og medindflydelse som nøgle til et godt arbejdsmiljø.
  • Et arbejdsliv med højt til loftet og plads til forskellighed.
  • En kultur, hvor vi sammen med borgerne løser opgaverne med respekt og professionalisme.
  • God opstart er vigtig for os. Du vil derfor få et tilrettelagt introduktionsprogram, som sikrer, at du bliver godt klædt på til opgaverne og får en tryg start hos os.
Løn og ansættelsesvilkår:

Stillingen ønskes tiltrådt d.01.11.2026 eller efter aftale

Løn- og ansættelsesvilkår efter gældende overenskomst og efter konkret forhandling med den forhandlingsberettigede organisation.

Hvis du vil vide mere:

Yderligere oplysninger om stillingen kan fås ved henvendelse til leder Anders Kloster på tlf.29 20 98 42 eller e-mail: andbekl@aarhus.dk eller til Gitte Simonsen, Viceleder i Team Hjortshøj på tlf. 41 85 56 61 eller e-mail: sdgi@aarhus.dk



Ansøgning:

Klik på ”søg jobbet” nedenfor for at udfylde og sende din ansøgning. Alle felter med * skal udfyldes. Først når du har modtaget en kvittering pr. e-mail, har vi modtaget din ansøgning.

Ansøgningsfristen er den 25.09.2026

Der afholdes løbende samtaler.

I Magistratsafdelingen for Sundhed og Omsorg har vi en generel politik om, at der ved ansættelser indhentes referencer og evt. straffeattest. Du må derfor forvente at blive anmodet herom, hvis vi tilbyder dig stillingen.
Vi gør opmærksom på, at der i forbindelse med rekrutteringsprocessen vil blive foretaget opslag i vores referenceregister. Referenceregisteret omfatter tidligere medarbejdere i Magistratsafdelingen for Sundhed og Omsorg, der er blevet bortvist grundet væsentlig misligholdelse af ansættelsesforholdet.

Om Sundhed og Omsorg og Aarhus Kommune:

Sundhed og Omsorg (MSO) i Aarhus Kommune arbejder med omsorg for ældre og sundhed for alle borgere.


Aarhus Kommune betragter mangfoldighed som en ressource og opfordrer derfor alle - uanset alder, køn, handicap, livsstil, religion eller etnisk tilhørsforhold - til at ansøge stillingen.
Aarhus Kommune er en af Jyllands største arbejdspladser, hvor 28.000 professionelle og passionerede kollegaer hver dag arbejder for at gøre visioner til virkelighed og skabe værdi for borgere og samfundet omkring os. Vi er en arbejdsplads, der vægter faglighed og samarbejde højt og vi tror på, at vores forskelligheder er med til at gøre Aarhus til en god by for alle. Sammen arbejder vi for en bæredygtig og inkluderende by, hvor både ansatte, borgere, virksomheder og naturen kan trives og blomstre. Vi har ambitioner for byen – og for dig. Kom og vær med!

title: Associate, Private Equity
description:
Firm Overview:

Ariel Alternatives is a growth-oriented private equity firm focused on acquiring high-quality businesses within strong, growing markets – built on a four-decade-old foundation as the private equity arm of Ariel Investments. The fund is highly differentiated within the private equity landscape, with the majority of LPs consisting of Fortune 500 companies who are invested in the success of the portfolio. These partners bring deep industry knowledge that helps build conviction during diligence and often become major customers after deals close.

The fund is currently investing out of its inaugural $1.45 billion fund, which has significant remaining dry powder available to invest. The firm targets majority control investments in high-quality B2B services businesses with EBITDA of up to $50 million across sectors benefiting from strong secular tailwinds (e.g., energy / utilities, industrials, business services, technology services). The team is lean, with significant opportunity for new associates to scale quickly in a highly entrepreneurial environment, take ownership and make an impact.

For more information, please visit .

Position Summary:

We are seeking a highly motivated Pre-MBA Associate to support all aspects of the private equity investment process. Responsibilities include supporting the team with executing new platform deals and add-on acquisitions, structuring and implementing value creation strategies and developing new investment thesis areas.

The ideal candidate will demonstrate intellectual curiosity, strong analytical skills, a desire to work in a fast-paced, entrepreneurial environment and have 2+ years of investment banking or private equity experience. We are a growing team that offers significant opportunity for career progression, with each new hire playing a pivotal role in shaping our culture. The firm maintains an inclusive and collaborative environment with a strong commitment to mentorship.

This position is based in our New York City office.

Responsibilities:

  • Deal Screening: Support efforts to evaluate potential investment opportunities.
  • Investment Analysis: Conduct rigorous business diligence, financial analyses, market research and strategic assessments to support informed investment decision-making.
  • Transaction Execution: Collaborate with senior investment professionals to conduct thorough due diligence, encompassing financial, commercial, operational and legal assessments; help manage 3rd party diligence vendors and lenders; provide qualitative and quantitative support for investment committee memos.
  • Portfolio Company Management: Help manage, monitor and report on portfolio companies, supporting add-on acquisitions, corporate finance activities, operational initiatives and quarterly reporting.
  • Marketing and Communications: Contribute to developing marketing materials and communications for limited partners, co-investors, debt providers and other relevant stakeholders.
  • Thesis Development: Assist with developing new investment thesis areas with additional impact from sourcing relevant opportunities.
  • Culture: Make a positive impact by being a supportive team member and effective project manager, fostering a cooperative and inclusive work environment.

Qualifications:

  • Experience: High performer with 2+ years in investment banking or private equity
  • Education: Bachelor’s degree demonstrating superior academic performance; all majors considered
  • Skills:
    • Excellent communication and interpersonal abilities
    • Strong grounding in modeling, accounting, finance, capital markets and quantitative analysis
    • Proficiency in analyzing, interpreting and distilling complex data sets and models to help drive investment decisions
    • Solid understanding of debt and equity capital structures
    • Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite, particularly Excel and PowerPoint
  • Attributes:
    • Highly motivated with a strong passion for investing
    • Team-oriented yet capable of independent work
    • Able to thrive in a fast-paced environment and manage multiple deadlines
    • Organized, detail-oriented and adept at multitasking

Compensation

The base salary range for this role is $135,000 - $135,000 + Bonus

Compliance:

Ariel employees, including the incumbent(s) in this position, are required to: (1) read and strictly adhere to all compliance policies and procedures of the various Ariel entities, as applicable; and (2) work together with their colleagues, including the CCO, to resolve compliance issues.

Equal Opportunity Employer / Diversity:

Ariel celebrates diversity and practices inclusion as a way to get work done – it’s in our DNA. As an equal opportunity employer, employment decisions are based on business needs, job requirements and individual qualifications without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, ancestry, marital status, parental status (including pregnancy), disability, perceived disability, veteran status, status of military discharge, or any other basis under federal, state, or local law. Ariel prohibits discrimination against an applicant or employee because of their actual or perceived protected characteristic(s), and is committed to recruiting, retaining, and developing a diverse group of talented applicants, and to providing employees with a workplace free from discrimination and/or harassment.

Equal employment opportunity takes place in all employment practices, including recruiting, hiring, promotion, demotion, compensation, and termination. The firm seeks to uphold an inclusive culture where diversity is recognized and valued. As such, Ariel provides employees a robust benefits package that includes:

  • Coverage for same-sex partner (domestic or spouse)
  • Coverage for children (natural born, step, adopted or foster)
  • Fully paid medical insurance that covers fertility treatments, gender affirmation
  • Employer contributions to a Health Savings Account
  • Maternity leave at 100% pay (12 weeks)
  • Paid Parental Leave (up to 12 weeks depending on tenure)

Lastly, all employees have access to Ariel-sponsored educational, training, and recreational activities.

title: T3 Content and Technical Writer
description:
Build the Future with Us — EquipmentShare is Hiring a T3 Content and Technical Writer

At EquipmentShare, we’re not just filling a role — we’re assembling the best team on the planet to build something that’s never been built before. We’re on a mission to transform an industry that’s been stuck in the past by empowering contractors and communities through innovative technology, real-time support, and a team that truly cares.

We’re hiring a T3 Content and Technical Writer at our Corporate Headquarters in Columbia, MO and we’re looking for someone who’s ready to grow with us, bring energy and drive to their work, and help us build the future of construction.

The T3 Content and Technical Writer brings creativity and precision to their work, helping tell the T3 story through clear, engaging, and impactful content. This role develops and supports customer-facing communications, digital content, technical documentation, and knowledge resources to help customers and employees use T3 successfully. By partnering with cross-functional stakeholders, this role helps create, maintain, and improve content while ensuring T3’s voice remains consistent across customer and employee touchpoints

Primary Responsibilities

  • Perform job duties in accordance with EquipmentShare’s vision, mission, and values.
  • Develop, contribute, revise, and maintain customer-facing communications, sales enablement resources, technical documentation, knowledge base articles, SOPs, playbooks, user guides, training materials, and operational documentation.
  • Develop content that supports customer education, employee enablement, sales enablement, product adoption, and business operations.
  • Coordinate with Product, Marketing, and other stakeholders to align messaging and improve the overall knowledge experience.
  • Partner with cross-functional teams and subject matter experts to develop, review, coordinate, and publish content that supports customer education, training, sales enablement, and product adoption.
  • Translate technical, operational, and product information into clear, accurate, and engaging content for diverse audiences.
  • Leverage AI tools to accelerate content creation, editing, organization, and maintenance while ensuring accuracy, quality, and consistency.
  • Help establish and maintain documentation standards, templates, style guides, and governance practices to ensure consistent, high-quality content.
  • Review, edit, and continuously improve content to ensure accuracy, consistency, accessibility, branding, and alignment with business objectives.
  • Partner with Product and other stakeholders to ensure customer communications, documentation, and training resources reflect product enhancements, business initiatives, and process changes.
  • Create visual content, including screenshots, diagrams, workflow maps, videos, and other supporting resources, to enhance understanding.
  • Analyze stakeholder feedback, content usage, and support trends to identify content gaps and continuously improve documentation and knowledge resources.

Why EquipmentShare?

Because we do things differently — and we think you’ll feel it from day one. We’re a people-first company powered by cutting-edge technology. That means our proprietary T3 platform doesn’t just run our business — it also makes your job easier, safer, and more connected. Whether you’re behind the wheel, under the hood, leading a branch, or closing deals — tech supports you, and you drive us forward.

We’re a team of problem-solvers, go-getters, and builders. And we’re looking for teammates who take pride in doing meaningful work and want to be part of building something special.

Perks & Benefits

  • Competitive compensation

  • Full medical, dental, and vision coverage for full-time employees

  • Generous PTO + paid holidays

  • 401(k) + company match

  • Gym membership stipend + wellness programs (earn PTO and prizes!)

  • Company events, food truck nights

  • 16 hours of paid volunteer time per year — give back to the community you call home

  • Career advancement, leadership training, and professional development opportunities

About You

You want to be part of a team that’s not just changing an industry for the sake of change — we’re transforming it to make it safer, more secure, and more productive. You bring grit, heart, and humility to your work, and you’re excited about the opportunity to grow within a fast-paced, mission-driven environment.

We’re looking for people who:

  • See challenges as opportunities

  • Embrace change and continuous improvement

  • Bring energy, effort, and optimism every day

Skills & Qualifications

    • Exemplary written and verbal communication skills with a talent for creating clear, engaging, and audience-appropriate content.
    • Strong technical writing, editing, proofreading, and quality assurance skills with exceptional attention to detail.
    • Demonstrated proficiency in developing sales enablement resources, customer-facing communications, technical documentation, knowledge base content, training materials, and operational documentation.
    • Skilled at translating complex technical and operational information into user-friendly documentation and communications.
    • Proven collaboration skills with cross-functional teams and subject matter experts.
    • Strong understanding of content strategy, knowledge management, and documentation best practices.
    • Continuous learning mindset with an interest in emerging AI tools and technologies, and the ability to leverage AI to research, create, refine, and maintain high-quality content.
    • Excellent organizational and project management skills with the ability to manage multiple projects and deadlines simultaneously.
    • Strong analytical and critical thinking skills to identify content gaps, improve documentation, and recommend process improvements.
    • Customer-focused mindset with a passion for creating content that enhances the customer and employee experience.e

    Education and Experience:

    • Bachelor's degree in Communications, English, Journalism, Marketing, Technical Writing, or related field preferred.
    • At least 3 years of experience in content development, technical writing, communications, customer education, or a related field.
    • Experience creating customer-facing communications, technical documentation, knowledge base content, training materials, or operational documentation.
    • Experience working with content management systems (CMS), knowledge base platforms, learning management systems (LMS), or documentation tools preferred.
    • Experience in SaaS, technology, or construction/fleet management industries is preferred.

    Physical Requirements:

    • Prolonged periods sitting at a desk and working on a computer

A Workplace For All

At EquipmentShare, we believe the best solutions come from a team that reflects the world around us. Our initiative — A Workplace For All — is rooted in the belief that we must work together to solve some of the toughest problems in construction. That means attracting, developing, and retaining great people from all walks of life.

We value different backgrounds, talents, and perspectives. We want you to feel like you belong here — because you do.

EquipmentShare is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, national origin, disability, or status as a protected veteran.

Employment is contingent on passing a background check. Additionally, some roles require passing a drug test, depending on the job responsibilities.

title: Resident Solution Architect (Databricks)
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Resident Solution Architect (Databricks) based in United States.

This is a senior, hands-on architecture role focused on delivering large-scale Databricks implementations for enterprise clients.
You’ll operate at the intersection of data engineering, cloud architecture, and client advisory, shaping modern Lakehouse environments from design through production.
You’ll help organizations make strategic platform decisions while also getting deeply involved in technical delivery and optimization.
The role offers the opportunity to work on complex, production-grade data infrastructure across sophisticated and regulated environments.
You’ll tackle distributed computing, performance optimization, CI/CD, and MLOps challenges at significant scale.
Working directly with enterprise stakeholders, you’ll translate business and technical needs into scalable, resilient data platforms.
This is an ideal opportunity for an experienced architect who enjoys combining technical depth, client engagement, and hands-on execution.

Accountabilities:

  • Lead end-to-end Databricks implementation initiatives, taking solutions from architecture and design through deployment and production.
  • Advise enterprise clients on Lakehouse architecture, platform capabilities, best practices, technology roadmaps, and implementation strategies.
  • Design scalable and resilient data platforms capable of supporting complex enterprise workloads and evolving business requirements.
  • Optimize large-scale distributed data systems, identifying and resolving performance and scalability challenges across production environments.
  • Serve as a hands-on technical lead, contributing directly to cloud-based implementations across AWS, Azure, and/or GCP.
  • Design, implement, and support CI/CD pipelines that enable reliable and repeatable production deployments for data platforms.
  • Apply MLOps principles and patterns to connect data engineering workflows with machine learning development and deployment processes.
  • Collaborate closely with client technical teams and stakeholders, providing architectural guidance and helping drive successful adoption of modern Lakehouse practices.
  • Bring practical expertise from multiple enterprise implementations to solve complex technical challenges and establish scalable architectural patterns.

    • Requirements:

    • 10+ years of consulting experience, including at least 7 years focused on data engineering, data platforms, analytics, or closely related disciplines.
    • Proven hands-on delivery of approximately 6–8 or more enterprise-scale Databricks implementation projects.
    • Deep expertise in Apache Spark and distributed computing, including a strong understanding of Spark runtime internals.
    • Extensive knowledge of the Databricks Lakehouse Platform, its capabilities, architectural patterns, and current best practices.
    • Databricks Data Engineering Professional Certification is strongly preferred.
    • Demonstrated experience optimizing and tuning large-scale data platforms for performance, reliability, and scalability.
    • Hands-on experience with at least one major cloud platform, including AWS, Azure, or GCP; multi-cloud experience is an advantage.
    • Solid understanding of CI/CD practices and pipelines for production data-platform deployments.
    • Working knowledge of MLOps concepts and their application across modern data and machine learning workflows.
    • Strong consulting, communication, and client-facing skills, with the ability to explain complex technical concepts and influence architectural decisions.
    • Ability to work independently in hands-on technical environments while balancing delivery priorities and client advisory responsibilities.
    • Must be authorized to work in the United States; visa sponsorship is not available for this position.

      • Benefits:

      • Compensation of up to $80/hour on W2.
      • Fully remote position with flexibility to work from anywhere in North America.
      • Opportunity to lead enterprise-scale Databricks and Lakehouse transformations.
      • Exposure to complex, high-impact data environments and modern cloud technologies.
      • Hands-on work across data engineering, distributed computing, CI/CD, and MLOps.
      • Senior-level client advisory and technical leadership opportunities.
