title: Electronic Manufacturing Technician
description:
We’re seeking a detail-oriented, experienced Electronic/Circuit Board Technician to join our production team. This role will support multiple production programs and projects, with primary responsibility focused on electronic assemblies, circuit board troubleshooting, testing, repair, and quality verification, while ensuring products meet exact specifications, quality standards, and safety requirements.
Key Responsibilities
  • Perform electronic assembly, soldering, rework, repair, and testing of printed circuit boards (PCBs) and electronic assemblies
  • Support a variety of manufacturing and assembly programs, with a primary focus on electronics-related products and systems
  • Diagnose, troubleshoot, and repair electronic components, assemblies, and systems to component level
  • Execute production tasks across various programs, including PCB population, wire harness assembly, component installation, system integration, and circuit board testing
  • Follow detailed electrical schematics, wiring diagrams, assembly instructions, and technical documentation
  • Conduct in-process inspections to ensure compliance with engineering specifications and quality standards
  • Collaborate with engineering and quality teams to troubleshoot and resolve issues
  • Maintain accurate documentation, test records, and production reports
  • Support continuous improvement initiatives and process enhancements
  • Operate test equipment including multimeters, oscilloscopes, power supplies, and other electronic diagnostic tools
  • Perform soldering and desoldering of through-hole and surface mount (SMT) components
Qualifications
  • High school diploma or equivalent; technical degree, electronics certification, or military electronics training preferred
  • Minimum 5 years of hands-on experience in electronics assembly, PCB repair, testing, troubleshooting, or electronics manufacturing required
  • Ability to read and interpret electrical schematics, wiring diagrams, PCB layouts, and technical drawings
  • Strong manual dexterity and attention to detail
  • Experience with IPC standards (IPC-A-610, IPC J-STD-001, or equivalent) preferred
  • Experience with SMT and through-hole soldering required
  • Electronics troubleshooting and component-level repair experience strongly preferred
  • Aerospace, defense, industrial, medical device, or other high-reliability electronics manufacturing experience is a plus
  • Experience performing soldering, inspection, and testing to IPC and/or military standards.is a plus
Additional
  • Drug and Alcohol testing is mandatory and random
  • Pay is dependent on experience
  • Full Time

title: Bliv ambulancebehandlerelev i Akutberedskabet
description:
Drømmer du om et job, hvor du kan gøre en forskel og redde liv? Er du god til at holde hovedet koldt, når det gælder? Kan du skabe tryghed og tillid hos alle typer mennesker? Så bliv ambulancebehandlerelev hos os!

Hvad går jobbet ud på?
Som ambulancebehandlerelev lærer du at yde akut førstehjælp, at håndtere opstået sygdom og skader, samt at skabe tryghed i pressede situationer. Det er et job, hvor det tit skal gå hurtigt, men der er også opgaver, hvor omsorg og kommunikation er det vigtigste.
Det præhospitale setup løser i dag mange ikke-akutte opgaver for sundhedsvæsenet. Derfor er det vigtigt, at du i høj grad er drevet af omsorg og pleje, frem for udelukkende blå blink.

Uddannelsen er en blanding af praktik og skole. I praktikken kører du ambulance sammen med erfarne ambulancebehandlere og paramedicinere, der lærer dig alt om jobbet, og du får en bred erfaring og viden om en masse forskellige situationer. Du vil få tilknyttet en vejleder, som kan støtte og vejlede dig undervejs i uddannelsen, så du efter endt elevtid vil være i stand til at skabe tryghed, uanset hvilken situation du bliver mødt af på jobbet.

Du vil opleve perioder med travlhed og også mere rutineprægede opgaver og der vil være situationer som kræver store samarbejdsevner, eller situationer som skal løses på egen hånd.

Dit ansættelsessted og dine praktikperioder vil være på en af Akutberedskabets baser.

Dine skoleperioderne vil foregå i Hillerød.

Hvem er du?

  • Du er fyldt 21 år ved ansættelse
  • Du har kørekort (kategori B) og mindst 3 års kørerfaring
  • Du har afsluttet 9. klasse (eller mere) med gode færdigheder i dansk og matematik
  • Du har gode IT-kompetencer
  • Du er i god fysisk form
  • Du kan holde hovedet koldt, tænke hurtigt og tage ansvar
  • Du trives i en hverdag, der er uforudsigelig
  • Du har erfaring med at kommunikere med mange forskellige typer mennesker
  • Du har gennemført Grundforløb 2 til Ambulancebehandler eller lever op til optagelseskravene herfor. Din ansættelse vil i så fald være betinget af, at du består Grundforløb 2 til Ambulancebehandler.
Hvis du har afsluttet dansk og matematik på minimum 10. klasses niveau (E), har grundforløbet en varighed på 12 uger. Hvis du ikke har det, vil grundforløbet have en varighed på 20 uger.

Hvad kan du forvente af dit kommende arbejde?

  • En spændende hverdag med både akutte og ikke-akutte opgaver
  • En unik uddannelse med masser af praktisk erfaring
  • Mulighed for at videreuddanne dig til paramediciner eller visitator på 1-1-2
  • Mulighed for at specialisere dig, så du fx kan køre akutbil, lægebil eller sociolance
  • En stærk holdånd og en masse kolleger, som støtter dig
Lyder det som noget for dig? Så send din ansøgning og bliv en del af et vigtigt fællesskab, hvor hver dag er en ny udfordring!

Din elevløn følger FOA’s løntakster jf. overenskomsten:

Sådan søger du
Vi optager elever på baggrund af en samlet vurdering af ansøgning, fysiske tests og samtaler. Når vi har læst ansøgningerne, udvælger vi kandidater til den fysiske test.

Du søger online via ansøgningsknappen. Upload din motiverede ansøgning sammen med dit CV, vedlagt dokumentation for tidligere uddannelser eller kurser. Du skal også sende en kopi af for- og bagsiden på dit kørekort.

Vi vægter lige muligheder for alle vores jobansøgere. Du skal derfor ikke indsætte et billede i dit CV eller på din ansøgning.

Hvis du bliver indkaldt til samtale, beder vi dig venligst medbringe en gyldig straffeattest, som del af vores rekrutteringsprocedure.

Indholdet i den afleverede straffeattest skal være foreneligt med stillingen. Dette vil bero på en konkret, individuel og saglig vurdering foretaget af den ansættende leder.

title: Tree Climber
description:
Tree Climber

Pay Range $25.00 - $32.00 per hour

Arbor Masters is committed to nurturing a culturally inclusive environment that hires, trains, and promotes regardless of race, sex, age, national origin, sexual orientation, religion, political beliefs, veteran status, or any other protected class. We will always cultivate an environment that celebrates differences in our teams at all Arbor Masters branches. We recognize that a diverse and inclusive workforce results in better decision-making, faster and more innovative problem solving, and creates a safe and welcoming environment for everyone.

Why work at Arbor Masters?

Arbor Masters is a third-generation, family-owned business, specializing in all areas of tree service and plant care. We love our industry, our work family, and making sure our customers are satisfied by approaching our work with high-level standards for safety and excellence. title: Director, Regulatory Writing
description:
The Organization

What's happening at Entrada Therapeutics? Entrada is a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company aiming to transform the lives of patients by establishing a new class of medicines that engage intracellular targets that have long been considered inaccessible. Through proprietary and versatile approaches, Entrada is advancing a robust development portfolio of genetic medicines for the potential treatment of neuromuscular and inherited retinal diseases, among others. Our lead oligonucleotide programs are in development for the potential treatment of people living with Duchenne muscular dystrophy (DMD) who are exon 44, 45, 50 and 51 skipping amenable. Entrada has partnered with Vertex Pharmaceuticals to develop a clinical-stage program, VX-670, for myotonic dystrophy type 1 (DM1).

2026 represents a catalyst-rich period for Entrada. We expect multiple clinical data readouts as we advance several DMD programs across the U.K., EU, and U.S. By year-end 2026, we anticipate four clinical-stage programs in our DMD franchise (ENTR-601-44, ENTR-601-45, ENTR-601-50, and ENTR-601-51). These programs are complemented by the ongoing clinical progress of our DM1 collaboration with Vertex (VX-670).

We are a tight-knit team of experts and leaders in both therapeutic development and rare diseases and are excited to grow and attract colleagues who are ready to join a high-energy, dedicated team that likes to get things done and dramatically improve the lives of patients and their families.

The Perfect Addition to Our Team

You are passionate and dedicated to your work, with a commitment to overcome challenges and deliver on our potential to develop transformative therapies for patients and their caregivers. You bring energy and enthusiasm to your role, while recognizing that a steady and consistent effort is required to successfully develop novel medicines. Most importantly, while experience within a Regulatory Writing department at a growing biotech is beneficial, a motivated attitude and commitment to collective success are paramount.

The Opportunity

The Regulatory Affairs team at Entrada is a dynamic, growing team. The Director of Regulatory Writing will coordinate and lead the efficient generation of high-quality regulatory documentation to support advancing Entrada’s pipeline, from preclinical through the clinical and registration stages. Reporting to the Senior Vice President, Regulatory Affairs, the successful candidate will support the development of strong internal processes, be the key liaison with external writing providers, serve as a lead author and document specialist, and support documentation planning and submission activities.

This high-impact role will be critical to the success of the Regulatory department and Entrada’s mission to discover, develop and commercialize life-changing medicines that are safe, effective and accessible to those who need them. The successful candidate will have a demonstrated track record as a lead writer for a broad range of documents representing various stages of global development, an ability and desire to coordinate regulatory documentation across Entrada’s growing portfolio, and working collaboratively with departmental and cross-functional colleagues.

Responsibilities

  • Leads the planning and management for the authoring of regulatory submission components from the pre-clinical through registration phase, including clinical protocols and amendments, Investigator's Brochures, Development Safety Update Reports, clinical study reports, health authority meeting requests and briefing documents, and summary documents for IND, CTA, CTR, and NDA submissions.
  • Leverages and efficiently manages external resources to ensure efficient execution of regulatory writing activities while ensuring effective communication with internal contributors and stakeholders.
  • Serves as a lead author and/or document expert to maximize quality and efficiency of critical deliverables.
  • Represents Regulatory Writing on cross-functional teams, working in close partnership with subject matter experts, Regulatory Affairs, and Program Management.
  • Expands processes and standards that are critical to Regulatory Writing, including development, maintenance, and improvement of SOPs, authoring guides, and project management tools.
  • Collaborates with Regulatory Affairs team to support submission-related activities.
  • Develop strong working relationships with Regulatory colleagues and cross-functional project teams, as well as external stakeholders, to support achievement of timelines and portfolio deliverables.

The Necessities

At Entrada, our passion for science, our devotion to patients and our values drives our behavior:

  • Humanity - We genuinely care about patients and about one another.
  • Tenacity - We are relentless and persistent in the pursuit of developing therapies for patients.
  • Creativity - We are creative problem solvers.
  • Collaboration - We are more than the sum of our parts.
  • Curiosity - We have a growth mindset and push conventional thought and theory.

To thrive on our team, you will need to come with:

  • BS or MS with at least 7 years of increasing responsibility as a regulatory / medical writer; education in a scientific field is a plus.
  • A strong work ethic, excellent communication skills, and a desire to work collaboratively with matrixed project teams.
  • A demonstrated track record in medical writing within the pharmaceutical, biotech, or CRO industry, particularly in creating and updating documentation for clinical development. Experience working within a biotech company while managing external resources is a plus.
  • Expertise with Microsoft Word and eCTD-compliant formatting requirements.
  • Proficiency in organizing and interpreting complex scientific and clinical data.
  • A strong understanding of the relevant ICH, GCP, and FDA regulatory standards governing regulatory documentation.
  • Experience with rare diseases, pediatrics, genetic medicines, or leveraging expedited development pathways is strongly preferred. Experience within Duchenne muscular dystrophy or neuromuscular therapeutic areas is a plus.
  • Excellent project management skills and the ability to work on multiple projects with tight timelines.
  • A motivated and driven attitude, with a proactive work style and a results-oriented mindset.
  • Integrity, a desire to learn and grow, and a commitment to excellence.

What We Offer: Meaningful Work, Fair Rewards, and Real Support

At Entrada Therapeutics, we understand that compensation and total rewards are a major consideration when exploring a new opportunity. We believe in transparency and equity and are committed to sharing salary ranges for every position, along with insight into our

compensation philosophy, in accordance with certain state requirements in the United States and fostering a fair and open environment at the onset.

But we also know it is more than just pay. When you join Entrada, you’ll be part of a mission-driven team with access to comprehensive health, dental and vision coverage; life and disability insurance; with a 401(k) match. We pride ourselves on offering competitive benefits that empower our employees and reflect the value of their contributions – offering paid, gender-inclusive parental leave, holistic support for your health and well-being, education reimbursement, discretionary time off and commuting benefits aligned to your working model. If you find yourself working from our office in Boston’s Seaport District, this puts you steps away from some of the best the city has to offer.

At Entrada, our approach to compensation is grounded in transparency, equity, and performance, recognizing the unique contributions each person brings. We believe meaningful work deserves meaningful reward, and view compensation as one way to show appreciation for the collaboration, curiosity, and commitment that drive our mission forward.

The salary for this opportunity ranges from $220,000 - $249,711. The final base compensation offered will depend on several considerations which include but may not be limited to a candidate’s skills, competencies, experience and other job-related factors permitted by law. The final salary offered may fall outside of this range. #LI-GG1 #LI-Remote

Third Party Staffing Agencies

title: Salesforce Solution Architect
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Salesforce Solution Architect based in the United States.

This is a strategic technical leadership opportunity for an experienced Salesforce professional to shape scalable enterprise CRM solutions.
You will own solution architecture across the Salesforce ecosystem, translating complex business needs into secure, high-performing technical designs.
The role combines hands-on technical expertise with enterprise-level architecture, integration, governance, and delivery leadership.
You will collaborate closely with business stakeholders, product owners, developers, administrators, and enterprise technology teams.
Your work will help modernize CRM capabilities, improve operational efficiency, strengthen customer engagement, and support long-term business growth.
You will also influence architecture standards, DevOps practices, data governance, and the adoption of emerging Salesforce capabilities.
The environment is collaborative and transformation-focused, offering significant scope to mentor technical teams and influence enterprise technology strategy.

Accountabilities:

  • Lead end-to-end Salesforce solution architecture across Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, Experience Cloud, Marketing Cloud, CPQ, and custom platform capabilities.
  • Design scalable, secure, resilient, and high-performing Salesforce architectures that align with business objectives and enterprise technology standards.
  • Partner with business stakeholders and product owners to understand requirements, translate them into technical designs, and develop implementation roadmaps.
  • Provide technical direction and mentorship to Salesforce administrators, developers, business analysts, integration specialists, and other technology teams.
  • Architect complex integrations between Salesforce and external enterprise platforms using APIs, middleware, ETL solutions, and event-driven architecture patterns.
  • Establish and enforce best practices covering Salesforce data modeling, security, governance, automation, release management, environment strategy, and DevOps.
  • Assess existing Salesforce architecture and recommend improvements to scalability, maintainability, reliability, and performance.
  • Lead architecture reviews, technical design sessions, solution assessments, and governance processes.
  • Support project estimation, planning, technical delivery, risk identification, and resolution of architecture-related issues.
  • Ensure Salesforce solutions comply with applicable data governance, security, privacy, and regulatory requirements.
  • Monitor Salesforce platform innovation and evaluate emerging capabilities, including AI and automation, for potential alignment with business and technology priorities.
  • Collaborate with enterprise architecture and IT leadership to ensure CRM initiatives support broader technology strategy and digital transformation objectives.
  • Contribute to a culture of continuous improvement while mentoring distributed technical teams and promoting consistent architectural standards.

    • Requirements:

    • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience.
    • 8+ years of experience implementing and supporting Salesforce solutions in enterprise environments, including 5+ years in a Solution Architect or Technical Architect capacity.

title: Interior Designer
description:
At Unispace, we create spaces that empower people and businesses to thrive. We are a global design-build partner delivering workplace and life sciences projects for some of the world’s most innovative brands.

With over 500 people across four continents, we bring together strategy, design, project management, and delivery into one seamless experience. Our integrated approach enables us to move with agility, solve complex challenges, and deliver meaningful outcomes for our clients.

Our people are at the centre of everything we do. We foster a collaborative, inclusive culture that values curiosity, accountability, creativity, and continuous improvement. We believe diverse perspectives strengthen our teams and help us create better experiences for our clients and each other.

At Unispace, you’ll have the opportunity to contribute to impactful projects, work alongside talented global teams, and grow your career in an environment that encourages innovation and new ideas.

Interior Designer

Location: Mumbai

Summary

Our Mumbai studio is looking to add an Interior Designer to our growing team. As an Interior Designer, you will play a vital role in providing commercial workplace solutions for our clients, from initial concept through to project completion. You will be instrumental in developing high-quality designs for pitches and tenders, coordinating project consultants, and ensuring the delivery of inspiring workplaces that align with Unispace’s global standards and innovative design philosophy.

Key Responsibilities (Include but not limited to):

  • Design & Documentation: Deliver comprehensive interior design packages including material selection, finishes, and detailed joinery documentation.
  • Commercial Acumen: Demonstrate a strong understanding of budgets and BOQs, managing self to profitability targets and supporting the management of fees and proposals.
  • Strategic Support: Support senior leaders and Principals on project briefs and conduct design reviews at key project milestones.
  • Cross-Disciplinary Collaboration: Collaborate with Delivery teams to ensure financial outcomes are met and work across disciplines and regions to drive studio initiatives.
  • Design Innovation: Continually enhance the depth and breadth of design skills, staying current with external market trends to improve studio design operations.
  • Brand & Culture Alignment: Ensure all design solutions and professional behaviors align seamlessly with the culture, values, and brand of Unispace.
  • Operational Improvement: Collaborate with Directors and Principals to develop and implement operational improvements within the design team.

About You:

  • Experience: Minimum of 4+ years of professional design experience, specifically within the commercial/workplace design sector, backed by an impressive portfolio.
  • Technical Proficiency: High proficiency in Revit is essential. You must also be proficient in using design tools such as InDesign, Photoshop, and SketchUp.
  • Educational Background: Tertiary qualification or equivalent in an Interior Design or design-related discipline.
  • Client Skills: Comfortable and confident in client-facing environments with exceptional communication and presentation skills.
  • Project Management: Ability to help deliver multiple projects simultaneously while adhering to tight deadlines; experience with resource management is a plus.
  • Local Expertise: Strong knowledge of local building codes and best method procurement; professional license or certification is preferred.
  • Adaptability: You are comfortable with change and ambiguity—seeing them as opportunities to innovate rather than barriers to achievement.
  • Collaboration: A team player who enjoys collaborating across global regions and studios to enhance design outcomes.

What We Offer:

In return, you will receive a competitive salary and a generous benefits package, including a pension, paid holiday leave, and travel opportunities across our global offices. Unispace values its employees and offers extensive rewards and recognition, career development, and a focus on well-being. While we do support Hybrid and Flexible working where possible, there will be a requirement to be in our London Studio to collaborate with the team on a regular basis.

The statements in this job description are intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed by individuals assigned to this role. They are not intended to be an exhaustive list of all responsibilities, duties, or skills required.

We encourage applications from individuals of all backgrounds and experiences and are committed to providing reasonable accommodations throughout the recruitment process and employment lifecycle where required by applicable law.

Inclusion & Diversity

At Unispace, we believe diverse perspectives strengthen our teams, our culture, and the work we deliver for our clients. We are committed to fostering an inclusive workplace where everyone is treated with respect and has the opportunity to thrive.

Employment decisions are based on qualifications, merit, and business needs, in accordance with applicable local laws and regulations.

title: Pre-Award: MXM- Electrical / Electronics Engineer III
description:
Barbaricum is a rapidly growing government contractor providing leading-edge support to federal customers, with a particular focus on Defense and National Security mission sets. We leverage more than 17 years of support to stakeholders across the federal government, with established and growing capabilities across Intelligence, Analytics, Engineering, Mission Support, and Communications disciplines. Founded in 2008, our mission is to transform the way our customers approach constantly changing and complex problem sets by bringing to bear the latest in technology and the highest caliber of talent.

Headquartered in Washington, DC's historic Dupont Circle neighborhood, Barbaricum also has a corporate presence in Tampa, FL, Bedford, IN, and Dayton, OH, with team members across the United States and around the world. As a leader in our space, we partner with firms in the private sector, academic institutions, and industry associations with a goal of continually building our expertise and capabilities for the benefit of our employees and the customers we support. Through all of this, we have built a vibrant corporate culture diverse in expertise and perspectives with a focus on collaboration and innovation. Our teams are at the frontier of the Nation's most complex and rewarding challenges. Join our team.

Barbaricum is seeking an Electrical/Electronics Engineer III to directly support the anticipated Naval Surface Warfare Center (NSWC) Crane Division, Model Based Engineering Assessment Division (Code MXM). Code MXM's mission is mission engineering analysis and assessment of complex Naval, DoD, and joint kill chains — with a specialized focus on Electromagnetic Spectrum Operations (EMSO) enabled analysis. As an Electrical/Electronics Engineer III, you will troubleshoot systems and assemble, repair, test, and disposition mechanical assemblies and associated equipment in support of Code MXM's EMSO mission engineering and test activities. You will work in a collaborative Government/contractor environment, providing hands-on hardware engineering across fielded and developmental systems.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Troubleshoot applicable systems and perform fault isolation.
  • Assemble, repair, test, and disposition mechanical assemblies and associated equipment.
  • Analyze test data and documentation and compare against requirements and specifications.
  • Operate discipline-specific equipment and software for troubleshooting, testing, and operation as specified in Technical Instructions (TIs).
  • Provide technical input and advice to Government programmatic and engineering personnel and support systems in the field.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Active DoD SECRET clearance (minimum); U.S. citizenship required.
  • Bachelor's degree from an ABET-accredited institution.
  • Demonstrated ability to troubleshoot systems and to assemble, repair, test, and disposition mechanical assemblies.

DESIRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Bachelor's degree (preferred education per the labor category).
  • Strong technical communication skills across written and verbal media.

EEO Commitment

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to sex, race, ethnicity, age, national origin, citizenship, religion, physical or mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, pregnancy, family structure, marital status, ancestry, domestic partner status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, veteran or military status, or any other basis prohibited by law.

title: Senior Level Design- Unannounced project | Concepteur·trice de niveaux  Senior·e - Projet non annoncé
description:
Are you ready to dive into the world of cutting-edge video game development? Headquartered in Montreal, Behaviour Interactive is at the forefront of the gaming industry, crafting unforgettable experiences across PC, console, and mobile platforms. We’re a dynamic, independent studio of over 1200 passionate employees, with studios in Toronto (Behaviour Toronto), Rotterdam (Behaviour Rotterdam) and in the UK (Behaviour UK–North & South). Our day to day revolves around two core business focuses: Services and Original Games. Our Services team collaborates with gaming and entertainment giants like Disney, Sony, Activision, and Nintendo, delivering exceptional work-for-hire development and pioneering immersive location-based entertainment (LBE). Meanwhile, our Original Games unit pushes our creative limits, with our signature IPs, including the iconic Dead by Daylight. Join us and be a part of the future of interactive entertainment!

At Behaviour Interactive, we believe in giving everyone a fair shot. We embrace a diverse and creative environment where everyone is celebrated. We value folks of all ages, sex, ethnicity, colour, ethnic or national origin, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, civil status, disability, or any other protected characteristics as per applicable law.

As a Senior Level Designer, you will report to an Design Director and play a pivotal role in bringing the next chapter of a renowned AAA franchise to life. You’ll collaborate with a team of seasoned professionals to craft high-quality missions that meet the project’s ambitious standards. This is a unique opportunity to contribute to a prestigious IP with strong industry recognition.

In this role you will:

  • Design, prototype, and own missions from pre-production to final implementation as part of a team, ensuring they deliver engaging objectives, combat encounters, and scenarios aligned with the game’s narrative and core gameplay pillars.
  • Shape mission flow, pacing, and difficulty curves to ensure engaging and rewarding experiences.
  • Combine combat, exploration, and storytelling into cohesive, interactive experiences.
  • Partner with systems designers to ensure missions complement progression, rewards, and core mechanics.
  • Clearly communicate your design intent to the creative director, artists, engineers, and QA across the full production pipeline.

What we are looking for:

  • Minimum of 4–5 years of proven experience designing missions, quests, or levels on shipped AAA or mid-size titles.
  • Strong understanding of mission design principles, including flow, pacing, player motivation, and engagement loops.
  • Proficiency with Unreal Engine 5 or similar engine.
  • Experience with visual scripting, such as Blueprint, for mission logic and ingredient prototyping.
  • Ability to balance narrative-driven storytelling with gameplay-driven challenges.
  • Excellent communication skills and collaborative mindset, in English and/or French.

Dans ce rôle tu devras:

  • Concevoir, prototyper et prendre en charge des missions depuis la pré-production jusqu’à la mise en œuvre finale, en équipe, en veillant à proposer des objectifs, des combats et des scénarios captivants, alignés avec la narration et les piliers du gameplay du jeu;
  • Définir le déroulement des missions, leur rythme et leur courbe de difficulté pour garantir une expérience engageante et gratifiante;
  • Intégrer de manière cohérente le combat, l’exploration et la narration dans des expériences interactives;
  • Collaborer avec les concepteurs systèmes pour s’assurer que les missions complètent la progression, les récompenses et les mécaniques principales du jeu;
  • Communiquer clairement l’intention de conception au directeur créatif, aux artistes, aux ingénieurs et à l’équipe QA tout au long du processus de production.

Ce que nous recherchons:

  • Un minimum de 4 à 5 ans d’expérience avérée dans la conception de missions, quêtes ou niveaux sur des titres AAA ou de taille intermédiaire déjà commercialisés;
  • Solide compréhension des principes de conception de missions, incluant le déroulement, le rythme, la motivation du joueur et les boucles d’engagement;
  • Maîtrise d’Unreal Engine 5 ou d’un moteur similaire;
  • Expérience en scripting visuel, tel que Blueprint, pour la logique des missions et le prototypage des éléments;
  • Capacité à équilibrer narration scénarisée et défis orientés gameplay;
  • Excellentes compétences en communication et esprit collaboratif, en anglais et/ou en français.
En tant Concepteur·trice de Missions Senior·e tu reporteras à un·e Design Director et jouera un rôle clé dans le développement du prochain chapitre d’une franchise AAA renommée. Tu collaborerez avec une équipe de professionnels expérimentés pour concevoir des missions de haute qualité répondant aux standards ambitieux du projet. Il s’agit d’une opportunité unique de contribuer à une propriété intellectuelle prestigieuse, reconnue dans l’industrie.

Prêt·e à plonger dans le monde du développement de jeux vidéo à la pointe de la technologie ? Basé à Montréal, Behaviour Interactif est un acteur majeur de l’industrie du jeu, créant des expériences inoubliables sur PC, console et mobile. On est un studio indépendant dynamique avec plus de 1200 employés passionnés, et on a des studios à Toronto (Behaviour Toronto), Rotterdam (Behaviour Rotterdam) et au Royaume-Uni (Behaviour UK–North & South). On se concentre sur deux grands axes : les Services et les Jeux Originaux. Notre équipe Services collabore avec des géants du jeu et du divertissement comme Disney, Sony, Activision et Nintendo, en offrant un développement sur commande de premier choix et en innovant dans le divertissement immersif en lieu fixe (LBE). Pendant ce temps, notre unité Jeux Originaux repousse les limites de notre créativité avec nos IPs emblématiques, comme le fameux Dead by Daylight. Rejoins-nous et fais partie de l'avenir du divertissement interactif !

Chez Behaviour Interactif, on croit en l’équité des chances pour tout le monde et on célèbre la diversité des personnes, des perspectives et des idées. C’est donc important pour nous de travailler avec des talents qui proviennent de tous les horizons, et ce, indépendamment de leur âge, sexe, ethnicité, couleur, origine ethnique ou nationale, religion, orientation sexuelle, identité de genre, statut familial, handicap ou toute autre caractéristique protégée par les lois applicables.

title: Therapy Technician- NoMad
description:

Spear Physical and Occupational Therapy is seeking a qualified, passionate Therapy Technician to join the team at our NoMad location.

  • Physical Therapy Technicians are expected to execute a high standard of clinical excellence while maintaining 5-star customer service.

  • Other duties as assigned

title: Handicaphjælper søges
description:
OMRÅDE: 8000 Århus C.

35 timer om ugen · Start 1. november

Jeg søger en stabil, fleksibel og humoristisk hjælper, der kan hjælpe uden at overtage.

LIDT OM MIG:
35 timer om ugen · Start 1. november
Jeg søger en stabil, fleksibel og humoristisk hjælper, der kan hjælpe uden at overtage.

JOBBET KORT FORTALT:
Du hjælper mig med det, jeg fysisk ikke selv kan: personlig hjælp, praktiske opgaver, indkøb, rengøring samt ledsagelse til møder. Du er mine arme og ben – ikke min chef, pædagog eller livscoach.

Du bliver som handicaphjælper en del af et godt, fleksibelt og nødvendigt team af handicaphjælpere, der i fællesskab dækker alle vagter året rundt. Jobbet foregår i borgerens eget hjem, til fritidsaktiviteter, sociale arrangementer og de udflugter borgeren skulle have lyst til at deltage i.

MINE VIGTIGSTE SPILLEREGLER:

  • Skrivning: Skriv direkte det, jeg siger. Du må rette stavefejl, men ikke ændre meningen eller tilføje symboler.

  • Telefon: Sig direkte det, jeg siger, og nævn aldrig dit navn. Hvis min telefon ringer, lader du den ringe, til jeg siger noget andet.

  • Samtaler: Når jeg taler med andre, blander du dig ikke, medmindre jeg beder om hjælp. Jeg kan selv rode mig ind i en samtale – og ud af den igen.

  • Madlavning: Jeg er kokken, og du hjælper. Hvis maden brænder på, er det mit problem.

  • Far med stort F: Mine børn er mit ansvar, ikke en hjælperopgave. Du må gerne hjælpe praktisk med fx en flyverdragt, men forældrerollen er min.

  • Stille perioder: Jeg er meget selvstændig, så tag gerne noget med, du kan underholde dig selv med. Jeg siger til, når jeg har brug for dig.

  • Løn og timer: Kom direkte til mig, hvis noget ikke stemmer. Jeg har styr på timerne, men er også et menneske og kan lave fejl.

Hvem er du?

Du er stabil og fleksibel, har humor, kan arbejde selvstændigt, respekterer mit private hjem og kan acceptere ordene “jeg kan selv”. Du har kørekort og forstår, at vi skal være gode kolleger – ikke nødvendigvis bedste venner.

Arbejdstid og ansættelse:

Stillingen er på cirka 35 timer om ugen. En typisk vagt er kl. 7.00-17.00, og der kan være både hverdags- og weekendvagter. Start 1. november. Ansættelsen foregår gennem Handicapformidlingen. Der kan også blive mulighed for at komme med til Uganda – som arbejde, ikke som ferie.

Lyder jobbet som noget for dig, så send en ansøgning og fortæl lidt om dig selv. Kørestolen er forholdsvis nem at arbejde med. jeg kan være lidt mere stædig.

KVALIFIKATIONER:

  • Kørekort

  • Fleksibel

  • Selvstændig

  • Have respekt- og forståelse for at arbejde i et privat hjem

PRAKTISKE INFORMATIONER:

  • Startdato: 01.11.2026

  • Deltid: 35 t./u.

  • Sidste frist for ansøgning: 20.10.2026

  • Afholdelse af samtaler: Løbende

  • Vi forbeholder os retten til at fjerne jobopslag før sidste frist, såfremt den rette kandidat er fundet

  • Hvis ikke du har hørt noget inden sidste frist, må du gå ud fra at stillingen er besat til anden side

  • Der vil blive indhentet børne- og straffeattest ved ansættelsen

LØN:
Hos den pågældende borger aflønnes du efter stedtillæg 2 i henhold til følgende takstblad – LINK

KONTAKT:
Har du lyst til at søge den ledige stilling, skal du sende en skriftlig ansøgning direkte til borgeren på mail: 201138@handicapformidlingen.dk – gerne med et billede af dig selv.
Spørgsmål vedrørende stillingen skal rettes til konsulent Simon på mail: sb@handicapformidlingen.dk eller på telefon: 71999835 på hverdage mellem kl. 09:00 og 15:00.
Ved eventuel henvendelse, oplys da medlemsnummer: 201138

Vi opfordrer alle kvalificerede til at søge – uanset køn, seksuel orientering, etnisk baggrund, religion, handicap eller alder. Vi tror på, at vores forskellighed beriger vores organisation og hjælper med at nå vores mål i fællesskab.

HANDICAPFORMIDLINGEN:
Handicapformidlingen administrerer hjælperordninger for mennesker med handicap i Danmark. Handicapformidlingen er Danmarks bedste BPA-leverandør – og specialist på området.

title: Leder af Stevns Ejendomme - Genopslag
description:
Vil du stå i spidsen for udviklingen af Stevns Kommunes ejendomsportefølje og skabe retning, struktur og resultater i en organisation med stor betydning for kommunens borgere?

Stevns Kommune søger en ny leder af Stevns Ejendomme. Du får ansvaret for kommunens samlede ejendomsportefølje med drift, vedligeholdelse, anlægsprojekter, energioptimering, rengøring og forsikring. Samtidig får du en central rolle i at udvikle organisationen, styrke samarbejdet på tværs og sikre, at kommunens bygninger understøtter både velfærd, vækst og bæredygtighed.

En lederrolle med stor betydning
Stevns Kommune er i vækst, og de kommende år byder på investeringer i kommunens bygninger og faciliteter. Samtidig står ejendomsområdet over for en vigtig udviklingsopgave med fokus på organisering, prioritering, vedligeholdelsesstrategi og energioptimering.

Som leder af Stevns Ejendomme får du ansvar for:

  • 30 medarbejdere, herunder en mellemleder
  • Kommunens ca. 250 bygninger
  • Drift, vedligeholdelse og energioptimering
  • Gennemførelse af anlægs- og byggeprojekter
  • Politisk betjening på ejendomsområdet
  • Budgetter og anlægsinvesteringer af væsentlig størrelse
  • Samarbejde med institutioner, fagforvaltninger, entreprenører og politikere

Du bliver en del af ledergruppen i Center for Erhverv, Kultur og Turisme og refererer til centerchefen.

Opgaven
Vi søger ikke en klassisk ejendomschef.

Vi søger en leder, der kan skabe stabilitet, udvikling og retning i en organisation, som samtidig skal håndtere en voksende anlægsportefølje, et betydeligt vedligeholdelsesefterslæb og mange samarbejdsflader.

Du skal kunne:

  • Skabe tillid og følgeskab efter flere års organisatoriske forandringer
  • Etablere klare strukturer, processer og prioriteringer
  • Sikre fremdrift i både drift og udvikling
  • Navigere sikkert i et politisk miljø med mange interessenter
  • Træffe prioriteringer på et solidt økonomisk grundlag
  • Omsætte politiske ambitioner til konkrete og bæredygtige løsninger

Vi forestiller os, at du

  • Har ledelseserfaring eller dokumenterede ledelsesevner
  • Har indsigt i ejendomsdrift, byggeri eller beslægtede områder
  • Har kendskab til eller mod på at arbejde i en politisk ledet organisation
  • Har økonomisk forståelse og erfaring med budgetter, investeringer og prioriteringer
  • Kan skabe struktur og overblik i komplekse sammenhænge
  • Er tydelig, robust og relationelt stærk

Derudover er du en leder, der skaber tillid gennem nærvær, troværdighed og klare prioriteringer.

Derfor skal du vælge Stevns Kommune
Hos os får du mulighed for at sætte et markant aftryk på et område med stor strategisk betydning for kommunen.

Du bliver en del af en organisation med korte beslutningsveje, engagerede medarbejdere og en ledergruppe, der prioriterer samarbejde, videndeling og fælles ansvar for kommunens udvikling.

Samtidig får du en arbejdsplads tæt på både naturen og hovedstaden – kun cirka 50 km fra København.

Og skulle du tilfældigvis have musik i blodet, er der mulighed for at blive en del af kommunens lederband. Det er ikke afgørende for jobbet, men det siger måske noget om den kultur og det fællesskab, du bliver en del af.

Yderligere oplysninger
Læs den fulde jobprofil for en nærmere beskrivelse af opgaver, organisation og forventninger til den nye leder af Stevns Ejendomme her: Job- og personprofil, Leder af Stevns Ejendomme | Stevns Kommune

Har du spørgsmål til stillingen, er du velkommen til at kontakte centerchef Birgitte G. Eriksen på sms på 23 31 66 11, hvorefter der ringes tilbage.
