title: Læge (Reservelæge) til Akutteamet på Psykiatrisk Center Amager
description:
Overvejer du at blive speciallæge i psykiatri? Eller er du nysgerrig efter at lære mere om psykiatrien? Så har vi en spændende mulighed for dig i vores fagligt stærke Akutteam.

Her får du mulighed for at blive en del af et dynamisk center med patienten i centrum, et professionelt tværfagligt team, og en lægegruppe med stort fokus på uddannelse, faglig udvikling, undervisning og mulighed for forskning.

Psykiatrisk Center Amager søger en reservelæge med tiltrædelse den 1. oktober 2026 eller snarest derefter.


Velkommen i Akutteamet

Psykiatrisk Center Amagers akutmodtagelse består af tre funktioner:

  • et Akutteam
  • en døgnåben, uvisiteret modtagelse (”skadestue”)
  • et åbent døgnafsnit med 10 senge.
Den udkørende og akut ambulante funktion varetages af Akutteamet. Formålet er at hjælpe patienterne i deres nærmiljø og skabe sammenhængende og fleksible behandlingsforløb.

Akutteamet modtager henvisninger fra den psykiatriske Fællestelefon og modtagelsen. På baggrund af en triage afklares det, hvordan patienten bedst tilses. Det kan være i patientens eget hjem eller til en samtale i modtagelsen på Psykiatrisk Center Amager, hvor teamet har sin base.

Akutteamet er et fagligt stærkt team, hvor høj klinisk kvalitet går hånd i hånd med en personlig og nærværende tilgang til patienterne. Vi lægger vægt på at møde patienten dér, hvor patienten er, og på at forstå både den aktuelle problemstilling, patientens netværk og de ressourcer, der findes i patientens eget miljø. Det giver mulighed for at se hele mennesket – og ikke kun de udfordringer, der har ført til behovet for psykiatrisk hjælp.

Ud over den akutte funktion varetager teamet intensive, kortvarige ambulante opgaver med henblik på at forebygge indlæggelser og genindlæggelser, facilitere hurtigere udskrivelser og skabe gode udslusningsforløb. Akutteamet varetager desuden ambulant udredning og behandling i en afgrænset periode på op til seks uger, fx indtil et andet ambulant behandlingstilbud er iværksat.

Akutteamet samarbejder tæt med akutsøjlens åbne og intensive afsnit med i alt 22 senge.

Akutteamet har også ansvar for to socialsygeplejersker samt en socialoverlæge. Disse har ikke behandlingsansvar, men understøtter sociale indsatser på tværs af huset med socialmedicinske tilsyn.


Hvilke arbejdsopgaver vil du få?

Du vil primært have klinisk funktion i Akutteamet, men kan af og til få opgaver i hele akutsøjlen.

Dine arbejdsopgaver vil bl.a. være:

  • gennemgang af nye patienter i teamet med udarbejdelse af behandlingsplan inden for den første uge
  • fokuseret udredning, kortvarig behandling og eventuel henvisning til andet behandlingstilbud
  • undervisning af tværfagligt personale i samarbejde med specialpsykolog og ledende overlæge
  • psykofarmakologisk behandling
  • varetagelse af InBasket med blodprøvesvar og EKG
  • receptudstedelser
  • aktiv deltagelse i teamets morgenkonferencer, hvor der blandt andet lægges planer for dagens arbejde med de enkelte patienter

Vores forventninger til dig

Vi forventer, at du:

  • er yngre læge med stort engagement og mod på faglige udfordringer
  • har lyst til at udvikle dine kompetencer inden for psykiatrien
  • gerne vil bidrage til et arbejdsmiljø med fokus på vidensdeling, faglig udvikling og tværfagligt samarbejde
  • har lyst til at møde patienterne med både faglighed, nysgerrighed og nærvær

Hvad tilbyder vi dig?

Hos os får du:

  • en god struktur for faglig understøttelse af det lægelige arbejde
  • et meget fagligt stærkt og engageret Akutteam, hvor du får mulighed for at udvikle dig både fagligt og klinisk
  • en ambitiøs og udfordrende arbejdsplads med gode læringsmuligheder gennem bl.a. aktiv supervision og mulighed for struktureret klinisk observation
  • mulighed for at arbejde med både akutte problemstillinger, fokuseret udredning og kortvarige ambulante behandlingsforløb
  • tæt tværfagligt samarbejde og fokus på den enkelte patients behov
  • sammenhæng mellem klinik, undervisning og forskning samt mulighed for deltagelse i centrets interne undervisningsprogram
  • synlige ledere med engagement og fokus på faglig udvikling
  • et godt kollegialt netværk blandt både yngre læger og speciallæger med fokus på trivsel, samarbejde og humor i hverdagen.
Hos os bliver du en del af et miljø, hvor faglighed og menneskelighed går hånd i hånd – både i mødet med patienterne og med hinanden.


Løn- og ansættelsesforhold

Stillingen er med tiltrædelse den 1. oktober 2026 eller snarest derefter.

Stillingen er på 37 timer ugentligt, og du indgår i et vagtbærende forvagtshold.

Du ansættes i henhold til overenskomst for underordnede læger, herunder overenskomstens bestemmelser om arbejdstid med lønindplacering som lægetrin 1.

Døgnafsnittet er døgndækket, og du vil derfor blive planlagt med blandede vagter i overensstemmelse med reglerne i den gældende arbejdstidsaftale/arbejdstidsreglerne i overenskomsten.


Interesseret?

Hvis du har spørgsmål til stillingen, er du velkommen til at kontakte ledende overlæge Maria Rye på anna.maria.rye@regionh.dk eller cheflæge René Sjælland på rene.sjaelland@regionh.dk eller telefon 21 72 95 01.

Søg stillingen via link på siden senest 20/09-2026. Ansøgningen skal indeholde CV, autorisation/eksamensbevis samt oplysninger om tidligere ansættelser.

Der indhentes, efter aftale med ansøger, referencer forud for endelig ansættelse.

Samtaler forventes afholdt i uge 39.

Vi glæder os til at møde dig.


Om Psykiatrisk Center Amager

Psykiatrisk Center Amager har et optageområde, der med undtagelse af Christianshavn dækker hele Amager og Vesterbro inklusive Sydhavnen. Befolkningstallet udgør omkring 260.000 borgere med forventning om yderligere befolkningstilvækst.

Centeret har ni døgnafsnit med i alt 129 sengepladser fordelt på fem intensive og fire åbne, subspecialiserede sengeafsnit.

Den ambulante behandling varetages i to psykiatriske ambulatorier på henholdsvis Hans Bogbinders Allé og Gl. Kongevej samt i Psykoterapeutisk og Ældrepsykiatrisk Ambulatorium, som ligger på Digevej. Derudover har vi et Gadeplansteam, OPUS Ambulatorium samt et Botilbudsteam.

Psykiatrisk Center Amager er et universitetshospital med uddannelses- og undervisningsaktivitet samt en Forskningsenhed. Centeret er klassificeret til uddannelse af læger i alle stillingskategorier: KBU (klinisk basisuddannelse), speciallæge i almen medicin samt introduktions- og hoveduddannelsesstillinger i psykiatri. Centeret er desuden uddannelsessted for specialpsykologer.

Centeret varetager studenterundervisning af medicinstuderende på 10. semester ved Københavns Universitet.

Du kan læse mere om centret her.


Region Hovedstaden sætter mennesket først. Vi giver plads til forskellighed og opfordrer alle kvalificerede ansøgere til at søge, uanset køn, alder, etnicitet, religion, seksualitet eller funktionsnedsættelser.

title: Press Operator (3rd Shift)
description:
MOO brings brands to life in a sustainable way, with a range of remarkable print and merchandise products. We combine design, technology, manufacturing and service, so that people can connect in memorable ways. Not online but out there, in real life.
We started in 2004. Since then we’ve built an award-winning and much-loved brand, with customer satisfaction and Trustpilot ratings that make most businesses want to give up and hire an army of review bots. We’ve got half a million customers, mostly small and medium businesses in North America, the UK, and Europe – businesses that, like us, get all excited about putting something real and beautiful into people’s hands. Does that make us nerds? Probably, and we’re ok with that.
We’ve been given the highest business award in Britain, ‘The Queen’s Award for Enterprise’. Backed by venture capital, we’re part of Tech Nation’s ‘Future Fifty’, recently passing $1bn in lifetime revenue, and featuring in the Guardian’s top 10 UK start-ups list. Ok, we’ll stop bragging now.
Today, we’re more than 400 people with our global HQ in London, UK, while we also have premises in Dagenham. In the US, you’ll find us in Boston, MA, as well as East Providence, RI and Denver, CO and with our most recent office expansion in Cape Town South Africa.

Our press operators run either HP or Konica Minolta presses which include managing print quality, routine maintenance and following production processes and managing substrates with minimal supervision. You'll be apart of the larger Manufacturing team in our East Providence facility.

We welcome all types of people but to succeed in this role, there are four things we really need.

  • Physical fitness
    No need to be a CrossFit champ, but you will need to stand for the whole shift (except meal and rest periods of course), move and lift up to 55 pounds and be able to bend or twist at the waist and knees.
  • People skills
    We’re a real team, so you’ll be a good communicator and keen to help out and assist others when needed.
  • Good work ethic
    Without you, there is no MOO. So, to keep our customers thrilled, we need good time management skills, high levels of concentration and a willingness to work overtime - including during the weekend when customer demand requires it.
  • Mechanical Aptitude
    Machines can be a bit quirky sometimes and you will need to be able to trouble shoot issues and work with service technicians to do minor repairs to the press.

Responsibilities

  • Operation of Konica Minolta presses and HP presses, which includes, but is not limited to managing print quality, routine maintenance and following production processes and managing substrates with minimal supervision
  • Process and produce MOO products as requested and/or directed
  • Ability to utilize MOO business software systems for manufacturing
  • Produce work in accordance with LEAN manufacturing principles
  • Follow instructions of supervisors and assist other workers in performing facility functions
  • Maintain work area to 5S standards
  • Maintain and manage repairs as outlined according to Konica Minolta level certification and HP level certification
  • Send files electronically to press organize work according to schedule

Nice to Haves

  • HP or Konica Minolta press experience or sheet fed offset experience
What’s it like to work at MOO?
MOO’s the kind of workplace where you can really be yourself. Dye your hair purple. Hit the sofa with your laptop. Whatever helps you feel comfortable and happy at work. We want to help you grow in your career and set you up for success – while also recognising the importance of a healthy work/life balance.
That’s why we offer 34 days of combined vacation and holidays, comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage, plus life and AD&D insurance. We also offer a 401(k) with company match and no vesting schedule, a dog-friendly and casual office environment, and free lunches every other week. Because when you feel good, your work does too.
Diversity Statement
We are working hard to create a representative, inclusive and super-friendly team, because we know that different experiences, perspectives and backgrounds make for a better workplace. And that creates a better experience for our customers. MOO doesn’t discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion or belief, gender, national origin, age, sexual orientation, marital status, disability, veteran status or any other protected class
As a design and technology company we have a desire and a responsibility to build a business that represents the world around us. So we strive to create a values-driven, purposeful and highly empowered organisation that we are all proud to work for. And we are committed to continuous investment in building an open and inclusive environment, welcoming a diverse audience of candidates who see themselves working and thriving at MOO. Therefore, we’d like to invite you to complete this optional survey to help us evaluate our inclusion and diversity efforts. Completing this form is entirely voluntary and if you decide not to it won’t in any way affect your job application. We keep the information separate from your application and it is kept secure and confidential, it is only used to better our inclusion and diversity efforts. By submitting this information, you consent to MOO's processing of it for these purposes.

title: Core Infrastructure Network Engineer
description:
Location: Hybrid / Thorpe Park, Leeds
Position Title: Core Infrastructure Network Engineer
Job Type: Full-Time

About Us

Assured Data Protection is a global leader in data backup and disaster recovery managed services, specialising in safeguarding against data loss and downtime in the event of a disaster, cyber, or ransomware attack. Our fully managed services include immutable backup, disaster recovery, and cyber resiliency to protect data on-premises and in the cloud, with 24/7/365 expert support.

We offer a flexible, consumption-based model to grow with your business, making data protection cost-effective and scalable. Our purpose-built software provides industry-leading monitoring and reporting capabilities to provide actionable insights into your data protection strategy. Our global datacentres ensure data sovereignty, meeting your organisation’s compliance requirements. A dedicated team is always available to recover your data and minimise disruption in the event of a disaster.

Job Summary

We are seeking a highly skilled Network Infrastructure Engineer to join our Global Core Infrastructure team. This role is responsible for implementing, and supporting secure, scalable, and highly available network environments across multiple regions, with a strong bias towards troubleshooting.

The ideal candidate will have hands-on experience with Cisco networking (ideally Nexus), Fortigate firewalls, with knowledge of Netgate pfSense a plus. Familiarity with networking configuration of Enterprise virtualization platforms, such as VMware/Hyper-V and Nutanix is preferred, and the candidate would be comfortable collaborating remotely with distributed teams across time zones. The candidate will also be required to participate in the departments on-call out-of-hours rota.
The ideal candidate would enjoy troubleshooting network issues and have a minimum of CCNA certification. Experience working for a Service Provider, supporting on-prem network equipment with many incoming customer connections/address spaces across multiple locations would be advantageous.

The role is not normally customer facing, however the ability to pick up issues and work with customer technical teams through to completion is important.

Key Responsibilities
  • Implement, troubleshoot and maintain enterprise-grade network infrastructure across global environments
  • Support and optimize Cisco-based networks, including routing, switching, and datacenter technologies.
  • Configure and manage Fortigate firewalls, including VPNs, security policies, and traffic inspection
  • Troubleshoot complex network issues across LAN, WAN, and datacenter environments
  • Collaborate with other infrastructure teams (client networking and virtualization) to support infrastructure projects and support issues.
  • Participate in out-of-hours on-call rota, providing operational support and incident response outside of standard business hours
  • Provide networking expertise to support virtualization platforms, including:
    • VMware vSphere / ESXi
    • Microsoft Hyper-V
    • Nutanix
  • Participate in network architecture reviews, capacity planning, and performance tuning
  • Create and maintain technical documentation, network diagrams, and operational procedures
  • Support change management, incident response, and root cause analysis
  • Work effectively as part of a global, remote team, including occasional out-of-hours support if required.

Required Skills & Experience
  • CCNA certification or higher.
  • Strong hands-on experience with Cisco networking technologies
    • Routing & Switching (BGP, VLANs, STP, LACP etc)
    • Datacenter networking (Cisco Nexus highly desirable)
  • Proven experience managing firewalls (ideally Fortigate) in enterprise environments
  • Strong troubleshooting skills across complex, multi-site networks
  • Demonstrable experience with network analysis tools like Wireshark, iPerf and others.
  • Solid understanding of network security principles and best practices
  • Experience working in a distributed or global IT team

Desirable / Nice-to-Have Skills
  • Experience with Netgate pfSense firewalls
  • Advanced datacenter networking experience
  • Familiarity with SD-WAN, VXLAN and BGP a plus.
  • Exposure to cloud networking (AWS, Azure, or GCP)
  • Scripting or automation experience (Python, Ansible, etc.)

Virtualization & Platform Knowledge (Desirable)
  • Networking within VMware vSphere / ESXi environments
  • Networking concepts for Microsoft Hyper-V
  • Networking architecture and integration with Nutanix

Personal Attributes
  • Self-motivated and comfortable working remotely
  • Strong communication skills for collaboration across regions and time zones
  • Proactive problem-solver with attention to detail
  • Ability to work independently while contributing effectively to a global team

What We Offer:
  • Hybrid working options for flexibility
  • Regular team-building and off-site company events.
  • A dynamic, inclusive, and collaborative work environment

At Assured Data Protection we value diversity and inclusivity. We offer perks such as flex holidays and flexible working practices to allow our employees to show up as their whole selves. We are an equal-opportunity employer, and we do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, colour, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please do not hesitate to let us know.

You must have the legal right to work in the UK at the time of application, as we are unable to offer visa sponsorship for this role.

title: [Job - 31028] QA with Security Fix Validation Expertise, Brazil
description:
At CI&T, we help large enterprises transform the potential of AI into real business impact with AI Deployment, AI-native execution, and tech-integrated business solutions.

With 30 years of experience in technological transformation, we accelerate innovation with expertise in Agentic SDLC, Application modernization, Data & AI, Martech and Business strategy.

We are 8,000 CI&Ters across more than 25 countries, collaborating to build solutions with real impact. AI is already part of how we work, evolve, and innovate every day.


At CI&T, our rapid growth is fueled by the innovative solutions we create for our global clients.

We are seeking a detail-driven QA to safeguard quality on a security remediation squad serving a large US mortgage lender. Remediation at volume is where regressions hide, and you will be the control that keeps throughput from costing the client stability — proving each fix works and nothing else broke.


Responsibilities:

• Validate remediation fixes by confirming the vulnerability no longer reproduces and intended behavior remains intact.
• Design and execute regression testing around each fix, focusing on the blast radius of dependency upgrades and configuration changes.
• Build and maintain automated regression coverage for the areas the squad touches most frequently.
• Define testable validation and closure criteria together with the developers so "fixed" is a verifiable statement.
• Produce validation evidence the client's risk program can attach to closure records.
• Execute testing across the client's AWS environments and verify deployment behaves consistently between them.
• Raise quality risk early when a fix's scope is broader than it first appears.
• Integrate automated tests into the client's CI/CD pipeline.


Requirements:

• Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field.
• Experience as QA or quality engineering for web applications.
• Good English communication skills (reading, writing, and speaking) — direct collaboration with a US-based engineering team.
• Proven capability in both manual exploratory testing and test automation.
• Test automation experience with a modern framework such as Cypress, Playwright, or Selenium.
• API testing experience with Postman, REST-assured, or an equivalent tool.
• Strong regression testing discipline, including the ability to scope what a change could have broken rather than re-running everything.
• Comfort testing PHP web applications hosted on AWS, including the ability to read PHP well enough to understand what a fix changed.
• Experience integrating automated tests into CI/CD pipelines.


Nice to Have:

• Security testing exposure — validating vulnerability fixes, OWASP-based test cases, and basic penetration testing concepts.
• Performance testing experience with JMeter or k6.
• SQL proficiency for data validation.
• Prior experience on a remediation or technical debt squad.
• Experience in mortgage or financial services.
• Experience working with international clients.


Join CI&T and be a part of our mission to ensure quality never becomes the trade-off for speed. If you have a passion for quality engineering and want to own validation on work that directly reduces a client's security risk, we want to hear from you!

title: Staff Product Manager, Strategy
description:
Bellese is a mission-driven Digital Services Company committed to pioneering innovative technology solutions in civic healthcare. Our dedication lies in making a meaningful impact on public health outcomes.
Driven by service design, we strive to know the “Why” to understand the healthcare journey for patients, caregivers, providers, payers, and policymakers. Our goal is to design and build solutions that reduce confusion, provide clarity, support decision making, and streamline the process so that we and our partners can focus on providing better health outcomes by improving patient care and reducing costs and burden.

Bellese Technologies is looking for an experienced vision-focused Staff Product Manager to lead strategy for one of our distributed teams that support the Centers for Medicare and Medicaid Services (CMS) federal agency.

As a Staff Product Manager at Bellese, you are a recognized authority in product management, agile delivery, and digital services — setting long-term vision, shaping strategy in partnership with executive stakeholders, and translating high-level goals into roadmaps that drive meaningful outcomes for clients and the communities they serve. You have a deep understanding of the contracting landscape, including how policy, compliance, and procurement shape product decisions. You lead by example rather than authority, mentoring product staff, driving cross-team collaboration, and representing Bellese's product philosophy with clients and the broader civic tech community. Beyond contract delivery, you are a business leader — identifying opportunities for organic growth within your program, supporting company-wide business development initiatives, and partnering with senior Product leaders across the company to continuously elevate the product management practice.

The ideal candidate brings a rare blend of strategic depth, collaborative instinct, and civic purpose. You thrive in the ambiguity of consulting and bring a systems-thinking mindset to every challenge - finding opportunity in every engagement to challenge the status quo and leave things better than you found them. You are equally comfortable in executive conversations and cross-functional team workshops, with a proven ability to align stakeholders toward a shared vision — always with the user at the center. You bring at least 3 years of experience at the Staff level or equivalent and a strong command of horizon three strategy; this is not a delivery role. Experience in the public sector, federal consulting, or a highly regulated industry is a strong plus, as is a background in digital healthcare technology and a passion for mentoring others. If you're driven to shape how technology and policy work together to advance digital services, Bellese is the right place for you.

[security clearance, benefits, you will like it here if…]

Required Qualifications

  • 3+ years operating at the Principal or equivalent senior IC level in a Product Management role

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent professional experience

  • Exceptional command of written and verbal English, with the ability to translate complex technical and policy concepts for diverse audiences

  • Deep understanding of the consulting mindset working with executive partners and stakeholders

  • Demonstrated habit of staying current with emerging industry trends, technologies, and methodologies — with the ability to form and articulate informed, evidence-based opinions on how they apply to product strategy, client outcomes, and long-term platform direction

  • Demonstrated experience owning long-term product vision and strategy across a portfolio of products or complex, multi-team programs

  • Strong command of modern product management practices including user-centered design, agile delivery, and continuous discovery

  • Track record of mentoring and elevating less experienced product practitioners

  • Proven ability to influence and align executive stakeholders, clients, and cross-functional delivery teams without formal authority

  • Experience contributing to business development efforts including proposals, client relationships, or practice growth initiatives

Preferred Qualifications

  • Familiarity with healthcare data standards, regulations, and systems — such as CMS programs, FHIR, eCQMs, or value-based care initiatives

  • Prior professional services, government, or federal consulting experience

  • Familiarity with procurement and contracting processes in the public sector or a highly regulated industry

  • Experience working directly with CMS, HHS, or similar federal health agencies

  • Familiarity with ATO processes, FedRAMP, or other federal compliance frameworks

  • Experience with quality reporting, payment models, or public-facing healthcare transparency programs

  • 2+ years working on a remote team, preferably in a leadership position

Security Clearance Requirements

  • US Citizenship or Green Card only - we do not offer Sponsorship
  • US Residency for at least the past 3 years
  • Able to meet the requirements to hold a position of Public Trust, including successful completion of a US Government background investigation
  • Disclaimer: Medical or recreational marijuana use is considered illegal at the federal level, regardless of state laws allowing such, and may affect your ability to obtain Public Trust. See article

Work that matters, with perks that deliver. Discover how Bellese Technologies invests in you through a benefits suite that makes every day better

  • Remote First, Remote Only Culture
  • Four weeks paid time off yearly (prorated based on start date for the first year)
  • 10 paid floating company holidays

  • Work from home setup including a Macbook
  • Collaborative, learning environment
  • Medical, dental, and company-paid vision insurance

  • Company paid basic life and AD&D insurance coverages
  • Company paid short and long term life insurance
  • Optional critical illness and accident insurance
  • 401K plan with 3% safe harbor contribution
  • Wellness resources and virtual care
  • Perks Plus employee discounts

You will like it here if

  • You foster a collaborative ethos, driven by the mission to deliver exceptional customer service to clients. You are passionate about Healthcare and changing the healthcare landscape. You’re an out of the box thinker, always striving to know the “why” when it comes to building solutions. You excel in a team-oriented, remote-first environment characterized by mutual respect and open communication. Your adaptability and ability to navigate challenges ensure your success in any situation.

title: Er du vores nye skolepædagog på Tagensbo Skole KKFO?
description:
På Tagensbo Skole søger vi lige nu en dygtig, nysgerrig og undersøgende skolepædagog. Du bliver en del af et årgangsteam, hvor halvdelen af din tid ligger i indskolingen om formiddagen og den anden halvdel i KKFO'en om eftermiddagen.

Vi er en udviklingsorienteret skole og KKFO, som konstant arbejder på at skabe de bedst mulige livsbetingelser for børnene. Hos os tror vi på, at vi som professionelle voksne kan gøre en forskel – særligt hvis vi trives, mens vi går på arbejde.

Vores skole og KKFO har gennem længere tid været i positiv udvikling, og det skyldes i høj grad vores fantastiske lærere, børnehaveklasseledere og pædagoger. Vi har fokus på høj faglighed, samarbejde og differentieret undervisning.

Om dig
Som pædagog hos os skal du være nysgerrig af natur og have en passion og øje for børnenes sociale trivsel og udvikling. Du skal være i stand til at inspirere børnene til at være nysgerrige, udforskende og legende samt skabe et miljø, hvor de føler sig trygge ved at udtrykke sig. Vi værdsætter kreativitet og evnen til at skabe engagerende aktiviteter, der fremmer børns fantasi og læring.

Dine primære opgaver vil inkludere, at

  • planlægge og tilrettelægge aktiviteter med fokus på social udvikling, kommunikation og leg
  • observere og støtte børns udvikling i samarbejde med kolleger
  • skabe inkluderende og stimulerende læringsmiljøer
  • samarbejde med forældre og andre fagprofessionelle for at sikre børns trivsel og udvikling
Vi tilbyder

  • en dynamisk arbejdsplads med gode kolleger
  • mulighed for faglig udvikling og sparring
  • en kultur, hvor vi værdsætter trivsel og samarbejde på tværs af faggrupper højt
  • en arbejdsplads, der arbejder målrettet med læring, sprog, inkluderende fællesskaber og styrkelsen af sociale kompetencer
Hvis du er klar til at tage del i vores spændende rejse og brænder for det pædagogiske arbejde med fokus på sprog, leg og læring, så send din ansøgning til os.

Løn- og ansættelsesvilkår
Løn- og ansættelsesvilkår efter gældende overenskomst og inden for rammerne af lokal løndannelse

Stillingen er på 37 timer ugentligt og med opstart den 1. november 2026.

I forbindelse med ansættelsen indhenter vi børne- og straffeattest og tager referencer.

Mere information

title: Pædagoger til Børnehusets Globussens børnehave i Brønshøj – vi flytter i nyt hus og vil gerne have dig med
description:
Der sker noget i Tingbjerg. Området er i gang med en spændende byfornyelse og byudvikling – og Globussen er med på rejsen.

Vores tidligere hus er revet ned, og i 2027 flytter vi tilbage i et spritnyt børnehus. Indtil da er vi genhuset på Kobbelvænget, tæt på vores kommende hus. Det betyder, at du kan blive en del af et stærkt og erfarent medarbejderfællesskab, samtidig med at du får mulighed for at være med til at udvikle vores hverdag i de nye rammer.

Vi skal ikke starte forfra. Vi skal tage det bedste med os og sammen finde ud af, hvordan vores pædagogik, læringsmiljøer og fællesskab skal folde sig ud i det nye hus. Det er den rejse, vi gerne vil have dig med på.

Hvem er vi?
Vi er en del af Nord Klynge I og lægger vægt på faglighed, nærvær og et stærkt arbejdsfællesskab. Hos os får du blandt andet:

  • arbejde i mindre grupper med fokus på børnene
  • fast tid til refleksion og faglig udvikling
  • forberedelsestid
  • mulighed for kompetenceudvikling og efteruddannelse
  • arbejdsfællesskaber inden for pædagogik, sprog og bevægelse
  • et tæt og prioriteret forældresamarbejde
  • en grundig introduktion til både Globussen og Nord Klynge I med onboardingfilm
  • nogle superskønne kolleger
Og så må der gerne være humor, højt til loftet og plads til gode idéer.

Skal du med?
Måske er du nyuddannet. Måske har du mange års erfaring. Det vigtigste er, at du er nysgerrig på din faglighed, har lyst til at være tæt på børnene og vil bidrage til fællesskabet. Tag også et kig på os, inden du søger her: Instagram, Facebook, LinkedIn og Globussens hjemmeside.

Ansættelsesvilkår
Stillingerne er fastansættelser og på 37 timer ugentligt, men vi er fleksible, så du får work-life balance. Vi ønsker, at du kan starte hurtigst muligt (vi venter dog gerne på de rette ansøgere). Løn- og ansættelsesvilkår efter gældende overenskomst og indenfor rammerne af lokal løndannelse. I forbindelse med ansættelserne indhenter vi børne- og straffeattest og tager referencer.

Grib telefonen
Send en SMS eller ring til pædagogisk leder Anja 51 68 05 29, hvis du vil vide mere om stillingerne og/eller aftale en dag til at blive vist rundt. Vi bor på Kobbelvænget 65, 2700 Brønshøj, 1. sal th. tæt på Utterslev Mose og med 2A næsten lige til døren. Du følger bare de glade grin (og skiltene). I 2027 er adressen Midtfløjene 3.

Sammen med din ansøgning beder vi dig vedhæfte CV og uddannelsesbevis.

Søg via linket senest fredag den 18. september 2026
Vi holder samtaler løbende.

title: Presuit Secretary
description:
At Morgan & Morgan, the work we do matters. For millions of Americans, we’re their last line of defense against insurance companies, large corporations or defective goods. From attorneys in all 50 states, to client support staff, creative marketing to operations teams, every member of our firm has a key role to play in the winning fight for consumer rights. Our over 6,000 employees are all united by one mission: For the People.

We are seeking a qualified Pre-Suit Secretary to join our office. In this role, you will be responsible for managing the law firm's day-to-day operations, including carrying out administrative services and supporting the legal team. This position's ideal candidate has a strong work ethic, exceptional problem-solving skills, and comfortable working in a fast-paced dynamic workplace.

The compensation for this role is $23/hour.

Responsibilities

  • Assist case managers and attorneys with organizing, filing, and maintaining of client files up to 100+ cases
  • Collect check request for medical records, accident reports, driving records and vehicle ownership as requested and submit for processing
  • Copy documents and demand packages as requested
  • Complete certified mail cards and mail documents and cost checks as requested
  • Perform general office duties such as typing, operating office machines, and sorting mail
  • Create new and existing client folders
  • Prepare and send turndowns and no representation letters, contracts, and multi-party combo letters
  • Send out demand letters
  • And other duties as assigned

Requirements

  • Associate degree, certificate, or equivalent work experience (preferred)
  • Bilingual English and Spanish (preferred)
  • 1 year of experience in the legal field a plus!
  • Knowledge of administrative and clerical procedures and systems such as word processing, managing of files and records, and other office procedures
  • Must possess the ability to multi-task, prioritize, handle a fast-paced environment, and manage workload with a positive attitude and minimal supervision
  • Great written and communication skills
  • Highly organized with the ability to juggle multiple deadlines in a fast-paced environment
  • Strong writing and communication skills along with attention to detail
  • Extensive computer and database expertise, Microsoft Word, Excel, Outlook, and type no less than 35 wpm
  • Remote and/or hybrid not eligible

#LI-SC1

Benefits

Morgan & Morgan is a leading personal injury law firm dedicated to protecting the people, not the powerful. This success starts with our staff. For full-time employees, we offer an excellent benefits package including medical and dental insurance, 401(k) plan, paid time off and paid holidays.

title: Studentermedhjælper i Forskningsfinansiering Nørre, Campus Administration Nørre
description:
Forskningsfinansiering Nørre er en enhed med ca. 25 medarbejdere, der understøtter hjemtag af eksterne midler fra forskningsmiljøer på Nørre Campus, Københavns Universitet.

Specifikt har vi behov for hjælp til:

  • Ad hoc administrativ understøttelse af ansøgninger om ekstern finansiering, herunder udfyldelse af administrative skemaer
  • Understøttelse af kommunikationsopgaver
  • Assistance ifm. afholdelse af events, seminarer og lignende
  • Understøttelse af ledelsesinformation, herunder samling af data mhp. videreformidling til ledelsen
Vi forventer at du

  1. Har flair for at sammensætte store mængder data
  2. Er detaljeorienteret
  3. Har flair for kommunikation
  4. God forståelse for og erfaring med en række forskellige IT-værktøjer
Vi tilbyder

  • Oplæring og sparring på de opgaver, du vil skulle løse
  • Et alsidigt job i en mindre afdeling, hvor der vil være afveksling i opgaverne
  • Engagerede kolleger, der lægger vægt på holdspil og faglighed i arbejdet, og som har en uhøjtidelig, åben og respektfuld omgangstone
  • Muligheden for at få indblik i en afdeling, der understøtter en række kerneopgaver på universitetet

    Løn- og ansættelsesforhold
    Ansættelse og aflønning sker som studerende i henhold til Fællesoverenskomsten mellem Finansministeriet og Offentligt Ansattes Organisationer – Det Statslige Område (OAO-fællesoverenskomsten) samt Organisationsaftalen for Kontorfunktionærer, laboranter og it-medarbejdere (HK).
    Stillingen er på op til 15 timer om ugen. Aflønning sker alene på grundlag af det faktiske antal ydede timer, og du er ikke garanteret et fast timetal. Fysisk er vi placeret i Panumbygningen på Blegdamsvej

    Ansøgningsfrist
    Senest d. 20. september og vi indkalder løbende til samtaler.
På universitetet vil vi gerne afspejle det omgivende samfund og opfordrer alle uanset personlig baggrund til at søge stillingen.

Københavns Universitet har etableret en ny fælles administrativ organisering, som fortsat implementeres. Det indebærer løbende forandringer og udvikling af bl.a. arbejdsgange og samarbejdsflader.

Københavns Universitet giver sine knap 10.000 medarbejdere muligheder for at udnytte deres talent fuldt ud i et ambitiøst, uformelt miljø. Vi sikrer traditionsrige og moderne rammer om uddannelser og fri forskning på højt internationalt niveau. Vi søger svar og løsninger på fælles problemer og gør ny viden tilgængelig og nyttig for andre.

title: Betonarbejdere til renovering og specialopgaver
description:
Vil du arbejde med renovering af beton?

Hos Christiansen & Essenbæk er vi på udkig efter flere dygtige kolleger til vores afdeling for betonrenovering. Har du erfaring med betonarbejde – og trives du både med at skabe noget nyt og give nyt liv til det gamle – så vil vi rigtig gerne høre fra dig.

Som en del af vores specialiserede entreprenørvirksomhed får du fingrene i alt fra fundamenter og bundplader til reparation og forstærkning af eksisterende konstruktioner. Vi løser både store projekter, der kræver tung faglighed, og mindre opgaver, hvor detaljen gør forskellen.

Du bliver en del af et hold, hvor faglighed, samarbejde og ordentligt håndværk står øverst på dagsordenen – og hvor der er plads til udvikling, sparring og gode kollegaer undervejs.

Eksempler på opgaver du kan komme til at arbejde med:
  • Udførelse af fundamenter, sokler og terrændæk
  • Betonrenovering og finisharbejder
  • Renovering af altaner
  • Støbning af trapper, ramper og støttemure
  • Mindre elementmontager og specialopgaver

Du bliver en del af et sjak, hvor man hjælper hinanden og løfter i flok. Nogle opgaver vil du løse selvstændigt, andre i tæt samarbejde med dine kollegaer og sjakbajs.

Vi forestiller os, at du:
  • Har erfaring med betonarbejde, fx som struktør eller betonarbejder
  • Har kendskab til armering, støbning, forskalling og arbejde med diverse mørtler
  • Er mødestabil og god til at samarbejde
  • Har mod på en alsidig og fysisk arbejdsdag
  • Er engageret og har lyst til at blive en del af fællesskabet
Hos os kan du forvente:
  • Et uformelt arbejdsmiljø med gode kollegaer og ordentlig tone
  • Specialiserede og varierende opgaver inden for beton
  • Grundig oplæring og mulighed for kurser
  • Løn efter kvalifikationer
Lyder det som noget for dig?

Så send os en kort ansøgning. Vi indkalder løbende til samtaler og ansætter, så snart vi har fundet de rette.

title: Byggelder til råhusbyggeri i Smørum - Polsk og dansk talende
description:
Vil du have høj løn, firmabil og et sted hvor det er sjovt at gå på arbejde?

Vi mangler en jord- og betonarbejder til råhusbyggeri i Smørum.

Du bliver en del af en entreprenørvirksomhed med egenproduktion, hvor råhusbyggeri, infrastruktur og forsyning fylder i hverdagen. Projekterne ligger i og omkring Smørum samt bredere på Sjælland, og der arbejdes for både offentlige og private bygherrer. Her er opgaverne store nok til at kræve styr på aftalerne, men stadig tæt nok på håndværket til at din indsats kan mærkes på pladsen.

Du får en selvstændig rolle, hvor du tager ansvar for det arbejde du afleverer. Firmabilen er med i pakken, lønnen ligger højt, og mottoet er helt enkelt: Det skal være sjovt at gå på arbejde.

Det får du

Løn: 260-281 kr. i timen

Firmabil: Ja

Arbejdsområde: Smørum og omegn

Kolleger: Cirka 40 ansatte

Faglig udvikling: Plads til kurser og opdatering

Overenskomst: Ansat under gældende overenskomst

Ansættelse: Fastansættelse - vi søger folk, vi kan arbejde med i mange år. Ingen korte forløb.

Hverdag: Råhus, jordarbejde og beton

Din hverdag

På pladsen handler dagen om at få jord, beton og nybyg til at spille i rigtig rækkefølge. Du arbejder selvstændigt med dine opgaver, holder aftalerne og siger til, hvis noget skal løses anderledes end planlagt.

Du kommer blandt andet til at arbejde med:

  • Arbejder med beton på byggepladsen
  • Udfører jord og gravearbejde
  • Arbejder på nybyggeri
  • Støber fundamenter og sokler
  • Planerer og regulerer terræn

Mottoet her er enkelt: Det skal være sjovt at gå på arbejde.

Når aftalerne holder, bliver hverdagen bedre for både sjakket, bygherren og dem der bor tæt på arbejdet. Derfor er ordentlighed ikke noget der står i en mappe, men noget du viser i måden du løser opgaven på.

Vi leder efter dig, der kan sætte kryds ved det meste

Du behøver ikke kunne alt. Men du skal kunne arbejde selvstændigt og tage ansvar for dine aftaler.

Vi forestiller os, at du:

  • Har mindst 5 års erfaring som jord- og betonarbejder
  • Har kørekort
  • Kan arbejde selvstændigt på pladsen
  • Er stabil og møder som aftalt
  • Siger til, hvis noget ikke stemmer

Det er en fordel, hvis du har arbejdet med beton, jordarbejde eller nybyg før. Men det vigtigste er, at du tager fat og afleverer ordentligt arbejde.

Allerede i job?

Så skal det selvfølgelig give mening at skifte.

Derfor starter vi med en uforpligtende snak. Du kan høre mere om opgaverne, virksomheden, lønnen og hverdagen, før du beslutter noget. Og ja, det foregår diskret.

Hvis det her lyder som noget for dig, kan du starte om 1 uge.

Du behøver ikke sende en lang ansøgning. Tryk på Ansøg job, så ringer vi dig op og tager den derfra.

Om PowerMatch

Hos PowerMatch matcher vi dig kun med job, der lever op til dine krav på løn, opgaver, kultur, firmabil og hvad der ellers betyder noget for dig.

Du starter direkte ude i virksomheden. Vi arbejder kun med forløb, hvor målet er fastansættelse. Ikke korte vikariater.

Hvis jobbet ikke viser sig at være det rigtige match, hjælper vi dig videre til noget, der passer bedre.

PowerMatch har 5 stjerner på Trustpilot baseret på 500+ anmeldelser fra håndværkere og fagfolk som dig.

Du optjener point hos PowerMatch, som du kan bruge på 1000+ forskellige gavekort som f.eks Circle K, Elgiganten og oplevelser.

Du får gratis Wolt+, WashWorld og Tv2Play abonnementer.

Du får ét ugentlig spin på vores app, hvor du kan vinde alt fra rejser til elektronik.

Søg uden lang ansøgning

Du behøver ikke skrive en roman.

Tryk Ansøg job, så ringer vi dig op til en kort og uforpligtende snak.

Passer jobbet til dig, går vi videre. Passer det ikke, prøver vi at finde et bedre match.

Tag fat nu - vi skal bruge en jord- og betonarbejder mere i Smørum, og det kunne sagtens være dig.



Jord og gravearbejde, Beton, Nybyg

title: Fritidsjob i Styrelsen for Arbejdsmarked og Rekruttering
description:
Er du mellem 13 og 17 år? Kunne du tænke dig et spændende fritidsjob, hvor du får et kig ind bag kulisserne i en styrelse og samtidig tjener dine egne penge? Så læs videre – måske er det dig, vi leder efter!

Arbejdsopgaver Hos os kommer du til at:

  • Hjælpe med at holde køkkenerne og andre faciliteter pæne, herunder tømme og fylde opvaskemaskiner
  • Postaflevering, håndtering af returpant
  • Små kommunikationsopgaver til vores intranet
  • Udføre andre små opgaver, der gør vores hverdag lettere.
  • Vi forventer, at du kan arbejde selvstændigt, er pligtopfyldende og tager ansvar.
Vi tilbyder
  • Et job, der nemt kan kombineres med skole og fritidsaktiviteter
  • En sjov arbejdsplads med en god stemning
  • Muligheden for at tjene dine egne penge og lære arbejdsmarkedet at kende.
  • Vi er ca. 200 medarbejdere fordelt på tre etager, hvor du kommer rundt blandt alle kontorer.
Praktisk info Vi forestiller os, at du kommer to-tre gange om ugen i ca. 2 timer ad gangen mellem kl. 13 – 17 mandag til fredag. Vi sørger selvfølgelig for at tilpasse arbejdstiderne, så de passer til dit skema. Du kan læse mere om reglerne for unges arbejdstid her. Vi forventer at ansætte to fritidsjobbere.

Dit daglige arbejdssted vil være Vermundsgade 38, 2100 København Ø.

Timelønnen udgør mellem kr. 62,27 og kr. 84,40 og afhænger af din alder.

Du ansættes i henhold til cirkulære af 21. november 1985 (LP nr. 110/85) fra Finansministeriet vedrørende bybude/retsbude (piccoloer/piccoliner) i statens tjeneste, med virkning fra 1. oktober 1985.

title: Epic Application Analyst (Healthy Planet) - Epic Applications Analyst
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for an Epic Application Analyst (Healthy Planet) - Epic Applications Analyst based in India.

This role is an opportunity for an experienced Epic applications professional to support and optimize healthcare technology solutions with a strong focus on Healthy Planet and Compass Rose. You will work closely with operational stakeholders, vendors, and IT teams to translate business needs into reliable application workflows. The position combines hands-on configuration, troubleshooting, maintenance, enhancement, and project support across critical Epic applications. You will contribute to initiatives involving patient registries, social determinants of health workflows, and remote patient monitoring. The role requires strong analytical thinking, independence, and the ability to resolve complex technical and functional challenges. You will also serve as a subject matter expert while helping maintain stable, effective, and continuously improving healthcare systems.

Accountabilities

  • Independently support Healthy Planet and Compass Rose initiatives, ensuring application functionality aligns with operational and clinical requirements.
  • Create, maintain, design, and optimize patient registries and related application workflows.
  • Design and improve Social Determinants of Health (SDOH) workflows to support evolving healthcare needs.
  • Support the expansion and ongoing development of Remote Patient Monitoring programs.
  • Perform daily application maintenance, including service requests, minor enhancements, and workflow optimizations.
  • Analyze and diagnose complex system and application issues, identify root causes, and develop appropriate solutions or escalate when necessary.
  • Design, configure, test, implement, maintain, and optimize Epic applications and workflows.
  • Translate business and technical requirements into functional application solutions.
  • Provide Tier 2 and Tier 3 application support, troubleshooting incidents and documenting resolutions thoroughly.
  • Collaborate with operational stakeholders, vendors, and IT teams to resolve issues and improve application performance.
  • Support system upgrades, enhancements, and monthly Epic updates, including associated testing and validation.
  • Maintain accurate technical and application documentation.
  • Act as a subject matter expert on application functionality, workflows, and system capabilities.
  • Lead or contribute to complex application projects and IT initiatives as assigned.
  • Support reporting, data validation, analytics, and integration-related needs when required.

    • Requirements

    • High School Diploma or GED.
    • Current Epic Healthy Planet Certification.
    • Current Epic Compass Rose Certification.
    • Previous hands-on experience supporting Epic Healthy Planet workflows and applications.
    • Strong understanding of healthcare application workflows, configuration, troubleshooting, and system maintenance.
    • Ability to work independently with minimal supervision while managing priorities effectively.
    • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and root cause analysis skills.
    • Ability to translate business requirements into practical functional and technical solutions.
    • Strong communication and collaboration skills when working with operational teams, vendors, and IT stakeholders.
    • Experience providing application support, resolving incidents, and documenting technical solutions.
    • Experience with workflow design and optimization is preferred.
    • Experience leading complex IT or application initiatives is an advantage.
    • Prior mentoring or leadership experience within an Epic applications environment is beneficial.

      • Opportunity to contribute to application optimization, system enhancements, and complex IT projects.

title: Senior Software Engineer, Message Delivery
description:
Working at Omnisend is... kind of boring.
Not the soul-crushing kind of boring — more like the “no drama, no chaos, just smart people doing great work” kind. The kind that lets you focus on what matters, without pointless meetings, micromanagement, or bureaucracy. We’re data-driven. We test, we iterate, we improve. Gut feelings don’t drive decisions — insights do. We trust each other. We’re transparent, give real feedback, and actually listen. No egos, no hand-holding — just a team of experienced professionals moving fast, adapting easily, and delivering impact. Omnisend is customer-funded and customer-driven. Our work is rooted in solving real problems that help ecommerce brands grow. No empty promises — we bring in results. And yes, we have fun. But the grown-up kind — workations, team gatherings, the occasional party. No forced fun, no awkward icebreakers. Just genuine moments with a team that actually enjoys working together.
The Message Delivery team is the backbone of Omnisend’s multichannel communication stack — ensuring that millions of marketing messages reliably reach inboxes, phones, and browsers every day.
We’re responsible for the reliable, fast, and compliant delivery of email, SMS, and push notifications. Our scope includes:
Managing message sending infrastructure;
Enabling message rendering and personalization across channels;
Powering message tracking, analytics, and logs for customers and support;
Collaborating with Product, Support, and Customer Success to deliver high-quality CX
We are looking for a Senior Full-stack Engineer with a preference for backend development. People that are proactive, product-minded and enthusiastic about crafting the impactful software product for our customers find a best fit at Omnisend.

What you’ll do @Omnisend:

  • Contribute significantly to product development decisions
  • Design, develop, and test features
  • Resolve technical challenges for seamless system functionality and optimal performance
  • Maintain features with effective monitoring, logging, and alerting
  • Share best practices with team members

We expect that you’ll bring:

  • Hands-on experience (5+ years) implementing and maintaining scalable, highly available, high load systems
  • Customer centricity
  • Ideally, experience with Golang or alternatively proficiency in any backend programming language with the willingness to learn Golang
  • Familiarity with modern software build pipelines and tools
  • Proficiency in any database
  • Experience with real time distributed messaging tools, like NSQ, Pub/Sub
  • Working experience with any cloud provider (at Omnisend we use Google Cloud Services)
  • Experience with event based architecture

How we work and what we value:

  • Company-wide OKR
  • Empowered product teams that solve customer and business problems
  • Objective-based planning and experimentation-driven delivery
  • Product-led growth
  • We look at product metrics daily, we speak to our customers and do it often
  • Outcomes and bringing value to our customers over outputs and feature factories
  • Ship to learn. Experimentation to validate hypotheses and assumptions
  • Truly embracing data-driven decisions

What we offer in return:

  • Gross salary starting point from 6000 EUR/month based on experience
  • Quarterly salary reviews
  • An unlimited learning budget for self-improvement complying with the best interest of Omnisend
  • Working methods and best practices inspired by the best tech companies in Silicon Valley
  • Senior colleagues (over 70%) enable us to have a high-performing, productive environment where your growth will accelerate
  • Flexible working hours and remote work possibilities
  • Private health insurance
  • Unlimited access to psychotherapy
  • Workstation budget
  • Personalized work anniversary gifts, such as house cleaning, spa treatments, international flights etc.
  • Attractive workations and team-led team-building events
Omnisend is an email and SMS marketing platform built for ecommerce brands. With one-click integration to major ecommerce platforms, intuitive automation, and powerful email templates, we make sophisticated marketing effortless — no learning curve required.
Award-winning 24/7/365 customer support? Check. A platform trusted by growing brands and seasoned pros alike? Absolutely. The idea that “great marketing needs to be expensive”? Our 150,000+ customers prove that wrong every day.

title: Nu er der endelig en pædagogstilling ledig i Skovstjernen, skynd dig og søg
description:
Vil du være med til at skabe tydelige, trygge og udviklende læringsmiljøer for børnehavebørn, i et hus, hvor fællesskabet bærer, og fagligheden står skarpt?

Er du fagligt stærk, stolt af dit fag og klar til at blive en del af et børnehus, hvor tydelig pædagogik, struktur, bevægelse og inkluderende fællesskaber går hånd i hånd?

Vi søger uddannede pædagoger til vores børnehave – som vil være med til at styrke vores pædagogiske retning i et NEST-inspireret og idrætscertificeret miljø.

Om jobbet

Vi er et børnehus med fokus på tryghed, forudsigelighed og stærke læringsmiljøer. NEST-principperne er en naturlig del af vores arbejde: tydelige rammer, støtte til sociale færdigheder, stærke relationer og en anerkendende tilgang. Som idrætscertificeret hus tænker vi bevægelse og motorik ind i hverdagen, både ude og inde


Vi søger pædagoger, der:

  • er fagligt solide og kan stå ved deres pædagogiske valg
  • arbejder reflekteret og har lyst til at udvikle praksis sammen med kolleger
  • trives i strukturerede, tryghedsskabende rammer
  • har lyst til at arbejde med NEST-inspirerede principper
  • bringer bevægelse, leg og kropslig læring naturligt ind i hverdagen
  • er gode samarbejdspartnere med blik for både det enkelte barn og fællesskabet
  • bidrager med stabilitet, overblik og varme i det pædagogiske arbejde


Om Skovstjernen

Vores selvejende institution Børnehuset Skovstjernen er skønt beliggende i DTU Science Park i Hørsholm, kun 20 min fra Ryparken St. med 150S. Vi er et integreret børnehus med et højt fagligt niveau hvor der er plads til ca. 100 børn, fordelt på 3 vuggestuegrupper ( 12 børn i grupper) og børnehave fordelt på 3 aldersopdelte grupper (ca. 20-24 børn i hver gruppe).

Få indblik i noget af vores hverdag her:

Børnefødselsdage | emu danmarks læringsportal

Børn og leg | emu danmarks læringsportal

Du kan læse mere om os på under Daginstitutioner.

Du får din daglige gang i et spændende, lyst og velindrettet hus i smukke omgivelser, tæt på lille skov med en dejlig stor naturlegeplads

  • Tæt på offentlig transport.
  • Fredagsbar
  • Julefrokost ”ude af huset”
  • Kompetence udvikling af alle ansatte inkl. Kurser
  • En god kultur, hvor vi videndeler og sparer på tværs af huset
  • Forberedelsestid


Uddannelse er en selvfølge - ikke et gode

Vi prioriterer at kompetenceudvikle alle vores pædagoger og pædagogmedhjælpere.

Om Rudersdal Kommune

I Rudersdal Kommune tror vi på, at vi kun lykkes i fællesskab. Derfor er det vores mål, at alle kommunens medarbejdere og ledere i alle opgaver - og i fællesskab - arbejder for at skabe bæredygtige løsninger, der giver værdi for borgerne, virksomheden og det samfund, vi er en del af. Se vores film om Rudersdal Kommunes strategi og værdier ”Vi lykkes kun i fællesskab” HER

Ansættelsesvilkår

Stillingen er som udgangspunkt på fuldtid og start snarest muligt. Ansættelse sker i henhold til gældende overenskomst.

Ansøgning, samtale og kontakt

Du søger jobbet ved at klikke på knappen "Søg stilling" nedenfor.

Samtaler: Vi forventer at holde samtaler løbende.

title: High School Dean of Student Life (26-27 School Year)
description:
WHO WE ARE
Intrepid College Prep is a network of free, college preparatory public charter schools located in the Antioch area of Greater Nashville, Tennessee. We educate scholars at two campuses: Opportunity Academy Middle School and Independence Academy High School. Our 5-12 model ensures that scholars have the opportunity to engage in a rigorous, college-preparatory education for eight years prior to their transition to college and the professional opportunities that follow. We are an open-enrollment school, which means that our scholars do not have to take an entrance test or pay tuition to enroll.

Our Mission:
Intrepid College Prep is committed to ensuring our scholars, educators, and families have the opportunity to unlock an unlimited future. By providing rigorous academic instruction and creating powerful relationships amongst our community’s members, we ignite passion, seek knowledge, and inspire the bravery needed to have a profound impact in our world.

Our core values are Ignite Passion, Seek Knowledge, and Inspire Bravery. While we ground our instruction in these values, we also strive to live them out as adults in our interactions with one another. We believe that professional development and intentional coaching can allow any person to develop the skills necessary to be an effective team member, but we know that rests upon the bedrock of these essential values.

WHO YOU ARE
Our Core Value: Ignite Passion
What does this core value mean to Intrepid?
You are DISCIPLINED. You hold yourself to a high standard and you take pride in your ability to take initiative. You have strong personal organization skills and are intentional about how you use your time.
You are MISSION ALIGNED. You believe in helping to unlock the unlimited potential in all students through a college preparatory education. You believe that each and every student, regardless of race, socioeconomic status, gender identity, religion, or immigration status is deserving of an excellent education and capable of achieving it.

Our Core Value: Seek Knowledge
What does this core value mean to Intrepid?
You are HUNGRY FOR FEEDBACK. You want to grow as a person and a professional. You want to learn from your peers and your coaches, even when it challenges you to put aside your ego.
You are NERDY. You have a deep love for your area of expertise and a genuine excitement to share it with others.

Our Core Value: Inspire Bravery
What does this core value mean to Intrepid?
You are DRIVEN BY EQUITY. You are committed to being actively anti-racist in your interactions with fellow staff, students and families. You believe that education is inherently social justice work that requires us to begin with ourselves and our own biases.
You are INTROSPECTIVE. You are committed to personal development and prioritize your own wellness. You are reflective about your impact on others and feel comfortable acknowledging your own mistakes and quirks.

WHAT YOU’LL DO
The Dean of Student Life leads the charge on creating and sustaining an achievement-oriented, disciplined, and joyful school culture based on the embodiment of our core values. As part of the Student Life team, the Dean will support academci instruction through a strong commitment to diversity, inclusiveness, and trauma-informed practices.

Dean of Student Life Responsibilities:

  • Invest teachers in a school culture of consistency by leading school-wide systems, structures, and procedures.
  • Work closely with the Principal and Assistant Principal of Student Life to establish a positive, disciplined, achievement-oriented, and joyful school culture.
  • Support teachers to hold all students to high and consistent behavioral expectations.
  • Support students with behavioral crisis-intervention and acute behavioral issues.
  • Act as a resource to teachers in their instructional practice, particularly with issues of discipline, relationship with students, classroom management, and school culture.
  • Engage in a community where your practice is public (i.e. engaging in classroom visits, publication of curriculum, observation and feedback cycles).
  • Availability and willingness to participate in after-school programs.
  • Availability and willingness to engage in a limited number of optional, evening/weekend student recruitment and community outreach events.
  • Other duties as assigned

Qualifications

  • A bachelor’s degree with a minimum 2.5 GPA.
  • Minimum of two years teaching experience in an urban public school or charter school setting (preferred, but not required).
  • Familiarity/proficiency in Microsoft Excel and Google Office required.
  • Spanish language fluency highly preferred.
Commitment to Diversity
Intrepid College Prep is an equal opportunity employer. As an equal opportunity employer, we hire without consideration to race, religion, creed, color, national origin, age, gender, sexual orientation, marital status, veteran status or disability.

Compensation
We offer a generous compensation package, including full health benefits. All staff members are equipped with the tools needed to succeed, including a dedicated work space, laptop computer, email, high-speed internet access, and all necessary supplies. Compensation is highly competitive; teachers are eligible to participate in the MNPS Retirement System.

Base salaries are determined by the ICP salary scale. Placement on the salary scale is determined by years of relevant, teaching experience. We do not negotiate salaries because of research that demonstrates the resulting impact of inequitable pay, primarily for women and people of color. Placement on the salary scale is solely determined by relevant experience.

Starting salary (Year 0) for a certified teacher with zero years of experience starts at $53,000. Please reach out to the hiring team for inquires regarding the salary scale.

title: Vil du være en del af en faglig stærk sundhedspleje, hvor du får mulighed for at arbejde i et tæt tværfagligt samarbejde både i familierne og på skoleområdet?
description:
Sundhedsplejen i Halsnæs Kommune søger en erfaren sundhedsplejerske til vores team. Vi er 13 sundhedsplejersker og en faglig leder. Vores arbejde er præget af høj faglighed, kollegial sparring og en fælles bestræbelse på at skabe trivsel og sundhed for børn, unge og familier i vores kommune. Dette gælder også vores tværfaglige arbejde i Børne, Unge og voksenafdelingen, som vi er en del af.

Vi tilbyder
  • En engageret arbejdsplads med fokus på faglighed og arbejdsglæde, med gode muligheder for faglig udvikling.
  • Kollegial sparring og ekstern supervision.
  • At være en del af vores indsats for udsatte familier med behov for ekstra støtte
  • Et tæt tværfagligt samarbejde med skoler, daginstitutioner, familieafdelingen, PPR, fysioterapeuter, ergoterapeut, samt andre relevante samarbejdspartnere.
  • Gode ansættelsesvilkår og fleksible arbejdstider, da vi arbejder i en selvtilrettelæggende funktion.
  • Vi tilbyder 7 hjemmebesøg inden for de første 1½ år, samt graviditetsbesøg til alle. I besøgene benytter vi NBO, ADBB, PUF, EPDS og Gotland tilbydes til begge forældre. Skolebørnene tilbyder vi helbredsundersøgelser 3- 4 gange i løbet af deres skoletid, med mulighed for behovssamtaler derudover. Vi har sundhedspædagogiske aktiviteter m.m.
  • Vi er stolte af vores mange tilbud til børn og familier, som har brug for gruppetilbud. Det er eksempelvis graviditetsgruppe, Fars legestue, COS-P forløb, mødregruppe for unge mødre, Stime forløb, UNG MOD etc.
  • Et introduktionsprogram, hvor man får sin egen kollegiale mentor
Vi søger
  • Autoriseret sundhedsplejerske med relevant erfaring.
  • Engagement og interesse for arbejdet i almenområdet uanset om det er småbørn eller skolebørn.
  • Brænder samtidig for at arbejde med udsatte familier og skabe positive forandringer.
  • Har overblik og handlekraft til at skabe et trygt og støttende miljø for alle familier.
  • Være en del af vores velfungerende tværfaglige samarbejde.
  • Går op i faglighed og vil gerne være med til at udvikle sundhedsplejen i Halsnæs.
Løn

Løn og ansættelsesforhold sker efter gældende overenskomst. Grundløn for laveste grundlønstrin er 33.700 kr. om måneden ekskl. pension. Derudover kan der aftales kvalifikations- og funktionstillæg, afhængigt af erfaring og kompetencer.

Yderligere oplysninger

Stillingen er på 37 timer og ønskes besat pr. 1. november 2026

Ansøgningsfristen er den 21. september kl. 12.00 og der afholdes samtaler den 23. september 2026.

Har du spørgsmål til stillingen kan du kontakte ledende sundhedsplejerske Lone Frederiksen, telefon 23 34 65 77 eller tillidsrepræsentant Maria Brosbøl, 51 67 54 73.

Vi ser frem til at høre fra dig!

Bliv en del af Halsnæs – et godt sted at arbejde og et godt sted at bo

Vi er en moderne og rummelig arbejdsplads med cirka 3.000 kollegaer, der hver dag gør sig umage for at levere velfærd og service af høj kvalitet. Vores værdier – redelighed, mulighed og helhed – er fundamentet for alt, vi gør.

Hos Halsnæs Kommune arbejder vi tæt på natur, hav og fjord – og med hovedstaden inden for rækkevidde. Her får du ikke kun et spændende job, men også muligheden for at skabe et liv med ro, fællesskab og aktive oplevelser. Mange vælger at bosætte sig her for at få mere plads, nærhed til naturen og et stærkt lokalt sammenhold.

Vil du vide mere om, hvordan det er at arbejde i Halsnæs Kommune? Besøg vores hjemmeside eller vores LinkedIn-profil.
Vil du vide mere om, hvordan det er at bo og leve i Halsnæs? Besøg Flyt til Halsnæs og se, hvad området kan tilbyde dig og din familie.

title: Superintendent/Project Manager

Company Summary:
Enerfab has over 120 years of experience, offering fabrication and construction capabilities to a wide
variety of customers for the chemical, food & beverage, oil & gas, heavy industrial and power industries.
Founded in 1901, our company began making sealants and lacquers — including a patented formula for
brewer’s pitch — for beer tanks and vessels. Over the last century, our expanded capabilities, project
experience, safety record, and commitment to quality have made Enerfab one of the industry leaders in

(e.g., Primavera, Microsoft Project).

hazards.
c. Ensure compliance with all applicable building codes and permits.

title: Environmental Monitoring Technician
description:
At Riparia Environmental, we believe people are at the heart of meaningful environmental work.

Every day, our teams help restore habitats, manage natural resources, support environmental compliance, and improve the health of the communities and ecosystems we serve. Whether you're working in the field, supporting operations, or contributing specialized expertise, your work helps create lasting environmental impact.

At Riparia Environmental, we believe people are at the heart of meaningful environmental work.

Every day, our teams help restore habitats, manage natural resources, support environmental compliance, and improve the health of the communities and ecosystems we serve. Whether you're working in the field, supporting operations, or contributing specialized expertise, your work helps create lasting environmental impact.

Riparia Environmental, a subsidiary of MacKay, is seeking an Environmental Monitoring Technician to join our team. This role is ideal for someone who enjoys working outside and alongside a team while contributing to the improvement of habitats and ecosystems.

Our Environmental Monitoring Technicians help our restoration team answer questions like: Are the plants we installed surviving? Are native species becoming established? Are invasive species returning? Is the habitat improving? Is erosion occurring? And are we meeting the project’s restoration goals? This is an essential role where individuals get to proactively contribute to the success of ongoing restoration efforts.

At Riparia, we strive to empower people, create solutions, and enhance communities. This means attracting and empowering a workforce that is collaborative, innovative, and committed to personal growth. All are encouraged to apply, even those who believe they do not meet every single one of the qualifications.

Shift and Schedule:

This position’s schedule varies based on current projects and the season. Work shifts are scheduled between the hours of 6:00am and 5:30pm. Overtime may be required. Local and overnight travel may be required.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Conduct field monitoring at wetlands, streams, rivers, forests, prairies, and other restoration sites.
  • Monitor the progress and condition of ecological restoration projects.
  • Identify potential problems such as erosion, invasive species, plant mortality, poor drainage, or unsuccessful restoration efforts.
  • Collect soil, water, vegetation, and other environmental samples.
  • Use GPS, tablets, cameras, and other field equipment to accurately document site conditions.
  • Record field data and maintain accurate monitoring records.
  • Provide regular updates to Project Managers and restoration team members on site conditions and monitoring results.
  • Prepare progress reports, monitoring reports, and client deliverables.
  • Present monitoring results, photographs, and field observations.
  • Lead restoration crews in survey and construction activities within your area of professional expertise, as needed.
  • Assist with restoration activities such as planting, invasive species removal, habitat enhancement, erosion control, and site maintenance when needed.
  • Travel to project sites and work outdoors in varied terrain and weather conditions.
  • Other duties as assigned.

Physical Conditions:

  • Ability to wear appropriate PPE for the entire shift including but not limited to: hard hats, goggles/glasses, gloves, reflective garments, etc.
  • Ability to work in variable outdoor conditions (heat, rain, rough terrain, etc.).
  • Ability to frequently bend, and squat throughout shifts.
  • Ability to carry loads of 30-40 pounds, up to the occasional 90 pounds.
  • Ability to work long hours and overtime.

Minimum Qualifications:

  • 3-5 years of related natural resources experience
  • High school diploma or equivalent.
  • Demonstrated experience collecting and organizing field data for reports
  • Knowledge of environmental restoration techniques and best practices
  • Experience driving and backing full-size trucks with trailers and equipment.
  • Experience with the safe operation of power tools such as lawn mowers, brush cutters, chainsaws, etc.
  • Ability to work both independently and as a member of a team.
  • Ability to obtain DOT Medical Examiner’s Certificate prior to employment.
  • Valid driver's license

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree in natural resources or a related field
  • Demonstrated leadership experience in and with teams (preferably with a natural resources crew)
  • Ability to identify invasive plant species and/or noxious weeds
  • WSDA Pesticide Applicator License
  • Active and up to date DOT Medical Examiner’s Certificate
  • Certified Erosion and Sediment Control Lead (CESCL) certification
  • Desire and aptitude to grow

As part of MacKay, Riparia Environmental is part of a growing collective of infrastructure and environmental professionals, bringing together talented teams, diverse capabilities, and specialized expertise from across the industry.

Meaningful Work with Visible Impact

Our work supports healthier ecosystems, stronger communities, and more resilient environments. From habitat restoration and environmental monitoring to vegetation management and compliance support, every project contributes to outcomes that matter.

A People-First Culture

At Riparia Environmental, we are committed to creating an environment where employees can grow, contribute, and do their best work. We support well-being, encourage balance, and foster a culture built on respect, collaboration, and accountability.

Growth and Opportunity

As part of a growing organization, employees have opportunities to build new skills, take on new challenges, and advance their careers. We invest in our people and support long-term professional development.

The Strength of a Growing Collective

Riparia Environmental combines specialized environmental expertise with the multidisciplinary resources of MacKay. Together, we bring deep technical knowledge, practical problem-solving, and a commitment to delivering quality work for our clients and communities.

Opportunities to Share in Success

We provide opportunities for employees to participate in ownership and build long-term financial value as the company grows.

Our Values

At Riparia Environmental, our values guide how we work, collaborate, and support one another.

Honesty. We build trust through transparency, integrity, and accountability.

Dedication. We are committed to the success of our team members, clients, and communities.

Relationships. We foster lasting connections that strengthen our work and the teams around us.

Who We Are

Riparia Environmental delivers environmental services that help communities, organizations, and landowners responsibly manage and protect natural resources.

Our team provides environmental maintenance, habitat restoration, vegetation management, environmental monitoring, permitting support, and related services that improve environmental health and support long-term resilience.

As part of MacKay, Riparia Environmental is connected to a growing collective of infrastructure and environmental expertise, bringing together talented professionals, expanded capabilities, and a shared commitment to solving complex challenges.

We're looking for dedicated individuals who take pride in their work, value collaboration, and want to contribute to healthier environments and stronger communities. If that sounds like you, we'd like to hear from you.

Please note that the pay information shown below is a general guideline only. Pay is based upon candidate experience and qualifications, as well as various market and business considerations.

The wage range for this position is $27.00 - $32.00/hr.

Full time employees receive a well rounded benefit package including access to our company sponsored Medical (including an HSA High Deductible option), Dental, Vision, FSA, and Supplemental Life Insurance plans. We also offer 100% company paid Life Insurance, Short Term Disability, and Long Term Disability coverage. Employees are eligible to participate in our company 401k plan with up to a 4% match. Additionally, employees also receive paid vacation time, paid sick time, and 11 paid holidays and are able to participate in employee ownership options. MacKay pays for expenses associated with licensure as well as annual profit sharing bonuses.

Employment requires passing a pre-employment background check and drug screen.

As a federal Contractor we participate in E-Verify and are proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity employer.
