A Snapshot of Your Day

Join the Offshore Execution Equipment Product & Portfolio Management team as an Equipment Product Manager. You will be responsible for defining what should exist in the equipment portfolio and ensuring a clear product vision across platforms. You translate customer, fleet, and market insights into cross-platform product roadmaps, guide strategic choices via governance forums, and ensure that development is aligned with value, cost, and long-term portfolio direction. This role is positioned upstream of delivery—focusing on defining the right solutions, while working closely with Platform Managers who ensure execution and delivery.

How You’ll Make an Impact

  • Own the product vision and cross-platform equipment roadmaps
  • Define what should exist in the portfolio based on customer needs, fleet insights, and strategic priorities
  • Translate market trends and operational feedback into product direction and feature pipelines.
  • Oversee the entire product lifecycle for designated equipment, ensuring seamless transitions from concept to end-of-life.
  • Drive strategic techno-commercial assessments to improve existing equipment and develop new components.

What You Bring

  • Degree in Engineering (Mechanical, Electrical, Industrial or similar)
  • 8+ years’ experience in product management, product strategy, or technical development
  • Strong experience in complex industrial products / energy sector
  • Proven ability to translate customer insights into product strategy and roadmap
  • Solid understanding of business cases, cost drivers, and value trade-offs
  • Strong stakeholder management and influencing skills

About the Team

This small yet impactful team is responsible for defining all new developments in offshore wind power equipment. Focusing on product management, value engineering, and platform management, the team ensures that every project aligns with strategic business objectives. The collaborative environment encourages open communication, distilling complex information into easily understandable insights, fostering a culture of storytelling and shared understanding. The ability to challenge ideas at all levels is crucial in navigating the complexities of the organization and its products.

Who is Siemens Gamesa?

Siemens Gamesa is part of Siemens Energy, a global leader in energy technology with a rich legacy of innovation spanning over 150 years. Together, we are committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. As a leading player in the wind industry and manufacturer of wind turbines, we are passionate about driving the energy transition and providing innovative solutions that meet the growing energy demand of the global community. At Siemens Gamesa, we are constantly seeking individuals to join our team and support our focus on energy transformation. Find out how you can make a difference at Siemens Gamesa:

Our Commitment to Diversity

Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity we generate power. We run on inclusion and our combined creative energy is fueled by multiple nationalities. We celebrate character – no matter what ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability. We energize society, all of society, and we do not discriminate based on our differences.

Rewards/Benefits

  • Opportunities to work with a global team
  • Medical benefits
  • Remote/Flexible work
  • Paid holidays and parental leave
  • Employer-funded pension
  • Subsidised lunch and more

title: PRN Overnight Admissions Clinician or RN - Behavioral Hospital
description:
Behavioral Health Admissions (A&R) Clinician

About Perimeter Behavioral Hospital of Arlington

Perimeter Behavioral Hospital of Arlington is a leading provider of behavioral healthcare services, dedicated to serving children, adolescents, and adults through comprehensive treatment programs across multiple states and care settings. Our mission is to deliver hope and healing through compassionate, evidence-based care.

Position Summary

Perimeter Behavioral Hospital of Arlington is seeking a dedicated and compassionate Admissions (A&R) Clinician to join our team. In this role, you will serve as the primary point of contact for individuals seeking mental health treatment services. The ideal candidate will combine strong clinical assessment skills with exceptional customer service to guide patients and families through the admission process and ensure access to appropriate levels of care.

Essential Responsibilities

Clinical Assessment

  • Conduct comprehensive intake assessments to determine appropriate levels of care.
  • Evaluate psychosocial, emotional, and behavioral health needs across various age groups.
  • Apply knowledge of developmental stages and special populations to clinical decision-making.
  • Provide culturally sensitive care while considering each individual's social, spiritual, and personal background.
  • Utilize crisis intervention and de-escalation techniques when necessary.

Care Coordination

  • Serve as a liaison between patients, families, referral sources, and treatment teams.
  • Verify insurance coverage and coordinate authorization processes.
  • Collaborate with clinicians, nursing staff, and business office personnel to facilitate admissions and continuity of care.
  • Maintain communication with referral sources and provide timely follow-up.
  • Accurately document assessments, referrals, and all related interactions.

Program Operations

  • Respond to high-volume calls, referrals, and walk-in assessments.
  • Coordinate intake appointments and admission activities.
  • Track, organize, and analyze referral and admissions data.
  • Resolve challenges effectively while maintaining a positive and professional attitude.
  • Demonstrate initiative, accountability, and sound judgment in daily operations.

Required Qualifications

  • Master's degree with active clinical licensure (LMSW, LCSW, LPC, LPC-Associate, or LMFT); or
  • Active Texas Registered Nurse (RN) license or eligibility through a compact state license.
  • Current Basic Life Support (BLS) certification.
  • De-escalation Training: Handle with Care (HWC) certification.
  • Knowledge of behavioral health principles, practices, and treatment modalities.
  • Understanding of legal, ethical, and regulatory standards in patient care.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Windows applications and electronic documentation systems.
  • Strong understanding of insurance plans, PPOs, and managed care processes.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Minimum of one year of experience in an inpatient behavioral health setting.
  • Experience conducting clinical assessments and treatment planning.
  • Familiarity with local and regional mental health resources.
  • Experience with data analysis and reporting.
  • Proven commitment to exceptional customer service.

Professional Competencies

  • Strong clinical judgment and assessment capabilities.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
  • Ability to work independently and collaboratively within a multidisciplinary team.
  • Cultural awareness, sensitivity, and professionalism.
  • Commitment to continuous professional development and learning.
  • High ethical standards and professional integrity.

Work Environment

  • Fast-paced behavioral healthcare setting
  • Collaborative and supportive team culture
  • Opportunities for professional growth and advancement
  • Patient-centered environment focused on clinical excellence

Schedule

  • PRN opportunities available!

title: Medarbejdere til administrative opgaver i klagesagsbehandling
description:
Skatteankestyrelsen behandler borgeres og virksomheders klager på skatte- og vurderingsområdet, og kontoret Sagsadministration bidrager med administrativ støtte før, under og efter klagesagsbehandlingen. Med fokus på høj kvalitet, stærkt detaljearbejde, effektivitet og professionel service finder vi gode løsninger. Nu kan du blive en del af vores hold i Odense, hvor vi er flyttet ind i nye lækre lokaler.

Brug dine administrative kompetencer til et bredt spænd af opgaver
Skatteankestyrelsen er en uafhængig klagemyndighed. Vi sikrer retssikkerheden for borgere og virksomheder med en kompetent behandling af klager. Vi er fællessekretariat for Landsskatteretten og de ankenævn, der oftest træffer afgørelse i sagerne. I kontoret Sagsadministration bidrager vi med administrativ understøttelse af sagsbehandlingen – og vi vil gerne byde velkommen til flere administrative kolleger.

Du bliver en del af et hold, som sammen med den øvrige styrelse, sikrer kompetent og uafhængig klagebehandling. Vi er med i hele sagsforløbet, og det betyder, at vi håndterer alt fra at besvare indledende spørgsmål fra borgere eller virksomheder til at sende afgørelser ud og afslutte sagerne, når klagen er afgjort. Sagsadministrationen er inddelt i to enheder, som har et tæt samarbejde. Vi har et bredt spænd af administrative opgaver og løser mange forskellige opgaver i løbet af en dag – vi er fleksible og forstår vigtigheden af at vi som understøttende kontor løser de opgaver, der er behov for.

Vi lægger vægt på høj faglighed og kvalitet og på en professionel tilgang til både borgere, virksomheder, sagsbehandlere og afgørelsesmyndighederne – vi har blik for modtagerne. Hele kontoret finder gode administrative løsninger og har et naturligt fokus på effektiv arbejdstilrettelæggelse og produktion og arbejder stort set kun digitalt.

Hos os møder du en uformel omgangstone og et fællesskab, hvor vi interesserer os for hinanden. Vi har et højt arbejdstempo og er en arbejdsplads i udvikling. Når du starter i kontoret, sætter vi dig grundigt ind i opgaverne og tilrettelægger et onboardingprogram skræddersyet til dig. Du får tilknyttet en sparringspartner, som hjælper dig godt på vej.
I Skatteankestyrelsen understøtter vi fleksible arbejdsvilkår, og rammerne for arbejdstilrettelæggelsen drøfter du med din leder med udgangspunkt i den samlede opgaveløsning.

Dine ansvarsområder og primære opgaver

  • oprette og klargøre sager til sagsbehandling.
  • behandle henvendelser fra borgere og virksomheder – både på telefonen og skriftligt.
  • hjælpe til ved svar på anmodninger om aktindsigt.
  • oprette dokumenter til sagsbehandlerne og indhente materiale fra andre styrelser.
  • klargøre materiale til ankenævn og Landsskatteretten, sende afgørelser og afslutte sager.
Med de opgaver forestiller vi os, at du

  • har interesse for offentlig forvaltning og som minimum har en gymnasial uddannelse efterfulgt af en kontoruddannelse eller nogle års relevant erhvervserfaring.
  • har flair for IT
  • arbejder struktureret og ansvarsbevidst og har et skarpt blik for kvalitet, for detaljen og for retningslinjer.
  • Trives med at arbejde i et højt tempo indtil opgaverne er løst og levere professionel service i et godt samspil med dine kolleger – og er velformuleret i tale og på skrift.
Din nye kollega Mikkel Bækkelund glæder sig til at møde dig
”Hos os i Sagsadministration kan du se frem til en afvekslende hverdag i selskab af gode kolleger. Vi er to enheder, der samarbejder om opgaverne. Vi kender alle de fleste opgaver i kontoret og kan byde ind og hjælpe hinanden. Og her er en kultur, hvor kollegerne rigtig gerne vil hjælpe – også når der er travlt – det er bare om at spørge. Jeg synes, at vi har det godt sammen, og jeg sætter selv pris på, at vi kan grine sammen og også have det sjovt på arbejdet”, fortæller Mikkel Bækkelund.

Vidste du…
… at Skatteankestyrelsen er en af landets største juridiske arbejdspladser, der dækker hele spektret af kompleksitet i skatteretten – lige fra ejendomsvurdering til transfer pricing og beskatning af lønmodtagere.

… at Skatteankestyrelsen er en uafhængig klagemyndighed. Det betyder, at når en borger eller virksomhed har fået en afgørelse fra fx Skattestyrelsen, som de ikke er enige i, så kan de klage til os. Det kan handle om, hvilken skat eller moms de skal betale. Vores vigtigste opgave er at hjælpe borgere og virksomheder med at få den korrekte afgørelse i deres sag inden for en rimelig sagsbehandlingstid. Hver dag går vi på arbejde for at sikre retssikkerhed, og det, synes vi, giver vores arbejde mening.

Kontakt og ansættelsesvilkår
Upload din ansøgning, dit CV og eksamensbevis via linket ”Søg stillingen” senest den 23. september 2026.

Har du spørgsmål til stillingen, er du meget velkommen til at kontakte funktionsleder Gitte Jørgensen på telefonnummer 3376 2673. Ønsker du at høre mere om opgaverne fra en eventuelt kommende kollega, er du velkommen til at kontakte Mathias Laage Hansen på telefonnummer 3376 0706.

Vi læser ansøgninger løbende og holder 1. samtaler i uge 40 og 2. samtaler den 7. oktober. Vi bruger personprofil som dialogværktøj på 2. samtaler.

Der vil forud for ansættelsen blive indhentet referencer og straffeattest.

Du bliver ansat på overenskomstvilkår i henhold til enhver tid gældende overenskomst for kontorfunktionærer, laboranter og It-medarbejdere (HK) eller overenskomst for fuldmægtige m.fl. (DTS) i Skatte- og Vækstministeriet.

Startdato og arbejdssted
Startdato er 1. december 2026.

Ansættelsesområdet er Skatte- og Vækstministeriet med tilhørende institutioner. Skatteankestyrelsen ligger centralt i Odense få minutters gang fra stationen. Dit arbejdssted er i et helt nyt kontorknudepunkt på adressen Lerchesgade 35, 5000 Odense C.

title: Food Quality Control
description:
Who we are: IRCA Group, an Advent portfolio company, was founded in Italy in 1919, and it is a leading international B2B provider of high-quality semi-finished ingredients such as chocolate, decorations, creams, inclusions, nuts and pistachios, pastry mixes, gelato ingredients, and other essential solutions for industrial clients or other independent artisanal producers.With more than 2.400 employees, 20 production facilities worldwide, and €1 billion in revenues, IRCA Group has a solid track record of growth and international expansion.
What do we offer:
  • An international and inclusive environment, with opportunities to work on global projects and collaborate with colleagues worldwide
  • Career growth opportunities, including possibilities abroad

The role: We are looking for a motivated and detail-oriented Quality Control Specialist / Quality Technician to join our team in the Laboratory on our production site in Gallarate (VA). This role focuses on inspecting, testing, and evaluating products or raw materials to ensure they meet quality standards. The successful candidate will contribute to maintaining compliance with company and regulatory requirements while gaining valuable hands-on experience in a dynamic environment.

Description of Main Activities/Responsibilities:

  • Chemical and physical analyses of raw materials, semi-finished, and finished products
  • Microbiological analyses of raw materials, semi-finished, and finished products
  • Sensory analysis of raw materials, semi-finished, and finished products
  • Calibration of instruments
  • Issuance of certificates of analysis
  • Shelf-life analysis of finished products
  • Support activities for quality assurance (environmental swabbing, description of analytical methods, documentation of laboratory equipment usage)

Requirements:

  • Education: Degree in Food Science & Technologies.
  • Professional Skills: Analytical skills with a strong ability to interpret and analyze results.
  • Experience: 1+ years of experience in the role in food companies.
  • Language Skills: Italian & English language knowledge is mandatory.
  • Computer Skills: Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite.
  • Behavioral Requirements: teamwork, ability to adapt in a dynamic company, precision and attention to details, Strong interest and passion for quality and the food industry.

Details:

  • Location: Gallarate (VA)
  • Working hours: Full time, 40h/week, from Monday to Friday, with weekend availability required on a rotational basis within the team to ensure laboratory coverage, as production operates 7/7.
  • Contract: CCNL Alimentare Industria
  • Level: Impiegatizio
  • Meal vouchers: €8 for each day spent in the office
  • Remuneration: Starting from RAL 30.000 €

IRCA fosters a dynamic environment, valuing different perspectives and international experiences, offering a stimulating context. We promote professional growth and career opportunities locally and internationally. With locations worldwide, we offer the chance to work on international projects, collaborate across cultures, and gain a global perspective. If you are looking for stimulating challenges and the chance to contribute your ideas for process improvement in an ever-growing company, IRCA is the right place.

We welcome applications from candidates of all genders, backgrounds, identities, nationality, ethnic origin, sexual orientation, marital status, disability, parental responsibilities, age, religion, or belief. We believe in equal opportunities for all and ensure that our hiring process complies with the highest standards of non-discrimination and inclusivity. IRCA Group is dedicated to fostering a diverse and inclusive work environment where everyone can be their authentic selves, reach their full potential, and feel a true sense of belonging. Join us in creating a workplace where diversity is valued, and everyone can thrive.

title: Metro Congregational Organizing Fellow
description:
Metro Congregational Organizing Fellow

ISAIAH

Exempt (from overtime), full-time, 6-month temporary position

Pay is based on a $55,000 annual salary

2 available Metro Organizing Fellow positions to be filled

POSITION AT A GLANCE

  • The Metro Organizing Fellow relates to and organizes a wide range of people to develop leadership and shared power across race, class, and wards.
  • The Congregational Base works in pursuit of a just economy and a democracy that honors the dignity and worth of people across race, faith, and class.
  • Our ideal candidates can explain why they are interested in the needs of people and communities and have demonstrated “grit” when faced with challenging work or a lack of initial success.
  • This position reports to a lead organizer and regularly works with a team of other organizers. The ideal starting date for this position is early fall.
  • This position involves meeting with people when they are available. Organizing fellows will often have meetings and events on evenings and weekends.


WHY THIS POSITION IS IMPORTANT:

Organizing Fellows will work with ISAIAH staff organizers to build and lead an organizing program to develop the capacity and leadership of everyday Minnesotans and develop a series of racial, economic, and climate justice campaigns with community and ISAIAH leaders.

The Metro Organizing Fellow will lead people in faith communities and other communities in Metro to develop leadership and build power to create an economy and a democracy that honors the dignity of all people.

The Metro Organizing Fellow will:

  • Engage staff and leaders to build powerful relationships based on trust and a well-defined understanding of each other’s desires and interests.
  • Work with staff and leaders to implement an organizing program that engages leaders from 15-20 churches.
  • Lead public actions and meetings with elected leaders to build a politics rooted in dignity and affordability for everyone.
  • Recruit and train volunteer leaders to do in-person and virtual meetings with friends, family, and members of their community.

To accomplish these objectives, The Metro Congregational Base Organizing Fellow will organize and expand the network of churches and church teams through canvassing, one on ones, community meetings, house meetings, congregational forums, and other leadership development tactics.

Over 6 months, organizing fellows receive paid holidays, sick time, a floating paid holiday, and a cell phone reimbursement. A driver’s license and car is required for this position. Organizing fellows will often have meetings and events on evenings and weekends.

About ISAIAH and Faith in Minnesota

ISAIAH, a 501(c)3 nonprofit, is a vehicle for multi-racial, multi-faith coalitions across Minnesota to act collectively and powerfully towards racial and economic equity in MN by addressing both local and regional community issues. Faith in Minnesota is our 501(c)4 organization that gives us a platform to organize and advocate directly in our state’s elections and political process.

Together, we have more than 250 member and partner churches and mosques, more than 25 barbershops, and more than 200 childcare centers who work to promote a caring economy and a multi-racial democracy that honors every person’s dignity. We do this work through intentional, intensive leadership development, collective action, and deep partnerships with grassroots organizations and public servants.

HOW WILL YOU KNOW IF YOU’RE A GOOD CANDIDATE?

You can be great for this role if you are someone who is:

  • Able to act with integrity, has a strong work ethic, “grit”, and willingness to persevere until you succeed.
  • A self-starter who can independently set goals and use them to guide daily actions.
  • A good listener and capable of establishing rapport with people from different backgrounds.
  • A quick learner eager to develop their leadership and help others do the same.
  • Open to evaluation and direction from their supervisor and peers.
  • Unafraid of being pushed and challenged by their peers and supervisor in order to more deeply reflect on and address personal barriers to leadership development.
  • Can navigate different cultural settings to relate to people across race, class, age, and religion.


HOW WE KNOW IF YOU’RE A GOOD CANDIDATE?

We are looking for candidates who:

  • Can articulate how working for social justice and grassroots organizing is connected to their personal motivation or self-interest rather than a desire to “serve” or “save” others.
  • Have demonstrated independent decision-making, management of multiple priorities in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment, and sound judgment on when to seek advice and support from team members.
  • Can share examples of achieving success when straightforward solutions aren’t available through problem-solving and applying flexible thinking.
  • Can speak to their ability to effectively work with diverse faith communities, racial groups, and diverse stakeholders.
  • Have a self-interest in the needs of people and communities.
  • Is comfortable using a range of technology, such as Google Workspace or Microsoft Office, WhatsApp, and other common software and apps.
  • Have a valid driver’s license and regular access to a reliable car.

HOW TO APPLY

  • Please submit your resume and cover letter to our online application.
    • You may combine your resume and cover letter into one PDF to be uploaded, or email a cover letter to office@isaiahmn.org after applying.
  • This position will remain open until filled. Applications are reviewed as they’re received. Our ideal hire date is early fall, 2026.


Our Statement Regarding Being an Equal Opportunity Employer

ISAIAH believes that a team with diverse experiences and backgrounds, working in an inclusive and safe work environment, generates richer discussions and more nuanced thinking. We are an equal-opportunity employer and actively encourage people whose identities and backgrounds reflect the rich diversity of our community and who are traditionally underrepresented in nonprofits to apply to our positions.

title: Project Assistant – Work Order Billing
description:
Project Assistant – Work Order Billing

Electra Link, Inc. | Houston/Spring, TX | Full-Time | Benefits Eligible

Build Your Career with Electra Link

Founded in 1985, Electra Link, Inc. is an established Texas technology contractor specializing in structured cabling, audio visual, security, and technology solutions.

We are seeking a highly organized and detail-oriented Project Assistant – Work Order Billing to support our Operations and Service teams. This position plays an important role in ensuring work orders are properly documented, accurately invoiced, tracked, and followed through to completion.

The ideal candidate has experience in billing, invoicing, accounts receivable, work orders, service coordination, or project administration and enjoys working in a fast-paced environment where accuracy, organization, and follow-through matter.

What You'll Do

  • Open, maintain, track, invoice, and assist with closing work orders and service tickets.
  • Review work orders for completeness and accuracy before billing.
  • Prepare and process invoices for completed work orders and service activity.
  • Process Time & Material (T&M) billing.
  • Verify labor, materials, purchase orders, and supporting documentation before invoicing.
  • Follow up with Project Managers, Service Managers, technicians, and other team members to obtain missing information needed for billing.
  • Monitor open and aging work orders and proactively follow up on outstanding items.
  • Maintain accurate work-order tracking spreadsheets and billing records.
  • Identify and help resolve issues that could delay invoicing or work-order closeout.
  • Coordinate with Accounting and Accounts Receivable regarding invoice questions, discrepancies, and supporting documentation.
  • Assist with customer-required billing documents and payment-release documentation.
  • Prepare reports and spreadsheets related to open work orders, aging, billing status, and outstanding items.
  • Maintain organized and auditable electronic work-order and invoice records.
  • Provide work-order billing support to other Electra Link offices as needed.

What We're Looking For

  • High school diploma or equivalent required.
  • Previous experience in billing, invoicing, accounts receivable, project administration, service coordination, or administrative support preferred.
  • Experience working with work orders, service tickets, or project billing preferred.
  • Construction, low-voltage, electrical, technology, or service-contractor experience is a plus.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Excel, Outlook, and other Microsoft Office applications.
  • Strong attention to detail and numerical accuracy.
  • Excellent organization, time-management, and follow-up skills.
  • Ability to manage multiple work orders, deadlines, and competing priorities.
  • Ability to identify missing or inconsistent information and resolve issues before billing.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.
  • Comfortable communicating and following up with Project Managers, field personnel, Accounting, and other departments.
  • Dependable, professional, and able to work independently while contributing to a team.

What Success Looks Like

A successful Project Assistant keeps work orders moving efficiently from completed work to complete documentation, accurate billing, and final closeout.

You will proactively identify missing information, follow up on outstanding items, keep aging work orders from falling through the cracks, and help ensure completed work is invoiced accurately and on time.

Benefits

Electra Link offers a competitive benefits package to eligible full-time employees, including:

  • Medical, dental, and vision insurance
  • 401(k) retirement plan with company contribution
  • Employee Stock Ownership Plan (ESOP)
  • Paid time off (PTO)
  • Paid company holidays
  • Company-sponsored training and professional development opportunities
  • Career growth and advancement opportunities
  • Additional company-sponsored employee benefits and programs

Why Electra Link?

For more than 40 years, Electra Link has built its reputation by delivering quality technology solutions and developing strong relationships with our customers and employees.

As an employee-owned company, our employees have an opportunity to contribute to and share in Electra Link's long-term success. We value accountability, teamwork, quality, professional growth, and employees who take pride in getting the job done right.

Apply Today

If you are organized, detail-oriented, comfortable working with numbers, and enjoy keeping projects and billing moving forward, we encourage you to apply and grow your career with Electra Link.

Electra Link, Inc. is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

title: Tømrer til døre, vinduer og renovering i Lillerød
description:
Er du tømrer og vil du have ordentlig løn og lokalt renoveringsarbejde?

Vi mangler en erfaren tømrer til opgaver i Lillerød og omegn.

Du lander i et lille tømrer- og snedkerhold, hvor hverdagen ikke kun handler om én type opgave. Arbejdet ligger især i boligprojekter, og opgaverne spænder fra renovering til døre, vinduer, køkkener, gulve, terrasser og tag. Pladserne ligger i Lillerød og resten af området, så jobbet passer godt til dig der gerne vil blive tæt på hjemmebanen.

Rollen passer til en erfaren tømrer, der kan tage ansvar uden at skulle have alt forklaret fra bunden. Du får en hverdag hvor finish, aftaler og praktisk sans betyder noget, og hvor kunden kan mærke at der er styr på håndværket. Det er arbejde for dig der hellere vil aflevere noget ordentligt end skynde dig videre til næste halvfærdige opgave.

Det får du

Løn: 230-250 kr. i timen

Arbejdsområde: Lillerød og omegn

Overenskomst: Ansat under gældende overenskomst

Ansættelse: Fastansættelse - vi søger folk, vi kan arbejde med i mange år. Ingen korte forløb.

Hverdag: Renovering, døre, vinduer og køkken

Din hverdag

En opgave starter med at løsningen, målene og rækkefølgen er aftalt, så du kan arbejde dig roligt igennem den. Du tager fat på de praktiske trin: opmåling, tilpasning, montering og finish. Når opgaven skifter fra vinduer til køkken eller terrasse, er det stadig det samme der tæller: tingene skal passe, holde og se ordentlige ud.

Du kommer blandt andet til at arbejde med:

  • Renoverer huse og rum efter aftalt plan

  • Udskifter døre og vinduer med opmåling, montering og finish

  • Monterer køkkener og får de sidste detaljer til at sidde

  • Bygger træterrasser, carporte, hegn og skure

  • Lægger nye gulve og løser snedkeropgaver

Aftalerne med kunderne skal holde, og du siger til hvis noget ikke stemmer. Det giver en hverdag hvor du kan bruge din erfaring rigtigt, i stedet for at rydde op efter dårlig planlægning.

Vi leder efter dig, der kan sætte kryds ved det meste

Du skal ikke være ekspert i hvert eneste hjørne af faget. Men du skal kunne stå inde for det du afleverer.

Vi forestiller os, at du:

  • Har mindst 7 års erfaring som tømrer

  • Har kørekort

  • Kan stå inde for det du afleverer

  • Er stabil og møder som aftalt

  • Taler ordentligt med kunderne

Det er en fordel, hvis du har arbejdet med renovering, døre, vinduer, køkkener eller terrasser. Men det vigtigste er, at du kan tage ansvar og lave arbejde der holder.

Allerede i job?

Så skal det selvfølgelig give mening at skifte.

Derfor starter vi med en uforpligtende snak. Du kan høre mere om opgaverne, virksomheden, lønnen og hverdagen, før du beslutter noget. Og ja, det foregår diskret.

Hvis det her lyder som noget for dig, kan du starte om Hurtigst muligt.

Du behøver ikke sende en lang ansøgning. Tryk på Ansøg job, så ringer vi dig op og tager den derfra.

Om PowerMatch

Hos PowerMatch matcher vi dig kun med job, der lever op til dine krav på løn, opgaver, kultur, firmabil og hvad der ellers betyder noget for dig.

Du starter direkte ude i virksomheden. Vi arbejder kun med forløb, hvor målet er fastansættelse. Ikke korte vikariater.

Hvis jobbet ikke viser sig at være det rigtige match, hjælper vi dig videre til noget, der passer bedre.

PowerMatch har 5 stjerner på Trustpilot baseret på 500+ anmeldelser fra håndværkere og fagfolk som dig.

Du optjener point hos PowerMatch, som du kan bruge på 1000+ forskellige gavekort som f.eks Circle K, Elgiganten og oplevelser.

Du får gratis Wolt+, WashWorld og Tv2Play abonnementer.

Du får ét ugentlig spin på vores app, hvor du kan vinde alt fra rejser til elektronik.

Søg uden lang ansøgning

Du behøver ikke skrive en roman.

Tryk Ansøg job, så ringer vi dig op til en kort og uforpligtende snak.

Passer jobbet til dig, går vi videre. Passer det ikke, prøver vi at finde et bedre match.

Lyder det som noget for dig? Det tager to minutter.

title: KONTAKTPERSON – HOLSTEBRO
description:
Har du lyst til et lille job, hvor du kan gøre en stor forskel for en mand med kombineret syns- og høretab ved at støtte ham i at deltage i hverdagsaktiviteter nogle timer om ugen? Så kunne dette job måske være noget for dig.

CFD Rådgivning søger på vegne af Holstebro Kommune en kontaktperson til en mand i 50'erne, som har et kombineret syns- og høretab. Kommunikationen med ham foregår ved direkte og tydelig tale. Han bor i hus sammen med sin hustru i en mindre by lidt udenfor Holstebro.

Arbejdstiden er ca. fire til syv timer om ugen, så det er vigtigt, at du er fleksibel i forhold til dette. Hvilke dage, du skal arbejde, kan også skifte fra uge til uge, ligesom der kan forekomme aften- og weekendarbejde. I aftaler arbejdstiden løbende mellem jer.

Opgaver

Din overordnede opgave som kontaktperson er at fungere som øjne og ører for manden i situationer, hvor har behov for det. Det indebærer blandt andet at ledsage, beskrive omgivelserne hvor I færdes (synsbeskrive) og støtte i forbindelse med kommunikation. Hvis du ikke kender til ledsagelse eller synsbeskrivelse i forvejen, skal vi nok lære dig det.

Opgaverne vil foregå både i og udenfor mandens hjem og består blandt andet af

  • oplæsning af avis m.m.
  • håndtering af post
  • informationssøgning på nettet

samt ledsagelse i forbindelse med

  • indkøb
  • besøg hos frisør, læge og tandlæge
  • tandemcykling
  • koncerter, museumsbesøg og kræmmermarkeder
  • foredrag
  • sociale sammenkomster.

Inden du begynder arbejdet som kontaktperson, skal du gennemgå et e-læringsforløb (samlet cirka 2,5 timers varighed), som giver en god introduktion til arbejdet. Denne undervisning foregår hjemme ved din egen computer, og du får løn for den.

Udover det ugentlige timetal er der afsat timer til undervisning og supervision ved CFD’s døvblindekonsulenter. Her kan du også møde andre kontaktpersoner. Du får også løn ved deltagelse i undervisning og supervision.

Vi forventer, at du

  • er god til at formidle og synsbeskrive – eller er villig til at lære det
  • har gode kommunikationsevner
  • har humoristisk sans
  • har tålmodighed og en god situationsfornemmelse
  • er mødestabil og fleksibel
  • taler klart og tydeligt dansk.

Mere information og ansøgning

Du kan læse mere om døvblindhed og kontaktpersonordningen her. Og du kan se, hvad andre kontaktpersoner fortæller om deres arbejde i disse korte videoer.

Du vil blive ansat af Holstebro kommune, og bliver som udgangspunkt indplaceret på løntrin 11.

Hvis du har spørgsmål til jobbet, kan du kontakte døvblindekonsulent Susanne Kirk på sukt@cfd.dk.

Send din ansøgning til sukt@cfd.dk hurtigst muligt og senest den 18. september 2026.

Vi forventer at holde ansættelsessamtaler den 23. september 2026. Hvis du ikke har hørt fra os senest den 2. oktober 2026, er stillingen besat til anden side.

OBS: Vi har løbende brug for kontaktpersoner. Skriv gerne i din ansøgning, om vi må gemme dine oplysninger, hvis du ikke får denne stilling. Så kan vi kontakte dig, hvis vi får en ledig stilling i området på et senere tidspunkt. Din ansøgning gemmes i to år, og du kan til enhver tid bede os om at slette den.

title: Fonden Opholdsstedet Moesgaard, afdeling Fredhøj, søger pædagogisk personale til en fast stilling på 37 timer:
description:
Vi søger dig, som står stærkt i dig selv og som synes, at pædagogisk arbejde med neurodivergente, er det som skaber mening i dit arbejdsliv.

Hvem er vi?

Vi er et opholdssted bestående af to afdelinger. Vi ligger i naturskønne omgivelser og nyder vores muligheder for frugtplantage, dyrehold og andre projekter. I vores beskæftigelse- og aktivitetstilbud inddrager vi både eksisterende faciliteter og ser nye muligheder. Det betyder også, at hvis en af stedets beboere eller en ansat får en god ide, så griber vi den gerne.

Målgruppen på stedet er voksne domsanbragte med psykisk udviklingshæmning, som primær udfordring. Derudover kan der være tale om misbrug og andre psykosociale udfordringer.

Det betyder, at der er indskrænkelser i deres frihed og at den pædagogiske indsats kræver en særlig tilgang.


Hvordan er rammerne?
Din nærmeste leder bliver afdelingslederen på stedet. Du vil blive en del af kollegagruppe med en uformel tone og god humor. Der er højt til loftet og med mulighed for at præge vores hverdag. De fleste ansatte er pædagogisk uddannet og med efteruddannelse indenfor neuropædagogik.

Du vil indgå i en rulleplan og vagterne er kombineret dag- og døgnvagter i løbet af ugens syv dage. En typisk uge består af 2-4 vagter.

Hvilke kompetencer søger vi?

Det er afgørende, at du ligesom os tror på, at alle mennesker har værdi og potentiale. Vi møder hinanden ligeværdigt og autentisk. Dine menneskelige værdier er derfor vigtige for os. Vi ønsker derudover, at du kan indfri nogle af nedenstående kriterier:

  • Du er pædagog, ergoterapeut eller har anden relevant faglig baggrund
  • Du har lyst til at efteruddanne dig og løbende tilegne dig nye faglige metoder
  • Du ved, at den pædagogiske indsats leveres gennem en god relation og kontakt, men at fagligheden dokumenteres på skrift
  • Du står stærkt i dig selv, med en indre følelse af stabilitet og balance
  • Du er nærværende, empatisk og etisk funderet
  • Du er positiv og bidrager til et sundt arbejdsmiljø
  • Vi tilbyder efteruddannelse

Hvis du har spørgsmål til stillingen, er du velkommen til at kontakte mig på telefon 23429102

Opsummerende:

  • Der er tale om 1 stilling svarende til 37 timer i ugen. Du indgår i en vagtplan og arbejder både weekender og i døgn.
  • Ansættelsestidspunkt 1. november 2026 eller snarest mulig herefter
  • Ansøgning frist 21.09.26 kl. 12.00. Samtaler forventes at blive afholdt i uge 39.
  • Ansøgning, CV og relevante uddannelsesbeviser sendes til mhs@opholdsstedetmoesgaard.dk
  • Stillingen kræver at du har kørekort kategori B
  • Du skal fremvise straffeattest

Med venlig hilsen

Michael H. Serup

title: Director, AI Engineering
location: Princeton, New Jersey, United States; San Diego, California, United States; South San Francisco, California, United States
description:
About Acadia Pharmaceuticals
Acadia is committed to turning scientific promise into meaningful innovation that makes the difference for underserved neurological and rare disease communities around the world. Our commercial portfolio includes the first and only FDA-approved treatments for Parkinson’s disease psychosis and Rett syndrome. We are developing the next wave of therapeutic advancements with a robust and diverse pipeline that includes mid- to late-stage programs in Alzheimer’s disease psychosis and Lewy body dementia psychosis, along with earlier-stage programs that address other underserved patient needs. At Acadia, we’re here to be their difference.

This hybrid position requires onsite attendance three days per week at one of our office locations in San Diego, CA, South San Francisco, CA, or Princeton, NJ

Position Summary

The Director, AI Engineering is a strategic technology leader responsible for shaping and advancing the enterprise AI application and agent ecosystem. This role owns the AI platform and agent framework layer that enables scalable, secure, and impactful AI-powered solutions across the organization.
The successful candidate will drive the development of enterprise-grade capabilities including reusable agent templates, multi-agent orchestration, an internal agent publishing platform, self-service RAG solutions, tool and skill registries, prompt management, and evaluation and output validation frameworks. This leader will balance deep technical expertise with a passion for creating intuitive, low-code experiences that empower business users to independently build and deploy AI solutions.
Partnering closely with IT, Cybersecurity, Enterprise Architecture, and business stakeholders, the Director will ensure the AI platform remains secure, governed, scalable, and aligned with organizational objectives while delivering measurable business value and accelerating AI adoption across the enterprise.

Primary Responsibilities

  • Architect and maintain the enterprise agent platform - the system through which agents are developed, published, versioned, and coordinated, using frameworks such as LangGraph, CrewAI, Anthropic Agents SDK, and OpenAI Agents SDK.
  • Engineer multi-agent coordination patterns enabling agents with distinct roles, data access, and functional scope to collaborate reliably on complex, multi-step business workflows.
  • Design and implement reusable agent templates, composable orchestration primitives, and agentic memory systems (short-term, long-term, episodic) that development teams and non-engineers can configure and deploy.
  • Build human-in-the-loop (HITL) escalation workflows and clearly defined agent action boundaries to ensure appropriate human oversight at high-risk decision points.
  • Lead the design and delivery of a self-service RAG builder, including ingestion pipelines, chunking, embedding, vector store integration, hybrid retrieval, and reranking surfaced through a low-code interface accessible to non-technical users.
  • Build and operate an enterprise tool and skill registry: a versioned catalog of APIs, functions, MCP servers, and data connectors that agents can securely discover and invoke, with schema contracts, authentication, and access controls.
  • Establish and manage the enterprise prompt management system with versioning, governance workflows, A/B testing, rollback capabilities, and domain-specific prompt libraries for commercial, medical, and R&D functions.
  • Own the evaluation and benchmarking methodology for agentic systems. Design rigorous, quantitative eval suites covering accuracy, faithfulness, groundedness, task completion, latency, cost, and safety. Implement automated regression detection in production.
  • Design and implement multi-layer guardrail frameworks including input/output validation, content moderation, hallucination detection, policy enforcement, and agent permission scoping aligned with AI governance policy and regulatory requirements.
  • Apply product thinking and user-centered design to platform tooling; track adoption metrics, gather user feedback, and iterate to reduce friction for non-engineer stakeholders across Commercial, Medical Affairs, R&D, and Corporate Functions.
  • Contribute to the enterprise AI strategy and portfolio roadmap; participate actively in the AI Governance Council providing expertise on agentic risk, safety, and platform governance.
  • Ensure all engineered solutions comply with global AI regulations, ethical AI standards, data privacy requirements (HIPAA, GDPR), applicable GxP processes, and enterprise security standards.
  • Mentor engineers and foster a culture of rigorous evaluation, responsible experimentation, and continuous improvement across the AI team.
  • Other responsibilities as assigned.

Education/Experience/Skills

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Machine Learning, Artificial Intelligence, or a related technical discipline required; advanced degree preferred
  • 8+ years of experience in AI/ML, software engineering, or a related field, including 4+ years of current, hands-on experience building production-grade agentic AI systems and LLM-powered applications
  • Experience delivering self-service or platform tooling adopted by non-technical users
  • Expert-level proficiency with at least two major agent frameworks such as LangGraph, CrewAI, Anthropic Agents SDK, or OpenAI Agents SDK, including framework customization and development
  • Expert-level experience designing and implementing RAG solutions, including chunking strategies, embedding selection, vector databases, hybrid retrieval, and reranking methodologies
  • Hands-on experience developing enterprise AI capabilities including evaluation frameworks, guardrails, agent memory systems, human-in-the-loop workflows, tool registries, skill registries, and prompt management platforms
  • Experience building or integrating Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers and exposing enterprise capabilities to AI agents
  • Proficiency in Python and machine learning frameworks such as PyTorch, scikit-learn, and Hugging Face Transformers, with a strong understanding of LLM architectures and traditional machine learning techniques
  • Experience leveraging AI-assisted development tools to accelerate software delivery, automate code generation, and improve engineering productivity
  • Experience working within regulated environments and AI governance frameworks, including GxP, NIST AI RMF, EU AI Act, or similar compliance standards
  • Biopharmaceutical industry experience, including familiarity with commercial, medical, research, clinical, or market access functions and relevant healthcare data sources
  • Willingness and ability to travel domestically and internationally as needed
  • An equivalent combination of education and relevant experience may be considered
  • Other duties as assigned

Physical Requirements

This role involves regular standing, walking, sitting, and the use of hands for handling or operating equipment. The employee may also need to reach, climb, balance, stoop, kneel, crouch, and maintain visual, verbal, and auditory communication in a standard office environment and while working independently from remote locations. The employee must occasionally lift and/or move up to 20 pounds. This position requires the ability to travel independently overnight and/or work after hours as required by travel schedules or business needs.

  • Must be able to lift up to 60 pounds independently; majority of lifting from knee to shoulder heights; other lifting required from various levels.
  • Must be able to carry and transport up to 60 pounds up to 20 feet.
  • Requires standing for an extended period of time with frequent stretching, reaching, walking and stooping, pushing and/or pulling in an environment that may be cold, hot, noisy, and wet and may have fumes or odors due to vehicle maintenance.
  • Requires working outdoors in all weather conditions.
  • Requires excellent visual acuity and manual dexterity.
  • Requires use of safety equipment that may include but not limited to face shield or goggles, non-slip shoes, gloves, mask, and other protective garments and equipment.
  • Requires frequent driving and some typing.
  • Must adhere to regular and predictable attendance.

About Carvana

At Carvana, we sell cars but we aren’t car salesmen. Our promise is simple: we won’t sell a car to a customer that we wouldn’t sell to our own Mom. Period.

Being a brand ambassador of Carvana means having a passion for our vision and having a motor that never quits when it comes to representing our brand and values. Our Market Operations team members work as a team to deliver awesome customer experiences in their markets, while also remaining agile enough to keep up with the ever-changing beat and cadence of your daily activities.

Think you’ve got what it takes to join our team? Apply today!

Carvana is an equal employment opportunity employer. All applicants receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, marital status, national origin, age, mental or physical disability, protected veteran status, or genetic information, or any other basis protected by applicable law. Carvana also prohibits harassment of applicants or employees based on any of these protected categories.

Hiring is contingent on passing a complete background check. This role is not eligible for visa sponsorship. Must be at least 18 years of age and possess a valid driver’s license. Must be able to read, write, speak and understand English.

title: Lejre Kommune søger en engageret virksomhedskonsulent. Er det dig?
description:
Virksomhedskonsulent til Lejre KommuneSkab veje til lønnede timer

Brænder du for at skabe konkrete jobmuligheder for borgere, der har brug for en håndholdt indsats? Er du stærk i den opsøgende kontakt til virksomheder, og kan du omsætte borgernes ressourcer til opgaver, der giver værdi på en arbejdsplads?

Lejre Kommune styrker virksomhedsservicen og søger en virksomhedskonsulent, der kan bygge bro mellem lokale virksomheder og borgere på kanten af arbejdsmarkedet. Dit vigtigste mål bliver at hjælpe borgerne tættere på beskæftigelse – gerne gennem ordinære løntimer.

Om jobbet

Du bliver en del af Team Indsats- og Virksomhedsservice og kommer til at arbejde med blandt andre jobparate og aktivitetsparate ledige, sygedagpengemodtagere samt borgere i jobafklarings- og ressourceforløb.

Stillingen kombinerer opsøgende virksomhedskontakt, tæt borgerkontakt, koordinering og skriftlig dokumentation. Du får en stor kontaktflade og gode muligheder for at tilrettelægge din arbejdsdag selvstændigt.

En central del af dit arbejde bliver at finde det gode match mellem borger og virksomhed. Det kræver, at du kan få øje på borgerens ressourcer, forstå virksomhedens behov og være nysgerrig på, hvordan arbejdsopgaver kan tilpasses eller sammensættes. Du skal kunne følge samarbejdet tæt og arbejde målrettet på, at praktik og andre virksomhedsrettede forløb udvikler sig til ordinære løntimer, når det er muligt.

Har du hertil evnerne til at facilitere gruppeforløb vil det være et stort plus.

Dine vigtigste opgaver

Du skal blandt andet:

  • Opsøge virksomheder og opbygge langvarige, tillidsfulde relationer til virksomhedsledere

  • Afdække virksomhedernes behov og finde arbejdsopgaver, som kan skabe muligheder for borgerne

  • Matche borgere og virksomheder med fokus på progression og ordinære løntimer

  • Etablere og følge tæt op på virksomhedspraktikker, løntilskud og andre virksomhedsrettede forløb

  • Understøtte virksomhederne i at inkludere og fastholde borgere, som har brug for særlige hensyn

  • Motivere borgerne og hjælpe dem med at få øje på egne kompetencer og muligheder

  • Udarbejde præcise praktik- og arbejdsevnebeskrivelser, blandt andet til brug af afklaring af arbejdsevne

  • Samarbejde tæt med rådgivere om sammenhængende og målrettede borgerforløb

  • Bidrage aktivt til udviklingen af Lejre Kommunes virksomhedsservice og til det faglige fællesskab i teamet

  • Facilitere gruppeforløb for borgere længere væk fra arbejdsmarkedet

Om dig

Vi forestiller os, at du:

  • Er initiativrig og trives med den opsøgende kontakt til virksomheder

  • Har blik for mulighederne i den enkelte borger – også når vejen til arbejdsmarkedet er lang

  • Kan skabe stærke og respektfulde relationer til både borgere og virksomheder

  • Arbejder målrettet med progression fra virksomhedsrettede forløb til ordinære løntimer

  • Kan tale med virksomhederne om både deres behov og deres sociale ansvar

  • Er vedholdende og følger aftaler og forløb helt til dørs

  • Kan udarbejde fagligt solide arbejdsevne- og praktikbeskrivelser

  • Har kendskab til – og gerne erfaring med – de relevante målgrupper

  • Kan arbejde selvstændigt og strukturere en hverdag med stor frihed

  • Samarbejder konstruktivt på tværs af faggrupper og afdelinger

  • Har erfaring med beskæftigelseslovgivningen og gerne med kommunale fagsystemer

  • Har kørekort og egen bil med mulighed for at komme rundt til virksomhederne

Din uddannelsesmæssige baggrund er ikke afgørende. Det vigtigste er, at du har de rette kompetencer, en stærk virksomhedsforståelse og lysten til at skabe resultater sammen med borgere, virksomheder og kolleger.

Om os

Team Indsats- og Virksomhedsservice løser en bred vifte af opgaver både internt i kommunen og i samarbejde med virksomhederne i og omkring Lejre. Teamet består aktuelt af fem virksomhedskonsulenter, og én myndighedsrådgiver som arbejder med alt fra håndholdte virksomhedsplaceringer, myndighedsopgaver til rekrutteringsopgaver.

Vi har fokus på at levere en professionel og fleksibel service, som giver værdi for både borgere og virksomheder. Du bliver en del af et fagligt fællesskab, hvor vi sparrer med hinanden, deler viden og hjælper hinanden med at lykkes.

Hverdagen er præget af frihed under ansvar. Du disponerer i høj grad selv din tid og skaber den rette balance mellem møder, virksomhedsbesøg, borgerkontakt, dokumentation og udviklingsopgaver.

Løn og ansættelse

Stillingen er på 37 timer om ugen med forventet tiltrædelse den 1. november 2026 eller snarest muligt.

Du bliver ansat efter gældende HK-overenskomst og aflønnet efter kvalifikationer. Stillingen forventes aflønnet 37.000 - 41.000 kr. pr. måned (ekskl. pension). Lønnen fastsættes i henhold til overenskomstens bestemmelser med grundlønsindplacering 33. Eventuelle tillæg baseret på kvalifikationer og erfaring forhandles.

Hvis du vil vide mere om stillingen, er du velkommen til at kontakte fagkoordinator Carina Søder på 2446 9880 eller afdelingsleder Christian Scharff på 23478629.

Ansøgningsfristen er onsdag d. 23. september 2026.

Vi forventer at holde ansættelsessamtaler mandag den 28. september 2026.

Vi glæder os til at modtage din ansøgning.



Lejre Kommune er et fællesskab af 49 små byer og landsbyer. Her bor lige under 30.000 mennesker, og stadig flere kommer til. Som kommune arbejder vi for at skabe det gode liv på landet, nu og for fremtidige generationer. Det handler om at tænke naturen ind i alt, hvad vi laver. At finde løsningerne i fællesskab og fællesskaber, og at skabe frirum, hvor borgere, foreninger og virksomheder kan udfolde sig.

Vi har i alt omkring 2000 medarbejdere, som arbejder for at skabe velfærd i et nært samarbejde med alle dem, som indsatsen har betydning for.

Det er derfor, vi kalder Lejre Kommune for Vores Sted.

I Lejre Kommune er der røgfri arbejdstid.

I Lejre Kommune indhenter vi straffeattester og børneattester til en række stillinger. Vær derfor opmærksom på, at du kan blive bedt om at give tilladelse til indhentning af disse, i de stillinger hvor det er relevant.

title: Qualified Professional (QP), I/DD
description:
Covenant Case Management Services is seeking an energetic and compassionate Qualified Professional (QP) with experience in intellectual and developmental disabilities (I/DD) to support individuals in the Charlotte area. In this hybrid role, you will help ensure high-quality service delivery, build positive relationships, and advocate fiercely for the people we serve.

Key Responsibilities

Staffing, Caseload, and Team Leadership

  • Team Recruitment: Own staffing for your team and caseloads; actively recruit and fill open roles to ensure adequate coverage.

  • Caseload Management: Manage a caseload of 25–30 active cases (excluding cases held for coverage). Match staff to cases based on skills, personality, and fit while ensuring timely staffing and strict policy compliance.

  • Supervision: Oversee direct care staff to ensure they adhere to CCMS policies and best practices. Lead monthly Direct Support Professional (DSP) supervision meetings and deliver ongoing training.

Compliance, Documentation, and Care Planning

  • Regulatory Compliance: Maintain strict compliance with DHHS/state rules, Medicaid/state waivers, MCO requirements, and CCMS policies. Act as a champion for policy adoption and ethical practice.

  • Care Planning: Conduct comprehensive, person-centered assessments; set measurable goals and develop clinically accurate, medically necessary Individualized Support Plans (ISPs).

  • Quality Review: Review and approve ISP documentation, assessments, progress notes, and related records. Sign off on new or updated ISPs and coordinate with Medical Records for timely system uploads.

  • Utilization Management: Daily review note reports to monitor compliance with staff-completed service notes. Train staff on correct documentation practices, approve compliant entries, and issue required corrections. Monitor underutilized reports and take swift action to optimize service delivery.

Incident Management & Quality Assurance

  • Incident Reporting: Promptly report all incidents to Quality Management (QM) via the internal Incident Reporting (IR) process; fully support IR/IRIS entries for Level 2 and Level 3 incidents.

  • Risk Mitigation: Partner with QM to identify risks, recurring incidents, or service gaps. Participate in risk-reduction activities and assist in developing, implementing, and monitoring Plans of Correction (POC).

  • Audit Readiness: Lead and participate in internal audits and CARF-related activities. Collaborate with QM, Clinical Directors, and Medical Records to prepare documentation and regulatory responses for auditors. Ensure ongoing, regulation-ready state across all assigned programs.

  • Financial Accountability: Review data and billing for precision and compliance. Monitor authorization status monthly, completing service limit sheets for every authorization received to support utilization management.

Client Engagement & Community Collaboration

  • Consents: Secure valid consents from individuals and legally responsible persons, supporting annual client consent updates when necessary.

  • Stakeholder Relations: Build trusted relationships with MCOs, collaborating agencies, families, and CCMS leadership. Proudly represent CCMS in community activities and interagency meetings.

  • Administration: Manage ongoing administrative workflows—including authorizations, progress reports, and documentation reviews—to guarantee completely regulation-ready records.

Training & Staff Development

  • Skill Building: Train staff members thoroughly on individual client needs, ISP requirements, and programmatic benchmarks. Lead staff development initiatives to maximize policy compliance.

  • Accountability: Provide guidance and clear accountability metrics for DSP performance. Administer corrective actions in accordance with company policy and facilitate the rollout of ongoing policy updates.

Crisis & On-Call Support

  • Crisis Response: Maintain availability for on-call crisis services as required. Uphold the highest quality and ethical standards to boost overall program performance and ensure compliance with federal, state, and local laws.

SCS & Nursing Collaboration

  • SCS Coordination: Collaborate closely with the SCS Director regarding any service updates or adjustments for members assigned to Supported Career Services (SCS), or those adding SCS to their active treatment plan.

  • Medical Compliance: Partner with the Nursing team to ensure all members have accurate, documented medications on file that meet company compliance standards.

  • Medication Tracking: Assist with the collection of medication administration documentation and periodically update physician order changes alongside the Nursing team.

  • Clinical Reporting: Document and report side effects, medical changes, or hospital visits directly to the Nursing team for immediate, specialized support.

Leadership Support

  • Mentorship: Collaborate directly with Clinical Directors and executive leadership to aid in mentoring newly hired staff and incoming QPs.

  • Special Projects: Assist with special agency projects, targeted training curriculum, job shadowing, and customized one-on-one development of staff as requested.

  • Flexibility: Complete additional operational duties and responsibilities as requested by leadership.

What We Are Looking For

Qualifications & Experience

  • Credentialing: Must meet the official North Carolina definition of a Qualified Professional (QP).

  • Experience: Have at least five years of supervisory and management experience and/or five years of dedicated experience working within human services.

  • Knowledge: Possess a deep, working knowledge of the behavioral sciences and allied disciplines related to Intellectual and Developmental Disabilities (I/DD).

  • Skills: Demonstrate exceptional communication, leadership, adaptability, and complex problem-solving skills.

  • Resources: Must have reliable access to high-speed internet, a functional cell phone, and reliable transportation.

  • Physical Requirements: Ability to sit, stand, walk, and lift up to 50 pounds as required by field conditions.

Education & Licensure Pathway Requirements

Candidates must meet at least one of the following state-defined educational criteria:

  • Hold a valid license, provisional license, certificate, registration, or permit issued by a governing board regulating a human service profession; OR

  • Have a graduate degree in a human service field paired with at least one year of post-graduate experience; OR

  • Have a bachelor's degree in a human service field paired with at least two years of post-graduate experience; OR

  • Have a bachelor's degree in any non-human service field paired with at least four years of post-graduate experience.

Covenant Rewards for You | Benefits

  • Generous Total Rewards Plan – including health insurance, 401(k) match, and career benefits.

  • A diverse and inclusive community focused on professional growth, compassionate care, and a highly supportive work environment.

Equal Employment Opportunity Statement

Covenant Case Management Services actively encourages applications from individuals of all backgrounds and lived experiences. We believe diversity strengthens our ability to serve individuals and families with dignity, respect, and compassion.

Covenant Case Management Services is an Equal Employment Opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, disability, genetic information, veteran status, marital status, or any other protected characteristic under applicable federal, state, or local laws.

We are committed to providing a workplace free from discrimination and harassment and to fostering a diverse, inclusive, and respectful environment for all employees, contractors, and applicants. Employment decisions are based on qualifications, merit, and business needs.

title: Næstved Specialskole søger en pædagog 37 timer til LK-rækken
description:
Næstved Specialskole er kommunens niveau 3-tilbud på det specialiserede område. Aktuelt er der indskrevet 114 elever. Eleverne kan gå i skole, SFO og klub hos os fra 0.-9./10. klassetrin. Eleverne bliver visiteret hertil og har behov for specialiseret støtte inden for blandt andet multiple funktionsnedsættelser, autismespektrumforstyrrelser, gennemgribende indlæringsvanskeligheder, følelsesmæssige- og reguleringsvanskeligheder samt et kognitivt funktionsniveau væsentligt under gennemsnittet.

På Næstved Specialskole er vi optaget af at skabe læring, trivsel og udvikling for alle elever. Vi arbejder i trygge læringsfællesskaber, hvor det enkelte barn kan udvikle sig fagligt, socialt og personligt i samspil med andre elever og professionelle voksne.

Vi har efter sommerferien fået flere elever i vores tilbud og søger derfor en uddannet pædagog med erfaring fra eller lyst til at arbejde med børn og unge med multiple funktionsnedsættelser, omfattende udviklingsforstyrrelser og kommunikative udfordringer til vores LK-række. Stillingen er på fuld tid og fordeles mellem undervisningstid i LK-rækken og et antal timer i skolens SFO om eftermiddagen.

Om LK-rækken

LK-rækken er et specialiseret tilbud for elever med multiple funktionsnedsættelser, kognitive forstyrrelser, autismespektrumforstyrrelser, kromosomafvigelser, epilepsi og andre komplekse udviklingsmæssige udfordringer. Mange af eleverne har kommunikative vanskeligheder og har behov for tæt støtte, guidning og regulering gennem hele dagen.

Vi arbejder med tydelig struktur, forudsigelighed og visualisering for at skabe tryghed og læring for den enkelte elev. Undervisningen tilrettelægges individuelt og tager udgangspunkt i elevens ressourcer, behov og udviklingsmuligheder.

En vigtig del af arbejdet er at understøtte elevernes kommunikation gennem ASK (Alternativ og Supplerende Kommunikation) samt at støtte eleverne i sociale relationer, deltagelsesmuligheder og udvikling af dagligdags færdigheder (ADL).

Vi søger en stabil medarbejder, som kan se sig selv i nedenstående:

  • Er uddannet pædagog og gerne har erfaring fra specialområdet.
  • Arbejder fagligt, professionelt og anerkendende med børn og unge.
  • Har interesse for eller erfaring med ASK, visualisering og kommunikationsstøttende pædagogik.
  • Har forståelse for arbejdet med elever med betydelige kognitive og kommunikative udfordringer.
  • Kan understøtte elevernes udvikling af selvstændighed og dagligdags færdigheder.
  • Glædes ved at indgå i et tæt samarbejde med kollegaer og øvrige faggrupper.
  • Er god til at formulere sig mundtligt og skriftligt.
  • Har et lyst sind og blik for elevernes potentialer.
  • Kan se dig selv arbejde både i skole og SFO (primær tid i skolen).

Vi tilbyder:

  • En dejlig skole beliggende centralt i Næstved by.
  • Et godt arbejdsmiljø.
  • Erfarne og hjælpsomme kollegaer, som er klar til at hjælpe dig ind i opgaverne.
  • Mulighed for at gøre en forskel for nogle af skolens mest sårbare elever.
  • Supervision til alle medarbejdere.
  • Klasser hvor man altid er flere voksne sammen.
  • En nærværende og anerkendende ledelse, der ønsker at være tæt på.

Løn- og ansættelsesvilkår sker i henhold til gældende overenskomst indgået mellem KL og BUPL.

Oplysninger om startløn og forventet løninterval
Via linket her kan ses oplysninger om relevant løninterval for den konkrete stilling. I oversigten vælges Næstved Kommune, hvilken stillingskategori (overenskomst) du ansøger til og yderligere hvilken stilling du søger. I tabellen derunder kan ses de relevante oplysninger for den konkrete stilling.

Tiltrædelse 1. november 2026 (gerne før hvis muligt).

Arbejdstid pr. uge 37 timer.

Vil du vide mere, er du velkommen til at kontakte Leder af LK-rækken Michael Avnborg på telefon 2365 2865

Ansøgningsfrist Tirsdag den 22. september 2026.

Ansættelsessamtaler afholdes i uge 39/40

Du søger stillingen ved at sende din ansøgning, CV og anden relevant dokumentation og uddannelsesbevis elektronisk via ansøgerknappen ”Ansøg”.

title: Specjalista ds. Ochrony Środowiska (k/m/n)
description:
Aldesa Polska Services Sp. z o.o.

Jesteśmy częścią globalnej grupy budowlanej Aldesa, która od ponad 50 lat prowadzi projekty budowlane na rynku międzynarodowym. W Polsce od 2007 roku, zrealizowaliśmy ponad 60 projektów! Nasze doświadczenie obejmuje działalność w sektorach: budowlanym, energetycznym, przemysłowym, energii odnawialnej, drogowym, kolejowym (metro i tramwaje) oraz nieruchomości. Kluczem do sukcesu firmy jest znajomość lokalnych uwarunkowań, międzynarodowych standardów pracy, indywidualne podejście do klienta oraz umiejętność adaptacji do zmieniających się wymagań rynku i potrzeb klientów, trafny dobór realizowanych projektów, a także ciągłe poszukiwanie nowych, lepszych rozwiązań. Aldesa tworzy wartość dodaną na każdym projekcie i oferuje klientom bardziej wszechstronne i efektywne kosztowo rozwiązania bez zaniedbywania efektywnego zarządzania terminami.

📍 Lokalizacja : Kawice
🛠 Stanowisko : Specjalista ds. Ochrony Środowiska (k/m/n)

Twój zakres obowiązków:

  • nadzorowanie przestrzegania wymagań i przepisów dotyczących ochrony środowiska przez pracowników oraz podwykonawców,

  • prowadzenie gospodarki odpadami na projekcie, w tym obsługa BDO i kontrola miejsc magazynowania odpadów,

  • przygotowywanie raportów, zestawień i sprawozdań dotyczących działań środowiskowych,

  • opracowywanie, weryfikacja i aktualizacja dokumentacji z zakresu ochrony środowiska,

  • prowadzenie spraw związanych z decyzjami administracyjnymi oraz monitorowanie realizacji wynikających z nich obowiązków,

  • udział w audytach, przeglądach środowiskowych oraz kontrolach prowadzonych przez Zamawiającego i instytucje zewnętrzne,

  • prowadzenie szkoleń z zakresu ochrony środowiska,

  • monitorowanie zmian w przepisach prawa ochrony środowiska i ich wpływu na realizowany kontrakt,

  • bieżąca współpraca z zespołem projektowym, podwykonawcami i nadzorem przyrodniczym.

Nasze wymagania:

  • wykształcenie wyższe w zakresie ochrony środowiska lub kierunku pokrewnego,

  • minimum 3 lata doświadczenia zawodowego w obszarze ochrony środowiska,

  • bardzo dobra znajomość przepisów prawa dotyczących ochrony środowiska,

  • praktyczna znajomość BDO i gospodarki odpadami,

  • umiejętność przygotowywania dokumentacji, raportów i sprawozdań środowiskowych,

  • dobra znajomość pakietu MS Office,

  • prawo jazdy kat. B,

  • dobra organizacja pracy, samodzielność i komunikatywność.

Mile widziane:

  • doświadczenie w obszarze ochrony środowiska na projektach budowlanych/infrastrukturalnych,

  • uprawnienia audytora wewnętrznego zgodnie z wymaganiami ISO 14001.

To oferujemy:

  • Zatrudnienie na umowę o pracę, na pełen etat,

  • Rozwój zawodowy przy wsparciu doświadczonych inżynierów.

  • Stabilne zatrudnienie w międzynarodowym środowisku.

  • Pakiet świadczeń dodatkowych.

⭐Dołącz do Aldesa⭐

W Aldesa znajdziesz nie tylko pracę, a także miejsce, w którym możesz się rozwijać.
Odkryj nasze PVP – People Value Proposition, czyli ofertę wartości dla pracowników, obejmującą wszystkie doświadczenia, korzyści i możliwości, które sprawiają, że praca u nas jest wyjątkowa. 👉 dowiedz się wiecej tutaj

Aldesa została wyróżniona w prestiżowym rankingu ENR Top 250 International Contractors 2025, zajmując 126. miejsce na świecie 🌍. To osiągnięcie było możliwe dzięki talentowi, zaangażowaniu i profesjonalizmowi całego naszego zespołu.

W Grupo Aldesa promujemy inkluzywne i pełne szacunku środowisko pracy.
Zobowiązujemy się do zapewnienia wszystkim kandydatom równych szans zatrudnienia i niedyskryminowania nikogo ze względu na wiek, płeć, tożsamość płciową, orientację seksualną, religię, pochodzenie etniczne, niepełnosprawność, stan cywilny ani jakąkolwiek inną cechę chronioną prawem. Wspieramy różnorodność i cenimy wkład każdej osoby.
