title: IT-officer / forskningskonsulent i informatik til Sektion for Geogenetik ved Globe Institute
description:
Sektion for Geogenetik, Globe Institute, ved Det Sundhedsvidenskabelige Fakultet på Københavns Universitet søger en IT-officer, Staff Scientist eller forskningskonsulent med stærke kompetencer inden for databaser, data management og informatik med tiltrædelse 15. oktober 2026, eller snarest muligt herefter. Stillingen er tidsbegrænset for en periode på 3 år.



Om os
Centre for Ancient Environmental Genomics (CAEG) er et tværfagligt forskningscenter med speciale i sekventering og analyse af ancient DNA (aeDNA). Vores internationale forskningsteam indsamler prøver fra is, jord og søaflejringer og anvender avancerede sekventeringsteknologier til at udtrække og analysere ancient DNA fra disse prøver.

Gennem rekonstruktion af fortidige miljøer bidrager forskningen med vigtig indsigt i økologiske og evolutionære processer, herunder effekter af klimaændringer og menneskelig aktivitet. Teamet består af forskere med baggrunde inden for geologi, genetik, økologi, evolutionsbiologi, datalogi, statistik og beslægtede fagområder. Vi lægger vægt på god onboarding, tæt samarbejde og en stærk integration i både centeret og instituttet.



Arbejdsopgaver
Du kommer til selvstændigt at stå for design, drift, vedligeholdelse og videreudvikling af databaser og data management-løsninger til forskningsdata.

Stillingen har særligt fokus på:

  • Design og vedligeholdelse af relationelle databaser og data management-systemer.
  • Vedligeholdelse og normalisering af PostgreSQL-skemaer.
  • Modellering af komplekse aeDNA sample-processer og metadata-relationer.
  • Databaseadministration, vedligeholdelse og performanceoptimering.
  • Udvikling af SQL-forespørgsler, views, triggers og audit logging.
  • Sikring af datakvalitet, konsistens, integritet og sporbarhed.
  • Udvikling og håndhævelse af datastandarder, valideringsregler.
  • Organisering og kuratering af videnskabelige metadata.
  • Sikre data provenance og audit trails.
  • Sikring af dataadgang, sikkerhed og tilgængelighed.
  • Udvikling og vedligeholdelse af forskningsunderstøttende software.
  • Udvikling og optimering af ETL pipelines og data delivery.
  • Udarbejdelse af databasearkitektur.
  • Brugerunderstøttelse og teknisk rådgivning.
  • I begrænset omfang, drift og fejlfinding i Linux-miljøer.
  • I begrænset mængde, migrering, standardisering og rensning af legacy-datasæt.


Vi forventer
Vi søger en person, der kan arbejde struktureret, selvstændigt og med stærk sans for kvalitet og dokumentation. Det er vigtigt, at du trives i et samarbejde med forskere og andre fagligheder og kan omsætte komplekse behov til robuste tekniske løsninger.

Vi forestiller os, at du har erfaring med:

  • Design og vedligeholdelse af relationelle databaser.
  • PostgreSQL og datamodellering.
  • Håndtering af komplekse datamodeller og metadata.
  • Datakvalitet, dataintegritet og sporbarhed.
  • SQL, automation og databasedrift.
  • Udvikling af data pipelines og integrationer.
  • Arbejde i Linux-miljøer.
  • Udvikling og vedligehold af videnskabsunderstøttende software
  • Udvikling af ETL-/ELT-processer, datapipelines og integrationer.
  • Bash scripting
  • Python programmering
  • Git og GitHub
  • Brugerunderstøttelse og teknisk rådgivning.
  • Teknisk dokumentation.


Ønskede kompetencer
Det er en fordel, hvis du også har erfaring med nogle af følgende områder:

  • Moderne frontend-frameworks, fx React, Flask, Vue eller TypeScript.
  • Viden om bioinformatik vil være en fordel.
  • Viden om aeDNA sampling og lab-processer vil være en fordel.
  • Erfaring med moderne AI-assisterede værktøjer til kodning, dokumentation, dataanalyse og automatisering


Vi tilbyder
Vi tilbyder en støttende, kreativ og stimulerende arbejdsplads i et dynamisk og internationalt forskningsmiljø. Du får en central rolle i et tværfagligt team og mulighed for at arbejde tæt sammen med forskere om spændende og komplekse opgaver.



Løn og ansættelsesforhold
Ansættelsen sker som enten akademisk medarbejder eller specialkonsulent afhængigt af kandidatens baggrund, kvalifikationer og erfaring. Løn og ansættelsesvilkår følger overenskomsten mellem Finansministeriet og Akademikerne.



Eller ansættelsen sker som IT-medarbejder i henhold til Fællesoverenskomst mellem Finansministeriet og Lærernes Centralorganisation og CO10 – Centralorganisationen af 2010 (LC/CO10-fællesoverenskomsten).



Den månedlige løn fastsættes efter anciennitet. Der vil være mulighed for forhandling af tillæg efter kvalifikationer. Du kan læse mere om lønniveauer i staten på .



Arbejdstiden er i gennemsnit 37 timer om ugen.

Arbejdsstedet er Sektion for Geogenetik, Globe Institute, University of Copenhagen.



Din ansøgning
Er du interesseret i at søge stillingen, beder vi dig sende en elektronisk ansøgning med CV, relevante eksamensbeviser samt andre relevante dokumenter via Jobportalen så vi har den senest d. 15. september 2026 (tryk på linket ”SØG STILLINGEN” nederst i opslaget.





Universitetet ønsker at afspejle det omgivende samfund og opfordrer alle uanset personlig baggrund til at søge stillingen



Yderligere spørgsmål
Spørgsmål til stillingen kan rettes til lektor Thorfinn Sand Korneliussen, email tskorneliussen@sund.ku.dk.

title: Facility Engineering Technician III
description:
LightEdge Solutions is developing the IT solutions that will propel businesses forward over the next 10 years. Using a combination of shared and private/dedicated platforms, LightEdge has been successful in offering businesses alternatives that streamline operations, improve reliability and reduce costs.
If you are passionate about creating real solutions that help businesses with cutting-edge technology, want to be challenged to think out of the box and be in a position where you can impact change on a daily basis, then LightEdge can offer you a dynamic corporate environment built on teamwork and personal responsibility.

The Facility Engineering Technician III is a senior, hands-on critical-facilities individual contributor and technical subject-matter expert for one or more electrical, mechanical, controls, or life-safety systems. This role independently operates, troubleshoots, and coordinates maintenance of 24x7 data-center infrastructure across one or more LightEdge sites.

The Technician III leads response to complex incidents, performs root-cause analysis, owns assigned systems and operating procedures, supports capacity and reliability planning, and drives improvements in safety, availability, efficiency, and documentation. This position does not necessarily have direct reports but provides technical direction, mentors lower-tier technicians, and may serve as a shift technical lead, incident lead, or system owner.

Critical Facilities Systems Scope:

Electrical infrastructure: Utility service; medium- and low-voltage distribution; switchgear and switchboards; transformers; automatic transfer switches; standby generators and fuel systems; UPS systems, batteries, and energy-storage systems; PDUs; RPPs; panelboards; branch circuits; grounding and bonding; EPMS; and associated monitoring and control systems.

Mechanical and cooling infrastructure: Chillers; chilled-water systems; CRAH, CRAC, RTU, and air-handling units; pumps; motors; variable-frequency drives; cooling towers or dry coolers; water treatment; leak detection; environmental controls; and associated piping, valves, and controls.

Life safety and facility-support systems: Fire alarm and fire suppression systems; emergency lighting; building automation systems; environmental monitoring; fuel monitoring; water detection; facility controls; and other systems required to maintain safe and reliable site operation.

Core Responsibilities:

  • Conduct scheduled facility rounds and record operating conditions, equipment status, alarms, readings, abnormalities, and required follow-up actions.
  • Monitor BMS, EPMS, DCIM, and other facility-monitoring platforms; investigate abnormal conditions and escalate issues in accordance with incident procedures.
  • Operate and maintain mission-critical electrical, mechanical, cooling, fire/life-safety, building infrastructure automation controllers (JACE, WinG, Daikin ITM, eBox, etc.), and facility-support systems in accordance with approved procedures.
  • Ensure compliance with regulatory, safety, and audit requirements in line with customer and company SLA standards.
  • Perform preventive and corrective maintenance, equipment testing, repairs, and post-maintenance verification while protecting customer operations and system redundancy.
  • Serve as technical lead during complex incidents, emergency events, loss-of-redundancy conditions, equipment failures, and abnormal operating scenarios.
  • Lead or support root-cause analysis, corrective-action plans, post-incident reviews, and reliability improvements.
  • Develop, review, execute, and close out MOPs, SOPs, EOPs, switching procedures, maintenance scripts, and other controlled operational documents.
  • Serve as the technical owner for assigned facility systems, including equipment records, procedures, training, spare parts, maintenance history, and lifecycle planning.
  • Identify single points of failure, capacity constraints, equipment deficiencies, operational risks, and opportunities to improve resilience and efficiency.
  • Collaborate with engineering and projet teams on new builds and expnasions.
  • Coordinate vendors and contractors, including scope review, job-safety documentation, permits, work execution, testing, punch-list completion, and closeout documentation.
  • Manage assigned work requests and maintenance activities through the company CMMS or service-management platform, driving work to timely resolution.
  • Maintain accurate one-line diagrams, sequences of operation, equipment records, asset data, configuration items in SNOW, maintenance history, as-built documentation, and site operating procedures.
  • Support facility capacity planning, energy-efficiency initiatives, infrastructure optimization, and readiness for high-density customer deployments.
  • Support construction, commissioning, integrated systems testing, equipment acceptance, punch-list completion, and operational turnover for new or modified facilities.
  • Train and qualify Technician I and II employees on equipment operation, emergency procedures, safe work practices, and technical procedures.
  • Participate in shift coverage, nights, weekends, holidays, on-call rotations, emergency response, and travel to other LightEdge sites as assigned

Safety, Compliance, and Work Control:

Perform all work in accordance with LightEdge safety policies, OSHA requirements, NFPA 70E practices, lockout/tagout procedures, PPE requirements, approved work permits, equipment-specific procedures, and applicable building, fire, environmental, and electrical codes.

  • Identify and report unsafe conditions, procedural gaps, equipment hazards, and compliance risks.
  • Follow approved work-control, change-management, risk-assessment, and peer-review processes before performing work that could affect critical operations.
  • Support audits, inspections, emergency exercises, safety training, and corrective actions.

Minimum Qualifications:

  • High school diploma or equivalent.
  • Five or more years of experience in data-center operations, critical facilities, industrial facilities, hospitals, utilities, military facilities, or another mission-critical environment.
  • Demonstrated experience operating and troubleshooting electrical, mechanical, HVAC, controls, or life-safety systems.
  • Ability to work independently during routine operations and complex incidents while exercising sound technical judgment.
  • Ability to read electrical one-lines, mechanical drawings, control diagrams, equipment manuals, and sequences of operation.
  • Ability to work assigned shifts, weekends, holidays, on-call rotations, and emergency events as required by site operations.
  • Ability to use CMMS, BMS, EPMS, DCIM, or similar operational systems.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Associate degree, technical degree, military training, trade-school certification, or equivalent practical experience.
  • Advanced experience with UPS systems, generators, switchgear, ATS equipment, PDUs, RPPs, chillers, CRAH/CRAC units, pumps, motors, and building controls.
  • Experience with Niagara, or similar BMS platforms and with EPMS or power-monitoring systems.
  • NFPA 70E, OSHA, EPA 608, OEM, electrical, HVAC, controls, or stationary-engine certifications, as applicable to the assigned site.
  • Experience supporting commissioning, integrated systems testing, design reviews, construction turnover, or high-density data-center deployments.

Physical and Work Environments Requirements:

  • Ability to work in a 24x7 data-center environment that may include rotating shifts, extended hours, nights, weekends, holidays, and on-call assignments.
  • Ability to walk, stand, climb stairs and ladders, reach, bend, kneel, crouch, work above shoulder level, and work in mechanical and electrical rooms.
  • Ability to lift, carry, push, and pull equipment and materials within the limits established by the company’s approved job analysis and applicable accommodations process.
  • Ability to work safely in areas with elevated noise, temperature variation, construction activity, PPE requirements, and energized or potentially energized equipment under approved safe-work practices.
  • Ability to travel between LightEdge facilities as required for training, project support, incident response, or operational coverage.

Success Measures:

  • Safe and reliable operation of assigned critical-facilities systems.
  • Timely and accurate completion of preventive maintenance, work requests, operating logs, and technical documentation.
  • Effective response, escalation, root-cause analysis, and corrective action for incidents and equipment abnormalities.
  • High-quality execution and closeout of MOPs, EOPs, SOPs, vendor work, projects, and commissioning activities.
  • Demonstrated development of lower-tier technicians and measurable improvements in reliability, readiness, safety, capacity, or efficiency.

General Position Statement:

This job description is intended to describe the general nature and level of work performed by employees in this role. It is not intended to be an exhaustive list of all duties, responsibilities, qualifications, or working conditions. Responsibilities may be adjusted based on business needs, site requirements, and applicable laws.
With over 20 years in business, LightEdge offers a full stack of best-in-class IT services delivering flexibility, security, and control. Our solutions include premier colocation across seven purpose-built data centers spanning Des Moines, IA, Kansas City, MO, Omaha, NE, Austin, TX, and Raleigh, NC, industry-leading private Infrastructure as a Service (IaaS) and cloud platforms, and the top global security and compliance measures. Our owned and operated facilities, integrated DR solutions, and premium compliant cloud choices make up a true Hybrid Cloud Solution Center. LightEdge annually undergoes third-party audits for ISO 20000-1, ISO 27001, HIPAA, PCI-DSS 3.2, and SSAE 18 SOC 1 Type II, SOC 2 Type II and SOC 3.

title: Associate Professor at the Department of Public Health
description:
The Department of Public Health at the Faculty of Health, Aarhus University, invites applications for one or more full-time, permanent positions as Associate Professor within one or more of our main academic areas: Applied Public Health, Clinical Public Health, Epidemiology, Environment & Biostatistics, and Sport Science. The teaching profile for the position is within philosophy of science. The expected start date is 1 May 2027, or as soon as possible thereafter.

About the Department
The Department of Public Health is a research-intensive environment dedicated to advancing fundamental scientific knowledge and developing applied solutions to major public health challenges. Our research spans theoretical, basic, and applied sciences, with the shared ambition to generate impactful knowledge and improving population health. Academic excellence is at the core of everything we do. We are committed to conducting rigorous and innovative research and delivering high-quality teaching. The department is responsible for teaching in public health, sport science, health science, nursing science, and related methodological disciplines, as well as delivering a substantial proportion of the teaching within the medical degree programme. The successful candidate will be expected to teach philosophy of science across these programmes.

While firmly rooted in our respective disciplines, we actively foster interdisciplinary collaboration to advance innovation and excellence in both research and education. We are equally committed to cultivating a healthy, inclusive, and supportive workplace culture characterised by open dialogue, mutual respect, and an informal atmosphere. We believe that academic excellence and personal well-being are mutually reinforcing and essential to long-term success.

You can read more about the department here and about the faculty here.

Your job responsibilities
As an Associate Professor, you will contribute actively to the department's research and teaching activities. You are expected to conduct research at a high international level and to develop an independent academic profile through both individual scholarship and collaboration with colleagues. You are committed to delivering high-quality teaching and supervision and bring strong collaborative skills, intellectual curiosity, and a willingness to contribute broadly across the educational programmes and courses for which the department is responsible. Your primary teaching responsibilities will be within the areas of philosophy of science across a range of degree programme. You are eager to engage in the academic community at Aarhus University and contribute to strengthening the department's national and international profile.

You are committed to maintaining high academic and pedagogical standards in your teaching, and you bring strong collaborative skills and a broad academic network that you actively leverage to strengthen the Department of Public Health’s academic profile, nationally and internationally.

We value academic citizenship. This includes active participation in collegial collaboration, mentoring, and the social and professional life of the department. We therefore expect you to be an engaged and visible member of the department's daily academic environment.

Your primary responsibilities will include:
  • Conducting and publishing research of high international quality, including in leading journals and publishers within your field.
  • Developing your research profile and contributing to the department's strategic objectives, including through applications for external research funding.
  • Teaching and supervising students at Bachelor's and Master's level and contributing to the continued development of innovative teaching activities.
  • Participating in the supervision of PhD students and contributing to the faculty's PhD courses.
  • Disseminating research findings to academic audiences, stakeholders, and the wider public.

Your competencies
You have established yourself as a recognised researcher within your field and can document research and teaching qualifications at a high international level. You have a well-developed international network, experience in attracting significant external research funding from national and international funding bodies, and clear potential and motivation to establish yourself as a research leader, to establish your own research group, and to consolidate an independent research agenda. In the assessment process, particular emphasis will be placed on experience gained through employment, visiting appointments, or extended research stays at recognised universities or research institutions outside the candidate's primary institution.

Your personal qualities include the ability to build trust-based relationships with colleagues, students, and external partners. As a teacher, you communicate current and relevant knowledge in a clear, engaging, and inspiring manner. As a supervisor, you are professional, inclusive, and supportive. You value collaboration and contribute positively to the collegial culture that characterises the Department of Public Health, the Faculty of Health Sciences, and Aarhus University more broadly. You are motivated to contribute to the department's continued development and to help maintain an inclusive, supportive, and high-performing work environment.

Fluency in written and spoken English is required. International applicants are expected to acquire Danish proficiency, and Aarhus University offers language training to support this process.

In order to be assessed as qualified for an Associate Professor position, you must meet these academic criteria.

Shortlisting will be applied as part of the assessment process.

Questions about the position
If you have any questions about the position, please contact Head of Department Michael Baggesen Klitgaard tel.: (+45) 4022 7649.

Your place of work will be the Department of Public Health, DK-8000 Aarhus C, Denmark.

Terms of employment
  • Appointment as an associate professor requires research and teaching qualifications at the level that can be achieved through the satisfactory completion of a period of appointment as an assistant professor, but may also be obtained in other ways.
  • The applicant is required to have completed a university pedagogical programme or an equivalent programme.
  • Further information on the appointment procedure can be found in the Ministerial Order on the Appointment of Academic Staff at Universities.
  • The appointment is in accordance with the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations (Akademikerne).
  • Remuneration is in accordance with the above, and the Salary agreement catalogue for staff at Health.
  • The yearly base salary for a fulltime associate professor is DKK 706.233,06 (including a position related supplement, a pre-agreed associate professor supplememt and pension (18.07%)). Additional supplement(s) can be negotiated dependent on experience, special qualifications and performance of special functions. Authorisation supplement(s) will be granted, if relevant for the position. Your local eligible trade union representative at Aarhus University negotiates your salary on your behalf.
  • Researchers recruited from abroad are offered a special researcher tax scheme with a lower tax rate.
  • Travel and moving expenses may be covered according to the employee in question and, to a limited extent, the accompanying family.
  • Further information on qualification requirements and job description can be found in the Ministerial order on Job Structure for Academic Staff at Universities.

Application
Your application must include the following:
  • Motivated application
  • Curriculum Vitae
  • Diploma
  • Template for applicant - associate professor
  • A list of publications
  • A teaching portfolio. We refer to Guideline on the use of teaching portfolios
  • The five publications stated as the most important in the 'Template for applicant - associate professor' must be submitted
  • Research plan, which is part of the 'Template to applicant - associate professor' can be uploaded separately (optional)
  • Coauthor statement(s) can be uploaded (optional)
  • References/recommendations can be uploaded separately in the e-recruitment system (optional)

We refer to the faculty’s Guidelines for applicants.

Aarhus University’s ambition is to be an attractive and inspiring workplace for all and to foster a culture in which each individual has opportunities to thrive, achieve and develop. We view equality and diversity as assets, and we welcome all applicants.

International applicant?
Aarhus University offers a broad variety of services for international researchers and accompanying families, including assistance with relocation and career counselling to expat partners. Please find more information about the International Staff Office and the range of services here.

The application must be submitted via Aarhus University’s recruitment system, which can be accessed under the job advertisement on Aarhus University's website.

title: Pædagog med psykiatrisk erfaring søges til et nyt og anderledes lukket afsnit på Psykiatrisk Center Ballerup
description:
Vil du være med til at skabe et nyt kapitel i den lukkede psykiatri?

På Afsnit 8, Psykiatrisk Center Ballerup, Herlev og Gentofte Hospital søger vi en engageret pædagog, der har erfaring fra psykiatrien og lyst til at være med til at udvikle et anderledes lukket afsnit, hvor relationer, miljøterapi og recovery er omdrejningspunktet.

Fra den 1. september 2026 ændrer Afsnit 8 profil. Vi bliver et lukket afsnit med patienter, der har behov for en lukket ramme, men som ikke er udadreagerende eller har behov for en højt specialiseret intensiv indsats. Det giver mulighed for at arbejde på en anden måde end på de traditionelle lukkede afsnit, med større fokus på nærvær, struktur, aktiviteter og udvikling af et terapeutisk miljø.



Vær med til at forme fremtidens lukkede afsnit

Vi står foran en spændende udvikling, hvor medarbejderne får en central rolle i at skabe kulturen og udvikle de miljøterapeutiske indsatser. Hos os bliver du ikke blot en del af et eksisterende tilbud, du bliver medskaber af det.

Vi ønsker at skabe et afsnit, hvor hverdagen er præget af:

  • stærke terapeutiske relationer
  • meningsfulde aktiviteter og struktur
  • recovery-orienteret praksis
  • høj faglighed og tværfagligt samarbejde
  • et miljø, hvor patienterne støttes i at genvinde funktioner, håb og mestring
Som pædagog vil du få gode muligheder for at bringe dine kompetencer i spil og være med til at udvikle nye miljøterapeutiske tiltag, der understøtter patienternes recovery og trivsel.



Vi søger en pædagog, som

  • har erfaring fra psykiatrien – gerne fra et lukket afsnit
  • brænder for miljøterapi og relationsarbejde
  • kan skabe struktur, ro og forudsigelighed for patienterne
  • arbejder recovery-orienteret og ser muligheder frem for begrænsninger
  • trives i et tværfagligt samarbejde med sygeplejersker, social- og sundhedsassistenter, læger, terapeuter og øvrige samarbejdspartnere
  • har lyst til at være med til at udvikle en ny kultur og nye arbejdsgange


Vi tilbyder

  • Mulighed for at sætte dit præg på udviklingen af et nyt og anderledes lukket afsnit
  • En arbejdsplads i udvikling med stor indflydelse på den faglige retning
  • Engagerede kolleger med høj faglighed og lyst til udvikling
  • Grundig introduktion og oplæring
  • Fokus på kompetenceudvikling og sparring
  • En arbejdsplads, hvor samarbejde, refleksion og faglig udvikling vægtes højt.
Hvis du motiveres af at være med til at udvikle et nyt behandlingstilbud og ønsker at gøre en forskel for patienter med behov for en lukket ramme, men hvor relationen og miljøet er de vigtigste redskaber, så hører vi meget gerne fra dig.

Vi glæder os til at byde dig velkommen på Afsnit 8.

Ved spørgsmål er du velkommen til at kontakte oversygeplejerske Karina Poller Andersen på telefon 30 22 61 89 eller overlæge Kristine Søgaard Dahl på telefon 38 64 50 06.



En tryg start hos os

Vi ved, at det er afgørende at få en god start i et nyt job – derfor har vi et introduktionsforløb hvor du er udenfor normeringen. Du bliver tilknyttet en mentor, så du føler dig tryg både fagligt og i fællesskabet.

I introduktionsperioden bliver du gradvist introduceret til afsnittets arbejdsgange og patientgruppen med plads til spørgsmål, sparring og feedback.

Vores mål er, at du føler dig godt klædt på – både fagligt og menneskeligt – til at blive en del af hverdagen på afsnittet.



Løn- og ansættelsesvilkår

Tiltrædelse efter aftale


Du ansættes i henhold til overenskomst for socialpædagogisk personale ved døgninstitutioner. Du er under ansættelsen omfattet af den til enhver tid gældende arbejdstidsaftale indgået mellem Regionernes Lønnings- og Takstnævn og Socialpædagogernes Landsforbund.


Regionen er et døgndækket område, og du vil efter konkret behov kunne blive planlagt med vagter uden for ambulatoriets åbningstider i overensstemmelse med reglerne i den gældende arbejdstidsaftale.



Ansøgningsprocedure

Ansøgningsfrist er den 20. september 2026.

Ansøgning, CV og uddannelsesbevis sendes via linket her på siden.

Læs mere om Psykiatrisk Center Ballerup her.

title: Social- og sundhedsassistenter/-hjælpere i dag- eller aftenvagt til Æblehaven
description:
Er du SSA/SSH med hjertet på rette sted og humor i baglommen? På plejehjemmet Æblehaven leder vi ikke bare efter endnu en medarbejder – vi leder efter dig, der både kan finde puls og personlighed i en hverdag fyldt med varme, nærvær og grin (og en gang imellem lidt ekstra kaffe!). Lyder det som dig? Så læs endelig videre!

Hos Æblehaven i Haarby søger vi lige nu en social- og sundhedsassistent/social- og sundhedshjælper til aftenvagt.

Stillingen i aftenvagt er på 28 timer om ugen med weekendarbejde i gennemsnit hver anden weekend.

Tiltrædelse pr. 1. november 2026.

Hvem er vi Æblehaven er et Eden registreret plejehjem. Det betyder, at vi har fokus på, at livet skal være værd at leve hele livet, og hverdagen skal være på beboernes præmisser. Vi tager udgangspunkt i beboernes ønsker for en god hverdag, hvor der er plads til, at vi er forskellige og har forskellige ønsker, rytmer og individuelle behov.

Vi har 35 beboere fordelt på 4 huse. Hvert hus har 8-9 beboere og hvert hus deres eget særkende. Vi fungerer som små familier i de enkelte huse, og vi lægger vægt på, at hvert hus som udgangspunkt har sit eget personale, som er en naturlig del af "familien" i huset sammen med beboerne.

Du vil få dygtige og erfarne kolleger, som glæder sig til at byde dig velkommen. Vi tror på, at det psykiske arbejdsmiljø ikke er noget, man bare taler om – det er noget, vi skaber sammen. Her er plads til at være menneske, både for beboerne og for dig. Vi har høj faglighed men også plads til dårlige vittigheder.

Vi tilbyder På Æblehaven tilbyder vi:

  • God kollegagaranti
  • Grundig introduktion og oplæring
  • Et inkluderende varmt og levende fællesskab
  • Synlig ledelse
  • Høj faglighed
  • Fleksibel vagtplanlægning
  • Stort fokus på arbejdsmiljøet.
Vi arbejder med udgangspunkt i de personalepolitiske værdier i Assens Kommune, som derfor naturligt præger og udleves i vores hverdag.

Om dig Vi lægger vægt på, at du:

  • udviser tålmodig og er nærværende
  • spreder positivitet og smil
  • er initiativrig og har overblik
  • inddrager beboerne naturligt i dagligdagens aktiviteter
  • formår at arbejde struktureret
  • træder til og giver en hånd, når nogen har brug for din hjælp
  • udviser fleksibilitet, stabilitet og pålidelighed
  • kan tilrettelægge og planlægge din tid
  • er udviklings- og forandringsparat
Løn og ansættelsesvilkår Løn og ansættelsesforhold sker i henhold til gældende overenskomst og ud fra reglerne om lokal løndannelse.

Vi gør opmærksom på, at straffeattest indhentes inden en eventuel ansættelse.

Vi er en røgfri kommune, hvilket betyder, at der ikke må ryges i arbejdstiden.

Vil du vide mere Har du spørgsmål eller brug for yderligere oplysninger om stillingen, er du velkommen til at kontakte leder Marie Vestergaard på telefon 64 74 76 94.

Ansøgningsfristen er søndag den 20. september 2026, og vi afholder ansættelsessamtaler løbende og med de sidste fredag den 25. september 2026.

title: Vil du som sygeplejerske være med til at skabe et nyt kapitel i den lukkede psykiatri?
description:
På Afsnit 8, Psykiatrisk Center Ballerup, Herlev og Gentofte Hospital søger vi en engageret sygeplejerske, der har erfaring fra psykiatrien og lyst til at være med til at udvikle et anderledes lukket afsnit, hvor relationer, miljøterapi og recovery er en integreret del af behandlingstilbuddet

Fra den 1. september 2026 ændrer Afsnit 8 profil. Vi bliver et lukket afsnit med patienter, der har behov for en lukket ramme, men som ikke er udadreagerende eller har behov for en højt specialiseret intensiv indsats. Det giver mulighed for at arbejde på en anden måde end på de traditionelle lukkede afsnit, med større fokus på nærvær, struktur, aktiviteter og udvikling af et terapeutisk miljø.



Vær med til at forme fremtidens lukkede afsnit

Vi står foran en spændende udvikling, hvor medarbejderne får en central rolle i at skabe kulturen og udvikle de miljøterapeutiske indsatser. Hos os bliver du ikke blot en del af et eksisterende tilbud, du bliver medskaber af det.

Vi ønsker at skabe et afsnit, hvor hverdagen er præget af:

  • stærke terapeutiske relationer
  • meningsfulde aktiviteter og struktur
  • recovery-orienteret praksis
  • høj faglighed og tværfagligt samarbejde med psykologisk tryghed
  • et behandlingstilbud som fokuserer bredt bio-psyko-socialt
Som sygeplejerske vil du få gode muligheder for at bringe dine kompetencer i spil, udvikle på egen og fælles faglighed og være med til at udvikle nye rammer og miljøterapeutiske tiltag, der understøtter patienternes recovery og trivsel.



Vi søger en sygeplejerske, som

  • har erfaring fra psykiatrien – gerne fra et lukket afsnit eller med terapeutiske interventioner
  • brænder for miljøterapi og relationsarbejde
  • kan skabe struktur, ro og forudsigelighed for patienterne
  • arbejder recovery-orienteret og ser muligheder frem for begrænsninger
  • trives i et tværfagligt samarbejde med social- og sundhedsassistenter, pædagoger, vores socialrådgiver, læger, terapeuter og øvrige samarbejdspartnere
  • har lyst til at være med til at udvikle en ny kultur og nye arbejdsgange


Vi tilbyder

  • mulighed for at sætte dit præg på udviklingen af et nyt og anderledes lukket afsnit
  • en arbejdsplads i udvikling med stor indflydelse på den faglige retning
  • engagerede kolleger med høj faglighed og lyst til udvikling
  • grundig introduktion og oplæring
  • fokus på kompetenceudvikling, feedback og sparring
  • en arbejdsplads, hvor samarbejde, refleksion og faglig udvikling vægtes højt


Hvis du motiveres af at være med til at udvikle et nyt behandlingstilbud og ønsker at gøre en forskel for patienter med behov for en lukket ramme, men hvor relationen og miljøet er de vigtige redskaber, så hører vi meget gerne fra dig.

Vi glæder os til at byde dig velkommen på Afsnit 8.

Ved spørgsmål er du velkommen til at kontakte oversygeplejerske Karina Poller Andersen på telefon 30 22 61 89 eller overlæge Kristine Søgaard Dahl på telefon 38 64 50 06.



En tryg start hos os

Vi ved, at det er afgørende at få en god start i et nyt job – derfor har vi et introduktionsforløb hvor du er udenfor normeringen. Du bliver tilknyttet en mentor, så du føler dig tryg både fagligt og i fællesskabet.

I introduktionsperioden bliver du gradvist introduceret til afsnittets arbejdsgange og patientgruppen med plads til spørgsmål, sparring og feedback.

Vores mål er, at du føler dig godt klædt på – både fagligt og menneskeligt – til at blive en del af hverdagen på afsnittet.



Løn- og ansættelsesvilkår

Tiltrædelse efter aftale


Du ansættes i henhold til overenskomst for ikke-ledende personale på Sundhedskartellets område. Du er under ansættelsen omfattet af den til enhver tid gældende arbejdstidsaftale indgået mellem Regionernes Lønnings- og Takstnævn og Dansk Sygeplejeråd.


Døgnafsnittet er døgndækket, og du vil derfor blive planlagt med blandende vagter i overensstemmelse med reglerne i den gældende arbejdstidsaftale.



Ansøgningsprocedure

Ansøgningsfrist er den 20. september 2026.

Ansøgning, CV og uddannelsesbevis sendes via linket her på siden.

title: Claims Analyst I (US Remote)
description:
TREND Health Partners is a tech-enabled payment integrity company. Our mission is to facilitate collaboration between payers and providers for mutual benefit and waste reduction, ultimately improving access to healthcare. We achieve this by aligning the common goals of payers and providers and fostering collaboration through a shared technology platform and seamless workflows.
Joining TREND Health Partners means becoming part of a dynamic, growing organization that promotes a collaborative and innovative work environment. Our comprehensive compensation package includes competitive salaries, highly valued health insurance, a 401(k) plan with employer match, paid parental leave, and more.
The primary responsibility of the Claims Analyst is the identification, analysis and recovery of claim overpayments on behalf of our clients who are commercial health insurance companies and state healthcare programs. responsible for researching and analyzing claims, systems and documents for assigned clients in order to develop new concepts or apply existing concepts to clients that would identify claim overpayments. ensure that all activities related to successfully and correctly analyzing claims are completed in an accurate and timely manner.

Role and Responsibilities

  • Acquire knowledge of the client’s claims adjudication system(s), member and provider contracts, and client claim payment policies and procedures.
  • Assist client in identifying, validating, and recovering claim overpayments.
  • Validate claims to ensure the accuracy of algorithms and that no refund has previously been posted to the client’s system(s)
  • Review and resolve disputed overpayments from client/provider.
  • Participate in knowledge sharing to brainstorm & resolve claim issues or seek clarifications.
  • Identify new overpayment opportunities by reviewing and researching areas such as CMS and Medicaid claims processing policies, adjustments by client’s internal unit/other vendors, client’s claims processing policies/system(s), provider, and member contracts.
  • Ideate, test, document & submit new overpayment trends/research scenarios.
  • Research potential new ideas and follow algorithm development process.
  • Assist Management with concept approval information needed for client approval on specific trends.
  • Always represent TREND and our clients in a professional manner
  • Cooperate with team members to meet goals and complete tasks in an efficient and effective manner.
  • Provide feedback to Management regarding inventory levels, algorithm effectiveness/productivity and new trend /ideas.
  • Collaborate with TREND Management to identify new opportunities, areas of improvement and innovate potential solutions.
  • Escalate to the manager any situation outside the employee’s control that could adversely impact the business relationship.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in accounting, business, healthcare, or a related field. Equivalent work experience in a similar position may be substituted for educational requirements.
  • Excellent computer skills and proficient in Excel
  • Strong analytical skills
  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills, displaying the ability to connect and build relationships at all levels with payers, providers, clients, management, and peers.
  • Attention to detail.
  • Proven problem-solving abilities.
  • Excellent written and oral communication skills
  • Effective organization, time management skills
  • Highly analytical, self-motivated, and directed
  • Must be able to learn, understand, and apply new technologies.
  • High School Diploma or Equivalent Required

Preferred Skills

  • Proactive, independent and results oriented.
  • Customer and team focused with a strong desire to be an active, long-term participant in the growth of the firm overall.
  • Experience with medical claims processing
  • Experience in identification, analysis, and recovery of claim overpayments

Mental and Physical Demands

  • This position will be exposed mainly to an indoor/office environment and will be expected to work in or around computers and printers.
  • The nature of the work is sedentary, and the employee will be sitting most of the time.
  • Essential physical functions of the job include typing and the repetitive motion to utilize computer software and hardware continuously throughout the day.
  • Essential mental functions of this position include concentrating on analytical tasks, reading information, and verbal/written communication to others continuously throughout the day.
  • This job description documents the general nature and level of work but is not intended to be a comprehensive list of activities, duties, or responsibilities required for this position. Consequently, employees may be asked to perform other duties as required.
  • Employees may also be asked to complete certain compliance requirements set forth by our Business Partners in the performance of their jobs including but not limited to requests for background and drug screenings and disclosures of personal health information or personally identifiable information. Exemptions as provided under the ADA and TITLE VII of the Civil Rights Act will be observed and followed.
  • Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the functions outlined above.

title: Principal NetSuite Consultant
description:

You will lead complex, multi-phase implementation and service engagements from discovery and solution design through training, testing, and go-live. The role combines strategic advisory work with hands-on functional and technical expertise, giving you broad influence across client projects. You will manage multiple initiatives simultaneously while ensuring scope, profitability, quality, and timelines remain on track. As a senior subject matter expert, you will also mentor consultants and contribute to business development and sales engineering activities. The position offers an opportunity to work directly with clients and shape practical solutions that improve finance, operations, reporting, and broader business performance.

    • Strong analytical, problem-solving, organizational, and project leadership capabilities, with the ability to translate complex business needs into practical solutions.
    • Ability to take ownership of projects and engagements while maintaining high standards for quality, profitability, scope adherence, and client satisfaction.
    • Comfortable contributing to sales engineering, product demonstrations, networking events, user groups, and other business development initiatives.
    • A collaborative, service-oriented mindset with the ability to work effectively with clients and colleagues at different levels of seniority.

      • Benefits

  • Can work independently and follow established procedures

title: Vi søger flexjobber/deltidsansatte pædagoger til vores nye skoletilbud, Vækstklasserne i Ugerløse.
description:
Holbæk Kommune har etableret Vækstklasserne – et visiteret specialpædagogisk skoletilbud for børn og unge i 0.9. klasse med sociale og følelsesmæssige vanskeligheder. I første omgang er tilbuddet startet op i indskoling og på mellemtrin på Ugerløse Skole. Nu søger vi en kollega eller to, der kan være med til at give vores dejlige unger en god og stabil skoledag - hele dagen. Du har derfor en solid pædagogisk baggrund, gerne med flere års erfaring fra specialområdet

Lidt om tilbuddet

Vækstklasserne er et særligt tilrettelagt tilbud for elever, der har brug for mindre læringsmiljøer, tydelige voksne og en struktureret hverdag. En klasse kommer til at bestå af 6-8 elever og 3 voksne.

Et vilkår du vil opleve er, at børnene kan blive fysiske i deres adfærd, og det stiller store krav til dig som fagperson. Du kan bevare roen og regulere miljøet, så det bliver konfliktnedtrappende. Du står på børnesynet og kan håndtere konflikter og fysisk adfærd indenfor den pædagogiske ramme.

Du tror på, at når børnene oplever voksne, der bliver stående, skaber tryghed og hjælper dem tilbage i regulering, sker der ofte små – men meget betydningsfulde – skridt i deres udvikling. Som medarbejder får du mulighed for at opbygge stærke relationer, se børnene vokse i selvforståelse og opleve, hvordan din faglighed gør en konkret forskel i deres hverdag.

Både skole og fritid

I vækstklasserne lægger vi stor vægt på, at børnene møder kendte voksne gennem hele deres dag. Det betyder, at du som medarbejder er sammen med barnet i de timer, hvor barnet er i tilbuddet.

Den sammenhæng skaber tryghed, ro og forudsigelighed for børnene og er en forudsætning relationsopbygning, regulering og læring. Det kræver, at du er fleksibilitet i forhold til arbejdstid og ferieperioder, og du mulighed for at arbejde helhedsorienteret og opleve, hvordan netop kontinuitet og tydelige relationer gør en mærkbar forskel for børnene.

Samarbejde, møder og sparring

Ved siden af hverdagen, vil der være et tæt samarbejde om børnene med forældre, PPR og Børn og Familie-afdelingen, både mødedeltagelse og den løbende dialog. Derudover er dine opgaver blandt andet, at:

  • arbejde relations- og ressourceorienteret med elevernes sociale og emotionelle udvikling.
  • understøtte elevernes regulering, trivsel og deltagelse i både skole- og fritidsdel
  • planlægge og gennemføre pædagogiske aktiviteter i både undervisnings- og fritidstiden
  • arbejde med psykoedukation, angstdæmpende pædagogik og tydelig struktur

Det har du med dig

Vi ønsker os dig, der tænker kreativt, fleksibelt og nyt, og du har måske erfaring med at starte noget nyt op. Ikke alt er fastlagt på forhånd, og netop dét giver mulighed for at præge praksis, bidrage med sin faglighed og være med til at skabe et tilbud, der giver mening – både for børnene og for de voksne omkring dem

Derudover:

  • er du uddannet pædagog med socialpædagogisk overbygning eller tilsvarende relevant efteruddannelse.
  • har du måske erfaring med behandlingsarbejde med børn og unge - du har i hvert fald interessen.
  • kan du arbejde med reguleringsstrategier, angstdæmpende og med social træning.

Det kan du glæde dig til

Du bliver en del af en engageret medarbejdergruppe på Ugerløse Skole, der er en mindre folkeskole fra 0.-6. klasse inkl. læringsklasser. Her får du skønne kollegaer, der altid er klar på faglig sparring, snak og grin.

Derudover får du:

  • mulighed for at være med til at opbygge et nyt specialpædagogisk tilbud fra starten.
  • et stærkt fagligt miljø med fokus på relationsarbejde.
  • fast supervision og mulighed for kompetenceudvikling.
  • et tæt samarbejde mellem undervisnings- og pædagogfaglighed.

Er du nysgerrig?

Så kan du kontakte skoleleder Jimmi Salkvist 72 36 71 75, jimsa@holb.dk. Det kan være du har spørgsmål – eller måske vil have en rundvisning.

Praktiske oplysninger

Ansættelsesdato: 1. oktober 2026

Ansøgningsfrist: 20. september 2026

Samtaler holdes løbende

Løn efter overenskomst og kvalifikationer

Vi glæder os til at modtage din ansøgning.

Vi er 4.800 engagerede kollegaer, der hver dag arbejder for at skabe god service og velfærd for vores ca. 75.000 borgere i Holbæk Kommune. Sammen bringer vi vores forskellige fagligheder i spil og skaber løsninger, der gør en reel forskel.

Vi lægger stor vægt på et godt arbejdsmiljø og på at udvikle vores medarbejdere - både fagligt og personligt.

I Holbæk Kommune arbejder vi aktivt for mangfoldige arbejdspladser, hvor der er plads til forskellighed. Alle kvalificerede ansøgere opfordres derfor til at søge stillingen - uanset køn, alder, handicap, etnicitet, politiske og religiøse overbevisninger eller seksuel orientering.

Holbæk Kommunes personalepolitik sætter rammen for vores værdier og måden, vi møder hinanden og borgerne på.

Læs mere om, hvordan det er at arbejde i Holbæk Kommune.

Scope of Work:

The Service Order Dispatcher receives, records, and distributes work orders to service crews in response to customer requests for facility maintenance and repair services. The position prepares and schedules service orders, dispatches service personnel, maintains service-call and work-order records, and communicates with customers and maintenance personnel to support timely and satisfactory completion of services.

Responsibilities:

  • Receive and record customer requests for maintenance and repair services.

  • Dispatch service crews and relay messages, work assignments, special instructions, and changes in priority.
  • Classify and coordinate service calls according to established emergency, urgent, and routine response requirements.
  • Create, update, track, and maintain service calls and work orders within the Computerized Maintenance Management System (CMMS).
  • Monitor the status of open work orders and coordinate with service personnel to support timely completion.
  • Follow up with customers, as appropriate, to confirm satisfactory completion of services and address or route outstanding concerns.
  • Maintain accurate records of service calls, work orders, dispatch activities, and supporting documentation.
  • Communicate with service crews and other departments using telephone, cellular, radio, or other designated communication systems.
  • Escalate emergency conditions, safety concerns, service interruptions, and other significant issues to appropriate personnel.
  • Adhere to company policies, procedures, and safety regulations.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

Minimum Requirements:

  • One (1) year of relevant experience in dispatch, administrative support, customer service, work control, or facilities maintenance support.
  • Experience with a CMMS or similar work-order tracking system preferred.
  • Proficiency with computers and Microsoft Office.
  • Strong communication, organizational, and customer service skills.
  • Ability to prioritize multiple requests and accurately maintain detailed records.
  • Must be able to satisfactorily complete a Tier 1 background investigation/Public Trust process, if required for the position.
  • Must be able to obtain and maintain access to the Government worksite.
  • Must possess and maintain a valid state driver’s license and a safe driving record, in accordance with company policy, to operate vehicles or equipment as required for the position.

Physical Demands / Work Environment:

  • Ability to sit or stand for extended periods while working at a computer or desk.
  • Frequent use of hands for typing, data entry, and handling paperwork.
  • Must be able to work on-call, alternate, and extended shift schedules as necessary to meet mission requirements, including weekends and holidays.

$20.50—$20.50 USD

At Tlingit Haida Tribal Business Corporation (THTBC), our work goes beyond delivering exceptional services—we are driven by a mission to create meaningful impact. When you join our team, you become part of an organization that values purpose, performance, and people.

We offer the opportunity to work in dynamic, fast-paced environments where your contributions directly impact mission success. Our teams are built on collaboration, accountability, and a commitment to excellence, ensuring you are supported while being challenged to grow.

title: Enterprise Technology Services Specialist
description:
Enterprise Technology Services Specialist

New York, NY

Are you a resourceful IT professional who enjoys solving complex endpoint, identity, and application issues while delivering an exceptional employee experience? Do you enjoy turning recurring support challenges into secure, scalable automations and self-service solutions? Are you excited to use AI-assisted tools thoughtfully to improve troubleshooting, documentation, and IT operations while maintaining high standards for security and privacy? If so, we invite you to be a part of our innovative team.

As an Enterprise Technology Services Specialist on Ridgeline’s IT team, you’ll deliver reliable, secure, and user-centered technology services while independently resolving complex support issues and improving the systems and processes behind them. You’ll manage corporate accounts and endpoints, strengthen access controls and endpoint security in partnership with Security, and build practical automations that reduce manual work, minimize downtime, and help IT operations scale. Working with cutting-edge technologies and approved AI tools, you’ll use AI-assisted troubleshooting, log analysis, knowledge-base drafting, and script generation to increase efficiency while carefully validating outputs for accuracy, security, privacy, and maintainability.

At Ridgeline, how we work matters as much as what we build. Ridgeliners act like owners, choose growth over comfort, and communicate with transparency. We assume positive intent, bias toward action, and bring solutions—not just problems. We celebrate wins, learn from setbacks, and thrive in a resilient, collaborative, high-performing culture.If this excites you, we’d love to meet you!

You must be work authorized in the United States without the need for employer sponsorship.

The impact you will have:

  • Provide advanced IT service management support and independently resolve complex Tier 1 and Tier 2 issues across software, licensing, endpoints, identity, and employee technology

  • Act as an escalation point for issues requiring deeper investigation, including first-line handling of information security detection and response escalations

  • Lead onboarding, offboarding, and account lifecycle execution across Google Workspace, Slack, Zoom, Box, Atlassian, and Microsoft, including automations supporting access modifications

  • Deploy, configure, maintain, and recover corporate Macs through Jamf while supporting CrowdStrike and Cloudflare Zero Trust and maintaining strong fleet compliance

  • Build and own automations for high-volume manual workflows using Jira Automation, Okta Workflows, REST APIs, webhooks, and Python, Bash, or JavaScript from problem definition through testing, rollout, documentation, and monitoring

  • Apply approved AI tools to ticket triage, troubleshooting, log analysis, knowledge-base development, and script generation while validating outputs for accuracy, security, privacy, and maintainability

  • Transform recurring support issues into automations and employee-facing self-service resources that improve productivity and reduce support volume

  • Monitor service queues against team SLOs, identify emerging issues and patterns, and communicate risks and potential solutions early

  • Manage inventory purchasing for your area and contribute to security awareness and operational resilience efforts

  • Mentor junior teammates through pairing, walkthroughs, and documentation, including practical and responsible adoption of AI-assisted workflows

  • Support Zoom Rooms, AV, and office network issues in partnership with Infrastructure and collaborate with Security on endpoint configuration, access reviews, and remediation

  • Contribute to a collaborative environment rooted in ownership, learning, teaching, transparency, and continuous improvement

What we look for:

  • 3–5 years of experience owning IT operations, service desk, or endpoint management work with a demonstrated ability to resolve issues independently

  • Hands-on experience administering macOS and Jamf and managing Google Workspace users, groups, licenses, and security settings

  • Working knowledge of identity and access management concepts including SSO, MFA, least privilege, RBAC, audit logging, and joiner, mover, and leaver processes

  • Demonstrated experience using AI in a support environment for activities such as ticket triage, troubleshooting, documentation, or script authoring, paired with the judgment to identify inaccurate or unsafe outputs

  • Practical automation skills spanning scripting, APIs, webhooks, JSON, authentication, integration debugging, testing, deployment, and ongoing monitoring

  • Strong root-cause analysis and problem-solving skills across endpoints, identity, and business applications

  • ITSM fluency and sound judgment when handling credentials, access requests, security issues, and employee data

  • Ability to communicate technical issues, risks, and tradeoffs clearly and proactively to technical and non-technical partners

  • Willingness to learn about cutting-edge technologies while continuously building expertise in enterprise technology, security, automation, and AI-assisted workflows

Bonus:

  • Experience with Okta Workflows, Jamf Pro, Jira Service Management, Jira Automation, Confluence, Microsoft 365, Intune, or Zoom Rooms

  • Experience with low-code or agentic automation platforms

  • Okta, Jamf, CompTIA, or other relevant IT certifications

About Ridgeline

Ridgeline is the first front-to-back system of record for investment managers. Founded by visionary entrepreneur Dave Duffield (co-founder of both PeopleSoft and Workday), the company was created to modernize an industry held back by outdated, disconnected technology. Powered by a single, real-time data set and embedded AI, Ridgeline helps firms automate complexity, accelerate collaboration, and deliver tailored client experiences at scale, without added headcount or risk. Ridgeline is headquartered in Lake Tahoe, with offices in New York, Reno, and the Bay Area, and is recognized by Fast Company as a “Best Workplace for Innovators,” by Frost & Sullivan as a “Technology Innovation Leader,” and by The Software Report as a “Top 100 Software Company.”

Ridgeline is proud to be a community-minded, discrimination-free equal opportunity workplace.

Ridgeline processes the information you submit in connection with your application in accordance with the Ridgeline Applicant Privacy Statement. Please review the Ridgeline Applicant Privacy Statement in full to understand our privacy practices and contact us with any questions.

Compensation and Benefits

The typical starting salary range for new hires in this role is $87,000–$102,500. Final compensation amounts are determined by multiple factors, including candidate experience and expertise and may vary from the amount listed above.

As an employee at Ridgeline, you’ll have many opportunities for advancement in your career and can make a true impact on the product.

In addition to the base salary, Ridgeline employees can participate in our Company Stock Plan subject to the applicable Stock Option Agreement. We also offer rich benefits that reflect the kind of organization we want to be: one in which our employees feel valued and are inspired to bring their best selves to work. These include unlimited vacation, educational and wellness reimbursements, and $0 cost employee insurance plans. Please check out our Careers page for a more comprehensive overview of our perks and benefits.

title: Faglighed sover aldrig – vil du med på natholdet?
description:
Brænder du for at gøre en forskel om natten? Trives du med ansvar, selvstændighed og høj faglighed? Så er du måske en af vores nye kollegaer på det udekørende nathold i Svendborg Kommune.

Har du lyst til at bruge dine kompetencer og samtidig blive fagligt udfordret?

Vi søger en social- og sundhedshjælper og en social- og sundhedsassistent til faste stillinger på vores udekørende nathold med tiltrædelse 1. november 2026 eller snarest muligt.

Hos os får du mulighed for at bruge hele din faglighed. Om natten arbejder vi selvstændigt og tæt på borgerne, og du vil møde både kendte, planlagte opgaver og situationer, der kræver, at du kan observere, vurdere, prioritere og handle.

Du står samtidig aldrig alene. Vi arbejder som et hold og bruger aktivt hinandens forskellige fagligheder.

Om jobbet

Du bliver en del af et velfungerende nathold med 12 dygtige og dedikerede medarbejdere, som hver nat arbejder for at skabe tryghed, kvalitet og nærvær for borgerne i Svendborg Kommune.

Som en del af det udekørende nathold kommer du i borgernes eget hjem og møder mennesker med meget forskellige behov. Det kræver både faglighed, selvstændighed og evnen til at skabe ro og tryghed – også når natten ikke går helt som planlagt.

Du får et tæt samarbejde med sygeplejerskerne i den udekørende sygepleje og Akutfunktionen, som også er på arbejde om natten. Samtidig har du en synlig leder og en planlægger tæt på, som du kan sparre med.

Hos os er arbejdsmiljøet lige så vigtigt som fagligheden. Vi tror på, at høj kvalitet i opgaveløsningen skabes gennem psykologisk tryghed, gensidig respekt og et stærkt kollegialt fællesskab.

Vi har plads til spørgsmål, forskellige perspektiver og faglige drøftelser. Vi forventer ikke, at du kan alt – men vi forventer, at du er nysgerrig, tager ansvar og tør række ud, når du har brug for dine kollegaer.

Hvorfor vælge natten?

Natarbejde er noget særligt.

Der er færre mennesker omkring dig, men det gør ikke opgaven mindre vigtig – tværtimod. Du får mulighed for at arbejde selvstændigt, bruge din faglighed og være den, der skaber tryghed for et menneske på et tidspunkt af døgnet, hvor verden omkring dem er stille. Når noget uventet opstår, løser vi det sammen.

Hvis du kan se dig selv i det, vil vi rigtig gerne høre fra dig.

Vi søger dig, der

  • Er uddannet social- og sundhedshjælper eller social- og sundhedsassistent
  • Har kørekort
  • Trives med at arbejde om natten og kan arbejde selvstændigt
  • Er engageret, udviklingsorienteret og tager initiativ
  • Tager ansvar og kan argumentere fagligt for dine observationer og beslutninger
  • Arbejder med udgangspunkt i borgerens ressourcer og med fokus på rehabilitering
  • Kan bevare roen og overblikket i pressede og uforudsete situationer
  • Tør spørge, når du er i tvivl, og række ud efter hjælp, når situationen kræver det
  • Er mødestabil og bidrager positivt til arbejdsfællesskabet
  • Møder borgere, pårørende og samarbejdspartnere nysgerrigt og anerkendende
  • Har lyst til at bidrage til en kultur, hvor vi hjælper hinanden, lærer af hinanden og spiller hinanden gode.

Om dig:

Vi forventer, at du:

  • Har høj faglighed og trives med selvstændigt ansvar.
  • Kan bevare roen og træffe gode beslutninger – også når tempoet er højt.
  • Er kreativ og løsningsorienteret i din tilgang til opgaverne.
  • Kommunikerer tydeligt og respektfuldt.
  • Har flair for dokumentation og IT.
  • Bidrager aktivt til et godt arbejdsmiljø og et stærkt tværfagligt samarbejde.

Om os:

Hos os bliver du en del af et nathold, hvor faglighed og arbejdsglæde går hånd i hånd. Vi prioriterer psykologisk tryghed, en synlig ledelse, tæt tværfagligt samarbejde og en kultur, hvor vi hjælper hinanden og spiller hinanden gode. Vi tror på, at de bedste løsninger skabes sammen, og at et godt arbejdsmiljø er fundamentet for god pleje.

Vi tilbyder:

  • En grundig introduktion med mentorordning og oplæring ved erfarne kolleger.
  • En sektion med god struktur, planlægning og et sundt arbejdsmiljø.
  • Et dynamisk arbejdssted med spændende og afvekslende opgaver.
  • Gode muligheder for faglig udvikling.
  • Et stærkt kollegialt fællesskab og et tæt tværfagligt samarbejde.
  • En planlagt vagtdækning, hvor den rette faglighed altid er til stede, når der er brug for den.

Om Ældreområdet
Når du arbejder på ældreområdet, møder du bag hver enkelt dør et unikt menneske. Et menneske, du gør en forskel for. Hos os har du frihed til at møde netop dét menneske – måske i en lille snak, i en svær stund eller med en hjælpende hånd.

Vi har ikke én færdig opskrift på det gode ældre liv, fordi vi hylder forskelligheden. Til gengæld gør vi os umage med altid at møde det enkelte menneske med værdighed, respekt og høj faglighed.

Vi skaber de bedste rammer for, at du kan udføre dit arbejde godt og meningsfuldt, og vi har samtidig høje forventninger til din faglighed. Hos os får du mulighed for at bruge dine kompetencer og udvikle dem yderligere.

Om Svendborg Kommune
Svendborg Kommune er i vores øjne en arbejdsplads af en helt perfekt størrelse: Vi er små nok til at være tæt på hinanden i et varmt uhøjtideligt fællesskab med korte kommandoveje og uden skjulte dagsordner. Og vi er store nok til at have god plads til ambitioner, høj faglighed og rige muligheder for udvikling.
Vi holder af hverdagen og insisterer på, at det skal være rart at gå på arbejde. Vi har travlt, men ikke for travlt til at hjælpe hinanden.
Vores værdier findes ikke kun på papiret, vi bruger dem faktisk som kompas hver dag. Vi møder hinanden i øjenhøjde, i dialog og med tillid, og sammen skaber vi en tryg ramme, hvor vi alle kan løse vores opgaver selvstændigt, fleksibelt og ansvarligt.


Løn og ansættelse:
Stillingen er en fastansættelse fra den 1. november 2026 på 37 timer pr. måned.

Arbejdsstedet er; Fåborgvej 64, 5700 Svendborg

I Svendborg Kommune ligger lønnen for denne type stilling for en social og sundhedsassistent typisk mellem 36.205 og 46.820 kr. pr. måned ved fuldtidsansættelse og for en social- og sundhedshjælper typisk mellem 33.962 og 43.131 kr. ved fuldtidsansættelse. Lønnen er inklusive pension, særlig feriegodtgørelse og faste tillæg. Der kan desuden være arbejdstidsbestemte tillæg og andre særydelser. Det er vigtigt at bemærke, at din konkrete løn fastsættes ud fra din erfaring, anciennitet og kompetencer og aftales ved forhandling med den relevante faglige organisation.

Der skal afleveres en privat straffeattest ved ansættelse i stillingen.

Svendborg Kommune har røgfri arbejdstid. Vi ønsker, at røgfri arbejdstid skal bidrage til et sundt arbejdsmiljø for alle medarbejdere.

Ansøgning:

Ansøgningsfristen er den 23. september 2026

Der planlægges ansættelsessamtaler mandag den 28. september 2026.

For yderligere information er du velkommen til at kontakte Sektionsleder Anne Hasseltoft på telefon 2479 6103.

Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig.

Velkommen til Svendborg - Øhavets hovedstad!
Svendborg har en suveræn beliggenhed midt i den skønneste natur, på kanten af det Sydfynske Øhav og med en mini-metropol, der byder på det hele. Vi tøver ikke, når vi med stolthed kalder Svendborg for Fyns kulturhovedstad. Vi har en charmerende bymidte og livlig handelsby med teatre og museer samt et rigt foreningsliv. Vores dagtilbud og folkeskoler er i top og med særligt fokus på bevægelse og sport, og vi har flere videregående uddannelser, som snart samles i et attraktivt uddannelsesmiljø ved havnen. Svendborg er placeret midt i landet med en halv time til Odense og under to timer til København og Århus. Svendborg er med sine ca. 60.000 indbyggere Fyns andenstørste kommune.

title: Integrations EDI Lead Engineer
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for an Integrations EDI Lead Engineer based in the United States.

As an Integrations EDI Lead Engineer, you will play a pivotal role in modernizing enterprise healthcare interoperability.
You will lead the design, development, and delivery of scalable EDI, HL7, and FHIR integration solutions.
The role combines hands-on engineering with technical leadership, architecture, mentoring, and cross-functional collaboration.
You will help evolve traditional batch-based EDI processes toward cloud-native, real-time interoperability.
Your work will support critical healthcare data exchange between payers, providers, clearinghouses, and technology partners.
You will also influence engineering standards, reliability, observability, and platform modernization at scale.
This is a high-impact opportunity to shape the future of healthcare integration while helping a growing engineering team deliver meaningful technology solutions.

Accountabilities:

  • Lead technical architecture and implementation for enterprise healthcare integration initiatives spanning HIPAA X12 transactions, HL7, and FHIR APIs.
  • Design and develop scalable data exchange solutions, transformation workflows, mappings, validation frameworks, error handling, and reconciliation processes.
  • Build and maintain integrations connecting internal platforms with payers, providers, clearinghouses, and third-party vendors.
  • Guide the modernization of legacy EDI capabilities toward microservices, event-driven architectures, cloud-native deployments, and real-time interoperability.
  • Establish engineering standards, lead design reviews, promote best practices, and mentor junior and mid-level engineers.
  • Partner with DevOps and SRE teams to automate deployments, improve scalability and resiliency, strengthen observability, and maintain high availability for mission-critical transaction processing.
  • Monitor system performance, investigate production issues, and contribute to incident resolution and continuous reliability improvements.
  • Collaborate with Product, Engineering, Business Analysis, and external partners to translate business requirements into effective technical solutions.
  • Drive strategic modernization initiatives, improve transaction throughput, and introduce scalable FHIR-enabled integration capabilities.
  • Help establish a modern integration ecosystem and influence the long-term architecture of healthcare data exchange.

    • Requirements

    • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related discipline, or equivalent professional experience.
    • 8+ years of software engineering experience, including at least 5 years focused on healthcare EDI.
    • Strong expertise in HIPAA X12 transactions, including 837, 835, 270/271, 276/277, and 278, as well as solid knowledge of HL7 and FHIR standards.
    • Hands-on programming experience with Java, C#, Go, or comparable languages.
    • Proven experience developing REST APIs, microservices, and event-driven architectures.
    • Practical experience with Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD pipelines, and cloud-native development practices.
    • Strong knowledge of SQL and/or NoSQL databases, performance optimization, and high-volume transaction processing.
    • Understanding of healthcare interoperability, data governance, security best practices, and payer workflows or claims processing.
    • Strong technical leadership, communication, mentoring, and problem-solving skills, with the ability to translate complex technical concepts for diverse stakeholders.
    • Experience working independently while providing technical direction and collaborating effectively across engineering, product, business, and vendor teams.
    • Preferred: experience with Edifecs xEngine, XEServer, EAM, or SpecBuilder.
    • Preferred: experience with Azure, AWS, or Google Cloud, along with knowledge of SMART on FHIR, OAuth2, and OpenID Connect.
    • Preferred: previous experience leading technical teams and driving enterprise-scale modernization initiatives.

      • Benefits

      • $140,000 annual salary
      • Competitive compensation and annual bonus program.
      • 401(k) retirement plan with company match.
      • Company-paid life insurance.
      • Company-paid short-term disability coverage, subject to location restrictions.
      • Medical, vision, and dental benefits.
      • Paid time off and paid sick time.
      • Paid parental leave.
      • Paid company holidays and floating holidays.
      • Quarterly company-sponsored events.
      • Health and wellness programs.
      • Career development and professional growth opportunities.
      • Remote opportunities available in Arizona, Colorado, Connecticut, Florida, Georgia, Idaho, Illinois, Kentucky, Massachusetts, Michigan, North Carolina, Nevada, New Jersey, New York, Ohio, Pennsylvania, South Carolina, Tennessee, Texas, Virginia, and Washington.
      • A collaborative, team-oriented environment focused on innovation, continuous improvement, and meaningful healthcare technology.
