title: Gartner til Service & Teknik ved Regionshospitalet Horsens
description:
Kunne du tænke dig et job med sund balance mellem arbejde og fritid?
Har du passion for grønne områder, sans for æstetik og lyst til at skabe indbydende grønne bæredygtige omgivelser for vores brugere?
Så er det nu, du skal slå til.

Regionshospitalet Horsens søger en kollega, som har lyst og evner til at bidrage til driften af et hospital med spændende udfordringer og udviklingsopgaver

Din nye hverdag
Du kommer til at indgå i vores tekniske team som tæller 21 topmotiverede medarbejdere. Sammen vedligeholder og udvikler vi vores bygninger, installationer og grønne områder. Dette sker i tæt samspil med regionale samarbejdspartnere og eksterne serviceleverandører.

På Regionshospitalet Horsens er planter og grønne miljøer en vigtig del af den stemning, vores brugere møder. Vi søger derfor en engageret og selvstændig gartner med stort hjerte for planter, æstetik og brugeroplevelser. Opgaven omfatter pleje og udvikling af vores udendørs beplantning med ansvar for, at vores ankomstområder, park, terrasser og nære grønne opholdsområder altid fremstår velplejede, levende og indbydende.

Som gartner hos os bliver du en central medspiller i at skabe de grønne rammer, der giver vores brugere en særlig oplevelse af nærvær, natur og trivsel. Det handler ikke om tungt anlægsarbejde, men om professionel plantepleje, god planlægning og et skarpt blik for det visuelle udtryk i de områder, hvor gæsterne færdes og opholder sig. Opgaverne spænder over:

  • Pleje, tilsyn og sæsonmæssige opdatering af beplantning på hospitalets udendørs områder
  • Sikre optimale vækstbetingelser. Herunder vanding, gødning, beskæring, ukrudtsbekæmpelse og løbende plantepleje
  • Løbende vurdering af planternes trivsel og hurtig handling ved behov for justeringer
  • Bidrage til, at terrasser og grønne opholdsområder altid fremstår rene, velplejede og indbydende for gæsterne
  • Planlægning af sæsonpleje, udskiftning og langsigtet vedligehold
  • Bidrage til dokumentation, planteovervågning og bestillinger
  • Betjening og vedligehold af maskiner og redskaber

Du skal primært varetage opgaver relateret til den grønne drift. I varierende grad er det forekommende service- og vedligeholdsopgaver for bygninger og installationer - indendørs såvel som udendørs.

Om dig
Som person er du serviceminded, kan arbejde selvstændigt, er ansvarsfuld og tager ejerskab for dine arbejdsopgaver. Du evner at prioritere dine opgaver sammen med din daglige leder og trives med rutineprægede arbejdsopgaver.

Vi forventer at du:

  • Er uddannet gartner, anlægsgartner eller lignende uddannelse indenfor grøn drift og vedligehold
  • Har indgående plantekendskab
  • Har sans for kvalitet og godt håndværk
  • Arbejder struktureret og selvstændigt og trives med at tage ansvar
  • Trives med både praktiske og tekniske opgaver
  • Er holdspiller og bidrager til et godt samarbejde
  • Møder både kollegaer og brugere med respekt, åbenhed og godt humør

Om Os
Du bliver en del af Service & Teknik med 350 medarbejdere. Service & Teknik varetager opgaver på tværs af de tre matrikler Regionshospitalet Horsens, Skanderborg Sundhedshus og Livstilscentret i Brædstrup. Ansvarsområdet spænder over logistik, køkken, service serviceassistenter og teknisk personale.

I Service & Teknik er fremtiden noget vi løbende forbereder os på og vores medarbejdere spiller en vigtig rolle. Det betyder, at du har mulighed for at gå innovativt til opgaven, og er med til at forme dit eget område.

Teknisk Afsnit er en del af Service & Teknik. Vi varetager drift og vedligeholdelse af bygninger, tekniske anlæg, installationer samt hospitalsteknisk udstyr på hele hospitalet. Dette alt imens at hospitalets kliniske sengeafdelinger, operationsafsnit samt ambulante klinikker har patienter, som skal behandles. Vi har en stor kontaktflade både internt til de øvrige afdelinger på hospitalet, de regionale samarbejdspartnere og til de over hundrede eksterne serviceleverandører, som udfører opgaver for Regionshospitalet Horsens. For at sikre den brede tekniske opgavevaretagelse er en lang række forskellige faggrupper repræsenteret i afdelingen f.eks. Ingeniører, maskinmester, bygningskonstruktør, elektriker, elektroniktekniker og VVS-tekniker.

Om Regionshospitalet Horsens
Regionshospitalet i Horsens er et af de mindre hospitaler i Region Midtjylland, og det, synes vi selv, er en af vores største styrker. Vi er der for patienterne dag og nat, men vi er gode til at deles, også om vagterne. Med vores hospitals størrelse har vi en nærhed og et fællesskab, som større arbejdspladser kan have svært ved at hamle op med. Det får det daglige samarbejde til at glide lettere, fordi vi kender hinanden og ved, at vi har hinandens ryg. Både når vi lykkes, og når vi en gang imellem begår en fejl. Så lærer vi af det sammen.

Vores vision er 'Regionshospitalet Horsens som attraktiv arbejdsplads, uddannelses- og behandlingssted samt samarbejdspartner' med fokus på både medarbejderne og patienterne. Der venter dig knap 2.000 kolleger på Regionshospitalet i Horsens. På tværs af afdelinger og specialer møder vi hinanden som mennesker samtidig med, at vi har hver vores fagprofil. Det gælder også, når vi byder nye kolleger velkommen.

Du kan læse mere om Regionshospitalet Horsens og Service & Teknik på .

Praktiske oplysninger
Stillingen er med ansættelse pr. 1. november 2026 eller efter aftale.

Arbejdstiden er 25 timer ugentligt med mulighed for fleksibilitet efter arbejdsopgaverne.

Løn og ansættelsesvilkår følger gældende overenskomst mellem Danske Regioner og den relevante faglige organisation.
Region Midtjylland er jf. EU’s løngennemsigtighedsdirektiv, der trådte i kraft 7. juni 2026 forpligtet til at oplyse dig om startløn eller et interval for startløn for en stilling inden du tilbydes ansættelse.
Her finder du Region Midtjyllands lønkatalog for de fleste faggrupper og stillinger, som findes i Region Midtjylland: Gennemsigtighed forud for ansættelse - Medarbejder.rm.dk

Vil du vide mere er du velkommen til at henvende dig til Teknisk Chef René Mørch Kjellerup, tlf. 51 300 100.

Ansøgningsfrist er den 16. september 2026.

Ansættelsessamtaler forventes at blive afholdt den 23. september 2026.

Det er et krav at du har kørekort kategori B, da vi transporterer os rundt mellem vores adresser.

En forudsætning for ansættelse ved hospitalet er i øvrigt, at der gives samtykke til indhentelse af straffe- og børneattest, og at disse er tilfredsstillende.

Vi glæder os til at modtage din ansøgning!

Da Region Midtjylland løbende gennemfører besparelser og omorganiseringer, vil medarbejdere i omplacering, der søger stillingen, have fortrinsret.

title: Electro-Mechanical / Industrial Maintenance Skills Instructor
description:
Turn Your Industry Experience Into Someone's Career

Are you an experienced Industrial Maintenance Technician, Industrial Electrician, Electro-Mechanical Technician, Controls Technician, PLC Technician, or Maintenance Supervisor looking for a career where you can make a difference?

Tec Centro – Capital Region is seeking an experienced Electro-Mechanical / Industrial Maintenance Instructor to provide hands-on technical training to individuals preparing for careers in industrial maintenance, manufacturing, electrical, automation, and skilled trades.

You don't need to be a career educator to succeed in this role.

If you know how to troubleshoot industrial equipment, diagnose electrical and mechanical problems, work safely, and explain how systems work, we want to hear from you.

This is an opportunity to take the knowledge you've developed in the field and use it to prepare the next generation of skilled technical workers in Central Pennsylvania.

What You'll Teach

You'll provide a combination of classroom, laboratory, demonstration, and hands-on instruction covering core industrial maintenance and electro-mechanical skills.

Training topics may include:

  • Electrical fundamentals and electrical safety
  • AC/DC electrical systems
  • Industrial wiring and electrical components
  • Motors, motor controls, starters, relays, contactors, and transformers
  • Electrical troubleshooting and diagnostics
  • Industrial electrical systems
  • Mechanical systems and power transmission
  • Bearings, belts, chains, gears, couplings, and related components
  • Pneumatic and hydraulic systems
  • Industrial controls and automation
  • Programmable Logic Controllers (PLCs)
  • Sensors, switches, and control devices
  • Preventive and predictive maintenance
  • Industrial equipment troubleshooting
  • Reading electrical schematics and mechanical drawings
  • Electrical meters and diagnostic equipment
  • Hand and power tools
  • Lockout/Tagout (LOTO)
  • OSHA and workplace safety practices
  • Basic industrial maintenance principles
  • Workplace communication and professionalism
  • Job readiness and expectations for industrial environments

    • Training content may evolve based on employer needs, student skill levels, available equipment, and changing workforce requirements.

Required Qualifications

  • 5+ years of hands-on industry experience in one or more of the following:
    • Industrial maintenance
    • Industrial electrical
    • Electrical maintenance
    • Electro-mechanical systems
    • Manufacturing maintenance
    • Automation and controls
    • PLCs
    • Mechanical maintenance
    • Industrial machinery
    • Mechatronics
    • Strong understanding of electrical and mechanical systems.
    • Demonstrated ability to troubleshoot industrial equipment and systems.
    • Ability to read and interpret electrical schematics, mechanical drawings, and technical documentation.
    • Strong commitment to workplace safety and proper work practices.
    • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
    • Ability to explain technical concepts clearly to individuals with varying levels of education and experience.
    • Ability and willingness to work in a hands-on training environment.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Previous experience teaching, training, mentoring, or supervising employees.
  • Experience working with apprentices, entry-level technicians, or individuals entering the skilled trades.
  • PLC programming or troubleshooting experience.
  • Industrial automation and controls experience.
  • Manufacturing or production equipment experience.
  • OSHA and/or NFPA 70E knowledge.
  • Lockout/Tagout experience.
  • Relevant industry certifications or licenses.
  • Associate degree, technical diploma, or formal training in electrical, electro-mechanical, industrial maintenance, automation, mechatronics, or a related field.

    • Teaching experience is preferred but not required. Strong industry experience combined with the ability to teach, communicate, and mentor others is highly valued.

Experienced Professionals Encouraged to Apply

Your current job title doesn't have to be "Instructor."

Tec Centro welcomes candidates with backgrounds such as:

  • Industrial Maintenance Technician
  • Industrial Maintenance Mechanic
  • Industrial Electrician
  • Maintenance Electrician
  • Electrical Technician
  • Electro-Mechanical Technician
  • Electro-Mechanical Engineer/Technician
  • Automation Technician
  • Controls Technician
  • PLC Technician
  • Maintenance Supervisor
  • Industrial Maintenance Supervisor
  • Manufacturing Maintenance Technician
  • Mechatronics Technician
  • Mechanical Maintenance Technician
  • Industrial Controls Specialist
  • Automation Specialist
  • Skilled Trades Trainer
  • Technical Trainer
  • Technical Instructor

If you've spent years fixing, maintaining, troubleshooting, and improving industrial equipment, you may have exactly the experience we're looking for.

The Ideal Candidate

The successful candidate will be:

Hands-On – Enjoys demonstrating how equipment and systems work.

Patient & Supportive – Understands that students enter training with different levels of experience.

A Strong Communicator – Can make complex technical concepts easy to understand.

Safety-Focused – Consistently models professional and safe workplace practices.

A Mentor – Takes pride in helping others develop technical skills and confidence.

Industry-Minded – Understands the skills employers expect from entry-level industrial maintenance and technical workers.

Adaptable – Can adjust instruction to different learning styles, student abilities, equipment, and employer requirements.

Career-Focused – Understands that successful training ultimately means helping students become employable and advance their careers.

Why Join Tec Centro?

This is more than a traditional teaching position.

At Tec Centro, you'll have the opportunity to:

  • Turn your years of industry experience into a new generation of skilled workers.
  • Help individuals develop technical skills that can lead to sustainable careers.
  • Make a direct impact on the Central Pennsylvania workforce.
  • Work with students from diverse educational and professional backgrounds.
  • Bring real-world industrial experience into a hands-on training environment.
  • Build relationships with local employers and industry partners.
  • Help address the growing demand for qualified industrial maintenance, electrical, automation, and skilled-trades professionals.
  • Make a meaningful difference in the lives and careers of your students.

title: Serviceassistent eller servicemedarbejder søges til Neurointensiv Rehabilitering og Klinik for Mave- og Infektionssygdomme (KMI), Regionshospitalet Silkeborg
description:
Vi søger en serviceassistent eller servicemedarbejder til en fast stilling fra 1. november 2026 på 37 timer pr. uge. Stillingen indebærer primært dagvagter, og derudover vil enkelte sendagvagter fra kl. 10-18 forekomme. Du vil have weekendvagt hver 5. weekend, ligesom du også vil have vagter på helligdage.

Funktionsområde
Du vil blive en del af en serviceassistentgruppe, som deltager i mange alsidige opgaver på Neurointensiv Rehabilitering og Klinik for Mave- og Infektionssygdomme. Arbejdsområderne bliver hovedsageligt rengøring og rengøring af skoper. Desuden vil du skulle bistå sygeplejerskerne til forflytning og mobilisering af patienterne.

Vi tilbyder

  • At du bliver en del af en rigtig god arbejdsplads, hvor vi forventer noget af den enkelte, men hvor der også er gode muligheder for udvikling og vedligeholdelse af dine kompetencer.
  • Et godt arbejdsmiljø, hvor dialog vægtes højt.
  • En arbejdsplads med fokus på service og høj kvalitet i pleje, behandling og rehabilitering med tværfaglige samarbejdspartnere
  • Oplæring til de forskellige funktioner, som jobbet indebærer.

Du tilbyder

  • Erfaring med rengøring og evt. erfaring med rengøring af skoper.
  • At du kommer glad og engageret på arbejde og har et stabilt fremmøde.
  • Da arbejdsdagene hos os er uforudsigelige og spændende, er det nødvendigt, at du er indstillet på at være fleksibel og kan prioritere dagens opgaver i samarbejde med dine kollegaer.
  • At du sammen med dine kolleger, vil være med til at bibeholde en fantastisk arbejdsplads med et godt arbejdsmiljø.
  • Er omhyggelig og ansvarsbevidst i forhold til dit arbejde.

Om afsnittet Neurointensiv Rehabilitering, Center for planlagt Kirurgi (CPK) og Klinik for Mave- og Infektionssygdomme, Medicinsk Diagnostisk Center (MDC)
Neurointensiv Rehabilitering har 5 sengepladser - heraf 4,5 neurointensiv rehabiliteringssenge og 0,5 ortopædkirurgisk intensiv plads.

På Neurointensiv Rehabilitering modtages intensive patienter med erhvervet hjerneskade (efter f.eks. traumer eller blødning). Patienterne er henvist til Regionshospitalet Hammel Neurocenter (RHN), men de indlægges her i tidlig fase for at modtage højt specialiseret neurorehabilitering samtidig med, at intensiv terapi foregår.

Personalegruppen består af sygeplejersker, intensivsygeplejersker, anæstesilæger, ergo- og fysioterapeuter, sekretærer og serviceassistenter.
Desuden uddannes sygeplejestuderende i afsnittet.

På Klinik for Mave- og Infektionssygdomme undersøges og behandles patienter for sygdom i mave/tarm og lever.
Personalegruppen består af sygeplejersker, speciallæger og sekretær. Her uddannes studerende og elever.

Ansættelsen sker ved Hospitalsenhed Midt, læs mere om den samlede hospitalsenhed her www.hospitalsenhedmidt.dk
Interesserede ansøgere, uanset personlig baggrund, opfordres til at søge stillingen.

Løn- og ansættelsesvilkår
Løn- og ansættelsesvilkår er i henhold til gældende overenskomst på området.
Med henvisning til lov om børneattest i forbindelse med ansættelse af personale m.v., vil der blive indhentet børneattest i forbindelse med eventuel ansættelse.
Ansættelse sker ved Region Midtjylland med tjeneste indtil videre ved Hospitalsenhed Midt, Center for planlagt Kirurgi.

Yderligere oplysninger
Yderligere oplysninger om stillingen kan fås ved henvendelse til oversygeplejerske Mette Hoff på telefonnr.: 78 41 66 59

Din ansøgning
Din ansøgning indeholdende autorisations ID, oplysninger om uddannelse og hidtidig erfaring skal være os i hænde elektronisk senest den 22. september 2026
Samtaler forventes afholdt den 25. september 2026

Stillingen er som udgangspunkt en fuldtidsstilling.
Da Region Midtjylland løbende gennemfører besparelser og omorganiseringer, vil medarbejdere i omplacering, der søger stillingen, have fortrinsret.

Region Midtjylland er jf. EU’s løngennemsigtighedsdirektiv, der trådte i kraft 7. juni 2026 forpligtet til at oplyse dig om startløn eller et interval for startløn for en stilling inden du tilbydes ansættelse. Her finder du Region Midtjyllands lønkatalog for de fleste faggrupper og stillinger, som findes i Region Midtjylland: Gennemsigtighed forud for ansættelse - Medarbejder.rm.dk

title: Massør med fleksible arbejdstider i Slagelse og omegn
description:
Brænder du for at hjælpe andre mennesker og gøre en forskel i hverdagen?
Vil du også gerne have balance mellem arbejde og fritid og selv bestemme dine arbejdstider?
Så er det dig, vi mangler på vores team af udekørende behandlere.

Hvem er vi?

RaskRask er et landsdækkende koncept for behandling og velvære. Vi tilbyder massage i hjemmet og på arbejdspladsen. Med mere end 250 engagerede fagpersoner og 10.000 glade kunder, er vi et populært og veletableret koncept. Vi vil gerne gøre det nemt at være selvstændig behandler og give dig frihed og fleksibilitet i din hverdag. Vores dedikerede team på kontoret i Aarhus tager sig af alt det praktiske som hjemmeside, bookingsystem, markedsføring og administration, så du får tid og overskud til at give den bedst mulige behandling til dine kunder og gøre en forskel, hvor det kan mærkes.

Hvad får du ud af det?

  • Fleksible arbejdstider: Hos RaskRask bestemmer du selv, hvornår og hvor meget du gerne vil arbejde.

  • Stærkt netværk af fagpersoner: Du vil blive en del af vores stærke netværk, der består af mere end 250 behandlere med forskellige faglige baggrunde.

  • Minimal administration: Vi sørger for alt det praktiske såsom markedsføring, bookingsystem og administration, så du slipper for at tænke på det.

  • Faglig udvikling: Mulighed for faglig udvikling gennem sparring med andre behandlere, vores samarbejde med At Work skolen samt vores interne læringsunivers.


Hvordan fungerer samarbejdet?

Vi har sørget for hjemmeside, bookingsystem, markedsføring og forsikring, så du kan koncentrere dig om at give en fantastisk massageoplevelse.

Du får adgang til vores partner-app, hvor du kan se dine bookings, kontakte kunderne og vælge det område, du ønsker at dække. I partner-app’en kan du åbne din kalender de dage og timer, du ønsker at arbejde og derved sammensætte din arbejdsdag, præcis som du ønsker. Kunderne har mulighed for at booke en tid med dig direkte gennem vores hjemmeside, nemt og enkelt.


Hvem er du?

  • Du er uddannet massør, kropsterapeut, fysioterapeut eller fysioterapeutstuderende (4.-7. semester).

  • Du er passioneret for dit fag, og elsker at gøre en forskel for andre mennesker

  • Du er kvalitetsbevidst og serviceminded og nyder at have kontakt med mennesker i din dagligdag.

Info@RaskRask.dk

title: Solutions Architect
description:
About Dialpad
Dialpad is the AI platform for customer experience, built to resolve customer problems in real time across voice and digital. Our AI agents learn from your best human agents and improve with every interaction, helping organizations understand their customers, deliver better experiences, increase operational efficiencies, and build a lasting competitive advantage.

Unlike legacy systems built to route and answer, or standalone agentic bot vendors built to deflect, Dialpad was built to resolve. Our AI agents and human agents operate on a single platform with shared context, allowing Agentic AI to resolve issues, advance deals, and eliminate busywork through automation while seamlessly handing conversations to humans when needed, with full context preserved.

Market-leading brands, including Randstad, Motorola Solutions, Netflix, the San Diego Padres, the Colorado Rockies Baseball Club, and Cal Athletics, trust Dialpad. Dialpad is backed by Andreessen Horowitz, GV, ICONIQ Capital, and T-Mobile.

Being a Dialer
At Dialpad, AI isn’t just a feature; it’s how our teams do their best work every day. We put powerful AI tools in every employee’s hands so they can move faster, think bigger, and achieve more.

We believe every conversation matters. And we’ve built the platform that turns those conversations into insight and action, for our customers and ourselves.

We look for people who are intensely curious and hold themselves to a high bar. Our ambition is significant, and achieving it requires a team that operates at the highest level. We seek individuals who embody our core traits: Scrappy, Curious, Optimistic, Persistent, and Empathetic.

Your role
Joining Dialpad as a Solutions Architect means stepping into a pivotal role where your problem-solving prowess and genuine passion for helping others will play a crucial part in ensuring our customers are set up for access on their Day 1 with Dialpad. From the initial call to the final interaction, you'll have the opportunity to dazzle and support our clients at every step, making a lasting impact with each connection. You will act as a subject-matter expert, provide consulting and guidance on technical solutions, and ultimately deliver a world-class experience for our customers.

This position reports to our Manager, Solution Architect. Must be able to work US hours.

What you'll do

  • You will design and configure contact center call flows, ensuring seamless integrations with business systems and accurate reporting data.
  • You will collaborate with clients to understand their operational needs and tailor Dialpad solutions to optimize call handling, automation, and analytics.
  • You will provision and configure desk phones, providing best practices and recommendations for an efficient setup.
  • You will lead deployment efforts, overseeing call flow design, integrations, and system configurations to align with business objectives.
  • You will troubleshoot issues and help identify and report bugs during deployments, ensuring a smooth transition and minimizing disruptions for end users.
  • You will analyze and refine workflows, proactively identifying areas for improvement to enhance efficiency and performance.
  • You will perform risk analysis and change management, ensuring project success and on-time delivery.
  • You will conduct video conferencing sessions to provide expert insights, guide clients through implementation, and ensure the adoption of best practices.

Skills you'll bring

  • Excellent grasp of various modern cloud communications platforms, such as Google G-Suite and Office 365.
  • Experience with Business VoIP Telephony Services (On-Premise or SaaS).
  • Understanding and experience with:
    • VoIP CODECs and technologies (G.711, G.729, G.722, OPUS, H.264, VP8, VP9, WebRTC, H.323, SIP, Network Analyzers).
    • Network Infrastructure (Firewalls, Routers, Switches & Wireless); WAN Technologies (MPLS, VPLS & SD-WAN).
    • Data Center Technologies (Public & Private Clouds).
    • Software components involved in enterprise service delivery (web servers, application servers, databases, web services, mainframes, network-attached storage, and other related technologies).
  • Proven track record in implementing CCaaS (Contact Center as a Service) and UCaaS (Unified Communications as a Service) solutions.
  • Engineering Services: Expertise in specialized technical and functional areas, including software engineering, programming languages, system integrations, and database management.

Why Join Dialpad

  • Work at the center of the AI transformation in business communications
  • Build and ship agentic AI products that are redefining how companies operate
  • Join a team where AI amplifies every employee’s impact
  • Competitive salary, comprehensive benefits, and real opportunities for growth

We believe in investing in our people. Dialpad offers competitive benefits and perks, cutting-edge AI tools, and a robust training program that help you reach your full potential. We have designed our offices to be inclusive, offering a vibrant environment to cultivate collaboration and connection. Our exceptional culture, repeatedly recognized as a Great Place to Work, ensures that every employee feels valued and empowered to contribute to our collective success.

Don’t meet every single requirement? If you’re excited about this role and possess the fundamental traits, drive, and strong ambition we seek, but your experience doesn’t meet every qualification, we encourage you to apply.

Dialpad is an equal-opportunity employer. We are dedicated to creating a community of inclusion and an environment free from discrimination or harassment.

title: Social- og sundhedsassistent til vikariat med primært nattevagter, på retspsykiatrisk afsnit B1, Psykiatrisk Center Sct. Hans, Roskilde
description:
Vil du være med til at skabe ro, tryghed og de bedst mulige rammer for vores patienter om natten?

På retspsykiatrisk afsnit B1 søger vi en social- og sundhedsassistent til et nattevagtsvikariat på 6 måneder med mulighed for forlængelse.

Om natten er din vigtigste opgave at understøtte, at patienterne så vidt muligt får sovet. Det kræver forudsigelige rammer, lavt aktivitetsniveau, rolig tilstedeværelse og fagligt overblik, så uro forebygges, og natteroen bevares.

Du bliver en del af et fast nattehold og står ikke alene med opgaven. Om natten er du sammen med tre andre kolleger, og der er desuden mulighed for at tilkalde en trisse.


Om B1 og vores patienter

B1 er et lukket retspsykiatrisk sengeafsnit på Psykiatrisk Center Sct. Hans med 16 sengepladser og længerevarende patientforløb.

Patienterne har ofte alvorlige psykiske lidelser — typisk psykosesygdomme som skizofreni — og kan samtidig have et forbrug af rusmidler, kognitive vanskeligheder og sociale udfordringer. Patienterne har dom til behandling, og indlæggelsen har et kriminalitetsforebyggende sigte.

Hverdagen på B1 bygger på struktur, forudsigelighed og relationel sikkerhed. Det gælder også om natten, hvor fælles aftaler og lavt aktivitetsniveau har stor betydning for, at patienterne kan finde ro.


Din opgave om natten

Natten på B1 skal være præget af forudsigelighed, lavt aktivitetsniveau og fælles aftaler. Nogle patienter sover, mens andre i perioder er vågne, urolige eller præget af tankemylder. Din opgave er at være tilgængelig og støtte patienterne på en måde, der hjælper dem til at finde ro, uden at natten bliver mere aktiv end nødvendigt.

Dine hovedopgaver bliver at:

  • Skabe ro og struktur på afsnittet gennem rolig tilstedeværelse og overblik
  • Understøtte patienternes søvn og hjælpe ved uro, tankemylder eller søvnbesvær
  • Arbejde forebyggende og deeskalerende, så uro ikke udvikler sig unødigt
  • Reagere fagligt, hvis der sker væsentlige ændringer i patienternes tilstand eller adfærd
  • Dokumentere relevante observationer og sikre klar overlevering til dagholdet
  • Bidrage til et sikkert og trygt miljø for både patienter og kolleger

Hvem er du?

Du er autoriseret social- og sundhedsassistent og trives med nattevagtens særlige rytme og ansvar.

Du behøver ikke have erfaring fra retspsykiatrien. Psykiatrisk erfaring er en fordel, men ikke et krav. Det vigtigste er, at du har interesse for psykiatri, kan arbejde roligt og struktureret og har lyst til at lære retspsykiatriens rammer og arbejdsgange.

Vi lægger vægt på, at du:

  • Kan bevare ro og overblik — også når noget uventet opstår
  • Forstår betydningen af en rolig nat og kan støtte patienterne uden at skabe unødig aktivitet
  • Kan arbejde selvstændigt og samtidig indgå som en pålidelig del af et fast nattehold
  • Kommunikerer respektfuldt og professionelt — også når situationen er svær
  • Kan holde fast i fælles aftaler

Vi tilbyder

  • En grundig introduktion med mentorordning
  • Et fire dages kursus i konflikthåndtering
  • Oplæring i afsnittets arbejdsgange, sikkerhed og fælles rammer
  • Supervision og faglig sparring, som også omfatter nattevagterne
  • Et fagligt stærkt miljø, hvor nattevagterne er en integreret og værdsat del af personalegruppen
  • En arbejdsplads med tydelige rammer og fokus på kvalitet, arbejdsmiljø og patientsikkerhed
  • En arbejdsplads i prisbelønnet byggeri tæt på naturen ved Roskilde Fjord

Det praktiske

Stillingen er et vikariat på 6 måneder med mulighed for forlængelse.

Tiltrædelse 1. november eller efter aftale.

Løn- og ansættelsesvilkår følger overenskomst for social- og sundhedspersonale indgået mellem FOA – Fag og Arbejde og Regionernes Lønnings- og Takstnævn med lønindplacering som social- og sundhedsassistent.

Du vil blive ansat i blandede vagter med primært nattevagter.

Regionen er et døgndækket område, og du vil efter konkret behov kunne blive planlagt med vagter på andre tidspunkter i overensstemmelse med reglerne i den gældende arbejdstidsaftale.

Ansøgningsfrist: 20. september 2026

Samtaler afholdes løbende.


Vil du vide mere?

Kontakt oversygeplejerske Martin Corlin Christensen på telefon 38 64 23 36, hvis du vil høre mere om stillingen, vagtplanen eller arbejdet på B1.

Vi glæder os til at modtage din ansøgning og dit CV via linket på siden.


Om Psykiatrisk Center Sct. Hans

Psykiatrisk Center Sct. Hans er en del af Amager og Hvidovre Hospital og ligger i naturskønne omgivelser ved Roskilde Fjord.

Vi arbejder med specialiseret psykiatrisk behandling og ønsker et sikkert og sundt arbejdsmiljø, hvor medarbejdere får gode forudsætninger for at udvikle sig og trives. Vi tilbyder røgfri arbejdspladser, vedligeholdelsestræning og attraktive karriereveje.

Region Hovedstaden sætter mennesket først. Vi giver plads til forskellighed og opfordrer alle kvalificerede ansøgere til at søge, uanset køn, alder, etnicitet, religion, seksualitet eller funktionsnedsættelser.

title: Forecasting and Research Internship - Healthcare
description:
Description


Please note: This fellowship is an unpaid opportunity intended to provide participants with practical experience, professional growth, and exposure to public service. Fellows will engage in meaningful work, collaborate with experienced professionals, and develop knowledge and skills applicable to future career opportunities.

This posting will be utilized for multiple intern hires.

This role will be done on a flexible schedule and will be remote.

Why work for OFM:
The Office of Financial Management (OFM) serves as the backbone of Washington state government. Our mission is to make our state a better place by connecting people, budgets, policies, data, and systems for state agencies and the Legislature. Our team includes budget advisors, researchers, and other experts, all dedicated public servants working towards an equitable future for every Washingtonian.

If you want to play a key role in enhancing how state government serves its citizens, you’ve found the right place. Join us in making a meaningful difference for every Washingtonian!

The intern/fellowship opportunity:

The Office of Financial Management’s mission is to provide accurate and timely information, fiscal services, and policy support that the Governor, Legislature, and state agencies need to serve the people of Washington State. The Forecasting and Research Division provides high-quality data and objective analyses on key issues affecting state policy and budget development, including economic trends, population estimates, health care, education, and public safety.

This position is part of the Health Care Research Center that provides objective health care research, analyses, and forecasts for Washington State. On a temporary, volunteer basis, this position will conduct research, organize and summarize credible information sources, and develop an information management approach to support Objective #4 of the State Health Plan and Resource Strategy. This position will help identify and monitor emerging trends in health care delivery and technology and translate findings into usable summaries, tracking tools, and briefing materials for public-sector health system planning.

What you’ll work on:

• Conduct environmental scans and targeted research on emerging trends in health care delivery, technology, system organization, workforce, facility financial sustainability, and health information. These efforts will help inform the responses to the overarching questions related to Objective #4 of the State Health Plan and Resource Strategy.

• Review academic literature, policy reports, agency publications, trade publications, and other credible sources aligned with Objective #4 topic areas and questions. This position will explore both peer-reviewed and “grey” literature sources.

• Develop and maintain a source inventory and practical monitoring approach for recurring review of high-value sources on the internet. This inventory will be developed using a long-term strategy that can be updated and expanded as needed.

• Design a structured tracking tool, such as a SharePoint list, Excel workbook, database structure, or other information management tool, to capture emerging trends and relevant metadata. This tracking tool will be integrated into current OFM resources.

• Recommend fields, tags, and categories for organizing information by topic area, source type, affected population, geography, equity relevance, rural health relevance, access/quality/cost implications, data needs, and potential Certificate of Need considerations.

• Prepare brief written summaries of selected trends, including why the trend matters for the State Health Plan, potential implications, limitations, and suggested next steps.

• Collaborate with OFM staff to refine the monitoring process, test the tracking tool, and identify where additional subject matter expertise or data may be needed.

• Produce defined outputs, such as a source inventory, tracking tool, process guide, annotated research summaries, final memo, or presentation.

• Comply with OFM policies on confidentiality, information security, ethics, records management, and public-sector data governance.

What we need you to bring:

  • Fellows:

    • Advanced degree preferred, such as MPA, MPH, MLIS, MS, PhD, or related degree; or equivalent training, knowledge, and experience in applied research, policy analysis, information science, public health, data science, or a related field.

    • Demonstrated experience conducting applied research, policy analysis, literature reviews, environmental scans, or knowledge management projects.

    • Ability to assess source credibility, identify policy-relevant themes, and prepare clear written summaries for a public-sector audience.

    • Ability to work collaboratively with multidisciplinary research, policy, and program staff while completing defined deliverables within agreed-upon timelines.

    • Strong commitment to professional ethics, confidentiality, impartiality, accessibility, and public-sector data governance standards.

    Interns:

    • Currently enrolled in, or recently graduated from, a graduate or advanced undergraduate program in public policy, public administration, public health, information science, library science, health services research, data science, statistics, economics, or a related field.

    • Foundational coursework or introductory experience in research methods, policy analysis, information management, data organization, or health policy.

    • Strong interest in applied public-sector research, health system planning, health technology, rural health, health equity, or health care delivery transformation.

    • Ability to work under close supervision, ask questions, incorporate feedback, and contribute effectively to team-based projects across OFM F&R units.

    • Capacity to commit to the required number of hours and complete assigned tasks within defined timelines.

    • Commitment to professionalism, confidentiality, impartiality, ethical conduct, and compliance with public-sector data governance requirements.

Desired qualifications:

• Experience with SharePoint lists or libraries, Excel, databases, dashboards, citation tools, taxonomies, tagging systems, or other information management tools.

• Experience preparing annotated bibliographies, literature reviews, policy scans, research briefs, or executive summaries.

• Familiarity with health care delivery models, telehealth, artificial intelligence, digital health, health system consolidation, private equity, rural health, health workforce issues, or Certificate of Need policy.

• Ability to organize complex information into a repeatable monitoring process and explain recommendations clearly to non-technical audiences.

• Fellows: advanced or terminal degree completion preferred. Interns: current enrollment in a graduate degree program preferred.

Supplemental Information

What we offer
At OFM, we foster a culture of integrity, innovation, inclusion, and belonging. We value both learned and lived experiences, believing that diversity makes us stronger. To support your health and well-being, we offer a variety of benefit programs for our employees.

Application Process:
Once you’ve decided to apply for this fellowship, you’ll complete an online application to showcase your qualifications. Keep in mind that once you submit the application, a real person will read it. We do not use AI or any other technology to screen your application and reject it. Please ensure you provide clear, detailed information about your work history so your qualifications can be accurately assessed. We will contact the top candidates directly to schedule interviews. If you require a reasonable accommodation during the application process, please call 7-1-1 or 1-800-833-6384.

When completing your application, please attach all of the following required documents:
  • Cover letter: describing your qualifications for this specific position
  • Resume: that details your applicable experience and education.
  • References: at least three professional references and their current contact information.


Questions:
OFM's Staff ASL interpreter is available to all deaf and hard-of-hearing applicants. For questions about this recruitment or to request a reasonable accommodation in the application or interview process, please email us atTalentAcquisition@ofm.wa.gov.

The Office of Financial Management is an equal opportunity employer. We strive to create a working environment that includes and respects cultural, racial, ethnic, sexual orientation, and gender identity diversity. Women, racial and ethnic minorities, persons with disabilities, persons over 40 years of age, and disabled and Vietnam-era veterans are encouraged to apply.


This position is exempt from civil service rules.

For more information, please seeWAC 357-19-195.

title: Benefits Consultant
description:

title: Security Risk Senior Analyst  (Transparency Posting)
description:
Department Information



Together, we innovate for a stronger Colorado

The work of employees at the Governor's Office of Information Technology (OIT) is challenging and diverse because the needs of agencies, customers and Coloradans constantly evolve. But our focus never changes: improve the lives of all Coloradans through innovation and collaboration. We're building one of the nation's leading government IT organizations by reimagining how we support agencies, building first-of-their-kind applications, and creating an inclusive, collaborative culture, together. Join us in the important work of providing equitable access to services.


Watch this video to learn more about how we're Serving People. Serving Colorado.

Description of Job



IMPORTANT NOTE: Please review your application to ensure completion. For the most equitable applicant experience, OIT’s hiring team considers only the contents of your application to review your qualifications. Please do not include any attachments (such as resume or cover letter) with your application as these items are not used by OIT’s hiring team.



Transparency Posting: This position is intended for and will be filled with an existing resource. This posting is for notification purposes only under the Equal Pay for Equal Work Act.


Senior Risk Analyst is a pivotal role responsible for identifying, assessing, and managing cybersecurity risks across state systems, data assets, and third-party relationships. In this role, you will lead the development and maintenance of our risk management program, ensuring alignment with the NIST Cybersecurity Framework (CSF) and regulatory requirements (e.g., CJIS, HIPAA).

The ideal candidate will conduct risk assessments, evaluate security controls, track remediation efforts, and translate technical findings into actionable guidance for leadership. This position offers a unique opportunity to collaborate across departments, ensuring risk-informed decision-making and protecting critical constituent data and public services.


Essential Functions:

  • Risk management strategy & governance: Establish and maintain the organization's cybersecurity risk management strategy, risk appetite, and tolerance thresholds in line with NIST CSF Govern (GV) outcomes. Outcome: an approved risk appetite statement that guides prioritization decisions across the security program.

  • Roles, policy & oversight: Define risk-related roles, responsibilities, and reporting lines; maintain policies governing risk assessment cadence and escalation. Outcome: documented governance structure that passes audit scrutiny and clarifies accountability.

  • Asset & risk assessment: Using current inventory of critical assets, conduct regular risk assessments mapped to CSF Identify (ID) categories (Asset Management, Risk Assessment, Improvement). Outcome: a rationalized and living risk register with likelihood/impact scoring covering all critical assets.

  • Third-party & supply chain risk: Maintain a documented program and processes to assess vendor and partner cybersecurity posture as part of ID.SC (Supply Chain Risk Management). Outcome: documented due diligence and reduced third-party exposure, evidenced in vendor risk files.

  • Control evaluation & gap analysis: Evaluate existing safeguards against CSF Protect (PR) categories (Identity Management, Data Security, Platform Security) to identify control gaps. Outcome: prioritized remediation roadmap tied to residual risk reduction.

  • Threat & risk trend monitoring: Analyze threat intelligence and detection findings (CSF Detect/DE) to refine and recalibrate the risk model. Outcome: a risk register that reflects current threat activity, not static assumptions.

  • Incident risk analysis & remediation tracking: Partner with incident response teams to assess risk impact of incidents (CSF Respond/RS) and track remediation of resulting findings to closure. Outcome: closed-loop remediation with measurable mean-time-to-remediate metrics.

  • Recovery planning risk input: Contribute risk analysis to recovery planning and business continuity efforts (CSF Recover/RC), ensuring recovery priorities reflect actual risk exposure. Outcome: recovery plans that are risk-informed and tested.

  • Executive & stakeholder reporting: Translate risk findings across all six CSF functions into business-relevant reporting for agencies, executives, and stakeholders (legal, compliance). Outcome: informed resourcing decisions and improved organization-wide risk literacy.

  • Program maturity metrics: Define and track KPIs/KRIs mapped to CSF function maturity (e.g., % of assets assessed, control coverage, remediation velocity). Outcome: quantifiable, framework-aligned evidence of year-over-year program maturity.


  • Additional Functions:


  • Self-Direction & Autonomy

    • Operates independently with minimal supervision; exercises sound judgment in ambiguous or evolving situations

    • Prioritizes and manages a complex workload across competing deadlines without day-to-day direction

    • Recognizes when to escalate versus when to resolve independently

  • Continuous Improvement Ownership

    • Proactively identifies gaps or inefficiencies in the risk program and drives improvements without being asked

    • Stays current on evolving threats, regulatory changes, and framework updates (e.g., NIST CSF revisions) and incorporates them into practice

    • Seeks feedback on their own work product and iterates on risk methodologies, templates, and reporting over time

  • Mentorship & Influence

    • Mentors other analysts and stakeholders

    • Influences stakeholders and leadership without formal authority — builds credibility through sound analysis rather than positional power

    • Acts as a subject-matter resource other teams turn to for risk-related questions

  • Accountability & Ownership

    • Takes ownership of outcomes, not just tasks — follows through on remediation and reporting until issues are genuinely resolved

    • Willing to make and stand behind risk recommendations, including ones that are unpopular or involve trade-offs

    • Documents decisions and rationale clearly enough to withstand audit or leadership scrutiny

  • Judgment Under Ambiguity

    • Comfortable making risk-based recommendations with incomplete information

    • Balances competing priorities (security, budget, mission delivery, public accountability) rather than defaulting to a single lens

  • Communication & Composure

    • Communicates effectively under pressure, including during incidents or audit findings

    • Adapts communication style for technical staff, program managers, and non-technical executives or elected oversight bodies

  • Professional Development

    • Maintains and pursues relevant certifications (CISSP, CRISC, CISM) as a mark of ongoing self-investment

    • Participates in professional risk/security communities to bring outside perspective back into the agency



Minimum Qualifications, Substitutions, Conditions of Employment & Appeal Rights



A wide salary range is posted for this position and any job offer is based upon a salary analysis to comply with the Colorado Equal Pay for Equal Work Act. The salary analysis considers relevant experience, education, certifications, and state seniority as compared to others doing substantially similar work. While most salary offers are made within the posted range, occasionally an offer is made below or above the posted range based upon this salary analysis.

This is a skills-based job announcement. The required minimum qualifications and/or education (if substituting for the proven experience, knowledge, and skills), are as follows:

Minimum Qualifications:


  • Minimum of five (5) years of experience managing cybersecurity risks across state systems, data assets, and third-party relationships.

  • Experience with the NIST Cybersecurity Framework (CSF) and applicable state and federal regulatory requirements (e.g., state IT security policies, CJIS, HIPAA, IRS Publication 1075, as applicable).


Substitutions:


  • Additional appropriate education will substitute for the required experience on a year-for-year basis, but cannot completely substitute for these qualifications.

  • Training or Certification related to the work assigned to the position will be assigned credit towards substitution for experience and/or education, but cannot completely substitute for these qualifications.

  • If the minimum qualifications include a degree requirement, additional appropriate paid or unpaid experience will substitute for the required education on a year-for-year basis.



Preferred Qualifications:


  • Professional security certification.





Conditions of Employment:

OIT employees must comply with any screening procedures in place at state agency locations where they might perform work.

A pre-employment background check will be conducted as part of the selection process. Post-employment background checks will be required for specific agencies as business needs dictate, which may include a polygraph exam, fingerprint-based criminal history search, reference checks, and a drug test.

This position may require travel within the specified geographic area, and to locations across the state as needed.

This position may require on-call duties as needed by the position.


Supplemental Information




If this posting indicates “remote from anywhere in CO” in the title, periodic reporting to the primary state work location designated for the position is required. All remote work must be performed in Colorado.


While candidates from out of state will be considered for this role, the candidate selected for the position must relocate and reside in Colorado on the first day of their new position. A reasonable timeframe for relocation will be established on an individual basis, while considering business needs, and determining a start date.

title: Studio Management Director - Lion Studios
description:
Who are we?

Tripledot Studios is one of the largest independent mobile games companies in the world.

We are a multi-award-winning organisation, with a global 2,500+ strong team across 12 studios.

Our expanded portfolio includes some of the biggest titles in mobile gaming, collectively reaching top chart positions around the world and engaging over 25 million daily active users.

Tripledot’s guiding principle is that when people love what they do, what they do will be loved by others.

We’re building a company we’re proud of. One filled with driven, incredibly smart and detail-orientated people, who LOVE making games.

Our ambition is to be the most successful games company in the world, and we’re just getting started.

The role is working within our studio: Lion Studios

About Lion Studios

We're looking for a Director of Studio Management to lead our global studio management team. The team currently has 10 managers who collectively partner with around 40 external studios. This is a remote role, with a preference for candidates based in Europe, reporting to the Senior Director of Publishing and Business Development. You'll be the bridge between our studio managers, cross-functional leads, and the finance and legal teams that keep our publishing department running.

About the Role

The Impact You'll Make:

  • Lead and support a team of studio managers, helping them sign premium studios, build strong developer relationships, and hit their goals.
  • Recruit, grow, and shape the team as the business scales, including org design and calibrating roles across regions.
  • Support the BD side of the team's work. Studio managers act as business development leads, and you'll help them win and keep top studios by understanding what partners need.
  • Develop and implement BD strategies at both the regional and global level, tailoring the approach to each market while keeping the overall portfolio aligned.
  • Oversee the company's game pipeline, with a focus on moving titles from prototyping to soft launch on time and clearing blockers early. You'll be accountable for pipeline velocity and studio-signing targets.
  • Create, update, and manage contracts alongside the TDS Legal team. Stay proactive about keeping terms in line with industry standards and partners’ requirement.
  • Work closely with Game Design, Data, Intelligence, Product, and Growth leads to understand how the teams operate and make changes that help them work better together.
  • Keep a solid understanding of the company portfolio's P&L. You should be able to explain how costs are structured and attributed, and work with the TDS Finance team on accuracy and improvements.
  • Review the publishing process and KPIs regularly, and update benchmarks and workflows as the company needs change.
  • Turn shifting company priorities into practical changes to internal workflows and processes.
  • Represent the studio management function to leadership, reporting on team performance and helping shape publishing strategy at the exec level.

Required Qualifications:

  • 7+ years in studio management, business development, or product/project management in mobile gaming, including 3+ years managing teams.
  • Track record building and managing external studios or developer relationships, ideally signing and keeping premium partners.
  • Hands-on experience with publishing contracts.
  • Experience overseeing game pipelines from concept to launch across multiple titles.
  • Strong communication skills and the ability to work with both technical and non-technical people.
  • Comfort working with P&L, KPIs, and pipeline data, and the tools behind them.
  • Experience managing across regions, markets, and time zones.
  • Organized and analytical, comfortable in a fast-paced environment.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Good grasp of current trends and metrics in mobile gaming.
  • Experience working with finance and legal teams in a publishing setting.
  • Familiarity with portfolio or game-level P&L, including how costs are structured and attributed.
  • Startup or high-growth experience.

Join us to shape the next generation of hit mobile games — where creativity meets performance, and innovation drives results.

Ready to lead the pride? Apply now!

An Ophthalmic Technician is a valuable asset to an Ophthalmologist as they assist in providing excellent patient care to the patients during their visit. This employee is able to handle a wide range of duties while using equipment to perform the initial testing needed to prepare a patient for an exam with an Ophthalmologist.

  • Verify patient information by interviewing patient

  • Checks condition of patient's eyes by observing pupils, muscles, visual acuity, and extraocular movements
  • Required skills include: dilation, refraction, pressures, and performing a variety of diagnostic tests including visual fields, OCT, GDX, IOL master, auto refractor and topography
  • Demonstrates working knowledge of eye anatomy, diseases, symptoms and ocular medications

SYSTEMS AND TECHNOLOGY

title: Dispensary Associate - GrowHealthy (Miami)
description:
At iAnthus, we are not just in the business of cannabis; we’re in the business of empowering individuals to lead healthier, happier lives through access to premium-quality medicinal and adult-use cannabis products. We believe in the potential of cannabis to enhance wellness and redefine the future of self-care. As a trailblazer in the cannabis industry, we’re committed to providing a holistic approach to well-being, fostering a community where every patient and customer can thrive and find relief.

This Dispensary Associate position is part-time and is located in Miami, FL.


Who We Are:

iAnthus Capital Management is a multi-state operator, encompassing the full spectrum of cannabis enterprises, from cultivation to processing to retailing. Cannabis will be the next great transformative industry - not just because it has the power to change people’s lives (especially those suffering from chronic ailments) – but also because it will impact many other industries, from agriculture to pharmaceuticals to alcoholic beverages. Our mission is to create the most valuable cannabis brands and network of cannabis operations and distribution nationally. At iAnthus, you will be given opportunities for career development, a flexible work environment, excellent benefits, a wellness program and the ability to interact with and learn from leaders in the cannabis industry.

Who You Are:

You have a strong desire to learn and to contribute to a team. You are passionate about making an inclusive, positive, and compliant workforce. You can effectively manage your time and focus on ensuring data integrity and accuracy for your projects. If you would like to work in a fast-paced environment and are interested in building something meaningful with the rest of the iAnthus team, we would love to hear from you!


Benefits:

  • Paid Sick Leave
  • Wellness Program
  • Employee Assistance Program
  • Product Discounts
  • Ability to work in a growing company where your talents and skills can have a positive impact

Summary:

As a Dispensary Associate, you’ll be a vital force in the evolving world of cannabis. Acting as a trusted advisor, you’ll be at the forefront of patient acquisition for medicinal cannabis and welcoming adult-use use customers, fostering an environment where education, exploration, and satisfaction intersect. Your primary responsibility is to offer comprehensive education on strains, effects, and various methods of cannabis use, ensuring everyone receives tailored information to make informed decisions. Beyond education, you’ll be the face of our dispensary, delivering warm and informed service, recording transactions in the POS system, and collaborating closely with dispensary managers to maintain a clean and organized dispensary environment.

Essential Functions:

The Dispensary Associate elevates the dispensary experience for our patients and customers. This role is the heartbeat of our interactions, where you’ll be a vital part of shaping a positive, informative, and seamless journey for prospective, new, and returning customers. Your key responsibilities include, but is not limited to the following:

  • Welcome everyone with a friendly attitude, creating a positive dispensary experience.
  • Guide and educate patients and customers in choosing the right medicine and products, providing personalized insights into strains and effects.
  • Proactively interact with customers, guide them through our product offerings, and highlight exclusive specials to increase sales opportunities.
  • Enter and access patient records accurately, confirming identities and eligibility to purchase in line with legal and company standards.
  • Represent the company’s brand well as a brand ambassador.
  • Follows and uphold the company’s core values, including respect, diversity, sustainability, research, and service.
  • Adheres to iAnthus' cultural principles of collaboration, innovation, and accountability.
  • Accurately handle transactions, receiving payments with a smile, and recording purchases in our Dispensary Management System.
  • Provide patients and customers with informative printed materials, helping them make well-informed decisions.
  • Bring a sales-focused attitude to every shift, always looking for chances to increase sales and grow business.
  • Work with Dispensary Managers to check product inventory, making sure we have a diverse and fresh selection that meets our patients' and customers’ needs.
  • Maintain a clean and organized dispensary area.
  • Additional duties and responsibilities as assigned.

This job description is not intended to cover or contain a comprehensive list of activities. This description reflects managements’ assignment of essential functions, and it does not restrict the tasks that may be assigned. Duties and responsibilities may change at any time with or without notice.

Your willingness to contribute to the evolving needs of our team is highly valued.


Qualifications + Education:

  • Must be twenty-one (21) years of age or older
  • High School diploma or equivalent is required.
  • Must have a valid driver's license and reliable transportation.
  • Exceptional interpersonal skills with a passion for delivering top-notch customer service.
  • Ability to work independently, coordinate multiple tasks, and prioritize work effectively.
  • Reliability is a must.
  • Meticulous organizational skills with acute attention to detail.
  • Computer-savvy, with a knack for quickly mastering new software.
  • Knowledge of or willingness to learn state-specific cannabis laws and regulatory compliance is non-negotiable.
  • Comfortable teaching customers about the medicinal and adult-use aspects of cannabis and conducting workshops or info sessions to boost their understanding and confidence in choosing products.
  • Ganjier certification preferred

Starting Pay Rate: $16/hr


Working Conditions:

The employee works in a medical dispensary environment and uses a computer, telephone, and other office equipment to perform duties. This is a hands-on, customer-facing position. The position will regularly interact with the public and needs to engage patients and customers in a friendly and helpful manner. The employee must be able to function effectively in a high-paced, fast-moving retail environment. The employee may be subjected to work in environments that include exposure to, but not limited to, fumes, dust, odors, heights, indoor A/C, no A/C, motion and noise.

The position also requires a high level of scheduling flexibility and will occasionally include evening, weekend, and holiday work hours. The employee will encounter frequent interruptions throughout the workday and must have a high regard for self-management, time management, and scheduling of activities.


Physical Requirements:

title: Klinisk farmakonom, som brænder for patientsikkerhed, søges til vikariat på Sygehusapoteket, Sygehus Lillebælt, Kolding
description:
Har du lyst til at være tæt på patienten og hver dag gøre dit bedste for at sætte deres sikkerhed og tryghed først?

Og vil du være en del af det klinisk farmaci team, som hver dag bruger en stor del af arbejdstiden på de kliniske afdelinger, hvor de bidrager med deres lægemiddelfaglighed og indgår i opgaveløsning på tværs af andre faggrupper?

Så er det dig vi har brug for som barselsvikar på Apoteket Sygehus Lillebælt Kolding.

Jobbet
Som farmakonom i klinisk farmaci hos os får du fast base på apoteket, men har hele sygehuset som din arbejdsplads. Du skal derfor være parat til at have din arbejdsdag ude på sygehusets afdelinger, hvor du løser flere forskellige opgaver i løbet af dagen.

Dine primære opgaver vil omhandle:

  • Medicindispensering, hvor du dispenserer lægemidler til den enkelte patient under indlæggelse og ved udskrivelse.
  • Medicinservice, hvor du i samarbejde med klinikken sikrer, at de nødvendige lægemidler er til rådighed samt medvirker til optimal økonomisk anvendelse og lagerstyring af afdelingens lægemidler.
  • Færdigtilberedning af IV præparater, hvor du hjælper afdelingerne med at gøre blandinger klar til brug, f.eks. antibiotika, men også i samarbejde med apotekets farmaceuter svarer på spørgsmål om mere komplicerede blandinger.
  • Medicinanamneser og medicinoverførsel, hvor du taler med patienterne og anvender FMK til at få et overblik over patienternes vanlige medicin, som du herefter dokumenterer, opdaterer og evt. overfører til EPJ.
Om apoteket
Vi er ca. 67 ansatte på apoteket, som er fordelt på afsnit i henholdsvis Kolding og Vejle. På afsnittet i Kolding er vi 25 ansatte i alle aldersgrupper og kerneområderne er indkøb, logistik samt klinisk farmaci. Vi følger GDP reglerne, og alle vores medarbejdere trænes og har forskellige kompetencer, der gør, at vi alle kan spille ind i løsningen af kerneopgaven med at ”skabe tryghed i medicineringen” for både os selv, samarbejdspartnere og patienter.
Vi har en åben atmosfære, hvor vi hjælper hinanden og praktiserer en uhøjtidelig men respektfuld tone med plads til gode grin.

Vi tilbyder

  • Et varieret job med stort ansvar, patientkontakt og tæt samarbejde med læger og plejepersonale
  • Et introduktionsprogram der sikrer dig grundig oplæring i alle dine arbejdsopgaver
  • En mentor der skal guide og sparre med dig i din første tid på arbejdspladsen
  • Plads til personlig udvikling i form af sidemandsoplæring, studiebesøg, og faglig sparring
  • Et kvalitetsbevidst arbejdsmiljø præget af engagement, omsorgsfulde kolleger, summende aktivitet og nærværende ledelse med let adgang til sparring
Din profil
Det vi vægter højt hos dig er, at du udviser positivt engagement i dit samarbejde om kerneopgaven på tværs af både faggrupper og patienten.
Du har gå på mod og evner at tilpasse dig en foranderlig hverdag, hvor det kan være nødvendigt og hensigtsmæssigt at lave om på arbejdsrutiner og opgaver, men samtidig holde fast i dit faglige dna.
Derudover vægter vi at du:

  • Er uddannet farmakonom og er ambitiøs med dit fag.
  • Arbejder struktureret, så du ikke mister overblik på trods af en omskiftelig arbejdsdag.
  • Kan arbejde selvstændigt men beder om hjælp, når du er i tvivl og også være en holdspiller, der overholder aftaler til planlagt tid.
  • Har erfaring inden for medicinservice og patientnære opgaver, men det er ikke et krav
Løn
Løn- og ansættelsesvilkår for stillingen følger aftale med Farmakonomforeningen og i henhold til gældende overenskomst mellem Sundhedskartellet og Danske Regioner, 32.17.1. Startlønnen for stillingen kan findes via følgende link: Se startløn for stillinger i Region Syddanmark.
Udover startlønnen kan lønnen indeholde forhandlede tillæg afhængigt af stillingen, dine erfaringer og kvalifikationer.

Ansættelse
Vikariat fra 01.12.2026 til 31.12.2027. Stillingen er på 37 timer ugentligt med mulighed for deltid.

Hvis du vil vide mere
Er du velkommen til at kontakte funktionsleder Anne Kjølbye på tlf. 21 70 75 80

Kan du se dig selv hos os?
Så send os din ansøgning, så vi har den senest den 20. september.
Vi holder 1. samtalerunde den 28. og 29. september og følger evt. op med 2. samtale den 6. oktober. Du skal være indstillet på at løse en case i forbindelse med 2. samtale.

title: Hospitalsserviceassistent til  S14, Serviceafsnit Køge, Sjællands Universitetshospital Køge
description:
Servicemindet hospitalsserviceassistent søges til 37 timers stiling

Vi søger en ny serviceassistent i Serviceafsnit Køge på Sjællands Universitetshospital Køge med start d. 01.10.26 eller hurtigst muligt.

Stillingen er på 37 timer pr. uge med skiftende vagter, herunder weekender og helligdage, i tidsrummet kl. 6.00 - 20.30.

Serviceafsnit Køge er en travl afdeling, hvor der fokuseres på kvaliteten af den leverede service og den nære kontakt med samarbejdspartnere. Medarbejderne er med til at skabe gode patientforløb. De arbejder i teams på de afdelinger, de er tilknyttet.

Jobbeskrivelse

Du vil indgå i servicegruppe S14, der varetager vigtige servicefunktioner som bl.a. rengøring, transport af patienter, madhåndtering, samt uddeling af mad til patienter.

Servicegruppen er delvis selvstyrende og handler dagligt selvstændigt i planlægningen af arbejdet i henhold til ledelsens retningslinjer.

Stillingen indebærer bl.a. følgende arbejdsopgaver

  • Rengøring
  • Diverse køkkenopgaver, herunder madservering
  • Forflytning og kørsel af patienter, herunder mors-kørsel
  • Isolationsrengøring
  • Opfyldning af skabe
  • Ad hoc opgaver

Vi forventer, at du

  • Er uddannet hospitalsserviceassistent, eller evt. har erfaring fra lignende stilling og er gerne uddannet indenfor rengørings-, ernærings- eller portørområdet. Såfremt du ikke er erhvervsuddannet serviceassistent med speciale i hospitalsservice, ansættes du som ufaglært serviceassistent. Det er i din ansættelse et krav, at du påbegynder og gennemfører uddannelsen som erhvervsuddannet serviceassistent med speciale i hospitalsservice inden udgangen af dit 2. ansættelses år, såfremt du opfylder betingelserne herfor - ellers påbegyndes uddannelse, så snart du opfylder betingelserne, og uddannelseshold oprettes. Under uddannelsen er din gennemsnitlige ugentlige arbejdstid 37 timer pr. uge i blandede vagter
  • Har kendskab til computer på brugerniveau
  • Evt. har kendskab til INSTA 800 og DS 2451-10
  • Er en udadvendt og serviceminded person, der sætter en ære i at yde en god service
  • Er engageret, ansvarlig, mødestabil og fleksibel
  • Har interesse for at omgås mennesker og kan samarbejde
  • Er kvalitetsbevidst og har ordenssans
  • Er forandringsvillig og omstillingsparat
  • Kan tale, læse og forstå dansk

Serviceafsnit Køge kan tilbyde

  • Faglige og personlige udviklingsmuligheder
  • Et spændende og udfordrende arbejdsmiljø
  • En god og grundig introduktion til arbejdet og virksomheden
  • Mulighed for at påvirke dit eget arbejde
  • Et job, hvor der lægges stor vægt på selvstændighed og medansvar

Løn og ansættelsesvilkår efter gældende overenskomst.

Ønsker du at høre mere om stillingen, er du velkommen til at kontakte serviceleder Jette Nielsen tlf. 47 32 84 04

Ansøgningen

Din ansøgning og CV skal sendes via ansøgningslinket her på siden. Ansættelsessamtaler forventes at blive afholdt løbende.

Om Serviceafsnit Køge

Hjertet i Serviceafsnit Køge på Sjællands Universitetshospital Køge er medarbejderne. De løser en lang række opgaver, hvoraf nogle er synlige for patienter og pårørende, andre kun for personalet. Der leveres en meget bred vifte af rengørings- og patientserviceopgaver, linnedhåndtering, specielrengøring og kapelfunktion.

Ansættelsesområde

Region Sjælland og Region Hovedstaden bliver den 1. januar 2027 til Region Østdanmark som følge af sundhedsreformen. Dit ansættelsesområde vil være Region Østdanmark med alle tilhørende organisatoriske enheder.
Læs mere om betydningen af ansættelsesområdet på Region Østdanmarks hjemmeside.

Startløn for overenskomstansatte

Regionen er forpligtet til at oplyse dig om startlønnen for stillingen. Du får oplyst grundløn, centralt fastsatte tillæg og pension i den relevante overenskomst. Udover startlønnen, kan lønnen indeholde eventuelt forhandlede tillæg afhængigt af stillingen, dine erfaringer og kvalifikationer.
Se startlønnen på regionens hjemmeside

Om Sjællands Universitetshospital

Sjællands Universitetshospital er Danmarks nyeste universitetshospital med aktiviteter i Køge, Roskilde og Nykøbing F. Vi er et modigt og udadvendt universitetshospital, hvor vi hver dag arbejder for at skabe et sammenhængende sundhedsvæsen og større lighed i sundhed for borgerne i regionen.

Vores optageområde er præget af flere borgere med kronisk sygdom og sociale udfordringer end landsgennemsnittet. Derfor arbejder vi målrettet med innovation, nye samarbejdsformer og løsninger, der bringer behandling tættere på borgerne.

Hos os bliver du en del af en ambitiøs arbejdsplads, hvor samarbejde på tværs, høj faglighed og løbende forbedringer er en naturlig del af hverdagen. Vores ledelsesværdier er nytænkning, følgeskab, ordentlighed og fællesskab, og de sætter retning for, hvordan vi arbejder, udvikler os og skaber gode resultater – for både borgere og medarbejdere.

title: Bliv en del af fremtidens akutsygepleje i Borgernær Sundhed i Sundhedsråd Øst og Øerne - Geriatrisk Afdeling, SUH
description:
Med den nye sundhedsreform overgår akutsygeplejen fra den kommunale hjemmesygepleje til hospitalerne i regionen pr. 1. januar 2027. Vi søger akutsygeplejersker til alle 9 baser i sundhedsområdet. Du vil blive tilknyttet én primær base.

Akutsygeplejen skal fremtidigt dække behovet for akutsygepleje i vores sundhedsrådsområde som dækker over kommunerne: Roskilde, Solrød, Greve, Køge, Stevns, Faxe, Vordingborg, Guldborgsund og Lolland.

Som led i Sundhedsreformen etableres på Sjællands Universitets Hospital en ny Geriatrisk afdeling beliggende i Køge og i Nykøbing Falster. Foruden 2 geriatriske sengeafsnit med tilhørende ambulante funktioner, består afdelingen af et afsnit dedikeret til Borgernær Sundhed, hvorunder akutsygeplejen lægges.

Akutsygeplejen får en central rolle når det kommer til at udvikle nærhed, lighed og sammenhæng for borgerforløbene.

Akutsygeplejen organiseres så vi sikrer nærhed til borgerne og lokalt kendskab. Som akutsygeplejerske i Borgernær Sundhed vil din primære arbejdsplads være i borgernes hjem og på akutsygeplejens klinikker.

Selvom du får en primær base på ét tjenestested, bliver du en del af én samlet organisation med fælles faglige standarder, udviklingsmuligheder og kollegialt fællesskab. Vi søger derfor sygeplejersker som:

  • Er autoriseret sygeplejersker med minimum 2 års klinisk erfaring
  • Har kendskab til akutsygepleje, den kommunale sygepleje eller bare har lyst til at prøve kræfter med noget nyt
  • Trives med at arbejde selvstændigt, og træffe hurtige kliniske beslutninger
  • Evner at skabe tillid og tryghed hos borger og pårørende og er i stand til at tilpasse kommunikationen til den enkelte borger.
  • Tænker sundhedsfremme og er i stand til at arbejde med en forebyggende og støttende tilgang, så borgeren undgår unødvendige indlæggelser.
  • Som har gode samarbejdsevner og som kan se og trække ”fællesskabet” på tværs af sektorerne.
  • Har forståelse for at et godt arbejdsmiljø ikke kommer af sig selv– det skaber vi sammen.
  • Har kørekort


Akutsygeplejens opgaver:
  • Akut sygeplejefaglig vurdering og behandling af borgere i eget hjem
  • Observation, monitorering og opfølgning på komplekse patientforløb
  • IV-behandling, prøvetagning og andre avancerede sygeplejeopgaver
  • Forebyggelse af unødige indlæggelser
  • Tæt koordinering med hospital, kommuner og almen praksis
  • Rådgivning og vejledning af patienter, pårørende og samarbejdspartnere
  • Varetage den akutte sygepleje i det næresundhedsvæsen, herunder vurdering, behandling og opfølgning på borgere med akutte behov og komplekse udfordringer.
  • Samarbejde tæt med læger, andre sundhedsprofessionelle og pårørende om den bedste løsning for borgeren
  • Deltage i udvikling og implementering af nye arbejdsmetoder og initiativer inden for akutsygeplejen i den borgernære sundhed
  • Bidrage til et trygt og professionelt arbejdsmiljø med fokus på trivsel, kvalitet og udvikling


Vi tilbyder:
  • En spændende stilling i en nyoprettet afdeling med mulighed for at bidrage til udviklingen af fremtidens akutsygepleje i en kontekst af nærhed, lighed og sammenhæng
  • Et sygeplejefagligt fællesskab, hvor nytænkning, kvalitet, nærvær og faglighed er i fokus
  • Engagerede og motiverede kolleger, som mødes med positiv indstilling
  • En arbejdsplads med plads til nye ideer og initiativer
  • En arbejdsplads med tætte og spændende samarbejdsrelationer på tværs af sektorer
  • Gode muligheder for løbende kompetenceudvikling
  • En afdeling der har fokus på det gode arbejdsmiljø, dialog og medinddragelse.
  • Et onboardingprogram med fagligt og organisatorisk indhold, hvor du introduceres til alt det nye.

Funktionen er døgndækkende 365 dage om året med skiftende vagter efter aftale.


Om Borgernær Sundhed:

Borgernær Sundhed er et afsnit under Geriatrisk Afdeling på SUH, som er blevet etableret for at understøtte Sundhedsreformens ambition om at skabe et mere nært, sammenhængende og lige sundhedsvæsen.

Afsnittet har følgende opdelte afsnit:

  • Akutsygepleje
  • Sundheds- og omsorgspladser
  • GeriKom – speciallægedækning af sundheds- og omsorgspladser, hvor af der er 168 i sundhedsområdet

SUH overtager myndighedsansvaret for sundheds- og omsorgspladserne d. 1. januar 2027, som er beliggende i hver af de ni kommuner. Akutsygeplejens mødesteder vil forholdsvist være placeret i hver kommune. Skriv gerne i din ansøgning hvilket tjenestested du ønsker.

title: Shift Leader 604
description:
​​​

Shift Leader

At WhiteWater Express, we are more than just a car wash; we are a company built on respect, communication, and a passion for people. Our dedicated team members are leaders within the company, and we believe that personal growth is the key to our organizational success. If you are a self-starter, motivated, and ready to take on new challenges, we want you to succeed with us, as a part of a rapidly growing business.

Position Overview

The Shift Leader position is responsible for assisting with oversight of each shift. The position ensures that every team member understands and is enabled to perform their daily duties and assists management with completing incident reports and equipment maintenance, repairs, and reporting.

Key Responsibilities

  • Foster a team-oriented environment where every employee feels empowered to take initiative and lead.
  • Cultivate a positive, customer-focused workplace by supporting team growth and leadership development.
  • Address and resolve concerns, including incident reporting, to ensure a seamless experience.
  • Monitor and adjust equipment, wash package functions, and tunnel performance to optimize efficiency.
  • Uphold company policies, enforce safety protocols, and ensure all employees complete required safety training.
  • Provide customers with information on wash products, packages, wash books, and membership plans.
  • Assist customers with membership account updates and issue resolution.
  • Oversee store opening and closing procedures, ensuring all tasks are completed correctly.
  • Learn car wash chemistry, product interactions, and their impact on wash quality.
  • Identify and resolve wash quality issues caused by chemical imbalances or other factors.
  • Communicate areas of improvement for the location, team, and company to management.
  • Administer customer feedback surveys during each shift to maintain high-quality service standards.

Qualifications

  • Strong team player with leadership abilities to guide and support colleagues.
  • Comfortable working outdoors in all weather conditions, including evenings and weekends.
  • Physically capable of lifting up to 50 pounds and standing or moving for extended periods.
  • Detail-oriented with a focus on delivering high-quality service and maintaining safety standards.
  • Ability to foster a welcoming, fun, and customer-focused environment that drives business and team success.
  • Adherence to all safety protocols, including proper handling of chemicals per safety guidelines.
  • Must successfully pass a background check.

Benefits

  • Competitive Compensation in Base and Bonus Potential
  • Comprehensive Health Benefits (Medical, Dental & Vision)
  • Paid Time Off in addition to Company Paid Holidays
  • 401(k) Retirement Plan with Company Match
  • Company-Paid Life Insurance
  • Pathways to Advancement
  • Free Weekly Car Washes

Our employees are our most valuable asset. We only employ the best people in the service industry who embrace new challenges with enthusiasm. If you are looking for professional development with advancement opportunities in a fast-growing organization, come join our Team!
