title: QA Specialist
description:
Origin Mining Company operates the Mineral Park copper-molybdenum mine in Arizona and is focused on responsible, sustainable resource development. We aim to lead the U.S. copper industry through strong safety practices, environmental stewardship, and operational excellence. Our team is committed to doing things the right way—acting with integrity, supporting our communities, and creating long-term value. With a hands-on, technically driven approach, we are advancing both leach and concentrator operations to produce high-quality copper and molybdenum products.

Position Overview:
We are looking for a versatile QA/QC Specialist with deep expertise in Fixed Plant Equipment to support our growing open-pit copper mining operation. This role bridges greenfield expansion projects and brownfield sustaining operations, ensuring that new installations seamlessly integrate with our existing infrastructure while maintaining uncompromising quality standards across all crushing, grinding, flotation, and material handling circuits.

Key Responsibilities:
  • Greenfield Project Execution: Provide QA/QC oversight for greenfield installations and new plant expansions, ensuring greenfield assets are built right the first time from ground up to commissioning.
  • Brownfield Integration & Sustaining Capital: Oversee quality control for brownfield tie-ins, major plant retrofits, scheduled shutdowns, day-to-day scheduled work and replacement of aging fixed assets within the active processing facility.
  • Inspection & Verification: Execute Receiving, In-Process, and Final QC inspections on heavy fixed plant equipment (e.g., crushers, mills, screens, thickeners, slurry pumps, and conveyor systems).
  • Code & Standard Compliance: Verify that all mechanical, structural, and piping works conform to engineering drawings, OEM specifications, and relevant industry codes (ASME, AWS, ISO).
  • Documentation & Handover: Review and audit quality dossiers, Material Test Reports (MTRs), Weld Procedure Specifications (WPS), NDE results, and final commissioning documentation for both project handovers and operational asset records.
Qualifications:
  • Education: A Degree or Diploma in Mechanical Engineering or Engineering is preferred but not required or a recognized Trade Certification. Certified Welding Inspector (CWI) or equivalent QA/QC certification is strongly preferred.
  • Experience: Minimum 5–10 years of QA/QC experience in heavy industry, with a proven track record split across both greenfield construction projects and brownfield operational environments.
  • Technical Expertise:
    • Thorough working knowledge of comminution circuits, material handling, and thickener/tailings infrastructure.
    • Strong familiarity with NDE methods (UT, MT, PT, RT) and the ability to interpret complex P&IDs, general arrangement drawings, and isometric piping drawings.
  • Operational Adaptability: Ability to navigate the fast-paced, high-pressure environment of active brownfield shutdowns alongside the rigorous milestone tracking required for greenfield project delivery.
  • Software Skills: Proficiency in MS Office and CMMS or project management platforms (e.g., SAP, Pronto, Primavera P6).
Physical Demands:
To be eligible for this position, an individual must possess the following requirements to perform the essential job functions:
  • Must be able to physically perform the basic life operational functions of climbing, stooping, kneeling, crouching, reaching, standing, walking on uneven surfaces, pushing, pulling, lifting, fingering, grasping, feeling, talking, hearing, and repetitive motion.
  • Ability to work both indoors and outdoors in all kinds of weather.
  • Able to operate a telephone and mine phone/radio with sufficient voice and hearing to carry on a conversation for the purpose of communicating information.
  • Able to hear sufficiently to distinguish various pitches of warning alarms.
  • Able to lift up to 25 pounds periodically.

As part of our continued investment in security and regulatory resilience, we are seeking a Security Architect to own the design of our enterprise security governance, risk, and compliance (GRC) framework. This is a senior, high-visibility role that sits at the intersection of security architecture, multi-jurisdiction regulatory compliance, and organizational risk — shaping how a global fintech company regulated across five jurisdictions thinks about, measures, and reduces security risk.

Responsibilities:

  • Own the enterprise security GRC framework — policy hierarchy, risk register methodology, control ownership, and audit evidence structure.

  • Map controls to DORA, NIS2, ISO 27001, and PCI-DSS, identify gaps, and set remediation priority.

  • Act as the final authority on regulatory interpretation affecting security, including written positions for audits and regulatory submissions.

  • Own the compliance and obligation management framework across all five regulated jurisdictions (FCA, CySEC, ASIC, SCB, SCA), including regulatory horizon scanning.

  • Represent the company in regulatory discussions alongside the CISO and General Counsel where required.

  • Define the company's human-risk philosophy and shape the security awareness architecture — segmentation, interventions, and measurement.

  • Advise the CISO, CHRO, Risk, and Compliance teams on security risk, regulatory obligations, and investment trade-offs.

  • Set the architectural standards the Corporate Security team executes against, and sign off on significant framework changes.

  • Support Third-Party Risk Management and Business Continuity & Crisis Management from a security and technical perspective.

Requirements:

  • 8+ years in security with a significant focus on GRC, regulatory compliance, riskmanagement, or a combination — with a track record of owning these programs at enterpriselevel, not just familiarity with them.

  • Proven experience designing enterprise-level security architectures or frameworks;experience in a regulated financial services environment (brokerage, payments, banking, orequivalent) is preferred but not required.

  • Deep command of ISO 27001 and PCI-DSS (working knowledge of DORA and NIS2preferred), with the ability to translate regulatory text into specific controls, identify gaps, anddetermine what is mandatory versus discretionary.

  • Multi-jurisdiction compliance experience; direct exposure to FCA or CySEC is a strongadvantage.

  • Demonstrated ability to advise and influence C-suite stakeholders on complex security andregulatory matters.

  • A structured, analytical thinking style — able to hold multiple regulatory regimessimultaneously without losing precision on any of them.

  • Fluent English, written and spoken.

Nice to have:

  • Direct experience managing regulatory submissions or engaging with supervisory authorities(FCA, CySEC, ASIC, SCB, or SCA).

  • TPRM program design experience, including DORA ICT third-party risk requirements andsupply chain risk.

  • Business Continuity Management background, with experience meeting operational resilienceobligations and presenting at Board level.

  • Security awareness program design with measurable behaviour-change outcomes.

  • Experience building or scaling a Corporate Security function from an early stage.

  • Relevant professional certifications (CISSP, CISM, CRISC, or equivalent).

title: Technical Solutions Advisor, Cloud & IT Solutions
description:
At CADimensions, we believe great sales is about more than closing deals. It is about building trusted partnerships and helping customers solve real challenges. As a Technical Solutions Advisor focused on Cloud & IT Solutions, you will help customers modernize infrastructure, improve security, enable collaboration, and support growth through technology solutions delivered through our partner, Advance2000.

This role is focused exclusively on Cloud & IT Solutions and is ideal for someone who enjoys consultative selling, building relationships, uncovering customer challenges, and translating technical solutions into business value.

WHAT YOU WILL DO

  • BUILD RELATIONSHIPS & GROW ACCOUNTS
    • Serve as a trusted advisor for existing CADimensions customers by identifying opportunities to improve infrastructure, security, collaboration, and IT operations
    • Build strong relationships with decision makers, IT leaders, engineering teams, operations leaders, and executives
    • Conduct regular customer outreach, account reviews, and follow-up meetings to uncover new opportunities
  • DRIVE NEW BUSINESS OPPORTUNITIES
    • Generate new opportunities through existing customer relationships, outbound prospecting, referrals, networking, marketing campaigns, and events
    • Prospect and develop new logo opportunities focused exclusively on Cloud & IT Solutions
    • Maintain a healthy sales pipeline and consistently move opportunities forward
  • LEAD A CONSULTATIVE SALES PROCESS

    • Identify customer challenges related to cloud infrastructure, cybersecurity, remote collaboration, disaster recovery, CAD hosting, and managed IT services
    • Recommend tailored solutions aligned to customer goals and business outcomes
    • Educate customers on the operational and financial benefits of cloud infrastructure and managed services
  • OWN THE SALES PROCESS
    • Manage opportunities through the full sales cycle from prospecting through close
    • Develop proposals, pricing, presentations, and solution recommendations
    • Maintain accurate activity tracking, pipeline management, forecasting, and opportunity updates within HubSpot CRM
    • Partner closely with technical teams, marketing, and leadership to deliver a seamless customer experience

WHAT WE OFFER

  • Compensation: This position offers a guaranteed base salary plus a performance-driven bonus structure, with expected total annual compensation ranging from $65,000 to $120,000 annually based on experience, performance, and results.
  • Comprehensive Benefits: Health, dental, vision, 401k, life insurance and more.
  • Award-Winning Culture: A workplace culture that has been repeatedly recognized as a great place to work.
  • Training and Development: Access to training and development opportunities to help you grow and succeed.
  • Career Growth: Opportunities for advancement within a dynamic and innovative company.

ABOUT YOU

  • 2+ years of experience in B2B sales, consultative selling, or solution selling
  • Experience selling cloud services, managed IT services, infrastructure solutions, cybersecurity solutions, or SaaS products
  • Strong relationship-building, communication, and presentation skills
  • Ability to understand customer challenges and position technical solutions effectively
  • Comfortable learning new technologies and developing knowledge around cloud solutions, cybersecurity, and managed IT services
  • Experience managing pipelines, opportunities, and CRM activities
  • Self-motivated, organized, and comfortable managing multiple priorities
  • Ability to travel 25%-50% of the time for customer meetings, trade shows, and events

BONUS POINTS IF YOU HAVE

  • Familiarity with manufacturing, engineering, architecture, or industrial business environments
  • Experience with HubSpot or other CRM platforms

ABOUT US
CADimensions, Inc. is the premier provider of innovative tools and solutions for the Engineering and Manufacturing community. We partner with industry leaders to offer state-of-the-art CAD software, 3D printing technologies, and comprehensive consulting services. Our mission is to empower our clients to bring their visions to life by enhancing efficiency and fostering creativity. Whether it's through advanced design services, cutting-edge additive manufacturing, or expert training and support, CADimensions is dedicated to driving success and innovation for our customers. Join us and be a part of a dynamic team that is shaping the future of engineering and manufacturing.

Visit us at CADimensions to learn more about our products and services.

EQUAL OPPORTUNITY EMPLOYER
CADimensions is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, protected veteran status, or any other legally protected characteristic.

description:

title: Allround bogholder søges til vikariat med mulighed for efterfølgende fastansættelse i det centrale København
description:
Kan du godt lide et selvstændigt arbejde hvor du arbejder med de forskellige bogholderiopgaver og har du mulighed for opstart hurtigst muligt, så er denne stilling måske lige netop dig?

Til en af vores kunder i det centrale København søger vi en erfaren allround bogholder til et længerevarende vikariat med mulighed for efterfølgende fastansættelse for den rette kandidat. Her kommer du til at arbejde med bogføring i e-conomic og dokumenthåndtering i Acubiz.

Vores kunde er en dansk virksomhed, og du kommer til at arbejde i et miljø med masser af energi og aktivitet.

En struktureret hverdag i en spændende virksomhed

Du får en afvekslende hverdag, hvor du kommer til referere til virksomhedens Head of Finance, og dine arbejdsopgaver omfatter bl.a.:

  • Debitor-, kreditor og finansbogføring
  • Håndtering af indkomne fakturaer og bilag
  • Opfølgning på rykkere og kontoudtog
  • Bank og øvrige afstemninger
  • Diverse andre økonomi ad hoc-opgaver

Selvstændigt drive og engagement

Vi forventer at du kan starte indenfor en uges tid samt at du er udadvendt, arbejdsom og tager ejerskab over dine arbejdsopgaver. Som person er du hjælpsom og serviceminded, og så er du god til at opfange kundens behov.

Derudover forventer vi, at du:

  • har nogle års erfaring fra lignende stillinger
  • har erfaring med bogføring i e-conomic
  • har en selvstændig, struktureret og effektiv opgavetilgang

ECIT Services

ECIT Services er en del af ECIT-koncernen med mere end 3500 medarbejdere i 10 lande, og som vikar konsulent hos ECIT får du 75 erfarne og kompetente kollegaer, som spænder fra administration (økonomi og regnskab) over konsulentvirksomhed til udvikling af vores kunders IT-systemer. Vi prioriterer et godt fællesskab og deling af viden samt lægger vægt på at hjælpe og have faglig sparring med hinanden, så vi sammen sikrer udviklingen af de mest kompetente og effektive løsninger for fremtidens økonomifunktioner.

Ansættelsesvilkår

Der er tale om en fuldtids projektansættelse via ECIT med opstart hurtigst muligt, og for den rette kandidat vil der være mulighed for en efterfølgende fastansættelse hos vores kunde.

Ansøgning og kontakt

Send venligst din ansøgning hurtigst muligt via ansøgningslinket, men hvis du vil vide mere om stillingen, er du velkommen til at kontakte rekrutteringsansvarlig Henrik Bruun på hbr@ecitservices.dk . Bemærk i den forbindelse at vi ikke modtager ansøgninger via vores mailadresse.

title: Pædagog til Kingosvej – en del af Granhøjens Særlige Tilbud
description:
Vi tror på, at mennesker er mere end deres historie. Også når historien er kompleks.

I Granhøjens Særlige Tilbud (§108) arbejder vi med borgere med kognitive funktionsnedsættelser, som samtidig er omfattet af en dom. Det kræver tid at opbygge relationer, og hverdagen går ikke altid efter planen.

Til gengæld får du et arbejde, hvor du kommer tæt på mennesker og bliver en vigtig del af deres hverdag. Ofte er det de små fremskridt, der betyder mest.

Bliv en del af et stærkt fagligt fællesskab

Du bliver en del af et team, der arbejder på tværs af vores to lokationer, Twillingegården i Vig og Kingosvej i Nykøbing Sj. Du får dog en fast tilknytning på Kingosvej.

Her står du aldrig alene med de svære situationer. Vi sparrer med hinanden og bruger aktivt hinandens erfaringer i hverdagen. Når noget er svært, finder vi løsningerne sammen.

Du får samtidig mulighed for at udvikle dig fagligt gennem supervision og intern uddannelse. Den løbende sparring er en naturlig del af hverdagen. Hos os bliver din faglighed brugt, og dine perspektiver bliver hørt.

Hvordan ser hverdagen ud?

Som pædagog bliver du en vigtig del af hverdagen omkring beboerne.

Nogle dage hjælper du en beboer med at komme godt afsted til beskæftigelse. Andre dage støtter du på en ledsaget udgang eller deltager i en aktivitet i huset. Du er med til at skabe en hverdag, hvor beboerne oplever forudsigelighed og får støtte til det, de gerne vil lykkes med.

Dine opgaver vil blandt andet være at:

  • støtte beboerne i daglige aktiviteter og rutiner
  • arbejde med beboernes individuelle mål og udvikling
  • ledsage beboerne på udgang og til aktiviteter uden for huset
  • deltage i husets fælles aktiviteter
  • dokumentere beboernes udvikling og indsatser
  • samarbejde med kolleger, pårørende og samarbejdspartnere

Du bliver selvfølgelig introduceret grundigt til opgaverne, og du står aldrig alene med ansvaret.

Er det dig, vi leder efter?

Vi forestiller os, at du:

  • har en pædagogisk eller sundhedsfaglig uddannelse
  • har erfaring med - eller lyst til – at arbejde med borgere med kognitive funktionsnedsættelser, som samtidig er omfattet af en dom
  • kan bevare roen og handle professionelt, også når en situation bliver udfordrende
  • har kørekort (B)

Har du kendskab til systemisk og narrative tilgange er det er en fordel, men ikke et krav.

Det får du hos os

  • en fast stilling på 37 timer om ugen
  • en vagtplan, som vi planlægger i fællesskab med arbejdstid i tidsrummet kl. 8-22
  • vagter hver 3. eller 4. weekend
  • mulighed for at udvikle dig fagligt gennem intern uddannelse, supervision, kurser og temadage
  • sundheds- og tandforsikring samt attraktive medarbejderordninger

Skal Kingosvej være din næste arbejdsplads?

Så send os en kort ansøgning sammen med dit CV via linket herunder.

Ansøgningsfristen er d. 22. september 2026

Har du spørgsmål til stillingen? Tag endelig fat i afdelingsleder, Liza Rueløkke på telefon 24492720 eller på mail liru@grh.dk.

Vi anvender elektronisk rekruttering og modtager derfor ikke ansøgninger via mail eller fysisk post.

Du må gerne bruge AI som hjælp, når du søger hos os. Det vigtigste er, at vi stadig kan mærke dig i ansøgningen og forstå, hvad der motiverer dig, og hvorfor jobbet giver mening for dig.

Hos os er der mennesker på den anden side af din ansøgning. Vi bruger ikke AI til at screene eller vurdere kandidater.


Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig!

Mere om Granhøjen

Granhøjen er en del af virksomheden Gran Recovery and Health som er en privatpsykiatrisk koncern, hvor vi tilbyder bolig, behandling og beskæftigelse til voksne med fysiske og psykiske vanskeligheder. Vi tror på, at alle mennesker er andet og mere end deres udfordringer eller diagnoser – og vi tror på, at vi alle gør en stor forskel sammen!

Læs mere om vores arbejdsplads, og mød dine kollegaer her.

title: Pædagogisk konsulent til PPR
description:
Er vejledning dit felt, og er du passioneret omkring understøttelse af børn og unge i vanskeligheder? Brænder du for at være med til at styrke børns deltagelsesmuligheder i skolernes læringsfællesskaber, og ønsker du at være med i et stærkt team i Pædagogisk Psykologisk rådgivning? Så er det måske dig, vi har brug for!

Da en af vores pædagogiske konsulenter har fået en lederstilling, søger Pædagogisk Psykologisk Rådgivning en pædagogiske konsulent til at varetage opgaver i Odense kommunes Timeout-team.

Timeout-teamet er et udkørende team, som betjener kommunens skoler i situationer, hvor børn udviser grænseoverskridende adfærd, og skolen har brug for øjeblikkelig hjælp. Timeout-teamet er et tværfagligt team af pædagogiske konsulenter og psykologer, som arbejder i makkerpar. Vi tilrettelægger og faciliterer intensive forløb, hvor skole og netværk omkring et barn/en ung aktiveres og træder sammen for at få øje på handlemuligheder, der gør, at barnet/den unge kan blive en del af (lærings)fællesskabet igen.

Timeout-teamet har AMBIT-metoden som navigationsmiddel og mentalisering som ledestjerne. Vi betragter børn og unges grænseoverskridende adfærd som et symptom og en invitation til de voksne til, at blive nysgerrige på barnets levede liv. I Timeout-teamet er vi koordinerende, vi sætter os gerne for bordenden, og vi tør vise vej i situationer, hvor samarbejdet mellem de voksne kan være sårbart og svært.

Stillingen er på 37 timer ugentlig med opstart pr. 1.november 2026.

Om PPR
PPR betjener alle Odense kommunes skoler. Vi er en gruppe med en mangfoldig videns-, interesse- og erfaringsbredde, hvor vi er optaget af at anvende og udvikle kompetencer, læring og viden sammen. Det faglige niveau er højt, og vi har fokus på at arbejde forebyggende, konsultativt og relationelt med kontekster og sammenhænge. Vi har et stærkt kollegialt fællesskab, hvor der er plads til socialt samvær både om faglige såvel som fællesskabsorienterede dagsordener.

PPR er en del af Tværfaglig Sundhed og Forebyggelse, som er organiseret i Børn- og Ungeforvaltningen. Vi er en del af en stor tværfaglig og forebyggende enhed, som dækker det almene og det specialiserede område fra 0-18 år. Vi tilstræber sammen en hverdag med god trivsel, høj faglighed og helhedsorienterede processer. Vi har et tæt samarbejde med forvaltningens Skoleafdeling og Dagtilbudsafdeling.

Vi tilbyder en dynamisk arbejdsplads med mange nye og forskelligartede opgaver. Et fællesskab med omsorgsfulde, lyttende og dygtige kollegaer, der bakker hinanden op fagligt og forstår at hygge sig socialt. Vi er en arbejdsplads, der prioriterer et stærkt tværfagligt samarbejde, fast tid til sparring i faggruppen/teamet og prioritering af fælles forberedelse af opgaverne, ligesom vi tilbyder dig et onboardingforløb med fast mentortid og makkeroplæring.

Om jobbet
Du kommer til at arbejde med spændende, afvekslende og ofte komplekse opgaver i makkerpar med en psykolog eller en pædagogisk konsulent.

Dine arbejdsopgaver vil bl.a. bestå i at:

  • Være gennemgående tovholder for skole, børn og deres familier i en svær periode i barnets skoleliv
  • Koordinere forløb i samarbejde med skole og forældre
  • Vejlede og understøtte medarbejderteams på skoler i forhold til at skabe deltagelsesmuligheder for børn i vanskelige skoleforløb gennem justeringer i læringsmiljøet
  • Skabe nye narrativer og forståelser omkring barnet gennem anerkendende undersøgelser
  • Bidrage til udviklingsdagsordenen på det almene pædagogisk-psykologiske område
Om dig

  • Du er uddannet lærer og har efteruddannelse, der retter sig mod vejledning og supervision
  • Du er rundet af en systemisk tænkning og ser barnets adfærd som invitation til at være nysgerrig
  • Du har gode vejlederevner og erfaring i at anvende forskellige metoder, der bidrager til at skabe læring i teams
  • Du har erfaring med (eller interesse for) koordinerende opgaver/funktioner
  • Du kan sætte dig for bordenden, være faciliterende og samarbejdende i forskellige mødefora
  • Du har lyst til at indgå i et meningsfuldt arbejde, hvor du både har blik på barnet/gruppen og på at støtte de professionelles betingelser for at lykkes
  • Du betragter fleksibilitet i opgaveløsningen, omstillingsparathed og positivitet som selvfølgelige elementer i en hverdagspraksis
  • Du evner og har prioritet for det tværfaglige og helhedsorienterede samarbejde i en praksisnær opgaveløsning
  • Du trives, når du er i læring og bidrager til samarbejdet i en lærende organisation
Løn- og ansættelsesvilkår
Stillingen aflønnes efter gældende overenskomst. Det forventede lønniveau oplyses inden en eventuel samtale og afhænger af erfaring og kvalifikationer.

Vil du vide mere?
Har du spørgsmål til stillingen, så er du velkommen til at kontakte leder af PPR, Heidi Adele Have på heah@odense.dk eller på 21 76 27 76.

Det praktiske
Ansøgningsfrist er søndag den 20. september 2026. Ansættelsessamtaler afholdes den 24. september 2026.

Bemærk der indkaldes med kort frist!

title: Social- og sundhedsassistent til demens bo enheder på Mou plejecenter
description:
Brænder du for at gøre en forskel for vores beboere – og vil du være en del af et engageret og fagligt stærkt team?

Mou Plejecenter søger en social- og sundhedsassistent, der har erfaring med demensomsorg og pleje, og som ønsker at bidrage til et meningsfuldt hverdagsliv for vores beboere.

Mou plejecenter med 36 boliger i et plan. Der er 12 somatiske pladser og 24 demenspladser fordelt over tre bo enheder.

title: Postdoc Position with Novo Nordisk Foundation Research CO2 Center Aarhus University, Denmark
description:
Postdoc Position with Novo Nordisk Foundation Research CO2 at Aarhus University, Denmark
The Novo Nordisk Foundation is establishing a world-leading interdisciplinary research center to develop knowledge and technology to capture and recycle carbon dioxide. The center will be based at Aarhus University in Denmark and will collaborate with industry and authorities to identify new solutions to reduce atmospheric CO2 levels.

The electrochemical section, led by Professor Kim Daasbjerg, is seeking candidates for a two-year postdoc position at this CO2 center.

The postdoc position is available from December 01, 2026, or as soon as possible thereafter.

Your tasks
The successful candidate will conduct research on developing catalysts for bicarbonate conversion using electrochemical methods. The focus will be on designing the interfacial organic layer at the electrode surface to promote the selective reduction of CO2 to syngas or ethylene. In addition, the most promising processes will be scaled up using electrochemical flow cells. This work will be carried out in collaboration with other members of the Daasbjerg research group.

Your requirements
The successful candidate
  • is required to have a strong background in electrochemistry
  • must be familiar with catlysis for carrying out chemical transactions
  • must have a PhD degree in Chemistry or similar
  • is expected to have significant experience in flow technology
  • must have experience with international collaborations and serve as a mentor/leader for the research group


Who are we
The Department of Chemistry is among the most successful departments in the Faculty of Natural Sciences at Aarhus University. The department houses several of the Danish National Research Foundation’s Centers of Excellence and teaches many of the faculty's degree programs. Comprising a wide range of scientific areas, the department is a strong partner in interdisciplinary initiatives, especially in the Novo Nordisk Foundation CO2 Research Center. The Department of Chemistry also educates most chemists in Denmark, with well over 200 active BSc students, a considerable number of MSc students, and more than 100 PhD students. The department has 42 permanent academic staff members, a strong support organization, and a considerable number of affiliated researchers.

What we offer
The successful candidate is offered:
  • access to a well-developed research infrastructure
  • laboratory space, shared equipment
  • a research climate inviting lively, open, and critical discussion within and across different fields of research
  • a working environment with teamwork, close working relations, network activities among young scientists, and social activities
  • a workplace characterized by professionalism, equality, and a healthy work-life balance


Place of work
The place of work is Gustav Wieds Vej 10, 8000 Aarhus C, and the area of employment is Aarhus University with affiliated institutions.

Contact information
For further information, please contact Professor Kim Daasbjerg at +45 23485249 or kdaa@chem.au.dk.

Application deadline
Applications must be received no later than 22 September 2026.

Application procedure
Shortlisting is used. This means that after the deadline for applications – and with the assistance from the assessment committee chairman, and the appointment committee if necessary, – the head of department selects the candidates to be evaluated. All applicants will be notified whether or not their applications have been sent to an expert assessment committee for evaluation. The selected applicants will be informed about the composition of the committee, and each applicant is given the opportunity to comment on the part of the assessment that concerns him/her self.

Formalities and salary range
Natural Sciences refers to the Ministerial Order on the Appointment of Academic Staff at Danish Universities under the Danish Ministry of Science, Technology and Innovation.

The application must be in English and include a curriculum vitae, degree certificate, a complete list of publications, a statement of future research plans and information about research activities, teaching portfolio and verified information on previous teaching experience (if any). Guidelines for applicants can be found here.

Appointment shall be in accordance with the collective labour agreement between the Danish Ministry of Taxation and the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations. Further information on qualification requirements and job content may be found in the Memorandum on Job Structure for Academic Staff at Danish Universities.

Salary and terms as agreed between the Danish Ministry of Taxation and the Confederation of Professional Unions at basic salary steps 4-8.

Aarhus University’s ambition is to be an attractive and inspiring workplace for all and to foster a culture in which each individual has opportunities to thrive, achieve and develop. We view equality and diversity as assets, and we welcome all applicants.

Research activities will be evaluated in relation to actual research time. Thus, we encourage applicants to specify periods of leave without research activities, in order to be able to subtract these periods from the span of the scientific career during the evaluation of scientific productivity.

Aarhus University offers a broad variety of services for international researchers and accompanying families, including relocation service and career counselling to expat partners. Read more here. Please find more information about entering and working in Denmark here.

Aarhus University also offers a Junior Researcher Development Programme targeted at career development for postdocs at AU. You can read more about it here.

At the Faculty of Natural Science at Aarhus University, we strive to support our scientific staff in their career development. We focus on competency development and career clarification and want to make your opportunities transparent. On our website, you can find information on all types of scientific positions, as well as the entry criteria we use when assessing candidates. You can also read more about how we can assist you in your career planning and development.

The application must be submitted via Aarhus University’s recruitment system, which can be accessed under the job advertisement on Aarhus University's website.

title: Psychiatrist (Child or Adult)
description:

As a psychiatrist at LifeStance, your focus remains on patient care. Our dedicated teams handle billing, technology, and administrative tasks, while local clinical leadership offers ongoing support and consultation to ensure your work is professionally rewarding.

You’ll work alongside experienced therapists, neuropsychologists, and psychiatric nurse practitioners in a collegial environment that encourages collaboration.
Finally, we place a high value on lifelong learning. Psychiatrists at LifeStance have access to regular Grand Rounds led by subject matter experts, weekly consult hours with clinical leadership, a generous CME stipend, and opportunities to receive training in TMS and other innovative therapies. title: Relationsstærk lærer søges til Ladegårdsskolen
description:
En udviklingsorienteret specialskole i Holbæk

Vi søger en engageret lærer til Ladegårdsskolen. Vi er en specialskole – og fritidshjem med elever, hvis udviklingsniveau varierer, vi rummer både børn med multiple funktionsnedsættelser og elever med gennemgribende udviklingsforstyrrelser.

Skolen er fordelt på tre matrikler i Holbæk by og har ca. 120 elever.

Om os

På Ladegårdsskolen brænder vi for at skabe trygge, inkluderende og udviklende læringsmiljøer, hvor eleverne mødes med respekt, anerkendelse og realistiske forventninger. Vores arbejde tager altid udgangspunkt i den enkelte elevs forudsætninger, styrker, potentialer og behov.

Vi arbejder for, at alle elever får mulighed for at udvikle selvstændighed og deltage i fællesskaber i det omfang, de mestrer og trives i. Vi lægger derfor vægt på, at skoledagen er

struktureret, forudsigelig og individuelt tilpasset til vores elever.

Vi har særligt fokus på

  • Relationsarbejde og ressourceorienteret pædagogik og læring.
  • At skabe faglig, social og personlig udvikling i små, trygge fællesskaber.
  • Visuel og tydelig struktur.
  • Alternativ og supplerende kommunikation (ASK) og totalkommunikation.
  • ADL-træning og udvikling af selvstændighed.
  • Sanse- og motorikunderstøttende aktiviteter.
  • Tæt tværfagligt samarbejde med kolleger, forældre og eksterne fagpersoner.

Om dig

Vi søger dig, der vil indgå i et tæt og forpligtende teamsamarbejde, som ønsker at bidrage aktivt til udviklingen af læringsmiljøer for elever med særlige behov og ikke mindst har lyst til at arbejde i et specialpædagogisk miljø.

Vi lægger vægt på, at du:

  • er relationelt stærk, hjertevarm, tålmodig og anerkendende.
  • arbejder struktureret og kan tilpasse undervisningen til den enkelte elev.
  • er nysgerrig og reflekterende over egen praksis.
  • trives i et tæt tværfagligt samarbejde.
  • har interesse for eller erfaring med TEACCH-inspireret special pædagogik eller ASK.
  • kan arbejde i et miljø, hvor udadreagerende adfærd kan forekomme, og hvor personlig pleje kan være en del af opgaven.
  • bevarer ro og overblik i krævende situationer.

Vi tilbyder

Du bliver en del af et fagligt fællesskab med løbende kompetenceudvikling, sparring, fælles planlægning og teamsupervision. Vi arbejder med afsæt i KRAP, ICDP og en tydelig Low Arousal-tilgang. Du møder engagerede kolleger, et tværfagligt miljø og en praksisnær ledelse med fokus på gennemsigtighed og et sundt arbejdsmiljø.

Gitte Lohmann Olsen – afdelingsleder.

Tlf. 72362890

Mail: golse@holb.dk

title: Seasonal Coordinator, Hiring Events Team
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Seasonal Coordinator, Hiring Events Team based in the United States.

This is an opportunity to coordinate virtual hiring programs that connect international participants with seasonal employment opportunities across the United States.
You’ll manage the full lifecycle of virtual hiring events, from understanding employer staffing needs to coordinating interviews and post-event follow-up.
The role combines event coordination, stakeholder communication, customer service, scheduling, and operational administration.
You’ll work closely with host employers, international representatives, applicants, and internal teams in a fast-paced, multicultural environment.
Your organization and attention to detail will help ensure hiring events run smoothly and participants and employers receive a consistent experience.
The position is ideal for a proactive coordinator who enjoys solving problems, managing multiple priorities, and working with people across different cultures and time zones.
This is a remote opportunity available within the Atlantic, Eastern, and Central U.S. time zones, with some early morning, evening, and travel requirements.

Accountabilities:

  • Coordinate virtual hiring services and events, ensuring employers and prospective participants are prepared throughout the process.
  • Communicate with internal teams, host employers, international representatives, and applicants through email, telephone, Skype, Microsoft Teams, and other communication channels.
  • Review host employer staffing needs and allocate available positions appropriately.
  • Communicate position requirements and hiring information to international representatives and make adjustments to staffing allocations when necessary.
  • Organize virtual events by creating calendar invitations, sending reminders, coordinating schedules, and communicating changes promptly.
  • Manage participant enrollments and ensure all required interview documentation is completed before virtual hiring events.
  • Provide live technical and operational support to stakeholders during virtual hiring events.
  • Conduct applicant interviews for placement into seasonal employment positions.
  • Provide professional, responsive, and consistent customer service throughout the hiring process.
  • Complete post-event reporting and maintain accurate, up-to-date hiring records in the relevant database.
  • Coordinate multiple events and daily projects simultaneously while maintaining strong attention to detail.
  • Collaborate across teams to resolve issues, gather information, communicate project status, and keep hiring activities on track.
  • Contribute to additional projects and responsibilities as assigned.

    • Requirements:

    • Bachelor’s degree required.
    • At least 1 year of experience in a customer-facing or client management role.
    • Event planning, scheduling, or coordination experience preferred; familiarity with virtual event management is an advantage.
    • Strong computer skills, including proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite; experience with Salesforce and advanced Excel capabilities, including macros, is preferred.
    • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to interact professionally with diverse stakeholders.
    • Exceptional customer service, critical-thinking, problem-solving, and decision-making abilities.
    • Strong organizational skills and meticulous attention to detail.
    • Self-motivated and proactive, with the ability to take initiative and independently drive projects forward.
    • Demonstrated ability to deliver results within a fast-paced, collaborative team environment.
    • Ability to gather information effectively and clearly communicate project direction, updates, and status.
    • Strong multitasking skills and the ability to manage competing priorities while overseeing events and daily operations.
    • Flexibility to work some early mornings and evenings to accommodate host employer schedules.
    • Willingness to travel occasionally for overseas hiring events and domestic activities.
    • Growth-oriented mindset with an interest in continuously developing yourself, stakeholders, and program operations.
    • Ability to work effectively in a multicultural environment and demonstrate professionalism, integrity, respect, inclusion, excellence, and a strong problem-solving approach.
    • Successful completion of required background checks and education and employment verification.

      • Benefits:

      • Remote work within the Atlantic, Eastern, and Central U.S. time zones.
      • Opportunity to work in a fast-paced, international, and collaborative environment.
      • Meaningful opportunity to contribute to international exchange and intercultural experiences.
      • Exposure to global stakeholders, including international representatives, U.S. host employers, and participants from around the world.
      • Opportunity to develop experience across virtual event management, recruitment coordination, customer service, and international program operations.
      • Potential opportunities for domestic and international travel connected to hiring events.
      • Mission-driven workplace focused on inclusion, collaboration, professional development, and creating meaningful connections across cultures.

title: VIL DU VÆRE EN DEL AF ET TILBUD FOR BORGERE MED AUTISME-SPEKTRUM-FORSTYRRELSER - SØGER SOCIALFAGLIG MEDARBEJDER OG ERGOTERAPEUT
description:
- og vil du være en del af den tværfaglige udvikling vi har igangsat?

Tingagergården er et døgndækket botilbud efter § 107 og §85. Der bor 23 borgere over 18 år, som alle har udfordringer indenfor autismespektret og udviklingshæmning og deraf varig nedsat psykisk funktionsevne.

Alle borgere på Tingagergården har behov for støtte til at strukturere hverdagen og på forskellig vis guides mod indfrielse af deres ønsker og drømme. Den socialpædagogiske indsats tager udgangspunkt i inddragelse og involvering af borgeren, mhp. at styrke og udvikle selvstændighed og livsmestring.

En del af borgerne er tilknyttet eksterne dagtilbud, uddannelse, praktik eller beskæftigelse.

Om stillingerne

Vi arbejder som udgangspunkt med metoderne KRAP, LA2 og Åben Dialog, og der er fokus på at sikre sammenhæng mellem daglig praksis, relationel tilgang og borgerens individuelle mål, egne ønsker og drømme.

Som ansat på Tingagergården indgår man i teams på 4-5 medarbejdere omkring en gruppe borgere, hvor man, som kontaktperson varetager den primære tovholderfunktion for 2-3 borgere, i tæt samarbejde med resten af teamet.

Vi søger en ergoterapeut og en pædagog, der begge:

  • Er gode til at strukturere, motivere og udfordre i trygge rammer.
  • Er involverende, inddragende og respektfulde i mødet med borgere og pårørende.
  • Gerne formidler og deler ud af sin faglige viden.
  • Trives med dokumentation, som en vigtig del af kerneopgaven.
  • Står solidt på begge ben, er stabil og kan tilpasse praksis ift. at hver dag er forskellig.
  • Trives med en høj grad af teamsamarbejde.
  • Drives af aktivt at påvirke og udvikle vores arbejdsplads.
  • Er indstillet på skiftende arbejdstider, dag-, aften- og rådighedsvagter samt arbejde hver tredje weekend, samt helligdage.
  • Har kørekort, og er villig til at køre vores minibus.
  • Kan være vedholdende i relationen og tænke ud af boksen med nye måder at se på opgaven.

Det er en fordel, hvis du har kendskab til autismespektrumforstyrrelse, psykiatriske tillægsdiagnoser (fx angst, depression, OCD, ADHD) samt viden om konflikthåndtering.

Vi tilbyder:

  • En arbejdsplads med fokus på faglig udvikling, metodeanvendelse og et sundt arbejdsmiljø.
  • En arbejdsplads med høj faglig tilgang og et spirende tværfagligt fællesskab med fokus på kerneopgaven.
  • En arbejdsplads der prioriterer at arbejde i dybden vedr. den enkelte borgers støttebehov.
  • En arbejdsplads der ønsker dit aktive bidrag til udvikling både fagligt og kulturelt.
  • En arbejdsplads der stiller gensidige forventninger, og viser du er vigtig.
  • Erfarne, engagerede og fagligt dygtige kollegaer.
  • Et grundigt introprogram for nye medarbejdere i Center for Autismetilbud for Voksne samt tilknytning til en mentor, som vil have ekstra opmærksomhed på din opstart på Tingagergården.

Alle borgerne har en autismespektrumforstyrrelse og begavelse under eller i den lave ende af normalområdet.


Løn og ansættelsesvilkår:
Løn og ansættelsesvilkår vil være i henhold til gældende overenskomst. Endelig lønfastsættelse sker efter forhandling med den forhandlingsberettigede faglige organisation på baggrund af kvalifikationer.

Ugentligt timetal: 37.

Stillingen er til enhver tid betinget af en tilfredsstillende offentlig straffeattest.


Hvis du vil vide mere:
Yderligere oplysninger om stillingen kan fås ved henvendelse til afdelingsleder Martin Harnisch telefon 41855697. På hverdage mellem kl. 9.00-14.00. Evt. spørgsmål kan desuden stilles via mail: harmar@aarhus.dk

Ansøgning
Klik på ”Ansøg” nedenfor for at udfylde og sende din ansøgning. Alle felter med * skal udfyldes. Først når du har modtaget en kvittering pr. e-mail, har vi modtaget din ansøgning.

Ansøgningsfrist: 20. september 2026.

Vi forventer samtalerne finder sted i uge 39 på Tingagergården, Tilst Skolevej 17, 8381 Tilst.





Om Sociale Forhold og BeskæftigelseVi ved, at det gode liv går gennem uddannelse, job og selvforsørgelse for langt de fleste – og meningsfulde fællesskaber for alle. Derfor er vi mere end 7000 mennesker, der går på arbejde hver dag for aarhusianere med et handicap, et integrationsbehov, dem, der lever socialt udsatte liv og dem, der har brug for at finde vej til det næste job. Vi arbejder med alt det, der er svært, men også med det vigtigste, der findes: aarhusianernes kernevelfærd. Vi er årligt i kontakt med omkring 100.000 aarhusianere, der får vores støtte til et liv med håb og handlekraft.

Om Aarhus Kommune
Aarhus Kommune er en af Jyllands største arbejdspladser, hvor 28.000 professionelle og passionerede kollegaer hver dag arbejder for at gøre visioner til virkelighed og skabe værdi for borgere og samfundet omkring os. Vi er en arbejdsplads, der vægter faglighed og samarbejde højt og vi tror på, at vores forskelligheder er med til at gøre Aarhus for en god by for alle.

Sammen arbejder vi for en bæredygtig og inkluderende by, hvor både ansatte, borgere, virksomheder og naturen kan trives og blomstre. Vi har ambitioner for byen – og for dig. Kom og vær med!

title: Associate Director – Integration, Separation & Carve-Out
description:
By joining our rapidly growing Private Equity practice, you will serve as a trusted partner to PE clients executing buy-and-build, carve-out, and divestiture investment theses.

You will bring first-hand experience, unique perspectives, and functional knowledge to deliver strategic and tactical integration, separation, and TSA support to PE sponsors and management teams.

As an Associate Director, you will be responsible for a mix of client delivery, team leadership, and developing junior team members. You will also participate in account management and business development activities.

What You'll Do

Finance & Office of the CFO

  • Own the Finance workstream on post-close integrations and separations — P&L, balance sheet, cash flow, and working capital through the full transaction lifecycle.
  • Lead or support the preparation of standalone cost models
  • Support management in drafting and pricing TSA-s and the related services (on the sell side) or performing diligence on such agreements (on the buy side

Integration work

  • Lead complex integration engagements, translating the sponsor's thesis into a cross-functional plan covering every workstream.
  • Build target operating models and re-engineer processes for post-close and NewCo operating states.
  • Drive Day 1 integration readiness across functions.
  • Own C-suite and sponsor communication on integration progress.
  • Drive holistic IMO and program management.
  • Contribute to developing and implementing firm-approved, AI-enabled solutions for clients, in accordance with company policies on data protection, intellectual property, and professional standards.
  • Stay informed about emerging AI tools and techniques and collaborate with firm leadership to identify compliant opportunities to enhance client solutions and internal processes.

Separation and Carve-Out work

  • Lead separation, carve-out, and divestiture engagements end-to-end, including the stand-up of NewCo entities.
  • Run functional separation planning and entanglement analysis.
  • Structure, negotiate, and manage TSAs and reverse TSAs, including scoping, pricing, service levels, and exit planning.
  • Lead legal entity separation, IT and data separation, and employee and customer migrations.
  • Stand up standalone operating capabilities for divested businesses.
  • Manage stranded cost identification and remediation planning.
  • Drive holistic program management and PMO; keep client leadership, deal teams, and third parties aligned through execution.

Internal / Business Development

  • Build new client relationships, deepen existing ones, and support partners in go-to-market efforts and proposal creation.
  • Play a key role in talent development, including mentoring and coaching junior team members.
  • Attract, interview, hire, and retain top talent.

What You'll Bring

  • 7+ years of prior experience in professional services or in-house M&A/integration leadership at a PE-backed company.
  • Experience in preparing and reviewing standalone cost models to support carve out transactions.
  • Hands-on experience structuring and managing TSAs from inception — scoping, pricing, service levels, and exit planning.
  • PE Sponsor relationship management presenting to and advising CFOs, boards, and deal teams.
  • Track record of running large-scale transformation projects to completion.
  • Direct experience across M&A integrations, carve-outs, and divestitures.
  • Experience mentoring and developing junior talent.
  • Comfort with AI: Demonstrated ability to responsibly explore and adopt firm-approved AI tools to enhance productivity and innovation.
  • Continuous learning mindset: Openness to learning and applying emerging technologies, including AI and automation, in alignment with firm policies and client standards

Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business, Economics, Engineering, Finance, Information Systems, or similar technical discipline.
  • CPA or CA credential strongly preferred.
  • Willingness to travel to client sites as needed — hybrid delivery model.

title: Pædagogmedhjælper søges til SFO på Næstved Specialskole
description:
Næstved Specialskole er kommunens niveau 3-tilbud på det specialiserede område. Aktuelt er der indskrevet 114 elever. Eleverne kan gå i skole, SFO og klub hos os fra 0.-9./10. klassetrin. Eleverne bliver visiteret hertil og har behov for specialiseret støtte og har som udgangspunkt følgende målgruppebeskrivelser:

• Multiple funktionsnedsættelser
• Autisme Spektrum Forstyrrelse
• Gennemgribende indlæringsvanskeligheder
• Følelsesmæssige- og reguleringsvanskeligheder
• Et kognitivt funktionsniveau der ligger væsentligt under gennemsnittet

På Næstved Specialskole er vi optaget af at skabe læring, trivsel og udvikling for alle elever. Vi arbejder i trygge læringsfællesskaber, hvor det enkelte barn kan udvikle sig fagligt, socialt og personligt i samspil med andre elever og professionelle voksne.

Vi søger en engageret og stabil medhjælper til vores SFO. Stillingen er på fuld tid og indeholder både timer i skolens undervisningsdel og i SFO'en om eftermiddagen.

Vi søger en medarbejder, som brænder for at skabe gode relationer til børn med særlige behov og som møder dem med nysgerrighed, tålmodighed og troen på, at alle børn har udviklingsmuligheder. Vi ønsker en kollega, der ser muligheder frem for begrænsninger og som kan bidrage til en hverdag præget af trivsel, deltagelsesmuligheder og fællesskab.

I vores SFO vægter vi leg, relationer og meningsfulde aktiviteter højt. Vi ser legen som en essentiel del af barnets udvikling og som en vigtig vej til læring, kommunikation, deltagelse og sociale fællesskaber.

Vi søger en stabil medarbejder, som kan se sig selv i nedenstående:

  • Er uddannet pædagog og har erfaring fra området
  • Arbejder fagligt, professionelt og anerkende med børn
  • Har stor forståelse og erfaring med de behov, der gør sig gældende for børn med autisme
  • Glædes ved at indgå i tæt samarbejde med kollegaer
  • God til at formulere sig mundtligt og skriftligt
  • Har et lyst sind og blik for børns potentialer
  • Kan se dig selv arbejde både i skole og i SFO
  • Ser legen som en væsentlig del af børns trivsel, udvikling og læring

Vi tilbyder:

  • En dejlig skole beliggende centralt i Næstved by
  • Et godt arbejdsmiljø
  • Erfarne og hjælpsomme kollegaer, som er klar til at hjælpe dig ind i opgaverne
  • Mulighed for at gøre en forskel
  • Supervision til alle medarbejdere
  • Klasser hvor man altid er flere voksne sammen
  • En nærværende og anerkendende ledelse der ønsker at være tæt på

Løn- og ansættelsesvilkår sker i henhold til gældende overenskomst indgået mellem KL og FOA.

title: Pædagogmedhjælper til Specialklasserækkerne på Sluseholmen Skole
description:
Er du passioneret omkring børns udvikling og trivsel? Brænder du for at gøre en forskel i hverdagen for børn med særlige behov? Så er det måske dig, vi gerne vil have med i vores team.

Vi søger en engageret pædagogmedhjælper til Specialklasserækkerne på Sluseholmen Skole, som har interesse for – og gerne erfaring med at støtte børn med autisme og ADHD.

Om Specialklasserækkerne på Sluseholmen Skole
Specialklasserækkerne på Sluseholmen Skole i København SV er et specialtilbud, der er startet op i juli 2024. Det er et tilbud for elever med gennemgribende udviklingsforstyrrelser og specifikke indlæringsvanskeligheder (KAT. 3). Eleverne har typisk diagnoser indenfor autismespektret og/eller opmærksomhedsforstyrrelser. Derudover har nogle af eleverne oplevet udfordringer med angst, skolevægring og stressbelastning. Tilbuddet indebærer både skole- og KKFO/klubtilbud.

Pædagogisk profil
I specialklasserækkerne arbejder vi relationsbaseret og TEACCH-inspireret med faste strukturer, genkendelighed, tydelig visuel struktur og Co-teaching. Vi arbejder med Low Arousal, og vores børnesyn tager udgangspunkt i princippet om, at alle børn gør det godt, når de kan.

Vi søger dig, der

  • Har erfaring med at arbejde med børn med autisme og ADHD
  • Er tålmodig, empatisk og har stærke kommunikations- og samarbejdsevner
  • Er robust, åben for faglig sparring og vejledning og tror på, at de bedste løsninger skabes i fællesskab
  • Ser relationsarbejde som en forudsætning for elevernes udvikling
  • Er initiativrig og kan arbejde selvstændigt og indgå konstruktivt i teamsamarbejde
Dine opgaver

  • At støtte og guide børnene i deres hverdag – fagligt, socialt og personligt, både i skoletid og i KKFO
  • At bidrage til at skabe struktur, forudsigelighed og tryghed i børnenes skole- og fritidsliv
  • At arbejde tæt sammen med kolleger, forældre og eksterne samarbejdspartnere
  • At implementere individuelle lærings- og udviklingsforløb tilpasset barnets behov
  • At deltage i planlægning og afholdelse af aktiviteter, der fremmer trivsel samt sociale og faglige kompetencer
Vi tilbyder

  • En dynamisk arbejdsplads med fokus på medinddragelse og mulighed for faglig udvikling
  • Dygtige og imødekommende kolleger og ledere, som er parate til at tage godt imod dig
  • Et rigtig godt arbejdsmiljø, hvor der er kort vej fra idé til handling og med plads til dig og dine ideer
  • Vi arbejder tæt sammen i tværfaglige teams, hvor vi vægter samarbejde, åbenhed og respekt for hinandens fagligheder
Ansættelsesvilkår
Stillingen er på 30-37 timer om ugen, og arbejdstiden ligger typisk imellem kl. 8.00 og 17.00 mandag-fredag. Stillingen er tidsbegrænset til ca. ni måneder evt. med mulighed for forlængelse. Vi håber, at du kan starte den 1. oktober 2026 eller snarest derefter.

Ansættelsen er pr. 1. oktober 2026 og er efter gældende overenskomst og forhåndaftale.

title: Klinikassistentelev søges til Godt Smil Hillerød
description:
Vi søger endnu en dygtig elev til teamet - er du vores nye kollega?


Praktiske oplysninger

Stillingen er på 37 timer og vi vil gerne have dig med på holdet så hurtigt som muligt.

Vi holder samtaler løbende så send din ansøgning hurtigst muligt.

Vi tilbyder dig

I Hillerød er vi et team med 5 tandlæger, 4 tandplejere, 5 assistenter og en klinikkoordinator. Klinikken er beliggende i industrikvarteret og råder over 7 klinikrum. Klinikken er udstyret med blandt andet Trios og CBCT.

Vi er vant til at have elever og vil sætte en ære i at gøre dig dygtig. Hos os vil du få stor indflydelse på dit arbejde, og vi lægger stor vægt på trivsel, arbejdsmiljø og faglig sparring.

Vi tilbyder dig at få en bred faglig uddannelse i et familiært netværk, med kollegaer der gerne vil lære fra sig. Du kommer hos os til at assistere til alle typer af behandlinger, samt hjælpe til i vores reception.

Derudover kan vi tilbyde:

  • Gode og ordnede forhold på en klinik hvor vi har fokus på den gode patientoplevelse
  • Medindflydelse på dagligdagen og mulighed for selvstændige opgaver
  • Dygtige kolleger der hjælper hinanden og har det sjovt sammen i hverdagen
  • Topmoderne klinikker med det nyeste udstyr

Din personlige profil

  • Du er smilende og imødekommende
  • Du er en holdspiller der ønsker at bidrage til en god kommunikation og et behageligt arbejdsmiljø
  • Du må gerne være ny-mesterlære elev, vi har stor erfaring med elever på klinikken.

Hvorfor Godt Smil?

Vi har hos Godt Smil fagligheden i højsædet og din hverdag vil være præget af et tæt tværfagligt samarbejde i et uformelt og energisk miljø.

Vi arbejder hårdt med at tilrettelægge arbejdet, så patienterne får den bedste oplevelse, og her får du som klinikassistent i Godt Smil en nøglerolle.

title: Technical Project Manager: Digital Payments
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Technical Project Manager: Digital Payments based in the United States.

This role offers the opportunity to own a critical workstream within a larger, multi-team digital payments program.
You will take an existing MVP from active development through rollout, production readiness, and the definition of its next-generation capabilities.
The position combines project leadership with hands-on technical and tactical analysis, requiring you to understand both delivery details and broader business objectives.
You will coordinate engineers, technical leads, business stakeholders, and client teams to maintain momentum and resolve complex dependencies.
A key part of the role will be shaping V2 requirements, priorities, scope, and delivery plans based on stakeholder needs and lessons from the MVP.
You will operate in the fast-moving financial technology space, with exposure to payment systems and modern cloud environments.
The role is well suited to a technically fluent project leader who can bring structure, clarity, and momentum to complex digital initiatives.

Accountabilities:

  • Own the day-to-day management and delivery of an assigned workstream within a larger, multi-team digital payments program.
  • Coordinate technical and cross-functional teams to keep the MVP rollout on schedule and support a successful transition into production.
  • Drive V2 definition and scoping by working with stakeholders to clarify business needs, technical requirements, priorities, and delivery expectations.
  • Apply tactical technical analysis to understand system details, dependencies, constraints, and implementation considerations rather than focusing solely on schedules and status reporting.
  • Track milestones, progress, dependencies, resource needs, and timelines across the workstream.
  • Identify risks, blockers, and delivery issues early, escalating appropriately and partnering with technical leads to develop effective solutions.
  • Facilitate alignment across engineering, business, program, and client stakeholders around status, decisions, priorities, and tradeoffs.
  • Translate complex technical information into clear updates and actionable decisions for non-technical stakeholders and program leadership.
  • Support team scaling by contributing to workforce planning, onboarding, and integration of additional engineers as the workstream grows.
  • Provide clear, concise reporting on delivery progress, risks, dependencies, and key decisions to senior program leadership and client stakeholders.
  • Contribute to a disciplined, collaborative delivery environment focused on successful MVP rollout and sustainable V2 development.

    • Requirements:

    • 5+ years of experience managing technical workstreams or projects within larger, multi-team technology programs.
    • Professional experience in financial services, with exposure to payments, credit, debit, ACH, or related financial transaction systems.
    • Background in software engineering, technical project delivery, systems analysis, or another discipline providing strong technical fluency.
    • Experience working with products or systems where an MVP is already in flight and the focus is shifting toward production rollout, scaling, and next-phase definition.
    • Demonstrated ability to understand technical details, investigate issues, and work effectively with engineering and technical leadership.
    • Experience scaling teams, including planning for additional resources and onboarding new engineers.
    • Familiarity with AWS and modern cloud-based technology environments.
    • Strong stakeholder management skills and the ability to communicate technical concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.
    • Excellent organization and prioritization skills, with the ability to manage dependencies, competing priorities, and changing requirements.
    • Clear, precise, and confident communication skills, with the ability to coordinate effectively across business, engineering, program, and client teams.
    • Bachelor’s degree required; candidates without a degree may qualify with additional specialized training and/or progressively responsible technology experience equivalent to the missing years of college.

      • Supportive environment with opportunities to develop both technical and leadership capabilities.

title: Southern Minnesota Congregational Organizing Fellow
description:
Southern Minnesota Congregational Organizing Fellow

ISAIAH

Exempt (from overtime), full-time, 6-month temporary position

Pay is based on a $55,000 annual salary

POSITION AT A GLANCE

  • The Southern Minnesota Organizing Fellow relates to and organizes a wide range of people to develop leadership and shared power across race, class, and wards.
  • The Congregational Base works in pursuit of a just economy and a democracy that honors the dignity and worth of people across race, faith, and class.
  • Our ideal candidates can explain why they are interested in the needs of people and communities and have demonstrated “grit” when faced with challenging work or a lack of initial success.
  • This position reports to a lead organizer and regularly works with a team of other organizers. The ideal starting date for this position is early fall.
  • This position involves meeting with people when they are available. Organizing fellows will often have meetings and events on evenings and weekends.


WHY THIS POSITION IS IMPORTANT:

Organizing Fellows will work with ISAIAH staff organizers to build and lead an organizing program to develop the capacity and leadership of everyday Minnesotans and develop a series of racial, economic, and climate justice campaigns with community and ISAIAH leaders.

The Southern Minnesota Organizing Fellow will lead people in faith communities and other communities in Southern Minnesota to develop leadership and build power to create an economy and a democracy that honors the dignity of all people.

The Southern Minnesota Organizing Fellow will:

  • Engage staff and leaders to build powerful relationships based on trust and a well-defined understanding of each other’s desires and interests.
  • Work with staff and leaders to implement an organizing program that engages leaders from 15-20 churches.
  • Lead public actions and meetings with elected leaders to build a politics rooted in dignity and affordability for everyone.
  • Recruit and train volunteer leaders to do in-person and virtual meetings with friends, family, and members of their community.

To accomplish these objectives, The Southern Minnesota Congregational Base Organizing Fellow will organize and expand the network of churches and church teams through canvassing, one on ones, community meetings, house meetings, congregational forums, and other leadership development tactics.

Over 6 months, organizing fellows receive paid holidays, sick time, a floating paid holiday, and a cell phone reimbursement. A driver’s license and car is required for this position. Organizing fellows will often have meetings and events on evenings and weekends.

About ISAIAH and Faith in Minnesota

ISAIAH, a 501(c)3 nonprofit, is a vehicle for multi-racial, multi-faith coalitions across Minnesota to act collectively and powerfully towards racial and economic equity in MN by addressing both local and regional community issues. Faith in Minnesota is our 501(c)4 organization that gives us a platform to organize and advocate directly in our state’s elections and political process.

Together, we have more than 250 member and partner churches and mosques, more than 25 barbershops, and more than 200 childcare centers who work to promote a caring economy and a multi-racial democracy that honors every person’s dignity. We do this work through intentional, intensive leadership development, collective action, and deep partnerships with grassroots organizations and public servants.

HOW WILL YOU KNOW IF YOU’RE A GOOD CANDIDATE?

You can be great for this role if you are someone who is:

  • Able to act with integrity, has a strong work ethic, “grit”, and willingness to persevere until you succeed.
  • A self-starter who can independently set goals and use them to guide daily actions.
  • A good listener and capable of establishing rapport with people from different backgrounds.
  • A quick learner eager to develop their leadership and help others do the same.
  • Open to evaluation and direction from their supervisor and peers.
  • Unafraid of being pushed and challenged by their peers and supervisor in order to more deeply reflect on and address personal barriers to leadership development.
  • Can navigate different cultural settings to relate to people across race, class, age, and religion.


HOW WE KNOW IF YOU’RE A GOOD CANDIDATE?

We are looking for candidates who:

  • Can articulate how working for social justice and grassroots organizing is connected to their personal motivation or self-interest rather than a desire to “serve” or “save” others.
  • Have demonstrated independent decision-making, management of multiple priorities in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment, and sound judgment on when to seek advice and support from team members.
  • Can share examples of achieving success when straightforward solutions aren’t available through problem-solving and applying flexible thinking.
  • Can speak to their ability to effectively work with diverse faith communities, racial groups, and diverse stakeholders.
  • Have a self-interest in the needs of people and communities.
  • Is comfortable using a range of technology, such as Google Workspace or Microsoft Office, WhatsApp, and other common software and apps.
  • Have a valid driver’s license and regular access to a reliable car.


HOW TO APPLY

  • Please submit your resume and cover letter to our online application.
    • You may combine your resume and cover letter into one PDF to be uploaded, or email a cover letter to office@isaiahmn.org after applying.
  • This position will remain open until filled. Applications are reviewed as they’re received. Our ideal hire date is early fall, 2026.


Our Statement Regarding Being an Equal Opportunity Employer

ISAIAH believes that a team with diverse experiences and backgrounds, working in an inclusive and safe work environment, generates richer discussions and more nuanced thinking. We are an equal-opportunity employer and actively encourage people whose identities and backgrounds reflect the rich diversity of our community and who are traditionally underrepresented in nonprofits to apply to our positions.

title: Senior Account Director, Client Partner
description:
(HYBRID/REMOTE/ATLANTA)

About Alloy

Meaningful connections. Measurable results. Alloy delivers precision storytelling and experiences for imaginative brands.

Our global team has deep industry expertise that cover all facets of the customer journey, from engaging creative experiences built with innovative technology to full communication strategies backed by measurable performance marketing. Our cross-channel solutions help global innovative brands engage with their buyers, shape public opinion, build lasting influence, create new categories and accelerate growth and market share.

Our client work has earned widespread industry recognition, including Technology Agency of the Year and more. Behind it all is a crew of nerds, rebels and creatives. Alloy has been called a Best Place to Work (10 times to be exact), but we call ourselves The Uncommon Crew.

As our story continues to unfold, one thing remains the same — different is in our DNA.

About the Role

As a Senior Account Director, you will manage and grow client relationships while leading multi-faceted marketing and digital strategies, coordinating collaboration and solutions between our public relations, media, martech, technology and experience design departments. You’ll go beyond delivering meaningful work on time and on budget to strategize with clients on macro business challenges, asking the right questions to develop recommendations and integrated solutions that meet their needs. You’ll identify and drive growth opportunities, fostering innovative thinking that delivers on our clients’ business goals. Our Sr. Account Directors have significant agency experience and a strong understanding of marketing strategies, lead by example, are highly collaborative, and are self-starters.

The Details of the Senior Account Director Role

  • Responsible for account health, retention and growth, overall engagement delivery and commercial outcomes; acts as voice of the client for internal teams
  • Proactively build client relationships at the right levels across the organization; identify and address potential blockers
  • Consult on client business challenges with a deep understanding of marketing, industry trends and economic factors;
  • Develop clear and thoughtful account and business-building strategies that address client challenges and opportunities, meet client objectives and create growth opportunities for both clients and the agency
  • Manage the delivery lifecycle: resourcing, timelines, milestones, dependencies, and handoffs; ensure we’re delivering exceptional work and results that are aligned with client business goals; drive cross-capability coordination among agency departments and synthesize disparate discipline inputs into coherent POVs for clients when needed
  • Lead account and campaign planning, client strategy meetings and quarterly business reviews (QBRs) in collaboration with appropriate agency departments, identifying gaps, opportunities and solutions in order to continuously drive accounts forward.
  • Manage account budgeting, revenue tracking and profitability initiatives to ensure team and agency success.
  • Lead account organic growth plans. Build thoughtful proposals for clients and pitch them; define SOWs, timelines and budgets for a variety of programs.
  • Support company marketing and the creation and presentation of new business proposals as needed.

Skillset Needed:

  • Ability to autonomously lead accounts / account teams, build strong rapport with clients, and deliver high quality work with minimal oversight.
  • Strong experience crafting and executing national and global marketing and digital campaigns with excellent results; leading team and client planning sessions; and communicating with executive stakeholders.
  • Display powerful presentation skills that invite participation and effect desired outcomes.
  • Can lead cross-capability teams to deliver creative thinking and powerful ideas that meet client objectives. Uses analysis to drive decisions (as opposed to taking orders) in a way that yields sustained, measurable results.
  • Deeply understands clients’ businesses at both strategic and tactical levels and delivers counsel rooted in business context, trends and data.
  • Excellent client retention and growth rates in your previous roles.
  • Consistently applies new approaches, tools, technology or methodologies to solve problems or deliver better results; proactively leverages AI-powered tools such as Claude, Gemini and/or ChatGPT to drive efficiencies and strong work output

The Benefits

  • Competitive salary
  • Performance-based bonuses
  • A flexible, hybrid/remote work model
  • Responsibly Unlimited PTO + 10 additional agency-wide holidays Summer Fridays
  • 401(k) match
  • 6-year workiversary paid sabbatical
  • Medical and dental benefits (including HSA/FSA)
  • Generous paid parental leave
  • Professional development stipend annually
  • Cell phone reimbursement
  • Peloton Membership

Our Commitment

Inclusivity and respect are two virtues that this company was built on from day one. Alloy does not discriminate based on race, religion, national origin, age, sex, gender, disability, sexual orientation, or any other protected category. We want the best people, and it doesn’t matter what you look like or who your friends are. We also believe that the workplace should be comfortable and safe. If you need reasonable accommodation at any point in the application or interview process, please let us know.
