title: Safety Operations Lead
description:
Who we are

Atoms is building the machines that power the next era of progress.

Over the last decade, software has transformed the digital world. But the physical world, where food is made, minerals are mined, goods are moved, and industries are run, remains far less intelligent, far less efficient, and far more constrained. We’re changing that.

Atoms builds Physical AI— real-world robots for the industries that move civilization forward, starting with food, mining, and transport. Our systems are designed to understand, predict, and control the real world with precision, turning complex physical operations into something more reliable, more scalable, and more productive.

This work requires more than robotics. It requires deep integration across hardware, software, AI, operations, manufacturing, and real estate. We don’t just build machines in a lab. We deploy them into real environments, operate them, learn from them, and improve them until they work at scale.

We are roboticists, engineers, operators, and builders. We believe the next great technology companies will not only transform information, but the physical systems that shape everyday life.

If you want to work on hard problems with real-world impact, join us.

About the role

Our safety practice is not a document exercise — it is an operating discipline that has to run at the speed of the fleet. This role owns that discipline. You will stand up and run the operational safety machinery: how we manage incidents, how we train and qualify the people in and around our vehicles, how field events get triaged and routed, and how investigations turn into engineering change. Today these functions exist on a smaller scale. Your job is to make them a coherent system that scales as we add vehicles, routes, and customers.

This is a hands-on role. You will write the next version of most of these processes yourself, run the first dozen investigations yourself, and only then hire against the parts that need scale.

What you’ll do

  • Incident management. Own the end-to-end response process: detection, notification, severity classification, on-scene coordination, containment decisions, root cause investigation, corrective action, and closure. Recommend who should have the authority to hold operations and under what conditions, and make sure that authority is real.
  • Event triage. Build the pipeline that turns raw field telemetry, disengagements, operator reports, and near-miss data into a ranked, actionable queue. Set the taxonomy and severity model. Own the triage rate, the backlog, and the time-to-disposition — and make those numbers visible to engineering and leadership.
  • Investigations. Lead investigations of collisions, disengagements, and anomalous behavior. Drive them to a defensible causal account, not a narrative. Track corrective actions through to verified closure.
  • Training and qualification. Design the training and recurrent-qualification program for safety drivers, autonomous vehicle operators, and remote support staff. Own the curriculum, the practical evaluation, and the qualification records.
  • Safety data and reporting. Own the operational safety metrics set and the reporting cadence, and make sure our internal records can withstand outside scrutiny.
  • Feedback into engineering. Be the channel that carries field reality into the product. Partner with the Head of Safety so that operational evidence feeds hazard analysis and change assessment rather than sitting in a separate system.

What success looks like

First 45 days: Incident response process documented, socialized, and exercised at least once in a tabletop. Event taxonomy and severity model in place with the current event backlog classified against it. A clear-eyed written assessment of where our operational safety practice is weakest.

First 3 months: Triage running on a predictable cadence with published metrics. Investigation process producing written reports with tracked corrective actions. Training program rebuilt with documented qualification records for every person on duty. You have identified the AI-native tooling that will scale this work.

First 12 months: The system runs without you personally in every loop. That tooling is implemented and in daily use. You know what the next hire needs to be and why.

Working AI-native

We expect this function to run leaner than it traditionally has run, and we expect AI tooling to be the reason. We are looking for someone who uses LLM-based tooling as part of the actual work — querying and summarizing large volumes of event data, drafting and maintaining investigation reports and training material, doing first-pass classification of an event backlog, pattern-finding across incidents that a human reading one at a time would miss — and who builds their own small tools rather than waiting on a roadmap. The boundary matters as much as the leverage: AI output is a hypothesis and a drafting accelerant, never the basis for a safety determination or a regulatory submission. Every conclusion still needs a human who has looked at the evidence and will stand behind it.

What we’re looking for

  • 8+ years in safety operations, fleet safety, transportation safety, or operational risk in a safety-critical domain — commercial trucking, autonomous vehicles, rail, aviation, or industrial operations. Direct AV or commercial fleet experience is a strong plus but not a hard requirement.
  • Demonstrated experience leading real incident investigations to root cause and driving corrective actions to closure. We will ask you to walk through specific investigations in detail.
  • Fluency with structured investigation and risk methods — root cause analysis, causal factor charting, human factors analysis, hazard identification — and the judgment to know which one a given event actually warrants.
  • Experience designing training for operational staff, including practical evaluation and qualification decisions.
  • Data-driven by default. You are comfortable working directly with event data: querying it, building your own views, and forming a defensible position from it. SQL and basic scripting are expected; you should not need an analyst to tell you what the fleet is doing.
  • Working knowledge of the US vehicle regulatory environment, — AV-specific reporting such as the NHTSA Standing General Order, FMCSA regulations, hours of service. Familiarity with SAE J3016 levels and ODD concepts.
  • The disposition this work requires: calm under a live incident, rigorous when it would be easier to be reassuring, and willing to be the person who says stop.
  • Willingness to be on-site and on-call. Incidents do not respect business hours.

Nice to have

  • Experience at an AV developer or an operator running AV pilots on public roads.
  • Experience building a safety function from a near-blank slate rather than inheriting a mature one.
  • Exposure to safety management systems, safety case development, or aviation-style safety assurance practice.
  • Experience preparing safety material for regulators or insurers.

Why join us

At Atoms, you’ll work on one of the defining challenges of our time—bringing automation into the physical world to drive real, lasting impact. We exist to uncover valuable unknown truths and turn them into progress, which means constantly pushing beyond what’s known and building what doesn’t yet exist. The work is ambitious and often challenging, but it’s grounded in a shared sense of purpose and a team committed to seeing it through together. Our work only matters if it serves others, and we know that meaningful progress depends on the trust of the people we serve and the strength of our team—so we invest in both, creating an environment where you can do your best work and grow.

What else you need to know

This role is based in our San Francisco office. Atoms is a company driven by invention and continuous change - we are constantly reimagining our industries, building new products, and refining how we operate. We do our best work together. That’s why all of our office-based teams work onsite, five days a week.

The base salary range for this role is $182,000 - $230,000 per year.

Actual compensation will be determined on an individual basis and may vary depending on experience, skills, and qualifications.

Base salary is just one part of your total rewards package. You may also be eligible for equity awards.

Benefits Summary (USA Full-Time Exempt Employees):

  • Flexible Spending Account / Health Savings Account Options
  • 401(k)
  • Equity
  • Sick Time, Unlimited Flexible Time Off, and Paid Holidays
  • Paid Parental Leave
  • Pre-Tax Commuter Benefit Plan
  • Team lunch in our SoMa office every Tuesday and Thursday

Benefits are subject to change at the company's discretion.
Atoms accepts applications on an ongoing basis.

Ready to join us as we serve those who serve others?

title: Clinical Director
description:
Come Join Overstory Health as a Clinical Director in Boston, MA

Overstory Health is a newly launched startup building world-class, patient-centric Partial Hospitalization (PHP) and Intensive Outpatient (IOP) programs for individuals with high-acuity mental health needs. Our mission is to make compassionate, connected behavioral healthcare more accessible when people need it most. The Clinical Director is the onsite leader for Overstory Health’s site, responsible for operational excellence, positive team dynamics, and patient satisfaction. You will lead the center’s first location, laying the groundwork for future expansion across Massachusetts. This includes fostering an inclusive culture, achieving growth targets, maintaining community relationships, ensuring quality care delivery, regulatory compliance, and healthy financial performance. title: Miljøstyrelsen søger dygtig(e) medarbejder(e) til kontoret for Godkendelser og Tilladelser (industrimiljø) i Slagelse eller Aarhus.
description:
Vil du være med til at sikre en effektiv og tidssvarende miljøregulering af nogle af landets største og meste komplekse virksomheder? Vi søger en ny kollega til Miljøstyrelsens kontor for Godkendelser og Tilladelser, hvor vi behandler virksomhedernes ansøgninger om miljøgodkendelse med fokus på korrekte og rettidige afgørelser. Arbejdet har stort politisk bevågenhed og er helt afgørende for både beskyttelsen af det danske miljø og virksomhederne vækstvilkår. Du vil komme til at indgå i et stærkt fagligt miljø, hvor vi løfter i flok.

Om Miljø og Produktion i Miljøstyrelsen
I området Miljø og Produktion er vi miljømyndighed for ca. 400 af de største og miljømæssigt mest komplekse virksomheder i Danmark. Arbejdet sker primært inden for miljøbeskyttelsesloven med tilknyttet lovgivning. Vi er samtidig ansvarlige for de EU-regler og danske bekendtgørelser, der regulerer virksomhedernes miljøgodkendelser og miljøtilsynet. Vores erfaring fra sagsbehandlingen inddrages til udvikling af nye regler i samarbejde med Miljøstyrelsens øvrige kontorer, og vi bidrager til betjening af det politiske niveau i samarbejde med Miljøministeriets departement.

Om stillingen
I kontoret Godkendelser og Tilladelser er vi ansvarlig for at behandle ansøgninger om miljøgodkendelser, træffe afgørelse om risikogodkendelser og tilladelser til udledning af spildevand samt gennemføre miljø- og habitatvurderinger. Vi fører endvidere tilsyn med offshore-aktiviteter og oliepipelines. Der er tilknyttet jurist- og sekretærfunktioner til kontoret. Vi er ca. 38 medarbejdere, to teamledere og én kontorchef.

Som godkendelsesmyndighed lægger vi stor vægt på, at virksomhederne oplever os som en effektiv og professionel samarbejdspartner. Vi skal balancere hensynet til både miljø og vækst, og har fokus på korrekt og rettidig sagsbehandling. Virksomhedernes miljøgodkendelser er et område med stort politisk bevågenhed og komplekse udfordringer. Du vil komme til at spille en rolle på et vigtigt område, som er i rivende udvikling og har stor samfundsmæssig betydning.

Kontorets arbejdsform er i høj grad præget af, at vi er effektive og sammen skaber resultater af høj faglig kvalitet. Du kan forvente engagerede kolleger, der løfter i flok, har tillid til hinanden og gode samarbejdsrelationer også på tværs i organisationen. Vi arbejder både lokalt og på tværs med dygtige kolleger i resten af landet som oftest ved brug af videomøder.

Vores brede opgaveportefølje betyder, at dine opgaver og brancheområder i høj grad vil afhænge af din faglige profil og erfaring.

Vi kunne godt tænke os, at du:

  • Har en relevant uddannelse som f.eks. ingeniør, biolog, geolog, kemiker eller lignende.
  • Har erfaring med forvaltning og/eller regulering af virksomheders miljøforhold. Eksempelvis som miljøsagsbehandler i en kommune, fra rådgivende ingeniør/konsulentfirma eller fra en produktionsvirksomhed.
  • Har fagligt kendskab til miljøgodkendelsesområdet og nogle af de brancher, vi regulerer. Herunder særligt deponier, affaldsforbrændingsanlæg, kraftværker, kemisk industri, biogasanlæg og CCS.
  • Har lyst til sagsbehandling af ansøgninger fra virksomheder og til at sætte dit præg på myndighedsarbejdet i tæt samarbejde med dine kolleger.
  • Er løsningsorienteret, god til at følge op på og afslutte opgaver.
  • Er god til at samarbejde samt både at give og modtage sparring.
Vi forventer at du:

  • Har en analytisk og struktureret tilgang til dit arbejde og er effektiv i din sagsløsning.
  • Er nysgerrig på sagsbehandling, offentlig forvaltning og juridiske problemstillinger og har lyst til at sætte dit præg på myndighedsarbejdet.
  • Er løsningsorienteret og god til at se flere muligheder, når sagerne skal løses.
  • Er god til at samarbejde både på tværs af kontorer, fagligheder og med virksomhederne.
  • Trives i en travl og omskiftelig hverdag.
  • Bidrager til og tager ansvar for, at vi har et godt samarbejde og en god trivsel i kontoret.
Vores områdes organisering
Vi er ca. 150 medarbejdere i hele området Miljø og Produktion, der har kontorer i Slagelse, Odense og Aarhus. Vi er organiseret i fem kontorer og er afhængige af et tæt samarbejde på tværs.

Hos os får du:

  • En fleksibel arbejdsplads, der værdsætter ”det hele menneske”.
  • Et inspirerende og fagligt stærkt kollegialt miljø, hvor vi hjælper og støtter hinanden.
  • Udfordrende og afvekslende arbejdsopgaver til gavn for miljøet.
  • Et stærkt fagligt miljø der løbende udvikles.
  • Gode muligheder for kompetenceudvikling/efteruddannelse.
Vi prioriterer det sociale og fællesskabet højt i enheden, som fx sociale arrangementer fordelt over året og mulighed for deltagelse i fælles træningsaktiviteter.

Løn og ansættelsesvilkår
Løn- og ansættelsesvilkår er i henhold til den til enhver tid gældende overenskomst mellem Finansministeriet og en række Akademiker-organisationer for akademikere i staten (Akademiker-overenskomsten).

Der kan blive tale om både varige og midlertidige ansættelser. Stillingen ønskes besat snarest muligt og senest 1. november 2026. Du bedes angive hvilken lokation, du søger ansættelse på.

Yderligere oplysninger
Hvis du vil vide mere om stillingerne, er du velkommen til at kontakte følgende:
Kontorchef for Miljøgodkendelser og Tilladelser Morten Rickers Østergaard på tlf. 41 96 94 09.
Teamledere Jane Fløe på tlf. 21 78 61 83 og Katrine Fagerli Jensen på tlf. 21 64 15 93.

title: Tech Lead! 50% Lead Developer. 50% Software Architect. 100% technical leadership.
description:
Are you the engineer people turn to when the code is difficult, the architecture matters and the team needs a technical direction?

Cubris is strengthening its engineering organisation around GreenSpeed® as part of our ambition to build a high-performing technology competence centre for intelligent railway solutions within Hitachi Rail.

We are looking for a Tech Lead who combines deep hands-on software engineering with architectural judgement.

This is deliberately not a traditional management role.

You will spend approximately 50% of your time as a Lead Developer and 50% as a Software Architect – building production software, solving difficult engineering problems and coaching developers while also representing your team in the Architecture Group and translating architectural direction into practical solutions.

Your role as Lead Developer

You will:

  • Write and ship production code

  • Take ownership of technically complex stories

  • Unblock other engineers when problems become difficult

  • Coach developers through pairing, design discussions and high-quality PR reviews

  • Raise standards for automated testing and CI/CD

  • Improve pipeline reliability and engineering effectiveness

  • Strengthen observability through logs, metrics and traces

  • Drive systematic reduction of technical debt

  • Establish useful patterns, runbooks and reference implementations

In other words: you are expected to remain technically credible because you are still doing the work.

Your role as Software Architect

At the same time, you will:

  • Represent your team in Cubris’ Architecture Group

  • Translate architectural decisions and ADRs into practical team standards

  • Define service boundaries, APIs, events and data contracts

  • Establish and verify non-functional requirements around security, reliability, performance and cost

  • Lead technical migrations and integrations

  • Manage architectural dependencies and compatibility

  • Maintain architectural documentation, roadmaps and decision records

You become the technical bridge between Product, Engineering and Architecture.

What you bring

We expect you to have:

  • 7+ years of software engineering experience

  • Experience leading technical initiatives or engineering teams

  • Strong C#/.NET expertise

  • Experience designing distributed systems and/or microservices

  • Good SQL/NoSQL fundamentals

  • Experience with APIs, domain modelling and event-driven architectures

  • Strong understanding of CI/CD and modern software delivery

The current environment includes C#/.NET, .NET Core, Entity Framework, MS SQL Server, Azure DevOps, Git, CI/CD and Visual Studio, with Azure, Kubernetes and Infrastructure-as-Code increasingly relevant.

Why Cubris?

title: Retail Event Associate - NHL All Star Game
description:
Fanatics Commerce is the global leader in licensed sports merchandise, operating a vertically integrated platform that designs, manufactures, and delivers officially licensed apparel, jerseys, headwear, and collectibles for major leagues, teams, and events worldwide. With more than 900 e-commerce sites and a global omnichannel presence across digital, in-venue, and retail, Fanatics Commerce reaches fans in over 180 countries and powers official fan experiences for many of the world's most iconic sports properties.

At Fanatics, we bring our BOLD Leadership Principles to life every day - building championship teams, obsessing over fans, acting with entrepreneurial speed, and delivering with a determined and relentless mindset.

ROLE OVERVIEW
The Retail Event Operations Associate is responsible for carrying out front-line event setup, executing logistics for the retail infrastructure at live events, and ensuring operational excellence throughout every stage of the fan experience. This role supports the full lifecycle of event retail — from merchandise setup and stocking to sales transactions and breakdown — while maintaining the highest standards of professionalism and customer service to ensure the Fanatics brand is always positively represented. The Retail Event Operations Associate delivers business and fan impact through BOLD leadership and execution excellence, leveraging data, automation, and AI-enabled insights.

HOW WILL YOU DRIVE IMPACT
Success is measured by the ability to deliver results through BOLD capabilities and measurable outcomes.

Team & Leadership Impact (Build Championship Teams)

• Collaborate with the onsite Retail Event Management Team to ensure all directives are executed efficiently and the retail environment meets Fanatics' standards throughout each event.
• Support fellow team members during setup, breakdown, and sales operations, fostering a fun, professional, and high-performing environment for both staff and fans.
• Build and maintain effective working relationships with team members, demonstrating a willingness to set and uphold high standards of performance throughout every assignment.

Fan & Customer Impact (Obsessed with Fans)

• Deliver an exceptional, fan-first experience by maintaining the highest standards of professionalism and customer service at every touchpoint.
• Engage warmly and effectively with fans and guests, creating an exciting and welcoming retail environment that reflects the Fanatics brand.
• Handle sales transactions accurately using the Fanatics Point of Sale (POS) system, applying basic math skills to count change and balance the bank with precision.
• Respond to guest and partner needs with a willingness and drive to exceed expectations at every interaction.

Innovation & Problem Solving (Limitless Entrepreneurial Spirit)

• Adapt quickly to a fast-paced, continuously changing event environment, independently identifying and resolving operational challenges as they arise.
• Contribute ideas and observations to the Retail Event Management Team that improve the organization, cleanliness, and overall effectiveness of the retail setup.
• Bring curiosity and a self-motivated approach to learning Fanatics' systems, processes, and tools in order to operate with greater efficiency at each event.

Ownership & Execution (Determined & Relentless Mindset)

• Assist with the loading and unloading of merchandise trucks, stocking of merchandise, and organization of supplies and equipment with a consistent eye for detail.
• Maintain the sales floor and stockroom to Fanatics' standards, ensuring the retail environment is neat, organized, clean, and fully stocked for all events.
• Demonstrate regular and consistent attendance and punctuality for the full duration of each event or assignment, with or without reasonable accommodation.
• Perform additional responsibilities as assigned by the Retail Event Management Team, approaching every task with a determined and relentless mindset.

CAPABILITIES & EXPERIENCE YOU BRING
Preferred Qualifications:

• Must be a minimum of 18 years of age.
• Experience working in a venue, retail, or merchandise environment, with the ability to thrive in a high-energy, event-based setting.
• Strong customer service skills with a friendly, self-motivated demeanor and a genuine enthusiasm for meeting new people in an exciting environment.
• Ability to work independently and responsibly, as well as collaboratively as part of a team, in a fast-paced and continuously changing environment.
• Basic math proficiency, including the ability to accurately count change and balance a cash bank.
• Strong communication skills with the ability to interact effectively with supervisors, team members, and guests throughout all stages of an event.
• Physical ability to assist with loading and unloading merchandise trucks, stocking merchandise, and performing setup and breakdown tasks as required.

WORK LOCATION
On-site: Your work location will be onsite.

The salary range represents base pay only and does not include short-term or long-term incentive compensation. When determining base pay as part of a final compensation package, we consider several factors such as location, experience, qualifications, and training. For information about our benefits, please visit

Salary Range
$23—$23 USD

At Fanatics, we operate with a BOLD mindset - We Build Championship Teams, we’re Obsessed with Fans, we embrace a Limitless Entrepreneurial Spirit, and we approach every challenge with a Determined and Relentless Mindset. If you’re ready to contribute to a dynamic, fast-paced environment that thrives on collaboration and growth, we want you to be part of our team.

ABOUT US
Fanatics is building a leading global digital sports platform. We ignite the passions of global sports fans and maximize the presence and reach for our hundreds of sports partners globally by offering products and services across Fanatics Commerce, Fanatics Collectibles, and Fanatics Betting & Gaming, allowing sports fans to Buy, Collect, and Bet. title: M3 Functional Analyst - EMEA
description:
Who We Are:

At Brooks, we believe movement is the key to feeling more alive. That’s why we’re driven to create gear and experiences that take people to the place that makes them feel more alive — whether it’s a headspace, a feeling or a finish line.

Everyone who works at Brooks is propelled by a company culture that sparks excitement, fuels collaboration, inspires creativity, and ignites innovation.

Our brand values help bond us together and drive our success:

• Runner First - We act in the best interest of the runner

• Word is Bond - We do what we say we’ll do

• Champion Heart - We give our all in everything we do

• There is no “I” in Run - We stay generous with our humanity

• Keep Moving - We find ways to move every day, because joy is kinetic!

We welcome everyone from every walk of life looking to inspire others through the power of movement — because we’re all moving towards something. Let’s run there.

Your Job:

As an M3 Functional Analyst you will be the primary person responsible for the Infor M3 ERP in the EMEA region. The ERP is the core system supporting our operations so you will participate in many projects that will help us grow our wholesale and eCommerce businesses, evolve our supply chain, and improve efficiency. You will frequently partner with Sales, Customer Service, Logistics and Finance to deliver new capabilities. You will collaborate with the global technology team to support the ERP system worldwide and support in global improvement projects such as system upgrades. Paramount responsibility is ensuring that customer facing transactions are processed effectively. You will also assist with EDI onboarding and processing to ensure all transactions are processed timely.

Your Responsibilities:

• Participate the design of integrated business processes along with the guidance of Global leads to provide new capabilities and streamline operations for Sales, Finance, Customer Service, Logistics, retailers, and consumers.

• Collect business requirements and maintain business process flows as they are implemented in M3 and related systems ensuring clarity and alignment with stakeholder expectations.

• Create functional specifications and collaborate with technology team members on implementation. Participate in testing new or updated functions alongside business users

• Participate in regular Super User meetings to discuss system enhancements and necessary business process adjustments.

• Monitor system performance using available tools to help identify issues related to stability and scalability. Escalate concerns and contribute to evaluating potential tools or improvements.

• Support system upgrades, fixes and enhancements while ensuring Brooks change control processes are followed for approvals, planning, testing, documentation, and implementation

• Assist in investigating initial root cause analysis on production application failures and support necessary remediation of defects.

• Create and maintain documentation including system context diagrams, system and data interfaces, and process flows.

• Support automation efforts by developing and maintaining scripts to increase efficiency

• Partner and foster collaboration with the wider Global IT team based in Seattle.

Qualifications:

• Bachelor’s degree in Information Systems, Computer Science, Engineering or relevant major.

• 3+ years of experience implementing, administering, managing and/or supporting enterprise IT applications, preferably in the consumer goods industry.

• 3+ years of experience working with Infor M3 as a Systems or Functional Analyst.

• Functional knowledge of supply chain business processes within the Infor M3 ERP system.

• Business requirements gathering skills are essential including the ability to support the design and configure business processes.

• Ability to query databases such as DB2 and SQL server.

• Preferred knowledge of M3 technologies such as business engine database, Grid, Infor ION, MEC and Stream serve.

• Experience with development methodologies such as Agile, Scrum, Waterfall, etc.

• Strong troubleshooting skills; tenacity and hunger for finding the root cause of a problem.

• Keen attention to detail in planning, organizing, and executing tasks, while still seeing the big picture and understanding how the pieces fit together.

• Ability to learn new applications and technologies.

• Strong communication and presentation skills, ability to partner with key business stakeholders on different levels along with ability to tailor approach based on audience and message.

• Excellent interpersonal and collaboration skills that encourage and build trust for effective working relationships across the company.

• Knowledge of ITIL service management framework and best practices for systems administration.

• Diligent and reliable; available to provide after-hours support as needed.

title: Junior Professional Officer (JPO) til Office of Legal Affairs i New York, USA
description:
Udenrigsministeriet søger i samarbejde med FN en Junior Professional Officer (JPO)

I juridiske anliggender

Brænder du for at med juridiske anliggender og i en international organisation? Udenrigsministeriet tilbyder i samarbejde med FN en spændende stilling som Junior Professional Officer (JPO) ved kontoret for juridiske anliggender i New York, USA.

Du vil bidrage til at yde rådgivning om en bred vifte af komplekse og væsentlige spørgsmål vedrørende international ret, herunder fortolkning og anvendelse af konstituerende, lovgivningsmæssige og andre instrumenter, der regulerer FNs aktiviteter og operationer. Du vil bidrage til at udføre omfattende juridisk forskning og analyse og udarbejde studier, briefinger, rapporter og korrespondance samt foretage omfattende gennemgang af juridiske dokumenter, instrumenter eller andet materiale.

Dine opgaver vil blandt andet inkludere:

  • Udarbejde eller bistå med udarbejdelsen af juridiske udtalelser, rådgivning og noter eller baggrundspapirer, studier, rapporter, lovgivningsmæssige tekster og kommentarer til disse tekster om en bred vifte af folkeretlige spørgsmål, der blandt andet omfatter spørgsmål vedrørende privilegier og immuniteter, fred og sikkerhed, internationale straffedomstole, den overordnede juridiske og administrative ramme for fredsbevarende operationer og særlige politiske missioner, institutionelle spørgsmål, traktat ret og praksis samt proceduremæssige spørgsmål, der opstår under møder med FN-organer.
  • Udarbejde udkast til værtslandsaftaler, konferenceaftaler og andre aftaler samt andre juridiske tekster og instrumenter, der kræves for udførelsen af aktiviteter, der udføres af FN, herunder dets kontorer, programmer og fonde.
  • Bistå juridiske medarbejdere med at betjene diplomatiske konferencer, kommissioner, udvalg, taskforcer, ekspertgrupper og andre organer, herunder udarbejdelse af baggrundsmateriale, resuméer af problemstillinger og delegationers synspunkter osv.
  • Forberede eller bistå med forberedelsen af seminarer og symposier, holde foredrag om forskellige juridiske spørgsmål ved sådanne arrangementer.
  • Udføre forskning i og bistå juridiske medarbejdere med at formulere rådgivning om en række specifikke juridiske spørgsmål relateret til strafferetlige ansvarlighedsmekanismer og organisationens rolle i forbindelse med oprettelsen og driften af FN eller FN-biståede tribunaler og relaterede resterende mekanismer – og mange andre spændende opgaver.
Kvalifikationer:

  • Kandidatuddannelse (master) inden for jura, herunder en baggrund, uddannelse eller specialisering i international ret eller et beslægtet område er påkrævet. En bacheloruddannelse kombineret med yderligere 2 års kvalificerende erfaring kan accepteres i stedet for kandidatuddannelse.
  • Minimum 2 års relevant erhvervserfaring og herunder inkl. juridisk analyse, research og skrivning. Endvidere Gode IT og særligt tekstbehandlingsfærdigheder og også kendskab til regneark, Excel eller PowerPoint vil ses som en fordel.
  • Flydende engelsk i skrift og tale. Kendskab til fransk vil være en fordel, idet både engelsk og fransk er arbejdssprogene i FN-sekretariatet. Kendskab til et andet officielt FN-sprog vil ses som en styrke. Stillingen giver dig mulighed for at arbejde i et internationalt miljø med stor faglighed og globalt fokus.
Du kan læse mere om stillingen her.

Din ansættelse finansieres af Udenrigsministeriet, men FN er din arbejdsgiver, og du vil derfor ikke være udsendt af Danmark (statsudsendt) under din ansættelse. Du ansættes og udsendes på FN’s ansættelsesvilkår og aflønnes under ansættelsen i henhold til FN’s lønsystem. Ansættelsesperioden er 1 år med mulighed for forlængelse. En JPO-stilling ved FN bidrager med værdifuld indsigt og erfaring i FN-systemet.

Programmet angiver, at stillinger under programmet er tiltænkt statsborgere fra det donorland (for denne stilling, Danmark), der finansierer stillingen.

Ansættelsessted
New York, USA

Forventet tiltrædelse
Snarest muligt

Ansøgning
Har stillingen vakt din interesse og mener du, at du opfylder de faglige kvalifikationer og har den nødvendige erfaring beskrevet i organisationens stillingsbeskrivelse, skal du søge elektronisk nederst i opslaget på ”søg stillingen”.

Vi skal have en målrettet ansøgning på ENGELSK bestående af følgende dokumenter:

  1. Motivationsskrivelse,
  2. FNs ansøgningsskema (klik på tekst for at finde ansøgningsskema).
  3. CV, inklusiv referencer.
  4. Eksamensbevis for bestået kandidatgrad eller bachelorgrad samt
  5. Underskrevet samtykkeerklæring (klik på tekst for at finde samtykkeerklæring).
BEMÆRK, at ansøgningen først er komplet, når alle ovenstående dokumenter er registeret i rekrutteringssystemet via linket "søg stillingen" nederst på siden.

Ansøgningsfrist
22 september 2026 kl. 23.59 dansk tid

Udvælgelse af kandidater til interview
Udvalgte kandidater vil blive kontaktet direkte via e-mail i løbet af september 2026. Øvrige ansøgere modtager samtidig besked om, at de ikke er kommet i betragtning til stillingen. FN forventes at gennemføre interviews i september/oktober 2026.

Kontakt
Evt. spørgsmål, som ikke fremgår af opslaget kan sendes til: Multijob@um.dk
Udenrigsministeriet ser mangfoldighed som en styrke og ønsker at beskæftige medarbejdere med forskellig baggrund. Vi opfordrer derfor alle kvalificerede, uanset personlig baggrund, til at søge stillingen.

Alle ledige stillinger i Udenrigsministeriet kan findes på www.um.dk.

title: Lead Software Engineer
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Lead Software Engineer based in Canada.

This is a hands-on technical leadership opportunity focused on strategically important digital banking products.
You will own the architecture and technical direction of online account opening and online loan application platforms.
The role combines software development, system design, engineering leadership, and close collaboration with product and client-facing teams.
You will build secure, scalable, compliant financial technology while integrating with core banking systems and specialized third-party services.
Your work will directly influence client implementations, production reliability, and digital acquisition experiences for financial institutions.
You will also mentor engineers, shape technical roadmaps, and establish engineering practices that support sustainable growth.
This role is ideal for an experienced fintech engineer who enjoys solving complex problems in a fast-moving startup environment.

Accountabilities

  • Own the technical architecture and direction for online account opening and online loan application products, ensuring systems are scalable, secure, compliant, and aligned with financial institution workflows.
  • Lead solution design and planning, making architectural and technology decisions that support product strategy, business priorities, and long-term system health.
  • Ensure applications meet financial industry requirements related to KYC/AML, identity verification, regulatory compliance, and data privacy.
  • Design and maintain integrations with core banking platforms and third-party providers supporting identity verification, fraud detection, e-signatures, and other financial workflows.
  • Provide hands-on technical leadership through coding, testing, debugging, code reviews, and architectural guidance using C#, .NET Core, Entity Framework, SQL Server, TypeScript, and Angular.
  • Break complex initiatives into milestones and deliverables while managing scope, dependencies, risks, technical debt, and delivery timelines.
  • Monitor engineering progress and proactively communicate blockers and risks to ensure reliable, high-quality client implementations and go-lives.
  • Lead and mentor engineers through regular coaching, feedback, performance development, and technical guidance while fostering a high-trust culture of ownership and continuous improvement.
  • Partner with Product to shape roadmaps, define feature scope, estimate technical effort, and balance customer needs with scalable engineering solutions.
  • Collaborate with Implementation, Client Success, and QA teams to understand client requirements, establish quality standards, support UAT readiness, and resolve implementation challenges.
  • Establish strong testing, CI/CD, monitoring, alerting, and observability practices to maintain production reliability and high-quality customer experiences.
  • Participate in on-call rotations, respond to production incidents, conduct root-cause analysis, and implement preventative improvements.
  • Hire and onboard engineering talent as the organization grows and contribute to the continued evolution of engineering processes and practices.

    • Requirements

    • 8+ years of professional software engineering experience, including at least 2 years in a technical leadership or Lead Engineer capacity.
    • Significant experience in digital account opening, loan origination, financial onboarding, banking technology, or a closely related domain; direct financial technology experience is required.
    • Strong proficiency in C#, .NET Core, Entity Framework, and SQL Server, with the ability to contribute directly to backend development.
    • Strong proficiency in Angular and TypeScript for frontend development.
    • Demonstrated experience integrating with core banking systems or third-party financial APIs, particularly solutions involving identity verification, KYC/AML, e-signatures, fraud detection, or related services.
    • Proven ability to architect scalable, secure, and compliant systems within a regulated financial environment.
    • Strong understanding of KYC/AML requirements, identity verification, data privacy, and other considerations relevant to financial applications.
    • Experience leading engineering teams through technical direction, mentorship, architectural decision-making, and delivery management without compromising engineering quality.
    • Experience with cloud infrastructure, containerization, microservices, CI/CD pipelines, automated testing, monitoring, and production observability.
    • Strong problem-solving and systems-thinking skills, with the ability to balance immediate business priorities against long-term maintainability and scalability.
    • Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively with Product, QA, Implementation, Client Success, and other stakeholders.
    • Ability to operate effectively in a high-growth startup environment where processes are continuously being created and improved.
    • Availability to work Eastern Time Zone hours is required.
    • Experience with credit unions or community banks, Corelation Keystone, Jack Henry Symitar, Fiserv Portico, CU Answers, Plaid, Socure, Alloy, DocuSign, business banking workflows, or conversion optimization is an advantage.

      • Benefits

      • Competitive compensation.
      • Stock options in a well-funded startup.
      • Remote-first work culture.
      • 100% coverage of extended medical, dental, and vision premiums for employees and their families in Canada under the comprehensive plan.
      • Retirement plan with 4% company matching.
      • 8 weeks of paid parental leave for birthing parents and 4 weeks for non-birthing parents.
      • 3–5 weeks of paid time off depending on tenure.
      • 5 health days.
      • 15 paid holidays.

      • Performance-based bonuses.
      • Fast-paced, collaborative working environment with opportunities for meaningful technical impact.
      • Equal employment opportunities and an inclusive workplace committed to diverse backgrounds and perspectives.

title: Data Scientist
description:
About Us

Beast Industries is a multifaceted media and entertainment company founded by Jimmy Donaldson, popularly known as MrBeast, the most watched person in the world. Renowned for revolutionizing digital content creation, Beast Industries encompasses a diverse portfolio of ventures that extend far beyond its origins on YouTube. With a mission to entertain, inspire, and create significant social impact, Beast Industries operates across various domains including digital media, philanthropy, consumer products, and innovative business initiatives. At Beast Industries, we believe in the transformative power of digital media and its potential to entertain, educate, and effect positive change. Our commitment to innovation, creativity, and philanthropy drives us to explore new frontiers, create unforgettable experiences, and build a legacy that inspires future generations.

We're doing an AI-first engineering rebuild for a company that already has an audience of 100M+ people. This is a zero-to-one build with no legacy constraints. You're not here to run reports or maintain someone else's dashboards. You're here to turn ambiguous product questions into clear, data-backed answers that directly shape what we build and how we grow. You'll work alongside engineers and product teams, using AI to move faster than a traditional data science workflow ever allowed.

The Product
You'll work as part of a small, fast-moving team on the data foundation that powers product decisions across consumer products, media, gaming, and e-commerce. The work spans the full journey from raw user behavior to actionable insight. That means:
Product questions that are ambiguous, high-stakes, and time-sensitive. You need to frame them correctly before you can answer them.
A/B experiments where the design, statistical rigor, and interpretation directly determine what ships next.
A fast-moving team that moves at a pace where every analysis needs to count, and AI tools are a core part of how we get there.

What You'll Do
Design and execute analyses that turn raw user behavior into actionable product insights, working closely with engineers and product teams to frame the right questions.
Own A/B experiments end to end, from experiment design and statistical analysis through to result interpretation and recommendation.
Communicate findings clearly to product and engineering stakeholders, translating complex analysis into actionable recommendations that drive product decisions.
Leverage AI tools to accelerate your workflow, from data exploration and analysis to insight delivery and iteration.

Who You Are
AI-Native: You're already using AI tools daily to move faster, from writing queries and building models to exploring data and communicating findings.
Analytical Builder: 2+ years of hands-on experience in data science or analytics, with strong SQL, Python, and statistical modeling skills. You don't just analyze. You build the tooling and frameworks that make analysis repeatable and reliable.
Product Connected: You care about why you're analyzing something, not just how. You can translate vague product questions into tractable data problems and communicate findings clearly to non-technical stakeholders.
Experimentally Rigorous: You understand the principles of A/B testing, know where experiments go wrong, and hold the line on statistical rigor even under deadline pressure.
Strong SQL and Python skills, experience with A/B experimentation frameworks, and familiarity with at least one major cloud data stack (AWS, GCP, Databricks, Snowflake, or equivalent). Bonus points for experience in consumer products, media, gaming, or e-commerce, and prior work alongside product or engineering teams in a fast-moving environment.

Benefits
Equity: Highly competitive equity package designed for a foundational hire.
Hybrid Model: Expected ~3 days per week in-office (Bay Area or NYC).

Benefits

The Perks, Why Work On the MrBeast Team

We are redefining what entertainment and storytelling look like at global scale. Every piece of content we publish reaches millions and influences culture in real time. This is your opportunity to lead the team that decides how those moments come to life across every screen.

  • Competitive Salary
  • Generous Medical (Blue Cross Blue Shield), Dental, Vision and company-paid Life Insurance
  • Company contributions to employee Health Savings Accounts (HSA)
  • 401k Plan with Safe Harbor company-matching
  • Flexible vacation policy and paid company holidays
  • Company-provided technology package
  • Relocation assistance where applicable, including travel and company-provided housing for the first 90 days

title: Erfarne sagsbehandlere, der kan værdifastsætte biler
description:
Er du på udkig efter en afvekslende arbejdsdag med værdifastsættelse af køretøjer i fokus, så er Motorstyrelsen måske noget for dig.

Motorstyrelsen søger lige nu tre erfarne medarbejdere til styrkelse af vores værdifastsætterenheder, der sikrer korrekt afgiftsberegning af køretøjer.

Hos Motorstyrelsen bliver du en del af et miljø, hvor faglig sparring og videndeling værdsættes. Du kommer til at arbejde med et område, der har stor bevågenhed, og du er med til at løse en vigtig samfundsopgave.

Jobbet som værdifastsætter
Som værdifastsætter arbejder du med vurdering af køretøjers værdi og beregning af registreringsafgift. Du skal være med til at sikre, at køretøjer er korrekt registreret, og at værdien og afgiften fastsættes på et ensartet grundlag.

Sagerne bygger på en værdifastsættelse af forskellige typer af køretøjer ved import eller eksport, og du skal derfor kunne identificere mærke og modeller. Det er vigtigt, at du har sans for detaljer, og at du er grundig i dit arbejde. På baggrund af værdifastsættelsen skal du gennem din sagsbehandling udarbejde en fyldestgørende og korrekt sagsfremstilling, så værdifastsættelsen sker på et ensartet og gennemskueligt grundlag.

Når køretøjerne skal værdifastsættes, sammenligner vi annoncerede køretøjer fra forskellige salgsportaler. Til det har vi et elektronisk hjælpeværktøj, vi bruger. På baggrund af den beregnede værdi, skal du træffe afgørelse, som sendes til borgere og virksomheder. I din hverdag har du også telefonisk kontakt.

Gode menneskelige, faglige og kommunikative kompetencer
Vi lægger vægt på, at du:

  • tænker helhedsorienteret og sætter borgere og virksomheder i fokus.
  • er detaljeorienteret, struktureret og analytisk i din tilgang til problemløsning, ligesom du er parat til at tage ansvar og træffe væsentlige beslutninger.
  • har dokumenteret erfaring indenfor offentlig forvaltning og sagsbehandling - gerne på styrelsesniveau.
  • skal kunne formulere dig klart og præcist og arbejde grundigt med både fakta og regelgrundlag.
  • håndterer dine opgaver selvstændigt og indgår samtidig i teamsamarbejde, hvor du forstår vigtigheden af videndeling og sparring med dine kolleger.
  • generelt er serviceminded i din tilgang opgaveløsningen.
  • trives med fart over feltet og med at få sager for hånden - uden at miste fokus på kvaliteten.
  • er dygtig til at kommunikere både på skrift og i tale til alle målgrupper.
Vi forventer, at du har fx kontoruddannelse, erhvervsakademiuddannelse professionsbachelor eller relevant akademisk uddannelse.

Bliv en del af et fagligt og kollegialt fællesskab
Du kan se frem til at blive en del af en spændende arbejdsplads, hvor det går ordentligt til, og hvor vi er holdspillere. Vi arbejder med køretøjer, men det handler om mennesker – både dem vi hjælper hver dag og dem, der arbejder hos os.

Derfor får du en hverdag, hvor du er omgivet af gode kolleger, der sætter pris på at have et godt arbejdsmiljø – både fagligt og socialt. Du får gode ansættelsesvilkår, fleksible arbejdstider og et job, hvor du gør en forskel for Danmark. Vi prioriterer en god onboarding til arbejdsopgaverne og styrelsen som arbejdsplads.

Du får kontorplads i en moderne og aktivitetsbaseret indretning centralt i Aalborg. Her har samarbejde og faglig sparring optimale vilkår samtidig med, at der er plads til faglig fordybelse og bevægelse i løbet af en arbejdsdag.

Kontakt og ansættelsesvilkår
Send din ansøgning med CV og eksamensbevis via linket ”Søg stillingen” senest den 15. september 2026.

Vi vil indkalde til samtaler løbende. Forventet tiltrædelse er pr. 1. oktober 2026 eller hurtigst muligt.

Du ansættes i en af vores enheder, der arbejder med Værdiansættelse. Har du spørgsmål til stillingen, er du velkommen til at kontakte funktionsleder Peter Ertmann på tlf. 72 37 48 65 eller funktionsleder Claus Rytter på telefon 72 38 63 66.

Forud for ansættelse vil vi indhente referencer og straffeattest.

Du bliver ansat på overenskomstvilkår i henhold til enhver tid gældende overenskomst for enten akademikere i staten (AC), overenskomst for kontorfunktionærer, laboranter og it-medarbejdere (HK) eller overenskomst for fuldmægtige m.fl. (DTS) i Skatteministeriet. Ansættelse vil være i Skatte- og Vækstministeriet med tilhørende institutioner.

Hvis du går videre til ansættelse i rekrutteringsforløbet, skal du være opmærksom på, at vi foretager en undersøgelse af, om du har gæld, der er sendt til inddrivelse hos det offentlige. Vi undersøger ligeledes, om du har afgjorte kontrol-/og eller straffesager på skatte- og afgiftsområdet. Din ansættelse sker under forudsætning af, at vi ikke finder oplysninger om dig, der er uforenelige med en ansættelse i Skatte- og Vækstminister koncern.

Du bliver ansat i Skatte- og Vækstministeriet med tilhørende institutioner. Arbejdsstedet er Lauritzens Plads 1, 9000 Aalborg.

title: Game Designer - Lion Studios
description:
Who are we?

Tripledot Studios is one of the largest independent mobile games companies in the world.

We are a multi-award-winning organisation, with a global 2,500+ strong team across 12 studios.

Our expanded portfolio includes some of the biggest titles in mobile gaming, collectively reaching top chart positions around the world and engaging over 25 million daily active users.

Tripledot’s guiding principle is that when people love what they do, what they do will be loved by others.

We’re building a company we’re proud of. One filled with driven, incredibly smart and detail-orientated people, who LOVE making games.

Our ambition is to be the most successful games company in the world, and we’re just getting started.

This role will be working at Lion Studios

Lion Studios is a mobile games publisher that works with mobile developers to get their games discovered by players around the world. Headquartered in San Francisco, Lion Studios’ creative and strategy teams utilize their expertise to help game developers break through the noise and grow their businesses.

Since launching in 2018, Lion Studios has driven 90% of its games to the Top 10 in the App Store and Google Play and helped drive 16 games to #1 in the US App Store’s Top Free chart.
Role Overview

As a Game Designer, you will support our Turkish teams and work on our successful casual puzzle titles. You’ll work closely with external development teams, studio managers, and you'll have the exciting opportunity to ideate, craft, and analyze our existing and future puzzle games, contributing to their success.

You’ll thrive here if you’re a versatile game design generalist with a strong interest in level design, comfortable building relationships across multiple teams, and able to balance creative judgement with data-informed decision-making.

Responsibilities

  • Design engaging & challenging core gameplay loops, player experiences, and monetization strategies.
  • Partner with external studios in Turkey throughout the new game development pipeline, from early concepts to playable builds.
  • Design new mechanics that enhance depth and progression while fitting seamlessly into the game’s design approach.
  • Evaluate player data, identify trends, and optimize level funnels for retention and monetization.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with developers to align with overall product goals.
  • Keep an eye on top-performing games to understand market trends and extract insights.

Required Skills, Knowledge and Expertise

  • At least 3+ years of experience as a game designer, or in a similar field.
  • Professional experience in game design, with the ability to contribute across mechanics, systems, progression, and player experience.
  • Confidence using data and player insights to identify design problems and recommend solutions.
  • Strong creative and problem-solving skills, with the ability to collaborate and communicate effectively with cross-functional stakeholders to align design with the product vision.
  • Advanced analytical skills, ability to spot patterns and trends
  • Experience with balancing levels and funnel optimization
  • Fluency in Turkish and the ability to communicate effectively with Turkish-speaking studio teams.

Desired Skills

  • Game design experience as a publisher in puzzle genres is a huge plus
  • Experience with liveops, A/B testing, or data-informed iteration cycles.
  • Familiarity with Figma or similar visual collaboration software for mock-ups
  • Proficient using AI tools for generating early prototypes
  • Track record of publishing/working on successful hypercasual, casual, or AAA titles

title: Test Analyst - Senior
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Test Analyst - Senior based in United Kingdom.

This role offers the opportunity to lead comprehensive testing and business readiness activities for a consumer-facing digital solution.
You will ensure applications meet business requirements, acceptance criteria, quality standards, and end-user expectations.
The position combines hands-on software testing with defect management, data validation, training, documentation, and deployment support.
You will work closely with Product Owners, Business Analysts, subject matter experts, technical teams, and business stakeholders in an Agile environment.
Your expertise will help ensure smooth releases, effective user adoption, and stable post-implementation operations.
You will also explore responsible uses of AI and Generative AI to improve testing, documentation, training, and knowledge-transfer processes.
This is an excellent opportunity for a senior testing professional who enjoys combining technical quality assurance with business-facing delivery and change readiness.

Accountabilities

  • Plan, develop, and execute comprehensive test scenarios, scripts, and test cases aligned with business requirements and acceptance criteria.
  • Perform UAT, functional, regression, enhancement, integration, data validation, and end-to-end testing.

  • Develop and maintain end-user training materials, user guides, job aids, FAQs, training scenarios, presentations, and knowledge-transfer documentation.
  • Facilitate user walkthroughs, demonstrations, training sessions, and knowledge-transfer activities.
  • Support business readiness, deployment readiness, go-live activities, and post-implementation stabilization.
  • Contribute to solutions involving licensing, regulatory, permitting, or citizen-facing applications and processes.
  • Identify opportunities to use approved AI and Generative AI tools to improve test case creation, coverage, defect analysis, documentation, training, and knowledge transfer.

    • Ability to critically evaluate AI-generated content and validate it for accuracy, completeness, accessibility, privacy, security, and regulatory compliance.
    • Strong analytical, problem-solving, documentation, communication, and stakeholder management skills.
    • Bachelor's degree or equivalent professional experience in a relevant field.
    • Ability to work effectively across technical and non-technical teams while managing multiple testing and business readiness priorities.

      • Benefits

title: Banking, Senior Full-Stack (.NET+Angular) Engineer, JR684
description:
ELEKS Software Engineering and Development Office is looking for a Senior Full-Stack (.NET + Angular) Developer in Poland or Ukraine.

ABOUT PROJECT

Our US-based client is the leading provider of Asset Liability Management (ALM) solutions for banks and credit unions.

REQUIREMENTS

  • Strong C# and .NET skills, with the judgment to work in an existing codebase – read it, understand the patterns, and improve it rather than paving over it
  • Solid experience with a modern SPA framework and TypeScript (Angular preferred; React/Vue transfers), plus comfort with HTML/CSS and a utility-first approach like Tailwind
  • Proven experience building and consuming RESTful web services in the cloud (Azure preferred)
  • Range across the stack – you have a home layer, but you’ll follow a problem from the UI through the API into a calculation or a query
  • Comfort reasoning about correctness: where a bug should have been caught, and how to verify numerical output (tolerances, expected values, regression of calculated results) rather than just HTTP 200s
  • Working knowledge of relational and/or document databases – schema design, writing queries, and knowing when the query is the bottleneck
  • Excellent communication in a distributed team – strong written English, and the ability to defend a design in review, ask hard questions in grooming, and explain tradeoffs to business stakeholders who aren’t engineers
  • 5+ years of relevant experience, and a bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Mathematics, or a related discipline – or equivalent practical experience

RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Design and build features end-to-end – C# APIs and Azure Functions on the backend, Angular and TypeScript on the frontend – and own them from design through production
  • Work in the numbers, not just around them: extend and maintain the financial calculation engines at the heart of platform
  • Build out new UI, wired to the API – and help establish the patterns the frontend will scale on
  • Extend and debug our event-driven Azure architecture: Service Bus, queue workers, blob storage, App Configuration, and Key Vault
  • Model and query data in MongoDB, and push work to the right layer when a query or a calc-heavy path gets slow
  • Write tests as you build – unit, integration, and end-to-end – with a clear opinion on where each layer earns its keep, especially for calculated output
  • Treat performance and reliability as features: catch slowdowns the same week they’re introduced, not the quarter a client notices
  • Close the loop with production – monitor Azure alerts, logs, and traces (Application Insights), diagnose escaped defects across the stack, and feed what you learn back into the code and the tests
  • Use AI tools like Claude Code daily – to explore unfamiliar code, scaffold features, generate tests, and sharpen how the whole team ships
  • Raise the floor for the team: review PRs with substance, partner on testable design, and make good practice shared practice
  • Refine requirements with business analysts before they become code – and push back when a requirement doesn’t hold together
  • Serve as second-level support for internal user questions and issues

title: Cross-Cultural Adaptation Technician
description:
We are looking for individuals who want to join our Team in Ansbach, Germany.
Apply Now!

JOB OPENING
  • Title: Cross-Cultural Adaptation Technician
  • Location: Ansbach, Germany
  • Start date: August 2026
  • Job-Type: Part-Time On Call (PTOC)

Job-Type: Part-Time On-Call (PTOC) = Substitute and replacement personnel for planned and unplanned absences at the ACS Office. Personnel should be available on short notice.

SUMMARY

Provide orientation services to US servicemembers, civilians and their families through the ACS Relocation Program to include Host Nation Orientation, Cultural Adaptation walking tours, translations, German and English as a Second Language classes for the USAG Ansbach Community.


QUALIFICATIONS
  • Fluent in English and German
  • Knowledge of German customs, culture, and language
  • Minimum of one year recent work or volunteer experience in Family Service Programs or German tourism
  • Able to give orientation, information, and guidance about life in Germany to newcomers
  • Minimum of one year experience in in conducting briefings, trainings, preparing formal and informal correspondence, memorandum, reports, and data collection, and creating lesson plans for classes.
  • Familiar with MS Word, Excel, Power Point, Publisher, Access, Internet and e-mail
  • Able to work flexible hours (some language classes have evening hours)
  • Familiar with US Army Regulations highly desirable but not necessary
JOB DESCRIPTION INCLUDES, BUT IS NOT LIMITED TO:

Host Nation Orientation Briefing and Walking Tours:
  • Conduct the weekly (currently on Mondays), Host Nation Orientation briefings for newcomers. Sssist in the set-up and break down, registration and preparation of the Host Nation briefing room.
  • During the Permanent Change of Station (PCS) months of June, July and August, the conduct Host Nation Orientation briefings twice a week from June to August,as agreed upon with the In-processing Transition Center.
  • Host Nation Orientation tour shall consist of a walking tour through Wiesbaden and will explain area information, cultural differences, and the actual use of public transportation. During the tour, and if no restrictions are in place from the host nation regarding patronage of restaurants, coordinate lunch at a local German restaurant where tour participants will learn differences between restaurant culture, menu reading, ordering and tipping.
  • Present a cultural adaptation program in the form of three (3) walking tours per month to educate the community; focusing on methods to purchase train and bus tickets, coordination of day trips within the local surrounding area (maximum 50 kilometer radius), to increase comfort and ease with German transportation (train/bus), increase knowledge of how to read the schedules, and payment of appropriate fees, going to local restaurants and ways to access public recreational and leisure activity centers. Each tour shall be a minimum of two (2) hours and a maximum of eight (8) hours.
  • Confirm with participants and participating agencies the dates, times,and location of each class, training, briefing and orientation offered. In case the orientation or the tour is cancelled, contact both the agencies and the participants to inform them of the cancellation before COB (close of business) on the day prior to the event. In inclement weather, when the walking tour is not possible, the Contractor shall provide an inhouse presentation i.e. virtual walking tour that will be similar to the agenda of the walking tour using Government approved virtual communication platforms, or provide an alternative date to attend.
  • Become knowledgeable of the Host Nation information, procedures and requirements necessary to provide the services in the paragraph above.

Language Training /Classes
  • Basic Conversational German Class: Provide basic conversational German (Deutsch) language class: one and half hour (1.5 hrs) class between the hours of 1100 to 1400hrs; second class during the evening between the hours of 1900 to 2030 (the days shall be coordinated with the Relocation Program Manager).
  • Courses shall be eight (8) sessions in length. Classes shall not be scheduled on Training Holidays, US Federal Holidays, or during DoDDS Spring Break. Five (5) courses shall be scheduled during each contract year. If necessary, and with the Relocation Program Manager agreement, the summer course may be of fewer sessions.
  • English-as-a-Second-Language (ESL) Courses: Provide basic conversational English as a Second Language (ESL) classes: a eight (8) week Beginner ESL class twice a week; Each class shall be 1.5 hours in duration. Three (3) courses shall be conducted during each contract year.

Host Nation Support:
  • When not training, teaching or providing Host Nation tours, be available to answer questions about the Host Nation by email or by phone.
  • Provide unofficial German to English, and vice-versa, translation services on subjects such as rental housing information, reading newspaper advertisements, transportation schedules, including contacting agencies via phone or email, as needed
Additional Information

This position is not eligible for support under the NATO Status of Forces Agreement (SOFA) supplemental agreement articles 72 or 73.

title: IT-supportere søges til skoleområdet
description:
IT-supportere søges til skoleområdet

Vi søger to IT-supportere til Roskilde Kommunes skole-it med tiltrædelse hurtigst muligt.

Du bliver ansat i Roskilde Kommunes Digitaliseringsafdeling, men vil arbejde på skolerne. Derfor er kørekort og bil nødvendigt. Du bliver kollega med IT-supporterne på kommunens øvrige skoler og refererer til teamlederen for skole-it på rådhuset. Derudover vil du have et tæt samarbejde med resten af Digitaliseringsafdelingen.

Vi afholder ugentlige møder, og den daglige kommunikation foregår via Teams. I de første uger vil du få fysisk sidemandsoplæring af en kollega.

Din opgave er at hjælpe skolen med at sikre en så gnidningsfri brug af it-udstyret som muligt. Du skal både yde konkret teknisk support til skolens elever og personale og fungere som sparringspartner for skolens ledelse i forbindelse med mere udviklings- og pædagogisk orienterede opgaver relateret til brugen af it i undervisningen.

Din dagligdag vil i høj grad være præget af samarbejde med lærere, administration og ressourcepersoner på skolen. Skoleårets rytme præger opgaverne, så forståelse for læringsmiljøets behov for få afbrydelser og for brugernes behov er vigtig.

For at kunne varetage stillingen forventer vi, at du både har gode pædagogiske og it-faglige kompetencer samt en generel teknisk flair. Du er omgængelig og god til selvstændigt at tage ansvar for din opgaveløsning, og du har sans for orden og struktur.

På it-siden forventer vi, at du er helt fortrolig med pc-verdenen og iPads.

Vi er en Microsoft 365-kommune, og vi bruger Intune som administrationsværktøj til både pc'er og iPads.

Office 365 og Teams er de værktøjer, som både personale og elever bruger i dagligdagen som henholdsvis samarbejdsplatform og læringsplatform.

Du bliver lokal administrator i Aula og skal samtidig yde support i forbindelse med blandt andet netværk, printere, projektorer og touchskærme, primært Clevertouch og CTOUCH.

Det er en fordel, hvis du har kendskab til hverdagen i en dansk folkeskole.

Ansættelse sker efter gældende overenskomst. I forbindelse med ansættelsen indhenter vi børne- og straffeattest samt referencer.

Ansøgningsfristen er den 20. september 2026. Vi afholder ansættelsessamtaler i uge 39.

Oplys gerne referencer fra tidligere tilsvarende ansættelser.

Yderligere oplysninger om stillingen kan fås hos teamleder Flemming Strand på telefon 46 31 32 10.
