description:
Barbaricum is a rapidly growing government contractor providing leading-edge support to federal customers, with a particular focus on Defense and National Security mission sets. We leverage more than 17 years of support to stakeholders across the federal government, with established and growing capabilities across Intelligence, Analytics, Engineering, Mission Support, and Communications disciplines. Founded in 2008, our mission is to transform the way our customers approach constantly changing and complex problem sets by bringing to bear the latest in technology and the highest caliber of talent.

Headquartered in Washington, DC's historic Dupont Circle neighborhood, Barbaricum also has a corporate presence in Tampa, FL, Bedford, IN, and Dayton, OH, with team members across the United States and around the world. As a leader in our space, we partner with firms in the private sector, academic institutions, and industry associations with a goal of continually building our expertise and capabilities for the benefit of our employees and the customers we support. Through all of this, we have built a vibrant corporate culture diverse in expertise and perspectives with a focus on collaboration and innovation. Our teams are at the frontier of the Nation's most complex and rewarding challenges. Join our team.

Barbaricum is seeking an Model Based Systems Engineer II to directly support the anticipated Naval Surface Warfare Center (NSWC) Crane Division, Model Based Engineering Assessment Division (Code MXM). Code MXM's mission is mission engineering analysis and assessment of complex Naval, DoD, and joint kill chains — with a specialized focus on Electromagnetic Spectrum Operations (EMSO) enabled analysis. As a Model Based Systems Engineer II, you will apply MBSE methodologies, frameworks, and tools in support of Code MXM's mission engineering capability development — this is the largest single labor category on the effort. You will develop and manage requirements and verification methodologies within system models and support the creation and management of MBSE artifacts.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Apply expert knowledge of MBSE methodologies and frameworks and expertise in MBSE tools.
  • Develop and manage requirements and verification methodologies within system models.
  • Use system models to identify subassemblies, interfaces, functions, environments, and software/firmware requirements.
  • Support creation of SETR artifacts and MBSE meta-chain report templates.
  • Support data management (DM) and configuration management (CM) of MBSE artifacts.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Active DoD SECRET clearance (minimum); U.S. citizenship required.
  • Bachelor's degree from an ABET-accredited institution.
  • Expert knowledge of MBSE methodologies and frameworks and expertise in MBSE tools.
  • Proficiency in UML (Universal Modeling Language).

DESIRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Bachelor's degree (preferred education per the labor category).
  • Experience with MBSE tools such as Cameo Systems Modeler, Rational Rhapsody, DOORS, and Teamwork Cloud.

EEO Commitment

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to sex, race, ethnicity, age, national origin, citizenship, religion, physical or mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, pregnancy, family structure, marital status, ancestry, domestic partner status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, veteran or military status, or any other basis prohibited by law.

title: Vehicle Software Engineer – Rust Controls
description:
At Stoke, we believe a thriving space economy will enable a vibrant, sustainable, and equitable future here on Earth. That is why we’re building Nova, our fully and rapidly reusable launch vehicle. Designed for daily flight, Nova tackles the core challenges of space transportation by reducing cost, increasing availability, and improving reliability. By radically lowering launch costs and increasing flight cadence, we’re helping create a truly scalable space industry.

Our team is mission-driven, collaborative, and empowered to take ownership of their work. If you want to work alongside some of the most dedicated and talented people on Earth, we’d love to have you join us.

Description

Automation links the Vehicle Software ecosystem to hardware intent. As a Rust Controls Engineer, your primary focus will be building an automation framework that lets end users compose vehicle behavior from building blocks you own. These building blocks will be used daily across the company to perform benchtop checkouts, engine hotfires, and flight objectives. You will define the right boundaries and guardrails to enable users to navigate a control language that is operationally flexible yet appropriately restrictive. You will also own pieces of automation, dogfooding your building blocks as your software commands the physical world around it.

You must be ready to stay focused, move fast, self-direct, and learn on the fly.

Responsibilities

  • Design useful abstractions for hardware control behavior in a distributed system
  • Create user-facing guardrails for an autonomy ecosystem
  • Develop ground and vehicle automation
  • Build software tests
  • Support hardware test

Qualifications

  • Experience with Rust and Python
  • Strong systems-thinking approach with the ability to navigate complex, distributed software-hardware interactions
  • Strong math background
  • 2+ years of professional experience in software development, controls, or systems engineering
  • Ability to prioritize, self-direct, and ask for help

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with control theory and laws
  • Software language or compiler background

Benefits

  • Equity – We know that our employees are the reason we succeed. To give everyone a stake in our future, we are pleased to offer equity in the form of stock options to all regular, full-time employees.
  • Comprehensive benefits program including subsidized medical, dental, and vision insurance
  • Company-paid life and disability insurance
  • 401(k) plan with employer match
  • 4 weeks’ Paid Time Off
  • Holidays – 10 days (including an end-of-year closure)
  • Paid Family/Parental Leave
  • On-site gym or monthly wellness stipend (depending on location)
  • Dog friendly offices!

Compensation

Target Levels:

  • Level 2 range: $123,480 - $185,220
  • Level 3 range: $154,350 - $231,525
  • Level 4 range: $192,885 - $289,380

Our job posts are intentionally written to attract a wide variety of experience levels, and we make decisions about the right fit on a per-candidate basis.

Your actual level and base salary will be decided based on your specific experience and skill level.

ITAR Requirements

To conform to U.S. Government space technology export regulations, including the International Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR), you must be a U.S. citizen, lawful permanent resident of the U.S., protected individual as defined by 8 U.S.C. 1324b(a)(3), or eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State.

Equal Opportunity

The Company is an Equal Opportunity Employer, including with respect to disability and veteran status. It is committed to compliance with all equal opportunity laws, including the Immigration and Nationality Act (INA) and Title VII. It does not discriminate on the basis of nationality, race, citizenship, immigration status, or any other protected class when it comes to employment practices, including hiring.

Employment at the Company is contingent upon satisfactory completion of reference and background checks, and on your ability to prove your identity and authorization to work in the U.S. for the Company. Employees must comply with the United States Citizenship and Immigration Services employment verification requirements, and, therefore, they must complete an Employment Eligibility Verification Form I-9 at the start of employment and re-verify authorization to work periodically.

Separate from this I-9 process, this position entails access to certain technology and technical data that is restricted under U.S. export control laws and regulations. Employment or continued employment may be conditioned on your legal authorization to work with or have access to export control materials as necessary to perform your job.

title: Vil du være med til at løfte fagligheden og skabe kvalitet sammen med os - Distrikt Storvorde
description:
Når faglighed bliver delt, vokser den – og det kan mærkes hos borgeren.

Har du lyst til at bruge din faglighed til mere end den daglige opgaveløsning? Som kvalitetsmedarbejder får du mulighed for at inspirere, undervise og udvikle sammen med dine kolleger. Du bliver en del af et fagligt fællesskab, hvor vi er nysgerrige på hinanden, deler vores viden og sammen finder veje til endnu bedre praksis.

For os handler kvalitet i sidste ende om mennesker – om tryghed, værdighed og livskvalitet for borgeren og om at skabe et stærkt fagligt fundament for medarbejderne.

Måske er det dig, vi mangler på holdet?

I Borgerens Faste Team, Distrikt Storvorde er vi et fagligt fællesskab, hvor vi hjælper hinanden og har borgeren i centrum. Vi tror på, at vi bliver bedre, når vi deler vores viden, lærer af hinanden og sammen er nysgerrige på, hvordan vi kan gøre tingene endnu bedre. Hos os er der plads til faglig sparring, udvikling, humor og arbejdsglæde. Vi lægger vægt på, at alle bidrager med deres faglighed og perspektiver, og at vi sammen skaber en hverdag med høj kvalitet – til gavn for både borgere og medarbejdere.

Som kvalitetsmedarbejder bliver du en vigtig del af dette fællesskab og får mulighed for at være med til at inspirere, udvikle og gøre en forskel i hverdagen.

Lidt om stillingen:

Som kvalitetsmedarbejder bliver du en vigtig del af arbejdet med at sikre, udvikle og fastholde høj faglig kvalitet i Borgerens Faste Team. Du får en central rolle i at understøtte medarbejdernes faglighed og være med til at omsætte viden, retningslinjer og faglige standarder til god praksis i hverdagen.

Vi tror på, at kvalitet skabes sammen. Derfor bliver du en vigtig sparringspartner for dine kolleger og en medspiller i at skabe en kultur, hvor vi deler viden, lærer af hinanden og er nysgerrige på, hvordan vi hele tiden kan gøre vores arbejde endnu bedre.

En vigtig del af stillingen er undervisning og vidensdeling. Du skal derfor have lyst til at formidle faglig viden og inspirere dine kolleger – både gennem planlagt undervisning og i den daglige praksis.

For os handler kvalitet og faglighed om at skabe de bedste forudsætninger for både borgeren og medarbejderen. Når vi arbejder systematisk med at udvikle vores faglighed og praksis, styrker vi kvaliteten i opgaveløsningen og skaber en tryg, værdig og sammenhængende hverdag for borgeren. Samtidig giver det medarbejderne et stærkt fagligt fundament, tydelige rammer og større sikkerhed i deres arbejde.

Stillingen er på 37 timer ugentligt og er fortrinsvist tilrettelagt med dagvagter. Der vil kunne forekomme aftenvagter, og der er weekendvagt hver 2. weekend.

Det er en forudsætning for stillingen, at du har et gyldigt kørekort.

Særlige hovedopgaver:

Som kvalitetsmedarbejder vil dine opgaver blandt andet være:

  • at understøtte og udvikle den faglige kvalitet i praksis
  • at planlægge og gennemføre undervisning for medarbejdere
  • at understøtte vidensdeling og læring i hverdagen
  • at være faglig sparringspartner for kolleger
  • at identificere områder med behov for udvikling og kvalitetssikring
  • at understøtte implementering af nye faglige tiltag, arbejdsgange og retningslinjer
  • at følge op på kvalitetsområder og medvirke til at omsætte resultater til læring og udvikling
  • at understøtte en høj kvalitet i dokumentationen
  • at medvirke til at skabe sammenhæng mellem faglig viden, lovgivning og den daglige praksis
  • at samarbejde med ledelse og kolleger på tværs af faggrupper
  • at være med til at skabe en kultur, hvor det er naturligt at stille spørgsmål, dele viden og lære af hinanden

Du får mulighed for at være med til at præge funktionen og sætte dit eget faglige aftryk på, hvordan vi arbejder med kvalitet og udvikling.

Faglige kompetencer:

Vi søger en uddannet social- og sundhedsassistent, som har:

  • en stærk sundhedsfaglig faglighed og interesse for kvalitetsarbejde
  • lyst og kompetencer til at undervise og formidle faglig viden
  • interesse for faglig udvikling, læring og vidensdeling
  • evne til at omsætte teori og faglig viden til konkret praksis
  • forståelse for betydningen af dokumentation og faglig kvalitet
  • interesse for at arbejde struktureret og systematisk
  • gode kommunikative evner og kan formidle fagligt stof på en forståelig og inspirerende måde
  • lyst til at arbejde med implementering og forankring af nye arbejdsgange
  • evne til at arbejde selvstændigt og tage ansvar for egne opgaver
  • lyst til at samarbejde tværfagligt og bidrage aktivt til fælles løsninger

Det er en fordel, hvis du har erfaring med undervisning, vejledning, kvalitetsarbejde eller faglig udvikling, men det er ikke et krav.

Dog er det vigtigste, at du har lysten til at lære, udvikle og gøre en forskel.

Personlige kompetencer:

Som kvalitetsmedarbejder bliver du en vigtig faglig sparringspartner for dine kolleger. Vi ved samtidig, at ingen kan vide alt, og at faglig udvikling sker gennem nysgerrighed, dialog og fælles læring. Derfor lægger vi vægt på, at du:

  • er nysgerrig og udviklingsorienteret
  • brænder for faglighed og har lyst til at dele din viden med andre
  • er god til at skabe relationer og møde mennesker med respekt og anerkendelse
  • kan inspirere og motivere dine kolleger
  • er tydelig og tillidsvækkende i din kommunikation
  • har mod på at stille spørgsmål til vores praksis på en konstruktiv måde
  • kan se muligheder og løsninger frem for begrænsninger
  • arbejder struktureret, systematisk og med overblik
  • kan arbejde selvstændigt, men samtidig ser værdien i at løfte opgaverne i fællesskab
  • er fleksibel og kan navigere i en hverdag, hvor opgaver og behov kan ændre sig
  • har en positiv tilgang og bidrager til et godt arbejdsmiljø

Praktiske oplysninger:

Arbejdsstedets adresse: Stationsvej 5, 9280 Storvorde.
Tiltrædelse: 1. november 2026
Ansøgningsfrist: 28. september 2026
Samtaler: 30. september 2026

Vil du vide mere?

Har du spørgsmål til stillingen, er du velkommen til at kontakte konstitueret leder Louise Amtoft Offersen på 99826120.

Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig!

Løn- og ansættelsesvilkår:

Efter gældende overenskomst mellem KL og den forhandlingsberettigede organisation.

Forud for endelig ansættelse skal der foreligge en straffeattest og indhentes referencer.

Send ansøgning:

Du sender din ansøgning ved at trykke på knappen "Søg jobbet" og udfylde den formular, som kommer frem. Det er også muligt at vedhæfte bilag som f.eks. ansøgning og CV i begrænset omfang.

Bliv en del af Dobbelt A – få dobbelt op på muligheder - Hos os bliver du en del af et fedt fællesskab med 17.500 kolleger. Glæd dig til at få dobbelt op på udviklingsmuligheder, gode ansættelsesforhold og fokus på trivsel. Vi tror på, at forskellighed gør os stærkere, og opfordrer alle til at søge – uanset alder, køn, baggrund, religion eller handicap.

Se alle fordelene ved et job hos os og bliv klogere på ansættelsesprocessen trin-for-trin.

title: Associate Vice President (AVP) of System Operations
description:
Position Summary
The Associate Vice President (AVP) of System Operations provides oversees systems, support, and operational infrastructure serving entertainment industry clients within a PEO environment. This role leads teams of Support Specialists and System Experts, ensuring stable system performance, effective troubleshooting, rigorous system testing, standardized operating procedures, and comprehensive training that support complex entertainment payroll and workforce needs.
The AVP partners closely with executive leadership, technology, compliance, client services, and external vendors to drive operational excellence, mitigate risk, and support growth across entertainment verticals.
Compensation
The compensation for this role is $80k-$90k USD.
Essential Duties and Responsibilities
Provide executive oversight for entertainment system operations, including system support, issue resolution, testing, documentation, and training functions. Establish scalable service and support models that align with production schedules, touring demands, and episodic employment cycles. Define operational priorities, service levels, and performance metrics to ensure reliable, accurate, and compliant system operations. Ensure teams are structured to provide timely front‑line support, advanced troubleshooting, and system expertise for high‑volume, time‑sensitive entertainment clients. Oversee day‑to‑day and escalated system support for payroll, timekeeping, onboarding, and workforce management platforms. Act as an escalation point for critical, high‑impact, or client‑sensitive system incidents. Ensure comprehensive system testing strategies are in place, including user acceptance testing (UAT), regression testing, and productio.n readiness validation. Partner with Technology and Product teams to validate functionality against entertainment‑specific operational requirements. Oversee the creation, maintenance, and governance of standard operating procedures (SOPs) related to system support, payroll processing, exception handling, and compliance workflows. Ensure documentation is clear, current, and standardized across entertainment clients and operational teams. Ensure system support, testing, and operational processes comply with labor regulations, union/guild requirements, and PEO standards. Partner with Compliance, and Internal Audit teams to reduce operational risk and support audits or regulatory reviews. Identifies training needs and ensures proper training is developed and provided. Oversees the daily workflow of the department. Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities
Deep knowledge of entertainment industry workforce and payroll operations, including film, television, live events, touring, and episodic employment models. Strong understanding of PEO operating models, co‑employment structures, and regulatory responsibilities. Expertise in enterprise payroll, timekeeping, onboarding, and workforce management systems, including system integrations and data flows. Working knowledge of union and guild agreements, complex pay structures, fringes, residuals, and multi‑jurisdictional labor requirements. Knowledge of system support operations, incident management frameworks, testing methodologies (UAT, regression), and release readiness practices. Advanced problem‑solving and troubleshooting leadership skills, with the ability to assess root causes and drive long‑term solutions. Strong system testing and validation leadership, ensuring operational requirements are met prior to production releases. Excellent process design and SOP development skills, with an emphasis on standardization, efficiency, and compliance. Strong cross‑functional collaboration skills, partnering effectively with Technology, Product, Compliance, Legal, Client Services, and Sales teams. Ability to anticipate operational risks related to system changes, compliance requirements, or workforce scale and proactively mitigate them.
Ability to translate business and client needs into system, support, and process requirements. Ability to lead through change, including system upgrades, regulatory shifts, and organizational growth. Education & Experience
Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Operations Management, Information Systems, Human Resources, or a related field required; or an equivalent combination of education and relevant experience. Minimum of 5 years of progressive experience in system operations, payroll operations, HR technology, or workforce support within a complex, high‑volume environment. 5+ years of senior leadership experience managing managers, system experts, and/or support specialists across multi‑tiered support or operational teams. Demonstrated experience supporting enterprise payroll, workforce management, timekeeping, or HRIS platforms, including system support, troubleshooting, testing, and production readiness. Proven experience leading system support functions, including incident management, root‑cause analysis, escalation handling, and service level management. Strong background in system testing and operational readiness, including UAT coordination, regression testing, and validation of system changes prior to release
Experience developing and maintaining standard operating procedures (SOPs), process documentation, and audit‑ready workflows. Experience working with or supporting entertainment industry clients (film, television, live events, touring, or production environments) highly preferred. Prior experience within a PEO, payroll service provider, or outsourced HR services organization a plus. Physical Demands The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this position. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the functions.
Frequently required to sit; occasionally required to stand and walk. Specific vision abilities required include close vision, color vision, and ability to adjust focus. Frequently required to talk and hear. Moderate concentration/intensity, which includes prolonged mental effort. Average memory, taking into consideration the amount and type of information. Noise level in the work environment is usually moderate. This position is eligible for the following benefits:
Health Insurance: Medical, dental, and vision coverage Retirement Plan: 401(k) with company match Paid Time Off: PTO, Holidays, Parental leave and Sick Leave provided as required by applicable state law Other Benefits: Life insurance, short term disability, long term disability, employee assistance program (EAP), flexible spending account (FSA), health savings account (HSA), Identity theft protection, critical illness, accident, cancer, hospital protection, legal and pet insurance. title: SAP EWM / IM Functional Consultant
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a SAP EWM / IM Functional Consultant based in India.

This role offers the opportunity to lead functional design and implementation activities across SAP S/4HANA Extended Warehouse Management and Inventory Management.
You will work closely with warehouse, supply chain, field operations, and inventory stakeholders to translate business needs into scalable SAP solutions.
The position covers the full delivery lifecycle, from requirements gathering and configuration through testing, migration, cutover, and go-live support.
You will design complex warehouse processes and integration touchpoints connecting SAP with third-party platforms and enterprise systems.
Your expertise will help optimize inbound, outbound, inventory, replenishment, picking, packing, and stock management operations.
You will also coordinate across functional, technical, and integration teams within large-scale, multi-workstream programs.
This is an excellent opportunity for an experienced SAP professional seeking significant ownership across sophisticated S/4HANA EWM and IM transformation initiatives.

Accountabilities

  • Engage directly with business stakeholders across warehouse operations, supply chain, field operations, and inventory management to gather, document, validate, and translate requirements into SAP solutions.
  • Author Business Requirement Documents (BRDs), Functional Design Documents (FDDs), Configuration Design Documents (CDDs), and other functional documentation.
  • Conduct fit-gap assessments between current warehouse and inventory processes and SAP S/4HANA standard capabilities.
  • Define functional designs for inbound, outbound, internal warehouse, inventory counting, stock transfer, and related processes across IM-managed and EWM-managed warehouses.
  • Design integration touchpoints between SAP EWM/IM and third-party systems, including external WMS, transportation management, field mobility, asset management, and work-order platforms.
  • Configure SAP S/4HANA Embedded EWM, including warehouse structures, storage types and bins, activity areas, putaway and stock removal strategies, wave management, replenishment, resource and queue management, and RF/mobile transaction frameworks.
  • Configure SAP S/4HANA Inventory Management covering plants and storage locations, movement types, goods receipt and issue processing, physical inventory, batch management, stock transfers, and material valuation.
  • Configure and support the IM-to-EWM integration layer, including distribution models, RFC connectivity, logical system assignments, and qRFC queue management.
  • Define interface requirements, message formats, field mappings, transformation rules, validation logic, error handling, monitoring, and recovery procedures in collaboration with integration and technical teams.
  • Own functional interface design across file-based batch integrations, APIs, IDocs, middleware, SAP Integration Suite, and MuleSoft message flows.
  • Develop Functional Unit Test (FUT) scripts with detailed scenarios, expected results, and traceability to functional designs.
  • Execute and support FUT, System Integration Testing (SIT), and User Acceptance Testing (UAT), investigating and resolving functional defects, data issues, and integration failures.
  • Validate end-to-end warehouse processes on RF and mobile devices, including putaway, picking, packing, goods issue, physical inventory, and stock transfers.
  • Support technical teams in translating functional requirements into specifications for ABAP developments, CDS views, OData services, and other enhancements.
  • Define functional requirements for warehouse master data and inventory migration, supporting stock conversion, Migration Cockpit or LSMW activities, and reconciliation procedures.
  • Participate in cutover planning, dress rehearsals, final stock loading, reconciliation, MRP activities, and warehouse operational readiness.
  • Provide hypercare support following go-live by monitoring interfaces, resolving functional issues, and supporting business users during stabilization.
  • Coordinate offshore and onshore functional, technical, and integration teams while tracking risks, dependencies, action items, and delivery blockers.
  • Participate in governance activities, design authority reviews, status reporting, issue resolution meetings, and other program forums.

    • Requirements

    • 9+ years of SAP EWM functional experience, including at least one full-cycle S/4HANA implementation or ECC-to-S/4HANA migration.
    • Strong hands-on experience configuring SAP S/4HANA Embedded EWM, including warehouse structures, process types, putaway and picking strategies, wave management, RF frameworks, resource management, replenishment, and queue management.
    • Solid understanding of SAP S/4HANA Inventory Management, including goods movements, stock types, batch management, physical inventory, stock transfers, and material valuation.
    • Proven experience designing and supporting SAP integrations with third-party systems such as WMS, field mobility platforms, work-order management solutions, and transportation systems.
    • Familiarity with SAP Integration Suite, MuleSoft, or SAP PI/PO for integration and interface design.
    • Strong understanding of interface concepts including APIs, IDocs, middleware flows, message mapping, data transformation, error handling, monitoring, and recovery processes.
    • Excellent documentation skills, with the ability to produce clear and structured BRDs, FDDs, CDDs, functional specifications, and FUT scripts.
    • Experience working within large-scale programs involving multiple workstreams, offshore and onshore delivery teams, and formal governance structures.
    • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to investigate functional, integration, and data-related issues.
    • Effective communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to work across business, functional, technical, and integration teams.
    • Experience in utilities, energy, or other asset-intensive industries is an advantage.
    • Knowledge of SAP PM/EAM integration with EWM and work-order-driven material demand is beneficial.
    • Experience with ITS Mobile or RF device configuration for warehouse operations is preferred.
    • Familiarity with SAP MRP, including MRP Live, special procurement keys, and stock transfer requisitions, is beneficial.
    • Experience with batch management and shelf-life handling within EWM is an advantage.
    • Awareness of ABAP debugging and development concepts for functional troubleshooting is preferred.

      • Benefits

      • Full-time remote opportunity.
      • Opportunity to contribute to large-scale SAP S/4HANA transformation programs.
      • Significant ownership across EWM and IM functional design, configuration, testing, migration, cutover, and go-live activities.
      • Exposure to complex integrations between SAP and third-party enterprise systems.
      • Collaboration with diverse onshore and offshore functional, technical, and integration teams.
      • Opportunity to work across sophisticated warehouse, inventory, supply chain, and operational processes.
      • Involvement throughout the complete SAP implementation lifecycle, from requirements through post-go-live stabilization.
      • Opportunity to apply expertise across modern SAP EWM, Inventory Management, integration, mobile warehouse operations, and data migration initiatives.
      • Potential to work on projects within utilities, energy, and other asset-intensive environments.

title: Tree Climber
description:
Tree Climber

Pay Range $27.00 - $32.00 per hour

Arbor Masters is committed to nurturing a culturally inclusive environment that hires, trains, and promotes regardless of race, sex, age, national origin, sexual orientation, religion, political beliefs, veteran status, or any other protected class. We will always cultivate an environment that celebrates differences in our teams at all Arbor Masters branches. We recognize that a diverse and inclusive workforce results in better decision-making, faster and more innovative problem solving, and creates a safe and welcoming environment for everyone.

Why work at Arbor Masters?

Arbor Masters is a third-generation, family-owned business, specializing in all areas of tree service and plant care. We love our industry, our work family, and making sure our customers are satisfied by approaching our work with high-level standards for safety and excellence. We are putting down new roots and expanding the family business. We are currently looking to add a Tree Climber to our team of experts. As a Tree Climber, you will participate in all aspects of tree work, including tree pruning and removals.

Your future at Arbor Masters:

When you join the Arbor Masters team, you are joining our work family. We want to see our work family continually grow and succeed. This is not just a job; it is a career path! We will equip you with all the experience and training necessary to grow and advance in the company. The opportunity is all yours and what you want to make of it!

As a Tree Climber, you would be responsible for:

  • Operating heavy equipment, hand, and power equipment, such as bucket trucks, brush trucks, claw trucks, chippers, pole saws, pruning saws, pole pruners, power pole saws, and chainsaws.
  • Repairing, sharpening, and maintaining equipment and tools
  • Performing basic felling and rigging, along with aerial rigging over obstacles
  • Ensuring all appropriate tools, supplies, and materials are loaded on truck, well maintained and accounted for, along with ensuring equipment is inspected and prepared with fuel and fluids
  • Performing job briefing and assisting Crew Leader in work zone set-up and utilizing safety PPE

title: Equipment Engineer
description:
Diamond Foundry Inc. is solving the thermal limitation at the foundation of today's most exciting tech industries -- AI & cloud compute, electric-car power electronics, and 5G/6G wireless. We have managed to produce the world's first single-crystal diamond wafers and are now on a mission to put a diamond behind every chip. We are the rare unicorn that has grown fast and profitably. We received $515m in funding and are executing a multi-$B expansion plan for one of the greenest forms of tech manufacturing: converting greenhouse gas into diamond wafers using zero-emission energy.

We are looking for an industrial equipment engineer to build, install, maintain and troubleshoot plasma reactors and other critical manufacturing equipment. You'll be working with an experienced team of process engineers, maintenance technicians locally and collaborating with mechanical, electrical, and software engineers in the US. Your goal will be to install new equipment in DF Spain, achieve maximum productivity for our production line through improving equipment capabilities and troubleshooting problems on the line.

Responsibilities

  • Installing, commissioning, upgrading, and maintaining plasma reactors (CVD tool) and other critical manufacturing equipment.
  • Troubleshooting industrial control/electrical systems, including high-voltage power supplies, controllers, sensors, pumps, PLC’s, valves, and other devices.
  • Tracking and reporting on equipment uptime/downtime, root cause analysis, overall equipment efficiency, mean time between failure and the like.
  • Working with manufacturing technicians, plan and execute upgrades and retrofits to improve tool reliability and process capabilities.
  • Writing procedures and checklists, assisting and training maintenance.

Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree in Electrical, Mechanical, Electronics Engineering or similar engineering discipline.
  • 2+ years of hands-on engineering experience with manufacturing equipment.
  • Ability in project planning and management, with the capacity to thrive in multidisciplinary teams to solve complex problems.
  • Must be available to complete a training period in the United States. Additionally, this role involves ad-hoc short-term international travel to the U.S. to fulfill project needs.
  • Able to read, write, and speak both Spanish and English proficiently.
Diamond Foundry believes in supporting our employees from the workplace to their personal and home life. We provide eligible employees with an opportunity to enroll in a variety of benefit programs, generally including health insurance, flexible spending accounts, retirement savings plans, life and disability insurance programs, and a number of programs that provide for both paid and unpaid time away from work. Perks include employee discounts to VRAI. All benefits offered are available starting your first day.

Diamond Foundry is an Equal Opportunity Employer and considers qualified applicants for employment without regard to race, color, creed, religion, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity and expression, age, disability, veteran status, or any other protected factor under federal, state or local law.

title: Summer 2027 Internship - Operations
description:

Our team is mission-driven, collaborative, and empowered to take ownership of their work. If you want to work alongside some of the most dedicated and talented people on Earth, we’d love to have you join us.

As an intern, you will work on real, open-ended problems that directly contribute to the success of the company. You must be ready to stay focused, move fast, self-direct, and learn on the fly.

title: Studentermedhjælper inden for Alternative Investeringer
description:
Vil du arbejde med investeringer i private equity, infrastruktur og skovinvesteringer og samtidig få praktisk erfaring i en professionel investeringsorganisation? Så har du muligheden for at blive en del af vores investeringsteam og få værdifuld erfaring med alternative investeringer.

**Vi har bedt din kommende leder om at sætte ord på jobbet og opgaverne
**Som studentermedhjælper bliver du en del af teamet, der arbejder med en bred vifte af illikvide aktivklasser. Du får en central rolle i det daglige investeringsarbejde og kommer tæt på samarbejdet med pensionskassens eksterne kapitalforvaltere.

Du bliver en del af den daglige forvaltning af pensionskassens alternative investeringer og får en aktiv rolle i samarbejdet med eksterne forvaltere. Arbejdet kombinerer porteføljeperspektiv, operationelle opgaver og analyse og giver dig et solidt indblik i de underliggende investerings- og beslutningsprocesser. Stillingen er et oplagt springbræt til en karriere inden for investeringer, særligt inden for pension og private markets.

Opgaverne spænder bredt, og du får faglig sparring med erfarne specialister samt mulighed for at bidrage til løsningen af konkrete opgaver.

Dine primære arbejdsopgaver:

  • Porteføljerapportering på alternative investeringer
  • Opfølgning på kapitalindkaldelser og distributioner fra fonde
  • Bidrage til prisfastsættelsen af investeringerne i samarbejde med kollegerne i teamet
  • Analyse og strukturering af forvalter- og fondsspecifikke data
  • Ad hoc-opgaver i samarbejdet med resten af investeringsteamet

**Du har forudsætningerne og modet til mere
**Der er styrke i forskellighed. Vi bliver bedre af at bringe forskellige erfaringer, fagligheder og personligheder sammen. Derfor opfordrer vi til, at alle uanset baggrund sender en ansøgning. Vi vurderer dog, at der er nogle grundlæggende forudsætninger, som er vigtige for at lykkes i jobbet:

  • Du arbejder analytisk og struktureret og har interesse for data, matematik og finansiering
  • Du har erfaring med programmering i Python og SQL. Erfaring med Excel er et plus
  • Du studerer økonomi, finansiering, matematik-økonomi eller en lignende uddannelse
  • Du kommunikerer flydende på engelsk i både skrift og tale
  • Du er nysgerrig og tør udfordre nuværende metoder og forudsætninger

**Sådan oplever en af dine nye kolleger afdelingen
**”Jeg oplever Velliv som en arbejdsplads, hvor vi hele tiden vil blive bedre. Det mærker vi også i teamet, hvor vi dagligt kigger på, hvordan vores eksterne forvaltere gør det [LK3] og forstår udviklingen på de markeder, som de er aktive i. Og det er netop her, du får mulighed for at udvikle dig inden for finansiering og håndtering og systematisering af data. Vi har desuden en fed kultur, hvor der er kort fra idé til handling, samtidig med, at der både er plads til en uformel tone med kollegaerne og mulighed for at få dygtig faglig sparring.” Carl Henriksen, Senior Analyst, Alternative Investeringer

**Plads til at være menneske – plads til at være dig
**Velliv er to år i træk blevet kåret til at have branchens bedste medarbejderimage og har gennem flere år vundet prisen som Årets Pensionsselskab. Hos os bliver du mødt med åbne arme, og vi gør os umage for, at du kommer godt fra start og hurtigt falder til.

Du får en buddy, der hjælper dig i gang, og en leder, der bidrager med mening, udvikling og retning. Du har mulighed for at melde dig ind i ”Klub Velliv” og deltage i aktiviteter inden for sport, mad, hobby og kultur for os medarbejdere og vores børn. I det hele taget kan du forvente en kultur, hvor vi lever vores tre kerneværdier: Optimisme, Ordentlighed og Omsorg. I Velliv skal der være plads til at være menneske – plads til at være dig.

**Vi holder samtaler løbende
**Send dit CV og nogle ord om dig selv og din baggrund i en kort ansøgning. Vi vil gerne høre fra dig senest den 12. september 2026, men vi holder samtaler løbende, så send gerne din ansøgning hurtigst muligt. Hvis du har spørgsmål til stillingen, kan du kontakte Carl, 24965929.

title: Database Administrator
description:
The Database Administrator is responsible for supporting and maintaining all aspects of database systems. The role requires deep technical expertise in SQL Server, database performance optimization, and high availability solutions. This role will collaborate with cross-functional teams, including developers and system administrators, to ensure seamless database operations, security, and compliance. The position will also focus on disaster recovery planning and automation for efficient and secure database environments.
Job Responsibilities: • Ensure high performance and uptime of all database systems. • Install, configure, and maintain Microsoft SQL Server databases to support business applications. • Optimize database performance through query tuning, indexing, and system configuration adjustments. • Design and implement database backup, recovery, and disaster recovery strategies. • Manage database security protocols, including data encryption, authentication, and role-based access control (RBAC). • Write and optimize complex T-SQL queries, stored procedures, and triggers to improve performance. • Oversee the migration of databases across servers or platforms, such as SQL Server to Azure SQL Database. • Set up and manage database monitoring tools (e.g., SQL Server Management Studio, SQL Server Agent) for proactive performance tracking and security. • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure database changes align with overall system architecture and business needs. • Automate database tasks using PowerShell, such as automated backups, maintenance scripts, and performance monitoring. • Regularly review and update database-related documentation, including operational procedures and incident response plans. • Provide technical guidance and mentorship to junior database administrators and other IT staff. • Respond to database issues during off-hours, including nights and weekends, as required.
Knowledge, Skills & Ability: • 5+ years of experience as a database administrator. • In-depth knowledge of SQL Server, T-SQL, and database performance optimization techniques. • Strong experience with high availability (HA) and disaster recovery (DR) technologies (e.g., clustering, replication). • Proficiency in database security, including encryption, access control, and auditing. • Hands-on experience with PowerShell scripting and automation of database tasks. • Ability to work cross-functionally, collaborating with developers, DevOps, and system administrators. • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with a customer-service-oriented mindset.

title: Motion Planning Engineer (m/f/d)
description:
Driving the transition to autonomous mobility: Our mission is to spearhead the deployment of Level 4 autonomous systems in Germany and beyond. By combining cutting-edge AI with the expertise of our multidisciplinary team, we are set to introduce the first certifiable solution of its kind to European roads. Since 2017, we have remained dedicated to one goal: shaping a future that is already in motion.

Tasks

  • Design and implement motion planning algorithms that generate safe and efficient vehicle trajectories under diverse driving conditions
  • Optimize planned trajectories for safety, comfort, and efficiency, balancing competing constraints in real time
  • Validate motion planning behavior in simulation and on real-world test data, identifying and resolving edge cases
  • Work closely with perception and software integration teams to ensure motion planning outputs integrate reliably into the overall driving stack
  • Ensure motion planning algorithms meet defined performance benchmarks and safety requirements for autonomous operation

Requirements

  • A completed degree in computer science, robotics, engineering, applied mathematics, or a comparable field - or equivalent vocational training/apprenticeship in a relevant technical discipline. Hands-on experience counts at least as much as the formal qualification
  • 3+ years of experience in motion planning, robotics, or autonomous vehicle software
  • Proven experience developing motion planning/trajectory generation algorithms for robotics or autonomous vehicles, with a solid background in optimization techniques (e.g. model predictive control, sampling-based planners)
  • Strong C++ and/or Python skills, with experience in motion planning frameworks/libraries (e.g. OMPL, MoveIt) and optimization solvers for trajectory optimization/MPC (e.g. CasADi, OSQP, IPOPT)
  • Experience with ROS/ROS2 and simulation environments (e.g. CARLA, Gazebo), plus a solid grounding in control theory and state estimation (e.g. Kalman filters), linear algebra, and numerical optimization
  • Experience validating algorithms via simulation and real-world test data, including edge-case analysis, and comfortable working with Git/CI-CD and real-time/embedded system constraints
  • Experience working cross-functionally with perception and software integration teams, with an understanding of functional safety requirements for autonomous systems
  • An analytical, structured problem-solving mindset, a safety-conscious approach, and the ability to clearly communicate algorithmic trade-offs to technical and non-technical stakeholders
  • English C1 is required; German is a plus

Benefits

  • Genuine team spirit: working in teams that drive change forward – no matter how complex and extensive the projects are
  • Flexible working hours – with room for the realities of life (parenthood, caregiving responsibilities, voluntary work, etc.)
  • Whether it's fashion, beauty, travel or culture – you'll receive numerous discounts through our partner Corporate Benefits
  • Social relevance: We work on solutions that have game-changing qualities
  • Subsidy for public transport tickets
  • Your professional development is important to us – that's why we cover the costs of further education and training
  • Excellent transport links: attractive location in Wedding with very good public transport connections
  • Focus on people: Our strength lies in our diversity. We respect each other for who we are

What are you waiting for? Apply to MOTOR Ai today and help make autonomous driving possible for everyone.

At our new premises, we place great importance on getting to know one another and working together to drive our vision forward. Our international team is growing and working together on this exciting mission. Face-to-face collaboration is the key to success, which is why we have decided not to become a fully remote company.

We ask recruitment consultancies and agencies not to submit candidate profiles without our prior express request. Any candidate profiles submitted without a prior written placement agreement signed by both parties shall be deemed to have been submitted unsolicited. No entitlement to placement fees or other charges shall arise from their use or from the subsequent recruitment of the candidate.

title: Weekend Sign Installer - Inver Grove Heights, MN
description:
Artisan Direct is seeking an independent contractor to place and pick up temporary weekend signs in the Inver Grove Heights, MN area in the community Argenta Townhomes.

The contractor will be responsible for installing signs between Friday at 5:00 PM and Saturday at 10:00 AM. The same signs must be picked up between Sunday at 6:00 PM and Monday at 8:00 AM. The work may be performed at any time within those windows, as long as all signs are placed by Saturday at 10:00 AM and removed by Monday at 8:00 AM.

The signs are lightweight corrugated plastic, and are installed on wooden stakes. Artisan Direct provides the signs and stakes and provides replacement inventory as needed.

Job Duties:

  • Use Artisan Direct's mobile application to report installation and pickup of signs at specific locations
  • Install signs every weekend between Friday 5 PM and Saturday 10 AM
  • Pickup the same signs between Sunday 6 PM and Monday 8 AM
  • Store signs and extra stakes safely during the week
  • Submit a weekly invoice and order replacement inventory after completing pick up- using our website
Pay Information:
  • Starting compensation is $ 82.50 per weekend
  • Pay is issued via direct deposit every two weeks
  • $20.00 Signing bonus
  • $100.00 bonus after 4 weeks of completed work

Requirements

  • Valid driver’s license and current auto insurance
  • 18+ years old
  • Reliable vehicle with enough space to transport 30+ signs
  • A smartphone (Android or iPhone), roughly four years old or newer, capable of running our mobile app
  • Ability to lift and place signs and work outdoors
  • Ability to hammer stakes 6–8 inches into the ground during the first weekend only
  • Dependable and able to complete routes within the required time windows each weekend

Independent Contractor Notice

This is a 1099 independent contractor position. Contractors are not employees of Artisan Direct and are responsible for their own fuel, expenses, taxes and insurance. Contractors determine their own driving order, provide their own vehicle and mobile device, and complete the work within the placement and pickup windows provided. No benefits, minimum hours, or employment guarantees are offered. Contractors may accept or decline routes but must complete any route they commit to.

Additional Information

The starting pay is for the current work available in this location. As more work comes available our contractor support team will offer additional work to increase earnings. This role is a great fit for delivery and rideshare drivers, couriers, retirees, veterans, or anyone looking for flexible supplemental income. The work is straightforward, independent, and recurring each weekend. Contractors who enjoy driving, being outdoors, and working solo tend to enjoy this role and find it a dependable way to earn extra income on their own schedule.

title: Data Engineer
description:
About Us

Beast Industries is a multifaceted media and entertainment company founded by Jimmy Donaldson, popularly known as MrBeast, the most watched person in the world. Renowned for revolutionizing digital content creation, Beast Industries encompasses a diverse portfolio of ventures that extend far beyond its origins on YouTube. With a mission to entertain, inspire, and create significant social impact, Beast Industries operates across various domains including digital media, philanthropy, consumer products, and innovative business initiatives. At Beast Industries, we believe in the transformative power of digital media and its potential to entertain, educate, and effect positive change. Our commitment to innovation, creativity, and philanthropy drives us to explore new frontiers, create unforgettable experiences, and build a legacy that inspires future generations.

We're doing an AI-first engineering rebuild for a company that already has an audience of 100M+ people. This is a zero-to-one build with no legacy constraints. You're not here to maintain someone else's pipelines. You're here to build the data infrastructure that powers every product decision we make, from real-time telemetry that keeps our systems healthy to the analytics pipelines that tell us what our users actually want.

The Product
You'll own the event and data infrastructure that sits beneath everything: the pipelines, platforms, and tooling that turn raw user behavior into reliable, decision-ready data. The work spans consumer products, media, gaming, and e-commerce, all sitting on top of a large and fast-growing user base. That means:

Operational telemetry that keeps the platform healthy and a separate, well-designed analytics layer that powers product and business decisions.
A data platform that supports real-time monitoring, long-term metric tracking, and the experimentation infrastructure that every product iteration depends on.
Event pipelines that handle high-volume user events with the right instrumentation contracts, schema validation, deduplication, late-arriving event handling, and identity stitching.

What You'll Do
Own, build, and operate the telemetry data pipeline that powers SRE and operational monitoring, ensuring real-time data freshness, reliability, and observability across all production systems.
Own, build, and operate the analytics data pipeline that supports product and user experience analysis, including event instrumentation, schema design, data quality checks, deduplication, late-arriving event handling, and identity stitching at scale.
Partner with data science, product, and SRE stakeholders to translate requirements into pipeline design, including cases where the requirements are vague and need to be shaped before implementation.
Embed AI tooling into the data engineering workflow to accelerate pipeline development, data quality monitoring, and insight delivery.

Who You Are
AI-Native: You're already using AI tools daily to move faster, from writing pipeline code to diagnosing data quality issues.
Data Platform Builder: 3+ years building and operating production data pipelines for high-volume consumer products, with hands-on experience in event instrumentation, schema design, and data quality at scale.
Business Connected: You don't wait for a data scientist to tell you what the pipeline should do. You understand the product well enough to translate vague requirements into robust pipeline design, and you can tell the difference between what someone asked for and what they actually need.

Operational and Analytical Thinker: You understand that operational telemetry and analytics serve different purposes and require different approaches, and you design accordingly.
Strong experience with streaming and batch data pipelines, event-driven architectures, and at least one major cloud data stack (AWS, GCP, Databricks, Snowflake, or equivalent). Bonus points for experience in consumer products, media, gaming, or ads, familiarity with sessionization and identity stitching at scale, and prior work alongside data science or product analytics teams.

Benefits
Equity: Highly competitive equity package designed for a foundational hire.
Hybrid Model: Expected ~3 days per week in-office (Bay Area or NYC).

Benefits

The Perks, Why Work On the MrBeast Team

We are redefining what entertainment and storytelling look like at global scale. Every piece of content we publish reaches millions and influences culture in real time. This is your opportunity to lead the team that decides how those moments come to life across every screen.

  • Competitive Salary
  • Generous Medical (Blue Cross Blue Shield), Dental, Vision and company-paid Life Insurance
  • Company contributions to employee Health Savings Accounts (HSA)
  • 401k Plan with Safe Harbor company-matching
  • Flexible vacation policy and paid company holidays
  • Company-provided technology package
  • Relocation assistance where applicable, including travel and company-provided housing for the first 90 days

title: Tandplejere til Børne- og Ungdomstandplejen i Københavns Kommune – generel sektor
description:
Er du uddannet tandplejer, og brænder du for at gøre en forskel? Får du energi af at samarbejde med børn, unge og forældre om tandbehandling?

Så læs videre om de opgaver, som vi kan tilbyde nedenfor.

Tandplejer opgaver
Ca. 90% af din arbejdstid vil du lave kliniske tandplejeropgaver som fx undersøgelser, profylakse, fokuserede undersøgelser, fissurforseglinger, kontrolbesøg, tilvænning samt delegerede opgaver fra kliniklederen. Du spiller en vigtig rolle i den primære opgave, som er at få opbygget gode tandplejevaner hos børn og unge samt at lære dem at modtage tandpleje.

Hvis du vil have en sundhedspædagogisk opgave i form af klasseundervisning efter vores undervisningsmateriale til specielt 4. klasse, er det en mulighed. Det præcise omfang er individuelt for hver klinik og aftales i samarbejde med kliniklederen.

Dertil kommer kommunikation med børn, unge og deres forældre samt at have et tæt samarbejde med dine kollegaer i alle faggrupper omkring kerneopgaven: Sund mund til byens børn.

Administrative opgaver
Disse udgør ca. 10% af din tid, herunder primært journalskrivning. Dertil kommer kommunikation med kollegaer og undervisningsopgaven.

Hvorfor arbejde hos os?
Vi varetager tandpleje af børn og unge i alderen 0-21 år i Københavns Kommune, lige nu svarende til omkring 140.000 børn og unge. Vi er en bydækkende enhed under Børne- og Ungdomsforvaltningen med tandklinikker fordelt over hele byen.

Den generelle sektor er fordelt på 20 tandklinikker af varierende størrelse - fra tre stole op til 10 stole. Orto er fordelt på tre tandklinikker, hvoraf en af dem er en stor fælles klinik. Dertil kommer en specialklinik, vores kontaktcenter samt administration.

Vi er omkring 360 medarbejdere, og på alle vores tandklinikker er der tandlæger, tandplejere og klinikassistenter ansat. Kendetegnet for dem alle er, at de meget engagerede i arbejdet med børn og unge og har børnekompetence.

På alle vores tandklinikker er der en koordinerede klinikassistent, der står for koordinering og håndtering af klinikassistentopgaverne i samarbejde med klinikkens klinikleder, der er tandlæge, og håndterer den daglige drift samt har det faglige ansvar for klinikken.

Tandplejen i Københavns Kommune har en central administration, som supporterer klinikkerne ved fx it-udfordringer, klagesagsbehandling, HR, lovgivning mv. Du vil derfor altid kunne finde sparring og hjælp i organisationen. Desuden har vi et centralt kontaktcenter, som håndterer kommunikation med vores brugere ift. tidsbestilling, henvendelser og aftalebøger mv.

Tandplejens ledelse består af seks personer med hver deres ansvarsområder inkl. personaleansvarsområde. Vi lægger stor vægt på høj faglighed og bestræber os på at levere det bedste tilbud til alle patienter i denne patientgruppe.

Som tandplejer i Tandplejen i København vil der være mulighed for at deltage i relevant uddannelse inklusiv en uddannelsesdag om året for hele tandplejen. Derudover vil der være både oplæring og grundig introduktion i forhold til den opgave, som forventes løst i funktionen.

Kompetencer

  • Erfaring inden for det kommunale område kan være en fordel, men det vigtigste er, at du har lyst til at arbejde med børn og unge
  • Du skal være klar til at løse mange forskelligartede opgaver i relation til patientbehandlinger i samarbejde med både tandlæger, tandplejere og klinikassistenter. Der er en forventning om, at du kan arbejde selvstændigt og struktureret indenfor klart definerede rammer
  • Du skal forvente og trives i en arbejdsdag, hvor en vis grad af uforudsigelighed altid vil være til stede. En venlig, imødekommende og anerkendende tilgang til alle patienter er en nødvendighed, og du skal have en evne til at indgå i konstruktiv dialog med både patienter og kollegaer
  • Du skal være tydelig og konstruktiv i din kommunikation, og vi forventer, at du bidrager positivt til et godt arbejdsmiljø, så teamet kan lykkes med kerneopgaven
Ansættelsesforhold
Løn- og ansættelsesvilkår følger overenskomst for danske tandplejere samt aftalen om lokal løndannelse. Stillingerne er med tiltrædelse snarest muligt. Vi har to faste stillinger. Det endelige timetal aftales ved samtalen.

I din ansøgning skal du give dit bud på, hvorfor du er den rette til at løse de arbejdsopgaver, som stillingen rummer. Husk at uploade CV og uddannelsesbevis og evt. dokumentation sammen med din ansøgning.

I forbindelse med ansættelsen indhenter vi straffe- og børneattest.

Yderligere oplysninger
Vil du vide mere om jobbet, så kan du kontakte ledende tandlæge Pernille Hess på 29 21 94 34.

Er du nysgerrig på at vide mere om Børne- og Ungdomstandplejen i København så besøg , hvor du kan læse mere om Tandplejens tilbud til byens børn og unge og vores interne organisering.

title: Kreativ marketingassistent til Nybolig Sønderborg
description:
Er du kreativ, skarp på sociale medier og god til at få idéer til at blive til godt indhold? Så er det måske dig, vi leder efter!

Hos Nybolig Sønderborg søger vi en kreativ og selvstændig marketingassistent, der kan hjælpe os med at gøre vores markedsføring endnu stærkere – særligt på de sociale medier.

Du får mulighed for at sætte dit eget præg på vores markedsføring og være med til at udvikle indhold, der både skaber synlighed, engagement og viser Nybolig Sønderborg fra sin bedste side. Du kommer til at arbejde tæt sammen med vores marketingansvarlige Freja, som er tilknyttet både Nybolig Kolding og Nybolig Sønderborg, og som vil være en af dine nærmeste sparringspartnere i hverdagen.

Nøglen til det næste

Hos Nybolig bliver du en del af en landsdækkende kæde med vind i sejlene og et godt samarbejde på tværs af afdelinger. Nøglen til vores succes er vores fællesskab og dygtige kolleger, der hver dag møder vores kunder lige der, hvor de er i livet, for at hjælpe dem med at realisere deres boligdrømme.

På vores kontor i Sønderborg bliver du en del af et engageret team, hvor der er plads til idéer, kreativitet og godt humør.

Skab indhold, der bliver set

Som marketingassistent bliver du en vigtig del af vores markedsføring og får en afvekslende hverdag, hvor du både arbejder selvstændigt og sammen med resten af teamet.

Du kommer blandt andet til at arbejde med:

  • Optagelse af video, billeder og andet content
  • Video- og billedredigering
  • Udarbejdelse og planlægning af indhold til sociale medier
  • Udarbejdelse af grafisk materiale og kreative markedsføringstiltag
  • Idéudvikling og medindflydelse på vores markedsføring
  • Bidrage til at styrke vores synlighed og profil på sociale medier
  • Skabe content fra boliger og andre aktiviteter i forretningen
Kreativitet og godt arbejdsmiljø? Vi har begge dele.

Vi lægger stor vægt på et godt arbejdsmiljø, hvor vi løfter i flok og hjælper hinanden. Du bliver en del af et engageret team med en uformel omgangstone, højt humør og plads til både faglighed, seriøsitet og gode idéer.

Vi tror på, at de bedste idéer opstår, når man tør tænke nyt. Derfor får du også mulighed for at komme med dine egne idéer og være med til at præge vores markedsføring.

Stillingen er på ca. 10-15 timer om ugen, og arbejdstiden kan aftales nærmere. Vi er fleksible i forhold til, hvordan timerne placeres, så det kan passe ind i din hverdag.

Kreativt talent med flair for sociale medier

Vi forestiller os, at du er kreativ, selvstændig og ikke er bange for at komme med idéer. Du har flair for det visuelle, følger med i trends på sociale medier og har lyst til at skabe indhold, der skiller sig ud.

Du behøver ikke nødvendigvis have mange års erfaring – det vigtigste er, at du har kreative evner, sans for det visuelle og lyst til at omsætte dine idéer til spændende indhold.

Derudover har du gerne:

  • flair for sociale medier og digital kommunikation
  • interesse for video, foto og grafisk design
  • erfaring med eller interesse for redigering af video og billeder
  • øje for detaljer og sans for det visuelle
  • lyst til at arbejde selvstændigt og tage ansvar for dine opgaver
  • mod på at tænke kreativt og komme med nye idéer
  • gode IT-kundskaber og evnen til hurtigt at sætte dig ind i nye programmer og systemer

Det er et krav, at du har bil, da en del af arbejdet vil foregå ude på forskellige lokationer.

Skal du være vores nye marketingassistent?

Lyder det som noget for dig? Så send din ansøgning og dit CV. Vi vil meget gerne se eksempler på videoer, grafisk materiale, SoMe-indhold eller andet kreativt, du tidligere har lavet. Opstart vil være hurtigst muligt.

Har du spørgsmål til stillingen, er du velkommen til at kontakte Louise Lehmann Kræmer på mail tk6@nybolig.dk eller telefon 4042 8709. Opstart vil være hurtigst muligt.

Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig!

Nybolig er en af landets største ejendomsmæglerkæder. Vi består af godt 220 ejendomsmæglerforretninger, der tilsammen udgør en landsdækkende kæde af specialister inden for formidling af privatboliger og landbrug. Nybolig er en del af Nykredit Mægler A/S, som er 100 % ejet af Nykredit.

title: Låsesmedslærling søges
description:
Låsesmedslærling søges – vil du lære et fag med både teknik, håndværk og ansvar?

Kan du lide at finde ud af, hvordan ting virker – og har du lyst til at lære et fag, hvor ingen dage er helt ens?

Hos 24/7 Låseservice i Skanderborg søger vi en låsesmedslærling.

Som låsesmed arbejder du i dag med meget mere end nøgler og traditionelle låse. Faget kombinerer mekanik, elektronik, IT, fejlfinding, håndværk og kundekontakt – og som lærling hos os får du mulighed for at lære det hele tæt på de rigtige opgaver.

Er du allerede faglært eller har du en relevant teknisk/håndværksmæssig baggrund?
Så se i stedet vores ledige stilling som sikringstekniker her →

Du kommer med ud fra starten

Hos os bliver din læretid ikke kun tilbragt på værkstedet.

Du kommer med Dan, som ejer 24/7 Låseservice og selv arbejder som låsesmed og sikringstekniker, ud til kunderne og oplever faget i praksis.

I starten følger du med, hjælper til og lærer. Efterhånden som du bliver dygtigere, får du mere ansvar og gradvist egne opgaver.

Du kommer blandt andet til at lære at arbejde med:

  • omkodning, stiftning og montering af låse og låsesystemer
  • skæring og kopiering af nøgler
  • adgangskontrol, alarm og videoovervågning
  • dørtelefoni, dørlukkere og dørautomatik
  • bilnøgler og programmering
  • fejlfinding på mekaniske og elektroniske løsninger
  • sikkerhedstjek og akutoplukninger.

Vi arbejder for både private og virksomheder og løser også opgaver for bl.a. politi, præhospital, hjemmepleje og fogeden i forbindelse med udsættelser.

Du får derfor mulighed for at opleve mange forskellige sider af låsesmedsfaget.

Du behøver ikke kunne faget – det skal vi lære dig

Vi forventer ikke, at du allerede ved, hvordan man stifter en lås, programmerer en bilnøgle eller fejlfinder på en dørautomatik.

Men vi forventer, at du har lyst til at lære det.

For os er en god lærling nysgerrig, følger med og spørger, når der er noget, der ikke giver mening. Du skal have lyst til at bruge både hænderne og hovedet og være interesseret i at forstå, hvorfor noget virker – eller ikke virker.

IT og digitale løsninger er også en naturlig del af faget, så du skal være fortrolig med IT og have mod på at lære nye systemer.

Du skal også kunne lide kundekontakten

Langt størstedelen af arbejdet foregår ude hos vores kunder. En almindelig dag kan derfor byde på flere forskellige kunder og vidt forskellige opgaver.

Som låsesmed kommer du ind i private hjem og virksomheder, og derfor lærer du hos os ikke kun den tekniske del af faget.

Du skal også lære at lytte til kunden, forstå behovet, opføre dig ordentligt i kundens hjem eller virksomhed og efterlade arbejdsstedet pænt.

Godt håndværk og en god kundeoplevelse hænger sammen.

Vi forventer, at du

  • har lyst til at lære et teknisk og håndværksmæssigt fag
  • er nysgerrig på, hvordan ting fungerer
  • kan lide at bruge både hænderne og hovedet
  • følger med, stiller spørgsmål og tager imod oplæring
  • er fortrolig med IT og digitale løsninger
  • møder til tiden og tager ansvar for din arbejdsdag
  • møder kunder og kolleger positivt og ordentligt
  • kan kommunikere ubesværet med kunder og kolleger på dansk, både mundtligt og skriftligt
  • kan fremvise ren straffeattest, da vi udfører opgaver for bl.a. politiet, som stiller krav om dette.

Kørekort B er en klar fordel og bliver nødvendigt, når du på sigt skal kunne køre selvstændigt ud til kunder.

Hvordan er det at være lærling hos os?

Vi er en lille virksomhed, og det betyder, at du bliver en del af den daglige drift og kommer tæt på både kunderne og faget.

Du får mulighed for at følge mange forskellige typer opgaver og lærer direkte sammen med en erfaren låsesmed. Efterhånden som du udvikler dig, får du også mere ansvar.

Til gengæld forventer vi, at du tager din læreplads seriøst, er interesseret i faget og gør en indsats for at blive dygtigere.

Praktisk om lærepladsen

Arbejdstiden ligger som udgangspunkt mandag–fredag omkring kl. 8–16.

Du får arbejdstøj og det nødvendige værktøj til arbejdet.

Løn og øvrige vilkår følger reglerne for din uddannelse og læreplads.

Har du lyst til at lære faget?

Så vil vi gerne høre hvorfor.

Du behøver ikke skrive en lang og formel standardansøgning. Send os dit CV og fortæl kort:

Hvorfor har du lyst til at blive låsesmed?
Hvad er det ved lærepladsen hos os, der har fanget din interesse?
Hvad interesserer dig mest ved teknik og håndværk?

Det vigtigste er ikke, at din ansøgning er perfekt formuleret. Vi vil langt hellere kunne mærke, at du har tænkt over dit valg af fag og oprigtigt har lyst til at lære det.

Har du spørgsmål til lærepladsen, er du velkommen til at ringe og tage en snak med os.

Vi afholder samtaler løbende og ansætter, når vi finder den rette lærling.
