title: Skolesekretær til Vestermarkskolen – bliv en vigtig del af vores skolefællesskab
description:
Har du styr på detaljerne, blik for helheden og lyst til at være en vigtig del af hverdagen på en skole med højt til loftet, godt humør og stærkt fællesskab? Så er det måske dig, vi leder efter.

Vestermarkskolen har ca. 300 elever og en engageret medarbejdergruppe. Vi lægger vægt på, at skolen skal være et godt sted at være – både for børn og voksne. Fællesskab, samarbejde og et godt arbejdsmiljø er derfor vigtigt for os. Vi tror på, at de bedste løsninger skabes, når vi hjælper hinanden og bringer forskellige fagligheder i spil. Det gælder også samarbejdet mellem administration, pædagogisk personale og ledelse. Vi har et stærkt kollegialt fællesskab og en aktiv personaleforening, som bidrager til det gode arbejdsliv – både fagligt og socialt.

Vestermarkskolen består også af Svendborg Heldagsskole. Til daglig skal du sidde på Vestermarkskolen. Skolernes sekretariat har aktuelt to sekretærer, som har deres primære arbejdssted på hver sin matrikel. Du vil blive en del af et samlet sekretariat med tæt samarbejde på tværs af matriklerne og med skolens ledelse og øvrige medarbejdere.

Som skolesekretær hos os får du en central rolle. Derfor leder vi efter dig, der både kan fordybe dig i de administrative opgaver og samtidig trives i en hverdag, hvor der er mange bolde i luften.

Dine primære arbejdsområder:

  • Afgangsprøver og karakterer
  • Administration af fællespostkasse
  • Koordinering og bestilling af transport
  • Ansvar for mærkedag, receptioner mm.
  • Superbruger i Aula
  • Administration i forbindelse med skolebestyrelsen
  • Vedligeholdelse af hjemmeside og Facebook
  • Referater, mødebooking og dokumenthåndtering
  • Praktisk og administrativ understøttelse af skolens ledelse
  • Øvrige administrative og praktiske opgaver i sekretariatet

Vi arbejder med fagprogrammer som f.eks. TRIO, TEA, ØS og Aula

Du vil som en del af stillingen være to'er på opgaver indenfor HR og økonomi. Det betyder du følger opgaverne og bliver oplært i arbejdsgange og processer, så du opnår et godt kendskab til områderne. Du vil ikke have det primære ansvar, men forventes at kunne understøtte og træde til ved behov. Opgaverne løses ikke alene. Du bliver en del af et sekretariat, hvor vi hjælper hinanden, sparrer på tværs og tager fælles ansvar for skolens administration.

Vi forventer desuden, at du:

  • Har relevant administrativ uddannelse og/eller erfaring
  • Har kendskab til enten økonomi eller HR
  • Arbejder sikkert og systematisk – også når der er travlt
  • Har flair for administrative og digitale systemer
  • Har forståelse for arbejdet med personfølsomme oplysninger og fortrolige sager
  • Kan prioritere mellem opgaver, når tingene går stærkt
  • Møder elever, forældre og kolleger med venlighed og respekt
  • Bidrager aktivt til et godt arbejdsmiljø

Vi forestiller os, at du er struktureret, kan arbejde selvstændigt og er administrativt stærk. Du kan skabe overblik over mange forskellige opgaver og deadlines, og du følger dine opgaver helt til dørs. Har du erfaring fra en skole eller en politiskstyret organisation, er det en fordel, men ikke et krav.

Vi tilbyder dig:

  • Et sekretariat med to dygtige kolleger, som du kan sparre og samarbejde med
  • Et tæt samarbejde med skolens ledelse
  • En arbejdsplads, hvor vi prioriterer trivsel og et godt arbejdsmiljø
  • En hverdag med stor variation og mulighed for selvstændigt ansvar
  • Et stærkt kollegialt fællesskab
  • En velfungerende personaleforening og sociale aktiviteter
  • En skole, hvor din indsats har synlig betydning for, at hverdagen fungerer

Stillingen er på 25 timer om ugen og tilstedeværelsen følger skolens ferieplan, dvs. at timerne fordeles på 42 uger. Der vil være mulighed for en ugentlig fridag.

Vil du høre mere om stillingen, kan du kontakte:

Skoleleder Nikolai Stougaard Skibdal
Telefon: 51 34 46 01

Skolesekretær Sina Ebsen
Telefon: 30 34 89 57

Ansøgningsfrist: 20. september 2026

Ansættelsessamtaler: 24. september 2026

Ansættelsesstart: 1. november 2026

Vi glæder os til at modtage din ansøgning – og forhåbentlig til at byde vores nye kollega velkommen på Vestermarkskolen.

I Svendborg Kommune ligger lønnen for denne type stilling typisk mellem 40.924 og 58.378 kr. pr. måned ved fuldtidsansættelse. Lønnen er inklusive pension, særlig feriegodtgørelse og faste tillæg. Der kan desuden være arbejdstidsbestemte tillæg og andre særydelser. Det er vigtigt at bemærke, at din konkrete løn fastsættes ud fra din erfaring, anciennitet og kompetencer og aftales ved forhandling med den relevante faglige organisation.

Svendborg Kommune har røgfri arbejdstid. Vi ønsker, at røgfri arbejdstid skal bidrage til et sundt arbejdsmiljø for alle medarbejdere.

Velkommen til Svendborg - Øhavets hovedstad!
Svendborg har en suveræn beliggenhed midt i den skønneste natur, på kanten af det Sydfynske Øhav og med en mini-metropol, der byder på det hele. Vi tøver ikke, når vi med stolthed kalder Svendborg for Fyns kulturhovedstad. Vi har en charmerende bymidte og livlig handelsby med teatre og museer samt et rigt foreningsliv. Vores dagtilbud og folkeskoler er i top og med særligt fokus på bevægelse og sport, og vi har flere videregående uddannelser, som snart samles i et attraktivt uddannelsesmiljø ved havnen. Svendborg er placeret midt i landet med en halv time til Odense og under to timer til København og Århus. Svendborg er med sine ca. 60.000 indbyggere Fyns andenstørste kommune.

title: Senior Risk & Trading Analyst, Sportsbook
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior Risk & Trading Analyst, Sportsbook based in Australia.

This is a high-impact opportunity to help shape risk, trading, and operational strategy for a rapidly growing sportsbook and casino platform. As a senior member of the function, you will take ownership of pre-match and live sportsbook exposure while protecting commercial performance and margin sustainability. You will analyze player behavior, betting activity, market movements, and casino performance to identify sharp play, arbitrage, fraud, and other risks. The role combines real-time decision-making with data-driven analysis and continuous optimization of risk controls. You will work closely with Trading, VIP, Product, Support, Fraud, and Payments teams in a fast-paced environment. This position is ideal for an experienced iGaming professional who thrives under pressure and is comfortable making high-conviction decisions in a 24/7 operation.

Accountabilities

  • Monitor live sportsbook and casino activity to identify and mitigate sharp play, arbitrage, exploits, bonus abuse, and other risk patterns.
  • Analyze player profitability, betting behavior, withdrawal velocity, and account activity to determine appropriate risk actions, including restrictions and market adjustments.
  • Review casino game outcomes against expected RTP and investigate technical anomalies, unusual volatility, and potential multi-accounting.
  • Monitor pre-match and in-play sportsbook exposure, liabilities, market movements, and overall platform risk.
  • Manage sportsbook risk settings, coordinate with feed providers, conduct bet reviews, and implement appropriate limit adjustments.
  • Partner with Fraud and Payments teams to investigate high-risk withdrawals and suspicious payment activity.
  • Develop data-driven risk reports and improve automated alerts, risk rules, monitoring frameworks, and operational processes.
  • Collaborate with Trading, VIP, Product, and Support teams to resolve risk issues and escalate critical incidents appropriately.
  • Contribute to long-term risk strategy while balancing financial protection, operational efficiency, and a strong customer experience.

    • Requirements

    • 6+ years of professional experience in Risk, Trading, Fraud, or a closely related function within iGaming or Sports Betting.
    • Deep understanding of sportsbook trading concepts, including odds, liabilities, exposure, market movements, and risk management.
    • Strong knowledge of casino mechanics, including RTP, volatility, game outcomes, and player behavior.
    • Demonstrated ability to use Excel, SQL, BI tools, or similar data-analysis technologies to identify anomalies, pricing inefficiencies, and sharp betting activity.
    • Experience making rapid commercial and risk decisions within high-volume, live operational environments.
    • Ability and willingness to work shifts within a 24/7 sportsbook and casino operation.
    • Strong analytical and investigative skills, with excellent attention to detail and sound commercial judgment.
    • Calm, decisive, and composed approach when managing escalations and high-pressure situations.
    • Excellent communication skills and the ability to clearly explain risk findings, decisions, and recommended actions to cross-functional stakeholders.
    • Strong sense of ownership, accountability, and ability to operate independently in a high-growth environment.

      • Benefits

      • Full-time opportunity within a high-growth sportsbook and casino environment.
      • Remote working arrangement with the role based in Australia.
      • Opportunity to become a founding member of the Risk, Trading, and Operations function for a new platform.
      • High level of ownership and direct influence over risk strategy, trading operations, and commercial performance.
      • Exposure to complex real-time sportsbook, casino, fraud, payments, and player-risk operations.
      • Collaboration with multidisciplinary teams across Trading, Product, VIP, Support, Fraud, and Payments.
      • Opportunity to work in a fast-paced, data-driven environment where decisions can directly influence business outcomes.
      • Professional growth opportunities within an expanding technology and iGaming operation.

title: Vil du være social- og sundhedshjælperelev i Holbæk Kommune?
description:
Vi søger motiverede social- og sundhedshjælperelever til uddannelsesstart 18. januar 2027 på hovedforløbet.

Uddannelsen varer 14 måneder og varierer mellem skole på ZBC Holbæk og praktik i Holbæk Kommune. Vi sørger for en praktikplads til dig på både plejecenter og i hjemmeplejen. Da vi cykler rundt til borgerne i hjemmeplejen, er det et krav, at du kan cykle. Du får en spændende uddannelse, hvor du bl.a. lærer at hjælpe borgeren med personlig pleje og praktisk hjælp til fx at varme mad, rengøring mv., men også at igangsætte aktiviteter med borgerne og styrke deres livskvalitet.

Vi har et godt lærings- og uddannelsesmiljø, hvor du har både en daglig vejleder og en ansvarlig vejleder, som er med til at støtte og vejlede dig under uddannelsen, da din trivsel og faglige udvikling er vigtig for os. Vi sørger for en grundig introduktion til arbejdsopgaverne på dit praktiksted samt til din uddannelse, hvor vi bl.a. afholder introduktionsdage for nye elever, så du får en god og tryg start.

Du mødes til elevcafeer med de andre elever, hvor I har mulighed for at sparre med hinanden og hvor vi også har undervisning i faglige emner.

Der er gode jobmuligheder inden for ældreområdet efter endt uddannelse.

Er du nysgerrig i at vide mere om uddannelsen, kan du læse yderligere her:

Du er

  • I gang med Grundforløb 2 – eller har allerede gennemført Grundforløb 2
  • Mødestabil og kan tage ansvar for din uddannelse
  • Interesseret i at arbejde med ældre mennesker

Ansøgning

  • Upload motiveret ansøgning hvor du begrunder dit valg af uddannelse og hvorfor du gerne vil være social- og sundhedshjælper

  • Vedlæg den RKV du har fået lavet på skolen
  • Vedlæg dokumentation for afsluttet eller igangværende grundforløb 2 rettet mod SOSU-uddannelserne

Løn og ansættelsesforhold

  • Du vil modtage løn under hele din uddannelse, både i skole- og praktikperioder
  • Lønnen er efter gældende overenskomst med FOA
  • Er du fyldt 25 år, vil du modtage voksenelevløn
  • Du må forvente at have weekendvagt hver 3. - 4. weekend
  • Praktikstederne er geografisk placeret i hele Holbæk Kommune

Ansøgningsfrist: 27. september 2026.

Ansættelsessamtaler: Samtaler afholdes løbende.

Har du spørgsmål, er du velkommen til at skrive en mail til uddannelseskonsulenterne på praktik@holb.dk

Alle kvalificerede ansøgere opfordres til at søge stillingen uanset køn, alder, handicap, etnicitet, politiske og religiøse overbevisninger eller seksuel orientering.

Vi er 4.800 passionerede kollegaer, der hver dag servicerer Holbæk Kommunes ca. 75.000 borgere.

Vi samarbejder og bruger vores fagligheder til at skabe vigtige løsninger og yde god service for borgerne i kommunen. Vi vægter arbejdsmiljøet højt og ønsker at udvikle vores medarbejdere fagligt og personligt. Der er derfor gode muligheder for at få nye udfordringer i jobbet.

Læs mere om, hvordan det er at arbejde i Holbæk Kommune.

title: Jobcenter Frederiksberg - Center for sygedagpenge søger fagligt stærk og kompetent medarbejder til sygedagpenge og jobafklaring
description:
Vil du være med til at opretholde og styrke det faglige niveau i et af landets mest ambitiøse jobcentre?

Da en af vores kolleger har søgt nye udfordringer, søger vi dig der brænder for sygedagpengeområdet.

I Jobcenter Frederiksberg arbejder vi målrettet med ”Job i fokus” i forhold til alle vores målgrupper. Derfor har vi fokus på arbejdsmarkedets behov for arbejdskraft i centrum og sigter mod den korteste vej til arbejde og uddannelse. Vi ønsker at støtte den enkelte borger til en plads på arbejdsmarkedet der, hvor chancerne for selvforsørgelse er størst.

Vi har desuden fokus på ”Borgerperspektivet” som har til formål, at styrke kvaliteten yderligere i vores dialog og samarbejde med borgerne. Vi har derfor borgeren fra start til slut, hvad enten borgeren vender hurtigt tilbage til arbejdsmarkedet, eller har et længere fravær, hvor borger enten får forlænget sygedagpengene, eller overgår til et jobafklaringsforløb.

Center for sygedagpenge er et center med 22 medarbejdere fordelt på myndighedsområdet og indsats, i form af fastholdelseskonsulenter. Vi har desuden tilknyttet lægekonsulent og specialpsykolog.

I Center for sygedagpenge arbejder vi tæt sammen, sparrer med hinanden, også på tværs af teams – trivsel og faglighed vægtes højt!

Vi søger netop dig der har kendskab til sygedagpengeområdet og den nye reform, ved hvad der skal til for at understøtte borgerens vej mod raskmelding og har gode samarbejdsevner.

Vi tilbyder

  • Ansættelse i en attraktiv organisation, hvor borgeren er i centrum og fagligheden høj
  • Engagerede kollegaer, der har fokus på løbende at udvikle indsatsen i forhold til at opnå bedst mulige resultater, hvor det at lære fra hinanden er højt prioriteret
  • Selvstændigt job med stort ansvar og mulighed for faglig sparring med sundhedskonsulenter og lægekonsulent samt deltagelse på tværfaglige konferencer
  • Regelmæssig supervision med fokus på udfordringer forbundet med at arbejde tæt med sygemeldte borgere
  • Mulighed for deltagelse i projekter på tværs af forvaltningen
  • Fleksible rammer og mulighed for hjemmearbejde
  • Mulighed for faglig udvikling
  • Individuel tilrettelagt opstartsplan med tæt oplæring og opfølgning

Jobindhold

  • Opfølgning og samtaler med fokus på et aktivt, arbejdsmarkedsrettet forløb.
  • Administrativt arbejde som fx; vurdering af uarbejdsdygtighed, udarbejdelse af indsatsplaner, indhentning af akter fra relevante aktører.
  • Etablering af beskæftigelsesrettede indsatser og opfølgning på disse
  • Inddragelse af og samarbejde med relevante samarbejdspartnere i og udenfor organisationen, såsom fastholdelseskonsulenter, beskæftigelsesenheden F86, sundhedssektoren, misbrugscentre, uddannelsesinstitutioner mm
  • Forberede sager til Fleks og FØP visitationen (tidligere rehabiliteringsteam)

Det er vigtigt for os, at du

  • Har praksiserfaring med myndighedsrollen og erfaring med målgrupperne samt kendskab til de lovgivningsmæssige rammer på beskæftigelsesindsatsområdet herunder den nye reform
  • Er i stand til at skabe motivation for forandring for borgerne, med udgangspunkt i borgerens eget perspektiv
  • Kan koordinere og samarbejde med borgeren omkring det samlede forløb med klart udviklingsfokus i forhold til borgerens vej tilbage til arbejdsmarkedet
  • Kommunikerer tydeligt både i skrift og tale
  • Har en struktureret og systematisk tilgang til det administrative arbejde
  • Har mod på og lyst til at indgå i en travl hverdag, hvor indsatsen over for borgerne og dermed også din opgaveportefølje udvikles løbende, mens vi løser kerneopgaven

Løn og ansættelsesforhold

Ansættelse pr. den 1. december 2026.

Stillingerne er på 37 timer ugentlig med flekstidsordning. Løn- og ansættelsesvilkår sker efter gældende overenskomst og forhandling med den forhandlingsberettigede organisation.

Er du interesseret i yderligere oplysninger om stillingen, er du velkommen til at kontakte Centerleder Anne-Marie Bennetzen på anbe18@frederiksberg.dk telefon 2898 5780 eller teamleder Michael Broe-Christiansen på mibr20@frederiksberg.dk telefon 2898 2117

Du kan læse mere om Frederiksberg kommune som en attraktiv arbejdsplads her.

Der er ansøgningsfrist onsdag den 30. september 2026 kl. 12.00

Jobsamtaler forventes afholdt i løbet af uge 42 og eventuel 2. runde i uge 43

Frederiksberg er en levende by med et dynamisk bysamfund. Byens sjæl bygger på vores historie og klassiske arv og er med til at præge den spændende udvikling af Frederiksberg som en grøn, sund og pulserende del af Hovedstaden.
Vi er en moderne kommune, der betjener 104.305 borgere. Frederiksberg Kommune ønsker at fremme ligestillingen og opfordrer derfor alle kvalificerede til at søge uanset alder, handicap, race, hudfarve, religion eller tro, politisk anskuelse, seksuel orientering, kønsidentitet, kønsudtryk eller kønskarakteristika eller national, social eller etnisk oprindelse.

Welocalize, a Welo Global brand, serves localization teams through AI-enabled multilingual content solutions that enable enterprises to operate and scale globally. Welocalize combines AI, automation, and human expertise to support enterprises in more than 300 languages, enabling accurate, culturally aligned, and compliant multilingual content at scale.

This includes checking grammar, spelling, punctuation, consistency, formatting, and cultural or contextual accuracy.
You’ll also work hands-on with products by executing test cases, identifying localization bugs, and reporting issues through internal bug-tracking systems. Once fixes are implemented, you’ll help verify that they’ve been resolved correctly. From time to time, you’ll also have the opportunity to translate content from English into Lithuanian. - Native language skills and cultural awareness of Lithuanian and Lithuania.
- Good oral and written communication.
- Highly organized with attention to detail and a commitment to quality.
- QA various products by accurately following testing instructions and test cases.
- Discover and report defects (bugs) using client-specific bug-tracking tools.
- Evaluate translations in the context of software, mobile apps, and documentation.

- Troubleshoot basic problems; be able to communicate effectively and escalate testing issues.
- Complete assigned tasks in a quality and timely manner.

I Sundhedsplejen i Odense Kommune arbejder vi hver dag for at skabe de bedste betingelser for børn og familiers trivsel. Vi søger engagerede sundhedsplejersker, der ønsker at gøre en forskel i tæt samarbejde med familier, kolleger og tværfaglige samarbejdspartnere.

Hos os bliver du en del af et stærkt fagligt fællesskab, hvor høj kvalitet, tværfagligt samarbejde og nærværende kollegaskab er fundamentet for løsningen af kerneopgaven.

Vi søger kolleger, som sammen med os vil levere sundhedsfremmende og forebyggende indsatser af høj kvalitet til gravide, børn, unge og familier i Odense Kommune.



Stillingerne er kombinationsstillinger med en ugentlig arbejdstid på 37 timer.

Vi ønsker stillingerne besat pr. 1. december 2026.



Bliv en del af et stærkt tværfagligt fællesskab

Sundhedsplejen er forankret i Børn- og Ungeforvaltningen under Tværfaglig Sundhed og Forebyggelse/småbørn, børn og forældre. Derfor skal du vælge Sundhedsplejen i Odense

I sundhedsplejen arbejder teamorganiseret fordelt i 9 teams på tværs af byen. Vi vægter faglighed, det stærke teamsamarbejde og en fair fordeling af opgaver og mødes ugentligt til fordeling af fødsler og øvrige opgaver.

Du varetager selvstændigt sundhedspleje til gravide, småbørnsfamilier og skolebørn samt fungerer som konsulent for dagtilbud og skoler.

I sundhedsplejen er vi en del af forskellige gruppetilbud både mono- og tværfagligt. Læs mere om Sundhedsplejens tilbud på Sundhedsplejen i Odense Kommune.

Fra foråret 2026 anvender vi AIMS i sundhedsplejen og alle sundhedsplejersker er certificerede i og arbejder med ADBB og "Forstå din baby". Derudover deltager alle i løbende supervision, både med kolleger, supervisor og certificerede ADBB-supervisorer.

title: Senior Staff Product Manager, Browser Control Platform
description:
Why Mozilla?

Mozilla Corporation is the non-profit-backed technology company that has shaped the internet for the better over the last 25 years. We make pioneering brands like Firefox, the privacy-minded web browser. Now, with more than 225 million people around the world using our products each month, we’re shaping the next 25 years of technology and helping to reclaim an internet built for people, not companies. Our work focuses on diverse areas including AI, social media, security and more. And we’re doing this while never losing our focus on our core mission – to make the internet better for people.

The Mozilla Corporation is wholly owned by the non-profit 501(c) Mozilla Foundation. This means we aren’t beholden to any shareholders — only to our mission. Along with thousands of volunteer contributors and collaborators all over the world, Mozillians design, build and distribute open-source software that enables people to enjoy the internet on their terms.

About this team and role:

This role owns the foundation that lets other software drive Firefox: the secure, reliable connection an outside tool or another team uses to act inside the browser, and the building blocks they call to do it. It enables the teams building on it — internal teams, outside AI tools — to create their own products on top. This role owns the shared layer and the strategy for it. It’s a hands-on, technical role in a fast-moving, greenfield space, so it’s as much strategy as execution.

The opportunity is broad: internal teams (Smart Window, New Products’ automated tools), outside AI tools and their users, and web developers. The three share much of the underlying technology, but each reaches its market in a different way. The mandate is to figure out what to go after, and in what order.

What you’ll do:
  • Own the shared foundation and the building blocks it gives other software, and make them reliable and secure.
  • Push the open standard (WebDriver BiDi) forward, and build Firefox-only advantages the standard won’t cover
  • Design the safety controls: let a person approve actions, see when software is acting for them, and take back control.
  • Define the strategy for any major third-party AI assistants people already use.
  • Serve internal teams (Smart Window, New Products) and outside tools through one shared layer.
Measured on:

Adoption across teams and tools, volume of usage through the platform, and sustained reliability and security.

What you'll bring:
  • A product-minded engineer, or a very technical PM who can drive a technical product
  • Developer-space experience, with the range to think about consumers and internal platforms
  • Comfortable setting strategy in ambiguity; own a technical contract other teams depend on
  • Strong instincts on security and trust. Nice to have: web standards, MCP, browser automation

What you’ll get:

  • Generous performance-based bonus plans to all eligible employees - we share in our success as one team
  • Rich medical, dental, and vision coverage
  • Generous retirement contributions with 100% immediate vesting (regardless of whether you contribute)
  • Quarterly all-company wellness days where everyone takes a pause together
  • Country specific holidays plus a day off for your birthday
  • One-time home office stipend
  • Annual professional development budget
  • Quarterly well-being stipend
  • Considerable paid parental leave
  • Employee referral bonus program
  • Other benefits (life/AD&D, disability, EAP, etc. - varies by country)

About Mozilla

Mozilla exists to build the Internet as a public resource accessible to all because we believe that open and free is better than closed and controlled. When you work at Mozilla, you give yourself a chance to make a difference in the lives of Web users everywhere. And you give us a chance to make a difference in your life every single day. Join us to work on the Web as the platform and help create more opportunity and innovation for everyone online.

Commitment to diversity, equity, inclusion, and belonging

Mozilla understands that valuing diverse creative practices and forms of knowledge are crucial to and enrich the company’s core mission. We encourage applications from everyone, including members of all equity-seeking communities, such as (but certainly not limited to) women, racialized and Indigenous persons, persons with disabilities, persons of all sexual orientations, gender identities, and expressions.

We will ensure that qualified individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodations to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment, as appropriate. Please contact us at hiringaccommodation@mozilla.com to request accommodation.

We are an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race (including hairstyle and texture), religion (including religious grooming and dress practices), gender, gender identity, gender expression, color, national origin, pregnancy, ancestry, domestic partner status, disability, sexual orientation, age, genetic predisposition, medical condition, marital status, citizenship status, military or veteran status, or any other basis covered by applicable laws. Mozilla will not tolerate discrimination or harassment based on any of these characteristics or any other unlawful behavior, conduct, or purpose.

title: Pre-Award: MXM- Radio Frequency Engineer III
description:
Barbaricum is a rapidly growing government contractor providing leading-edge support to federal customers, with a particular focus on Defense and National Security mission sets. We leverage more than 17 years of support to stakeholders across the federal government, with established and growing capabilities across Intelligence, Analytics, Engineering, Mission Support, and Communications disciplines. Founded in 2008, our mission is to transform the way our customers approach constantly changing and complex problem sets by bringing to bear the latest in technology and the highest caliber of talent.

Headquartered in Washington, DC's historic Dupont Circle neighborhood, Barbaricum also has a corporate presence in Tampa, FL, Bedford, IN, and Dayton, OH, with team members across the United States and around the world. As a leader in our space, we partner with firms in the private sector, academic institutions, and industry associations with a goal of continually building our expertise and capabilities for the benefit of our employees and the customers we support. Through all of this, we have built a vibrant corporate culture diverse in expertise and perspectives with a focus on collaboration and innovation. Our teams are at the frontier of the Nation's most complex and rewarding challenges. Join our team.

Barbaricum is seeking an Radio Frequency Engineer III to directly support the anticipated Naval Surface Warfare Center (NSWC) Crane Division, Model Based Engineering Assessment Division (Code MXM). Code MXM's mission is mission engineering analysis and assessment of complex Naval, DoD, and joint kill chains — with a specialized focus on Electromagnetic Spectrum Operations (EMSO) enabled analysis. As a Radio Frequency Engineer III, you will apply radio frequency engineering expertise in support of Code MXM's EMSO modeling, simulation, and electromagnetic analysis. You will contribute RF domain depth to the team's characterization and assessment of EW systems and their operational environments.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Apply radio frequency engineering across EMSO modeling, simulation, and analysis tasking.
  • Support characterization of RF propagation and analysis of EW systems and operational environments.
  • Contribute RF communications systems engineering and integration expertise as tasked.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Active DoD SECRET clearance (minimum); U.S. citizenship required.
  • Master's degree in a quantitative field such as engineering or mathematics (e.g., Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, Information Technology, or Information Systems).
  • 10 years of professional experience with radio frequency engineering.

title: Specialarbejder til Logistiksektionen ved Hærhjemmeværnsdistrikt Sydøstjylland
description:
Har du lyst til at arbejde med forvaltning på det logistiske område, støtte ansatte, frivillige og reserve personel i rammen af det nationale beredskab – herunder både understøttelse af skarpe indsættelser og uddannelse? Er du en person med overblik, ordenssans samt stærk til at planlægge, kommunikere og udføre opgaver i praksis i et fleksibelt, dynamisk og udfordrende miljø? Så er denne stilling måske noget for dig.

Om os

Hærhjemmeværnsdistrikt Sydøstjylland, er en del af Landsdelsregion Vest og har domicil i Vejle, blot 150 meter fra motorvejsafkørsel nr. 60. Her vil du indgå i et team, bestående af 16 fastansatte medarbejdere (9 militære og 7 civile), samt ca. 850 frivillige hjemmeværnssoldater og personel af reserven.

Overordnet har vi ansvaret for uddannelsesniveauet, den operative parathed, samt indsættelsen af ni Hjemmeværnskompagnier, fordelt på Vejle, Kolding, Billund, Skanderborg, Horsens, Hedensted og Fredericia kommune, svarende til Sydøstjyllands politikreds. Derudover skal Hærhjemmeværnsdistrikt Sydøstjylland opstille kadren, svarende til to kompagnier under Totalforsvarsstyrken, med alt hvad dette indebærer.

Ud over den ultimative opgave for Hjemmeværnet, deltager vi med alt personel i forsvaret af Kongeriget – yder vi i det daglige også støtte til samfundet og Forsvaret. Vi har derfor tætte samarbejdsrelationer til politiet, det øvrige forsvar og civile myndigheder.

Vores arbejde i en frivillig organisation, bestående af engagerede hjemmeværnssoldater, er forbundet med en del aften og weekendarbejde. Men som udgangspunkt har vi en 37-timers arbejdsuge, hvor optjent merarbejde som udgangspunkt søges afspadseret, så den tid du har været væk, gives igen til dig og familien.

Vores arbejdsplads er præget af en respektfuld og munter tone samt en god stemning. Vores målsætning er den, at vores medarbejdere skal være glade for at gå på arbejde, men vi har samtidig plads til, at man kan have en dårlig dag, og have behov for støtte. Men vi har også fokus på udvikling af medarbejdernes kompetencer, da personlig udvikling er en vigtig del i forhold til fastholdelse.

Om stillingen

Vi består, ud over en chef og næstkommanderende, af én materielforvalter, en materielassistent, én distriktsserviceteknikker og én specialarbejder.

Du kommer til at bestride funktionen som specialarbejder med primære opgaver knyttet til vores store vognpark.

Du vil som specialarbejder være medansvarlig for den daglige drift af distriktets køretøjer og dermed være omdrejningspunkt for at vores køretøjer er i god operativ stand. Du vil gennem dit virke have daglig sparring med distriktets frivillige, samt eksterne samarbejdspartnere som f.eks. Vedligeholdelsestjenesten.

Afhængig af kompetencer, vil du ligeledes kunne hjælpe andre sektioner med f.eks. uddannelse af frivillige. Jobbet er således varierende, alsidigt og indeholder en interessant hverdag, hvor du selv har indflydelse på opgaveløsningen, samt udleder og identificerer de afgørende forhold og faktorer for opgaveløsningen.

Dine primære opgaver vil bestå af følgende

  • Vartning af Hærhjemmeværnsdistrikt Sydøstjylland køretøjspark, herunder fejlmelding, booking af værksted og syn.
  • Vartning af vores bookingportal på HJV.DK hvor køretøjerne kan bookes af vores frivillige medlemmer.
  • Tastning af kilometerregnskab i SAP, samt ansvarlig for monitorering af vores køretøjs kontaktpunktspostkasse (KTP).
  • Deltage i daglige opgaveløsninger på tværs af medarbejdere i logistiksektionen
  • Arrangere eftersyn og kontrol af alt distriktets løftegrej i samarbejde med Forsvarets vedligeholdelsestjeneste.
  • Planlægge køretøjers fordeling ved større øvelser.
  • Sparring med frivillige garagemestre og kontrol af køretøjer som måtte stå ved vores enheder udenfor Vejle.
  • Transportopgaver, som afhentning af materiel ved kaserner o.lign.
Andre opgaver:

  • Deltage i logistiske møder med Forsvarets vedligeholdelsestjeneste og andre Distrikters GARM-personel.
  • Deltage, ved behov, i Hærhjemmeværnsdistrikt Sydøstjylland mønstringer af vores kompagnier.
  • Deltage i distriktets øvelsesvirksomhed som specialarbejder.
  • Ved anmodning støtte distriktets andre sektioner som stabshjælper.
  • Sparring med- og uddannelse af frivillige soldater afhængig af kompetencer.
Dine arbejdsopgaver løses primært fra Vejle, men der vil være mulighed for hjemmearbejde, skulle behovet opstå.

Der må forudses nogen rejseaktivitet i forbindelse med kurser, seminarer og møder. Der vil forekomme aften- og weekendarbejde efter gældende overenskomst, men der vil til gengæld ikke være uge lange øvelser.

Om dig

Du har en logistisk eller køretøjmæssig faguddannelse – dette er ikke et krav, men ønskeligt.

Du evner at kunne fremstå som en rollemodel der inspirerer og motiverer vores frivillige gennem dit personlige eksempel.

Du møder andre i øjenhøjde og behandler dem høfligt og med gensidig respekt, med formål at udvikle god mandskabsbehandling og herigennem bidrage til disciplin, korpsånd og samarbejde.

Samtidigt tager du ansvar for, og bidrager aktivt til, andres udvikling.

Du er i besiddelse af et godt humør, så også du bidrager til det gode arbejdsmiljø.

Du er god til at kommunikere i skrift og tale, og kan arbejde selvstændigt, da du bliver ansvarlig for din egne sagsområder.

Du formår at skabe gode samarbejdsrelationer på tværs af vores organisation.

Du er en fleksibel holdspiller og samtidigt kan du arbejde selvstændigt med frihed under ansvar. Du tager initiativ og er ikke bange for nye og omskiftelige opgaver. Du er i stand til at balancere nødvendige hensyn til de frivilliges funktionsvilkår med det bestemmelsesgrundlag, som Hjemmeværnet er underlagt.

Opfyldelse af krav og forventninger til alle fokuskompetencerne er ønskelige for at løse opgaven. Særligt fleksibilitet, styring og samarbejde. Endvidere vil kompetencerne planlægning, helhedsorientering og initiativ også være i fokus for dit virke.

Det er en fordel du har kendskab til brugen af Office-pakken, DeMars, er kørerassisstent eller køreinstruktør, samt at du har kørekort til kategori B og C.

Afhængigt af dine forudgående kvalifikationer, må du påregne kursus- og uddannelsesvirksomhed.

Ansættelsesvilkår

Ansættelsen sker i henhold til den til enhver tid gældende Fællesoverenskomst mellem Finansministeriet og Offentligt Ansattes Organisationer – Det Statslige Område (OAO-S-fællesoverenskomsten) og Organisationsaftale for rengøringsassistenter, sanitører, specialarbejdere og visse erhvervsuddannede m.fl. i staten mv. (3F).

Afhængigt af dine kvalifikationer og kompetencer, er der mulighed for forhandling af tillæg. Der er til stillingen knyttet en arbejdsgiverfinansieret pensionsordning.

Basislønnen som faglært er 28.911,92 kr. pr. måned. Som ufaglært, sker ansættelsen som specialarbejder med en basisløn på 26.228,00 kr. pr. måned.

Arbejdsstedet er i Vejle.

Som ansat under Forsvarsministeriets område er du omfattet af nogle særlige vilkår. Du skal bl.a. kunne sikkerhedsgodkendes og opretholde sikkerhedsgodkendelsen under hele ansættelsesforholdet.

Du har som ansat pligt til at forrette tjeneste uden for landets grænser, herunder ved enheder i internationale operationer med henblik på deltagelse i konfliktforebyggende, fredsbevarende, fredsskabende, humanitære og andre lignende operationer.

Kontakt og ansøgning

Hvis du vil høre mere om stillingen, er du velkommen til at kontakte chefen for S4 ved HDSEJ KN Thomas Frisk på telefon 4174 6858, eller via mail: HDSEJ-S4-01@fiin.dk

Har du spørgsmål til løn- og ansættelsesvilkår er du velkommen til at kontakte Personelkommandoen, HR-konsulent Mia A. F. Rostermund på telefon 3266 5971.

Ansøgningsfristen er den 18. september 2026 og samtaler forventes afholdt i forlængelse heraf. Stillingen er til besættelse den 2. november 2026.

Du søger stillingen via linket, og vi beder dig vedhæfte ansøgning, CV og kopi af uddannelsesbevis/svendebrev. Vær opmærksom på, at bilag skal tilføjes i PDF-format.

I Forsvarsministeriets organisation tror vi på, at mangfoldighed optimerer opgaveløsningen. Derfor opfordrer vi alle interesserede uanset baggrund til at søge stillingen.

Om Landsdelsregion Vest

Landsdelsregion Vest er en selvstændig niveau III myndighed under Hjemmeværnskommandoen med domicil på Skive kaserne. Landsdelsregionen har seks hærhjemmeværnsdistrikter underlagt og er operativt underlagt Hærkommandoen. Vi har fokus på nationale operationer, og vores geografiske ansvarsområde dækker hele Jylland og Fyn. Regionens primære opgave er at indsætte landmilitære kapaciteter i regionens ansvarsområde til militære opgaver eller til støtte for politiet eller andre civile myndigheder. Regionen indgår som en af komponenterne i de lokale beredskabsstabe inden for samfundets samlede beredskab. Regionen har et tæt samarbejde med Hjemmeværnskommandoen, Forsvarskommandoen, Hærkommandoen, Politiet og andre civile myndigheder. Herudover deltager regionen med enheder i øvelsesaktiviteter ved hærens brigader og bataljoner.

title: Industrial Engineer
description:
🚀 Optimize How We Build, Pack, and Ship at Scale

📍 Role: Industrial Engineer
📍 Company: Coastal Trading Ventures (CTV)
📍 Location: Fort Worth, TX (Warehouse, Onsite)

You might currently be a Senior Process Engineer, Process Engineer (Supply Chain), Continuous Improvement Engineer, Industrial Engineer, Lean/Six Sigma Engineer, or Program Manager (Industrial Engineering). If you've built labor standards from scratch, run time-and-motion studies on a live warehouse floor, and turned line-balancing or slotting redesigns into measurable cost-per-unit savings, you'll recognize this role.

Coastal Trading Ventures (CTV) is a high-growth eCommerce fulfillment operation powered by smart systems and a team that takes operational excellence seriously. We're investing in the infrastructure, technology, and people that will define how we scale and this role is an important part of that work.

This is a greenfield seat. We're building our own WMS in-house, and you'd be the first industrial engineer on the ground shaping it, not adapting your process to someone else's off-the-shelf software, but defining how physical labor flow and system logic fit together from scratch across an 8,000+ SKU environment.

We're not just moving products, we're building the infrastructure behind one of the fastest-growing Amazon operations in the country. We're looking for an Industrial Engineer to own the efficiency of our warehouse operations: eliminating waste, setting labor standards, and redesigning workflows across an 8,000+ SKU fulfillment environment.

If you want to see your work translate directly into P&L impact - fewer wasted steps, lower cost-per-unit, faster throughput, we'd love to meet you.

🎯 What You'll Be Doing

  • Serve as the first industrial engineer on the ground for our in-house WMS build, shaping system logic around real physical workflows rather than retrofitting process to an existing platform
  • Identify and eliminate non-value-added activities across all warehouse zones
  • Conduct floor-level time-and-motion studies to establish baseline labor standards and standardized work procedures
  • Analyze high-volume kitting and assembly workflows to break through labor bottlenecks in manual packaging (shrink-wrapping, boxing, bundling)
  • Optimize line-balancing, ergonomics, and component presentation to minimize operator reach, wait, and walk time across 8,000+ SKUs
  • Redesign pack stations, slotting logic, and pick paths to reduce travel time and eliminate unnecessary forklift and pedestrian movement
  • Map physical labor flow against our in-development WMS to identify gaps where software limitations force manual workarounds, and feed those findings directly into the build
  • Build poka-yoke (error-proofing) guardrails to ensure inventory flows without manual intervention or rework
  • Partner with Operations leadership to measure and report cost-savings metrics, translating physical efficiency gains into lower operational labor cost-per-unit

✅ What You Bring

  • Bachelor's degree in Industrial Engineering or related engineering discipline
  • Lean Six Sigma certification (Green Belt minimum; Black Belt or Master Black Belt preferred)
  • 5+ years of experience in process optimization and continuous improvement
  • Proven hands-on experience in e-commerce fulfillment, 3PL, or high-volume manual assembly environments (kitting, bundling, packaging)
  • Comfortable operating without an established playbook - this site is building its own WMS, so you'll be defining process alongside the system rather than working within a mature, pre-built one
  • Highly analytical with the ability to translate raw data into actionable strategies
  • Strong root cause analysis skills and a track record of resolving bottlenecks through structural and layout improvements
  • Comfortable on the warehouse floor. This is not a desk-only role

📈 Growth & Career Opportunities at Luminize/Coastal Trading Ventures

At Luminize, growth isn't just something we drive for our clients - it's our mindset and a big priority for our people.

We offer clear career paths and leveling guidelines so you always know where you stand, what's next, and what skills and experience you need to get there. From day one, you'll have visibility into advancement opportunities and what it takes to grow into leadership, specialization, or cross-functional roles.

We're proud of our strong track record of promoting from within. Many of our team leads and managers started in individual contributor roles and grew by consistently showing initiative, curiosity, and impact.

About Luminize / Coastal Trading Ventures
Luminize and Coastal Trading Ventures (CTV) operate as two halves of the same business. Luminize is the front-end Amazon growth partner, headquartered in San Diego, CA, driving strategy, advertising, and brand management. Coastal Trading Ventures is the back-end physical engine, based in Fort Worth, TX, running the warehousing, receiving, inventory management, product prep, and fulfillment that bring every Luminize-managed brand to the customer. The two share leadership, systems, and people. A role posted under either name is part of one connected operation.

If you're ready to work with great people, do work that matters, and keep growing, we'd love to meet you!

👉 Apply now and let's grow together!

title: Staff Guidance, Navigation & Control (GNC) Engineer - Rotorcraft/VTOL
description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

The Maneuver Dominance team, along with the Flight Engineering Team at Anduril develops operationally relevant, multi-asset autonomy. We are focused on making large groups of autonomous systems work effectively together. We leverage existing Anduril platforms like Ghost or Altius, in addition to bringing 3rd party platforms into Anduril’s Lattice ecosystem.

We are currently looking for highly skilled GNC Engineers with expertise in autonomous safety-critical systems. The successful candidate will play a pivotal role in developing, testing, and implementing GNC systems and architectures for air vehicle platforms developed by Anduril or a 3rd party.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

  • Develop, implement, and test algorithms for guidance, navigation, and control systems in line with project requirements.
  • Design, implement, and assess the GNC architectures considering all elements, including vehicle, sensors, actuators, and algorithms.
  • Participate in all phases of system development, from concept to design, prototyping, testing, and operation.
  • Collaborate closely with a multidisciplinary team including systems engineers, flight software engineers, mission autonomy engineers, and test engineers to ensure system-wide integration and performance.
  • Contribute to design reviews, safety assessments, and system documentation.
  • Use simulation and analysis tools to verify GNC models and system performance under different operating conditions.
  • Provide system engineering expertise in the development of GNC systems, ensuring a cohesive and efficient approach to the design and implementation process.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve issues related to GNC systems during design, testing, and operational phases.
  • Keep updated with the latest technologies and trends in GNC engineering and system architecture design.

You will work on vehicles like:
Omen
Thunder
And several others behind the scenes.


REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • BS in Robotics, Computer Science, Electrical, Mechanical, Mechatronics, Aerospace Engineering or related field with focus on dynamics and control
  • 12 or more years of experience in Guidance, Navigation & Control engineering or related technical experience
  • A strong theoretical knowledge of classical and modern control theory, estimation, and filtering techniques.
  • Exceptional understanding of flight dynamics (Vertical Take-off and Landing - VTOL and Conventional Take-off and Landing - CTOL)
  • Experience with developing GNC solutions for flight systems
  • Experience with developing, integrating, and troubleshooting tools for linear analysis of dynamic systems
  • Proficiency with GNC simulation tools like MATLAB, Simulink, and related toolboxes
  • Familiarization with 6-DOF simulations
  • Ability to travel up to 25%

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • A Ph.D. in Aerospace Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related field is a plus
  • Practical experience developing GNC designs for flight systems.
  • Extensive experience in GNC system and architecture development and testing, preferably in the aerospace industry.
  • Experience generating in C or C++ code from Simulink models.
  • Experience writing code in C/C++ or Rust
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making skills.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
  • Ability to work independently and in a team-oriented, collaborative environment.
  • Familiarity with agile and Lean product development methodologies such as Scrum.
  • Experience using Jira, Git, GitHub, or GitLab
  • Understanding of and compliance with industry, safety, and quality standards appropriate for the application
  • Passion for defending the United States and its allies
  • Eligible to obtain an active U.S. Secret security clearance

title: Consultant
description:
Analytic Partners is a woman-founded and led global leader in commercial measurement and optimisation, helping the world’s largest brands turn complex data into confident growth decisions. For more than 25 years, we have partnered with top-tier companies to navigate a rapidly changing landscape of data, analytics, marketing effectiveness, and business decisioning — with a clear focus on helping marketers unlock sustainable brand growth.

Our holistic approach combines an industry-leading decisioning platform with the expertise of consultants who know how to translate insight into action. Technology enables our work, but our people are the differentiator: we are a client-focused consultancy where innovation is encouraged, impact is recognised, and talented individuals are empowered to shape their careers.

With clients in 50+ countries and offices across major global markets, including Sydney and Melbourne, we are growing quickly — and looking for exceptional talent to help shape the future of analytics.

To learn more about what we do, visit – and see why we’re recognised as a Leader in the industry by independent research firms Forrester and Gartner.

Team & Position Overview

The Client Engagement Team (CET) is the analytical and consultative backbone of Analytic Partners. Our model is hands-on: the people who partner with clients also prepare, analyse, and deliver data-driven insights, helping them use our technology solutions to make better decisions. Because all work is completed in-house, this high-touch approach requires strong analytics capability, clear communication, commercial curiosity, and a consultative mindset to help clients grow ROI.

As a Consultant with Analytic Partners, you will advise and partner with leading Australian, New Zealand, and global brands, influencing strategic and tactical planning across marketing and broader business priorities. Your work will help uncover growth opportunities worth tens of millions of dollars, supported by strong client relationships and engagement with senior audiences, from brand managers and media directors to CMOs and CEOs. You will deepen your expertise in marketing, analytics, and business drivers, using predictive models and client data to identify what drives sales, appointments, accounts, brand health, or any other outcome our clients want to grow.

You will split your time between collaborating with colleagues and clients and working independently. We support your development through immersive onboarding Bootcamp, which builds the technical and conceptual foundations for success, as well as ongoing training in new methodologies, consulting skills, and career growth.

The Consultant role will span across multiple projects and includes processing data, building models, and creating presentations that translate analysis into clear insights and recommendations. You will also guide junior analysts in their day-to-day work and career development, while contributing to company-wide initiatives beyond client delivery.

What you’ll be doing:

  • Lead multiple customer engagements day-to-day, in collaboration with CET leadership, to help customers make optimal investment decisions based on the combination of our proprietary technology and advisory services.
  • Manage customer delivery: align project timelines, manage key customer communication, manage tasks and goals of other team members, ensure deliverables are of high quality and meet project deadlines.
  • Accountable for driving the most efficient data collection process with customers and build cutting edge statistical/econometric models.
  • Build strong relationships with customers understand their business objectives and deliver presentations with actionable insights and recommendations to drive impactand long-term partnerships.
  • Act as point of contact for customer projects, being able to address ad-hoc client requests and questions about data, models, software, etc.
  • Collaborate with leadership to balance project resources across teams, and support in managing towards revenue targets.
  • Train and coach new & existing team members, providing feedback and guidance in the moment during daily work.
  • Work on a hybrid model, with team members spending at least three days each week in our North Sydney office to support team collaboration, connection, and client impact.

What we look for in you:

  • Bachelor’s degree or above (ideal areas of study/related study including: Business Analytics and Management, Economics, Statistics, Mathematics, and/or Marketing)
  • 5+ years of experience in marketing mix modeling, digital media analysis, business focused analytics, advertising effectiveness analysis or other related client insights experience
  • Strong working knowledge of Microsoft PowerPoint and Excel
  • Highly analytical with strong problem-solving skills and attention to detail
  • Project and people management experience
  • Experience developing and presenting presentations using insights derived from analytics
  • Ability to apply marketing and commercial intelligence concepts for business success
  • You must be eligible to work in Australia on an unlimited basis to be considered for this job.

Our Leadership Values for Marketing Science Analysts and Company Culture:

  • Results Driven - firmly understands business risks and links them to decision making
  • Effective Communication - utilises data to tell a story and not just present facts
  • Accountability & Integrity - works to clear roadblocks to allow for better team performance when an obstacle is identified
  • Creative Collaboration - collaborates upward and actively works to bring in outside perspectives
  • Harnessing Innovation - technifies existing practices by leveraging knowledge and innovative solutions
As a woman founded and led company, this has meant supporting a meritocracy where everyone has opportunities to achieve their best and ensure we foster an environment of diversity, equity, and inclusion. In practice this means we will not only work to recruit a diverse workforce, but also maximize the full potential of all of our people. You can read more about our commitment to DEI Here
Additionally, Analytic Partners participates in the E-Verify program in certain locations, as required by law.

title: Vi søger Social- og Sundhedshjælpere til både dag- og aftenvagter
description:
Har du lyst til at gøre en forskel – og blive en del af et godt fællesskab?Hvorfor søger vi?

Nogle af vores dygtige unge medarbejdere starter på uddannelse, og derfor får vi brug for nye kolleger.

Samtidig vælger vi at styrke vores faglige bemanding, fordi flere af vores beboere har behov for kompleks pleje.

Det betyder, at vi nu har mulighed for at byde nye faglærte kræfter velkommen i teamet.


❤️ Hos os er beboerne hjemme

Vi er en del af Danske Diakonhjem, og vores hverdag bygger på værdierne:

Fællesskab · Livskvalitet · Hjemlighed

For os betyder det, at beboerne skal opleve, at de bor i deres eget hjem – ikke er på en institution.

Vi har blik for hele mennesket og møder den enkelte med respekt, ligeværd og omsorg.

Kom med indenfor på Aarhus Friplejehjem Slet - Se video


Vi søger

🌞 SOSU-hjælper – dagvagt

Du bliver en del af den daglige pleje og er med til at skabe tryghed, nærvær og gode stunder for vores beboere.

🌙 Faglært SOSU-medarbejder – aftenvagt

Du er med til at skabe en tryg afslutning på dagen og varetage den faglige pleje og omsorg, når aftenen falder på.

Vi håber, du
  • Er fagligt engageret og har lyst til at udvikle dig
  • Trives med kompleks pleje
  • Kan arbejde selvstændigt og samtidig være en del af et team
  • Ser mennesket bag opgaven
  • Møder beboere og kolleger med respekt og nærvær
  • Har lyst til at bidrage til et godt fællesskab


Vi tilbyder
  • En grundig introduktion
  • Et stærkt fagligt miljø
  • Gode kolleger og et godt fællesskab
  • Fokus på beboernes livskvalitet
  • Mulighed for faglig udvikling
  • En arbejdsplads med plads til humor, nærvær og engagement
  • Mulighed for at gøre en reel forskel i menneskers hverdag


Dagvagt: 30-37 timer / uge med weekendvagt hver 3. weekend

Aftenvagt: 30-37 timer / uge med weekendvagt hver 2. weekend

Tiltrædelse: 1. oktober 2026 eller efter aftale

Ansøgningsfrist: 20. september 2026. Ansøgninger behandles løbende.

Løn- og ansættelsesvilkår i henhold til gældende overenskomst. Derudover har vi forskellige personalegoder, bl.a. sundhedsforsikring og madordning.

Ansættelsessted: Aarhus Friplejehjem Slet, Slet Møllevej 12, 8310 Tranbjerg.

Ansøgningen med relevante bilag skal sendes via link her fra siden.


Har du lyst til at blive en del af os?

Så vil vi meget gerne høre fra dig! Har du spørgsmål til stillingen er du velkommen til at kontakte forstander Julie Rye.


Vi glæder os til at byde vores nye kolleger velkommen.


Om Aarhus Friplejehjem Slet og Danske Diakonhjem

Aarhus Friplejehjem Slet ligger bynært og med udsigt ud over markerne i Slet. Hjemmet rummer 54 moderne lejligheder, hyggelige fællesarealer, eget køkken og en fællessal, som bliver brugt til både daglige aktiviteter, fester og meget andet. Vi er et attraktivt plejehjem og har stor søgning af nye beboere.

Hjemmet er en del af Danske Diakonhjem, som er landets største ikke-kommunale aktør inden for plejehjem og friplejehjem. I øjeblikket har Danske Diakonhjem 45 hjem og godt 3.000 medarbejdere. Organisationen arbejder non-profit, og målet er at levere hjemlig, hjertevarm og respektfuld pleje og omsorg.

title: Workers' Compensation Appeal Specialist
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Workers' Compensation Appeal Specialist based in United States.

As a Workers' Compensation Appeal Specialist, you will play an important role in resolving post-payment medical billing disputes and supporting effective healthcare cost containment.
You will manage a caseload of Workers' Compensation bills, including balance billing and usual-and-customary-rate disputes.
The role combines provider outreach, payment negotiation, regulatory compliance, and detailed case documentation.
You will work directly with healthcare providers and internal clients to investigate appeals and reach appropriate resolutions.
Your expertise will help ensure accurate reimbursement while maintaining compliance with state-specific requirements and HIPAA standards.
This is an opportunity to contribute to a collaborative, detail-oriented environment where communication, judgment, and organization are highly valued.
The ideal candidate is confident handling negotiations, comfortable navigating complex billing matters, and committed to delivering timely, high-quality outcomes.

Accountabilities:

  • Manage an assigned caseload of post-payment Workers' Compensation bills, including state balance-billing matters and usual-and-customary-rate (UCR) disputes.
  • Conduct proactive outreach to medical providers to explain payment methodologies, investigate disputed charges, and negotiate reductions on appealed or outlier bills.
  • Communicate professionally with clients to gather information, coordinate investigations, and support effective appeal resolution.
  • Educate providers on Workers' Compensation billing practices, reimbursement methodologies, applicable policies, and regulatory requirements.
  • Thoroughly document all provider interactions, including contact details, bill information, proposed and counter-offered payment rates, and final outcomes.
  • Ensure all case activities comply with state-specific Workers' Compensation regulations, confidentiality standards, and HIPAA requirements.
  • Maintain productivity and quality standards while resolving cases within applicable regulatory and client-specific timelines.
  • Follow established client protocols, internal procedures, communication scripts, and documentation requirements.
  • Monitor changes to Workers' Compensation regulations, fee schedules, reimbursement policies, and state-specific requirements across multiple jurisdictions.
  • Collaborate effectively with internal team members and contribute to a positive, results-oriented team environment.
  • Support special projects and take on additional responsibilities as needed.

    • Requirements:

    • 2–3 years of relevant experience working with Workers' Compensation bills, medical billing, medical coding, insurance negotiations, or a closely related field.
    • Strong understanding of Workers' Compensation reimbursement methodologies, state regulations, fee schedules, and provider billing practices.
    • Demonstrated experience negotiating medical bill payments, adjustments, reductions, or disputed charges with healthcare providers.
    • Familiarity with claims processing systems and provider-facing communications.
    • Strong verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to explain complex billing and reimbursement matters clearly and professionally.
    • Excellent negotiation, organization, prioritization, and case-management skills.
    • Strong attention to detail and the ability to maintain accurate documentation across multiple cases.
    • Sound judgment and decision-making skills, with the ability to evaluate information and determine appropriate next steps.
    • Ability to collaborate effectively with a variety of internal and external stakeholders.
    • High level of discretion, professionalism, and ethical conduct when handling confidential healthcare and claims information.
    • Comfortable working in a structured, deadline-driven environment while maintaining productivity and quality standards.
    • Strong technical aptitude and the ability to learn and navigate claims, billing, and other business systems.

      • Benefits:

      • Salary: $55,000–$65,000 USD annually, with compensation based on experience and qualifications.
      • Certain positions may offer additional compensation opportunities, including bonuses and merit increases.

title: Redaktør med blik for sprog, struktur og målgrupper
description:
Har du kompetencer og lyst til at gøre en konkret forskel for børn og deres familier, når de møder sundhedsvæsenet? Kan du omsætte faglig viden og praktiske oplysninger til tekster, der er lette at forstå og handle på? Så er du måske vores nye kollega.

Vi søger en redaktør til en etårig projektansættelse.
Du får ansvaret for at gennemskrive og udvikle den skriftlige patientinformation målrettet forældre til børn, som skal undersøges eller indlægges på Mary Elizabeths Hospital - Rigshospitalets nyeste byggeri. Ved projektets afslutning er målet, at forældrene møder sammenhængende, målrettet og forståelig information gennem hele deres forløb på hospitalet, som er designet til at skabe de optimale rammer for børn, unge og gravide og deres familier.

Det er derfor vigtigt, at du kan skrive, redigere og bearbejde tekster, så forældrene omkring barnet bliver bedst muligt rustet til at forberede sig, forstå og handle. Du skal også have blik for at sortere i budskaberne, så forældrene får informationer på de rigtige tidspunkter i forløbet.

Du kommer til at arbejde tæt sammen med sundhedsfagligt personale på Rigshospitalet og kommunikationsfaglige kolleger med et projekt, der har betydning for den samlede hospitalsoplevelse.

Region Hovedstaden arbejder målrettet på at forbedre den skriftlige information, som vores patienter og pårørende får i indkaldelser, på papir, digitale kommunikationsplatforme, på hjemmesiden og meget mere. Arbejdet med at udvikle god patientinformation foregår i en regional redaktion på Regionsgården i Hillerød.

Vi har brug for selvstændige og effektive hænder, og du skal kunne bevare overblikket i et stort projekt og arbejde systematisk med sans for detaljer og korrekt grammatik.

Vi lægger vægt på, at du har gennemslagskraft, erfaring med faglig formidling, projektledelse og teknisk forståelse. Kendskab til sundhedsvæsenet er en fordel, men ikke et must.

Dine opgaver bliver at

  • skrive og bearbejde patientrettede tekster efter redaktionelle principper til bl.a. indkaldelser, print og hjemmesider.
  • redigere og samle fraser (tekstbidder) til sammenhængende, patientrettede tekster.
  • sikre sammenhæng i patientinformation på tværs af mange kanaler.
  • samarbejde med sundhedsfaglige om indhold.
Vi forventer, at du

  • skriver fejlfrit dansk og kan dit håndværk.
  • har en relevant sproglig eller kommunikationsmæssig baggrund.
  • har erfaring med faglig formidling og kan omsætte det til målgruppen.
  • har teknisk forståelse og lyst til at arbejde med systemer – vi arbejder i Pimcore.
  • er selvstændig, opsøgende, har gennemslagskraft og er god til at samarbejde med mange forskellige faggrupper.
  • kan holde overblikket i store projekter, men også kan arbejde med detaljen.
Vi tilbyder:

  • engagerede og fagligt stærke kolleger, som giver faglig sparring hele vejen.
  • erfaring med at løse kommunikationsopgaver i en stor organisation.
  • en meningsfuld arbejdsplads, hvor dit arbejde bidrager til at styrke hospitalsoplevelsen for børnene og deres familier.
Om os
Du bliver en del af enheden Patientkommunikation og digitale medier i Center for Politik og Kommunikation på Regionsgården i Hillerød. Du vil dog også arbejde tæt sammen med kommunikationskollegaer og sundhedsfaglige på Rigshospitalet.

I enheden Patientkommunikation og digitale medier arbejder vi med drift og udvikling af patientkommunikation, digitale kommunikationsplatforme, web og brugervenlighed, video og foto, og deltager i større tværgående projekter.

I Center for Politik og Kommunikation får du gode kolleger, der foruden digital og visuel brugerkommunikation arbejder med presse, ledelseskommunikation, design, betjening af politikere og koncernledelse og jura. Vi arbejder alle tæt sammen med vores kommunikationskolleger på regionens virksomheder og hospitaler.

Yderligere oplysninger

title: Senior C++ Engineer
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior C++ Engineer based in Germany.

This is an opportunity to contribute to the enhancement and security of critical desktop software used within the healthcare sector.
You will work on modern C++ components for high-performance applications where stability, efficiency, and security are essential.
The role combines deep software engineering with code analysis, vulnerability remediation, and advanced multithreading diagnostics.
You will collaborate with architecture, quality assurance, and product teams to deliver robust and dependable software.
AI-assisted coding tools will be used to accelerate analysis, troubleshooting, and development workflows.
This contract role is suited to a highly experienced engineer who enjoys complex technical challenges and takes ownership of engineering quality.
The position is remote within Europe, with occasional onsite collaboration in Central or Northern Germany.

Accountabilities

  • Develop, maintain, and enhance modern C++ components for high-performance desktop applications, with a strong focus on stability, reliability, and IT security.
  • Analyze existing software architecture against security specifications to identify, remediate, and prevent vulnerabilities.
  • Investigate complex technical issues and perform advanced multithreading analysis and debugging to optimize system efficiency and application performance.
  • Collaborate with software architects, quality assurance specialists, product managers, and other stakeholders to ensure robust software delivery.
  • Apply structured debugging and code-analysis techniques to identify root causes and implement durable solutions.
  • Leverage AI coding agents and automated engineering tools to accelerate code analysis, bug resolution, and development workflows.
  • Contribute to continuous improvements in engineering practices, software quality, security, and development efficiency.

    • Requirements

    • Extensive professional experience as a Senior C++ Engineer working with high-performance, multithreaded desktop applications.
    • Strong proficiency in modern C++ development practices and advanced software engineering principles.
    • In-depth expertise in system security, multithreading, concurrency, and advanced debugging techniques.
    • Practical experience with build systems and development toolchains including CMake, Conan, and MSVC.
    • Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities, with a structured approach and high standards for software quality.
    • Fluent English communication skills; German language skills are considered an advantage.
    • Eligibility to work from within the EU, EEA, UK, or Switzerland.
    • Familiarity with AI coding agents such as Claude Code or comparable automated engineering tools is preferred.
    • Experience with formal IT security standards, regulatory compliance, or software development in regulated environments is an advantage.
    • Previous experience in healthcare or other highly regulated industries is beneficial.
    • A university degree in Computer Science, Mathematics, Physics, Electrical Engineering, or a related technical discipline is preferred.

      • Benefits

      • Full-time contract or freelance engagement with a competitive daily rate.

title: Senior Software Developer, Mid-Market
description:
7shifts is a scheduling and payroll platform designed to help restaurant teams thrive. With an easy-to-use app and industry-specific solutions, 7shifts saves time, reduces errors, and helps keep costs in check for over 55,000 restaurants. Our mission is to simplify team management and improve performance for restaurants, with a long-term vision of creating a thriving restaurant industry through the power of connected & engaged teams.

As a Senior Software Developer, Mid-Market at 7shifts, you'll be one of the founding engineers on our mid-market squad — the team responsible for building the foundational systems that serve restaurant groups with real complexity: multiple locations, layered permissions, and the need for rollup visibility across their entire operation. You'll report to Mike Kleiman and work closely with a product counterpart, the data team, and a Director of Software Development.

The work is greenfield in the places that count. You'll define the data structures that power rollup reporting for multi-location operators and design a permissions and authorization system that properly supports role-based access control (RBAC) at scale, going meaningfully beyond what exists today. Within 6 months, the expectation is a beta of rollup reports delivered across a few dimensions and the architectural path for the permissions system defined and in early development. This is not a backlog of tickets. It's a chance to shape systems used every day by over 1.5 million restaurant workers.

What you’ll do:

  • Design and build the data structures and pipelines that power rollup reporting for multi-location restaurant groups, owning the work from schema design through beta delivery
  • Architect and lead early development on a new permissions and authorization system, mapping the migration path from what exists today and sequencing the transition safely
  • Partner with your product counterpart to sequence, estimate, and prioritize across two foundational workstreams, surfacing tradeoffs and risks early
  • Communicate architectural decisions and status clearly to your team, the data team, and leadership, including when the plan needs to change
  • Work alongside AI agents as part of how you build: spec-driven development, agentic harnesses for code generation and debugging, and deliberate agent use in your daily workflow
  • Raise the technical bar of the squad through code reviews, design discussions, and hands-on guidance for teammates

What you bring:

  • 7–10 years of experience building production software, including work where data modeling or permissions and authorization were central to how the system worked, not just adjacent to it
  • You've owned systems end to end: from technical design through delivery, support, and iteration, making real decisions when things broke or needed to change
  • A track record of turning ambiguous, complex problems into clear, maintainable solutions without waiting for everything to be defined
  • Comfort in large, evolving codebases, with the judgment to improve them incrementally while still shipping progress
  • Strong technical judgment when balancing speed, quality, performance, and long-term maintainability, especially against a concrete timeline
  • Clear communication and the ability to work effectively across engineering, product, and data partners
  • Experience mentoring developers or leading technical discussions that raise the quality of decisions across a team

It’d be even cooler if you had:

  • Hands-on experience with data lake or warehouse tooling such as Snowflake, BigQuery, or AWS equivalents
  • Background in a domain where accuracy, reliability, and real-time data were business-critical

This role is an existing vacancy and is part of our current hiring plan

Compensation

The base compensation range for this position is CAD $130,000 to $180,000. This range reflects the full growth path for the role, from building core skills to accomplished performance, through to role mastery. We typically target the accomplished level when hiring externally. At this level, individuals bring relevant experience in the role, demonstrate strong job-related skills, operate with confidence and consistency, and are able to deliver impact with limited ramp-up while still having meaningful opportunity to grow.

Compensation at 7shifts is performance and growth-driven. As you develop your skills and expand your impact over time, your compensation grows with you. Your specific placement within this range is based on your job-related skills, knowledge, and experience, as well as our internal equity assessment. We are always happy to discuss our approach throughout the hiring process.

Our commitment to our Shifties:

  • Opportunity: Our product is evolving in exciting ways, and we’re focused on delivering even more value to restaurants. This momentum creates real opportunities to learn and grow. Whether you’re honing your craft or exploring new paths, you’ll be supported and empowered to own your growth and impact a product shaping the future of the restaurant industry.
  • Challenge: We’re tackling real problems in a fast-moving, complex industry. The work is scrappy and ambiguous, but meaningful. You’ll think critically, act with intention, and shape solutions that make a real difference for restaurant teams.
  • Culture: We’re proud to be recognized among the best workplaces in North America. Guided by our mission and values, we move fast to solve meaningful problems and celebrate wins together. Whether through in-office and remote events, team offsites like Sparks, or everyday moments of connection, we create space for shared growth, collaboration, and fun.
  • Equity: We’re a Series C, VC-backed SaaS company, and we believe everyone should share in the success they help create. When we build together, we grow together.
  • Health and Wellness: We support Shifties in and outside of work, knowing that what people need can change over time. From day one, you’ll have access to benefits like health and dental, lifestyle spending accounts to a parental leave program built with flexibility in mind, to help you bring your best self to work.
  • Flexibility: Our team is intentional around how and where we work, whether remotely, in person, or a mix of both. We prioritize candidates who thrive in a hybrid work environment with offices in Saskatoon and Toronto, ensuring in-person collaboration and connection when possible. Plus, we offer a flexible vacation policy to encourage everyone to recharge when needed. Oh, and our ‘90 Day Shift’ program lets Shift work from (almost) anywhere because who wouldn’t want to trade their desk for a beach view once in a while?
  • Support: We set Shifties up for success with the tools they need, like the latest Apple tech, a home office setup, and some 7shifts swag to make it official. But support goes beyond day one. We’re serious about professional growth, offering coaching, feedback, development planning, and opportunities to grow from within.

We know you might not check every box, and that’s okay. If you’re excited about this role, inspired to contribute to a meaningful product, and eager to share ideas that drive real change, we’d love to hear from you. We’re building an inclusive team that reflects the diverse industry we serve, and we welcome applicants from all backgrounds.

We thank you for your interest in joining the 7shifts team!
