title: Senior Software Engineer
description:
Analytica is seeking a Senior Software Engineer to design, develop, and maintain modern, cloud-based applications supporting federal government missions. The Full Stack Azure Developer will work across the application stack, developing scalable front-end and back-end solutions while leveraging Microsoft Azure services to build secure, reliable, and high-performing applications.

The ideal candidate has strong full-stack development experience, hands-on expertise with Azure cloud services, and the ability to translate business and mission requirements into robust technical solutions. This role will collaborate closely with developers, architects, data engineers, product owners, and government stakeholders in an Agile environment

Analytica has been recognized by Inc. Magazine as one of the fastest-growing 250 businesses in the U.S. for three years. We partner with U.S. government clients in health, civilian, and national security missions to build innovative technology solutions that impact our day-to-day lives. The company offers competitive compensation with opportunities for bonuses, employer-paid healthcare, training and development funds, and a 401(k) match.

Responsibilities
  • Design, develop, test, deploy, and maintain full-stack web applications using modern development frameworks and Azure cloud technologies.
  • Develop responsive, user-friendly front-end applications using React, Angular, or similar JavaScript/TypeScript frameworks.
  • Build scalable back-end services, APIs, and microservices using C#, .NET/.NET Core, Python, or similar technologies.
  • Develop and integrate RESTful APIs and other services to support application and data integration requirements.
  • Leverage Azure services such as Azure App Service, Azure
  • Functions, Azure API Management, Azure Storage, Azure SQL, Azure Cosmos DB, Azure Service Bus, and Azure Key Vault.
  • Implement cloud-native application architectures using microservices, serverless computing, containers, and event-driven patterns
  • Develop and optimize database solutions using SQL Server, Azure SQL, PostgreSQL, Cosmos DB, or other relational and NoSQL technologies.
  • Implement CI/CD pipelines and automated deployment processes using Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, or similar tools.
  • Participate in Agile ceremonies including sprint planning, backlog refinement, daily standups, demos, and retrospectives. Collaborate with technical architects and stakeholders to evaluate technical approaches and recommend solutions.
  • Develop technical documentation, architecture diagrams, API documentation, and deployment procedures.
  • Support modernization efforts, including migration of legacy applications to Azure cloud-native architectures.
  • Ensure solutions comply with applicable federal security, privacy, accessibility, and data management requirements.
Required Qualifications
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.

  • Experience designing and developing REST APIs and web services.
  • Strong proficiency with JavaScript and/or TypeScript, HTML, and CSS.
  • Experience with relational databases and SQL. Experience with Git and modern source-control practices. Experience implementing CI/CD pipelines and DevOps practices.
  • Experience working in Agile/Scrum development environments.
  • Strong understanding of software development lifecycle, application architecture, testing, and deployment practices. Ability to obtain and maintain the appropriate level of U.S. federal government security clearance or suitability, if required by the program.

Magazine each of the past three years as one of the 250 fastest-growing companies in the U.S. Analytica specializes in providing software and systems engineering, information management, analytics & visualization, agile project management, and management consulting services. title: Lead AI Consultant (Field)
description:
Celonis is the trusted platform to industrialize Enterprise AI. At our core is the Celonis Context Model — which combines process data, business knowledge, and intelligence into a living digital twin of the enterprise that AI can actually understand, turning AI's operational blind spots into operational clarity. World's leading companies trust Celonis and its global ecosystem of partners to make their AI agents, people, systems, and processes work together, achieving transformational outcomes. We believe there's a massive opportunity to unlock global productivity and sustainability by giving AI the context to understand how every business process really works. Join our mission to make processes work for people, companies, and the planet.

The Team

Celonis Services is the delivery engine of our Celonis Customer Organization, responsible for turning the Celonis platform into measurable, business-critical outcomes for our customers. In the AI era, our role has elevated: as AI agents like our own Apollo take on more of the technical build, our people focus on the work that drives real impact—understanding our customers' business-critical problems, designing the solutions that solve them, and quantifying the value delivered. Our Deployment Engineers and Deployment Architects pair deep domain and industry expertise with serious platform mastery and AI-augmented delivery, directing agentic systems while owning the judgment, architecture, and customer relationships that AI cannot replace. We deliver faster and smarter than ever, and we own the outcome: solution go-live, solution adoption, initial value realization support and the long-term success of our customers.

The Role

As a Lead AI Consultant (Field) (known internally - Lead Deployment Engineer) of the Iberia & LATAM region, you are the backbone of Celonis delivery. You lead the hands-on implementation of Celonis solutions for enterprise customers, combining platform expertise with AI-augmented workflows to deliver high-quality outcomes, fast. You use Celonis’s AI deployment tools as your primary instruments - directing agents to build data models, generate analyses, and configure operational solutions, while applying your own judgment to validate outputs, adapt to customer context, and ensure business relevance.
You will lead the team of junior Consultants and team with experts (AI, Product, Functional) to make sure the customer achieves value and adoption.

As a strategic driver in the pre-sales stage, you will partner closely with Account Teams to shape and position our Services solutions. You won't just present offerings—you will architect the foundation for long-term customer success, ensuring rapid adoption and value realization.

This is not a traditional consulting role where you build everything manually. You are Product expert and an AI-augmented delivery professional: you specify what needs to be built, direct AI agents to execute wherever possible, validate the results, and iterate with the customer. You generate value by understanding the customer’s business, translating their needs into technical specifications and solutions, to ensure the platform delivers measurable impact and adoption.

The Work You’ll Do

Pre-Sales:

  • Designing tailored deployment roadmaps and implementation strategies aligned with the customer's maturity.
  • Estimating project timelines, team structures, and overall professional services effort to support commercial proposals.
  • Partnering with Account Executives and Value Engineers to translate business cases into actionable deployment plans.
  • Drafting clear Statements of Work (SOW), defining project scope, deliverables, assumptions, and acceptance criteria.
  • Aligning client expectations with operational feasibility to prevent post-sale scope creep.

Post-Sales: Initiate and Connect

Define the strategy and oversee junior Consultants covering -

  • Conduct business discovery workshops to translate customers’ strategic objectives into high-impact Celonis use cases
  • Collaborate with the customer’s IT and business stakeholders to define project scope, data requirements, and success criteria
  • Ensure data connectivity and extraction pipelines are properly configured, working with specialist resources if required

Build & Value

  • Direct AI deployment agents to build data models, process analyses, KPIs, and dashboards - writing clear specifications and validating agent outputs against business requirements – do we make this less of a must have?
  • Build and configure Celonis solutions across the platform: Process Intelligence Graph, data transformations, process analysis, operational solutions, and AI-powered insights
  • Identify process inefficiencies and root causes using Celonis technology, always in close collaboration with the customer
  • Validate AI-generated outputs for accuracy, business relevance, and alignment with customer context - applying domain knowledge where the AI cannot
  • Lead value creation workshops and define measures to improve process inefficiencies
  • Define and build KPIs measuring the customer’s success and quantify business impact
  • Design and build operational solutions to drive value, adoption and improve process conformance

Rollout, Adoption, and Handover

  • Enable key customer users to use and extend the solution independently, setting the foundation for long-term adoption
  • Manage project outcomes against timelines, scope, and customer expectations
  • Train and demonstrate to customer users, guiding them on the path to sustained value
  • Document solution design decisions and configurations for future reference and handoff

Domain & Industry Depth

  • Develop and maintain deep expertise in one or more process domains (e.g., Supply Chain, Order to Cash, Procure to Pay, IT Service Management) or industry verticals
  • Translate domain knowledge into scalable solution patterns, reference architectures, and best practices that the broader team can leverage
  • Proactively identify and standardize high-value use cases within your domain, collaborating with Product and Business Apps teams to shape the platform roadmap

What Makes This Role Different in the AI Era

  • You work with AI agents as your primary tools - your job is to direct, validate, and refine their output, not to write every line of code or build every analysis manually – still hands on technical?
  • You need strong specification and context engineering skills - the ability to translate a customer’s ambiguous business need into a precise instruction that an AI agent can execute correctly
  • You are expected to continuously learn and adapt as AI capabilities evolve, experimenting with new approaches and sharing what works with your peers
  • You balance speed with quality - AI accelerates execution, but you own the judgment calls on whether the output is right for this customer
  • You think in sustainable software solutions. While AI agents will generate first results quickly, you need to ensure that the operational solutions you build in Celonis are robust, user friendly, maintainable, and scalable

The Qualifications You Need

  • Experience: 7+ years in Management or IT consulting, data/solution consulting, or process improvement consulting within software vendors, consulting firms, or system integrators.
  • Consulting pre-sales experience
  • Platform skills: Track record in complex IT/SAP transformations, process optimization, and PQL/SQL/Python technical capability
  • AI fluency: Comfort working with AI-assisted development tools (e.g., Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, etc.). Ability to write clear specifications, evaluate AI-generated outputs, and iterate effectively. Experience with prompt engineering or context engineering is a strong plus.
  • Business and process domain expertise : Strong understanding /deep expertise (based on seniority level) of enterprise business processes and financial metrics. Knowledge of standard ERPs (SAP, Oracle) and process areas (Inventory Management, Order to Cash, Procure to Pay, Accounts Payable) is a strong plus.
  • Consulting skills: Ability to steer customer workshops, present findings to management, manage stakeholder expectations, and deliver outcomes in the face of adversity and ambiguity. Comfortable working with both technical and business audiences.
  • Analytical mindset: Excellent problem-solving skills with a value-driven orientation. Ability to translate business requirements into technical solutions and quantify business impact.
  • Learning agility: Willingness to continuously develop expertise through experimentation. Comfort with ambiguity and evolving tools.
  • Education: Bachelor’s or Master’s in Technology Management, Business Informatics, Computer Science, Engineering, Business Administration, or a comparable field.
  • Languages: Fluency in English and Spanish required. Portuguese beneficial.
  • Travel: Willingness to travel to customer location up to 50%, according to customer requirement and project delivery phases.

What Celonis can offer you:

  • Pioneer Innovation: Work with the global leader in Process Mining and the Process Intelligence Graph to shape the future of AI-driven business operations.
  • Ownership from Day 1: Every full-time "Celonaut" is an owner, receiving Restricted Stock Units (RSUs) and merit-based refresh grants.
  • Unrivaled Family Support: Benefit from our inclusive parental leave policy—24 weeks of fully paid leave for primary carers and 12 weeks for supporting carers, available from your first day of employment.
  • Work-Life Integration: Enjoy Unlimited PTO (in applicable regions) and generous PTO globally, as well as a flexible hybrid work model that balances remote focus with vibrant office collaboration.
  • Continuous Growth: Elevate your skills through our 70-20-10 learning framework, mentorship programs, and access to a dedicated learning platform.
  • Holistic Well-being: Prioritize your health with subsidized Wellhub memberships, mental health counseling, and dedicated "Wellness Weeks" that prioritize work/life balance.
  • Drive Sustainability: Participate in annual Impact Days, where you receive paid time off to volunteer for community and environmental causes with your local office, or virtually.
  • Global Inclusion & Belonging: Find community through our Inclusion Think Tank and participate in our annual Inclusion Days, ensuring every voice is heard and valued.
  • Value-Driven Impact: Join a mission-led organization where our core values—Live for Customer Value, The Best Team Wins, We Own It, and Earth Is Our Future—drive every decision.

About Us:

Celonis is the trusted platform to industrialize Enterprise AI, empowering organizations to analyze, design, and operate AI-driven processes. The Celonis Platform is powered by the Celonis Context Model, which combines process data, business knowledge, and intelligence to create a living digital twin of the enterprise that AI can understand — turning AI’s operational blind spots into operational clarity. Industry-leading companies around the world trust Celonis and its global ecosystem of partners to make their AI agents, people, systems, and processes work together, achieving transformational outcomes. Celonis is headquartered in Munich, Germany, and New York City, USA, with more than 20 offices worldwide.

Get familiar with the Celonis Process Intelligence Platform by watching this video.

Celonis Inclusion Statement:

At Celonis, we believe our people make us who we are and that “The Best Team Wins”. We know that the best teams are made up of people who bring different perspectives to the table. And when everyone feels included, able to speak up and knows their voice is heard - that's when creativity and innovation happen.

By submitting this application, you confirm that you agree to the storing and processing of your personal data by Celonis as described in our Privacy Notice for the Application and Hiring Process.

title: Pre-Award: MXM- Software Engineer III
description:
Barbaricum is a rapidly growing government contractor providing leading-edge support to federal customers, with a particular focus on Defense and National Security mission sets. We leverage more than 17 years of support to stakeholders across the federal government, with established and growing capabilities across Intelligence, Analytics, Engineering, Mission Support, and Communications disciplines. Founded in 2008, our mission is to transform the way our customers approach constantly changing and complex problem sets by bringing to bear the latest in technology and the highest caliber of talent.

Headquartered in Washington, DC's historic Dupont Circle neighborhood, Barbaricum also has a corporate presence in Tampa, FL, Bedford, IN, and Dayton, OH, with team members across the United States and around the world. As a leader in our space, we partner with firms in the private sector, academic institutions, and industry associations with a goal of continually building our expertise and capabilities for the benefit of our employees and the customers we support. Through all of this, we have built a vibrant corporate culture diverse in expertise and perspectives with a focus on collaboration and innovation. Our teams are at the frontier of the Nation's most complex and rewarding challenges. Join our team.

Barbaricum is seeking an Software Engineer III to directly support the anticipated Naval Surface Warfare Center (NSWC) Crane Division, Model Based Engineering Assessment Division (Code MXM). Code MXM's mission is mission engineering analysis and assessment of complex Naval, DoD, and joint kill chains — with a specialized focus on Electromagnetic Spectrum Operations (EMSO) enabled analysis. As a Software Engineer III, you will apply software engineering expertise and modern development practice in support of Code MXM's EMSO mission engineering, modeling, and test activities. You will bring depth in programming concepts and contemporary software development methodologies to the team's software efforts.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Apply programming concepts in a professional or academic setting.
  • Apply modern software development methodologies (e.g., agile, DevOps/DevSecOps) in a professional or academic setting.
  • Support the team's software engineering tasking across the development lifecycle.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Active DoD SECRET clearance (minimum); U.S. citizenship required.
  • Master's degree in a quantitative field such as engineering or mathematics (e.g., Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, Information Technology, or Information Systems).
  • 10 years of professional experience with software engineering.

DESIRED QUALIFICATIONS

title: Warehouse and Cable Technician - Panalux London
description:

Part of the Panavision group, Panalux offers the world of film, television, and media production the very best in lighting rental equipment and associated facilities.

Created specifically to cater to the exacting needs of the global entertainment industry, the Panalux service is unrivalled in its ability to provide creative solutions to the full spectrum of production types, regardless of size or genre.

Experience and innovation, plus an extensive inventory of modern equipment fully supported by a team of highly skilled professionals, sets Panalux apart from the competition. Utilising these resources, clients continually trust Panalux to deliver practical, effective lighting systems to projects throughout the world.

Panavision’s portfolio includes the renowned brands Panalux, LEE Filters, Direct Digital, and Island Studios. For more information and locations worldwide, visit Panavision.com

title: Pædagogmedhjælper til Ådalens Skoles SFO
description:
Vi søger en engageret pædagogmedhjælper, der brænder for sport, udeliv og værkstedsarbejde til Ådalens Skoles sfo med timer ind i skolen.
Vores dygtige kollega har søgt nye udfordringer, og vi søger derfor en ny pædagogmedhjælper med timer i skolen. Vi ønsker os en nysgerrig kollega, som er optaget af børnefællesskaber og som er motiveret for at udvikle børnenes læringsrum og samarbejdet på skolen. Vi leder særligt efter en kollega, som både kan være fysisk aktiv og folde spejdertalenterne ud.

Hvad søger vi?
Vi søger en pædagogmedhjælper til fastansættelse på 30 timer med tiltrædelse 1. oktober 2026 eller hurtigst muligt.
Som pædagogmedhjælper vil du blive en del af vores team, der er omkring 1. klasserne. Du vil følge børnene, til de starter i klub i 3. klasse. Og derefter forfra i børnehaveklasse.
Vi er en stor skole, og det er særlig vigtigt for os, at du er optaget af det pædagogisk fundament, og skolens værdier, som er grundlæggende for børnenes dag. Vi forventer, at du har fokus på at udvikle og etablere, de bedste rammer og relationer for børnenes tid i folkeskolen.
Vi ser desuden gerne, at du har kompetencer inden for sport, værkstedsarbejde og læring i naturen.

Vi forventer af dig, at du
  • vil tage aktivt del i både skoledelen og SFO-delen og kan rumme deres forskellighed
  • er udviklingsorienteret og vil være med til at videreudvikle vores indskoling
  • er villig til at modtage pædagogfaglige sparring
  • vil indgå i et forpligtende samarbejde med nærvær, anerkendelse og godt humør
  • er nysgerrig og har gå-på-mod
  • har en god relationskompetence
  • vægter faglig viden og trivsel
  • er engageret, ansvarsfuld og har en positiv indstilling til de udfordringer du møder.
  • møder børnene i børnehøjde og forældrene i øjenhøjde.
  • har erfaring med inklusion.
  • udtrykker dine holdninger og meninger i en konstruktiv værdsættende dialog og anerkender forskellighed og mangfoldighed.
  • kan og vil bidrage til fællesskabet.

Vi tilbyder dig
  • En SFO/skole med dejlige børn, gode kolleger og med et godt og stærkt forældresamarbejde.
  • En SFO/skole, hvor du har mulighed for at deltage i og præge udviklingen.
  • En SFO/skole med fællesskab, bevægelse og faglighed i højsædet, og en ambition om at værdierne er tydelige i alles arbejde.
  • En SFO/skole med engagerede voksne, som samarbejder i teams om elevernes trivsel og læring.
  • Et uformelt og dynamisk arbejdsmiljø, hvor der er højt til loftet og plads til smil.

Vi er en stor SFO er delt på 4 årgangs huse, hvor vi har lokalefællesskab med skolen.
Vi har tæt samarbejde mellem husene.
Vi har bla. fælles legeplads, hal-dage, ude dage, aktiviteter, fester og den årlige markedsdag

Ansættelsesvilkår
Løn- og ansættelsesvilkår efter gældende overenskomst og aftale om lokal løndannelse.

Nærmere oplysninger om stillingen og skolen kan fås ved henvendelse til konstituere leder af SFO Ida Schubert telefon 21 20 62 41 eller skoleleder Hanne Rask Pedersen. Læs mere på Ådalens Skoles hjemmeside

Ansøgningsfrist og samtaler
Vi skal have din ansøgning senest 22. september 2026
Vi forventer at holde ansættelsessamtaler i uge 39 og 40.

Børne- og straffeattest
Vi indhenter børneattest.

title: Sundhedsfaglig koordinator til Granhøjens Særlige Tilbud
description:
Vil du bruge din sygeplejefaglighed til mere end dine egne opgaver?

Som sundhedsfaglig koordinator får du en central funktion i det sundhedsfaglige arbejde omkring vores beboere. Du sørger blandt andet for, at dokumentationen er på plads, og hjælper dine kolleger, når sundhedsfaglige opgaver kræver sparring eller et ekstra blik.

Det betyder, at din faglighed ikke kun kommer i spil i det, du selv gør. Du er også med til at gøre dine kolleger tryggere i de sundhedsfaglige opgaver, de møder i hverdagen.

Brug din faglighed tæt på praksis

Du bliver den, kollegerne kan gå til med sundhedsfaglige spørgsmål. Nogle gange handler det om dokumentation. Andre gange skal en kollega klædes bedre på til en opgave, eller du opdager noget, der skal følges op på.

En vigtig del af jobbet er derfor at kunne gøre din sundhedsfaglige viden brugbar for andre. Også for kolleger, der ikke selv har en sundhedsfaglig baggrund.

Samtidig har du dine egne ansvarsområder og opgaver, hvor du arbejder mere systematisk med den sundhedsfaglige praksis.

Din hverdag er på tværs af Granhøjens Særlige Tilbud

I Granhøjens Særlige Tilbud (§108) arbejder vi med borgere med kognitive funktionsnedsættelser, som samtidig er omfattet af en dom. Det kræver tid at opbygge relationer, og hverdagen går ikke altid efter planen.

Du bliver en del af et team, der arbejder på tværs af vores to lokationer, Twillingegården i Vig og Kingosvej i Nykøbing Sj.

Her er den sundhedsfaglige indsats en del af en større helhed omkring beboeren. Du arbejder tæt sammen med kollegerne og får samtidig mulighed for faglig sparring med Granhøjens øvrige sundhedsfaglige koordinatorer.

Hvad får du konkret ansvar for?

Du kommer blandt andet til at:

  • sikre, at den sundhedsfaglige dokumentation lever op til Styrelsen for Patientsikkerheds målepunkter
  • understøtte og opkvalificere kolleger i sundhedsfaglige opgaver og dokumentation
  • følge op på utilsigtede hændelser (UTH) og sikre korrekt indberetning
  • udarbejde og vedligeholde lokale sundhedsfaglige retningslinjer
  • deltage i medicinskabsgennemgang og opfølgning på auditrapporter
  • bidrage til introduktion og oplæring af nye medarbejdere

Når noget ikke fungerer i praksis, er din opgave ikke bare at opdage det. Du skal også være med til at finde ud af, hvad der skal ske bagefter.

Kan du se dig selv i rollen?

Du er uddannet sygeplejerske og har lyst til at bruge din faglighed gennem andre.

Du skal kunne tage ansvar for dine sundhedsfaglige områder, men du skal ikke løse alting selv. En stor del af rollen handler netop om at samarbejde med kollegerne og gøre den sundhedsfaglige praksis forståelig og anvendelig i deres hverdag.

Har du solid erfaring med sundhedsfaglig dokumentation, er det en klar fordel. Kendskab til SensumOne eller den systemiske og narrative tilgang er også et plus – men det er ikke et krav. Det er dog et krav, at du har kørekort (B).

Det praktiske skal selvfølgelig også passe

Stillingen er på 30-37 timer om ugen, og arbejdstiden ligger i dagtimerne. Det præcise timetal aftaler vi med dig og afhænger blandt andet af, om du har lyst til også at have nogle timer i driften.

Du får mulighed for løbende at dygtiggøre dig gennem kurser, temadage og uddannelse. Derudover får du sundheds- og tandforsikring samt attraktive medarbejderordninger.

Skal du være vores nye sundhedsfaglige koordinator?

Så send os en kort ansøgning sammen med dit CV via linket herunder.

Ansøgningsfristen er d. 20. september 2026

Har du spørgsmål til stillingen? Tag endelig fat i afdelingsleder Liza Rueløkke på telefon 24 49 27 20 eller på mail liru@grh.dk.

Vi anvender elektronisk rekruttering og modtager derfor ikke ansøgninger via mail eller fysisk post.

Du må gerne bruge AI som hjælp, når du søger hos os. Det vigtigste er, at vi stadig kan mærke dig i ansøgningen og forstå, hvad der motiverer dig, og hvorfor jobbet giver mening for dig.

Hos os er der mennesker på den anden side af din ansøgning. Vi bruger ikke AI til at screene eller vurdere kandidater.



Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig!

Mere om Granhøjen

Granhøjen er en del af koncernen Gran Recovery and Health som er en privatpsykiatrisk koncern, hvor vi tilbyder bolig, behandling og beskæftigelse til voksne med fysiske og psykiske vanskeligheder. Vi tror på, at alle mennesker er andet og mere end deres udfordringer eller diagnoser – og vi tror på, at vi alle gør en stor forskel sammen!

Læs mere om vores arbejdsplads, og mød dine kollegaer her.

title: Senior HR Partner/Generalist (Contract)
description:
Antora Energy delivers affordable, reliable energy to industry, data centers, and the grid. Our thermal batteries turn low-cost electricity into always-on heat and power, without supply-constrained critical minerals or multi-year construction timelines.

We are growing our company with people who put team and mission first, value connection through laughter and joy, and work with humility and openness. We are committed to building a diverse, passionate, and creative team dedicated to a future powered by abundant, clean, low-cost energy.

Position Summary

Antora is looking for an Senior HR Generalist / People Partner who combines hands-on ownership of day-to-day people operations with the judgment to manage more complex employee relations, manager coaching, and people-program work. This role is the primary point of contact for a defined group of employees and managers, running the operational engine of payroll, benefits, onboarding/offboarding, immigration, and leave administration, while also partnering with leaders on team effectiveness, organizational change, and moderately complex employee relations matters. It suits someone who is equally comfortable processing a payroll change in UKG and coaching a manager through a difficult conversation, and who can work independently while collaborating closely with the broader People Team.

Roles & Responsibilities

  • Serve as a trusted point of contact for employees and managers, answering questions about HR programs, policies, and benefits, and escalating complex issues when needed.
  • Manage employee onboarding and offboarding end-to-end (orientation to terminations) with a focus on employee experience.
  • Own day-to-day HR operations: HRIS/UKG maintenance and reporting, payroll support, benefits administration, leave-of-absence (parental, FMLA, disability) and immigration case support) in partnership with outside counsel.
  • Manage moderately complex employee relations matters — including workers' comp claims, investigations, and terminations — assessing risk and recommending solutions in partnership with legal and HR colleagues as needed.
  • Partner with managers to support team effectiveness, performance, development, and engagement; provide coaching on people decisions and escalate complex issues to senior HR as needed.
  • Support organizational design and change initiatives by identifying implications for people, advising on communications, and helping teams navigate transitions.
  • Partner with leaders on workforce planning, headcount needs, and org health insights using people data and trends.
  • Own or co-own the rollout of people programs (performance cycles, engagement initiatives, onboarding improvements, benefit enrollment, compensation planning, capability-building efforts).
  • Interpret HR policies and employment law to guide decision-making across salaried and hourly populations, staying current on regulations, trends, and best practices.
  • Strengthen cross-functional partnerships with HR Operations, Talent Acquisition, Payroll/Finance, and other teams to enable effective execution and continuous improvement.
  • Lead or support other people-program projects and initiatives as needed.
Key Qualifications

  • 5+ years of human resources or people operations experience supporting managers and employees in a fast-paced environment.
  • Demonstrated ability to manage moderately complex employee relations and organizational challenges with increasing independence.
  • Hands-on experience owning HR operational work (HRIS, payroll support, benefits, leave administration, immigration coordination) as well as advising managers on team-level decisions.
  • Comprehensive knowledge of HR policies, best practices, and employment law across HR disciplines (performance, development, policy, org effectiveness).
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills, both written and verbal.
  • High discretion and judgment, with the ability to handle sensitive matters and employee data with impeccable attention to detail.
  • Proven ability to build trust and collaborate across teams, and experience rolling out new people programs, processes, and policies.
Additional Qualifications Desired

  • Experience in a fast-paced startup environment.
  • PHR or SPHR certification.
  • Experience with UKG.

Work Location: Onsite/Hybrid - San Jose, CA

8 month contract

Salary Range: $64.00/hr USD - $77.00/hr USD

Salary Basis: Hourly

The actual salary offered will be within the posted range and determined based on several factors including but not limited to a candidate's experiences, credentials and expertise, as they pertain to the position's requirements.

title: Husassistent til Børne- og familiehusene
description:
Udviklingscenter for Børn og Familier søger husassistent til Børne- og Familiehusene

Har du erfaring med kost, måltider og ernæring til spæd- og småbørn – og har du lyst til at være med til at skabe et trygt, hjemligt og udviklende miljø for børn?

Udviklingscenter for Børn og Familier søger 1 husassistent til døgnafdelingen Kilden i Børne- og Familiehusene med forventet tiltrædelse 1. november 2026. Stillingen er på 30 timer ugentligt.

Vi søger en engageret og kvalificeret medarbejder, som finder mening i at skabe gode rammer og muligheder for udsatte børn. Du skal have lyst til at bidrage til, at hverdagen i huset opleves så hjemlig, tryg og forudsigelig som muligt – også når arbejdet er udfordrende og kræver refleksion, fleksibilitet og tæt samarbejde med kollegaer.

Er du samtidig motiveret af at være en del af en engageret medarbejdergruppe, hvor der er plads til humor, energi og et smil i hverdagen, så er det måske dig, vi leder efter.

Om stillingen
Du bliver en del af en servicegruppe på seks medarbejdere, som varetager serviceopgaver på tværs af Udviklingscenter for Børn og Familier.
Som husassistent vil du i tæt samarbejde med afdelingens medarbejdere og de øvrige servicemedarbejdere varetage en række af husets praktiske og huslige funktioner. Du vil samtidig være en vigtig del af den daglige ramme omkring børnene.

Opgaverne omfatter blandt andet:

  • Planlægning og tilberedning af måltider
  • deltagelse omkring måltiderne og understøttelse af gode måltidsrutiner
  • indkøb og håndtering af fødevarer
  • tøjvask og rengøring
  • praktiske opgaver i huset
  • deltagelse i særlige arrangementer
  • lejlighedsvis vikariere for andre medarbejdere i servicegruppen.

Der kan i perioder være behov for, at du indgår i særlige støttefunktioner omkring enkelte børn.

Et særligt fokus på børn fra 0–8 år og deres kost
En væsentlig del af opgaven er at være med til at sikre, at børnene får sund, nærende og alderssvarende kost, der understøtter deres trivsel, udvikling og vækst.

Målgruppen består blandt andet af helt små børn og spædbørn, og det stiller særlige krav til viden om og erfaring med spæd- og småbørnskost.

Nogle af børnene kan have manglet stabilitet og kontinuitet omkring måltider og ernæring og kan derfor have erfaringer med mad, der ikke har været tilpasset deres alder eller udvikling. Det kan blandt andet betyde, at der er behov for en særlig opmærksomhed på barnets madvaner, appetit, måltidsstruktur, konsistens, portionsstørrelser og introduktion til forskellige fødevarer.

Det er vigtigt for os, at måltidet ikke kun handler om ernæring, men også om tryghed, fællesskab og gode erfaringer med mad. Vi ser gerne, at du har erfaring med at tilpasse mad til børn i forskellige aldre – herunder børn, som endnu ikke har fået en kost, der svarer til deres alder og udviklingsmæssige behov.

En hjemlig og tryg hverdag
Det tilstræbes, at miljøet i huset i vid udstrækning fungerer som et stabilt og støttende hjem for børnene.
Som husassistent er du derfor med til at skabe de praktiske rammer, der giver børnene en oplevelse af ro, genkendelighed, omsorg og tryghed.
Det er vigtigt, at du har blik for, hvad der skal gøres for at få hverdagen til at fungere – men også for de små ting, der skaber stemning og hjemlighed i huset.

Om Udviklingscenter for Børn og Familier
Udviklingscenter for Børn og Familier er en del af Næstved Kommunes samlede specialtilbud for særligt udsatte børn og unge.

UBF omfatter en familiekompenserende forebyggende dagforanstaltning, fire døgnafdelinger – Elvergården, Ladbyhus og Børne- og Familiehusene – Skolen Ved Åsen samt Familieplejen.

Målgruppen
Børne- og Familiehusene arbejder med børn, hvor en målrettet og intensiv mentaliseringsbaseret miljøterapeutisk indsats er nødvendig.

Arbejdstider
Stillingen er på gennemsnitligt 30 timer ugentligt.
Arbejdstiden ligger primært om morgenen og i dagtimerne og tilrettelægges efter husets rytme.
Der kan lejlighedsvis være behov for ændringer i arbejdstiden i forbindelse med særlige arrangementer.
Aftenarbejde kan forekomme i begrænset omfang.

Vi tilbyder

  • En refleksiv arbejdsplads med gode muligheder for personlig og faglig udvikling.
  • En arbejdsplads, hvor vi kontinuerligt er nysgerrige på mening, kvalitet og resultater.
  • En arbejdsplads med stort fokus på sund, nærende og alderssvarende kost til børnene.
  • En engageret og udviklingsorienteret medarbejdergruppe præget af høj faglighed, humør og ansvarlighed.

Vi søger dig, der

  • er uddannet inden for kost og ernæring, pædagogik eller en anden relevant uddannelse – eller har tilsvarende erfaring og kompetencer.
  • har erfaring med at tilpasse kost til børns forskellige aldre, udviklingstrin og individuelle behov herunder allergier, intolerancer og andre kostmæssige hensyn
  • gerne har erfaring med børn, som har særlige udfordringer omkring måltider, madvaner eller ernæring.
  • har erfaring med fødevarehåndtering, kostplanlægning, tilberedning og god køkkenhygiejne.
  • har blik for ernæringsmæssig kvalitet, variation og bæredygtighed.
  • kan følge faglige vejledninger, instruktioner og aftaler.
  • kan arbejde selvstændigt og samtidig indgå konstruktivt i et tæt samarbejde med kollegaer.
  • er stabil, fleksibel og serviceminded.
  • har kørekort.

Ansøgning
Der søges elektronisk, og ansøgningen skal vedlægges relevant dokumentation.

Ansøgningsfrist: 18. september 2026
Ansættelsessamtaler: Afholdes i uge 40
Forventet tiltrædelse: 1. november 2026

Løn og ansættelsesvilkår: Efter gældende overenskomst samt dokumenterbare kvalifikationer, der retter sig mod opgaverne.

Vil du vide mere?

Koordinator for service, Lene Pedersen Tlf. 55 88 32 20

title: Director, Civil Rights Memorial Center
description:
The SPLC is seeking a Deputy Director, Civil Rights Memorial Center who is passionate about social justice!

The Director, Civil Rights Memorial Center (CRMC) provides strategic, operational, and visionary leadership across all aspects of the CRMC. The Director is responsible for advancing the museum's mission, overseeing financial health, cultivating community relationships, leading staff, and serving as the primary ambassador to the community, partners, and the broader museum field. Provide direction and support for curatorial, educational, and public programming initiatives that reflect the museum's mission and community needs.

Who You Are

Visionary. You are a collaborative leader with a passion for history, cultural preservation, and community engagement, and a demonstrated ability to translate mission into strategy, action, and measurable impact.

Relationship Builder. You are an exceptional communicator who inspires trust, cultivates meaningful partnerships, and serves as a compelling ambassador with community leaders, funders, educators, elected officials, and other key stakeholders.

Strategic. You exhibit strong business and operational acumen, experienced in organizational leadership, financial stewardship, and balancing long-term planning with day-to-day execution.

Collaborative. You are an inclusive and empowering people leader who fosters a culture of collaboration, accountability, creativity, and continuous learning while developing and supporting high-performing teams.

Inclusive. You are committed to creating engaging, accessible, and inclusive cultural experiences that honor diverse histories, strengthen communities, and ensure the museum remains a vibrant resource for current and future generations.

Mission, Vision & Values Alignment. Demonstrates an understanding of and a commitment to SPLC's mission, vision and values.

What You'll Do

Develop and implement a long-range strategic plan in partnership with the executive team and staff that advances the museum's mission, broadens its community impact, and supports long-term organizational growth and sustainability.

Foster an organizational culture that values inclusion, collaboration, creativity, professional excellence, and accountability, while providing the executive team with timely and accurate quarterly reports on organizational performance and progress toward strategic goals.

Serve as a compelling public spokesperson and advocate for the museum, promoting the importance of history, cultural preservation, and community engagement throughout Alabama and beyond.

Lead and support community development initiatives and annual programmatic campaigns while cultivating and stewarding relationships with community partners, civic leaders, elected officials, schools, tourism partners, and other key stakeholders.

Identify, cultivate, negotiate, and maintain strategic partnerships that strengthen the museum's programs, expand its reach, enhance its financial health, and advance its mission.

Provide leadership and support for curatorial, educational, and public programming initiatives that reflect the museum's mission and respond to the needs and interests of diverse audiences, while championing diversity, equity, access, and inclusion in all exhibitions, programs, and interpretive approaches.

Ensure sound financial stewardship through the development and management of the annual operating budget, while maintaining the preservation, accessibility, and professional stewardship of the museum and its collections, and representing the museum through active participation in regional and national museum associations and affiliations.

Manage and develop a small team of staff through hiring, training, coaching, performance management, goal setting, work assignment, and regular performance evaluations.

Perform other duties as required or assigned which are within the scope of the duties in this job classification.

Minimum Qualifications

We are committed to equitable hiring practices, therefore you must meet the minimum qualifications to be considered for the role.

  • Minimum of 10 years' experience of progressive leadership experience in a museum or cultural center environment;
  • Minimum of 5 years' management experience in a museum, cultural institution, nonprofit, or related environment; and
  • High School Diploma or GED.

Compensation & Benefits

This is an exempt role and the minimum starting salary is $101,000 annually. Salary will be commensurate with experience.

Click here to view the benefits available to SPLC staff.

Where & How You'll Work

This role has the following work designation options:

  • Telework: Positions designated as telework eligible may work two days (16 hours) a week from an alternative work location.
  • This role is intended to report to the Chief Strategy Officer; however, during an interim period, it will report to the Director of Alabama State Office.

Other Special Considerations

This job is performed under general office conditions and is not subject to any strenuous physical demands or dangerous conditions.

Disclaimer:

The statements herein are intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed by the employee in this position. These statements are not intended to be construed as an exhaustive list of all responsibilities, duties, and skills required of a person in this position.

An Equal-Opportunity Employer with a Commitment to Diversity

Southern Poverty Law Center (SPLC) is proud to be an equal opportunity employer, and as an organization committed to diversity and the perspective of all voices, we consider applicants equally without regard to age, caregiver status, color, disability, ethnicity, gender, gender expression, gender identity, marital status, national origin, on the basis of genetic information, political affiliation, pregnancy, or veteran status.

title: Kok til daghold og cater til nathold hos LEGO System A/S i Billund – faste arbejdstider og plads til dit madhåndværk
description:
Vil du bruge dit madhåndværk i et moderne køkken – og have faste arbejdstider, der giver plads til livet uden for jobbet?

Hos LEGO System A/S i Billund søger vi lige nu to nye kollegaer: en kok til vores daghold og en cater til vores nathold.

Der er tale om to forskellige roller og arbejdstider – men fælles for dem er, at du bliver en del af et professionelt køkkenmiljø, hvor vi laver god mad til vores gæster og samarbejder om at skabe gode oplevelser hver dag.

To køkkener hos LEGO System A/S
Compass Group driver flere kantiner og køkkener hos LEGO System A/S, der hver dag sørger for gode madoplevelser til de mange mennesker, der har deres hverdag på campus.

Lige nu søger vi nye kollegaer til to forskellige køkkener: en kok til vores store kantine på LEGO Kornmarken Campus Nord, hvor vi hver dag laver mad til op mod 1.000 gæster, og en cater til LEGO Kornmarken Kantine, som har åbent døgnet rundt og servicerer omkring 380 gæster i løbet af et døgn.

De to køkkener har forskellige teams, opgaver og arbejdstider – så læs med nedenfor og se, hvilken af de to stillinger der passer bedst til dig.

Kok til daghold – 37 timer om ugen
I begyndelsen af 2026 åbnede LEGO Kornmarken Campus Nord – et nybygget hus med kontorer, mødelokaler og produktion. Her får du din hverdag i et moderne og velindrettet køkken med gode rammer for at bruge dit kokkehåndværk.

Som kok bliver du en del af et køkkenteam på 18 kollegaer med Mikkel Nielsen som køkkenchef. Sammen laver I hver dag mad til op mod 1.000 gæster.

Her starter dagen tidligt med forberedelser til dagens serveringer. Grøntsager snittes, kød steges, saucer simrer, og sammen sørger I for, at alt spiller, når gæsterne kommer til frokost. Vi laver mad fra bunden, arbejder med både varme og kolde retter og giver gerne plads til nye idéer og smage.

Du kommer blandt andet til at:

  • Tilberede varme og kolde retter med fokus på kvalitet og smag
  • Deltage i alle dele af køkkenets drift – fra forberedelse til servering
  • Bidrage med idéer og sætte dit faglige præg på maden
  • Samarbejde tæt med dine kollegaer om at skabe gode oplevelser for gæsterne

Du arbejder 37 timer om ugen mandag til fredag kl. 06.00-14.00. Det betyder, at du som udgangspunkt kan lægge forklædet fra dig kl. 14 og have fri hver eftermiddag, aften og weekend.

Cater til nathold – 30 timer om ugen
Trives du med at arbejde om natten, og kan du lide at have ansvar og arbejde selvstændigt? Så kan vores caterstilling være noget for dig.

Du bliver en del af et team på 12 kollegaer med Birgitte Poulsen som køkkenchef. Kantinen har åbent døgnet rundt, og omkring 380 gæster kommer forbi i løbet af et døgn.

På nattevagten arbejder du alene og har derfor selvstændigt ansvar for dine opgaver. Det kræver, at du er tryg ved at arbejde på egen hånd, kan skabe struktur i din vagt og sørger for, at opgaverne bliver løst.

Dine opgaver vil blandt andet være at:

  • Tilberede kolde og varme retter
  • Klargøre og fylde op i salatbaren
  • Varetage almindelige kantineopgaver
  • Sørge for rengøring og holde køkkenet pænt og ryddeligt
  • Sikre, at køkkenet er klar til den videre drift

Du arbejder 30 timer om ugen kl. 00.00-06.30 fra natten mellem søndag og mandag til fredag morgen.

Hvem er du?
Uanset hvilken af de to stillinger du søger, lægger vi vægt på, at du har glæde ved madhåndværket og tager ansvar for kvaliteten i dit arbejde.

Vi forestiller os desuden, at du:

  • Er uddannet kok, hvis du søger kokkestillingen, eller uddannet cater, hvis du søger caterstillingen
  • Har sans for kvalitet, smag og gode råvarer
  • Arbejder struktureret og bevarer overblikket, når der er fart på
  • Bidrager positivt til samarbejdet med dine kollegaer
  • Forstår og taler både dansk og engelsk

Søger du caterstillingen, er det samtidig vigtigt, at du trives med at arbejde alene og kan tage selvstændigt ansvar for nattens opgaver.

Det får du hos os

  • En fast stilling på enten 37 timer som kok eller 30 timer som cater
  • Faste arbejdstider – med fri eftermiddag, aften og weekend som kok og faste nattevagter som cater
  • Et professionelt køkkenmiljø med fokus på kvalitet og godt madhåndværk
  • Gode kollegaer og et stærkt samarbejde i teamet
  • Gode ansættelsesvilkår efter overenskomst med 11 % arbejdsgiverbetalt pension, 10 % fritvalgskonto, sundhedsordning og medarbejderrabatter
  • Et solidt bagland i Compass Group med gode muligheder for faglig udvikling

Vil du være med?
Send dit CV allerede i dag, og fortæl os, om du søger stillingen som kok eller cater.

Vi holder samtaler løbende og ansætter, når vi har fundet de rette kollegaer.

Opstart er snarest muligt eller efter aftale. Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig!

Har du spørgsmål til kokkestillingen, kan du kontakte køkkenchef Mikkel Nielsen på tlf. +45 2343 1678. Søger du caterstillingen, kan du kontakte køkkenchef Birgitte Poulsen på tlf. +45 2170 5828.

title: Android Architect
description:
ImagineX is a tech company that deploys AI-assisted teams to build and secure mission-critical enterprise solutions with our clients – spanning software, data, and AI. Structured like a software company, not a traditional consultancy, we blend deep technical expertise with authentic values, achieving world-class satisfaction (NPS 91). Our dedicated teams specialize in software, data, and AI across the U.S. and LATAM, bridging the gap between boutique agility and enterprise scale.

We're looking for an Android Architect to join our growing team. Our execution success is rooted in our unique model that is supported by our industry partners and specialists. The ImagineX culture thrives on entrepreneurship, risk taking, mutual trust, teamwork, encouraging change, and letting our consultants own their way of working.

This is a remote role, no additional travel required, aggressive salary and bonus packages, and 401K matching.

Duties:

You will be responsible for designing scalable, modular application architectures; providing deep technical leadership in Kotlin, Jetpack libraries, and modern Android development patterns; and collaborating closely with backend, design, and AI teams to define system integrations, API contracts, and end‑to‑end technical solutions. This role leads daily mob‑programming or collaborative engineering sessions to drive clarity, alignment, and consistent implementation across the team, while also reviewing complex code for architectural integrity, performance, and maintainability. You'll partner directly with clients and stakeholders to translate business requirements into actionable engineering plans, prototypes new or AI‑driven features to validate feasibility, and oversees the evolution of large, enterprise‑level Android codebases to ensure long‑term reliability, scalability, and technical excellence.

Required:

  • Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science or similar
  • Extensive Kotlin expertise, including:
    • Deep understanding of coroutines, flows, structured concurrency, and asynchronous programming
    • Strong command of advanced Kotlin features (sealed classes, inline functions, extension functions, generics, DSL construction)
    • Experience architecting and maintaining large-scale Kotlin applications in production
    • Ability to write idiomatic, testable, maintainable Kotlin code following modern best practices
    • Familiarity with the broader Kotlin ecosystem (Ktor, Kotlinx libraries, Gradle Kotlin DSL, etc.)
  • Experience designing and working with scalable architectures, including distributed systems, high‑availability patterns, and performance‑oriented design
  • Interest or experience working at the forefront of AI, including integrating AI services, building AI‑driven features, or working alongside ML/AI engineering teams
  • Strong verbal communication skills, with the clarity and confidence to lead or actively drive daily mob‑programming sessions
  • Experience with modern IDEs, source control systems, and continuous integration pipelines
  • Comfortable working with large codebases and navigating complex, evolving architectures

This role is based in the US and only open to citizens and permanent residents of the US who do not require visa sponsorship.

title: Power System Studies Project Manager - Data Center
description:
Company Description

We are Olsson. We engineer and design solutions that improve the world around us. As a company, we promise to always be responsive, transparent, and focused on results – for our people, our clients, and our company.

We’re a people-centric firm, so it’s no surprise our greatest asset is our people. The impact this creates is an environment that encourages our people to grow and be creative with their talents. This approach builds a culture that is uniquely Olsson. It allows us to grow our people as we grow our business. This, in turn, creates a lasting impact on the world around us.

Job Description

At Olsson, we are passionate about improving communities through expert engineering and design. Our people are our greatest asset, and we are committed to creating an environment where you can grow, lead, and make an impact.

Our Data Center team delivers multidisciplinary engineering and design services for some of the world's most innovative companies. These projects represent some of the largest and most complex infrastructure developments in the country, creating opportunities to solve challenging problems, collaborate across disciplines, and shape the facilities that support global connectivity.

We are seeking a Project Manager to lead the Short Circuit, Coordination, and Arc Flash (SCCAF) process for complex data center projects. In this role, you will bring clients, contractors, and technical teams together around the information, decisions, and milestones needed to deliver coordinated electrical studies. You will help move the work from kickoff through final reports and labels while supporting system reliability, personnel safety, and a smooth transition from design into construction.

What You'll Do

  • Serve as the primary point of contact for SCCAF coordination among the client, general contractor, electrical contractor, and Olsson engineering team.
  • Lead the SCCAF process from project kickoff through final reports and labels, keeping the work aligned with construction milestones and project priorities.
  • Develop and maintain a detailed SCCAF schedule, adjusting it as project information, equipment data, and construction activities evolve.
  • Coordinate the flow of SCCAF information and deliverables, including requests for information, submittals, equipment data, settings, labels, study revisions, and final reports.
  • Track required inputs and follow up with project partners to address missing information, field discrepancies, late design changes, or other items that may affect progress.
  • Plan, lead, and document SCCAF coordination meetings while maintaining clear action items, responsibilities, and follow-up.
  • Partner with technical teams to support quality, consistency, and alignment between SCCAF deliverables and approved construction documents.
  • Identify schedule, coordination, and project delivery risks early and work with stakeholders to develop practical solutions.
  • Support project management activities, including deliverable tracking, document control, invoicing coordination, project reporting, and adherence to Olsson's quality processes.

Qualifications

You are passionate about:

  • Working collaboratively with others.
  • Having ownership in the work you do.
  • Using your talents to positively affect communities.

You bring to the team:

  • Bachelor's degree in electrical engineering is strongly preferred. In lieu of a bachelor's degree, an associate degree with equivalent experience is required.
  • 4+ years of experience within the Architecture, Engineering, and Construction (AEC) industry with increasing project responsibilities.
  • 2+ years of project management, project coordination, or related leadership experience, which may be concurrent with overall project experience.
  • Familiarity with electrical engineering and design terminology. Experience supporting short circuit, coordination, arc flash, power studies, or construction-phase electrical work is beneficial.
  • Understanding of project schedules, contracts, project financials, documentation, and multidisciplinary coordination.

title: Data Engineer, Data Cloud International
description:
The Role

Zeta Global is seeking a Data Engineer to help accelerate the operationalization of Zeta’s Data Cloud across international markets.

Sitting within the Data Cloud International / commercial data partnerships function, this position will work closely with Business Operations, Applications, Product, Engineering, Compliance, and external partner technical teams.

The focus is practical data engineering: turning high-potential data partnerships into usable, repeatable, revenue-generating Data Cloud assets that support product innovation, market expansion, and commercial growth through disciplined evaluation, ingestion, transformation, validation, and documentation.

You will work primarily across AWS-based data workflows, using tools such as S3, Athena, Glue, SQL, Python, APIs, and orchestration frameworks such as Airflow. This is a hands-on, delivery-focused position suited to someone who enjoys turning technical data requirements into practical workflows.

You will also use AI-assisted tools and automation techniques to improve data evaluation, documentation, workflow generation, and internal productivity.

The position is based in Copenhagen, Denmark. Candidates should be able to commute regularly to the Copenhagen office, located in Copenhagen or near Copenhagen Central Station.

Roles & Responsibilities

• Build and automate data workflows for new and existing data partnerships.
• Create repeatable ingestion, transformation, and replication processes for partner data feeds.
• Evaluate incoming datasets for structure, usability, coverage, completeness, and quality.
• Write scripts to transform, normalize, move, and prepare data for analysis or downstream use.
• Use SQL and Athena to query large datasets, validate outputs, and generate reporting tables or extracts.
• Build lightweight validation checks for files, schemas, counts, formats, and expected values.
• Produce clear technical documentation, including field mappings, data dictionaries, process notes, data flow summaries, and partner integration documentation.
• Use AI-assisted tools where appropriate to accelerate data investigation, documentation, code generation, workflow prototyping, and repeatable analysis.
• Communicate with technical contacts at data partners via email and occasional technical calls.
• Help translate partner data delivery requirements into practical ingestion and automation workflows.
• Work with internal teams across Operations, Product, Engineering, Compliance, and Data Cloud.
• Contribute to reusable templates, naming conventions, and documentation standards for partner data onboarding.

Required Qualifications

• Strong written and spoken English is required, as the role works across international teams and external data partners.
• 3–5 years of relevant experience, or equivalent practical experience, in data engineering, analytics engineering, technical data operations, cloud data automation, or a similar role.
• Practical experience writing SQL to query, validate, and transform data.
• Hands-on experience with Python for scripting, automation, or data manipulation.
• Familiarity with AWS data services, especially S3 and Athena; experience with Glue is strongly preferred.
• Understanding of ETL/ELT concepts and how data moves between systems.
• Experience working with structured and semi-structured data formats, including large delimited files, JSON, Parquet, or ORC.
• Comfortable reading technical documentation and working with API-based data sources.
• Ability to work with large datasets and investigate issues in schemas, counts, formats, or transformation outputs.
• Comfortable collaborating with internal technical teams and external partner technical contacts.
• Able to work independently on defined tasks while escalating ambiguity, blockers, or risks appropriately.

Required Skills

• Business-level English communication
• SQL
• Python
• AWS S3, Athena, and Glue / Glue Data Catalog
• ETL/ELT workflows
• Data ingestion and replication
• APIs and file-based data exchange
• Airflow, Prefect, or similar orchestration tools
• Snowflake, Databricks, Redshift, Hive, Presto, or similar data platforms
• Git or similar version control
• Data validation and quality checks
• Data dictionaries, field mappings, and technical documentation
• Structured and semi-structured data formats, including JSON, Parquet, ORC, and large delimited files
• Working knowledge of S3 policies, IAM permissions, and secure data access patterns
• Practical use of AI-assisted development, documentation, or data analysis tools

title: Socialrådgiver til det specialiserede team i Job og Socialindsats Ishøj Kommune
description:
Socialrådgiver til det specialiserede team i Job og Socialindsats – Ishøj Kommune

Er du drevet af faglig udvikling? Har du flair for at navigere i komplekse og svære situationer? Er du nysgerrig, videbegærlig og har du en stor portion gå-på-mod? Så er det måske dig, vi mangler!

Om stillingen

Job og Socialindsats er en del af Center for Social og Beskæftigelse i Ishøj Kommune og varetager myndighedsopgaver inden for både social- og beskæftigelsesområdet.

Vi søger en socialrådgiver til vores specialiserede team, som varetager myndighedsopgaver på det specialiserede socialområde.

I det specialiserede team møder du et stærkt fagligt miljø, hvor der er højt til loftet, plads til humor og masser af gode grin i hverdagen. Vi er et team med høj faglighed og stærke kollegiale relationer, hvor vi hjælper hinanden og sparrer om de komplekse problemstillinger, vi møder i arbejdet.

Som rådgiver har du en høj grad af selvstændighed og indflydelse på tilrettelæggelsen af din egen arbejdsdag. Vi lægger vægt på frihed under ansvar, fleksibilitet, faglig sparring og tryghed.

Du får en sagsstamme på omkring 50 sager, hvilket giver gode muligheder for at arbejde grundigt, følge op og fordybe dig i den enkelte sag.

Om målgruppen

Det specialiserede team arbejder med borgere, som ofte har behov for omfattende og længerevarende indsatser. Målgruppen er bred og spænder blandt andet over mennesker med psykisk sårbarhed, fysiske funktionsnedsættelser, udviklingshandicap og misbrugsproblematikker.

Det er borgere, som til tider befinder sig i meget svære livssituationer, og som kan have komplekse og sammensatte behov.

Som rådgiver er din fornemmeste opgave at understøtte borgeren i at få et så selvstændigt og meningsfuldt liv som muligt. Vi tror på, at borgeren er ekspert i eget liv, og vi arbejder derfor med udgangspunkt i borgerens ønsker, ressourcer og muligheder.

Vi skal turde lytte – også når løsningen ikke er den mest oplagte – og samtidig bruge vores faglighed til at finde den rette indsats sammen med borgeren.

Faglighed og økonomisk bevidsthed går hånd i hånd

Vi har et stærkt fokus på kvalitet, effekt og sammenhæng mellem faglig indsats og økonomi.

Vi arbejder tæt på både borgere og tilbud og har fokus på, om de indsatser, der leveres, fortsat matcher borgerens behov, samt om pris, indhold og kvalitet hænger sammen med de aftaler og kontrakter, der er indgået.

Derfor indgår rådgiverne også i dialog og forhandling med tilbuddene, når der er behov for det.

Du skal derfor have mod på at tage de faglige og økonomiske drøftelser med samarbejdspartnere og tilbud – altid med borgerens behov og den faglige vurdering som udgangspunkt.

Dine kerneopgaver
  • Visitation til og opfølgning på indsatser efter SEL §§ 103, 104, 105/85, 107, 108 og 117
  • Afholdelse af borgersamtaler i forbindelse med afklaring og opfølgning
  • Råd og vejledning til borgere og samarbejdspartnere
  • Handleplansarbejde og handleplansmøder
  • Tæt opfølgning på borgere og tilbud
  • Dialog og forhandling med tilbud og leverandører
  • Borgerkontakt og relationsarbejde
  • Faglig sparring og samarbejde på tværs af fagområder og organisationen
  • Deltagelse i faglige udviklingstiltag og tværgående opgaver
  • Varetagelse af et fagligt speciale, eksempelvis unge/voksne

Vi arbejder med VUM 2.0, og det er en fordel, hvis du har erfaring med den metode.


Hvem er du?
  • Har gode kommunikative og skriftlige kompetencer
  • Har gerne erfaring fra det specialiserede socialområde – men det er ikke et krav
  • Kan arbejde selvstændigt og ansvarsbevidst og samtidig indgå aktivt i faglig sparring
  • Arbejder systematisk og struktureret og kan skabe overblik over en kompleks sagsportefølje
  • Er nysgerrig og videbegærlig og har lyst til hele tiden at udvikle din faglighed
  • Kan samarbejde på mange forskellige niveauer og ser samarbejde som en vigtig forudsætning for god sagsbehandling
  • Kan navigere i en hverdag, hvor prioriteringer og opgaver kan ændre sig
  • Er tillidsvækkende og imødekommende og kommunikerer med borgerne i øjenhøjde
  • Har blik for borgerens ressourcer, ønsker og udviklingsmuligheder
  • Er økonomisk bevidst og kan se sammenhængen mellem faglige vurderinger, indsatser og økonomi
  • Arbejder med ordentlighed og har ambitioner på både borgernes og faglighedens vegne
  • Har mod på at tage ansvar og gå ind i de svære samtaler – også med samarbejdspartnere og tilbud
Vi tilbyder
  • Et stærkt fagligt team med høj grad af selvbestemmelse
  • Et arbejdsmiljø præget af tillid, humor, fællesskab og selvstændighed
  • Gode muligheder for faglig sparring og udvikling
  • En arbejdsplads, hvor der er plads til diversitet og forskellige perspektiver
  • En sagsstamme, der giver mulighed for grundighed og fordybelse
  • En grundig introduktion til området
  • En struktureret onboardingplan med både en primær og sekundær mentorkollega
  • Mulighed for at få indflydelse på udviklingen af det specialiserede socialområde i en organisation i udvikling
Praktisk information

Det er en fordel, at du har kørekort, da du vil skulle deltage i møder hos borgere, samarbejdspartnere og tilbud. Ishøj Kommune stiller bil til rådighed. Kørekort er dog ikke et krav.

Stillingen er på 37 timer ugentligt.

Løn og ansættelsesvilkår sker efter gældende overenskomst, herunder principperne om Ny Løn.

Ansøgningsfrist: 23.9.2026

Samtaler: Afholdes løbende eller senest i uge 40.

Har du spørgsmål til stillingen, er du meget velkommen til at kontakte afdelingsleder Signe-Marie på sigan@ishoj.dk

Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig!

title: Humoristisk og energisk hjælper med kendskab til epilepsi søges til 15-årig pige i Greve - ca. 10 timer/måned
description:
Er du sygeplejestuderende, SSA-elev eller ufaglært med erfaring inden for epilepsi og sondeernæring – eller har du lyst til at blive grundigt oplært? Så er dette måske noget for dig.

Om borgeren

Vi søger en sjov, sprælsk og nærværende hjælper til en skøn 15-årig pige, som vægter selskab og hyggelige stunder højt. Pigen bor med sin familie i naturskønne omgivelser tæt på vandet, hvor der er oplagte muligheder for hyggelige stunder og fælles oplevelser.

Hun er en glad pige med god humor og stor glæde ved samvær, nærhed og spontane turer ud af huset. Hun har en særlig interesse for heste og nyder ture i naturen.

Pigen har Retts syndrom og en betydelig fysisk og kognitiv funktionsnedsættelse. Hun er nonverbal, men kommunikerer via mimik og god øjenkontakt, som er en vigtig del af samspillet med hende. Derudover kommunikerer hun også via en eye gaze-computer (øjenstyret computer). Derudover har hun epilepsi og har fået anlagt en VNS (Vagus Nerve Stimulator), hvor magnet anvendes i forbindelse med anfald.

Hun er kørestolsbruger, og der vil forekomme forflytninger ved hjælp af lift i arbejdet.

Arbejdsopgaver

Dine opgaver vil bl.a. være:

  • At skabe trygge og hyggelige rammer i samværet med pigen
  • At deltage i hendes aftenrutine og putning
  • Let personlig pleje og forflytninger med lift
  • At give sondemad og medicin efter oplæring
  • At observere og håndtere epileptiske anfald

Du vil altid blive oplært grundigt af familien og introduceret til alle opgaver, så du føler dig tryg.

Arbejdstid

  • Ca. 10 timer pr. måned (timerne samles på max tre dage pr. måned)
  • Primært hverdage i tidsrummet kl. 17–21
  • Vagter planlægges løbende i samarbejde med familien

Om dig

Vi forestiller os, at du:

  • Er omsorgsfuld, tålmodig og er udadvendt
  • Kan skabe relation gennem både ro og opmærksomhed, men også besidder evnen til at finde din indre spasmager frem
  • Er tryg ved (eller motiveret for at lære) sondeernæring og epilepsihåndtering
  • Kan bevare overblik og ro i akutte situationer i forbindelse med epileptiske anfald
  • Har en positiv tilgang og lyst til at gøre en forskel

Erfaring er en fordel, men ikke et krav – det vigtigste er din tilgang og vilje til at lære.

Hvem er Olivia Danmark ?

  • Vi står for kvalitet, viden og dedikation og arbejder med det daglig.
  • Vi tror på ordentlighed i alt det, vi gør
  • Vi arbejder med at vi meningsfuldt forskellige
  • Vi tager ansvar og skaber løsninger – hver dag

Ansøgning og kontakt

Ansøg stillingen hurtigst muligt eller inden deadline. Vi kalder løbende til samtale, så skriv gerne til os i dag.

Har du spørgsmål til jobbet, er du velkommen til at kontakte Mie Baungaard Johannsen på mail mie.johannsen@oliviadanmark.dk

Vi ser frem til at høre fra dig.

title: PhD Scholarship within the Research Project Not Liking School: Lived Experience of School Emotions
description:
The Department of Culture and Communication at Aalborg University invites applications for a fully funded 3-year PhD scholarship beginning on 1 January 2027, or as soon as possible thereafter. The position is fixed term and full-time and includes both research and teaching activities.

The PhD scholarship is part of the research project Not Liking School: Lived Experience of School Emotions, funded by Independent Research Fund Denmark. The project is based at the Centre for Education Policy Research and explores lived experiences of not liking school in Danish comprehensive schooling from the late 1950s and onwards. Through a combination of history of emotions, educational history, historical ethnography, and policy analysis, the project explores how students' discomfort with, resistance to, and disengagement from school have been lived, understood, and addressed over time. The project explores how students expressed dissatisfaction through practices such as truancy, silence, restlessness, withdrawal, classroom disruption, and school protests, and how these experiences were addressed through pedagogical and policy responses.

The overall aim of the PhD project is to explore the lived experiences of former students in the Danish folkeskole, with particular attention to school strikes and other forms of resistance, disengagement, and withdrawal from school life. Through ethnographic history interviews and related qualitative methods, the PhD fellow will explore how students experienced, negotiated, and articulated dissatisfaction with schooling. The PhD fellow will contribute to the development of the project's conceptual framework on school emotions and not liking school and participate actively in an interdisciplinary research environment that brings together educational history, history of emotions, ethnography, and policy studies. Further description of the project can be found here: and here: Can history help us understand why children do not like going to school?

The project is led by Associate Professor Mante Vertelyte (PI), Department of Culture and Communication. Associate Professor Mante Vertelyte (principal supervisor) and Professor Mette Buchardt (co-supervisor) will supervise the PhD project. The successful applicant will become part of an international research environment that includes international collaborations and research stays abroad.

Qualification requirements
PhD stipends are allocated to individuals who hold a Master’s degree. PhD stipends are normally for a period of 3 years. It is a prerequisite for allocation of the stipend that the candidate will be enrolled as a PhD student at the Doctoral School of Social Sciences and Humanities in accordance with the regulations of Ministerial Order No. 1124 of September 19, 2025 on the PhD Programme at the Universities and Certain Higher Artistic Educational Institutions. According to the Ministerial Order, the progress of the PhD student shall be assessed at regular points in time. As part of the PhD study, you are among other things required to complete PhD courses corresponding to 30 ECTS, gain experience with teaching or other forms of knowledge dissemination and complete an external research stay outside of Aalborg University, preferably 3-6 months at a foreign research institution.

SSH PhD candidates must have achieved the grade 10 or above in the Danish grading system (or the equivalent in a different grading system) for their Master’s Thesis/final exam. Please visit the website of the doctoral school for further information on admission requirements.

Who we are
The Department of Culture and Communication deals with human life in its complexity. We ask fundamental questions about life and contribute knowledge about how human beings create meaning, interact, flourish and participate in society. The Department has activities at both Campus Aalborg and Campus Copenhagen. Read more about the Department here.

The position is affiliated with the research group: Centre for Education Policy Research

How to apply
Your application, written in English, must include the following:

  • Application stating reasons for applying and qualifications in relation to the position
  • Curriculum Vitae (CV)
  • Diplomas (bachelor's and master's degree diploma, including grades)
  • Project description (approx. 5 pages). Read more about the project description
  • Applicants WHO are planning to complete a doctoral thesis in English and who do not have English as a first language or WHO have not completed an English language-based Master's programme (or an equivalent educational achievement in English) shall provide documentation that they have passed one of the following official tests with the respective minimum score: IELTS (band score): 7, TOEFL (paper-based): 600, TOEFL (internet-based): 100. The language test must be no more than five years old at the time of the application. Read more on how to document your English qualifications.
  • Other relevant documents

The application must be submitted via Aalborg University’s recruitment system, which can be accessed under the job advertisement on Aalborg University's website.

Aalborg University wants to reflect the surrounding society and has diversity as a core value. Therefore, everyone, regardless of personal background and orientation, is encouraged to apply for the position.

Do you have any questions?
If you have any questions about the position, you are more than welcome to contact us. You will find contact persons at the bottom of the jobpost.

Interviews are expected to take place in the first week of December 2026.

Further information
Read more about our recruitment process here.

The assessment of candidates for the position will be carried out by qualified experts.
Shortlisting will be applied. This means that after the application deadline, the head of the department, with the assistance of the hiring committee, will select the applicants to be assessed. All applicants will be informed whether they have been shortlisted for assessment or not.

The hiring process at Aalborg University may include a risk assessment as a tool to identify potential risks associated with new hires, ensuring the safety, compliance, and integrity of the workplace.

Read more about The Doctoral School of Social Sciences and Humanities

Salary and terms of employment
The employment is in accordance with the Ministerial Order on the Appointment of Academic Staff at Universities (the Appointment Order) and the Ministerial Order on Job Structure for Academic Staff at Universities (in Danish).

Salary and terms of employment are in accordance with the collective agreement between the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations and the state (AC collective agreement) (in Danish)

There is a mutual probationary period of 3 months for the position.

Aalborg University - Knowledge for the world
Aalborg University is an international workplace with more than 3,700 employees. We offer real-world-oriented education and create world-class research results through collaboration between researchers, students, and public and private companies. This is how we achieve insights, new solutions to societal problems, and knowledge that changes the world. Our main campus is in Aalborg, but we also have campuses in Esbjerg and Copenhagen.
