title: BDC Service Representative - Audi Stuart!
description:
BDC Service Representative | Audi Stuart (Stuart, FL)
Part of the Murgado Automotive Group

Love connecting with people, solving problems over the phone, and being the reason, customers choose (and stay with) a luxury brand? Audi Stuart is hiring a BDC Service Representative who turns service inquiries into booked appointments and lasting relationships.

This isn’t a traditional call-center job. You’ll be the first voice of Audi Stuart’s service department—helping owners keep their vehicles performing at their best while you build a career with clear earnings potential and real growth paths inside a top-tier automotive group.

What’s in it for you

  • Competitive base pay + performance bonuses tied to appointments set and shown
  • Full benefits package: medical, dental, vision, and 401(k) with company match
  • Employee discounts on vehicle purchases, parts, and service
  • Clear career paths within Audi Stuart and the broader Murgado Automotive Group
  • Modern facility and tools, supportive team culture, and the prestige of representing the Audi brand on Florida’s Treasure Coast
  • Ongoing training so you can grow your skills and earnings

What you’ll do

You’ll own the customer conversation from first contact through a smooth handoff to the service team:

  • Handle inbound service calls, texts, emails, and online inquiries with professionalism and warmth
  • Proactively reach out to customers about maintenance reminders, recalls, declined services, and specials
  • Schedule and confirm appointments accurately while coordinating with service advisors
  • Keep CRM and dealership systems updated so every customer interaction is documented and seamless
  • Hit (and beat) daily/monthly appointment and contact goals while promoting service specials
  • Deliver the kind of experience that makes Audi owners feel taken care of and eager to return

Who thrives here

  • Strong phone presence and genuine customer-service mindset
  • Ability to multitask, stay organized, and keep a positive attitude in a fast-paced environment
  • Comfort with CRM systems and basic computer tools (Microsoft Office experience is a plus)
  • Previous BDC, call-center, customer-service, or dealership experience preferred—but we value attitude, coachability, and communication skills most
  • Basic familiarity with automotive service is helpful; we’ll train you on Audi processes and terminology

Location: On-site at Audi Stuart in Stuart, FL
Schedule: Full-time (typical dealership service hours; details discussed in interview)

Apply today and help us deliver the exceptional experience Audi customers expect!

If you’re ready to be the trusted first point of contact for Audi owners and grow with a dealership that invests in its people, we’d love to hear from you.

Murgado Automotive Group is an equal opportunity employer. Murgado Automotive Group does not discriminate in employment on account of race/ethnicity, color, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation/transgender status, age disability, martial/parental status, citizenship status, military status, political affiliation and/or beliefs, pregnancy, order of protection status or other non-merit status.
We are an employer who participates in the E-verify program with the Department of Homeland and Security.

title: Vil du være med til at gøre den grønne trepart til virkelighed?
company: Styrelsen for Grøn Arealomlægning og Vandmiljø Odense C
description:
Har du naturfaglige kompetencer, og vil du være med til at implementere den Grønne Trepartsaftale gennem spændende tilskudsopgaver? Vil du være en del af et fagligt stærkt arbejdsmiljø med gode udviklingsmuligheder? Så er du måske vores nye kollega i Styrelsen for Grøn Arealomlægning og Vandmiljø.

Vil du være en del af et fagligt stærkt team til gavn for miljøet
Vi søger en kollega til vores enhed ”Tilskud – Vand & Natur”, som har ansvaret for at udvikle og administrere nogle af de tilskudsordninger, der skal hjælpe med at omlægge landbrugsjord til natur, samt sikre bedre vandløb.

”Vi har rigtig mange interessante og spændende opgaver inden for tilskudsområdet, som skal løses de kommende år: vi skal forsætte arbejdet med at give tilskud til vand og natur, dvs. tilskud til at lave kvælstofvådområder, restaurere vandløbene og udtage lavbundsjorde. Vi skal også fortsat have fuld fokus på den nye tilskudsordning til skovrejsning og vi skal arbejde videre med it-systemet MARS” fortæller kontorchef, Bettina Helle Jensen.

Det kan vi tilbyde dig som kollega i Tilskud – Vand og Natur
I ”Tilskud – Vand og Natur” er vi ca. 35 der arbejder med tilskudsordninger til ny natur. Vi administrerer bl.a. tilskudsordninger til udtagning af lavbundsjord, skovrejsning, etablering af vådområder og restaurering af vandløb og søer. Derudover arbejder vi også med at understøtte arbejdet i de lokale treparter og omlægningsplanerne, bl.a. ved at udvikle it-systemet MARS.

Vi arbejder i teams, og fælles for hele enheden er, at du bliver en del af en tillidsfuld, forpligtende og humørfyldt enhed, hvor vi prioriterer et inspirerende arbejdsmiljø og god stemning i hverdagen. Vi hjælper og sparrer med hinanden i vores opgaveløsning, og skaber resultater af høj faglig kvalitet.

Vi søger en AC-kollega til teamet sikker drift, som arbejder med sagsbehandlingen og tilskudsordningerne til vand og natur.
Du vil indgå i et team, hvor du sammen med dine kolleger, skal løse opgaverne med at administrere tilskudsordningerne til udtagning af lavbundsjorde, etablering af kvælstofvådområder og vandløbsrestaurering. Opgaverne vil både være at sagsbehandle ansøgninger, samt at bidrage til at sikre et korrekt og robust administrationsgrundlag. Da det er tilskud til arealomlægning, vil der også være opgaver med GIS og Excel. Der vil være kommunikation med kommunerne og de øvrige aktører (lodsejere og interesseorganisationer) ligesom du også vil skulle samarbejde med departementet. Det forventes derfor at du er stærk i både skriftlig og mundtlig kommunikation.

Dine opgaver
I samarbejde med kollegaer og ledelsen kommer du til at:

  • Sagsbehandle og afgøre ansøgninger om tilskud.
  • Udarbejde og levere skriftligt materiale fx vejledninger til ansøgerne.
  • Bidrage til administrationen af forskellige tilskudsordninger.
  • Sikre det faglige grundlag for tilskudsordningerne, herunder at vi har korrekt data (effektdata m.m.).
Du bliver involveret i forskelligartede opgaver og får mange kontaktflader både i Styrelsen for Grøn Arealomlægning og Vandmiljø, andre styrelser, departementet og kommuner.
”Vi understøtter arbejdet med at implementere aftalen om et grønt Danmark, og har fokus på effektiv tilskudsadministration, så f.eks. kommuner, lodsejere og fonde kan gennemføre naturprojekter. Det er vigtigt, at vi opleves som en effektiv og professionel samarbejdspartner” uddyber Bettina.

Vi forestiller os, at du:

  • Har viden om tilskudsadministration, naturforvaltning og implementering af politiske beslutninger i praksis.
  • Arbejder løsningsorienteret og har forståelse for arbejdet i en faglig styrelse.
  • Kommunikerer klart både i skrift og tale, og har lyst til at gå i dialog både internt og eksternt.
  • Har lyst til at kombinere faglighed med de juridiske rammer inden for sagsbehandling.
  • Har erfaring med GIS og Excel.
  • Har et positivt sind og lyst til at bidrage til vores fællesskab.
Din faglige baggrund kan være inden for det naturfaglige fx biolog, forstkandidat, agronom, miljøingeniør, cand.scient. eller lignende. Har du erfaring med tilskudsadministration eller offentlig administration er det en stor fordel, men det vigtigste er, at du vil bidrage til god forvaltning og har lyst til at sætte dig ind i nye fagsystemer.

Ansættelsesvilkår
Løn- og ansættelsesvilkår fastsættes ud fra erfaring og anciennitet og i henhold til overenskomst for akademikere i staten.

Dit ansættelsesområde vil være Ministeriet for Natur og Dyrevelfærd med tilhørende institutioner, og tjenestestedet er Styrelsen for Grøn Arealomlægning og Vandmiljø, Lerchesgade 35, 5000 Odense C.

Stillingen er fuldtid og ønskes besat snarest muligt.

Yderligere oplysninger
Hvis du vil vide mere, er du velkommen til at kontakte kontorchef Bettina Helle Jensen på
tlf. 41 39 24 04 eller teamleder Rikke Thomle Andersen på tlf. 20 99 60 55.

Ansøgning
Søg stillingerne ved at sende en ansøgning inkl. CV, eksamensbevis og evt. referencer senest tirsdag den 15. september 2026.
Vi forventer at holde samtaler i Odense den 22. september 2026

title: Director of Sustainability
description:
Our mission at Oura is to empower every person to own their inner potential. Our award-winning products help our global community gain a deeper knowledge of their readiness, activity, and sleep quality by using their Oura Ring and its connected app. We've helped millions of people understand and improve their health by providing daily insights and practical steps to inspire healthy lifestyles.

Empowering the world starts with living our values and empowering our team. As a quickly growing company focused on helping people live healthier and happier lives, we ensure that our team members have what they need to do their best work — both in and out of the office.

We are looking for a Director, Sustainability to lead Oura’s enterprise sustainability strategy and build the systems that will support it.

This is a new director-level role and the first dedicated sustainability leader at Oura. The role sits in Supply Chain because many of Oura’s most important sustainability decisions involve materials, suppliers, manufacturing, logistics, packaging, returns, recycling, and product end of life. Supply Chain gives the role a direct connection to the teams and partners that can turn strategy into action. The role also has company-wide responsibility. It will partner with Manufacturing, Sourcing, Logistics, Quality, Finance, Legal, Marketing, and Customer Experience to put that strategy into practice.

The Sustainability Director will develop Oura’s point of view on sustainability at a company level. They will work with Product, Industrial Design, Hardware Engineering, and Supply Chain technical leaders to decide how sustainability should shape the product roadmap, design choices, materials, manufacturing, and supplier strategy. They will set a practical roadmap and define how we will measure progress across environmental sustainability, responsible sourcing, product lifecycle impact, regulatory readiness, and relevant social and governance topics.

This role will suit someone who can set direction, work through details, and build relationships across the company. The person in this role will need to make sound decisions with incomplete information and explain the tradeoffs clearly.

This is a hybrid role based in our San Francisco, California office. The expectation is to be onsite at least two to three days per week.

What You Will Do

Set Oura’s enterprise sustainability strategy

  • Define Oura’s sustainability principles and multi-year roadmap with input from Product, Industrial Design, Hardware Engineering, and Supply Chain technical leaders.

  • Establish a way to prioritize work based on impact, member and brand relevance, regulatory exposure, business value, feasibility, and supplier leverage.

  • Recommend the areas where Oura should invest first and explain the reasoning to senior leadership.

  • Track changes in regulations, customer expectations, supplier capabilities, and industry practice.

  • Set targets, measures, decision forums, and investment requirements.

Build the operating model

  • Work with Product, Industrial Design, Hardware Engineering, and Supply Chain technical teams to put sustainability into product requirements, design reviews, sourcing decisions, supplier selection, manufacturing readiness, logistics planning, packaging, returns, and end-of-life planning.

  • Define ownership across the functions involved in sustainability work.

  • Create a scorecard and review cadence for executives, product teams, category teams, and suppliers.

  • Build the team and capability plan for the function.

  • Create standards, templates, and training that help teams apply sustainability in their work.

Reduce product and supply-chain impact

  • Build a baseline for Oura’s product and supply-chain footprint, including Scope 1, 2, and 3 emissions where relevant.

  • Identify the highest-value opportunities to reduce emissions, waste, and resource use across materials, manufacturing, packaging, freight, returns, repair, recycling, and end of life.

  • Partner with Product, Industrial Design, Hardware Engineering, and Supply Chain technical teams on material choices, durability, repairability, recyclability, lifecycle impact, and the tradeoffs that shape the product roadmap.

  • Work with Manufacturing and contract manufacturers on energy use, renewable energy, waste, material utilization, and environmental performance.

  • Work with Logistics on freight emissions, service levels, launch timing, resilience, and landed cost.

  • Set a clear policy for the use of carbon credits or offsets.

Improve supplier sustainability

  • Own Oura’s supplier sustainability and corporate responsibility program with Sourcing, Quality, Legal, and Manufacturing.

  • Set supplier expectations, onboarding requirements, scorecards, risk segments, corrective-action plans, and escalation paths.

  • Use EcoVadis, SA8000, ISO 14001, Dodd-Frank, and other relevant standards to improve supplier performance and manage risk.

  • Build a supplier partnership program that includes training, data sharing, remediation, and follow-up.

  • Lead supplier assessments across environmental performance, labor and human rights, ethical sourcing, responsible minerals, and other material risks.

  • Include sustainability performance in category strategy, supplier selection, contracts, business reviews, and partner development.

Manage measurement, compliance, and reporting

  • Build the data and controls needed for reliable sustainability measurement.

  • Work with Legal, Finance, Quality, and other teams on requirements related to EPR, WEEE, RoHS, REACH, UFLPA, CSRD-related requests, and other relevant regulations.

  • Review sustainability claims, supplier requirements, customer responses, and external disclosures for accuracy and support.

  • Prepare sustainability updates for employees, customers, retailers, senior leadership, and the Board as needed.

  • Report progress, gaps, tradeoffs, and areas where Oura is still building capability.

Lead across Oura

  • Serve as Oura’s enterprise sustainability leader and senior internal advisor.

  • Set the sustainability agenda for senior leadership and help teams make decisions that account for cost, quality, schedule, resilience, customer experience, brand, and environmental impact.

  • Represent Oura with suppliers, contract manufacturers, customers, retailers, industry groups, NGOs, regulators, and external partners.

  • Build relationships with experts and peer companies to keep Oura’s approach current.

  • Communicate Oura’s priorities and progress clearly, using evidence that can stand up to scrutiny.

Requirements

We would love to have you on our team if you have:

  • 10+ years of experience in sustainability, responsible supply chain, product sustainability, environmental strategy, manufacturing, operations, or a related field.

  • Significant experience working with hardware, consumer electronics, wearables, or another product-based business.

  • Experience defining and executing an enterprise sustainability strategy with product and technical teams.

  • Experience building a new function, operating model, or cross-functional program.

  • A strong understanding of product lifecycle impact, manufacturing, contract manufacturing, sourcing, logistics, materials, packaging, reverse logistics, and end of life.

  • Experience with carbon accounting, emissions reduction, lifecycle assessment, supplier sustainability, environmental and social due diligence, and sustainability reporting.

  • Working knowledge of frameworks and regulations such as the GHG Protocol, EPR, WEEE, RoHS, REACH, UFLPA, ISO 14001, SA8000, EcoVadis, Dodd-Frank, CDP, GRI, or SASB.

  • The ability to evaluate tradeoffs across cost, quality, schedule, resilience, customer experience, brand, and environmental impact.

  • Strong executive communication skills and the ability to turn complex topics into clear recommendations.

  • Experience working directly with Product, Industrial Design, Hardware Engineering, Supply Chain technical teams, and other functions across geographies.

  • Experience hiring, developing, or leading people and building capability through external partners.

  • Experience working with suppliers, customers, retailers, industry groups, NGOs, or regulators.

  • A practical and evidence-based approach to sustainability.

  • Willingness to travel internationally up to 25–30% as needed.

Preferred qualifications

  • Experience shaping product strategy and adding sustainability requirements to product development, design reviews, sourcing events, supplier contracts, or manufacturing readiness reviews.

  • Experience with repairability, circularity, e-waste, recycled materials, packaging, freight emissions, or renewable energy in manufacturing.

  • Experience responding to retailer, customer, investor, or regulatory sustainability requests.

  • Experience building sustainability data models, dashboards, or reporting controls.

  • Graduate degree in sustainability, environmental science, engineering, supply chain, public policy, business, or a related field.

Benefits

At Oura, we care about you and your well-being. Everyone here at Oura has a ring of their own and we are continually looking to improve employee health.

What we offer:

  • Competitive salary and equity packages
  • Health, dental, vision insurance, and mental health resources
  • An Oura Ring of your own plus employee discounts for friends & family
  • 20 days of paid time off plus 13 paid holidays plus 8 days of flexible wellness time off
  • Paid sick leave and parental leave

Oura takes a market-based approach to pay, which may vary depending on your location. US locations are categorized into tiers based on a cost of labor index for that geographic area. While most offers will be closer to the starting range, successful candidates' pay will be determined based on job-related skills, experience, qualifications, work location, internal peer equity, and market conditions. These ranges may be modified in the future.

San Francisco Salary Range: $226,100 - $266,000

Oura is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. Individuals seeking employment at Oura are considered without regard to age, ancestry, color, gender (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), gender identity or expression, genetic information, marital status, medical condition, mental or physical disability, national origin, protected family care or medical leave status, race, religion (including beliefs and practices or the absence thereof), sexual orientation, military or veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local laws. We will not tolerate discrimination or harassment based on any of these characteristics.

We will work to ensure individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment.

Disclaimer: Beware of fake job offers!
We’ve been alerted to scammers posing as ŌURA recruiters, especially for remote roles. Please note:

  • Our jobs are listed only on the ŌURA Careers page and trusted job boards.
  • We will never ask for personal information like ID or payment for equipment upfront.
  • Official offers are sent through Docusign after a verbal offer, not via text or email.

Stay cautious and protect your personal details.

To all recruitment agencies: Oura does not accept agency resumes. Please do not forward resumes to our jobs alias, Oura employees, or any other organization's location. Oura is not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes.

title: Børnehaveklasseleder til Solskinsskolen – Skælskør Skole
description:
Vi søger en fagligt velfunderet og engageret børnehaveklasseleder, der brænder for at give vores yngste elever en tryg og lærerig start på skolelivet.

Du kan omsætte læringsmålene til konkret og meningsfuld læring og skabe en varieret skoledag, hvor leg, læring, bevægelse, nysgerrighed og fællesskab går hånd i hånd. Du har lyst til at være med til at udvikle vores praksis og samarbejde tæt med både kolleger og forældre om at skabe de bedste rammer for elevernes trivsel og læring.

Vi leder efter dig, der både har fagligheden, engagementet og hjertet med, når du arbejder med skolens yngste elever.

For stillingen er gælder det, at du skal være indstillet på at indgå i et tæt teamsamarbejde med andre lærere og pædagoger, hvor man deler opgaverne mellem sig og arbejder systematisk sammen i klasserummet.

I dette skoleår har vi særligt fokus på det fortsatte arbejde med implementeringen af NEST som grundform, der skal være med til at skabe en rød tråd i arbejdet med inklusion i alle skolens klasser.

Vi har reduceret undervisningstimetallet for at sikre flest mulige to-voksen-timer i undervisningen og har et maksimalt timetal på 25 lektioner for en lærer på fuld tid.

Vi lægger vægt på, at du
  • har lyst til at udvikle din undervisning i samspil med kolleger
  • er nysgerrig på nye tiltag og trives i et læringsmiljø præget af udvikling
  • har godt humør og en positiv tilgang til både samarbejde og undervisning
  • ønsker at bidrage aktivt til skolens fokus på inklusion og praksisfaglighed

Vi tilbyder
  • en arbejdsplads med fokus på teamsamarbejde og faglig sparring
  • maksimalt 25 lektioners undervisning om ugen
  • gode muligheder for efteruddannelse og faglig udvikling
  • et stærkt kollegialt fællesskab, hvor der er plads til både seriøsitet og humor

om stillingen eller Solskinsskolen, er du velkommen til at kontakte

title: Uddannet pædagog søges til børnehavegruppe i Børnehaven Langenæsstien 6A
description:
Uddannnet pædagog søges til Børnehaven Langenæsstien 6A

Langenæsstien 6A er en del af LANGENÆS dagtilbud, der består af 7 afdelinger; fire 0-6 års afdelinger, tre vuggestue afdelinger og en naturbørnehave beliggende i Mariendal ved Ajstrup Strand.

Langenæsstien 6A arbejdet særligt med vores børnemiljøer, vi arbejder med læring, dannelse, udvikling. Langenæsstien 6A har fokus på bæredygtighed i hverdagen - bæredygtighed forstås særdeleshed også i det sociale samspil mellem børn og voksne i afdelingen, hvor vi har et særligt fokus på metoderne fra Øget Trivsel For Alle, som udspringer af De utrolige år. Ved ansættelse i vores dagtilbud modtager man viden og læring om principperne for Øget Trivsel For Alle fra personale der har gennemført uddannelse som Gruppeleder for Dina skolen/Øget Trivsel For Alle.

Vi er en integreret institution og arbejder med en helt hus-tanke, hvor vi hjælper hinanden, sparrer med hinanden og støtter op om hinanden. Vores fokus i hverdagen er at skabe udviklende børnemiljøer, hvor børn trives og udvikles. Samtidig har vi fokus på at bevare det gode samarbejde og kollegaskab der allerede eksisterer.

Vi arbejder målrettet med natur og udeliv og har blandt andet etableret et naturlæringscenter med reptiler og krybdyr. Vi starter vores dage på legepladsen fra kl 07:30, da vi det er vores erfaring, at det giver en god start på dagen for børnene og det er en god måde at imødekomme de forskellige pædagogiske behov ved henholdsvis vuggestue- og børnehavebørn.

Ligeledes er vi et hus med mange muligheder, da vi i dagtilbuddet har en naturbørnehave, som vi ofte besøger, vi har en skøn legeplads der inspirerer til leg og bevægelse m.m. Hertil kommer et uderum med bålplads, muligheder for at klatre i træer, en boldbane mm.

Faglig profil og kompetencer

  • Uddannet pædagog
  • Interesse i og eventuelt erfaring med special pædagogik
  • Tydelig i din kommunikation såvel mundtligt, kropsligt og skriftligt
  • Kan arbejde struktureret og samtidigt tænkte kreativt.
  • Trives i at arbejde selvstændigt og samtidig være en del af et team, hvor du bidrager til et godt arbejdsmiljø såvel fagligt som socialt.
  • Kan holde hovedet koldt i pressede situationer.
  • Tør være eksperimenterende og prøve nye pædagogiske veje ift. inkluderende børnefællesskaber og forældreinddragelse.
  • Kan se dig selv i et tæt forældresamarbejde med til tider sårbare forældre – samt aktiv deltagelse i møder, netværksmøder mm.
  • Handlekraftig, vedholdende og har motivation og passion for arbejdet.
  • Nysgerrig og reflektere over egen og andres praksis og bidrager til kollegial sparring og vidensdeling.
  • Vægter forældresamarbejdet højt
  • Kan se værdien i det inkluderende arbejde med børn med særlige behov.
  • Kan arbejde i tidsrummet 6.30-17.00 og deltage i lejlighedsvis mødevirksomhed til kl. 20
Vi vægter børnefællesskaber højt og arbejder hele tiden ud fra et inkluderende afsæt.

Der vil være planlagt forberedelse, sparring, hvor der er rig mulighed for vidensdeling og erfaringsudveksling. Vi har et højt ambitionsniveau ift. skriftlig dokumentation og forventer at vores kommende kollega er klar til at tage aktiv del i dette.



Forældresamarbejdet:

Vi ved at et tæt samarbejde mellem forældre og pædagoger er afgørende i forhold til barnets udviklingsmuligheder. Vi afholder jævnligt samtaler, netværksmøder, sparring med PPR mm, hvor vores tætte samarbejde kommer til udtryk.

Vi er imødekommende og nysgerrige, idet vi mener, at lige præcis sådan en tilgang danner grundlaget for et ligeværdigt samarbejde - hvilket fordrer den bedste trivsel og udvikling for børnene.

Vi har i Langenæsstien 6A en mangfoldig forældregruppe, med mange nationaliteter, der ligeledes fordrer kommunikation på mange platforme.

Derfor skal du vælge os:

Vi er en engageret, vidende og reflekterende personalegruppe, som er nysgerrige på nye kollegaer.

Vi er tilsammen med vuggestuen 20 kolleger, med hver vores faglige kompetencer. Vi er hele tiden i proces omkring at videreudvikle og forfine vores læringsmiljøer. Vi tror på at selv små justeringer i

tilgange og praksis har stor betydning for den kvalitet vi møder børn og forældre med. Vi kan lide at samarbejde og ”være hinandens ryg”, som vi ser som forudsætninger for et godt arbejdsmiljø.

Vi er vilde med udelivet, naturen og mulighederne i uderummet, derfor skal du som pædagog have lyst til at være ude i al salgs vejr, tage på cykelture og ture til skov, strand og naturbørnehave Mariendal, som er en del af vores dagtilbud.

Løn og ansættelsesvilkår:

Ansættelsen er et barselsvikariat med en gennemsnitlig ugentlig arbejdstid på 37 timer. Du skal kunne tiltræde 01.10.26 eller snarest herefter. Der afholdes samtaler i løbet af uge 39.

Løn og ansættelsesvilkår vil være i henhold til gældende overenskomst. Endelig lønfastsættelse sker efter forhandling med den forhandlingsberettigede faglige organisation på baggrund af kvalifikationer. I henhold til Aarhus Kommunes regler, vil der blive indhentet børneattest samt straffeattest.

Hvis du vil vide mere:

title: SSA til Aftenvagt
description:
Valby Friplejehjem søger en social- og sundhedsassistent som finder glæde i at skabe stjernestunder med vores beboere og i at bruge og udvikle sine faglige kompetencer.

Som et Danske Diakonhjem lægger vi vægt på hjemlighed og ordentlighed. Vi møder beboerne med respekt for deres livshistorie, ønsker og forudsætninger, og vi inviterer dem til at leve livet - også når de har brug for støtte. Du bliver en vigtig del af den oplevelse, både gennem din faglighed og gennem de små stjernestunder, der opstår i hverdagen.

Hvem er du?

Vi leder efter en kollega, der trives i tæt kontakt med beboere og pårørende, og som har lyst til at bringe sin faglighed i spil i et miljø, hvor vi løfter i flok. Du har overblik, er nysgerrig på udvikling og ser værdien i tværfagligt samarbejde. Dokumentation er en naturlig del af dit arbejde – og kender du KMD Nexus, er det en fordel, men ellers lærer vi dig det gerne. Det vigtigste er, at du møder mennesker med varme, respekt og et ønske om at skabe tryghed.

Du ønsker at arbejde i en værdibaseret organisation, hvor beboernes trivsel og livsglæde er udgangspunktet for vores arbejde, faglighed, samarbejde og kultur. Du er fleksibel, imødekommende og har lyst til at arbejde tværfagligt. Vi er her for beboernes skyld.

Du har lyst til at være et sted, hvor du får lov at udvikle dig indenfor det, du brænder for. Vi har fokus på faglighed og udvikling.

Du vil bidrage til at skabe en samarbejdende kultur med afsæt i de værdier, hjemmet bygger på.

Dine opgaver vil bl.a. være at:
  • At yde pleje og omsorg med faglighed, nærvær og respekt
  • At sikre god dokumentation og samarbejde med kollegaer og pårørende
  • At bidrage til en rehabiliterende og meningsfuld hverdag for beboer.
  • At tage ansvar og arbejde struktureret ud fra beboernes behov og ønsker
Vi søger dig som:
  • Er uddannet social- og sundhedsassistent
  • Er fagligt stærk og har lyst til at udvikle dig
  • Brænder for at skabe et godt hverdagsliv for ældre
  • Er positiv, fleksibel og arbejder godt både selvstændigt og i teams
Hvad kan du forvente af os?
  • En grundig introduktion
  • Et stærkt fællesskab med engagerede kollegaer
  • Stor selvbestemmelse og ansvar i hverdagen
  • Fokus på faglighed, udvikling og videndeling
  • Sundhedsforsikring med mulighed for ægtefælle- og børnedækning

Vi vægter måltidsfællesskabet med beboerne og hinanden. Maden tilberedes i vores eget køkken, og vi har en attraktiv madordning, så hos os kan du glemme alt om at smøre madpakke

Om stillingen
  • Stillingen er på 28 t/u, med arbejde hver 2. weekend i de lige weekender
  • Løn og ansættelse sker efter gældende overenskomst.
  • Sundhedsforsikring, der bl.a. tilbyder fysioterapeut, kiropraktor m.m.
  • Fordelagtig madordning
  • Tiltrædelse: den 1/11 2026 eller efter aftale.
Søg via det grønne link herunder

Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig!

Om HJEMMET

Valby Friplejehjem rummer 48 boliger og er en del af Danske Diakonhjem. Det betyder at det kristne menneskesyn er fundamentet for vores måde at drive plejehjem på. Vi er centralt beliggende, på Trekronergade 94 i Valby, nær bus og togstation.

Læs mere på Valby Friplejehjem - Valby Friplejehjem eller følg os på Facebook.

Om Danske Diakonhjem

Danske Diakonhjem er en selvejende, nonprofitorganisation med mere end 65 års erfaring i at opføre og drive plejehjem. Vi er landets største private aktør inden for plejehjem og friplejehjem med 41 hjem og knapt 3.000 medarbejdere.

Derudover administrerer vi en række selvejende institutioner inden for løn, regnskab, bolig, IT og rådgivning — i alt omkring 80 plejehjem, hospices og bofællesskaber.

Vores arbejde bygger på et kristent livs- og menneskesyn, hvor hvert menneske betragtes som unikt og værdifuldt. Vi forventer, at du kan se dig selv i en organisation, hvor respekt, ordentlighed og rummelighed er centrale værdier.

title: Senior Software Engineer, Autonomous Pilot Integration (R5423)
description:
Shield AI is a venture-backed defense-tech company with the mission of protecting service members and civilians with intelligent systems. Its products include Hivemind autonomy software, V-BAT and X-BAT aircraft, and Aechelon simulation and synthetic reality technologies. With offices and facilities across the U.S., Europe, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific, Shield AI’s technology actively supports operations worldwide. For more information, visit . Follow Shield AI on LinkedIn, X, Instagram, and YouTube.

This position is ideal for an individual who thrives on solving complex integration challenges that span hardware, software, and systems engineering. A successful candidate will be skilled at deploying autonomy solutions onto unmanned platforms, preparing systems for flight, and troubleshooting mission-critical issues in both lab and field environments. The role is highly dynamic, requiring hands-on experience, strong systems thinking, and the ability to operate effectively in fast-paced, real-world test conditions.
Shield AI is committed to developing cutting-edge autonomy for unmanned aircraft operating across all Department of Defense (DoD) domains, including air, sea, and land. Our Flight Integration Engineers are essential to bridging the gap between R&D and deployment, ensuring that autonomous systems function reliably and effectively when and where they are needed most.

What you'll do:

  • System Integration & Deployment — Integrate autonomy software onto unmanned aircraft systems, ensuring seamless operation across onboard compute, sensors, and control interfaces.
  • Pre-flight Preparation — Own the build, configuration, and validation process for flight-ready systems; coordinate hardware/software compatibility and mission readiness.
  • On-site Flight Test Support — Travel to test sites and support live flight operations, including safety checks, system bring-up, and troubleshooting under time-critical constraints.
  • Hardware/Software Debugging — Diagnose and resolve integration issues across complex autonomy software stacks and embedded systems in lab and field environments.
  • Flight Data Capture & Analysis — Manage data collection during missions and post-test analysis, working with autonomy engineers to refine behaviors and identify improvements.
  • Collaboration Across Teams — Work closely with autonomy, GNC, systems, and test teams to ensure mission-critical functionality is delivered on time and validated thoroughly.
  • Continuous Improvement — Build tools and processes to improve integration timelines, flight test reliability, and team efficiency across deployment cycles.
  • Support Certification and Compliance — Assist with documentation and system-level validation required for certification, airworthiness, and compliance in defense-relevant environments.
  • Travel Requirement – Members of this team typically travel around 30-40% of the year (to different office locations, customer sites, and flight integration events).

Required Qualifications:

  • BS/MS in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, and/or similar degree, or equivalent practical experience
  • Typically requires a minimum of 2 years of related experience with a Bachelor’s degree; or completion of a Master’s or PhD program with internship or equivalent practical experience preferred; or equivalent professional experience.
  • Proficiency in programming languages such as C++ and Python, and familiarity with real-time operating systems (RTOS).
  • Proficiency in Linux-based development and experience working with embedded systems, shell scripting, and system diagnostics.
  • Knowledge of sensor integration, sensor fusion, and middleware frameworks (e.g., ROS, DDS).
  • Hands-on experience supporting flight demos or live exercises.
  • Experience with simulation tools and environments (e.g., AFSIM, NGTS) for testing and validation.
  • Strong problem-solving skills, with the ability to troubleshoot and optimize system performance.
  • Excellent communication and teamwork skills, with the ability to work effectively in a collaborative, multidisciplinary environment.
  • Ability to obtain a SECRET clearance.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Direct experience supporting unmanned aerial systems or similar flight test campaigns.
  • Familiarity with autonomy stacks, flight control systems, or GNC pipelines.
  • Competence in sensor integration, electronics debugging, or avionics bring-up.
  • Proficiency in developing automation tools for system testing, logging, and data parsing.
  • Comfortable interfacing with DoD stakeholders during field events or technical reviews.
  • Experience with UCI and OMS Standards.

title: Administrative Coordinator 3/4- Court Reporter
description:
About this Job

The Administrative Hearings Division (AHD) of the Louisiana Public Service Commission (LPSC or Commission) is primarily responsible for compiling accurate and complete records of proceedings before the Commission.

The incumbent serves as an LPSC Court Reporter and adheres to professional standards of court reporting by utilizing electronic recording equipment to produce verbatim transcripts of all public hearings and meetings presided over by the five elected LPSC Commissioners, all adjudicatory hearings and oral arguments presided over by the Administrative Law Judges, and technical conferences conducted by the Commission's Office of General Counsel. A strong command of punctuation is very useful in this position.

Core Competencies:

Accepting Direction: The ability to be open and willing to follow guidance or instructions.
Demonstrating Accountability: The ability to take ownership of actions, behaviors, performance, decisions, and outcomes.
Following Policies and Procedures: The ability to follow, reinforce, adapt, or develop policies and procedures to maintain compliance with federal and state legal requirements, State Civil Service rules, and organizational policies.
Communicating Effectively: The ability to convey information, ideas, and emotions using structured communication methods that promote understanding and engagement.
Demonstrating Initiative: The ability to assess situations independently and take proactive steps to address them without being prompted or instructed by others.

Minimum Qualifications

Two years of experience in administrative services.

EXPERIENCE SUBSTITUTION:
Every 15 semester hours earned from an accredited college or university will be credited as six months of experience.

Job Specification

The official job specifications for this role, as defined by the State Civil Service, can be found here.

Job Duties and Other Information

Job Duties:

  • The position is public-facing during hearings and meetings and you must be able to present a professional image and work professionally.
  • Day to day you will use the weekly schedule to guide you on what meetings or hearings you are assigned to cover.
  • You will test recording equipment before each hearing/meeting, set up for the hearing/meeting, cover the hearing/meeting, and the transcribe the hearing/meeting using For The Record for audio playback and a foot pedal.
  • During the hearing/meeting you will receive exhibits filed into the record, often confidential, so you must be able to maintain confidentiality of information.
  • You will also assist team members in reviewing/proofreading their transcripts for thoroughness and appropriate punctuation.
  • Will have occasional travel out of town to cover an out-of-town public meeting.
  • Serve as backup to supervisor as needed.

Position-Specific Details:

Appointment Type: Probational and Promotional

Career Progression: This position provides the opportunity to advance within the division.

Work Schedule: Work hours are 8:00 AM to 4:30 PM, Monday-Friday.


How To Apply:

To apply for this vacancy, click on the “Apply” link above and complete an electronic application, which can be used for this vacancy as well as future job opportunities. Applicants are responsible for checking the status of their application to determine where they are in the recruitment process. Further status message information is located under the Information section of the Current Job Opportunities page.

* Information to support your eligibility for the position must be included in the application (i.e., relevant, detailed experience/education). Resumes will not be accepted in lieu of completed education and experience sections. Applications may be rejected if incomplete.

title: SOSU-hjælper på Plejehjemmet Hedevej, Aarhus Kommune
description:
Vil du bruge din faglighed dér, hvor den virkelig gør en forskel?
Som social- og sundhedshjælper hos os på Plejehjemmet Hedevej er du med til at skabe en tryg og meningsfuld hverdag for mennesker, der har brug for din omsorg og opmærksomhed. Du arbejder tæt på beboerne og får mulighed for at følge dem over tid, opbygge relationer og sætte din faglighed i spil i et tværfagligt fællesskab.

Om jobbet:
Vi søger en social- og sundhedshjælper til vores dejlige plejehjem Hedevej.
Ønsker du et arbejde med høj faglighed, omsorg og nysgerrighed? Og vil du være en del af et sted, hvor liv leves - også når helbredet og funktionsevnen ændrer sig?
Så skal du søge denne stilling ved os!
På plejehjemmet Hedevej bliver du en del af et tværfagligt team, hvor opgaverne spænder bredt: fra personligpleje, hverdagsliv til samtaler, pårørendemøder og dokumentation.
Du kommer til at arbejde tæt sammen med beboerne, pårørende, kollegaer, huslægen, samt eksterne samarbejdspartnere – og det, du ikke kan i forvejen, lærer vi dig.
Vi gør opmærksom på, at stillingen ligger inden for det døgndækkede område. P.t. forventes tjenesten fortrinsvis at være i aftenvagt, samt vagter hver 2. Weekend.


Kandidatens profil:

Vi søger dig, som:
• Er uddannet SOSU-hjælper
• Trives i en hverdag med tæt kontakt til beboerne
• Har lyst til at lære og lære fra dig
• Er nysgerrig, engageret og har lyst til at udvikle din faglighed
• Møder beboere, pårørende og kollegaer med respekt og ordentlighed


Derfor skal du vælge os:

• En grundig introduktion, og vi hjælper dig godt i gang
• Tid til at opbygge relationer og følge beboerne i deres hverdag
• Et tværfagligt fællesskab med høj faglighed og god sparring
• Et godt arbejdsmiljø, hvor vi hjælper hinanden og stiller spørgsmål – også de svære
• Kompetenceudvikling og relevante kurser
• Gode kollegaer og sociale arrangementer

Om afdelingen:
Vores plejehjem er et sted, hvor livet leves med alt, hvad det indebærer af glæder, nærvær og udfordringer. Vi arbejder ud fra den enkelte beboers ønsker og behov, og vi lægger vægt på tillid, åbenhed og faglig udvikling.
Plejehjemmet Hedevej er et stort plejehjem med fem forskellige afdelinger, hvor der bor mellem 15-18 borgere på hver afdeling.
Hedevej er opdelt i 3 huse – hus 1 består af 2 afdelinger, hus 2 består af 1 afdeling og hus 3 består af 2 afdelinger.
Vi er placeret i et villaområde i Risskov med dejlige, store grønne arealer og gode stisystemer.
På hver afdeling er der fast plejepersonale bestående af social- og sundhedshjælpere, assistenter, samt en fysioterapeut, en ergoterapeut, en sygeplejerske og en ernæringsassistent. Dertil er der fast rengøringsassistenter og teknisk servicemedarbejdere.
Derudover er Hedevej et uddannelsessted og har 2 vejledere, samt elever og studerende.
På Plejehjemmet Hedevej har vi en synlig og fagligt engageret ledelse bestående af forstander Camilla Joy T. Nielsen, konstitueret viceforstander Pernille Lund Christensen og konstitueret viceforstander Frederikke Dupont.

Løn og ansættelsesvilkår:
Stillingen ønskes tiltrådt 1. November 2026 eller snarest muligt.
Løn og ansættelsesvilkår efter gældende overenskomst og efter konkret forhandling med den forhandlingsberettigede faglige organisation.

Ugentligt timetal: 37.


Hvis du vil vide mere:
Yderligere oplysninger om stillingen kan fås ved henvendelse til forstander Camilla Joy T. Nielsen 41859385 og/eller cajn@aarhus.dk.

Ansøgning
Klik på ”Ansøg” nedenfor for at udfylde og sende din ansøgning. Alle felter med * skal udfyldes. Først når du har modtaget en kvittering pr. e-mail, har vi modtaget din ansøgning.

Ansøgningsfristen er den 23.09.2026.

Vi forventer at afvikle jobsamtaler ultimo uge 39/primo uge 40.

I Magistratsafdelingen for Sundhed og Omsorg har vi en generel politik om, at der ved ansættelser indhentes referencer og evt. straffeattest. Du må derfor forvente at blive anmodet herom, hvis vi tilbyder dig stillingen.
Vi gør opmærksom på, at der i forbindelse med rekrutteringsprocessen vil blive foretaget opslag i vores referenceregister. Referenceregisteret omfatter tidligere medarbejdere i Magistratsafdelingen for Sundhed og Omsorg, der er blevet bortvist grundet væsentlig misligholdelse af ansættelsesforholdet.


Om Sundhed og Omsorg og Aarhus Kommune:

Sundhed og Omsorg (MSO) i Aarhus Kommune arbejder med omsorg for ældre og sundhed for alle borgere.


Aarhus Kommune betragter mangfoldighed som en ressource og opfordrer derfor alle - uanset alder, køn, handicap, livsstil, religion eller etnisk tilhørsforhold - til at ansøge stillingen.
Aarhus Kommune er en af Jyllands største arbejdspladser, hvor 28.000 professionelle og passionerede kollegaer hver dag arbejder for at gøre visioner til virkelighed og skabe værdi for borgere og samfundet omkring os. Vi er en arbejdsplads, der vægter faglighed og samarbejde højt og vi tror på, at vores forskelligheder er med til at gøre Aarhus til en god by for alle. Sammen arbejder vi for en bæredygtig og inkluderende by, hvor både ansatte, borgere, virksomheder og naturen kan trives og blomstre. Vi har ambitioner for byen – og for dig. Kom og vær med!

title: Omsorgsfuld og initiativrig hjælper søges til skønne 10-årige Molly ca. 1-2 små vagter om måneden i Brøndbyøster
description:
Omsorgsfuld og initiativrig hjælper søges til skønne 10-årige Molly ca. 1-2 små vagter om måneden i Brøndbyøster

Vi søger en omsorgsfuld, ansvarsbevidst og initiativrig hjælper til Molly, som er 10 år.

Molly er generelt en glad, mild og kærlig pige. Hun har et medfødt syndrom, som betyder, at hun har brug for ekstra hjælp og støtte i sin hverdag. Det handler blandt andet om leg og aktivering, hjælp til mobilisering og forflytning, spisning, personlig pleje, træning samt gåture, hvor hun sidder i sin kørestol.
Molly kan ikke altid selv tydeligt give udtryk for sine behov. Derfor er det vigtigt, at du kan være nærværende og opmærksom på hende og hendes signaler – og at du kan tage initiativ til det, hun har brug for.

Vi forestiller os, at du:

  • er omsorgsfuld, rolig og nærværende
  • er initiativrig og ansvarsbevidst
  • gerne har erfaring med børn eller en pædagogisk eller sundhedsfaglig baggrund. Det er dog ikke det vigtigste for os – det vigtigste er, at du har lyst, engagement og et oprigtigt ønske om at gøre en forskel for Molly.
  • har lyst til at lære Molly at kende og blive tryg ved hendes behov
  • kan arbejde selvstændigt og samtidig indgå naturligt i vores familie

Arbejdstid

Vagterne ligger primært på hverdage om eftermiddagen/aftenen, fra Molly kommer hjem fra skole, til hun skal sove, samt enkelte vagter i weekenderne.

Vagtbyrden vil variere, men forventeligt være omkring 1-2 mindre vagter om måneden, typisk fra ca. 3,5 time +

Arbejdet foregår primært hjemme hos Molly i 2605 Brøndbyøster, men kan også indebære ture ud af huset.

En del af en børnefamilie

Molly er en del af en børnefamilie med søskende, så det er vigtigt, at du trives i en hverdag med børn, liv og lidt hurlumhej. Du vil blive en naturlig del af familiens hverdag, hvor der både er plads til leg, grin, nærvær og de mere praktiske gøremål.

Lyder det som noget for dig?

Så vil vi meget gerne høre fra dig! Opstart er hurtigst mulig.
Inden ansættelse vil du komme på et ”kemi-besøg”

Send en kort ansøgning og fortæl lidt om dig selv, din erfaring og hvorfor du gerne vil være aflastningsperson for Molly.

Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig!

title: Engineer I - Civil
description:
At ANS, we’re not just a consulting engineering firm—we’re a team of trailblazers shaping the future of multi-disciplinary engineering.
Recognized as one of the Best Places to Work and Top 10 Hottest Engineering Firms in the US by Zweig Reports, and featured in Inc. 5000’s Top 250 for our staggering 1,748% growth, we’re proud of what we’ve built and where we’re headed.
We’re allergic to bureaucracy, thrive on innovation, and embrace data-driven decisions. If you love collaboration, creativity, and a fast-paced environment, we might just be your perfect match! Our team includes professionals licensed in over 20 states, with more than 70 years of collective experience. We pride ourselves on fostering a collaborative and supportive work environment that encourages growth and professional development. At ANS, you’ll enjoy paid vacation, sick, and personal time off; support for continuing education and community involvement; and comprehensive healthcare, vision, and dental benefits for eligible employees.
We are seeking a motivated and driven Engineer I - Civil to join our team. ANS is a rapidly growing, emerging civil engineering firm focusing on civil, geotechnical, structural, and electrical engineering for renewable energy and infrastructure projects across the US. The ideal candidates will participate in and contribute to a diverse range of engineering projects and services in our team-oriented environment. Under the direction of experienced engineers, you will gain exposure to the Renewables industry in Solar and Battery Storage projects.

Job Responsibilities

  • Under supervision and working with experienced staff, the successful candidates will complete civil engineering designs and the generation of construction plans and specifications, technical calculations, exhibits and reports.
  • Utilize Civil 3D including alignments, profiles and grading features to produce engineered construction plans and sheet set ups
  • Basic understanding of Site Grading & Storm Drainage, Erosion and Sediment Control and Storm Water Best Management Practices with strong desire to learn and an interest in civil engineering design.
  • Attention to detail, strong problem-solving and good communication skills

Position Requirements

  • B.S. in Civil Engineering from an accredited institution or equivalent Engineering B.S
  • EIT Preferred
  • 0-3 years of experience

Software Expertise

  • 2D CAD Intermediate
  • Civil 3D CAD Novice. Able to create basic alignments and existing profiles
  • Google Earth, Microsoft Suite, AutoTURN
If you’re passionate about clean energy design, precision engineering, and turning data into impact, we want to meet you! Join us in shaping the next generation of solar and battery storage projects—and help transform ANS into the name everyone in renewables knows.

title: Kommende Stabschef til Regionsapoteket Pharma Øst (270386)
description:
Vil du stå i spidsen for den administrative stab i et nyt og ambitiøst regionsapotek?

Regionsapoteket Pharma Øst etableres pr. 1. januar 2027 som en ny og samlet organisation med ansvar for hospitalsfarmaci, medicinforsyning, medicinanvendelse, produktion, kvalitet, forskning, innovation og understøttelse af sundhedsreformen. Vi søger en stabschef, der kan lede den administrative stab og sikre stærk strategisk, organisatorisk og administrativ understøttelse af hele organisationen.

Som stabschef får du en central rolle i opbygningen af et fælles regionsapotek i Region Østdanmark. Du bliver en tæt sparringspartner for direktionen og får ansvar for at skabe sammenhæng, fremdrift og kvalitet i de tværgående funktioner, der binder organisationen sammen.

Den administrative stab omfatter blandt andet strategi og porteføljestyring, ledelses- og direktionssekretariat, kommunikation, uddannelse, beredskab, arbejdsmiljø, kvalitetsledelse samt centrale sekretariats- og koordineringsopgaver. Staben skal understøtte direktion, chefgruppe og organisation med beslutningsoplæg, governance, mødefora, strategiske processer, forandringskommunikation og organisatorisk implementering.

Stillingen er placeret på Marielundvej 29 i Herlev sammen med direktionen. Der må forventes tæt samarbejde og fleksibel tilstedeværelse på tværs af organisationens matrikler og samarbejdsflader.

Om stillingen

Du får det samlede ledelsesansvar for den administrative stab og skal sikre, at staben fungerer som en professionel, proaktiv og sammenhængende understøttelse af organisationens strategiske og driftsmæssige behov. Opgaven kræver både strategisk udsyn, sikker drift, stærk politisk og organisatorisk forståelse samt evne til at omsætte komplekse dagsordener til klare beslutningsprocesser og konkrete resultater.

Dine hovedopgaver

  • Ledelse og udvikling af den administrative stab, herunder tydelig retning, prioritering og koordinering på tværs af fagområder
  • Understøtte strategiske processer, porteføljestyring, governance og organisatorisk implementering
  • Sikring af sammenhæng mellem sundhedsreform, fusion, drift og udvikling i Regionsapotek Østdanmark.
  • Ansvar for stærke sekretariatsprocesser, beslutningsoplæg, mødeforberedelse og opfølgning.
  • Udvikling af kommunikation, uddannelse, beredskab, arbejdsmiljø og tværgående administrative processer og ikke mindst varetagelse af ledelsen heraf i såvel stab som organisation.

Din profil

Du har en relevant akademisk uddannelse og dokumenteret erfaring med ledelse, strategisk rådgivning og sekretariatsbetjening på højt niveau. Du har blik for både drift og udvikling og trives i en rolle, hvor du skal skabe sammenhæng mellem strategi, beslutninger, mennesker og implementering. Du er helhedsorienteret, robust og tillidsvækkende, og du formår at skabe følgeskab gennem tydelighed, ordentlighed og stærke relationer.

Vi tilbyder

  • En arbejdsplads med ambitioner om kvalitet, samarbejde, ordentlighed og stærk organisatorisk sammenhængskraft

title: [Job - 31210] Senior Data Architect (Azure), Brazil
description:
At CI&T, we help large enterprises transform the potential of AI into real business impact with AI Deployment, AI-native execution, and tech-integrated business solutions.

With 30 years of experience in technological transformation, we accelerate innovation with expertise in Agentic SDLC, Application modernization, Data & AI, Martech and Business strategy.

We are 8,000 CI&Ters across more than 25 countries, collaborating to build solutions with real impact. AI is already part of how we work, evolve, and innovate every day.


As CI&T grows, we seek a talented and experienced Data Architect Senior to lead the design and evolution of our client's data platform. This role is central to a strategic initiative to migrate existing data pipelines to Microsoft Fabric and to strengthen the reliability of curated, business-ready data. The professional in this role will be the technical reference point who turns architectural vision into resilient, scalable data systems.

The Data Architect Senior owns the long-term data architecture strategy and works hands-on with development and architecture teams to bring it to life. This position blends deep technical expertise in cloud-based data platforms with the ability to mentor other team members, align diverse stakeholders, and explain complex data concepts in clear, simple terms. The role carries both strategic influence and day-to-day technical involvement, ensuring the data architecture scales smoothly and stays secure as it evolves.

Responsibilities

  • Define and communicate the long-term data architecture vision, aligning it with business strategy and goals.

  • Lead the migration of data pipelines to Microsoft Fabric, ensuring data is reliably promoted to the curated golden layer for business consumption.

  • Design and evolve data lake and Delta Lake-based architectures on Azure Cloud Services, balancing performance, scalability, and cost.

  • Lead the evaluation and selection of technologies, frameworks, and standards used to implement the data architecture.

  • Establish and promote best practices for data management and governance across the organization.

  • Collaborate with leadership teams and business stakeholders to ensure the data architecture meets evolving business needs, by translating technical constraints into clear, actionable options.

  • Identify and anticipate complex technical challenges in the data platform, proposing innovative and effective solutions.

  • Provide advanced technical guidance to data development and architecture teams, reviewing design decisions and unblocking complex implementation issues.

  • Ensure data architecture decisions comply with applicable data security regulations and standards.

  • Mentor and empower other team members by sharing knowledge and experience, supporting their technical growth.

  • Develop and maintain strategic relationships with technology partners and suppliers relevant to the data platform.

  • Represent the data architecture in internal and external technical and strategic forums.

Requirements

  • Advanced English proficiency (C1 or above), required for direct interaction with international stakeholders.

  • Extensive, hands-on experience with data platform architecture, including data modeling and ELT (Extract, Load, Transform) processes at scale.

  • Proven experience with cloud data platforms, preferably Azure Cloud Services and Microsoft Fabric.

  • Experience with data lake design, implementation, and Delta Lake-based architectures.

  • Demonstrated ability to guide teams through complex technology migrations and architectural changes.

  • Strong mentoring and technical leadership skills, with experience supporting the growth of less experienced team members.

  • Ability to explain complex data architecture concepts in clear, accessible terms to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

Nice to Have

  • Relevant Azure certifications related to data platform architecture or Microsoft Fabric.

  • Experience defining data governance frameworks and data security compliance standards.

  • Experience partnering with technology vendors and strategic suppliers on data platform initiatives.

  • Background presenting technical or architectural strategy in cross-functional or executive forums.

title: KONTAKTPERSON – FREDERIKHAVN
description:
Er du på udkig efter et lille, men spændende job og trives du med at gøre en stor forskel for et andet menneske, så er dette job måske noget for dig.

På vegne af Frederikshavn Kommune søger vi en kontaktperson til en kvinde i slutningen af 80'erne med kombineret syns- og høretab. Kommunikationen med hende foregår ved tydelig og direkte tale.

Kvinden bor på plejehjem, og arbejdet vil foregå både i og udenfor kvindens bolig.

Stillingen er som udgangspunkt på to timer om ugen, som ligger tirsdag i tidsrummet kl. 9-11. Der er dog behov for fleksibilitet og mulighed for at kunne forlænge de to timer ved behov.

Derudover er der 80 årlige puljetimer, som kan benyttes efter behov til f.eks. kurser af flere dages varighed eller endagsture ud af huset.

Opgaver

Din overordnede opgave som kontaktperson er at fungere som øjne og ører for kvinden i situationer, hvor der er behov for det. Det indebærer blandt andet at ledsage, beskrive omgivelserne, hvor I færdes (synsbeskrive), og støtte i forbindelse med kommunikation.

Opgaverne vil foregå både i og udenfor kvindens hjem og består i oplæsning og sortering af post samt ledsagelse og beskrivelse af omgivelserne i forbindelse med blandt andet

  • indkøb
  • gåture
  • endagsture ud af huset
  • lægebesøg
  • kurser eller foredrag.

Det må forventes, at du i forbindelse med kurser er afsted flere dage, og at der derfor vil være overnatning.

Hvis du ikke kender til ledsagelse eller synsbeskrivelse i forvejen, skal vi nok lære dig det.

Inden du påbegynder arbejdet som kontaktperson, skal du gennemgå et e-læringsforløb (samlet cirka 2,5 timers varighed), som giver en god introduktion til arbejdet. Denne undervisning foregår hjemme ved egen computer, og du får løn for den.

Du vil efterfølgende få løbende undervisning og supervision ved CFD’s døvblindekonsulenter, hvor du også vil kunne møde andre kontaktpersoner. Dette er også lønnet.

Vi forventer, at du

  • er nysgerrig
  • er fleksibel
  • har humoristisk sans
  • taler klart og tydeligt dansk
  • er god til at formidle og synsbeskrive – eller er villig til at lære det.

Mere information og ansøgning

Du kan læse mere om døvblindhed og kontaktpersonordningen her.

Du kan også se andre kontaktpersoner fortælle om arbejdet i disse korte videoer.

Du vil blive ansat af Frederikshavn Kommune og aflønnet med løntrin 11.

Hvis du har spørgsmål til jobbet, kan du kontakte døvblindekonsulent Louise Brygger Klattrup på lbk@cfd.dk.

Send din ansøgning og CV til job_ktp@cfd.dk hurtigst muligt og senest den 9. september 2026 kl. 12.00.

Skriv KONTAKTPERSON – FREDERIKSHAVN i mailens emnefelt.

Hvis du ikke har hørt fra os senest den 15. oktober, er stillingen besat til anden side.

OBS: Vi har løbende brug for kontaktpersoner. Skriv gerne i din ansøgning, om vi må gemme dine oplysninger, hvis du ikke får denne stilling. Så kan vi kontakte dig, hvis vi får en ledig stilling i området på et senere tidspunkt. Din ansøgning gemmes i to år, og du kan til enhver tid bede os om at slette den.

title: Supplier Development Engineer, Brittles
description:
Our mission at Oura is to empower every person to own their inner potential. Our award-winning products help our global community gain a deeper knowledge of their readiness, activity, and sleep quality by using their Oura Ring and its connected app. We've helped millions of people understand and improve their health by providing daily insights and practical steps to inspire healthy lifestyles.

Empowering the world starts with living our values and empowering our team. As a quickly growing company focused on helping people live healthier and happier lives, we ensure that our team members have what they need to do their best work — both in and out of the office.

We are looking for a Supplier Development Engineer, Brittles based in the San Francisco Bay Area who will provide concepting and end-to-end manufacturing and process solutions for the key design features in Oura's new hardware products.. This includes close collaboration with industrial designers on achieving design intent, scoping manufacturing process development and capability, new supplier bring-up, automation development, and process technology R&D across our mechanical components.

This is a hybrid role; the candidate should be based in the San Francisco Bay Area and able to come into the San Francisco office 2+ days per week.

What you will do:

  • Define best-in-class processes for ceramic, sapphire crystal, glass, and other brittle components that meet all Oura design and operational requirements
  • Partner with Quality Engineers, Material Engineers, and Product/Industrial Designers to optimize brittle-material component design and manufacturing for cost, cosmetics, reliability, and fracture resistance
  • Use data (Cpk, GD&T, strength/fracture testing) to drive process decisions and influence product and industrial design, including part tolerances and specifications for brittle substrates
  • Drive suppliers globally to establish and optimize manufacturing processes for Oura's ceramic, sapphire crystal, and glass components — including CIM, sintering, precision CNC grinding, lapping/polishing, edge chamfering, laser cutting/drilling, and coating adhesion on brittle substrates — ensuring best-in-class quality and resolving production issues
  • Lead Design for Manufacturing (DFM) reviews and set acceptance criteria specific to brittle materials (chip/crack defects, edge integrity, cosmetic standards) for tooling and processes entering development builds and production ramp
  • Develop and document processes, parameters, consumables, and secondary-operation requirements (grinding, polishing, coating, laser marking) to meet defined specifications
  • Provide leadership and support at manufacturing sites during development and production ramp, driving brittle-material-specific issues (cracking, chipping, warpage, thermal shock failures) to resolution with cross-functional teams

Requirements

We would love to consider you for this role if you have:

  • 4+ years of direct experience in a mechanical manufacturing environment as a Supplier Development Engineer, Supply Base Engineer, Manufacturing Engineer, Manufacturing Design Engineer, Supplier Industrialization Engineer, or equivalent role with 2 or more years focused on brittle materials
  • Experience driving global suppliers to establish and qualify brittle-material manufacturing processes from NPI to mass production, including DFM reviews that surface brittle-specific risks (cracking, chipping, thermal shock) before build start
  • Hands-on knowledge of ceramic, sapphire crystal, and glass manufacturing processes (e.g., ceramic injection molding (CIM), sintering, CNC grinding, lapping/polishing, edge chamfering, laser cutting/drilling, PVD/coating adhesion on brittle substrates) plus failure analysis (fractography), design of experiments (DOE), and dimensional capability (Cpk, GD&T)
  • Working understanding of brittle fracture mechanics and relevant strength/reliability testing (e.g., 4-point bend, ring-on-ring, thermal shock/cycling) and cosmetic defect standards for ceramics, sapphire crystal, or glass
  • Ability to travel internationally, up to ~15% of the time
  • Excellent critical thinking and problem-solving skills, with the ability to communicate challenges clearly to leadership and cross-functional partners
  • A positive, high-urgency mindset with a willingness to learn and challenge the status quo; direct experience with ceramics, sapphire crystal, or glass on highly cosmetic parts or health wearable devices strongly preferred

Benefits

At Oura, we care about you and your well-being. Everyone here at Oura has a ring of their own and we are continually looking to improve employee health.

What we offer:

  • Competitive salary and equity packages
  • Health, dental, vision insurance, and mental health resources
  • An Oura Ring of your own plus employee discounts for friends & family
  • 20 days of paid time off plus 13 paid holidays plus 8 days of flexible wellness time off
  • Paid sick leave and parental leave
  • Amazing culture of collaborative and passionate coworkers

Oura takes a market-based approach to pay, which may vary depending on your location. US locations are categorized into tiers based on a cost of labor index for that geographic area. While most offers will be closer to the starting range, successful candidates' pay will be determined based on job-related skills, experience, qualifications, work location, internal peer equity, and market conditions. These ranges may be modified in the future.

title: IT Project Manager (CORA) Strategic Planner
description:
This position supports the Air Force Cyber Assessment Team (AFCAT) in the 688th Cyberspace Wing and conducts Cyber Operational Readiness Assessments (CORA) at Air Force locations around the world. These assessments will help strengthen the posture and resiliency of the DoW Information Network (DOWIN) by supporting commanders and directors in their efforts to harden their information systems, reduce the attack surface of their cyber terrain, and enhance a more proactive defense.

An IT Project Manager plays a crucial role in the successful completion of all AFCAT projects. They are responsible for overseeing the entire project lifecycle, from initial planning to final delivery.

Key Tasks & Responsibilities

  • Ensure all AFCAT Assessor certification requirements and training are up to date under the DCDC Reviewer Certification Program (RCP)

  • Coordinate with multiple DoW agencies for on-the-job training and check-ride opportunities for AFCAT assessors to become fully DCDC certified under the RCP

  • Contractor shall utilize appropriate tools and methodologies based on DCDC standard processes and procedures.

  • Prioritize tasks based on urgency and importance from AFCAT leadership guidance.

  • Respond to digital correspondence (Email, Teams, MS Planner) from the field and AFCAT leadership concerning upcoming tasks or short-notice taskers.

  • Monitor and maintain AFCAT Teams and SharePoint site and respond to questions.

  • Provide logistics coordination support for CORAs (Accounts, Badge Access, Visitor Access Requests, Out-Briefs, etc.)

  • Coordinate with AFCAT leadership on daily status reports and operations & intelligence briefs

  • Stay informed on 688 CW/CC, AFCYBER/CC, and larger Air Force strategic priorities to inform base selection for CORAs.

  • Advocate with wing organizations for access to enterprise assets and capabilities to prepare for CORA.

  • Support daily assessment meetings to track progress and provide summaries to base leadership and 688 CW leadership.

  • Participate in regular teleconferences with base comm squadron leadership to identify issues and inform commanders on risk.

  • Provide written feedback on process update recommendations.

  • Coordinate travel arrangements with fellow assessment team members.

  • Complete supervisory and administrative tasks as required.

  • Complete other duties as assigned.

Education & Experience

  • Requires a bachelor's degree (or equivalent) +5 years of experience, or 8+ years of related experience

  • Must have excellent verbal and written communication skills

  • Must have excellent critical thinking skills

Desired:

  • University certifications in Project or Program Management

Certifications

Required:

  • IAT II – Sec+, CASP+, or higher

  • 10+ years of Project Management experience

Desired:

  • Certified Project Management Professional (PMP)

  • CompTIA Project+

  • Certified ScrumMaster (CSM)

  • Work Role: 802 Certified

  • Lean Six Sigma (Green/Black Belt)

Security Clearance

Required: Must have active Secret clearance with ability to obtain a Top-Secret clearance with SCI eligibility

Desired: Active Top Secret Clearance with SCI eligibility

Other (Travel, Work Environment, DoD 8570 Requirements, Administrative Notes, etc.)

  • Anticipate team members travelling 6 to 7 weeks per year but could be more or less

  • Must possess or obtain a US Passport within 6 months

  • Must be able to fund your travel up front and you will be reimbursed upon filing expense report

title: Technical Lead - Business Automation & AI Development
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Technical Lead - Business Automation & AI Development based in France.

This role offers the opportunity to help build a new technology and automation practice focused on turning complex business processes into practical digital solutions.
You will operate at the intersection of business strategy, software architecture, automation, and AI-assisted development.
The position combines hands-on engineering with the architectural leadership needed to deliver secure, scalable, production-ready applications.
You will translate existing workflows and business requirements into custom applications that improve operations without requiring disruptive legacy system replacements.
Using AI-accelerated development approaches, you will help deliver solutions efficiently while applying strong technical judgment and engineering standards.
As the practice grows, you will have the opportunity to shape development standards, build a team, and mentor future engineers.
This is an ideal opportunity for an entrepreneurial technical leader who enjoys ambiguity, ownership, and solving real-world operational challenges.

Accountabilities

  • Design and oversee custom business applications, including CRM platforms, project management tools, data integration layers, and other operational software.
  • Translate complex business processes, existing documentation, video walkthroughs, and structured requirements into functional and scalable digital solutions.
  • Lead AI-assisted software development using platforms such as Replit Agent/Builder, ensuring generated solutions meet appropriate standards for architecture, security, maintainability, and scalability.
  • Apply sound architectural judgment to determine when AI-generated solutions require manual intervention, refinement, or redesign.
  • Design integration strategies and workflows that capture client requests, manage project lifecycles, and enable reliable data handoffs into existing legacy systems.
  • Develop solutions that improve operational efficiency while minimizing the need for disruptive replacements of established infrastructure.
  • Ensure deployed applications achieve strong availability, reliability, and performance through appropriate infrastructure management, monitoring, and quality assurance practices.
  • Establish technical and development best practices that support repeatable delivery as the automation practice scales.
  • Over time, identify, hire, mentor, and develop junior developers while building a high-performing team focused on AI-augmented software development.
  • Partner closely with business stakeholders to understand operational challenges and translate them into commercially valuable technical solutions.

    • Requirements

    • Proven experience combining software engineering with business analysis, product management, or a similar business-facing technical discipline.
    • Demonstrated experience using AI coding assistants or AI-powered development platforms such as Replit, Lovable, or comparable tools to rapidly deliver production-ready software.
    • Strong architectural judgment and the ability to evaluate, guide, and improve AI-generated code rather than relying solely on automated development.
    • Strong full-stack knowledge covering frontend and backend architectures, SQL and/or NoSQL databases, APIs, integrations, and application design.
    • Experience building or optimizing business applications such as CRM systems, project management platforms, internal operational tools, or workflow automation solutions.
    • Ability to design systems with a long-term perspective, ensuring solutions can scale from an individual client deployment to a much larger customer base.
    • Strong understanding of business processes and the ability to translate operational requirements into practical technology solutions.
    • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to bridge technical execution and the needs of non-technical business stakeholders.
    • Entrepreneurial and self-directed mindset, with a strong sense of ownership and comfort working in a fast-moving environment.
    • Ability to navigate ambiguous or undefined problems, make sound strategic decisions, and operate effectively without a rigid playbook.
    • Strong organizational and prioritization skills, with the ability to work autonomously and deliver results with minimal supervision.
    • Leadership and mentorship potential, with the ability to establish standards and develop future engineering talent.
    • Experience in professional services, consulting, BPO, legacy system migration, remote team leadership, or startup environments is beneficial but not essential.

      • Benefits

      • Full-time remote engagement.
      • Flexible working hours with required overlap with US time zones when needed for client and project delivery.
      • Opportunity to play a foundational role in launching and shaping a new technology and automation practice.
      • Significant technical ownership across architecture, application development, automation, integrations, and platform reliability.
      • Opportunity to work with AI-accelerated development technologies and modern software engineering approaches.
      • Potential to build, hire, and mentor a development team as the practice grows.
      • Exposure to diverse business processes and operational challenges across multiple client environments.
      • Opportunity to create practical technology solutions that modernize workflows without requiring disruptive legacy system replacements.
      • Entrepreneurial environment with substantial autonomy and opportunities to influence technical standards and delivery practices.
      • Candidates are expected to provide their own laptop and basic equipment, maintain reliable connectivity, and work from a secure environment.
      • Compliance with required security controls, including two-factor authentication.
How Jobgether works:
