title: Assistant Director of Accessibility Services
description:
The Center for Academic Success (CAS) provides academic support services for the student population at Alfred University. CAS also provides support, consultation, and advocacy for students with learning, physical, and/or psychological disabilities. Reporting to the Executive Director, the Assistant Director of Accessibility Services supports the mission of the Center for Academic Success by ensuring equitable access to the academic experience for students with disabilities. The position coordinates the implementation of accommodations, provides individualized support through academic coaching and case management, promotes universal design and inclusive teaching practices, and collaborates with faculty and staff to reduce barriers to student success.

As a member of the Center for Academic Success, the Assistant Director contributes to institutional retention and persistence efforts by supporting students' academic confidence, self-advocacy, and successful navigation of the university environment. The position also serves as a campus resource on disability-related issues, accessibility, assistive technology, and inclusive educational practices. The Assistant Director will also maintain an appropriate caseload of students with disabilities.

Salary: $50,917.88-$56,849.68, 35hrs/week

Accessibilitiy Services:
  • Coordinate the interactive process for students requesting academic accommodations, including intake appointments, documentation review, eligibility determinations, implementation of reasonable accommodations, and accommodation renewals.
  • Manage caseload of students registered with Accessibility Services, providing ongoing case management, advocacy, and support throughout their academic experience.
  • Coordinate the housing accommodation request and review process in partnership with Residence Life and other campus partners, including communicating decisions and maintaining appropriate documentation.
  • Maintain accurate, confidential student records in compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act
    (ADA), Section 504 of the Rehabilitation Act, FERPA, and institutional policies.
  • Monitor accommodation utilization and recommend improvements to enhance service delivery, accessibility, and student success.
Academic Sucess & Student Support:
  • Provide individualized academic coaching focused on executive functioning, time management, organization, study strategies, goal setting, self-advocacy, and academic confidence.
  • Maintain a support caseload of students experiencing academic difficulty, including students on academic warning or probation, and collaborate with faculty, advisors, and student success professionals on intervention strategies.
  • Develop individualized student success plans and connect students with tutoring, writing support, counseling, career services, and other campus resources.
  • Support institutional early alert and retention initiatives by responding to student referrals and implementing proactive interventions.
  • Assist students in developing independent learning strategies that promote persistence and academic achievement.
Faculty Development & Campus Education:
  • Develop and facilitate training for faculty, staff, and student employees on disability awareness, accessibility, Universal Design for Learning (UDL), inclusive teaching practices, and accommodation processes.
  • Serve as a campus resource on disability-related legislation, accessibility best practices, assistive technology, and emerging trends in higher education.
  • Develop educational materials and campus resources that increase awareness of accessibility services and promote an inclusive learning environment.
  • Participate on institutional committees and initiatives that advance student success, accessibility, equity, and belonging.
Outreach & Student Engagement:
  • Coordinate outreach initiatives to increase awareness of accessibility services among prospective and current students.
  • Participate in Orientation, Summer Bridge, Open Houses, First-Year Experience programming, and other transition initiatives.
  • Develop and present workshops on learning strategies, executive functioning, self-advocacy, and academic success in conjunction with Center for Academic Success staff.
  • Coordinate and teach one section of the University's first-year seminar (UNIV 103 or equivalent) each semester.
Assitive Technology & Testing Services:
  • Evaluate, recommend, and train students in the effective use of assistive technologies that enhance accessibility and academic success.
  • Collaborate with Information Technology and campus partners to support accessibility initiatives and technology solutions.
  • Coordinate and assist with accommodated testing services, including scheduling, exam administration, and proctoring, while providing backup support during periods of high demand.
Center fro Academic Sucess Operations:
  • Hire, train, supervise, and evaluate graduate assistants and student employees supporting the Center for Academic Success.
  • Assist the Executive Director with daily operations, strategic initiatives, program assessment, policy development, and continuous improvement efforts.
  • Respond to student and parent inquiries regarding accessibility services and academic support.
  • Collect, analyze, and report data related to accessibility services, academic coaching, and student success outcomes to inform decision-making.
  • Perform other duties as assigned in support of the mission of the Center for Academic Success.
Other Duties & Responsibilities:
  • Supports and assists in creating intersections for faculty, staff, and students that will assist in transforming people’s lives.
  • Supports and assists in creating an evolving culture of mentoring and rich engagement opportunities for faculty, staff, and students.
  • Maintains a commitment to diversity, equity and inclusion and a high degree of cultural competence and respect for a wide range of identities and experiences, therefore welcoming and supporting all faculty, staff and students and expanding access to the AU experience.
  • Maintains a safe working environment within and around their facilities and associated equipment and supplies including, but not limited to, obtaining Safety Data Sheet (SDS) information pertaining to any hazards associated with their work environment.
  • Participates in all required assigned training, including safety training and will comply with safety rules, regulations, and protocols.
Qualifications-Education & Experience, Knowledge, Skills & Abilities:
  • Formal Education: Bachelor’s in psychology or related field. Master’s Degree in School Psychology, Education, College Student Development, or related field preferred.
  • Experience: Experience with working with the college student population is desired, but other experiences will be taken into consideration.
  • Additional knowledge/skills
    • Highly organized and motivated with the ability to work independently.
    • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
    • Interest in academic success in higher education, program design, and evaluation.
    • Excellent computer literacy.
    • Skills in data analysis and assessments.
Physical Demands & Work Environment:
The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform essential functions.

Personal Protective Equipment must be worn when required. A respiratory function test and the ability to use respirators may be required. Stairs and uneven surfaces may be present; artificial lifts, etc., may or may not be available. The position may require the incumbent to walk outdoors in all types of weather to other buildings or offices located on the campus. The Campus is in an area that contains numerous hills and slopes and may not always be fully accessible for mobility-impaired individuals.

About Alfred University:
Lighting the way for students since 1836. “We've always been a place for makers, especially those who make the future. Our commitment to independent thinking, creativity, academic rigor, and community have made us a unique kind of leader since 1836.”

Alfred University (AU) was founded on principles of social justice in 1836 by liberal, independent thinkers who placed high value on education for all citizens. The University has retained and built upon the strong values of its founders, developing as an institution of national and international renown that is responsive to the needs of contemporary society while remaining consistent with the spirit of its origins. Alfred University is the second oldest coeducational college in the United States as well as one of the earliest nineteenth-century colleges to have enrolled African American and Native American students. It has a long-standing history of educating socially conscious students who make a difference in their professions and their communities.

Over the course of the twentieth century, Alfred University evolved into a complex institution offering a full range of programs in the liberal arts and sciences, art and design, engineering, business, education, counseling, and school psychology to its nearly 2,000 undergraduate and graduate students that live, learn, and play on a 232-acre campus located in an idyllic, creative valley in Western New York.

Alfred University actively subscribes to a policy of equal employment opportunity, and will not discriminate against any employee, student or applicant because of race, age, sex, color, sexual orientation, gender identification or expression, physical or mental disability, religion, ancestry or national origin, marital status, genetic information, military or veteran status, domestic violence victim status, criminal conviction status, political affiliation or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

title: Seniorforsker søges til økonomisk evaluering af Fusionsklinikken på Midt- og Vestsjællands Hospital
description:
Forskningsafdelingen ved Midt- og Vestsjællands Hospital i Region Sjælland søger en seniorforsker til en 37-timers tidsbegrænset ansættelse på 16 måneder.

Vi søger en kandidat, der er uddannet i folkesundhedsvidenskab og har gennemført en ph.d. inden for området. Ansøgeren forventes at have dokumenterede kompetencer inden for sundhedsøkonomi, forskning og videnskabelig formidling.

Stillingen er knyttet til gennemførelsen af en økonomisk evaluering af Fusionsklinikken, som er et integreret behandlingstilbud til mennesker med alvorlig psykisk sygdom og diabetes. Opgaverne omfatter planlægning, gennemførelse og formidling af den sundhedsøkonomiske evaluering i samarbejde med projektets forskere og samarbejdspartnere.

Ansættelse sker efter gældende overenskomst.

Yderligere oplysninger kan fås ved henvendelse til Forskningsleder Lene Berring, tlf. 24526326.

Ansøgningsfrist: d. 6. september 2026.

Ansættelsesområde

Region Sjælland og Region Hovedstaden bliver den 1. januar 2027 til Region Østdanmark som følge af sundhedsreformen. Dit ansættelsesområde vil være Region Østdanmark med alle tilhørende organisatoriske enheder.
Læs mere om betydningen af ansættelsesområdet på Region Østdanmarks hjemmeside.

Startløn for overenskomstansatte

Regionen er forpligtet til at oplyse dig om startlønnen for stillingen. Du får oplyst grundløn, centralt fastsatte tillæg og pension i den relevante overenskomst. Udover startlønnen, kan lønnen indeholde eventuelt forhandlede tillæg afhængigt af stillingen, dine erfaringer og kvalifikationer.
Se startlønnen på regionens hjemmeside

Om Midt- og Vestsjællands Hospital

På Midt- og Vestsjællands Hospital arbejder vi hver dag for at fremme det sunde liv ved at forebygge og behandle i en sammenhængende sundhedsindsats. Som hospital forener vi psykiatri og somatik. Vores mål er, at patienter og borgere oplever gode og trygge forløb af høj kvalitet.

Som medarbejder bliver du en del af et nytænkende, fagligt og organisatorisk robust hospital, hvor vi gør en forskel for de mennesker, der har brug for os. Læring og udvikling er en del af hverdagen og sker i fagligt forpligtende fællesskaber. Også på tværs af afdelinger.

Midt- og Vestsjællands Hospital dækker et opland på ca. 230.000 borgere. Vi har 766 sengepladser og er omkring 5.000 ansatte fordelt på 20 afdelinger, herunder 16 somatiske og psykiatriske specialer.

Vi tilbyder et solidt forskningsmiljø med 13 professorer og et stærkt fagligt uddannelsesmiljø, hvor vi hvert år byder cirka 2.700 studerende, elever og læger i videreuddannelsesforløb velkommen.

title: GIS Analyst
description:
Infinity Natural Resources (NYSE: INR), is an oil and gas exploration and production company deeply rooted in the Appalachian Basin. Headquartered in Morgantown, WV, we are committed to responsible energy development, operational excellence, and strong environmental stewardship across our growing operations in Ohio and Pennsylvania. We pride ourselves on a collaborative work environment, a team dedicated to innovation and safety, and our strong connection to the Appalachian Basin, the region we proudly call home and operate within.

The Opportunity
We are looking for a detail-oriented GIS Analyst I to join our team. In this role, you'll build, maintain, and analyze the geospatial data that powers leasing, drilling, production, and operational decisions across the company. It's a strong fit for someone early in their GIS career who takes pride in accurate maps and clean data, and who enjoys partnering with colleagues across the business to turn spatial information into practical answers.

Location
This position is based at our Morgantown, WV headquarters on a hybrid schedule — in the office Tuesday through Thursday, with Monday and Friday worked from a home office. Occasional field or site visits should be expected as projects require.

What You'll Be Doing
  • Generate maps, figures, reports, and database queries to support leasing, production, drilling, and operational activities.
  • Create, update, maintain, and refine geospatial datasets, attributes, layers, file structures, and naming conventions.
  • Perform routine spatial analysis and queries to support decision-making across departments.
  • Manage and integrate external data sources to enhance GIS projects, reporting, and data accuracy.
  • Support end users by responding to routine GIS requests, troubleshooting issues, and helping resolve data discrepancies.
  • Perform quality control checks to maintain geodatabase integrity and ensure compliance with company standards.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams and stakeholders to provide GIS support for projects and initiatives.
  • Research and compile information to keep GIS data current, accurate, and useful for business needs.
  • Stay current on GIS tools, practices, and process improvements that enhance efficiency and expand team capabilities.
  • Demonstrate professionalism, flexibility, and a collaborative approach while adapting to changing priorities.

Your Background
  • Associate degree in GIS or related field preferred; bachelor’s degree preferred
  • Minimum 2 years of GIS experience within the Oil and Gas Industry
  • Foundational knowledge of GIS software, including ArcMap and/or ArcGIS Pro.
  • Understanding of geodatabase creation, maintenance, editing, and spatial data management.
  • Strong cartographic skills with the ability to design clear, accurate, and professional maps and presentations.
  • Ability to perform basic spatial analysis, queries, and data validation.
  • Strong attention to detail and accuracy when working with data, reports, and mapping outputs.
  • Effective organizational, time management, problem-solving, written, and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to work collaboratively with colleagues across departments and support a wide range of business needs.
  • Commitment to continuous learning and professional development in GIS applications and tools.
  • Ability to work in an office environment with occasional field or site visits and operate standard office and computer equipment.

Infinity Natural Resources is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, race, color, religion, national origin, disability, protected Veteran status, age, or any other characteristic protected by law.

If you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, you may contact us at humanresources@infinitynr.com.

title: Security Consultant (Microsoft Azure & M365)
description:
As one of Microsoft’s most recognized global partners, Quisitive sits at the forefront of cloud transformation, enterprise data strategy, cybersecurity, and the emerging frontier of agentic AI. Here, consultants and technologists operate on the edge of innovation—supported by a culture that values craftsmanship, open collaboration, and technical expertise. What You'll Do

  • Configure and support Microsoft Entra ID, identity governance, and privileged access solutions

With a diversified delivery model that includes both nearshore and offshore capabilities, our team of Microsoft experts delivers cloud solutions, artificial intelligence and business applications that transform our clients’ businesses and achieve remarkable business outcomes. ​

title: Engineer III - Civil

title: Hospital Technician - UPMC Children's & St. Margaret

The Representative will team up daily with drivers, operations personnel, sales teams, and corporate support staff to service their assigned hospital location.

UPMC St. Margaret - 815 Freeport Rd, Pittsburgh, PA 15215 (Mon/Wed/Thurs)

UPMC Children's Hospital - 4401 Penn Ave, Pittsburgh, PA 15224 (Tues/Fri)

Check this out on our YouTube!

  • Inspection and servicing of all Daniels’ products within your assigned hospital or medical center; this includes entering procedural areas and working around sensitive patients and equipment

  • Comfortable standing for extended periods and working in PPE

Why work for us?

  • Consistent work hours – Monday – Friday (5AM - 2PM)
  • Benefits – Full time roles are provided benefits, sick leave and vacation leave from day one!!
  • Permanent position – This is a Full-time permanent role of 40 hours per week!

title: Project Manager
description:

We create value through technology and deliver customer-focused engineering services for leading companies in the automotive industry. Join our talented team and grow professionally while gaining experience with advanced robotics, state-of-the-art vision systems, Internet of Things (IoT)-based applications, and emerging processes and practices in manufacturing.

How do you add value to the role?

The PM manages the planning, implementation, and quality of projects and programs executed by the company in the field of industrial production system automation. The Project Administrator is responsible for coordinating and managing assigned personnel and resources and also contributes to new business development by leveraging experience and knowledge of the customers and/or business lines served.

Requirements

  • Education: Bachelor's Degree in Engineering or a related Science discipline (Professional License is required).

  • Master in Manufacturing Systems or Business.

  • Languages: Advanced English (Mandatory).

  • Passport and VISA are required.

Experience

  • 5 years participating in capital equipment projects.

  • 4 years leading projects and work teams.

  • 4 years in factory automation projects (Automotive Industry preferred)

Knowledge

  • Extensive Knowledge of industrial applications and processes related to factory automation.

  • Proficiency in project management techniques and methodologies.

  • Experience with manufacturing processes, preferred in the automotive industry.

  • Full ability to interpret technical specifications and requirements for industrial environments and processes; identify tasks, actions, and risks; plan activities; and define relevant milestones.

title: Brand Ambassador (part time) - San Jose
description:
About Us

Connected International, Inc. (Connected Cannabis Co.) is a leading vertically integrated cannabis company based in Sacramento and operating in California, Arizona, and Florida. With over 11 years experience, Connected specializes in breeding, growing, manufacturing, and distributing top-shelf cannabis through its state-of-the-art facilities and proprietary genetics.

With over 250 employees across the United States, Connected maintains a strong presence in the industry across multiple markets. The company has recently expanded into Arizona and Florida with ambitious national expansion plans underway. Connected's mission has always been to breed, grow, and sell the best cannabis in the world, setting high standards for its products, people, and partners wherever we go.

A Brand Ambassador for Connected International will play a pivotal role in driving growth within designated markets. Their primary focus will be to support a range of activities including product demonstrations, Budtender trainings, product seeding, account follow-ups, administrative tasks, store visits, merchandising, and event support, among other miscellaneous support duties.
This dynamic role requires a proactive go-getter to ensure the successful execution of our marketing strategies. They must be willing to work weekends, adapting to the demands of the role to meet our objectives effectively. This position is based on a temporary employment contract, with potential opportunities for extension based on performance and business needs.

The Brand Ambassador will be covering the San Jose area and surrounding areas.

NOTE: This is a part-time, long term temporary role with variable hours.

What You Will Do

  • Receive and engage in training sessions led by Team Leads or experienced Brand Ambassadors to ensure up-to-date knowledge and skills.
  • Participate in Demo's, Trainings, Events, Retail Installations, and Misc. duties.

  • Support Retail merchandising with necessary materials and promotional items as required.
  • Work collaboratively with a team of Brand Ambassadors during event activations, contributing to team efforts and success.
  • Assist in gathering post-event reports to evaluate stock levels and key insights
  • Available for weekend duties and support needs.
  • Contribute to the achievement of organizational goals and maintaining high team morale ensuring the effective execution of company promotions.

What We Are Looking For

  • 1-2 years of experience in Field Marketing preferred, preferably in the Cannabis industry.
  • Deep understanding of and passion for cannabis
  • Strong understanding of the retail landscape across California.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to build and maintain relationships with trade partners.
  • Ability to analyze market trends and consumer behavior and recommend new and effective trade marketing tactics.
  • Ability to work independently, prioritize tasks and meet deadlines in a fast-paced environment.
  • Ability to work non-traditional schedule, including mandatory evening and weekend work, with days off occurring mid-week.
  • Reliable transportation and valid CA drivers license.
  • 21 years & older

Compensation Description (hourly): The hourly pay range for this position in the selected city is $25.00

Compensation may vary outside of this range depending on a number of factors, including a candidate’s qualifications, skills, competencies and experience, and location.

Why Connected?

Connected is an exciting, innovative workplace with an inclusive culture that offers rare career opportunities, and a chance to make a real-world impact in a new start-up industry! We are looking for exceptional people to join our team as we transition into the next phase of our business ventures and become a leader in the cannabis industry.

title: Retail Designer
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Retail Designer based in Mexico.

As a Retail Designer, you will help shape engaging, high-quality retail environments across international markets. You will translate customer needs, brand identity, commercial objectives, and strategic goals into compelling architectural and interior design solutions. Working closely with project teams, contractors, consultants, and local stakeholders, you will manage projects from concept through delivery. Your work will combine creative design thinking with technical expertise, commercial awareness, and practical problem-solving. You will develop detailed architectural packages, construction documentation, 3D visualizations, and space plans that bring retail concepts to life. This is an opportunity to influence how customers experience physical spaces while contributing to evolving retail concepts and best practices.

Accountabilities

  • Translate brand DNA, identity, commercial objectives, and strategic priorities into architectural and interior design solutions through detailed drawings and plans.
  • Create, develop, and review architectural, interior design, and construction documentation for a range of retail projects.
  • Design and plan retail spaces based on customer behaviors, site-specific requirements, commercial priorities, and established design guidelines.
  • Provide innovative and practical solutions to technical and design challenges throughout the project lifecycle.
  • Present concepts and design solutions clearly and professionally using plans, sections, 3D models, renderings, and visualizations.
  • Collaborate with relevant stakeholders to develop retail concepts, improve design approaches, and establish effective processes and best practices.
  • Manage project timelines, organize deliverables, and ensure work is completed according to realistic schedules.
  • Structure and maintain project information and documentation to support clear, secure handovers to internal and external stakeholders.
  • Follow up on completed projects, evaluate successes and areas for improvement, and apply learnings to future initiatives.
  • Maintain effective communication and collaboration with project teams, brands, contractors, consultants, and local stakeholders.
  • Incorporate stakeholder feedback and balance competing requirements to identify the best solution for each retail space.

    • Requirements

    • Degree in Architecture, Interior Design, or a related discipline, or equivalent professional experience.
    • 3–5 years of experience in retail architecture or interior design, particularly involving commercial space planning.
    • Proficiency in Revit, AutoCAD Architecture, and other CAD tools used for 2D and 3D design.
    • Strong understanding of real estate and retail project stages, including exploration, negotiation, design, approval, construction, and project follow-up.
    • Demonstrated ability to manage multiple projects in complex environments involving diverse stakeholders.
    • Strong 3D visualization skills and the ability to translate concepts into accurate renderings and practical spatial solutions.
    • Ability to make fact-based layout and design decisions while balancing guidelines, customer needs, commercial objectives, and site-specific conditions.
    • Goal-oriented and results-driven approach, with strong problem-solving skills and the ability to operate effectively in fast-paced environments.
    • Excellent communication, presentation, collaboration, organization, and time-management skills.
    • Advanced proficiency in both English and Spanish.
    • International retail or architectural experience is an advantage.

      • Benefits

      • Comprehensive health insurance and wellbeing support.
      • Wellness and family support programs.
      • Paid leave and paid time-off programs, including opportunities to contribute to the local community.

title: Yard Attendant
description:
Taylor Northeast is the mid-Atlantic and New England’s premier dealer of forklifts, container handlers, railcar movers, industrial floor cleaning machines, and much more. Headquartered near Reading, Pennsylvania with multiple branch facilities from Baltimore to New Hampshire, we sell, rent, service, and rebuild a range of custom and heavy-duty material handling equipment that is unlike any other company in the industry. And we are fortunate to have an equipment lineup that is backed by the best service technicians and parts support teams in the Northeast.

We are looking for a dependable Detailer/Yard Attendant to support the Shop Coordinator, mechanics, and yard operations. This role involves equipment handling, detailing, general labor, and helping keep the shop running smoothly.

Responsibilities
  • Equipment Handling & Yard Work
  • Load and unload equipment
  • Move equipment to/from the shop and various buildings.
  • Dig out equipment and organize the yard.
  • Assist with yard inventory and staging attachments (masts, channels, forks, etc.).
  • Move units for sales photos, demos, or measurements.
  • Bring equipment inside at the end of the day.
Detailing & Cleaning
  • Detail equipment (major part of the workday).
  • Paint touch-ups; paint forks and wheels.
  • Clean excess fluids and debris.
  • Check equipment for damage vs. normal wear.
  • Perform 360 check-in/check-out and apply tags.
  • Wash bay support when needed.
Shop Support
  • Pull job supplies and put away materials.
  • Provide shop supplies to employees.
  • Find parts in storage and help road mechanics load vans.

  • Help with dock maintenance, including lift gate and garage door checks.
  • Keep detail supplies and keys organized.
  • Dump scrap barrels, smash down dumpsters, and swap them when needed.

Taylor Northeast is proud to be a flagship member of the Forged Industrial Group, a fast-growing network of four operating companies that employs hundreds of experts at businesses located throughout the US. From the nation’s busiest ports, to its largest mills, to its biggest infrastructure projects, you’ll find our equipment wherever you find materials on the move. Learn more about the power of our teams at taylornortheast.com.

We are an equal opportunity employer.

title: Field Technician
description:

title: Cloud Digital Trust
description:
Spektrum supports apex purchasers (NATO, UN, EU, and National Government and Defence) and their Tier 1 supplier ecosystem with a wide range of specialist services. We provide our clients with professional services, specialised aerospace and defence sales, delivery, and operational subject matter expertise. We are looking for personnel to join our team and support key client projects.

Who we are supporting

The NATO Communication and Information Agency (NCIA) is responsible for providing secure and effective communications and information technology (IT) services to NATO's member countries and its partners. The agency was established in 2012 and is headquartered in Brussels, Belgium.

The NCIA provides a wide range of services, including:

  • Cyber Security: The NCIA provides advanced cybersecurity solutions to protect NATO's communication networks and information systems against cyber threats.
  • Command and Control Systems: The NCIA develops and maintains the systems used by NATO's military commanders to plan and execute operations.
  • Satellite Communications: The NCIA provides satellite communications services to enable secure and reliable communications between NATO forces.
  • Electronic Warfare: The NCIA provides electronic warfare services to support NATO's mission to detect, deny, and defeat threats to its communication networks.
  • Information Management: The NCIA manages NATO's information technology infrastructure, including its databases, applications, and servers.

Overall, the NCIA plays a critical role in ensuring the security and effectiveness of NATO's communication and information technology capabilities.

The program

Assistance and Advisory Service (AAS)

The NATO Communications and Information Agency (NCI Agency) is NATO’s principal C3 capability deliverer and CIS service provider. It provides, maintains and defends the NATO enterprise-wide information technology infrastructure to enable Allies to consult together under Article IV, and, when required, stand together in the face of attack under Article V.

To provide these critical services, in the modern evolving dynamic environment the NCI Agency needs to build and maintain high performance-engaged workforce. The NCI Agency workforce strategically consists of three major categorise's: NATO International Civilians (NIC)'s, Military (Mil), and Interim Workforce Consultants (IWC)'s. The IWCs are a critical part of the overall NCI Agency workforce and make up approximately 15 percent of the total workforce.

Role ID – 2026-0128

Role Duties and Responsibilities

  • The Contractor shall perform the following activities in support of the deliverables. These activities are not considered deliverables in themselves:
  • Facilitate stakeholder discussion to confirm the pilot scope, target environment, priority SaaS application, success criteria, and key risk areas.
  • Coordinate with Cloud, compliance, audit and business stakeholders to agree on roles and responsibilities, dependencies, and decision points of the pilot.
  • Review whether automated evidence from cloud and/or SaaS is complete, reliable, traceable, and suitable.
  • Mapping “digital evidence” to relevant controls, audit requirements and assurance expectations.
  • Review dashboard content to ensure it accurately reflects live risk posture, control status and compliance.
  • Prepare C-suit demo flow to explain live dashboard, key insights and business value.
  • Conduct Stakeholder Review Sessions to validate assumptions, mappings etc.
  • Issue tracking and remediation support.
  • Deliverables
    D001 – Pilot Scope and Governance Baseline (document)
  • Deliverable: a signed-off Pilot Definition Document containing

(a) the named pilot environment (specific Azure Landing Zone or SaaS application),

(b) quantified success criteria for the pilot (e.g. number of controls under continuous monitoring, evidence refresh frequency, target reduction in manual audit effort),

(c) a RACI covering cloud, compliance, audit and business stakeholders, (d) the selected control framework baseline to be expressed in OSCAL

(e) a risk and dependency register with owners.

Acceptance: document approved in writing by the NCIA PM

  1. D002 – Digital Evidence Assessment and Audit Readiness Report (document plus
    mapping artifact)
  • Deliverable:

(a) a control-to-evidence mapping matrix covering 100% of the controls in the agreed pilot baseline, identifying for each control the automated evidence source, collection method, and traceability path, delivered in OSCAL-compatible format where feasible,

(b) an assessment of each evidence source against completeness, reliability, traceability and suitability,

(c) a gap and remediation log with prioritised actions, and
(d) a written internal audit validation memo confirming which controls the digital evidence satisfies and which require compensating manual evidence.
Acceptance: mapping matrix covers the full pilot baseline; approved in writing by the NCIA PM

  1. D003 – Executive Demo Package and Scaling Recommendation (working demo plus documents)
  • Deliverable:
    (a) a configured Live Trust Dashboard in the pilot environment showing real-time control status, risk posture and compliance state for the pilot scope,

(b) the executive briefing deck and demo script used for the Board presentation,
(c) a one-page business value summary quantifying audit effort saved and risk visibility gained, and

(d) a recommendation report describing the path from pilot to cATO MVP on RegScale, including resourcing, licensing and dependency assumptions.
Acceptance: demo delivered to the Board or delegated executive audience; all artifacts handed over and stored as directed by NCIA per Section 8.

Essential Skills, Experience and Certifications

  • A minimum requirement of a Bachelor’s degree at a nationally recognized/certified University in a related discipline and 3 years post-related experience.
  • A minimum of 3 years’ experience in all of the following items:
    Leadership,
  1. Communication,
  2. Strategy,
  3. Risk Management,
  4. Audit standards,
  5. Storytelling and ROI Analysis.
  • Documented (or demonstrable) experience in process analysis, and design techniques

Essential Skills, Experience and Certifications

  • Robust technical knowledge of NATO operations, responsibilities and organization – with specific focus on how NATO achieves technical interoperability on the battlefield.
  • Comprehensive understanding of NATO’s Cloud strategies.
  • Knowledge of ITIL, COBIT, or equivalent.
  • Familiarity with current and evolving capabilities and trends in military and civilian communication protocols and standards.
  • Deciding and Initiating Action - Takes responsibility for actions, projects and people; takes
    initiative and works under own direction; initiates and generates activity and introduces changes into work processes; makes quick, clear decisions which may include tough choices or considered risks.
  • Adhering to Principles and Values - Upholds ethics and values; demonstrates integrity; promotes and defends equal opportunities, builds diverse teams; encourages organizational and individual responsibility towards the community and the environment.
  • Relating and Networking - Easily establishes good relationships with customers and staff; relates well to people at all levels; builds wide and effective networks of contacts; uses humor appropriately to bring warmth to relationships with others.
  • Formulating Strategies and Concepts - Works strategically to realize organizational goals; sets and develops strategies; identifies, develops positive and compelling visions of the organization’s future potential; takes account of a wide range of issues across, and related to, the organization.
  • Achieving Personal Work Goals and Objectives - Accepts and tackles demanding goals with enthusiasm; works hard and puts in longer hours when it is necessary; seeks progression to roles of increased responsibility and influence; identifies own development needs and makes use of developmental or training opportunities.

Working Location

  • The Hague, Netherlands

Working Policy

  • On-site

Travel

  • Some travel to other NATO sites may be required
  • All travel expenses, including per diem, lodging and associated expenses for travel are included in the price of the bid (NTE), such that the purchaser shall not be invoiced separately for travel.
  • Extraordinary Travel (Purchaser Directed Travel) may be required to other NATO or non-NATO
    locations as necessary. In the event of such unforeseen meetings being called, the cost of all travel and subsistence will be addressed through a contract amendment.
  • Extraordinary Travel expenses will be reimbursed in accordance with Article 5.5 of AAS+ Framework Contract. Such costs will be set as a separate PO line with a not to exceed value to cover and reimburse of actual expenses upon submissions of all receipts and invoices in line with NCIA processes.

Security Clearance

  • Valid National or NATO Secret personal security clearance

title: Fagligt dygtige sagsbehandlere til Rejsesektionen ved Forsvarsministeriets Regnskabsstyrelse
description:
Fagligt dygtige sagsbehandlere til Rejsesektionen ved Forsvarsministeriets Regnskabsstyrelse

Kan du se dig selv i en Rejsesektion, der har ansvaret for booking, administration og kontrol af tjenesterejser i forsvaret, og hvor vi sammen løfter i flok?

Arbejder du struktureret, er ansvarsbevidst og trives med driftsopgaver? Så er det måske dig, vi leder efter til vores team i Rejsesektionen.

Om os

I Forsvarsministeriets Regnskabsstyrelse er vi ca. 250 medarbejdere hvoraf Rejsesektionen består af 40 medarbejdere fordelt i mindre teams. Vi har ansvaret for den samlede rejseproces i koncernen.

Forsvaret er i en stor udvikling, hvilket også har betydning for os i Rejsesektionen, derfor søger vi i øjeblikket nye kollegaer til vores teams.

Du bliver en del af et team, der lægger vægt på samarbejde, vidensdeling, nysgerrighed, en uformel omgangstone og et godt arbejdsmiljø - ikke mindst med plads til socialt samvær.

Du bliver en del af en unik arbejdsplads med fokus på bl.a. work-life balance, kompetenceudvikling og medarbejderinvolvering.

Om stillingerne

Vi søger engagerede medarbejdere til forskellige stillinger med fokus på de daglige driftsopgaver, hvor kvalitet og overblik er i højsædet.

Dine primære ansvarsområder og arbejdsopgaver vil variere alt efter, hvilket team du ansættes i, men kan f.eks. være:

  • Telefonbetjening
  • Opfølgning på og afstemning af rejseudgifter
  • Administration af firmahæftende betalingskort
Vi har mulighed for at tilpasse jobbet til ansøgeren. Du får en grundig sidemandsoplæring og vi forventer ikke, at du kan det hele på forhånd, men vi forventer, at du har en stor motivation for at ville lære. Derudover forventer vi, at du bidrager til opgaveløsningen på tværs af de enkelte teams og i hele Regnskabsstyrelsen. Ansættelsen er på fuld tid 37 timer ugentligt.

Om dig

Vi forestiller os, at du er kontoruddannet, har en finansøkonom eller administrationsbachelor uddannelse eller tilsvarende.

Har du erfaring med databehandling eller har du arbejdet processer vil det være et plus.

Vi forventer, at du:

  • Arbejder selvstændigt og tager ansvar for dine opgaver
  • Har fokus på drift og kvalitet i dit arbejde
  • Er en holdspiller, der er motiveret for at bidrage til de fælles mål
  • Er mødestabil og vægter fremmøde på kontoret højt
  • Har administrativ erfaring
Vi sørger for, at du bliver godt klædt på til jobbet, og investerer i dig og din udvikling i form af oplæring, uddannelse og kurser.

Ansættelsesvilkår
Ansættelsen sker i henhold til den til enhver tid gældende Fællesoverenskomst mellem Finansministeriet og Offentligt Ansattes Organisationer – Det Statslige Område (OAO-S-fællesoverenskomsten) og Organisationsaftale for kontorfunktionærer, laboranter og it-medarbejdere (HK) i staten.

Afhængigt af dine kvalifikationer og kompetencer, er der mulighed for forhandling af tillæg. Der er til stillingen knyttet en arbejdsgiverfinansieret pensionsordning.
Arbejdsstedet er i Hjørring.

Som ansat under Forsvarsministeriets område er du omfattet af nogle særlige vilkår. Du skal bl.a. kunne sikkerhedsgodkendes og opretholde sikkerhedsgodkendelsen under hele ansættelsesforholdet.

Du har som ansat pligt til at forrette tjeneste uden for landets grænser, herunder ved enheder i internationale operationer med henblik på deltagelse i konfliktforebyggende, fredsbevarende, fredsskabende, humanitære og andre lignende operationer.

Kontakt og ansøgning
Hvis du vil høre mere om stillingen, er du velkommen til at kontakte teamleder Jeanette Kristensen på telefon 7281 0802.

Har du spørgsmål til løn- og ansættelsesvilkår er du velkommen til at kontakte Personelkommandoen, HR-konsulent Mia A. F. Rostermund på telefon 3266 5971.

Ansøgningsfristen er den 20. september 2026 og samtaler forventes afholdt løbende. Stillingen er til besættelse den 1. november 2026 eller efter nærmere aftale.

Du søger stillingen via linket, og vi beder dig vedhæfte ansøgning, CV og kopi af uddannelsesbevis/svendebrev. Vær opmærksom på, at bilag skal tilføjes i PDF-format.

I Forsvarsministeriets organisation tror vi på, at mangfoldighed optimerer opgaveløsningen. Derfor opfordrer vi alle interesserede uanset baggrund til at søge stillingen.

Forsvarsministeriets Regnskabsstyrelse
Forsvarsministeriets Regnskabsstyrelse holder til i Hjørring og har ca. 250 medarbejdere med en bred civil baggrund. Vi sørger for regnskaber, betalinger, lønadministration og bogføring for hele ministeriets koncern. Samtidig hjælper vi vores kunder – de andre styrelser og myndigheder – med at styrke deres kontrolmiljø og sikre en solid økonomistyring. Vi arbejder også på at gøre processerne smartere med videndeling og automatisering, og vi lægger stor vægt på samarbejde og faglig kvalitet.

title: Pædagogmedhjælpere til Langenæsstien 6A og Langenæsstien 6B
description:
Pædagogmedhjælpere søges til Langenæsstien 6A og Langenæsstien 6B

Vi søger to pædagogmedhjælpere der har lyst til at være en del af dagligdagen i Langenæsstien 6A og Langenæsstien 6B

Stillingerne er på 37 timer og faste

Medhjælperjobbet er en vekselvirkning mellem praktiske opgaver og samvær/leg med børnene.

Din profil:

Vi har ingen forventninger om, at du har erfaring fra tidligere ansættelser, det vigtigste er, at du har lyst til at bidrage og tage ansvar i det daglige arbejde med børnene. Du skal kunne tage initiativ på egen hånd, bevare overblikket i pressede situationer, ”skynde dig langsomt” og vigtigst af alt have lyst til at lege og være nærværende sammen med børn i alderen 0-6 år.

Medhjælperjobbet indebærer også en del praktisk arbejde, så du skal ligeledes kunne gribe både kost og klud.

Forældresamarbejdet er en stor del af arbejdet i vuggestuen, og den daglige dialog med forældrene ved aflevering og afhentning vil også være en del af jobbet.

Vi har en forventning til, at du kan igangsætte og fordybe dig i leg med børnene, at du både kan ”se” det enkelte barn men samtidig også have blik for hele børnegruppen. Du skal have lyst til at danse, hoppe, kravle, synge mm sammen med børnene både ude og inde og du skal selv kunne tage initiativ hertil.

Som pædagogmedhjælper bliver du fast tilknyttet en stue, men vil samtidig have en vigtig og alsidig flyverfunktion i huset, hvor du ved personalefravær, kurser, møder mv. træder til på tværs af stuerne. Det kræver, at du har lyst og evne til at skabe gode relationer til alle husets børn og opbygge et godt kendskab til deres behov, så du trygt og naturligt kan indgå i forskellige børnegrupper. Vi sørger selvfølgelig for en grundig introduktion og klæder dig godt på til opgaven, så du får en god start og bliver tryg i rollen.

Derfor skal du vælge os:

Vi er en del af Langenæs dagtilbud som består af 7 afdelinger. I Langenæsstien 6B og 6A er vi i vuggestuen 26 børn fordelt på 2 stuer i vuggestuen og 50 børn i børnehave fordelt på 3 grupper. Vi er en blandet personalegruppe af yngre, erfarne og uerfarne personaler, som du bliver en del af.

Vi elsker natur og udeliv og du skal derfor være indstillet på at være ude størstedelen af dagen, sommer som vinter. Vi holder af at give børnene førstehånds oplevelser med naturen samt at arbejde med og hele tiden udvikle på vores legemiljøer – det glæder vi os til at I kan blive en del af.

Vi arbejder struktureret med afsæt i vores aktivitetsplan der tager udgangspunkt i vores Årshjul, som afspejler årets gang.



Løn og ansættelsesvilkår:

Stillingerne er faste medhjælperstillinger med en gennemsnitlig ugentlig arbejdstid på 37 timer.

Du skal kunne tiltræde d. 01.10.26. eller snarest derefter.

Der afholdes samtaler torsdag den 24.09.2026.

Løn og ansættelsesvilkår vil være i henhold til gældende overenskomst. I henhold til Aarhus Kommunes regler, vil der blive indhentet børneattest samt straffeattest.



Hvis du vil vide mere:

Har du yderlige spørgsmål til stillingen kan der rettes henvendelse til:

Langenæsstien 6B tlf: 4012 4575 el. Langenæsstien 6A 4012 4586.

Vi modtager kun ansøgninger igennem stillingsopslaget og vi tilbyder ikke rundvisninger, da det er forstyrrende for børnemiljøet.

Ansøgning

Klik på linket ”SØG JOB” for at udfylde og sende din ansøgning. Ansøgningen skal være os i hænde senest klokken 12.00 den 22.09.26. Alle felter med * skal udfyldes. Først når du har modtaget en kvittering pr. e-mail, har vi modtaget din ansøgning.

title: Lærere til specialskolen Skolen ved Rønnebær Allé, barselsvikariater
description:
To lærere søges til barselsvikariater på Skolen ved Rønnebær Allé pr. 1. november 2026
Brænder du for at skabe undervisning, hvor alle elever får mulighed for at lykkes – og har du lyst til at bringe din faglighed i spil på en specialskole?

Skolen ved Rønnebær Allé søger to lærere til barselsvikariater med tiltrædelse 1. november 2026.

Vi søger:
1. En lærer til 2./3. årgang med matematik
Her bliver du en del af et team omkring elever med autisme og kognitive udfordringer. Vi søger en lærer, der kan gøre matematik konkret, overskuelig og meningsfuld og tilrettelægge undervisningen med blik for elevernes forskellige faglige og udviklingsmæssige forudsætninger.
Du skal have lyst til at arbejde i en struktureret og forudsigelig hverdag, hvor undervisningen tilpasses den enkelte elev, og hvor relationer, tydelighed og genkendelighed er vigtige elementer i elevernes læring og trivsel.

2. En dansklærer til mellemtrin/udskoling
Her bliver du en del af et team omkring elever med opmærksomhedsforstyrrelser. Vi søger en lærer med stærke danskfaglige kompetencer, som har lyst til at arbejde med elever på mellemtrinnet og/eller udskolingen.
Du skal kunne skabe en undervisning, der engagerer og motiverer eleverne, samtidig med at du kan differentiere og skabe tydelige og overskuelige rammer. Eleverne kan have brug for støtte til blandt andet opmærksomhed, koncentration, struktur og deltagelse i undervisningen.
Vi lægger vægt på, at du kan se bag om elevernes adfærd og møde dem med tydelighed, ro og positive forventninger.

Om Skolen ved Rønnebær Allé
Skolen ved Rønnebær Allé er en specialskole, hvor vi arbejder med børn og unge med forskellige specialpædagogiske behov.
Vores udgangspunkt er, at eleverne skal mødes med tydelige forventninger, stærke relationer og undervisning, der tager afsæt i deres individuelle forudsætninger og potentialer.
Vi arbejder tæt sammen i teams og på tværs af fagligheder. Hos os står man derfor ikke alene med opgaven. Vi bruger hinanden aktivt til sparring, udvikling af undervisningen og til at finde løsninger, når en elev eller en klasse kalder på, at vi gør noget anderledes.

Vi leder efter dig, der
  • er uddannet lærer og har stærke kompetencer inden for blandt andet matematik eller dansk
  • kan planlægge og gennemføre differentieret undervisning
  • har blik for både elevernes faglige, sociale og personlige udvikling
  • kan skabe struktur, forudsigelighed og tydelige rammer
  • er relationskompetent og nysgerrig på det, der ligger bag elevernes adfærd
  • kan bevare ro og overblik, når en situation bliver vanskelig
  • ser muligheder frem for begrænsninger
  • har lyst til tæt teamsamarbejde og faglig sparring
  • bidrager aktivt og positivt til vores fælles skole.
Erfaring fra specialområdet er en fordel, men det er ikke en forudsætning. Det vigtigste er, at du har lyst til at arbejde specialpædagogisk, er fagligt nysgerrig og har mod på at udvikle din praksis sammen med dine kolleger.

Hos os får du
En arbejdsplads, hvor faglighed, samarbejde og relationer er helt centrale. Vi ved, at arbejdet på en specialskole både kan være krævende og utrolig meningsfuldt, og derfor prioriterer vi, at der er mulighed for sparring tæt på praksis.
Du får blandt andet:
  • engagerede elever, der kalder på kreativitet og stærk faglighed
  • tæt samarbejde med kolleger omkring eleverne
  • faglig og pædagogisk sparring
  • mulighed for at udvikle dine specialpædagogiske kompetencer
  • dygtige og engagerede kolleger, der hjælper hinanden
  • mulighed for at gøre en reel forskel for børn og unge.

Ansættelse
Der er tale om to barselsvikariater med tiltrædelse 1. november 2026:
  • ét barselsvikariat på 2./3. årgang med blandet andet matematik for elever med autisme og kognitive udfordringer
  • ét barselsvikariat på mellemtrin/udskoling med blandet andet dansk for elever med ADHD og andre opmærksomhedsforstyrrelser.
Løn og ansættelsesvilkår sker efter gældende overenskomst.
Ansøgningsfrist: 15. september 2026
Samtaler forventes afholdt: 23. september 2026

Stillingen i indskolingen:

title: Børnehuset Højstensgård søger vuggestuepædagog til Krummestuen
description:
Vil du være med til at skabe trygge hverdage og stærke fællesskaber for de allermindste, og trives du i en kultur, hvor metodefrihed går hånd i hånd med faligt ansvar? Så er du måske vores nye pædagog i vuggestuen Krummestuen i Børnehuset Højstensgård.

Om os
I Børnehuset Højstensgård arbejder vi med nærvær, ro og tydelig rammesætning som grundlag for leg, læring og trivsel. Hverdagen er præget af autentiske relationer, forudsigelige rutiner og indbydende læringsmiljøer, som er tilstræbt børnenes præmisser. Vi har et hus, hvor medarbejderne tager naturligt ansvar, i alt fra de små praktiske greb i hverdagen, ad hoc-opgaver og oprydning, til den fælles pædagogiske retning på stuen, i afdelingen og på tværs af huset. Den frihed, der gives i opgaveløsningen, følges af en klar forventning om, at man kan stå fast professionelt, både i sig selv, sin faglighed og sin praksis.

Vores samarbejdskultur
Vi prioriterer faglig sparring højt. For os betyder det, at vi møder uenigheder med nysgerrighed og respekt. Vi skelner mellem person og sag, og bruger uenighed som motor for læring. Vi er åbne om vores antagelser, vi metakommunikerer, når noget er uklart, og vi giver og modtager feedback med blik for børnenes bedste. Kort sagt, er en sund, ordentlig og professionel pædagogisk identitet noget, vi både værner om og udvikler sammen.

Forældresamarbejdet
Vi prioriterer et ligeværdigt, tillidsfuldt forældresamarbejde med tydelig og imødekommende dialog. Dette gælder både i de korte overleveringer og i planlagte samtaler og møder. Vi deler konkrete observationer, laver klare aftaler og følger op, så barnet oplever trygge, sammenhængende rammer i hverdagen. Når noget er svært, tager vi dialogen respektfuldt og løsningsorienteret og gør, hvad vi kan for at sikre de bedst mulige betingelser for det enkelte barn. Vores børnesyn er også et menneskesyn: Børn gør det bedste, de kan, med de kompetencer, de har – og vi møder deres forældre som ligeværdige partnere, med respekt, nysgerrighed og en grundlæggende tro på, at alle vil deres barn det bedste. I den forbindelse arbejder vi med faglig ydmyghed, selv når vi er allermest overbeviste og enige, betragter vi vores viden som kvalificerede antagelser, der skal afprøves, deles i sparring og justeres i lyset af praksis og nye observationer. Sådan holder vi fast i ressourcesynet på både børn og forældre.

Om stillingen
Som pædagog på Krummestuen bliver du en central del af et team, der skaber trygge rammer og udviklende læringsmiljøer for 0–3-årige. Du arbejder pædagogfagligt i hverdagen med rutiner, leg, aktiviteter og målrettede forløb, og kobler det med observation, refleksion og systematisk praksis. Når der er behov, indgår du i skærpede indsatser i tæt samarbejde med PPR og relevante fagpersoner, og du tager del i den nødvendige administration: Handleplaner, dokumentation og opfølgning, så indsatsen er gennemsigtig, koordineret og til barnets bedste. Du bidrager aktivt i den kollegiale sparring, tager medansvar for et ryddeligt og velfungerende læringsmiljø og er med til at fastholde en kultur, hvor kvalitet, ordentlighed og arbejdsglæde går hånd i hånd.

Det søger vi
Vi leder efter en pædagog, der:

  • Har erfaring med, eller er stærkt motiveret for arbejdet med børn i 0–3-års området, og som brænder for at skabe de bedste betingelser for de allermindstes trivsel, deltagelse og dannelse.
  • Står sikkert i sin faglighed og kan indgå i en åben og respektfuld sparring, også når vi er uenige.
  • Er initiativrig, selvstændig og ansvarsbevidst, og som ser de praktiske opgaver i hverdagen som en naturlig del af det pædagogiske arbejde.
  • Kommunikerer tydeligt, nærværende og professionelt med både børn, kolleger og forældre.

Arbejdstid og ansættelse
Huset har åbent mandag–torsdag kl. 6.45–17.00 og fredag kl. 6.45–16.30. Stillingen er som udgangspunkt på fuld tid, men har du ønsker til timetal eller arbejdstid, hører vi meget gerne fra dig – alle opfordres til at søge. Løn- og ansættelsesvilkår følger gældende overenskomst.

Ansøgning og kontakt
Send din ansøgning og dit CV senest søndag den 17. september 2026 kl. 12.00. Vi gennemgår ansøgningerne umiddelbart efter fristen og indkalder relevante kandidater til samtaler i den efterfølgende uge (uge 39); angiv gerne i ansøgningen, hvis der er perioder, du ikke kan. Har du spørgsmål eller ønsker du at se vores hus, er du velkommen til at kontakte Andreas Elme Schaub, souschef og konstitueret leder i Børnehuset Højstensgård, på tlf. 2170 7703 eller mail anels@brondby.dk. Tiltrædelse snarest muligt eller efter aftale.

Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig.

Børnehuset Højstensgård
Brøndbytoften 15
2605 Brøndby

Søg stillingen via 'ansøg'-knappen. Her kan du uploade din ansøgning og CV samt evt. relevant dokumentation.

Du bliver ansat efter overenskomsten for pædagoger ved daginstitutioner, skolefritidsordninger, klubber mv. mellem KL og BUPL, hvor din løn fastsættes efter overenskomstens grundlønstrin og derudover – hvis relevant i forhold til stillingen og din erfaring og kompetencer – funktionsløn, kvalifikationsløn samt tillæg jf. forhåndsaftale i Brøndby Kommune

Stillingen er som udgangspunkt på fuldtid på 37 timer pr. uge, men der kan være mulighed for at aftale andet, hvis du ønsker det.

Alle interesserede ansøgere uanset alder, køn, handicap, religion eller etnisk tilhørsforhold opfordres til at søge stillingen.

I Brøndby Kommune er der en generel politik om, at nyansatte skal forevise straffeattest. Ved beskæftigelse og direkte kontakt med børn under 15 år, indhentes der også en børneattest.

Brøndby Kommune har røgfri arbejdstid.

Brøndby er en centralt beliggende hovedstadskommune med cirka 40.000 indbyggere. Byens puls er præget af fællesskab, mangfoldighed og en stærk idrætskultur. Vi er en kommune med kant og spændende kontraster med bolig- og erhvervsområder, skove, grønne områder og Strandparken med havet og indsøerne.

title: Senior Full Stack Engineer – Registration
location: Mexico City, Ciudad de México, Mexico
description:
Our Why At Dotmatics

At Dotmatics, a Siemens company, we believe science, data, and decision-making must be deeply intertwined for innovation to thrive. Our Portfolio includes Luma, LumaLab Connect, ELN Platform, Graphpad Prism, Geneious, SnapGene, Protein Metrics, OMIQ, FCS Express, LabArchives, NQuery, EasyPanel, SoftGenetics and Virscidian.

We have a vision for a new Lab of the Future that will change the future of scientific research.

We have created the world’s most comprehensive digital science platform – best-of-breed software applications already used by more than 2 million scientists, together in a single ecosystem united by a powerful, flexible enterprise data platform. This is not flat data buried away in digital graveyards. This is dynamic, multi-dimensional decision-making.

Scientific enterprises need a new level of effectiveness to achieve tomorrow’s breakthroughs. Illness will not wait. The biosphere will not wait. We are tireless in our vision, because the time for innovation is now.

Shaping the Future of Science At Dotmatics

Our global team of more than 800 colleagues are dedicated to supporting our customers in over 180 countries. Together, with our scientific community of users, we accelerate scientific innovation in order to make the world a healthier, cleaner, and safer place to live.

You’ll join a collaborative, global team pushing the boundaries of scientific innovation. Your ideas and efforts will have a tangible impact, accelerating scientific progress and discovery. Combined, we are now the world’s largest cloud-based scientific research R&D platform. We need your help to keep growing and pioneering the future.

We are Science Driven. We are Customer Centric. We are Better Together.

Dotmatics is seeking a Senior Full Stack Engineer to join our team. We are building the most powerful R&D AI-Powered platform in the world. Luma is an AI-Native Multimodal Research Platform for Scientific Intelligence - it fits the way our customers "do science," letting them streamline research with adaptive R&D workflows driven by AI and seamless data integration.

As a Senior Full Stack Engineer, you'll build scalable features across a distributed, event-driven system and help maintain the technical health of our codebase. You should be a hands-on expert across the Node.js/React ecosystem, comfortable designing asynchronous, microservice-based architectures, with a genuine passion for scientific innovation. We value engineers who are curious about AI and motivated to find new ways to apply it in software development.

In this role you will:

  • Lead development of complex, high-impact features across a microservices architecture, owning both backend services and the frontend experiences they power
  • Design, build, and maintain serverless and event-driven data pipelines — including streaming and message-based workflows — capable of handling high-volume scientific data
  • Build asynchronous, non-blocking services and APIs that scale reliably under load
  • Write clean, maintainable, well-tested code; proactively identify technical debt and advocate for architectural improvements
  • Partner closely with other engineers to build intuitive user interfaces that simplify complex scientific research
  • Provide technical guidance through thoughtful code reviews and pair programming, fostering a culture of continuous learning
  • Support the reliability of our services by implementing observability and participating in deployment and monitoring of your code in production

**We are looking for candidates with: **

  • Strong fluency with English - Written & Spoken
  • 8+ years of engineering experience, preferably in a SaaS environment, ideally with a degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or equivalent
  • You're curious and inquisitive - someone who questions the why and the how.

The key skills:

  • Strong commercial experience building backend services with Node.js and modern frontend applications with React
  • Solid experience designing, building, and consuming RESTful APIs
  • Strong proficiency working with PostgreSQL and relational database design
  • Experience designing and working within microservices and event-driven architectures, preferably using Kafka
  • Strong understanding of asynchronous programming patterns and distributed systems
  • Hands-on experience with AWS services in production environments
  • Experience using Docker and Kubernetes for containerisation and orchestration
  • A strong advocate for automated testing (unit, integration, E2E) and experience with CI/CD tools such as GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, or AWS CodePipeline
  • Proficiency in Agile methodologies and a track record of delivering value in iterative cycles

You may also have experience in:

title: Mankato/St. Peter Organizing Fellow
description:
Mankato/St. Peter Organizing Fellow
ISAIAH
Exempt (from overtime), full-time, 6-month temporary position
Pay is based on a $55,000 annual salary

POSITION AT A GLANCE
  • The Organizing Fellow relates to and organizes people in manufactured home communities and congregations to develop leadership and shared power across race, class, and geography. They will evenly split their time between both communities.
  • We work in pursuit of a just economy and a democracy that honors the dignity and worth of people across race, faith, and class.
  • Our ideal candidates can explain why they are interested in the needs of people and communities and have demonstrated “grit” when faced with challenging work or a lack of initial success.
  • This position reports to a lead organizer and regularly works with a team of other organizers. The ideal starting date for this position is early fall.
  • This position involves meeting with people when they are available. Organizing fellows will often have meetings and events on evenings and weekends.

WHY THIS POSITION IS IMPORTANT:
Organizing Fellows will work with ISAIAH staff organizers to build and lead an organizing program to develop the capacity and leadership of everyday Minnesotans and develop a series of racial, economic, housing and climate justice campaigns with community and ISAIAH leaders.

The Organizing Fellow will lead people in faith-based and manufactured home communities in the Mankato-St. Peter area.

The Manufactured Home Resident Organizing Fellow will be responsible for the following work.

General organizing:
  • Engaging staff and leaders to build powerful relationships based on trust and a well-defined understanding of each other’s desires and interests.
  • Leading public actions and meetings with elected leaders to build a politics rooted in dignity and affordability for everyone.
  • Recruiting and training volunteer leaders to do in-person and virtual meetings with friends, family, and members of their community.
  • Developing a voter education and engagement campaign with core resident leaders to support champions of our affordability and dignity agenda.
  • Attending organizing and narrative building training.
  • Participating in weekly development sessions with supervision from a lead organizer .
Manufactured Homes organizing:
  • Running a petition drive (door knocking) to gather support for the Save Our Homes Campaign and the Manufactured Home Residents Bill of Rights, and to build relationships with residents.
  • Hosting a series of community conversations in manufactured home communities, such as initial info session for residents, candidate forums, and additional community engagement sessions to invite them into our organizing effort.
  • Facilitating candidate forums between residents and the candidates seeking to represent them specifically about issues impacting manufactured home residents.
Congregational organizing:
  • Working with staff and leaders to implement an organizing program that engages leaders from 15-20 churches.
  • Expanding the network of churches and church teams through canvassing, one on ones, community meetings, house meetings, congregational forums, and other leadership development tactics.
Over 6 months, organizing fellows receive paid holidays, sick time, a floating paid holiday, and a cell phone reimbursement. A driver’s license and car is required for this position. Organizing fellows often have meetings and events on evenings and weekends.

About ISAIAH and Faith in Minnesota
ISAIAH, a 501(c)3 nonprofit, is a vehicle for multi-racial, multi-faith coalitions across Minnesota to act collectively and powerfully towards racial and economic equity in MN by addressing both local and regional community issues. Faith in Minnesota is our 501(c)4 organization that gives us a platform to organize and advocate directly in our state’s elections and political process.

Together, we have more than 250 member and partner churches and mosques, more than 25 barbershops, and more than 200 childcare centers who work to promote a caring economy and a multi-racial democracy that honors every person’s dignity. We do this work through intentional, intensive leadership development, collective action, and deep partnerships with grassroots organizations and public servants.

HOW WILL YOU KNOW IF YOU’RE A GOOD CANDIDATE?
  • You can be great for this role if you are someone who is:
  • Able to act with integrity, has a strong work ethic, “grit”, and willingness to persevere until you succeed.
  • A self-starter who can independently set goals and use them to guide daily actions.
  • A good listener and capable of establishing rapport with people from different backgrounds.
  • A quick learner eager to develop their leadership and help others do the same.
  • Open to evaluation and direction from their supervisor and peers.
  • Unafraid of being pushed and challenged by their peers and supervisor in order to more deeply reflect on and address personal barriers to leadership development.
  • Can navigate different cultural settings to relate to people across race, class, age, and religion.
HOW WE KNOW IF YOU’RE A GOOD CANDIDATE?
We are looking for candidates who:
  • Can articulate how working for social justice and grassroots organizing is connected to their personal motivation or self-interest rather than a desire to “serve” or “save” others.
  • Have demonstrated independent decision-making, management of multiple priorities in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment, and sound judgment on when to seek advice and support from team members.
  • Can share examples of achieving success when straightforward solutions aren’t available through problem-solving and applying flexible thinking.
  • Can speak to their ability to effectively work with diverse faith communities, racial groups, and diverse stakeholders.
  • Have a self-interest in the needs of people and communities.
  • Is comfortable using a range of technology, such as Google Workspace or Microsoft Office, WhatsApp, and other common software and apps.
  • Have a valid driver’s license and regular access to a reliable car.
HOW TO APPLY
  • Please submit your resume and cover letter to our online application.
  • This position will remain open until filled. Applications are reviewed as they’re received. Our ideal hire date is early fall, 2026.
Our Statement Regarding Being an Equal Opportunity Employer
ISAIAH believes that a team with diverse experiences and backgrounds, working in an inclusive and safe work environment, generates richer discussions and more nuanced thinking. We are an equal-opportunity employer and actively encourage people whose identities and backgrounds reflect the rich diversity of our community and who are traditionally underrepresented in nonprofits to apply to our positions.

Vi forestiller os, at du:

Om uddannelsen

Du starter den 1. november 2026, og din første skoleperiode begynder i januar 2027 på Campus Bornholm.

Uddannelsen varer 2 år og kombinerer praktisk oplæring med skoleforløb inden for blandt andet administration, kommunikation, offentlig forvaltning og lovgivning.

Grundforløbet behøver ikke være gennemført, når du søger stillingen.

Lyder det som noget for dig?

Så send os din motiverede ansøgning og CV samt dokumentation og fortæl, hvorfor du ønsker at blive kontorelev hos Bornholms Energi og Forsyning.

Har du spørgsmål til stillingen eller uddannelsen, er du velkommen til at kontakte Johanne Kiørboe Graulund, Afdelingsleder for Koncernsupport på jkg@beof.dk eller 2859 7006.

Our name reflects our origins. Inspired by one of our founding investors, Neil Armstrong, the first person to walk on the moon, the business was built with the same pioneering mindset. Alongside Jim Hays, Neil set out to create a different kind of Lloyd’s platform, focused, agile and built around people.

Since launch in 2009, we have grown into a diversified insurance group offering products across Property, Casualty, Marine, Energy and Transportation, Specialty and Reinsurance, alongside Smart Follow and digital and embedded risk programmes. Our experience and unique ecosystem give Platform Partners the best chance of success, from navigating the Lloyd’s new entrant process through to the delivery of their long-term strategy.

With a team of more than 300 professionals, we continue to grow with purpose, combining underwriting excellence, innovation and collaboration to enable a more resilient and sustainable world.

Your Role

At Apollo, we believe strong pricing capability is fundamental to delivering sustainable underwriting performance. We're looking for a qualified Pricing Actuary to partner closely with Underwriters across our Property, Reinsurance and Specialty portfolios, helping shape underwriting decisions through data-led insight, technical expertise and constructive challenge.

This is an opportunity to work at the heart of the business, collaborating with Underwriting, Claims, Exposure Management, Capital Modelling, Data and Technology teams to support profitable growth while continuing to evolve pricing tools, models and capabilities.

What You'll Be Doing

  • Partnering with Underwriters to provide pricing support, portfolio insight and technical challenge across Property, Reinsurance and Specialty classes.
  • Supporting the pricing of individual risks, treaties and portfolios through robust actuarial analysis and judgement.
  • Developing, maintaining and enhancing pricing methodologies, models and analytical tools.
  • Monitoring portfolio performance, profitability, claims experience and rate adequacy to identify trends and opportunities.
  • Producing pricing MI, portfolio analysis and performance reporting for key stakeholders.
  • Contributing to the development of pricing infrastructure, automation initiatives and analytical capabilities.
  • Supporting pricing governance activities, including compliance with pricing frameworks, policies and documentation requirements.
  • Collaborating across Pricing, Underwriting, Claims, Capital Modelling and Reserving teams to improve business insight and decision making.
  • Communicating technical concepts clearly to a range of audiences across the organisation.
  • Contributing to knowledge sharing, peer review and continuous improvement within the actuarial function.

What We Are Looking For

  • Qualified Actuary (FIA or equivalent).
  • Experience within Lloyd's, London Market or Specialty Insurance environments.
  • Experience supporting pricing activities within Property, Reinsurance and/or Specialty lines.
  • Strong actuarial, analytical and problem-solving capability.
  • Experience developing or maintaining pricing models and analytical tools.
  • Proficiency in Python, SQL or similar analytical programming tools.
  • Ability to translate complex technical concepts into clear business insight.
  • Strong stakeholder management and relationship-building skills.
  • Commercial judgement and an interest in supporting profitable underwriting decisions.
  • A collaborative approach with a focus on continuous improvement.

What you’ll get in return

We offer a competitive and thoughtfully designed reward package that reflects the value of our people. This includes a fair and attractive salary, discretionary bonus, and a comprehensive benefits package - including 31 days’ annual leave, a non-contributory pension and private medical insurance.

Our commitment to inclusion

At Apollo, people are at the heart of everything we do. We are a diverse, growing team of empowered experts who bring collaboration, innovation and data-driven thinking to every relationship and every risk.

We believe diversity and inclusion go far beyond targets. They are essential to understanding the global communities we serve and to making better decisions. That’s why we are committed to developing diverse talent at every level and creating an environment where different perspectives are genuinely valued, supported and celebrated.

We also run a programme of events, training and initiatives designed to recognise both the challenges and opportunities that come with building an inclusive workplace.

Hybrid & flexible working

Flexible and hybrid working are fully embraced at Apollo. We do not believe in presenteeism. Instead, we trust our people to work in ways that allow them to perform at their best, balancing professional responsibilities with personal commitments.

Supporting your application

Apollo is committed to creating an inclusive recruitment experience where every candidate feels supported and able to perform at their best.
