title: Psykolog til PPR Frederikshavn
description:
Vil du være med til at gøre en forskel for børn og unge i deres hverdag? Trives du med at arbejde tæt på praksis og i stærke samarbejdsrelationer med forældre og fagpersoner og børn? Så er du måske vores nye psykolog i PPR Frederikshavn.

Som psykolog i PPR er du med til at skabe trygge og udviklende rammer for børn og unge i vores dagtilbud og skoler. Du bliver en del af en vigtig indsats, hvor vi arbejder tæt på praksis og med barnet og dets omgivelser i centrum.

I PPR Frederikshavn tror vi på, at de bedste løsninger skabes tæt på barnet og med de mennesker, der er en del af barnets hverdag. Vi har fokus på lokal tilstedeværelse og er organiseret i tre tværfaglige kontorfællesskaber, så vi kan være tæt på både børn, familier og fagprofessionelle i hverdagen. Hos os får du mulighed for at bringe din faglighed i spil dér, hvor den gør en reel forskel.

Din hverdag og dine opgaver

Som psykolog i PPR Frederikshavn rådgiver og vejleder du dagtilbud, skoler og forældre om, hvordan børn og unge bedst støttes i deres trivsel, læring og udvikling. Du bidrager til at skabe meningsfulde og bæredygtige løsninger, som kan omsættes i barnets hverdag.

Derudover udarbejder du, når der er behov for det, pædagogisk-psykologiske vurderinger når der er behov for en vurdering af specialpædagogisk støtte eller ved bekymring for et barns trivsel og udvikling. Samtidig arbejder du ud fra et helhedsorienteret perspektiv og indgår i et tæt samarbejde med både interne og eksterne samarbejdspartnere.

Stillingen rummer en bred vifte af opgaver på både dagtilbuds- og skoleområdet og giver gode muligheder for at bringe egne faglige interesser og kompetencer i spil. Der er desuden mulighed for at arbejde med opgaver i det Lettilgængelige Behandlingstilbud, alt efter interesse og erfaring.

Du bliver tilknyttet et lokalt tværfagligt team, som ud over psykologer består af fysioterapeuter, ergoterapeuter, logopæder, en specialpædagogisk konsulent og en ungeguide.

Vi arbejder tæt sammen med børn, forældre og fagprofessionelle og vægter dialog, tilgængelighed og samarbejde højt. Gode relationer, både internt og eksternt, er en vigtig del af fundamentet for vores arbejde.

Vi søger en psykolog, der

  • er autoriseret psykolog, gerne med praksisuddannelse
  • er nysgerrig, fagligt velfunderet og opmærksom på relationens betydning
  • kan arbejde selvstændigt og samtidig værdsætter faglig sparring og samarbejde
  • har blik for, hvad en opgave kalder på, og arbejder fleksibelt inden for de givne rammer
  • formulerer sig klart og professionelt i både skrift og tale
  • møder børn, familier og kolleger med engagement, respekt og godt humør

Hos os kombinerer vi klare procedurer med faglig fleksibilitet og stor tillid til den enkelte medarbejders dømmekraft.

Hos os får du

  • en meningsfuld hverdag med børn og unge i centrum
  • et stærkt fagligt fællesskab med 15 psykologkolleger
  • tæt tværfagligt samarbejde på tværs af fagområder
  • supervision og gode muligheder for faglig udvikling
  • en arbejdsplads præget af tillid, fleksibilitet og faglig sparring
  • flextid og mulighed for én hjemmearbejdsdag om måneden

Din daglige base bliver i PPR's kontorfællesskab på Sæbygaardskolen i Sæby, hvor du sidder sammen med dit tværfaglige team og har tæt kontakt med de skoler og dagtilbud, du betjener.

Vi glæder os til at byde en ny kollega velkommen i et fællesskab, hvor faglighed, nysgerrighed og humor går hånd i hånd. Hos os bliver du en del af en arbejdsplads, der tror på, at de bedste løsninger skabes i relationer og tæt på den praksis, hvor børn og unge lever deres liv.

Er du interesseret?

Du kan få flere oplysninger om stillingen hos afdelingsleder Janni Nibuhr Thrysøe på telefon 98 45 69 72 eller mail jatr@frederikshavn.dk.

Vi glæder os til at modtage din ansøgning.

Ansættelsesproces

Ansøgningsfristen er den 14. september 2026.

Ansættelsessamtaler afholdes den 21. september 2026 fra kl. 13.00.

Forud for endelig ansættelse indhentes børneattest og straffeattest.

Forventet tiltrædelse er 1. november 2026 eller før efter nærmere aftale.

title: Test Analyst - Senior
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Test Analyst - Senior based in Switzerland.

This role offers the opportunity to lead comprehensive testing and business readiness activities for a consumer-facing digital solution.
You will ensure applications meet business requirements, acceptance criteria, quality standards, and end-user expectations.
The position combines hands-on software testing with defect management, data validation, training, documentation, and deployment support.
You will work closely with Product Owners, Business Analysts, subject matter experts, technical teams, and business stakeholders in an Agile environment.
Your expertise will help ensure smooth releases, effective user adoption, and stable post-implementation operations.
You will also explore responsible uses of AI and Generative AI to improve testing, documentation, training, and knowledge-transfer processes.
This is an excellent opportunity for a senior testing professional who enjoys combining technical quality assurance with business-facing delivery and change readiness.

title: SAP EWM / IM Functional Consultant
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a SAP EWM / IM Functional Consultant based in Brazil.

This role offers the opportunity to lead functional design and implementation activities across SAP S/4HANA Extended Warehouse Management and Inventory Management.
You will work closely with warehouse, supply chain, field operations, and inventory stakeholders to translate business needs into scalable SAP solutions.
The position covers the full delivery lifecycle, from requirements gathering and configuration through testing, migration, cutover, and go-live support.
You will design complex warehouse processes and integration touchpoints connecting SAP with third-party platforms and enterprise systems.
Your expertise will help optimize inbound, outbound, inventory, replenishment, picking, packing, and stock management operations.
You will also coordinate across functional, technical, and integration teams within large-scale, multi-workstream programs.
This is an excellent opportunity for an experienced SAP professional seeking significant ownership across sophisticated S/4HANA EWM and IM transformation initiatives.

Accountabilities

  • Engage directly with business stakeholders across warehouse operations, supply chain, field operations, and inventory management to gather, document, validate, and translate requirements into SAP solutions.
  • Author Business Requirement Documents (BRDs), Functional Design Documents (FDDs), Configuration Design Documents (CDDs), and other functional documentation.
  • Conduct fit-gap assessments between current warehouse and inventory processes and SAP S/4HANA standard capabilities.
  • Define functional designs for inbound, outbound, internal warehouse, inventory counting, stock transfer, and related processes across IM-managed and EWM-managed warehouses.
  • Design integration touchpoints between SAP EWM/IM and third-party systems, including external WMS, transportation management, field mobility, asset management, and work-order platforms.
  • Configure SAP S/4HANA Embedded EWM, including warehouse structures, storage types and bins, activity areas, putaway and stock removal strategies, wave management, replenishment, resource and queue management, and RF/mobile transaction frameworks.
  • Configure SAP S/4HANA Inventory Management covering plants and storage locations, movement types, goods receipt and issue processing, physical inventory, batch management, stock transfers, and material valuation.
  • Configure and support the IM-to-EWM integration layer, including distribution models, RFC connectivity, logical system assignments, and qRFC queue management.
  • Define interface requirements, message formats, field mappings, transformation rules, validation logic, error handling, monitoring, and recovery procedures in collaboration with integration and technical teams.
  • Own functional interface design across file-based batch integrations, APIs, IDocs, middleware, SAP Integration Suite, and MuleSoft message flows.
  • Develop Functional Unit Test (FUT) scripts with detailed scenarios, expected results, and traceability to functional designs.
  • Execute and support FUT, System Integration Testing (SIT), and User Acceptance Testing (UAT), investigating and resolving functional defects, data issues, and integration failures.
  • Validate end-to-end warehouse processes on RF and mobile devices, including putaway, picking, packing, goods issue, physical inventory, and stock transfers.
  • Support technical teams in translating functional requirements into specifications for ABAP developments, CDS views, OData services, and other enhancements.
  • Define functional requirements for warehouse master data and inventory migration, supporting stock conversion, Migration Cockpit or LSMW activities, and reconciliation procedures.
  • Participate in cutover planning, dress rehearsals, final stock loading, reconciliation, MRP activities, and warehouse operational readiness.
  • Provide hypercare support following go-live by monitoring interfaces, resolving functional issues, and supporting business users during stabilization.
  • Coordinate offshore and onshore functional, technical, and integration teams while tracking risks, dependencies, action items, and delivery blockers.
  • Participate in governance activities, design authority reviews, status reporting, issue resolution meetings, and other program forums.

    • Requirements

    • 9+ years of SAP EWM functional experience, including at least one full-cycle S/4HANA implementation or ECC-to-S/4HANA migration.
    • Strong hands-on experience configuring SAP S/4HANA Embedded EWM, including warehouse structures, process types, putaway and picking strategies, wave management, RF frameworks, resource management, replenishment, and queue management.
    • Solid understanding of SAP S/4HANA Inventory Management, including goods movements, stock types, batch management, physical inventory, stock transfers, and material valuation.
    • Proven experience designing and supporting SAP integrations with third-party systems such as WMS, field mobility platforms, work-order management solutions, and transportation systems.
    • Familiarity with SAP Integration Suite, MuleSoft, or SAP PI/PO for integration and interface design.
    • Strong understanding of interface concepts including APIs, IDocs, middleware flows, message mapping, data transformation, error handling, monitoring, and recovery processes.
    • Excellent documentation skills, with the ability to produce clear and structured BRDs, FDDs, CDDs, functional specifications, and FUT scripts.
    • Experience working within large-scale programs involving multiple workstreams, offshore and onshore delivery teams, and formal governance structures.
    • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to investigate functional, integration, and data-related issues.
    • Effective communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to work across business, functional, technical, and integration teams.
    • Experience in utilities, energy, or other asset-intensive industries is an advantage.
    • Knowledge of SAP PM/EAM integration with EWM and work-order-driven material demand is beneficial.
    • Experience with ITS Mobile or RF device configuration for warehouse operations is preferred.
    • Familiarity with SAP MRP, including MRP Live, special procurement keys, and stock transfer requisitions, is beneficial.
    • Experience with batch management and shelf-life handling within EWM is an advantage.
    • Awareness of ABAP debugging and development concepts for functional troubleshooting is preferred.

      • Benefits

      • Full-time remote opportunity.
      • Opportunity to contribute to large-scale SAP S/4HANA transformation programs.
      • Significant ownership across EWM and IM functional design, configuration, testing, migration, cutover, and go-live activities.
      • Exposure to complex integrations between SAP and third-party enterprise systems.
      • Collaboration with diverse onshore and offshore functional, technical, and integration teams.
      • Opportunity to work across sophisticated warehouse, inventory, supply chain, and operational processes.
      • Involvement throughout the complete SAP implementation lifecycle, from requirements through post-go-live stabilization.
      • Opportunity to apply expertise across modern SAP EWM, Inventory Management, integration, mobile warehouse operations, and data migration initiatives.
      • Potential to work on projects within utilities, energy, and other asset-intensive environments.

title: Vice President of Data & Business Analytics – Commissions
description:
About Us Vensure Employer Solutions is the largest privately held organization in the HR technology and service sector, providing a comprehensive portfolio of solutions, including HR/HCM technology, managed services, and global business process outsourcing (BPO). The company and its service providers collectively serve over 95,000 businesses and process over $135B in annual payroll. As a "One Employer SolutionΓÇ¥ headquartered in Chandler, Arizona, Vensure helps thousands of businesses streamline and grow their operations with custom strategies that benefit both employers and employees. Find out more by visiting .
Position Summary
The Vice President of Data & Business Analytics – Commissions owns end-to-end execution of the monthly commissions cycle at Vensure Employer Services and leads the existing commissions team currently reporting to the SVP, Innovation – Data & Business Analytics. This is a hands-on senior leadership role combining deep technical and analytical execution (advanced Excel, Power Query, ARR and commission-structure modeling, accounting, SQL / Snowflake), disciplined project and deadline management across a complex monthly calendar with roughly 80 discrete interdependent responsibilities, and active accountability-driven leadership of approximately nine specialists. The scope spans eight-figure monthly commission payouts, varied product lines, a broad ecosystem of technologies and data streams, and cross-functional interfaces with Sales, Payroll, HR, Legal, and Accounting. The leader is expected to execute some work personally, not merely oversee it.
Essential Duties and Responsibilities Monthly Commissions Cycle Ownership Data hygiene • Maintain data hygiene across SFDC, payroll processing platforms, our CRM, and our proprietary commission application. Own data anomaly detection and correction to ensure accurate ARR calculations, accurate commission calculations and payout to the appropriate payees. Ensure appropriate cost allocations and amortization of commission expenses. Revenue capture across all product lines • Manage the Sales Board. Oversee the monthly identification of all new deal starts, ARR calculations, and uploads to Salesforce (SFDC). • Oversee revenue audits and calculations from various product lines and service models, facilitating monthly information gathering from structured reporting tools and from third parties throughout the organization. This activity is highly time constrained with many external dependencies, requiring strong organization, time management, communication, and thoughtful escalation protocols. • Create and execute a shaping plan to integrate new service and product offering revenue audits and improve their robustness over time. • Handle special calculations and one-off agreements or client-specific rules approved by senior leadership. Compute, audit cycles, and QC • Execute the monthly commission compute in our payroll platforms, custom commission application, and various Power Query–supported Excel files. • Run the audit cycles at start, 30 day, 90 day, 6 month, 9 month, and 1 year milestones. Apply audit-period decisions (push, static date, change BC) where standard logic doesn’t apply cleanly. • Run all QC steps: starts matching between SFDC and payroll platforms or other sources of truth, file-input variance, failed data mapping, duplicate detection, and month-over-month variance analysis. Troubleshoot anomalies and resolve them. • Own the negative commission balance carry-forward tracker. Monitor rep-level running negatives and surface retention-risk cases to Sales leadership proactively. Leader, SDR, channel partner, and special commissions • Execute leader commission calculations including the roll-up leadership commission tool and non-standard sales leader arrangements. • Generate the internal commission payout file consolidating commissions across core payroll platforms and more minor revenue streams from legacy and newly acquired technologies and offerings. • Execute channel partner payouts, including payout percentage validation and exception-report disposition. Journal entries and close • Execute the three journal entry categories each cycle (portal, non-portal, legacy manual), consolidate, and complete the Intacct upload. • Execute the PTG amortization process — the 48-month amortization for starts, including audit-driven adjustments at each milestone. Run the stored procedures in the correct sequence with null-fill logic between periods. • Execute the estimate / accrual journal entries using the 2-month trailing average methodology (excluding January), coordinated with Accounting. Team Leadership and Business Continuity • Lead, coach, and develop the commissions team of approximately nine specialists, including senior team members handling audit review, calculation, data validation and setup, Snowflake / SQL reporting, reconciliation, and automation. • Own the process ownership and cross-training tracker team-wide. Ensure every process has both a primary owner and a cross-trained backup so no single team member is the only person able to execute any process. • Maintain the end-to-end workflow, SOPs, and indexed recording library for every process in the commissions swim lane. Ensure team-authored SOPs remain current as automation lands and workflows shift. • Serve as backup on critical database work (Snowflake reports, stored procedures) to protect data integrity and continuity. • Manage weekly and monthly cadences including team standups, deliverable tracking, blocker resolution, and performance conversations. Cross-Functional Coordination • Payroll: coordinate on internal payroll deadlines that drive early and mid-cycle execution timing. • Sales leadership: route non-standard sales leader compensation decisions, channel partner deal desk cases, and rep-level escalations. • Accounting and Finance: coordinate on journal entry booking, estimate / accrual methodology, Intacct upload, and audit-cycle reconciliation. • Data engineering and IT: partner on Snowflake reports, Prism instance maintenance, and Salesforce integration. • HR: coordinate on termed-employee treatment, draw administration, and BC compensation questions. • Legal: route wage-hour or contract-interpretation questions on non-standard compensation cases. • External partners: manage payment statements and various channel partner requests such as reconciliations and general account / commission questions. Systems in Scope Prism (multiple instances), VENCommissions.venture, Salesforce (SFDC), Snowflake, ClientSpace (CRM), Intacct, and various other payroll processing and billing platforms. Process Improvement Partnership • Partner with the SVP, Innovation – Data & Business Analytics on continuous simplification and automation of the commissions process, applying 80/20 prioritization to identify the highest-leverage opportunities. • Surface improvement opportunities from steady-state execution and feed them into the master Commissions Improvement Opportunities backlog. Contribute to the monthly Improvements Delivered document. • Coordinate on the transition of the new commission module (currently in development) into steady-state operation once launched. Post-launch, ownership of the module’s ongoing operation transitions to this role. Marginal Functions • Build, maintain and promote relationships with team members, peers across disciplines, and all other company team members ensuring effective coordination of communications and services affecting clients. • Attend webinars and training to stay up to date on best practices related to the company and department. • Complete projects and other duties as assigned by supervisor. Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities • Advanced Excel and Power Query. Demonstrated ability to build complex conditional logic, dynamic date calculations, and M-language transformations from scratch, as well as troubleshooting and adjusting existing transformations. • SQL / database experience. Sufficient to partner on and back up Snowflake report development and troubleshoot stored-procedure output. • Strong accounting foundation. Demonstrated fluency in ARR calculations, commission structures, revenue recognition principles, and accrual methodology. • Deadline execution at scale. Proven ability to manage a high volume of interdependent deadlines (roughly 80 discrete deliverables in a typical monthly cycle) with precision, including sustained peak-cycle periods and early or mid-cycle internal payroll deadlines. • People leadership at the senior level. Track record of leading professional teams of six or more, with comfort in hands-on execution alongside team leadership — this is not a purely delegated role. • Cross-functional communication. Track record of clean written and verbal communication with senior peers in Sales, Payroll, Finance, HR, and Legal. • High execution pace with accuracy. Strong bias to action; delivers at speed without sacrificing accuracy, and remains steady under intense, deadline-driven cycles. • Independent problem-solving. Takes a broad business requirement, designs a solution, and executes it with minimal iteration or hand-holding. Comfortable operating without a detailed playbook when the situation is new. • Simplification instinct. Converts complex, multi-source data into clear, actionable, end-user-ready outputs. Recognizes when a workaround should be replaced with a root-cause fix. • Judgment on materiality. Knows when to escalate a small discrepancy versus when to route it through the standard true-up cycle. Understands when to hold ground and when to accept an approximation. • Assertive in driving deadlines. Comfort communicating routinely with third parties responsible for delivering key information each cycle, clearly communicating deadlines and proactively escalating when needed. • Proactive communication. Raises blockers, risks, and status updates early rather than explaining them after a deadline is missed. Looks forward to proactively identify and arrange any support needed outside of standard hours. • Discretion. Handles compensation information, non-standard sales leader arrangements, and personnel data with appropriate confidentiality. Required Education & Experience • CPA or equivalent accounting qualification. • PEO industry experience. • Sales compensation program experience — particularly with ARR-based, draw-against-commission, and channel-partner structures. • Salesforce administration or reporting experience. • Prior experience owning a monthly financial close or commissions cycle at similar scale.

title: Cardiac Perfusionist
description:
Overview

Ansible Government Solutions, LLC (Ansible) is currently recruiting multiple Cardiac Perfusionist to support the Richmond VA Healthcare System located at 1201 Broad Rock Blvd, Richmond, VA 23249. The work schedule is expected to be Monday-Friday with on call. If you accept employment with Ansible, you must also acknowledge that any assigned schedule is subject to change at the direction of either Ansible or its customers.

Ansible is a Service-Disabled Veteran-Owned Small Business (SDVOSB) providing Federal customers with solutions in many arenas. Our customers face wide-ranging challenges in the fields of health care, national security, and information technology. To address these challenges, we employ intelligent and committed staff who take care of our customers’ success as if it is their own.

Responsibilities
  • Provide onsite Board-Certified Perfusion Services for veteran patients undergoing cardiothoracic procedures.
  • Assist Cardio-Thoracic Surgery with:
    • Open-heart surgeries
    • Valve replacement procedures
    • Emergency cardiac procedures
  • Prepare, operate, and maintain:
    • Heart-lung machines
    • Autotransfusion pumps
    • Intra-aortic balloon pumps
    • Centrifugal ventricular assist devices
  • Maintain extracorporeal circulation during surgical procedures.
  • Maintain appropriate blood volume and circulation support during surgery.
  • Prevent shock and air emboli during procedures.
  • Assemble equipment and supplies for emergent cardiopulmonary support situations.
  • Support patients requiring:
    • ECMO (Extracorporeal Membrane Oxygenation)
    • Balloon pump therapy
    • Other advanced circulatory support modalities.
  • Review patient records and surgical plans prior to procedures.
  • Document treatment plans and patient care in the VA Electronic Health Record (EHR).
  • Complete and maintain transfusion documentation, including SF-518 forms.
  • Enter assessments, treatment plans, outcomes, and follow-up recommendations into patient records within required timeframes.
  • Ensure compliance with privacy, HIPAA, and VA documentation requirements.
  • Participate in quality improvement activities and meetings as required.
  • Attend staff meetings as directed by Surgical Service leadership.
  • Complete QA/QI documentation for procedures, complications, and outcomes.
  • Complete weekly timesheets and attendance documentation.
  • Report patient safety incidents within 24 hours.
Qualifications
  • Graduate of an accredited Allied Health Education Program School of Perfusion Technology.
  • Current certification through the American Board of Cardiovascular Perfusion (ABCP).
  • Current AHA BLS and ACLS certification.
  • Minimum 2 years of perfusion experience.
  • Minimum 200 clinical perfusion cases completed.
  • Demonstrated experience with:
    • Open-heart surgery
    • Autotransfusion
    • Heart-lung machines
    • Membrane oxygenation
    • Left/right heart bypass
    • Intra-aortic balloon pumping
    • Centrifugal ventricular assist devices
  • Current, full, unrestricted license, registration, certification, or credential as required by the profession and applicable state regulations.
  • No sponsorship available.

All candidates must be able to:

  • Sit, stand, walk, lift, squat, bend, twist, and reach above shoulders during the work shift
  • Lift up to 50 lbs from floor to waist
  • Lift up to 20 lbs
  • Carry up to 40 lbs a reasonable distance
  • Push/pull with 30 lbs of force

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or status as a protected veteran.

title: Senior C++ Engineer

You will collaborate with architecture, quality assurance, and product teams to deliver robust and dependable software.

title: Product Lead (all genders) - Buyer Experience
description:
About Us

At eduki, we believe that supporting teachers leads to the best possible lessons, the best possible schools, and the best possible education. That’s why we built a platform where teachers can find and share high quality, ready-to-use teaching materials. We offer both printable and digital resources for all school types, subjects, and grade levels. Whether it’s for a last-minute lesson or long-term inspiration, we make it easier for educators to feel confident and prepared.

eduki is used by more than 3 million teachers internationally who download more than 100.000 teaching resources a day. That’s where your impact begins. Join us!

Product Lead (all genders) | Job Level: Lead | Spain (Working from Home) | Full Time (40h/week)

Fix Salary Range: 51.000€ - 69.000€

Please note: This vacancy will be open for applications until 100 applications have been received. We’ll then close the position for new applicants so we can thoroughly review all applications received.

Your Impact

As a Product Lead - Buyer Experience (all genders) at eduki, you lead our Buyer Product Stream to successfully deliver an outstanding customer experience and drive a step change in buyer retention and conversion. Here are the key tasks and responsibilities that you will be taking on to achieve this goal:

  • Product Strategy: You own end-to-end product strategy for our Buyer Stream (discovery/navigation, decision enablement and transactions) and contribute to the overall Product Strategy alongside the other Product Leads and our CPO. For your Stream, you’ll set quarterly priorities aligned with the company goals and will present and defend those across leadership and C-level.
  • Leadership: Within the Buyer Stream you lead and develop a team of Product Managers, a Product Analyst and UX Designers. To achieve this you’ll e.g. coach the Product Managers to elevate their strategic thinking, decision making and product craft. Additionally, you’ll drive experimentation across the stream and increase hypothesis quality, measurement and outcome delivery.
  • Cross-Team Collaboration: You partner with the other Product Stream Leads, our Engineering Leadership and adjacent Divisions (especially Marketing, Supply, Data & Business Development) to ensure alignment in our overall Product Strategy and goals.

Your Skills and Expertise

We are searching for a Product Lead (all genders) who would like to focus their passion for product craft, leadership experience and strategic mindset to achieve our mission to enhance education. Furthermore, you should check the following boxes:

  • You've led a team of Product Managers before, not just been one yourself - people management is nothing new to you. In your last role, you were responsible for a whole product stream, portfolio, or business unit, not just a single feature or surface.
  • Commerce, marketplace, or two-sided platform products are familiar territory. You know how discovery, decision-making, and transaction work together as one connected experience, rather than treating them as separate pieces.
  • You're a strategic thinker who can build a 12-month roadmap, and still zoom in when a specific product decision needs your attention.
  • Data plays a big role in how you decide. You read dashboards naturally, dig into experimentation results and cohort data, and aren't afraid to question how numbers are being interpreted.
  • Working with people across teams comes naturally to you. Working with engineering, marketing, supply, or data, you know how to align without simply going along with everything, and how to push back without shutting people down.
  • Good product craft matters to you. You care about the quality of what users actually experience, not just about processes or org charts.
  • You enjoy being part of an international team and feel comfortable communicating in English on a daily basis.

Please note: Due to legal restrictions, we can only hire candidates living in and owning a valid work permit for Spain. eduki is a registered employer in Spain, and you will receive a direct work contract with us according to Spanish work law.

Our Commitment to You

Attractive Compensation Package: The total compensation for this role is up to 80.500 EUR per year and consists of a fixed salary and a VSOP (Virtual Stock Options Program) package. Depending on your skills and competencies, as well as your individual performance, the gross annual salary will range between 51.000 EUR and 69.000 EUR.

Growth Opportunities: At eduki, you will find an exciting job opportunity within a profitable and fast-growing company. We prioritize action over perfection and view mistakes as opportunities for growth. Regular performance feedback sessions ensure that you receive constructive insights into your work and progress.
Additionally, you will receive a 1.000 EUR development budget per year to invest in your professional development goals.

Working from Home: We fully embrace a home office culture and want you to enjoy full flexibility by enabling you to set your own work schedule.
In addition to providing the necessary software and hardware, we offer a 500 EUR budget that you can freely use to equip your home office.
Furthermore, you can work from abroad for up to 90 days per year with us!

Employee Health: Your well-being matters to us. To help you take care of both body and mind, we offer online yoga sessions and actively support mental health by allowing time for therapy or coaching sessions during your working hours. Take advantage of your flexible schedule to prioritise what you need, including your health!

Team Building Events: At eduki, we foster a strong sense of community. Whether virtual or on-site, you'll have opportunities to bond with your colleagues. Once a year, the entire team enjoys a company-wide team event, visiting new places and creating lasting memories together.

Your Contact

Juliane
Senior Talent Acquisition Manager

jobs@eduki.com

At eduki, we value diversity and the unique contributions each person brings to our team. We foster an inclusive culture where respect and appreciation are essential. Talents are considered regardless of age, gender, sexual identity, ethnicity, nationality, religion, or disability.

title: Software Engineer, AI
description:
Backblaze provides reliable, high-availability cloud storage trusted by consumers, SMBs, enterprises, and developers in over 150 countries. Backblaze B2 Cloud Storage supports data-intensive workloads including backup, media, analytics, and modern AI pipelines. Our teams focus on building durable, scalable systems with a strong emphasis on developer experience and operational efficiency.

But while there is a lot to celebrate in our past, there is almost as much opportunity ahead of us. We’re seeking a Software Engineer, AI to join our team!

What You’ll Do

  • Use AI-assisted development tools, including Claude Code, to accelerate implementation while validating correctness, security, and performance.
  • Design and build server-side APIs that authenticate users, accept and manage backups, handle large-scale data operations, and prepare restored data for customers across our global user base.
  • Collaborate with Product, QA, and Support teams to ensure both backend features reflect real customer workflows and usage patterns.
  • Build and maintain support tooling to help diagnose and resolve customer issues at scale.
  • Ensure all code and open source assets meet high standards for testing, documentation, reproducibility, and developer usability.

Tools and Technologies

  • AI coding agents such as Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, and Antigravity
  • Languages: Python, TypeScript, Go, JavaScript, Java (and other languages common in the open source ecosystem)
  • Backblaze B2 SDKs and REST APIs
  • Open source AI frameworks and tooling (e.g. LangChain, LlamaIndex, vector databases)
  • SQL and NoSQL backend development (experience with large-scale distributed databases a plus)
  • GitHub, pytest, CI/CD pipelines
  • Large-scale server infrastructure (Linux, cross-platform awareness)

The Right Fit

  • 2+ years of backend software engineering experience, ideally on systems that serve millions of users across multiple platforms.
  • Proficiency in one or more backend languages (Java, Python, TypeScript, or similar); comfortable picking up new languages as needed.
  • Practical understanding of AI workflows — data ingestion, preprocessing, inference, and agent-based orchestration.
  • Experience building or working with large-scale APIs and distributed storage or data systems.
  • Production-quality coding habits: rigorous testing, clear documentation, and attention to security and performance.
  • Customer-focused mindset — you think about the developer and end-user experience in everything you build.
  • Strong written communication skills; you can explain technical decisions clearly to both engineers and non-engineers.
  • Good attitude, cross-functional collaboration skills, and a genuine desire to work in a fast-paced environment with evolving requirements.

Bonus Points For

  • Experience building or evaluating AI agents and multi-step tool-use systems.
  • Experience with Cassandra or other large-scale NoSQL systems.
  • Familiarity with ReactJS or front-end frameworks.
  • Prior work with vector databases or embedding pipelines.

Learning, developing, and growing are key parts of our culture. We're eager to meet people who believe in our mission and can contribute to our team in various ways. We want people to feel comfortable expressing their true selves and to come, stay, and do their best work here.

At Backblaze, we value being fair and good to our customers, partners, and employees. That’s why diversity, equity, and inclusion are at the core of our values. We are committed to fostering a workforce where all employees feel a sense of belonging regardless of race, ethnicity, nationality, gender, sexual orientation, age, religion, socio-economic status, ability, veteran status, and education. We believe that our dedication to cultivating a diverse workspace not only allows us to better serve our customers in over 175 countries but further reinforces our commitment to doing the right thing. We are proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer.

title: Greve Gymnasium søger ny uddannelseschef
description:
Vil du være med til at lede og udvikle en ambitiøs gymnasieskole med elevernes læring, dannelse og trivsel i centrum?

Greve Gymnasium søger en ambitiøs, fagligt dygtig og relationsstærk uddannelseschef, der skal indgå i ledelsesteamet på en skole med en positiv, elevrettet og udviklingsorienteret kultur

Greve Gymnasium står foran nogle spændende år. Vi er for nuværende i gang med en værdi- og visionsproces frem mod 2030, og de kommende års forandringer på ungdomsuddannelsesområdet stiller nye krav til både vores uddannelser, organisation og ledelsesopgaven.

Som vores nye uddannelseschef bliver du en central medspiller i dette arbejde.

En del af et fælles ledelsesteam

Ledelsesteamet arbejder tæt sammen om den samlede ledelse og udvikling af Greve Gymnasium. Vi har et fælles ansvar for skolen, samtidig med at den enkelte leder har et tydeligt ansvar for egne områder og opgaver.

Som uddannelseschef skal du medvirke til at skabe en velfungerende hverdag for elever og ansatte og samtidig understøtte og videreudvikle en skolekultur baseret på samarbejde, ansvar og tillid.

Du skal kunne forbinde det strategiske niveau med hverdagens beslutninger, planlægning og drift. Det betyder, at du både skal kunne løfte blikket og se skolen og dens udvikling i et større perspektiv – og have lyst til at tage fat på de konkrete ledelses- og driftsopgaver, der får en stor gymnasieskole til at fungere hver dag.

Vi lægger vægt på en ledelsesstil, hvor vi skaber resultater gennem tydelig retning, involvering, delegering og tillid. Som leder på Greve Gymnasium skal du være synlig, tilgængelig og nærværende – og samtidig kunne træffe beslutninger og stå på mål for dem.

Profil for vores nye uddannelseschef

Vi forestiller os, at du har flere af nedenstående erfaringer og kompetencer:

  • har indgående kendskab til det gymnasiale område, særligt stx og gerne hhx

  • har undervisningskompetence i mindst ét af fagene i gymnasiets fagrække

  • har ledelsesmæssig erfaring fra en uddannelsesinstitution og erfaring med personaleledelse

  • har en høj arbejdskapacitet og arbejder effektivt og resultatorienteret

  • kan overskue og håndtere komplekse administrative og organisatoriske opgaver

  • arbejder struktureret, planlægger godt og følger op, så opgaverne kommer helt i mål

  • er analytisk stærk og samtidig har sans for kvalitet og relevante detaljer

  • kommunikerer klart, tydeligt og imødekommende

  • har en stærk organisations- og ledelsesforståelse og kan se en sag fra flere perspektiver

  • er relationelt stærk og skaber tillid og følgeskab blandt både medarbejdere og elever.

Vi ser det som en fordel, hvis du har en relevant lederuddannelse.

Ledelse i praksis

For os er måden, du bedriver ledelse på, mindst lige så vigtig som din erfaring.

Vi lægger derfor vægt på, at du er en leder, der:

  • er meningsskabende: Du kan analysere komplekse problemstillinger, prioritere og omsætte analyser til beslutninger og handling.

  • er handlingsrettet: Du arbejder struktureret, følger op og tager ansvar for, at opgaver og beslutninger bliver ført helt til dørs.

  • er relationsstærk: Du er lydhør og nærværende og kan skabe tydelige rammer på en ordentlig måde.

  • er tydelig: Du kan lytte og involvere, men har samtidig mod til at træffe beslutninger, når situationen kræver det.

  • trives i et stærkt samarbejde: Du bidrager aktivt til ledelsesteamet, deler viden og ansvar og bruger dine lederkolleger som sparringspartnere.

  • viser tillid og tager ansvar: Du delegerer, giver andre rum til at lykkes og fremstår selv ordentlig, troværdig og tillidsvækkende.

Dine opgaver

Du får en bred opgaveportefølje, der rummer personaleledelse, administration og planlægning, udviklingsopgaver og undervisning.

Som udgangspunkt forventer vi, at følgende opgaver vil indgå i din portefølje:

  • personaleledelse og ledelsesansvar for et antal klasser

  • ledelse af udvalgte udvalg og arbejdsgrupper

  • ledelse af pædagogiske/didaktiske udviklingsprojekter

  • ledelse af SRP/SSO-progression og arbejdet med skriftlighed

  • ledelse af vejledningsfunktionerne (studievejledning, læsevejledning og matematikvejledning)

  • ledelse af skolens udvalg

  • APV og organisatorisk arbejdsmiljø

  • onboarding og udvikling af medarbejdere

Den endelige opgavefordeling fastlægges i samarbejde med den nye uddannelseschef og det øvrige lederteam. Stillingen og opgaveporteføljen vil naturligt udvikle sig over tid.

Ansøgning og ansættelsesproces

Ansøgningsfristen er torsdag den 17. september 2026 kl. 12.00.

Stillingen ønskes besat 1. november 2026 eller snarest derefter.

Send din ansøgning, CV og relevante bilag via dette link.

Ansættelsesudvalget mødes efter ansøgningsfristens udløb og udvælger kandidater til første samtalerunde. Hvis du bliver inviteret til samtale, hører du fra os i uge 38.

Vi gennemfører to samtalerunder:

  • Første samtale: mandag den 21. september 2026

  • Anden samtale: onsdag den 23. september 2026

Går du videre til anden samtale, indgår en case-opgave i processen. Casen udleveres forud for samtalen og præsenteres og drøftes ved anden samtale.

Som en del af den afsluttende ansættelsesproces indhenter vi referencer for at validere oplysninger og vurderinger fra ansøgning og samtaler. Vi indhenter to-tre referencer, og det sker i alle tilfælde efter forudgående aftale med dig.

Vil du vide mere?

Hvis du har spørgsmål til stillingen eller Greve Gymnasium, er du meget velkommen til at kontakte rektor Claus Ellekær Sommer-Madsen på telefon 61 77 48 71.

Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig.

Lidt om Greve Gymnasium

Greve Gymnasium er en udviklingsorienteret skole med et højt ambitionsniveau, hvor elevernes social og faglige trivsel er udgangspunktet for vores arbejde.

Vores ambition er, at vores elever med viden, lyst og mod udforsker, udvikler og udvider verden sammen.

På Greve Gymnasium prioriterer vi fællesskab i trygge rammer, mangfoldighed og tolerance samt nysgerrighed, arbejdsomhed og interesse for viden.

Vi har dedikerede lærere, dygtige administrative og tekniske medarbejdere. Vi lægger vægt på en involverende ledelseskultur med tydelige forventninger, ansvar og tillid.

Vores elevgruppe er mangfoldig. Vi har både meget fagligt stærke og fagligt udfordrede elever, elever, der engagerer sig aktivt i udvalg og skolens store fællesskaber, og elever, som har brug for et kærligt skub for at blive en del af dem. Faglig trivsel er omdrejningspunktet for vores arbejde med eleverne.

Greve Gymnasium har ca 1.000 elever på stx og hf og omkring 105 ansatte. Gymnasiet er lokalt forankret og har samtidig et omfattende lokalt, nationalt og internationalt netværk.

Vi har høj elevfastholdelse, løfter vores elever fagligt, har gode trivselsmålinger og en høj og stigende overgangsfrekvens til videregående uddannelser.

Og vi har ambitioner om mere. Derfor søger vi en uddannelseschef, der har lyst til at være med til at forme Greve Gymnasiums fremtid.

title: Gerontopædagogisk konsulent til Helsingør Stift
description:
Stillingen

Helsingør Stift søger en gerontopædagogisk konsulent på 25% til en tidsbegrænset stilling på to år.

Stillingen er finansieret af Helsingør Stiftsråd via stiftets bindende stiftsbidrag og administreres af Helsingør Stift. Konsulentens hovedopgave er at understøtte det teologisk-pædagogiske arbejde med forkyndende sigte for ældre i sogne og provstier i Helsingør Stift. Sideløbende hermed skal konsulenten sammen med stiftets diakonikonsulent være medvirkende til at afsøge og udvikle samarbejdsmuligheder mellem folkekirken og kommunerne i stiftet.

Primære opgaver

  • At sikre synlighed på området bredt i stiftet via videndeling, fx gennem centralt organiserede efteruddannelses- og kursusaktiviteter.

  • At udarbejde idekatalog til brug for sognenes virke indenfor gerontopædagogiske initiativer, demensvenlige gudstjenester i kirken og/eller på plejehjem.

  • Sammen med uddannelseskonsulenten at drage omsorg for, at nye præster introduceres til det gerontopædagogiske arbejde på plejehjem i stiftet.

  • At følge og i videst muligt omfang at deltage i landsnetværket af folkekirkens gerontopædagogiske stiftskonsulenter samt være kontakt til den gerontopædagogiske uddannelse (FUV).

  • At koordinere, deltage i og varetage sekretæropgaver for stiftets gerontopædagogiske netværk.

Din profil
Vi søger en konsulent, der har erfaring fra samarbejde mellem kirke og kommune, faglig baggrund og erfaring inden for kirkelig gerontopædagogik og har bevist stærke relationelle kompetencer.

Vi tilbyder

· En spændende udviklingsstilling, hvor du bliver en del af et dedikeret fællesskab og kommer til at sætte kød og blod på Helsingør Stiftsråds ”Vision 2025 – 2029: Skabe Rum. Møde liv. Dele tro. Sammen om fællesskaber i Helsingør Stift”. Den gerontopædagogiske konsulent indgår i Helsingør Stiftsadministration og arbejder tæt sammen med stiftets diakonikonsulent og uddannelseskonsulent. Konsulenten er tilknyttet stiftets religionspædagogiske udvalg med henblik på faglig ideudvikling og sparring.

· Om Helsingør Stiftsadministration: Helsingør Stift er en del af folkekirken. Stiftet består af 13 provstier, 146 sogne med i alt 133 menighedsråd og ca. 300 præster. Stiftsadministrationen understøtter biskoppen i stiftets mange opgaver herunder generel rådgivning af stiftets menighedsråd og provstier, yder sekretariatsbistand til Stiftsrådet og arbejder med kirkelige udviklings- og implementeringsopgaver.

· Du kan læse mere om Helsingør Stift her .

Praktiske oplysninger

· Ansættelsesvilkår: Stillingen er en 25% tidsbegrænset stilling (to år). Løn og ansættelsesvilkår fastsættes efter gældende overenskomst. Såfremt du er sognepræst, vil du blive frikøbt fra din stilling.

· Arbejdssted: Helsingør Stift, Hestemøllestræde 3A, 3000 Helsingør.

· Tiltrædelse: Snarest muligt.

· Ansøgningsfrist: 16. september, 2026, kl. 12.00.

· Ansættelsessamtaler afholdes forventeligt i uge 40

· Spørgsmål: Har du spørgsmål til stillingen, er du velkommen til at kontakte stiftskonsulent Jørgen Skov Sørensen på tlf. 2910 1256 eller jsks@km.dk.

title: Javanese Speakers - Test Voice Modes of AI Models
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Javanese Speakers – Test Voice Modes of AI Models based in Spain.

This project-based opportunity is designed for highly proficient Javanese speakers interested in helping improve the quality of conversational AI systems.
You will interact with AI chatbots through voice mode, conducting structured conversations entirely in Javanese as spoken in Indonesia.
Your feedback will help evaluate how effectively AI models understand, respond to, and sustain natural voice conversations in the target language.
The work combines language expertise, careful evaluation, and attention to detail in a flexible, task-oriented environment.
You will follow predefined prompts and conversation goals, then assess the quality of each interaction according to detailed guidelines.
The role is well suited to language professionals, experienced evaluators, voice contributors, and motivated individuals with strong linguistic skills.
Workload may vary depending on project needs, offering flexibility while contributing directly to the development of better AI experiences.

Accountabilities

  • Conduct voice-mode conversations with designated AI chatbots using predefined starting prompts and conversation objectives.
  • Complete each interaction entirely in Javanese as spoken in the Indonesia region (jv_ID).
  • Evaluate and rate voice-mode interactions on a laptop according to established project guidelines and quality criteria.
  • Complete all written evaluations in English, ensuring feedback is accurate, complete, and clearly documented.
  • Follow detailed instructions carefully to achieve required conversation goals and maintain consistency across evaluations.
  • Assess voice interactions with a strong focus on accuracy, completeness, naturalness, and overall quality.
  • Work with AI chatbots using a personal smartphone and complete evaluation activities using a personal laptop.
  • Be prepared to complete certain tasks in different environments, including quiet or noisy settings and indoor or outdoor locations, depending on project requirements.

    • Excellent attention to detail and the ability to assess conversational AI interactions accurately and consistently.
    • Strong listening, communication, and linguistic judgment skills, with the ability to recognize naturalness, clarity, pronunciation, and contextual appropriateness.
    • Ability to follow detailed instructions and predefined conversation scenarios precisely.
    • Comfortable using voice-enabled AI applications and adapting quickly to new digital tools and workflows.

    • Willingness to complete required identity verification and background screening procedures.
    • Ability to maintain strict confidentiality regarding project information and comply with applicable platform agreements.

      • Benefits

title: Balletlærer til Det Kongelige Teaters Balletskole (barselsvikariat)
description:
Barselsvikariat som balletlærer på Det Kongelige Teaters Balletskole

Vil du være med til at udvikle næste generation af professionelle klassiske balletdansere – og skabe rammer, hvor børn og unge kan udvikle sig både kunstnerisk, fagligt og personligt?

Så har du mulighed for at blive en del af Det Kongelige Teaters Balletskole og et fagligt miljø, hvor høj balletfaglighed går hånd i hånd med elevernes læring, udvikling og trivsel.

Det Kongelige Teaters Balletskole er en kunstnerisk skole, der varetager balletuddannelse og skolefaglig uddannelse af elever fra 2. klasse til 3. HF. Balletuddannelsen foregår på højeste faglige niveau og med blik på den enkelte elevs udvikling gennem forskellige aldre og faser af uddannelsen.

Vi søger en balletlærer til et barselsvikariat, hvor du skal undervise elever på hold 9 (piger i 8. og 9. klasse) i klassisk ballet og fungere som holdets hovedlærer.

Om jobbet

Som hovedlærer har du et særligt ansvar for elevernes balletfaglige undervisning og udvikling. Vi forventer, at hovedlæreren:

  • Møder eleverne med tydelige faglige forventninger og med respekt for, at børn og unge udvikler sig forskelligt – både fagligt, fysisk, socialt og personligt.

  • Skaber et professionelt, trygt og motiverende læringsmiljø, hvor eleverne oplever tydelighed, dialog og mulighed for at tage aktiv del i deres egen læring og udvikling.

  • Er aktivt en del af Balletskolens gruppe på 13 balletlærere, som sammen varetager undervisningen gennem elevernes uddannelsesforløb.

  • Samarbejder tæt med skolelærere, pædagoger, pianister, sundhedsteam og administrative medarbejdere.

Som hovedlærer indgår du i et tværfagligt team omkring eleverne, hvor I sammen arbejder for at skabe sammenhæng mellem høj kunstnerisk og balletfaglig kvalitet, læring, udvikling og trivsel.

Stillingen er på 27 timer ugentligt.

Kvalifikationer, baggrund og erfaring

Vi søger en balletlærer, der kombinerer stærk balletfaglighed med lysten og evnen til at arbejde professionelt og ansvarligt med børn og unge.

Vi forventer, at du:

  • har en relevant uddannelsesmæssig og/eller professionel balletfaglig baggrund

  • har erfaring med at undervise i klassisk ballet på et højt fagligt niveau

  • har et indgående kendskab til Bournonville-traditionen

  • har erfaring med at undervise og arbejde med børn og unge og har blik for deres forskellige forudsætninger, perspektiver og udvikling

  • kan skabe et trygt og udviklende undervisningsmiljø med tydelige rammer, høje faglige ambitioner og respektfulde relationer

  • arbejder udviklingsorienteret og kan give tydelig, konstruktiv og alderssvarende feedback

  • er nysgerrig på elevernes perspektiver og kan inddrage dem relevant i deres egen læring og udvikling

  • har gode samarbejdsevner og trives med et tæt tværfagligt samarbejde omkring børn og unge

  • kan arbejde med både tradition og fornyelse og bidrager konstruktivt til udviklingen af Balletskolens faglige miljø

  • er fortrolig med Office-pakken og relevante digitale værktøjer

  • behersker dansk og engelsk i skrift og tale.

Løn- og ansættelsesvilkår

Undervisningen er som udgangspunkt placeret mellem kl. 8.00 og 18.00 på hverdage og mellem kl. 8.00 og 12.00 på lørdage. Som hovedlærer for 8. og 9. klasse skal du forvente at arbejde ca. 22 lørdage i løbet af sæsonen.

Der kan være eftermiddagstræning mellem kl. 16.00 og 18.00 afhængigt af det endelige skema. Derudover vil der i perioder være aktiviteter om eftermiddagen og aftenen, f.eks. i forbindelse med forestillinger, prøver og skole-hjem-samarbejde.

Undervisning og øvrige aktiviteter planlægges i års- og ugeplaner, så arbejdstid og aktiviteter så vidt muligt er tydelige og forudsigelige.

Arbejdet er fordelt over 41 uger. Ud over ferie efter ferieloven og feriefridage er der i stillingen op til fem ugers arbejdsfri perioder med løn i henhold til gældende overenskomst.

Balletskolen følger de ordinære skoleferier, og arbejdstiden er som udgangspunkt placeret uden for skolens ferier. Den ugentlige arbejdstid varierer, og der vil kunne være perioder med højere aktivitet, blandt andet i forbindelse med forestillinger og årsvisninger.

Ansættelse og aflønning sker i henhold til gældende overenskomst.

Ansættelsesstedet er Det Kongelige Teaters Balletskole på Kongens Nytorv. Stillingen er organisatorisk placeret på Balletskolen med reference til Kristoffer Dahl Sakurai, Balletskolens kunstneriske leder.

Stillingen er et barselsvikariat på 27 timer ugentligt med forventet tiltrædelse 1/11 2026 og forventet varighed på 10 måneder med mulighed for forlængelse.

Sådan søger du

Søg stillingen ved at klikke på ”Søg stillingen” i annoncen. Ansøgningsfristen er d. 18. september 2026.

Vedlæg CV, eventuelle eksamensbeviser og relevante anbefalinger.

Vi holder løbende samtaler.

Det Kongelige Teater ønsker en mangfoldig arbejdsplads og opfordrer alle kvalificerede kandidater til at søge stillingen uanset personlig baggrund.

Kontakt

Har du spørgsmål til stillingen, er du velkommen til at kontakte Balletskolens kunstneriske leder, Kristoffer Dahl Sakurai krsa@kglteater.dk

title: Qualified Professional (QP), I/DD
description:
Covenant Case Management Services is seeking an energetic and compassionate Qualified Professional (QP) with experience in intellectual and developmental disabilities (I/DD) to support individuals in the Harrisburg area. In this hybrid role, you will help ensure high-quality service delivery, build positive relationships, and advocate fiercely for the people we serve.

Key Responsibilities

Staffing, Caseload, and Team Leadership

  • Team Recruitment: Own staffing for your team and caseloads; actively recruit and fill open roles to ensure adequate coverage.

  • Caseload Management: Manage a caseload of 25–30 active cases (excluding cases held for coverage). Match staff to cases based on skills, personality, and fit while ensuring timely staffing and strict policy compliance.

  • Supervision: Oversee direct care staff to ensure they adhere to CCMS policies and best practices. Lead monthly Direct Support Professional (DSP) supervision meetings and deliver ongoing training.

Compliance, Documentation, and Care Planning

  • Regulatory Compliance: Maintain strict compliance with DHHS/state rules, Medicaid/state waivers, MCO requirements, and CCMS policies. Act as a champion for policy adoption and ethical practice.

  • Care Planning: Conduct comprehensive, person-centered assessments; set measurable goals and develop clinically accurate, medically necessary Individualized Support Plans (ISPs).

  • Quality Review: Review and approve ISP documentation, assessments, progress notes, and related records. Sign off on new or updated ISPs and coordinate with Medical Records for timely system uploads.

  • Utilization Management: Daily review note reports to monitor compliance with staff-completed service notes. Train staff on correct documentation practices, approve compliant entries, and issue required corrections. Monitor underutilized reports and take swift action to optimize service delivery.

Incident Management & Quality Assurance

  • Incident Reporting: Promptly report all incidents to Quality Management (QM) via the internal Incident Reporting (IR) process; fully support IR/IRIS entries for Level 2 and Level 3 incidents.

  • Risk Mitigation: Partner with QM to identify risks, recurring incidents, or service gaps. Participate in risk-reduction activities and assist in developing, implementing, and monitoring Plans of Correction (POC).

  • Audit Readiness: Lead and participate in internal audits and CARF-related activities. Collaborate with QM, Clinical Directors, and Medical Records to prepare documentation and regulatory responses for auditors. Ensure ongoing, regulation-ready state across all assigned programs.

  • Financial Accountability: Review data and billing for precision and compliance. Monitor authorization status monthly, completing service limit sheets for every authorization received to support utilization management.

Client Engagement & Community Collaboration

  • Consents: Secure valid consents from individuals and legally responsible persons, supporting annual client consent updates when necessary.

  • Stakeholder Relations: Build trusted relationships with MCOs, collaborating agencies, families, and CCMS leadership. Proudly represent CCMS in community activities and interagency meetings.

  • Administration: Manage ongoing administrative workflows—including authorizations, progress reports, and documentation reviews—to guarantee completely regulation-ready records.

Training & Staff Development

  • Skill Building: Train staff members thoroughly on individual client needs, ISP requirements, and programmatic benchmarks. Lead staff development initiatives to maximize policy compliance.

  • Accountability: Provide guidance and clear accountability metrics for DSP performance. Administer corrective actions in accordance with company policy and facilitate the rollout of ongoing policy updates.

Crisis & On-Call Support

  • Crisis Response: Maintain availability for on-call crisis services as required. Uphold the highest quality and ethical standards to boost overall program performance and ensure compliance with federal, state, and local laws.

SCS & Nursing Collaboration

  • SCS Coordination: Collaborate closely with the SCS Director regarding any service updates or adjustments for members assigned to Supported Career Services (SCS), or those adding SCS to their active treatment plan.

  • Medical Compliance: Partner with the Nursing team to ensure all members have accurate, documented medications on file that meet company compliance standards.

  • Medication Tracking: Assist with the collection of medication administration documentation and periodically update physician order changes alongside the Nursing team.

  • Clinical Reporting: Document and report side effects, medical changes, or hospital visits directly to the Nursing team for immediate, specialized support.

Leadership Support

  • Mentorship: Collaborate directly with Clinical Directors and executive leadership to aid in mentoring newly hired staff and incoming QPs.

  • Special Projects: Assist with special agency projects, targeted training curriculum, job shadowing, and customized one-on-one development of staff as requested.

  • Flexibility: Complete additional operational duties and responsibilities as requested by leadership.

What We Are Looking For

Qualifications & Experience

  • Credentialing: Must meet the official North Carolina definition of a Qualified Professional (QP).

  • Experience: Have at least five years of supervisory and management experience and/or five years of dedicated experience working within human services.

  • Knowledge: Possess a deep, working knowledge of the behavioral sciences and allied disciplines related to Intellectual and Developmental Disabilities (I/DD).

  • Skills: Demonstrate exceptional communication, leadership, adaptability, and complex problem-solving skills.

  • Resources: Must have reliable access to high-speed internet, a functional cell phone, and reliable transportation.

  • Physical Requirements: Ability to sit, stand, walk, and lift up to 50 pounds as required by field conditions.

Education & Licensure Pathway Requirements

Candidates must meet at least one of the following state-defined educational criteria:

  • Hold a valid license, provisional license, certificate, registration, or permit issued by a governing board regulating a human service profession; OR

  • Have a graduate degree in a human service field paired with at least one year of post-graduate experience; OR

  • Have a bachelor's degree in a human service field paired with at least two years of post-graduate experience; OR

  • Have a bachelor's degree in any non-human service field paired with at least four years of post-graduate experience.

  • A diverse and inclusive community focused on professional growth, compassionate care, and a highly supportive work environment.

title: Senior Software Engineer, DepoLive
description:
Filevine is a Legal AI company delivering Legal Operating Intelligence for the future of legal work. Grounded in a singular system of truth, Filevine brings together data, documents, workflows, and teams into one unified platform—where modern legal work happens with clarity and consistency.

Powered by LOIS, the Legal Operating Intelligence System, Filevine connects context across every matter to transform legal operations from reactive to proactive. LOIS reads, understands, and reasons across your data to surface insight, automate complexity, and give professionals the clarity and confidence to see more, know more, and do more. Fueled by a team of exceptional collaborators and innovators, Filevine’s rapid growth has earned AI awards and recognition from Deloitte and Inc. as one of the most innovative and fastest-growing technology companies in the country.

About the team:
The DepoLive team builds real-time products. We own services such as a real-time speech-to-text pipeline used across many Filevine products, and Depo Copilot, the AI legal assistant that processes deposition data as it streams in. Our systems demand low latency, high availability, and strong observability. Our primary goal is to ship new features fast while keeping deployed versions reliable.

What You'll Do:

  • Build features end-to-end: architect, implement on both backend and frontend, deploy, and monitor the running service.

  • Take ownership of our systems. You will be responsible for keeping them healthy, debugging issues as they arise, and finding clever ways to scale them as load grows.

  • Partner with our ML team to operate our state-of-the-art ML infrastructure and pipelines.

  • Review code thoughtfully, mentor other engineers, and help set the bar for platform quality.

What You Need:

  • At least 6 years of software development experience.

  • Full-stack experience: you have owned architecture decisions, built both frontend and backend, handled deployment and monitoring, and iterated on features over time.

  • Hands-on experience with streaming or queuing systems (Kafka, Kinesis, or similar) under high load is required.

  • Preferred experience with Kubernetes, Terraform, Python, React, and AWS (though we care more about engineering skill than specific tools).

  • A product mindset: you care about the business reason behind what you build and understand how it shapes implementation tradeoffs.

  • Fluent English, since you will present your work at our demo days and collaborate on technical decisions in English.

  • Hybrid model: 2x Office, 3x Home Office

Compensation starts at 6,000 EUR per month, with the final offer determined by the candidate’s seniority and experience.

This opportunity is for independent contractors and is not intended to establish an employment relationship. Contractors are responsible for their own taxes and compliance with applicable laws in their jurisdiction.

This role is open exclusively to candidates currently residing in, or willing to relocate to, Czechia or Slovakia with the legal right to work in these countries. Unfortunately, we are unable to consider applications from candidates based outside of these locations due to operational and regulatory requirements

Privacy Policy Notice
Filevine will handle your personal information according to what’s outlined in our Privacy Policy.

title: Technical Lead - Business Automation & AI Development
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Technical Lead - Business Automation & AI Development based in Germany.

This role offers the opportunity to help build a new technology and automation practice focused on turning complex business processes into practical digital solutions.
You will operate at the intersection of business strategy, software architecture, automation, and AI-assisted development.
The position combines hands-on engineering with the architectural leadership needed to deliver secure, scalable, production-ready applications.
You will translate existing workflows and business requirements into custom applications that improve operations without requiring disruptive legacy system replacements.
Using AI-accelerated development approaches, you will help deliver solutions efficiently while applying strong technical judgment and engineering standards.
As the practice grows, you will have the opportunity to shape development standards, build a team, and mentor future engineers.
This is an ideal opportunity for an entrepreneurial technical leader who enjoys ambiguity, ownership, and solving real-world operational challenges.

Accountabilities

  • Design and oversee custom business applications, including CRM platforms, project management tools, data integration layers, and other operational software.
  • Translate complex business processes, existing documentation, video walkthroughs, and structured requirements into functional and scalable digital solutions.
  • Lead AI-assisted software development using platforms such as Replit Agent/Builder, ensuring generated solutions meet appropriate standards for architecture, security, maintainability, and scalability.
  • Apply sound architectural judgment to determine when AI-generated solutions require manual intervention, refinement, or redesign.
  • Design integration strategies and workflows that capture client requests, manage project lifecycles, and enable reliable data handoffs into existing legacy systems.
  • Develop solutions that improve operational efficiency while minimizing the need for disruptive replacements of established infrastructure.
  • Ensure deployed applications achieve strong availability, reliability, and performance through appropriate infrastructure management, monitoring, and quality assurance practices.
  • Establish technical and development best practices that support repeatable delivery as the automation practice scales.
  • Over time, identify, hire, mentor, and develop junior developers while building a high-performing team focused on AI-augmented software development.
  • Partner closely with business stakeholders to understand operational challenges and translate them into commercially valuable technical solutions.

    • Requirements

    • Proven experience combining software engineering with business analysis, product management, or a similar business-facing technical discipline.
    • Demonstrated experience using AI coding assistants or AI-powered development platforms such as Replit, Lovable, or comparable tools to rapidly deliver production-ready software.
    • Strong architectural judgment and the ability to evaluate, guide, and improve AI-generated code rather than relying solely on automated development.
    • Strong full-stack knowledge covering frontend and backend architectures, SQL and/or NoSQL databases, APIs, integrations, and application design.
    • Experience building or optimizing business applications such as CRM systems, project management platforms, internal operational tools, or workflow automation solutions.
    • Ability to design systems with a long-term perspective, ensuring solutions can scale from an individual client deployment to a much larger customer base.
    • Strong understanding of business processes and the ability to translate operational requirements into practical technology solutions.
    • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to bridge technical execution and the needs of non-technical business stakeholders.
    • Entrepreneurial and self-directed mindset, with a strong sense of ownership and comfort working in a fast-moving environment.
    • Ability to navigate ambiguous or undefined problems, make sound strategic decisions, and operate effectively without a rigid playbook.
    • Strong organizational and prioritization skills, with the ability to work autonomously and deliver results with minimal supervision.
    • Leadership and mentorship potential, with the ability to establish standards and develop future engineering talent.
    • Experience in professional services, consulting, BPO, legacy system migration, remote team leadership, or startup environments is beneficial but not essential.

      • Benefits

      • Full-time remote engagement.
      • Flexible working hours with required overlap with US time zones when needed for client and project delivery.
      • Opportunity to play a foundational role in launching and shaping a new technology and automation practice.
      • Significant technical ownership across architecture, application development, automation, integrations, and platform reliability.
      • Opportunity to work with AI-accelerated development technologies and modern software engineering approaches.
      • Potential to build, hire, and mentor a development team as the practice grows.
      • Exposure to diverse business processes and operational challenges across multiple client environments.
      • Opportunity to create practical technology solutions that modernize workflows without requiring disruptive legacy system replacements.
      • Entrepreneurial environment with substantial autonomy and opportunities to influence technical standards and delivery practices.
