  • Develop test plans, test schedule, and approach
  • Write test cases and scripts and identifies data for test scenarios
  • Conduct a walk through on test case(s)/script(s) with Test Managers, Requirement Leads, Project Managers, and Development Leads
  • Perform and lead tests and software and/or Information Technology (IT) systems to ensure proper operation and freedom from defects
  • Perform verification activities on work products using defined methods, procedures, and criteria with an appropriate verification environment
  • Document and communicate test results
  • Support analysis of test results and resolution of open issues
  • Document and communicate test results
  • Support analysis of test results and resolution of open issues
  • Document and work to resolve all complex problems
  • Report progress on problem resolution to management
  • Devise improvement to current procedures and develop models of possible future configurations
  • Create daily test metrics and reporting
  • Occasionally perform other IT systems engineering activities such as requirements, design, installation, operation, sustainment, and support
  • Apply technical principles, theories, and concepts in the field
  • Receive assignments in the form of objectives and establish goals to meet outlined objectives
  • Provide direction to employees according to established policies and management guidance
  • Measure whether objectives have been met
  • Provide technical solutions to a wide range of difficult problems where analysis of data requires evaluation of identifiable factors
  • Ensure that solutions are imaginative, thorough, practicable, and consistent with organizational objectives
  • Independently determine and develop approach to solutions
  • Review work upon completion for adequacy in meeting objectives
  • Demonstrate good judgment in selecting methods and techniques for obtaining solutions
  • Contribute to completion of specific programs and projects
  • Perform frequent inter-organizational and outside customer contacts
  • Represent organization in providing solutions to difficult technical issues associated with specific projects
Required Skills and Experience
  • Strong programming skills, often in languages such as C#, Java, or Python
  • A proven track record of working on complex software projects and ensuring high-quality deliverables
  • Experience in both manual and automated testing
  • Experience with Agile/Scrum methodologies and understanding of the Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC)
  • Proficiency in writing and executing test cases, test scripts, and test plans
  • Strong knowledge of test automation frameworks and tools (e.g., Selenium, TestNG, JUnit, QTP, LoadRunner)
  • Experience with continuous integration/continuous deployment (CI/CD) tools (e.g., GitHub Actions)
  • Familiarity with version control systems (e.g. Git and Subversion)
  • An understanding of performance testing and tools (e.g., JMeter and Gatling)
  • Experience with defect tracking and management tools (e.g. JIRA and Bugzilla)
  • Knowledge of database and SQL for validating stored data

title: Fish Hatchery Specialist 3 - Naselle River Hatchery - Permanent - 2026-07274
description:
Description



Classification- Fish Hatchery Specialist 3

Job Status- Full-Time/Permanent
WDFW Program- Fish Program – Hatcheries Division
Duty Station- Naselle River Hatchery – Naselle, Washington – Pacific County

Housing- No housing provided

*Standby- Standby is not currently assigned


Learn more about being a member of Team WDFW!


Photo Caption: Hatchery steelhead plant – Photo Credit: WDFW


Support salmon and steelhead conservation efforts while providing sustainable recreational, tribal, and commercial opportunities in the state of Washington.


As part of the Naselle River Hatchery team, you will perform scientific, technical, and related maintenance duties within the hatchery facilities and trap sites.


Serve as a leader and role model for staff and volunteers by fostering an environment that ensures fish population goals are met while prioritizing safety, identifying areas for improvement, and creating educational opportunities.



What to Expect:

Among the varied range of responsibilities held within this role, the Fish Hatchery Specialist 3 will,


Perform Fish Culture:

  • Carry out sound fish culture practices to meet program goals.
  • Project and monitor fish growth and feed requirements.
  • Perform fish inventories, splits, grading, marking trailer inventories, weight samples, and plants.
  • Lead crew members in feeding, cleaning, and transferring fish, determining the proper rearing densities for ponding and planting fish.
  • Collect genetic samples (opercula punches, dorsal ray samples) for genetic population analysis.
  • Collect various types of biological and environmental samples such as fish tissue, fish scales, ovarian fluid, water and feed for transport to laboratories; sample preparation includes dissection, vacuum filtration, and aseptic technique.
  • Coordinate on-station and off-site fish planting activities.
  • Independently implement on-site biological research projects to collect genetic samples, train lower-level staff in proper procedures in research protocols, as well as provide input into design changes driven by findings at the facility.


Crew Leader:

  • Monitor projects/activities to ensure completion in a timely manner.
  • Ensure that the staff is productive and well informed on activities.
  • Serve as a leader and role model for staff, temporary workers, and volunteers.
  • Demonstrate, instruct, and train others in methods on how to complete tasks.
  • Demonstrate an ongoing commitment to learning and self-improvement.
  • Plan daily and cyclic hatchery work schedules.
  • Act as agency liaison and project manager of the contracted crews during fish marking programs.


Physical Operation and Maintenance of Facility:

  • Ensure that working components of the fish hatchery are kept in good condition such as pumps and motors, vehicles, alarms, generators, and flashlights.
  • Maintain the grounds in appearance and upkeep during seasonal events using lawn mowers, weed eaters, chainsaws, pressure washers, forklifts, tractors, generators, and carpentry power tools.
  • Monitor water quality and quality rearing environments.
  • Manage the operation of fish traps and ladders.
  • Order tools and supplies to meet facility needs.


Communications:

  • Keep supervisor and management well informed on production issues that may lead to fish health concerns or program shortfalls.
  • Communicate with outside entities to implement agency-approved projects, as the facility subject matter expert.
  • Communicate with Fish Health Pathologists and Epidemiologists to ensure appropriate fish culture activities.
  • Perform outreach and education duties through community presentations and the preparation of materials for educational purposes on the hatchery operations and species information.


Data Collection, Entry, Reporting, and Budgeting:

  • Maintain a facility filing system that is well organized and user-friendly.
  • Ensure that staff are well informed on where and how to collect and record data.
  • Organize and maintain the budget tracking system for all hatchery expenditures.



Working Conditions:


Work Setting, including hazards: Work outside in all weather conditions, which may include working independently or in inclement weather, for approximately 250 days per year. Perform frequent strenuous physical activities such as daily, repetitive lifting of 50 pounds (fish feed bags, adult/juvenile fish, pumps and other equipment). This position may involve working in or near water, including tasks that require navigating, negotiating, and performing duties related to water environments.


Schedule: Typically, Monday – Friday, 8:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m. Work hours may vary at different times of the year, depending on the work schedule and weather conditions, and may sometimes include working evenings or weekends.


*Standby: Standby duties are not currently assigned - standby entails the employee being responsible for overseeing the facility for the remaining 16 hours of the day after the regular 8-hour shift, with a response time of 15–30 minutes. The standby schedule consists of working ten (10) consecutive days, including seven (7) days of standby duty, followed by four (4) days off.


All applicants applying for this position should understand that standby is a requirement for all positions in the Fish Hatchery Specialist series. Management may determine it is necessary to assign standby in order to accomplish the goals and objectives of the agency and as necessary to protect the resources of the agency and if assigned, it will be a requirement of the position.


Housing: No housing is provided.


Travel Requirements: Travel may be required for short periods of time to accomplish agency goals and required training.


Tools and Equipment: Hand and power tools, lawn care equipment, tractors, forklifts, welding equipment, egg picking machines, water sampling instruments, transport trucks, passenger vehicles, adult fish pumps and counters, coded wire tag (CWT) identification equipment, trash pumps, pressure washers, diesel generators, small gas engines, and computers.


Customer Interactions: Regularly interact with small community groups, individual members of the public, and volunteers. Will respond to questions from visitors to the facility and conduct organized tours as needed.



Qualifications:

Required Qualifications:


Option 1: Six (6) years of experience performing a variety of fish culture duties in a hatchery.


Option 2: One (1) year of experience as a Fish Hatchery Specialist 2.


Option 3: An Associate’s degree in fisheries technology, biology, or closely allied field and two (2) years of experience performing fish culture duties in a hatchery.


Option 4: A Bachelor’s degree in fisheries, biology, or closely allied field and two (2) years of experience performing fish culture duties in a hatchery.


Option 5: Successful completion of a fish culture program from a vocational school and two (2) years of experience performing fish culture duties in a hatchery.


Certifications/Licenses:

Valid Driver’s License.


Preferred Qualifications:

In addition to the required qualifications, our ideal applicant will possess some or all the following:


A four (4) year degree in Fisheries or closely associated field.



Your application must include the following:

  • A completed online application showcasing how your qualifications align with the job requirements.
  • An up-to-date resume.
  • At least three professional references with current contact information.

Supplemental Information

In addition to pay and other special employee programs, there are other benefits that WDFW employees may be eligible for. Click the “Benefits” tab at the top of this announcement to learn more.


Important Note:

All new employees must complete an Employment Eligibility Verification Form (I-9 Form) on their first day of work. If hired for this or any position at WDFW, you will be required to provide documentation proving you are eligible to work in the United States. For a list of acceptable documents, please use the following link:


Union - WAFHP:

These positions are in the bargaining unit represented by the Washington Association of Fish & Wildlife Hatchery Professionals and is subject to the terms of the Collective Bargaining Agreement between the State of Washington, Department of Fish & Wildlife, and the Washington Association of Fish Hatchery Professionals (WAFHP).



Veteran and Military Spouse Preference Notice:

Per RCW 73.16.010 Veterans and qualifying spouses who meet the minimum qualifications of a position are eligible for preference during the initial application review stage. To receive this benefit, please do the following:

  • Notify us of your veteran or military spouse status by email at danielle.gustafson@dfw.wa.gov.
  • Veterans only – Attach a copy of your DD214 (Member 4 copy), NGB 22 or USDVA signed verification of service letter.
    • Please redact any PII (personally identifiable information) data such as social security numbers.
  • Subject line must include recruitment number, position, and spouse/veteran (example: 2026-1234 – Biologist 1 – Veteran)
  • Include your name as it appears on your application in careers.wa.gov.


Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion Employer

As part of WDFW’s efforts to advance respectful and inclusive work environments, the Agency expects inclusivity as part of our professional interactions and communications. Therefore, we want to ensure that all individuals feel welcome, are treated fairly and respectfully. All staff are empowered to fully contribute to serving their work unit, Agency, and the citizens of Washington.


The Department of Fish and Wildlife is an equal opportunity employer. We strive to create a working environment that includes and respects cultural, racial, ethnic, sexual orientation and gender identity diversity. Women, racial and ethnic minorities, persons of disability, persons over 40 years of age, disabled and Vietnam era veterans and people of all sexual orientations and gender identities are encouraged to apply.


Request an accommodation: Persons needing accommodation in the application process or this announcement in an alternative format please contact Jayme Chase by phone 360-902-2278 or email Jayme.Chase@dfw.wa.gov, or the Telecommunications Device for the Deaf (TDD) at 800-833-6388.


Technical Difficulties: If you are having technical difficulties creating, accessing, or completing your application, please call NEOGOV toll-free at (855) 524-5627 or support@neogov.com.


Other questions: If you have other questions regarding this position, please reach out to danielle.gustafson@dfw.wa.gov and reference job #2026-07274.

title: Social- og sundhedshjælper til Vonsildhave – Nattevagt
description:
Kan du bevare roen, sprede omsorg og sikre, at vores beboere sover trygt? Vi søger en social- og sundhedshjælper, der vil være med til at forme det gode, nære hverdagsliv om natten. Hos os leves livet – hele livet.

Når dagen går på hæld, og roen sænker sig over Vonsildhave, starter din vigtige opgave. Vores beboere skal altid opleve maksimal omsorg, nærvær og professionel pleje – også i de mørke timer.

Som vores nye nattevagt bliver du ikke bare en praktisk hjælp; du bliver trygheden, beboerne møder, hvis de vågner.

Hvorfor vælge os?
  • Ledelse i øjenhøjde: Din leder er synlig, tilgængelig og klar til at sparre med dig.
  • Du står aldrig alene: Vi arbejder som et tæt team, hvor vi støtter hinanden og løfter i flok. Derudover er du i tæt makkerpar med en Social og sundhedsassistent i din vagt.
  • Fantastiske rammer: Vi er et privat plejehjem i naturskønne omgivelser i Kolding Syd, kendt for vores hjemlige atmosfære og stærke fællesskab.
Det praktiske om stillingen
  • Timetal: 28 timer om ugen.
  • Arbejdsrul: Som udgangspunkt en attraktiv 7/7-ordning.
  • Weekend: Vagter hver 2. uge.
  • Ekstra gode: Sundhedsforsikring er en fast del af din ansættelse.
Hvem er du?

Du er uddannet social- og sundhedshjælper, og trives med nattearbejdets særlige rytme og selvstændighed. Du brænder for at gøre en mærkbar forskel, besidder stor empati og sætter en ære i at levere høj kvalitet i plejen.

Vil du se dit nye arbejdssted?

Vi vil utrolig gerne byde dig indenfor til en kop kaffe, så du kan mærke stemningen og se vores rammer, før du søger.

Ring til afdelingsleder Camilla Bjerg Jensen på tlf. 20 53 83 65 for en uforpligtende snak eller for at aftale et besøg.

Ansøgning: Vi holder samtaler løbende, så tøv ikke med at række ud. Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig!

title: Pædagogmedhjælper til Fritidsklubben Sengeløse
description:
Nu har du muligheden for at blive en del af en fritidsklub, hvor relationer, aktiviteter og fællesskab er i centrum. Vær med til at skabe en spændende og tryg hverdag for børn og unge i klubben sammen med dedikerede kolleger.

Hos os handler klubben ikke kun om at være et sted, man kommer efter skole. Det handler om fællesskaber, aktiviteter, oplevelser og om at give børn og unge mulighed for at være med, tage ansvar og få indflydelse på deres fritidsliv.

Vi er på udkig efter dig, som:

  • Har lyst til at arbejde med børn og unge i en fritidsklub
  • Er praktisk og pædagogisk anlagt og ikke er bange for at tage fat
  • Kan lide både at sætte aktiviteter i gang og være deltagende sammen med børnene
  • Kan planlægge og gennemføre aktiviteter både i klubben og uden for huset
  • Har lyst til at lave mad sammen med børnene – og også tage opvasken bagefter
  • Kan se det pædagogiske potentiale i de praktiske opgaver og bruge dem til at skabe fællesskab og ansvar
  • Kan skabe gode relationer til børn og unge og møde dem med nærvær og respekt
  • Kan arbejde selvstændigt, men samtidig indgå aktivt i et team
  • Har lyst til at bidrage med idéer og være med til at udvikle klubbens aktiviteter

Samarbejde med skolen

Vi har et tæt samarbejde med den lokale skole, fordi vi tror på, at et godt samarbejde mellem skole og klub er vigtigt for børnenes trivsel og udvikling. Som medarbejder i klubben vil du derfor også kunne få timer og opgaver på skolen. Det kan fx være deltagelse i aktiviteter, understøttende pædagogiske opgaver eller samarbejde omkring enkelte børn og fællesskaber. Det betyder, at din arbejdsdag både kan foregå i klubben, på skolen og på ture ud af huset.

Aftenarbejde er en del af jobbet

Stillingen indebærer fast aftenarbejde. Aftenerne er en vigtig del af vores klubtilbud, hvor vi bl.a. laver aktiviteter, spiller, laver mad, tager på ture og skaber fællesskaber sammen med de unge. Det er derfor vigtigt, at du trives med at arbejde på tidspunkter, hvor mange andre har fri og kan se værdien i det arbejde, der foregår i klubben om aftenen.

Vi håber, du har kørekort

Det er en fordel, hvis du har almindeligt kørekort, da en del af vores aktiviteter foregår uden for klubben. Vi tager på ture og bruger vores nærområde aktivt.

Hos os får du:

  • En arbejdsplads med plads til idéer og initiativ
  • En hverdag, hvor du kommer tæt på børnene og de unge
  • Mulighed for at præge aktiviteter og ture
  • Et engageret kollegafællesskab
  • En arbejdsdag, hvor du både kan være pædagogisk, kreativ og praktisk
  • Mulighed for at være med til at udvikle klubben og dens tilbud
  • En arbejdsplads, hvor skole og klub arbejder tæt sammen om børn og unges trivsel

Det vigtigste er ikke, hvilken uddannelse du kommer med, men at du har lyst til at arbejde med børn og unge, kan skabe relationer og har lyst til at tage ansvar for både det pædagogiske og det praktiske.

Hvis du kan se dig selv i en hverdag, hvor du den ene dag står og laver mad med børnene, den næste tager på tur, og den næste igen er med på skolen – og hvor en god snak, et spil eller en spontan aktivitet kan være mindst lige så vigtig som det, der står i kalenderen, så vil vi meget gerne høre fra dig.

Vi glæder os til at tage imod dig og få dig godt ombord.

Praktiske oplysninger
Jobbet er på 30 timer om ugen. Arbejdstiden omfatter fast aftenarbejde mandag og onsdag til kl. 22.00. Øvrige arbejdstid ligger fredag fra 10.30-17.00.

Ansættelse pr. 1. november 2026.

Løn- og ansættelsesvilkår fastsættes i henhold til gældende overenskomst samt principperne i Ny Løn. Vi indhenter børne- og straffeattester samt referencer fra tidligere ansættelser i forbindelse med ansættelsen.

Ansøgningsfristen er torsdag den 17. september 2026

Vi holder samtaler tirsdag den 22. og onsdag den 23. september 2026 mellem kl. 16-18.

Ansøgning, CV og anden relevant dokumentation sendes via kommunens rekrutteringssystem.

Hvis du har spørgsmål til jobbet, vores dagligdag eller har lyst til at besøg os, er du meget velkommen til at kontakte klubleder Lucas Knigge Marott-Thøfner på 30534907.

Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig 😊

title: Sundhedsadministrativ koordinator/lægesekretær søges til Ultralydsskanning af Gra-vide, Klinik 1
description:
Afdeling for Kvindesygdomme, Graviditet og Fødsler, Herlev Hospital

Vil du være med til at gøre en forskel for gravide og deres familier i en af livets mest betydningsfulde perioder?

Har du interesse for det obstetriske speciale, stærke administrative kompetencer og lyst til en hverdag med både patientkontakt og tværfagligt samarbejde? Så er du måske vores nye kollega i afsnit for Ultralydsskanning af Gravide.

Om stillingen

Vi søger en engageret og dygtig sundhedsadministrativ koordinator eller lægesekretær til en fast stilling på 37 timer ugentligt.

Du bliver en vigtig del af den daglige drift i et specialiseret afsnit med stor aktivitet og mange samarbejdspartnere. Vi arbejder tæt sammen på tværs af faggrupper for at sikre høj kvalitet, gode patientforløb og den bedst mulige oplevelse for kommende forældre.

Du vil primært være tilknyttet afsnittet for Ultralydsskanning af Gravide, hvor du blandt andet vil bemande vores fælles reception sammen med Klinik for Kvinde- og Bækkenbundssygdomme. Her er du ofte patienternes første møde med afdelingen og bidrager til en professionel, tryg og imødekommende modtagelse i tråd med hospitalets ambition om, at alle patienter skal være godt behandlet.

Dine arbejdsopgaver

Dine opgaver vil blandt andet omfatte:

  • Modtagelse af patienter og pårørende
  • Telefonbetjening og callcenterfunktion
  • Booking af ultralydsskanninger og øvrige undersøgelser
  • Booking af specifikke prøver
  • Ressourceplanlægning og skemalægning i Sundhedsplatformen
  • Administrative opgaver i forbindelse med samrådssager
  • Håndtering af henvisninger og tilhørende arbejdsgange
  • Booking af tider i jordemoderkonsultationer og lægeambulatorier
  • Arbejde med administrative arbejdslister og registreringsopgaver
  • Håndtering af henvendelser via Sundhedsplatformen og fælles postkasse
  • Bestilling af tolk og patienttransport
  • Bestilling af varer og koordinering med håndværkere
  • Diverse ad hoc-opgaver, herunder håndtering af prøvesvar
Om os

Du bliver en del af en sekretærgruppe på 21 engagerede kolleger, som ser frem til at byde dig velkommen.

Vi lægger vægt på et godt arbejdsmiljø med høj faglighed, hjælpsomhed og en uformel omgangstone. Hos os er det naturligt at sparre med hinanden på tværs af funktioner og faggrupper, og vi værdsætter både det faglige og sociale fællesskab.

Sekretærerne er organiseret i mindre teams, men hjælper hinanden på tværs af afdelingen. Vi arbejder aktivt med kompetenceudvikling og giver mulighed for løbende at udvide ansvarsområder og funktioner. Gennem Min Karrierevej understøtter vi både faglig og personlig udvikling, og vi tilbyder relevante efteruddannelsesmuligheder.

Afdelingen varetager graviditet, fødsel og barsel for cirka 5.300 familier årligt.

I Ultralydsskanning af Gravide udfører vi hvert år cirka:

  • 22.000 ultralydsskanninger
  • 400 invasive prøver
  • 300 genetiske rådgivningsforløb
Vi er placeret på 15. etage på Herlev Hospital med udsigt over store dele af hovedstadsområdet.

Når du starter hos os, vil du hurtigt opleve en afdeling præget af tæt tværfagligt samarbejde. Læger, jordemødre, sonografer og sekretærer arbejder sammen om patientforløbene og har stor respekt for hinandens fagligheder og kompetencer.

Du får et individuelt tilrettelagt introduktionsforløb og bliver tilknyttet en mentor, som sikrer, at du kommer godt fra start.

Vi søger dig, der

  • Er uddannet sundhedsadministrativ koordinator eller lægesekretær
  • Gerne har erfaring fra obstetrik, gynækologi eller et beslægtet speciale
  • Har kendskab til Sundhedsplatformen og registreringsopgaver
  • Trives med patientkontakt, både personligt og telefonisk
  • Arbejder struktureret og har sans for kvalitet og detaljer
  • Er ansvarlig, initiativrig og selvstændig
  • Er fleksibel og stabil i dit fremmøde
  • Møder patienter, pårørende og kolleger med venlighed og overskud
Derudover er du en holdspiller, som trives i et tværfagligt miljø og bidrager positivt til både samarbejde og arbejdsmiljø.

Vi tilbyder

  • En spændende og varieret hverdag i et højt specialiseret obstetrisk afsnit
  • Tæt samarbejde med mange forskellige faggrupper
  • Grundig oplæring og mentorordning
  • Gode muligheder for kompetenceudvikling og efteruddannelse
  • Dygtige og engagerede kolleger
  • Et stærkt fagligt og socialt fællesskab
  • En arbejdsplads, hvor vi hjælper hinanden og værner om et godt arbejdsmiljø

title: Sundhedsplejerske
description:
Svendborg Kommune søger sundhedsplejerske til fast stilling 37 timer pr uge, med mulighed for færre timer

Om jobbet

Svendborg Kommune søger, med start 1. januar 2027, en sundhedsplejerske. Stillingen er på 37 timer pr uge i kombineret ordning med sundhedspleje til både småbørn og skoleelever. Der er mulighed for færre timer.

Sundhedsplejen er organisatorisk placeret i Sundhedsafdelingen i direktørområde Social, Sundhed og Beskæftigelse. Sundhedsplejerskerne er inddelt i 3 teams og vi prioriterer et godt teamsamarbejde meget højt. Vi prioriterer dog også et godt samarbejde på tværs af teams og fremstår derfor som én samlet afdeling.
Herudover har vi en sundhedsfaglig leder samt en sundhedsfaglig sekretær.

Sundhedsplejen har til huse i Sundhedsplejens Hus, hvor vi har samlet konsultationer og kontorpladser. Vi gør os umage med, at her er et godt miljø for både borgere og ansatte. Samarbejde, respekt og tillid er nøgleord.

Vi er generelt meget udviklingsorienterede og er en afdeling i konstant bevægelse. Vi har særligt fokus på tidlig opsporing og helhedsorienteret indsats. Vores praksis bygger bl.a. på mentaliserings- og tilknytningsteorier, ligesom vi er særligt optagede af betydningen af relationer.

Vores arbejdstider har ændret sig i takt med samfundsudviklingen, ligesom vi ønsker at give partnere, der ikke har orlov, bedre mulighed for at deltage i sundhedsplejens tilbud. Vi arbejder således både om dagen, sidst på eftermiddagen, først på aftenen i gruppeaktiviteter samt enkelte lørdage.

Særligt for os er også:

Sund Sex Skolen. Tilbud til unge fra 6. til 9. klasse

Vækstklinikken. Tilbud til børn og unge med vægtproblematik.

Familiecafé. Gruppetilbud til alle familier

Tryghedscirkelforløb. Tilbud til alle småbørnsfamilier.


Din profil
Vi ser gerne at du:

  • Er uddannet sundhedsplejerske og har erfaring med både småbørns-og skoleområdet. Herunder undervisning af grupper
  • Har erfaring indenfor ovenstående områder (seksualundervisning, vægtproblematikker, gruppeundervisning, Tryghedscirkel)
  • At du finder arbejdet med socialt og psykisk sårbare samt etniske familier interessant
  • Er stærk i det monofaglige samarbejde, teamsamarbejde og i tværfagligt samarbejde. At du formår at arbejde selvstændigt samtidig med, at du har en stærk vi-følelse
  • Har interesse i arbejdet med studerende
  • Er udviklingsorienteret og kan dokumentere at du kontinuerligt har prioriteret faglig udvikling. F.eks. AIMS, ADBB mm.
  • Er it-kyndig, interesseret og kompetent i forhold til nyere kommunikationsplatforme
  • Kan navigere i krydsfeltet mellem struktur og fleksibilitet og på den måde få ”tingene til at glide”


Vi kan tilbyde

  • En god arbejdsplads med høj social kapital og fokus på højt fagligt niveau
  • En samlet sundhedspleje, med Sundhedsplejens Hus som fælles base for udvikling af stærk faglighed
  • Faglig sparring som arbejdsredskab
  • Supervision efter behov
  • At møde dig åbent, med nysgerrighed på, hvad du kan bidrage med til fællesskabet


Løn- og ansættelsesvilkår: I Svendborg Kommune ligger lønnen for denne type stilling typisk mellem 49.708 og 54.094 kr. pr. måned ved fuldtidsansættelse. Lønnen er inklusive pension, særlig feriegodtgørelse og faste tillæg. Der kan desuden være arbejdstidsbestemte tillæg og andre særydelser. Det er vigtigt at bemærke, at din konkrete løn fastsættes ud fra din erfaring, anciennitet og kompetencer og aftales ved forhandling med den relevante faglige organisation. Der indhentes børne- og straffeattest forud for eventuel ansættelse.


Ansøgningsfrist: Ansøgningsfrist søndag den 20. september 2026. Samtaler afholdes onsdag den 30. september 2026.

Yderligere oplysninger: Du er velkommen til at kontakte TR Cecilie Stoumann på mobil 5154 0523 eller leder Jane Bergenhagen på 2160 7824.

Svendborg Kommune har røgfri arbejdstid. Vi ønsker, at røgfri arbejdstid skal bidrage til et sundt arbejdsmiljø for alle medarbejdere.

Velkommen til Svendborg - Øhavets hovedstad!
Svendborg har en suveræn beliggenhed midt i den skønneste natur, på kanten af det Sydfynske Øhav og med en mini-metropol, der byder på det hele. Vi tøver ikke, når vi med stolthed kalder Svendborg for Fyns kulturhovedstad. Vi har en charmerende bymidte og livlig handelsby med teatre og museer samt et rigt foreningsliv. Vores dagtilbud og folkeskoler er i top og med særligt fokus på bevægelse og sport, og vi har flere videregående uddannelser, som snart samles i et attraktivt uddannelsesmiljø ved havnen. Svendborg er placeret midt i landet med en halv time til Odense og under to timer til København og Århus. Svendborg er med sine ca. 60.000 indbyggere Fyns andenstørste kommune.

title: Senior C++ Engineer
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior C++ Engineer based in Spain.

This is an opportunity to contribute to the enhancement and security of critical desktop software used within the healthcare sector.
You will work on modern C++ components for high-performance applications where stability, efficiency, and security are essential.
The role combines deep software engineering with code analysis, vulnerability remediation, and advanced multithreading diagnostics.
You will collaborate with architecture, quality assurance, and product teams to deliver robust and dependable software.
AI-assisted coding tools will be used to accelerate analysis, troubleshooting, and development workflows.
This contract role is suited to a highly experienced engineer who enjoys complex technical challenges and takes ownership of engineering quality.
The position is remote within Europe, with occasional onsite collaboration in Central or Northern Germany.

Accountabilities

  • Develop, maintain, and enhance modern C++ components for high-performance desktop applications, with a strong focus on stability, reliability, and IT security.
  • Analyze existing software architecture against security specifications to identify, remediate, and prevent vulnerabilities.
  • Investigate complex technical issues and perform advanced multithreading analysis and debugging to optimize system efficiency and application performance.
  • Collaborate with software architects, quality assurance specialists, product managers, and other stakeholders to ensure robust software delivery.
  • Apply structured debugging and code-analysis techniques to identify root causes and implement durable solutions.
  • Leverage AI coding agents and automated engineering tools to accelerate code analysis, bug resolution, and development workflows.
  • Contribute to continuous improvements in engineering practices, software quality, security, and development efficiency.

    • Requirements

    • Extensive professional experience as a Senior C++ Engineer working with high-performance, multithreaded desktop applications.
    • Strong proficiency in modern C++ development practices and advanced software engineering principles.
    • In-depth expertise in system security, multithreading, concurrency, and advanced debugging techniques.
    • Practical experience with build systems and development toolchains including CMake, Conan, and MSVC.
    • Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities, with a structured approach and high standards for software quality.
    • Fluent English communication skills; German language skills are considered an advantage.
    • Eligibility to work from within the EU, EEA, UK, or Switzerland.
    • Familiarity with AI coding agents such as Claude Code or comparable automated engineering tools is preferred.
    • Experience with formal IT security standards, regulatory compliance, or software development in regulated environments is an advantage.
    • Previous experience in healthcare or other highly regulated industries is beneficial.
    • A university degree in Computer Science, Mathematics, Physics, Electrical Engineering, or a related technical discipline is preferred.

      • Benefits

      • Full-time contract or freelance engagement with a competitive daily rate.
      • Flexible working hours and the independence associated with contractor work.
      • Remote working within Europe, with only occasional onsite visits required in Central or Northern Germany.
      • Freedom to choose projects aligned with your professional interests and expertise.

      • Dedicated support throughout the engagement to help with project-related questions.
      • Opportunities to expand your professional network and advance your technical career.
      • Opportunity to work with modern engineering practices, including AI-assisted development tools.

title: Vagtplanlægger til S9 - 1-årigt barselsvikariat på AUH
description:
Har du blik for både mennesker, struktur og de mange brikker, der skal gå op, når en vagtplan skal fungere?

Psykiatrisk Sengeafsnit 9 (S9), Afdeling for Depression og Angst, Aarhus Universitetshospital søger en vagtplanlægger til et 1-årigt barselsvikariat med tiltrædelse d. 1. november 2026.

Som vagtplanlægger får du en central funktion i afsnittets daglige drift. Vi søger dig, der kan skabe overblik og finde gode løsninger, som både sikrer en stabil bemanding og tager hensyn til medarbejdernes arbejdsliv og fritid.

Om S9

S9 er et voksenpsykiatrisk sengeafsnit i Afdeling for Depression og Angst. Vi behandler primært patienter med affektive lidelser samt patienter med PTSD og angstlidelser.

Vi er en tværfaglig medarbejdergruppe bestående af blandt andet sygeplejersker, social- og sundhedsassistenter, pædagoger, ergo- og fysioterapeuter, læger, psykologer, socialrådgiver, sekretær og studerende.

Vi lægger vægt på høj faglighed, et godt arbejdsmiljø og et tæt samarbejde – med plads til humor i hverdagen.

Om stillingen

Du får ansvar for at udarbejde og koordinere vagtplaner for afsnittets plejepersonale og studerende. Du arbejder i PDC VagtPlan og sikrer planlægning i overensstemmelse med gældende overenskomster, arbejdstidsregler, hviletidsbestemmelser og ferielovgivning.

Dine opgaver vil blandt andet være

  • udarbejdelse og løbende koordinering af vagtplaner
  • håndtering af ønsker til arbejdsplaner, ferie og frihed
  • koordinering af vagtbytte og fraværsdækning
  • oprettelse af nye medarbejdere i relevante systemer
  • indberetning af løn
  • koordinering af kurser og øvrige aktiviteter
  • lettere administrative opgaver og telefonbetjening.

Du bliver en vigtig samarbejdspartner for både medarbejdere og afsnitsledelse. En væsentlig del af jobbet er at balancere medarbejdernes ønsker med behovet for en stabil og fagligt forsvarlig bemanding.

Vi søger dig, der

  • har erfaring med vagtplanlægning, gerne fra sundhedsvæsenet eller en anden døgnbemandet organisation
  • arbejder struktureret og kan bevare overblikket, også når planerne ændrer sig
  • er selvstændig, ansvarlig og løsningsorienteret
  • har gode samarbejdsevner og kommunikerer tydeligt og imødekommende
  • er en sikker IT-bruger.

Kendskab til PDC VagtPlan, relevante overenskomster og arbejdstidsregler er en fordel.

Du får en grundig start

Vi ved, at vagtplanlægning i et døgnbemandet sengeafsnit er en kompleks opgave. Derfor får du et struktureret onboardingforløb på minimum en måned sammen med den fungerende vagtplanlægger på S9, så du får mulighed for at lære både opgaver, systemer, medarbejdere og arbejdsgange grundigt at kende.

Herefter står du ikke alene med funktionen. Du bliver tæt kollega med vagtplanlægger på S4, som du får løbende sparring og samarbejde med, ligesom du arbejder tæt sammen med afsnitsledelsen på S9.

Vi tilbyder en selvstændig nøglefunktion med mulighed for at præge arbejdsgangene og en arbejdsplads med høj faglighed, godt samarbejde og plads til humor.

Stillingen er et étårigt barselsvikariat med tiltrædelse d. 1. november 2026 og er som udgangspunkt på 37 timer ugentligt.

Vil du vide mere?

Du er meget velkommen til at kontakte vagtplanlægger Louise Tode Henriksen på mail LOUTOD@rm.dk eller oversygeplejerske Hanne Elmo Mikkelsen på tlf. 7847 2220 for at høre mere om stillingen og S9.

Ansøgningsfrist er d. 17. september 2026 og ansættelsessamtaler afholdes i uge 39.

Vi ser frem til at modtage din ansøgning.

Stillingen er som udgangspunkt en fuldtidsstilling.

Da Region Midtjylland løbende gennemfører besparelser og omorganiseringer, vil medarbejdere i omplacering, der søger stillingen, have fortrinsret.

Region Midtjylland er jf. EU’s løngennemsigtighedsdirektiv, der trådte i kraft 7. juni 2026 forpligtet til at oplyse dig om startløn eller et interval for startløn for en stilling inden du tilbydes ansættelse.

Her finder du Region Midtjyllands lønkatalog for de fleste faggrupper og stillinger, som findes i Region Midtjylland: Gennemsigtighed forud for ansættelse - Medarbejder.rm.dk

title: Car Detailer
description:
We’re looking for entry-level Lot Attendants to build an exciting career at Carvana - the fastest-growing used automotive retailer in U.S. history and one of the four fastest companies to make the Fortune 500! As a Lot Attendant, you will be focused on maintaining the cleanliness and appearance of the vehicles at our Market Hubs. As part of this role, you will be expected to coordinate with fellow employees to ensure timely deliveries and the highest level of customer satisfaction. Interested in joining the team? Check out more below:

  • This is a full-time position
  • PTO and paid holidays + your birthday is a holiday

Unlock Your Earning Potential!

We offer a competitive starting hourly rate of $17/hr with significant growth opportunities based on performance. You can boost your earnings within a short timeframe:

  • Pay Range: $17-$18 hourly
  • Starting Pay: $17/hr
  • At 3 Months: $17.25/hr
  • At 6 Months: $17.50/hr
  • At 9 Months: $17.75/hr
  • At 12 Months: $18/hr

In your first year, you can progress from $17hr to $18hr through our performance-based Careers Not Jobs program, which provides four merit opportunities annually. As part of this program, eligible team members can enjoy an additional $0.25 increase in their pay every 90 days.

We’re looking for enthusiastic, energetic, and self-motivated team players to:

  • Ensure each vehicle is inspected for mechanical, drivability or cosmetic concerns
  • Wash and vacuum all inventory on a regular basis
  • Complete multi-point inspection on arriving inventory to include fuel level, safety features, drivability test and proper display of all company and state disclosures
  • Maintain positive relationships with coworkers and external vendors
  • Interact and communicate with team members and management across all lines of the business.
  • Must adhere to regular and predictable attendance.

General qualifications and requirements

  • High School Diploma or equivalent is desirable
  • Must be 18 years of age and have a valid driver’s license
  • Must have a valid driver's license and clean driving record for the past 3 years
  • Must be able to lift up to 60 pounds independently; majority of lifting from knee to shoulder heights; other lifting required from various levels.
  • Must be able to carry and transport up to 60 pounds up to 20 feet.
  • Requires standing for an extended period of time with frequent stretching, reaching, walking and stooping, pushing and/or pulling in an environment that may be cold, hot, noisy, and wet and may have fumes or odors due to vehicle maintenance.
  • Requires working outdoors in all weather conditions.
  • Requires excellent visual acuity and manual dexterity.
  • Requires use of safety equipment that may include but not limited to face shield or goggles, non-slip shoes, gloves, mask, and other protective garments and equipment.

  • Must adhere to regular and predictable attendance.

At Carvana, we sell cars but we aren’t car salesmen. Our promise is simple: we won’t sell a car to a customer that we wouldn’t sell to our own Mom. Period.

Being a brand ambassador of Carvana means having a passion for our vision and having a motor that never quits when it comes to representing our brand and values. Our Market Operations team members work as a team to deliver awesome customer experiences in their markets, while also remaining agile enough to keep up with the ever-changing beat and cadence of your daily activities.

Think you’ve got what it takes to join our team? Apply today!

Carvana is an equal employment opportunity employer. All applicants receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, marital status, national origin, age, mental or physical disability, protected veteran status, or genetic information, or any other basis protected by applicable law. Carvana also prohibits harassment of applicants or employees based on any of these protected categories.

Hiring is contingent on passing a complete background check. This role is not eligible for visa sponsorship. Must be at least 18 years of age and possess a valid driver’s license. Must be able to read, write, speak and understand English.

title: Pre-Award: MXM- Model Based Systems Engineer III
description:
Barbaricum is a rapidly growing government contractor providing leading-edge support to federal customers, with a particular focus on Defense and National Security mission sets. We leverage more than 17 years of support to stakeholders across the federal government, with established and growing capabilities across Intelligence, Analytics, Engineering, Mission Support, and Communications disciplines. Founded in 2008, our mission is to transform the way our customers approach constantly changing and complex problem sets by bringing to bear the latest in technology and the highest caliber of talent.

Headquartered in Washington, DC's historic Dupont Circle neighborhood, Barbaricum also has a corporate presence in Tampa, FL, Bedford, IN, and Dayton, OH, with team members across the United States and around the world. As a leader in our space, we partner with firms in the private sector, academic institutions, and industry associations with a goal of continually building our expertise and capabilities for the benefit of our employees and the customers we support. Through all of this, we have built a vibrant corporate culture diverse in expertise and perspectives with a focus on collaboration and innovation. Our teams are at the frontier of the Nation's most complex and rewarding challenges. Join our team.

Barbaricum is seeking an Model Based Systems Engineer III to directly support the anticipated Naval Surface Warfare Center (NSWC) Crane Division, Model Based Engineering Assessment Division (Code MXM). Code MXM's mission is mission engineering analysis and assessment of complex Naval, DoD, and joint kill chains — with a specialized focus on Electromagnetic Spectrum Operations (EMSO) enabled analysis. As a Model Based Systems Engineer III, you will apply MBSE methodologies, frameworks, and tools at a senior level in support of Code MXM's mission engineering capability development. You will develop and manage requirements and verification methodologies within system models and lead the creation and management of MBSE artifacts.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Apply expert knowledge of MBSE methodologies and frameworks and expertise in MBSE tools.
  • Develop and manage requirements and verification methodologies within system models.
  • Use system models to identify subassemblies, interfaces, functions, environments, and software/firmware requirements.
  • Create SETR artifacts and MBSE meta-chain report templates.
  • Perform data management (DM) and configuration management (CM) of MBSE artifacts.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

title: DevSecOps Engineer – Compliance Automation
description:
Spektrum supports apex purchasers (NATO, UN, EU, and National Government and Defence) and their Tier 1 supplier ecosystem with a wide range of specialist services. We provide our clients with professional services, specialised aerospace and defence sales, delivery, and operational subject matter expertise. We are looking for personnel to join our team and support key client projects.

Who we are supporting

The NATO Communication and Information Agency (NCIA) is responsible for providing secure and effective communications and information technology (IT) services to NATO's member countries and its partners. The agency was established in 2012 and is headquartered in Brussels, Belgium.

The NCIA provides a wide range of services, including:

  • Cyber Security: The NCIA provides advanced cybersecurity solutions to protect NATO's communication networks and information systems against cyber threats.
  • Command and Control Systems: The NCIA develops and maintains the systems used by NATO's military commanders to plan and execute operations.
  • Satellite Communications: The NCIA provides satellite communications services to enable secure and reliable communications between NATO forces.
  • Electronic Warfare: The NCIA provides electronic warfare services to support NATO's mission to detect, deny, and defeat threats to its communication networks.
  • Information Management: The NCIA manages NATO's information technology infrastructure, including its databases, applications, and servers.

Overall, the NCIA plays a critical role in ensuring the security and effectiveness of NATO's communication and information technology capabilities.

The program

Assistance and Advisory Service (AAS)

The NATO Communications and Information Agency (NCI Agency) is NATO’s principal C3 capability deliverer and CIS service provider. It provides, maintains and defends the NATO enterprise-wide information technology infrastructure to enable Allies to consult together under Article IV, and, when required, stand together in the face of attack under Article V.

To provide these critical services, in the modern evolving dynamic environment the NCI Agency needs to build and maintain high performance-engaged workforce. The NCI Agency workforce strategically consists of three major categorise's: NATO International Civilians (NIC)'s, Military (Mil), and Interim Workforce Consultants (IWC)'s. The IWCs are a critical part of the overall NCI Agency workforce and make up approximately 15 percent of the total workforce.

Role ID – 2026-0127

Role Background

The NATO Communications and Information Agency (NCIA) located in The Hague, The Netherlands, is providing technical support to the NATO HQ Cyber and Digital Transformation (CDT) Division and Supreme Allied Command Transformation (SACT) by moving away from manual point-in-time audits, authorization to operate and security accreditation towards Continuous Governance, Risk and Compliance Auditing leading to Continuous Authorization to Operate (cATO) and Continuous Security Accreditation via EaC (Everything as Code) + Regulatory Operations (RegOps) using NIST OSCAL (Open Security Controls Assessment Language ) data models with the ultimate goal to deploy the RegScale platform as a workload and establish a Minimum Viable Product (MVP) for Continuous Authorization to Operate (cATO)

Role Duties and Responsibilities

  • The Contractor shall perform the following activities in support of the deliverables defined in
    Section 3.2. These activities are not considered deliverables in themselves.
  • Review the target Kubernetes/PaaS environ and prepare deployment, DB, API gateway, networking and configuration.
  • Configure and test Entra ID/Azure AD or IAM integration, incl. role mappings, automated user onboarding and access controls.
  • Set up and validate integrations with Azure Policy, AWS Sec. Hub, M365 and Purview to ingest compliance, telemetry and SaaS inventory data.
  • Verify that imported compliance data, telemetry, control statuses and evidence are correctly received, normalized and mapped within RegScale.
  • Run controlled test changes to confirm that event-driven updates are detected and reflected accurately in RegScale.
  • Configure and test automated workflows so that failed controls generate Jira or Azure DevOps tickets.
  • Conduct Stakeholder Review Sessions to validate assumptions, mappings etc.
  • Issue tracking and remediation support.

Essential Skills, Experience and Certifications

A minimum requirement of a Bachelor’s degree at a nationally recognized/certified University in a related discipline and 3 years post-related experience.
2) A minimum of 3 years’ experience in all of the following items:
a. Kubernetes, API Integration (REST), Python/Scripting, CI/CD pipelines;
b. Drafting of technical data flows;
c. Webhooks, Jira/ServiceNow APIs;
d. M365 Graph API, Security Center;
e. Red-teaming compliance;
f. PowerShell, Cloud APIs, JSON;
g. OAuth2, OIDC, Identity Management.
3) Documented (or demonstrable) experience in process analysis, and design techniques.
B) Desirable Knowledge and Experience
1) Robust technical knowledge of NATO operations, responsibilities and organization – with
specific focus on how NATO achieves technical interoperability on the battlefield.
2) Comprehensive understanding of NATO’s Cloud strategies.
3) Knowledge of ITIL, COBIT, or equivalent.
4) Familiarity with current and evolving capabilities and trends in military and civilian
communication protocols and standards.
C) Desirable Competencies
1) Deciding and Initiating Action - Takes responsibility for actions, projects and people; takes
initiative and works under own direction; initiates and generates activity and introduces
changes into work processes; makes quick, clear decisions which may include tough
choices or considered risks.
2) Adhering to Principles and Values - Upholds ethics and values; demonstrates integrity;
promotes and defends equal opportunities, builds diverse teams; encourages
organizational and individual responsibility towards the community and the environment.
3) Relating and Networking - Easily establishes good relationships with customers and staff;
relates well to people at all levels; builds wide and effective networks of contacts; uses humor appropriately to bring warmth to relationships with others.
4) Formulating Strategies and Concepts - Works strategically to realize organizational goals;
sets and develops strategies; identifies, develops positive and compelling visions of the
organization’s future potential; takes account of a wide range of issues across, and related
to, the organization.
5) Achieving Personal Work Goals and Objectives - Accepts and tackles demanding goals
with enthusiasm; works hard and puts in longer hours when it is necessary; seeks
progression to roles of increased responsibility and influence; identifies own development
needs and makes use of developmental or training opportunities.

Working Location

  • The Hague

Working Policy

  • On-site

Travel

  • Some travel to other NATO sites may be required

Security Clearance

  • Valid National or NATO Secret personal security clearance

title: Børnehuset Gl. Kirkevej søger en engageret og nærværende pædagog
description:
Børnehuset Gl. Kirkevej søger en engageret og nærværende pædagog

Vil du være med til at skabe en hverdag, hvor børn oplever sig set, hørt og som en vigtig del af fællesskabet?

Brænder du for børns trivsel, udvikling, læring og dannelse? Er du nysgerrig på børnenes perspektiver og optaget af, hvordan vi som voksne kan skabe de bedste rammer for leg, læring og fællesskaber?

Så er det måske dig, vi leder efter.

Hos os får du mulighed for at blive en del af et fagligt arbejdsfællesskab, hvor vi både tør være nysgerrige på vores egen praksis og udvikle den sammen.

Vi tror på, at når vi bliver nysgerrige på børnenes perspektiver, bliver vi også bedre pædagogiske voksne.


💚 Velkommen til Børnehuset Gl. Kirkevej

Børnehuset Gl. Kirkevej er en integreret institution med 24 vuggestuebørn og 69 børnehavebørn, fordelt på to vuggestuegrupper og tre børnehavegrupper.

Vi er et børnehus, hvor integration, rummelighed og plads til det enkelte individ er en vigtig del af vores hverdag. Vi ønsker, at alle børn oplever, at de hører til, og at der er plads til at være den, man er.

Vi er særligt optagede af, hvad de fysiske læringsmiljøer kan tilbyde børnene – og hvordan indretning, materialer og organisering kan understøtte børnenes trivsel, udvikling, læring og dannelse.

Vores legeplads rummer masser af muligheder. Her kan børnene gå på opdagelse i skoven, klatre i legetårnet, gynge, cykle og fordybe sig i leg.

Vi bruger også vores lokalområde aktivt. Vi har grønne oaser, legepladser, stranden og Amager Fælled lige i nærheden, og vi gør brug af kommunens forskellige tilbud og tager blandt andet på ture til biblioteket, Naturskolen og Kastrup Bio.

Vi tror på, at verden er et fantastisk læringsrum – og at børn lærer allermest, når de får lov til at være nysgerrige, undersøgende og aktive deltagere.


🌿 Her bliver din hverdag

Som pædagog hos os bliver du en vigtig del af børnenes hverdag.

Sammen med dine kollegaer og ledelsen er du med til at skabe spændende, trygge og legende dage, hvor børnene får mulighed for at udvikle sig og opleve sig som en del af fællesskabet.

Du vil både kunne fordybe dig med mindre børnegrupper i planlagte aktiviteter og være legeagent på stuen eller legepladsen.

Som legeagent har du en særlig vigtig opgave: At være tæt på legen, få øje på børn, der står på kanten af fællesskabet, og hjælpe dem ind i legen.

For os er leg ikke bare noget, børnene laver. Leg er et af de vigtigste steder, hvor børn udvikler sig, lærer og oplever fællesskab.

Stuerne arbejder ud fra en fælles aktivitetsplan med blandt andet aktivitetsgrupper, køkkenaktiviteter og ture ud af huset. Aktiviteterne kan foregå på den enkelte stue eller på tværs af børnehuset.

Du kommer blandt andet til at:

  • planlægge, gennemføre og understøtte pædagogiske aktiviteter
  • skabe gode rammer for leg, læring og fællesskaber
  • være tæt på børnenes leg og følge deres spor
  • have den daglige dialog med forældrene og deltage i forældresamtaler
  • deltage i ugentlige stuemøder og personalemøder én aften om måneden
  • samarbejde med dine kollegaer om det enkelte barns trivsel, udvikling, læring og dannelse
  • understøtte børnenes sociale kompetencer og deltagelsesmuligheder
  • dokumentere og reflektere over dagens leg, aktiviteter og det, der rører sig på stuen.

🌱 Dette skal du kunne

Vi søger en pædagog, som både kommer med faglighed, engagement og lyst til at være en del af vores fælles udvikling.

Vi forestiller os, at du:

  • er fleksibel og samarbejdende og kan smile, når dagens plan må ændres, fordi en kollega eller et barn har brug for dig
  • er optaget af børnenes perspektiver og har lyst til at følge børnenes spor
  • har lyst til at fordybe dig i legen sammen med børnene
  • interesserer dig for de fysiske læringsmiljøer og ser indretningen som en aktiv del af det pædagogiske arbejde
  • kan skabe et tillidsfuldt og respektfuldt forældresamarbejde
  • er imødekommende, lyttende og ser forældrene som en vigtig ressource
  • er optaget af tidlig indsats i forhold til børns trivsel og har gerne kendskab til Hjernen & Hjertet.

Vi lægger vægt på, at du kan reflektere over din egen praksis, give og modtage faglig sparring og har lyst til at udvikle dig sammen med andre.


⭐ Det kan du forvente hos os

Hos Børnehuset Gl. Kirkevej bliver du en del af et arbejdsfællesskab, hvor vi tager ansvar – både for det enkelte barn og for fællesskabet.

Vi arbejder systematisk med at evaluere vores pædagogiske praksis og vores læringsmiljøer. Vi er nysgerrige på, hvad der virker, og hvad vi kan gøre endnu bedre.

Vi møder hinanden med faglige ambitioner og positive forventninger, og vi har barnet i centrum for vores opgaveløsning.

Vi arbejder med Nest som ramme for at skabe struktur, forudsigelighed og gode deltagelsesmuligheder for børnene.

Du vil møde en rummelig personalegruppe, hvor vi prioriterer sparring på tværs af børnehuset og hjælper hinanden med at lykkes.

Og så er vi vilde med at skabe små stjernestunder gennem dagen – de øjeblikke, hvor et barn oplever: Her blev jeg set. Her lykkedes jeg. Her hører jeg til.

Vi tror på, at kvalitet skabes i relationen mellem mennesker – og at vi bliver dygtigere sammen.

Hos os får du:

  • faglig sparring og mulighed for udvikling
  • en arbejdsplads med fokus på børnenes perspektiver
  • kollegaer, der hjælper hinanden og tager fælles ansvar
  • mulighed for at sætte dit faglige aftryk
  • ledelse tæt på og fokus på faglig ledelse
  • sparring og vejledning gennem dagtilbuddets tilknyttede pædagogiske vejleder
  • et børnehus, hvor der er plads til både faglighed, humor, nysgerrighed og forskellighed.

Arbejdstiden ligger mellem kl. 6.30–17.00 og kl. 6.30–16.00 om fredagen. Derudover forventes det, at du deltager i personalemøde én aften om måneden kl. 17.00–20.00.

Som pædagogisk medarbejder i Tårnby Kommunes dagtilbud vil du desuden være en del af en organisation med fokus på faglig udvikling, sparring og tæt ledelse.


💚 Kan du se dig selv hos os?

Måske sidder du lige nu og tænker: ”Det lyder faktisk som et sted, hvor jeg kunne trives.”

Så vil vi meget gerne høre fra dig.

Vi søger ikke nødvendigvis den perfekte pædagog.

Vi søger en kollega, der har hjerte for børnene, lyst til at lege, mod på at reflektere og lyst til at være en del af et fagligt fællesskab.

Hvis du kan genkende dig selv i det, vi fortæller, så glæder vi os til at læse din ansøgning


📞 Mere om os

Hvis du er blevet nysgerrig og gerne vil vide mere om jobbet, er du meget velkommen til at kontakte:

Maria Foss eller Sussi Jacobsen

Telefon: 30760404

Ansøgningsfrist: Indtil at vi har fundet det rigtige match

Vi forventer at afholde ansættelsessamtaler løbende


Løn- og ansættelsesvilkår

Ansættelsen sker i henhold til gældende overenskomst med BUPL efter forhandling.

Kommunens ansættelsespolitik indebærer, at der ved ansættelse indhentes referencer fra tidligere og nuværende arbejdssteder. Har du været ansat i Tårnby Kommune, vil der altid blive taget reference herfra. Der skal desuden ved ansættelse forevises straffeattest og indhentes børneattest. Ansættelsen vil være betinget af, at disse er tilfredsstillende.

Tårnby Kommune tilbyder en række personalegoder. Disse kan ses her.

Er du nysgerrig på at vide mere om arbejdet som pædagog i Tårnby Kommune se her.

Tårnby Kommune har et værdigrundlag, som du kan læse her.

Vi gør opmærksom på, at Tårnby Kommune har røgfri arbejdstid.

GMO is privately owned and employs over 430 people worldwide. We are headquartered in Boston, with additional offices in Europe, Asia and Australia. Our company-wide culture emphasizes commitment to clients, intellectual curiosity, and open debate. We celebrate and respect our differences, while embracing and valuing what each of us brings to work, as we know that diverse teams in an inclusive, caring environment achieve higher engagement and better client results.
Please follow the prompts included in this job posting to apply. The application window for this role is anticipated to remain open until the job is filled, or as otherwise determined by GMO.

Position Overview
The Investment Research Associate Program is a three-year rotational opportunity designed for highly motivated and intellectually curious individuals. Associates will rotate across multiple investment teams at GMO, gaining exposure to both quantitative and fundamental investment approaches across a range of asset classes, including equities, fixed income, alternatives, and asset allocation.
The program is structured to develop future investors by providing hands-on experience and continuous training. Associates work closely with experienced researchers, portfolio managers, and traders, contributing meaningfully to investment research and decision-making.
Each rotation typically lasts six to eight months, though timing and assignments may vary based on team needs, individual skills, and interests. Ongoing research and investment training, along with firmwide initiatives, support integration into GMO’s culture and investment philosophy.
The goal is to place associates into full-time roles on investment teams upon completion of the program. In some cases, permanent placement may occur before the three-year period concludes.
Responsibilities:
Examples of the work include:
•Develop and/or redefine investment models and frameworks for understanding the drivers of returns and associated risks across markets
•Complete complex analytical projects
•Interpret company announcements and their investment implications
•Investigating macroeconomic themes and trends
•Communicating and presenting investment ideas to colleagues
Qualifications:
•Completed Bachelor’s or Master’s degree by June 2027
•Degree in a quantitative or analytical field such as Mathematics, Economics, Financial Engineering, Physics, Computer Science, or a related discipline
•Demonstrated interest in investing through relevant coursework or internship experience
•Strong verbal and written communication skills
•Programming experience in at least one of Python or MATLAB; familiarity with SQL is a plus
•Familiarity with generative AI tools (e.g., MS Copilot, ChatGPT, Claude) and prompt engineering
•Genuine passion for investing and a strong desire to analyze investment opportunities
•Willingness to take initiative, embrace risk, and contribute a differentiated perspective
•Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to synthesize information, identify key insights, and draw conclusions
•Proactive and intellectually curious, with the ability to prioritize, multitask, and thrive in a collaborative, team-oriented environment
•Fewer than two years of relevant experience in the investment industry
Application Process
Step 1
  1. Submit a Statement of Interest that explains (please keep it to one page):
    • Why do you want to pursue a career as an investor?
    • Please tell us something about yourself that is not on your résumé
  2. Include your current résumé
  3. Include a copy of your transcript
Step 2
Selected candidates will be asked to complete a phone interview with the manager of the Investment Research Associate program during September/October 2026.
Step 3
Selected candidates will be invited to an in-person or video interview at GMO’s Boston office during October/November 2026.
GMO is committed to the recruitment, employment, and promotion of all candidates equally, regardless of an individual's gender, race, color, national origin, ancestry, age, religion, pregnancy, marital status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, military or veteran status, genetic information, physical or mental disability (except where such disability is a bona fide occupational disqualification) or any other classification protected under federal, state or local law.

title: Studentermedhjælper til udvikling og kvalitetssikring af voicebot i Københavns Borgerservice
description:
Vil du arbejde med kunstig intelligens, data og digitale løsninger, der gør en forskel for københavnerne?

Hos Borgerservice Udvikling søger vi en studentermedhjælper, der skal supportere vores udviklingsteam i at udvikle og teste en voicebot, der tager imod telefoniske henvendelser til Københavns Kommunes kontaktcenter.

Om jobbet
Vi udvikler løbende voicebotten, tester den og følger med i, hvordan løsningen fungerer i mødet med borgerne. Voicebotten udvikles på platformen Boost.ai og spiller sammen med en række af kommunens øvrige systemer.

Du kommer til at arbejde tæt sammen med teamets udviklere samt serviceformidlere og faglige specialister.

Dine arbejdsopgaver
Du skal blandt andet

  • teste nye områder i voicebotten inden lancering, fx pas, kørekort og folkepension
  • kortlægge og analysere, hvad borgerne ringer om
  • overvåge voicebottens samtaler efter lancering og registrere fejl og mønstre
  • analysere data og identificere muligheder for forbedringer
Om dig
Vi forestiller os, at du læser fx informationsvidenskab, digital design, kommunikation og IT eller lignende. Du behøver ikke have erfaring med voicebots eller digitale agenter. Det vigtigste er, at du

  • kan sætte dig i borgerens sted og har sans for god service
  • interesserer dig for conversation design, prompt engineering eller har lyst til at lære det
  • har tålmodighed til systematisk test og andre opgaver, der kan indebære gentagelser
  • arbejder struktureret og grundigt og har blik for detaljer
  • er nysgerrig på data, AI og digitale løsninger
  • har en god logisk og teknisk forståelse
Vi tilbyder
Hos os får du praktisk erfaring med udvikling og drift af en borgervendt AI-løsning. Du får indblik i hele processen fra kortlægning af borgernes behov og udvikling til test, lancering og løbende forbedringer. Du bliver tilknyttet et engageret og dynamisk projektteam med forskellige fagligheder og får mulighed for at påvirke en løsning, som skal bruges af københavnerne.

Hvem er vi?
Du bliver del af et projektteam i udviklingsafdelingen hos Københavns Borgerservice. Vi arbejder med alt fra servicedesign, AI projekter til kommunikation og kompetenceudvikling. Vi arbejder tæt sammen og prioriterer faglighed og en uformel god stemning.

Ansættelsesvilkår
Løn- og ansættelsesvilkår følger gældende overenskomst. Arbejdstiden er ca. 15 timer om ugen, og du kommer til at arbejde i Nyropsgade i hjertet af København.

Tiltrædelse ønskes fra den 1. oktober 2026 eller hurtigst muligt derefter.

Der vil blive indhentet reference i forbindelse med ansættelsen. Du skal derudover dokumentere, at du er studieaktiv.

Mere information
Har du spørgsmål til stillingen, er du velkommen til at kontakte Lotte Stehr Ebbensgaard på 20 48 65 31.

Vedhæft en kort ansøgning og dit CV.

Søg via linket senest torsdag den 17. september 2026
Vi forventer at holde samtaler onsdag den 23. september og torsdag den 24. september 2026.

Om Kultur-, Fritids- og Borgerserviceforvaltningen
I Kultur-, Fritids- og Borgerserviceforvaltningen arbejder vi hver dag for at skabe gode rammer for kultur- og fritidslivet i byen, og for at give københavnerne samt byens gæster en professionel og nærværende service. Fra biblioteker, kulturhuse og museer til idrætsfaciliteter, borgerservice og byens grønne rum – skaber vi rammer for fællesskaber, hvor københavnerne kan mødes og udfolde sig. Vores fælles mål er at gøre København til et godt sted at leve, mødes og engagere sig.

title: Subsystem Test Engineering Intern - Spring/Summer 2027
description:
Hermeus is a venture-backed defense aviation company reclaiming the lost art of rapid iterative prototyping to build the fastest aircraft in the world today. By prioritizing relentless hardware iteration, we deliver high-speed systems at the pace of the modern battlefield. We work with the Department of War to provide the high-speed capabilities our nation and its allies need to maintain a durable, asymmetric advantage.

About The Role:

As a Test Engineering Intern at Hermeus, you will play a pivotal role in developing, building, analyzing and operating test assets for our supersonic vehicles. This position offers a unique opportunity to work on groundbreaking technology in a fast-paced and collaborative environment. As part of this team, you will have the opportunity to work on a broad range of vehicle subsystems including hydraulic system, fuel system, mechanisms, high-voltage, mechanisms, airframe structural, and more!
Spring: Around 16 weeks (January - April)
Summer: Around 12 weeks (May - August)

Responsibilities:

  • Support the design, development, manufacturing, implementation, and maintenance of test assets, including test facilities, fixtures, rigs, and supporting hardware.
  • Design test fixtures, tooling, adapters, interfaces, panels, and other hardware used in test setups.
  • Assist in developing test plans, procedures, and protocols for vehicle subsystems and components.
  • Perform engineering analysis to help determine target test points, instrumentation requirements, and appropriate test safety margins.
  • Support test design reviews and collaborate with cross-functional engineering, manufacturing, and technician teams to ensure alignment on test requirements and execution.
  • Create CAD models, drawings, and manufacturing plans for test components, fixtures, and flight-like hardware as needed.
  • Work directly with manufacturing and build teams to track hardware progress, troubleshoot issues, and support test readiness.
  • Assist with the operation and troubleshooting of fluid, mechanical, and electrical test systems, including pumps, motors, heat exchangers, valves, regulators, accumulators, tubing, fittings, and high-voltage components.
  • Support test execution, data collection, and troubleshooting of test hardware and systems.
  • Maintain detailed documentation of test configurations, procedures, results, findings, and hardware changes.
  • Identify opportunities to improve testing processes, hardware, and infrastructure and contribute to the development of new testing methods and capabilities.

Requirements:

  • Practical experience designing, building, and testing vehicles through internships, studies or projects.
  • Must be currently enrolled in a STEM program at an accredited college or university (undergraduate student in your third or fourth year of study, or enrolled in a Master's or Ph.D. program).
  • Strong interest in testing.
  • Strong understanding of engineering first principles.
  • Demonstrated ability to work within cross-functional teams.
  • Enthusiasm for aviation and Hermeus's mission.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • GPA of 3.0 or above.

The hourly rate listed for this internship is intended as a general guideline. Final compensation will be determined based on degree level.

Benefits:

  • Time Off: Interns are eligible for 5 days of sick leave and unpaid time off.
  • Office Perks: Weekly paid office lunches and fully stocked breakrooms.
U.S. EXPORT CONTROL COMPLIANCE STATUS
The person hired will have access to information and items subject to U.S. export controls, and therefore, must either be a “U.S. person” as defined by 22 C.F.R. § 120.62 or otherwise eligible for deemed export licensing. US persons include U.S. citizens, U.S. nationals, lawful permanent residents (green card holders), and asylees and refugees with such status granted, not pending.
EQUAL OPPORTUNITY
Hermeus is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Employment decisions at Hermeus are based solely on merit, competence, and qualifications, without regard to race, color, religion, gender, national origin/ethnicity, veteran status, disability status, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, mental or physical disability, or any other legally protected status.

title: Guidance, Navigation & Control (GNC) Engineer - Rotorcraft/VTOL
description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

The Maneuver Dominance team, along with the Flight Engineering Team at Anduril develops operationally relevant, multi-asset autonomy. We are focused on making large groups of autonomous systems work effectively together. We leverage existing Anduril platforms like Ghost or Altius, in addition to bringing 3rd party platforms into Anduril’s Lattice ecosystem.

We are currently looking for highly skilled GNC Engineers with expertise in autonomous safety-critical systems. The successful candidate will play a pivotal role in developing, testing, and implementing GNC systems and architectures for air vehicle platforms developed by Anduril or a 3rd party.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

  • Develop, implement, and test algorithms for guidance, navigation, and control systems in line with project requirements.
  • Design, implement, and assess the GNC architectures considering all elements, including vehicle, sensors, actuators, and algorithms.
  • Participate in all phases of system development, from concept to design, prototyping, testing, and operation.
  • Collaborate closely with a multidisciplinary team including systems engineers, flight software engineers, mission autonomy engineers, and test engineers to ensure system-wide integration and performance.
  • Contribute to design reviews, safety assessments, and system documentation.
  • Use simulation and analysis tools to verify GNC models and system performance under different operating conditions.
  • Provide system engineering expertise in the development of GNC systems, ensuring a cohesive and efficient approach to the design and implementation process.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve issues related to GNC systems during design, testing, and operational phases.
  • Keep updated with the latest technologies and trends in GNC engineering and system architecture design.

You will work on vehicles like:
Omen
Thunder
And several others behind the scenes.


REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • BS in Robotics, Computer Science, Electrical, Mechanical, Mechatronics, Aerospace Engineering or related field with focus on dynamics and control
  • 2 or more years of experience in Guidance, Navigation & Control engineering or related technical experience
  • A strong theoretical knowledge of classical and modern control theory, estimation, and filtering techniques.
  • Exceptional understanding of flight dynamics (Vertical Take-off and Landing - VTOL and Conventional Take-off and Landing - CTOL)
  • Experience with developing GNC solutions for flight systems
  • Experience with developing, integrating, and troubleshooting tools for linear analysis of dynamic systems
  • Proficiency with GNC simulation tools like MATLAB, Simulink, and related toolboxes
  • Familiarization with 6-DOF simulations
  • Ability to travel up to 25%

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • A Ph.D. in Aerospace Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related field is a plus
  • Practical experience developing GNC designs for flight systems.
  • Extensive experience in GNC system and architecture development and testing, preferably in the aerospace industry.
  • Experience generating in C or C++ code from Simulink models.
  • Experience writing code in C/C++ or Rust
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making skills.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
  • Ability to work independently and in a team-oriented, collaborative environment.
  • Familiarity with agile and Lean product development methodologies such as Scrum.
  • Experience using Jira, Git, GitHub, or GitLab
  • Understanding of and compliance with industry, safety, and quality standards appropriate for the application
  • Passion for defending the United States and its allies
  • Eligible to obtain an active U.S. Secret security clearance
US Salary Range
$129,000—$220,000 USD

The salary range for this role is an estimate based on a wide range of compensation factors, inclusive of base salary only. Actual salary offer may vary based on (but not limited to) work experience, education and/or training, critical skills, and/or business considerations. Highly competitive equity grants are included in the majority of full time offers; and are considered part of Anduril's total compensation package. Additionally, Anduril offers top-tier benefits for full-time employees, including:

Benefits

At Anduril, we invest in our people. Our comprehensive, competitive benefits package (available at little to no cost to employees) ensures you’re supported in health, recovery, and whatever comes next. For more information, Explore Our Benefits.

Protecting Yourself from Recruitment Scams

Anduril is committed to maintaining the integrity of our Talent acquisition process and the security of our candidates. We've observed a rise in sophisticated phishing and fraudulent schemes where individuals impersonate Anduril representatives, luring job seekers with false interviews or job offers. These scammers often attempt to extract payment or sensitive personal information.

To ensure your safety and help you navigate your job search with confidence, please keep the following critical points in mind:

  • No Financial Requests: Anduril will never solicit payment or demand personal financial details (such as banking information, credit card numbers, or social security numbers) at any stage of our hiring process. Our legitimate recruitment is entirely free for candidates.

  • Please always verify communications:
    • Direct from Anduril: If you receive an email from one of our recruiters, it will only come from an @anduril.com address.
    • Via Agency Partner: If contacted by a recruiting agency for an Anduril role, their email will clearly identify their agency. If you suspect any suspicious activity, please verify the agency's authenticity by reaching out to contact@anduril.com.

  • Exercise Caution with Unsolicited Outreach: If you receive any communication that appears suspicious, contains grammatical errors, or makes unusual requests, do not engage. Always confirm the sender's email domain is @anduril.com before providing any personal information or clicking on links.

  • What to Do If You Suspect Fraud: Should you encounter any questionable or fraudulent outreach claiming to be from Anduril, please report it immediately to contact@anduril.com. Your proactive caution is invaluable in protecting your personal information and upholding the security and trustworthiness of our recruitment efforts.
