title: Blue Star Connect Outdoors Leader Consultant
description:
Independent Contractor : Blue Star Connect Outdoors Leader Consultant

Location: Oceanside, California (must reside within 25 miles of location)

Project Lead: Associate Director National Programs

Position Type: Independent Contractor, approximately 30 hours per month through December 2026

Hourly range: $30 per hour

About Blue Star Families

Blue Star Families (BSF) is a national nonprofit dedicated to supporting military families by providing programming and resources while strengthening their connections to their local communities. We partner with businesses, government agencies, and local organizations to create impactful programs that empower and uplift military families.

Independent Contractor Engagement Terms:

This independent contractor will be retained solely for project-based, outcome-driven services and will not be an employee, agent, or representative of Blue Star Families. The independent contractor:

  • Retains full autonomy over the method, schedule, and tools used to perform services.
  • Is not assigned work hours, or internal recurring meetings.
  • Shall not use a BSF job title, business card, or name tag.
  • Will not represent themselves as a BSF employee or agent to external stakeholders.

Project Based Scope of Work:

  • Plan and deliver independently organized, and regularly occurring outdoor recreation meetup opportunities for local families, with a target of one event per month, as seasonably appropriate.
  • Coordinate as needed with staff at local national park sites for outdoor recreation activities. The contractor retains discretion over communications and partnerships.
  • Track and submit outdoor recreation opportunities using provided planning documents for visibility and support, at the Contractor’s discretion and in a manner consistent with agreed-upon deliverables.
  • Track and log attendance for Blue Star Connect Outdoors activities, utilizing tools or methods selected by the contractor that meet the basic reporting needs.
  • Develop and implement ideas for highlighting outdoor meetup activities via social media and Blue Star Neighborhood (ex. providing photographs and stories from events, helpful resources to get outdoors, or sharing “best of” outdoor activities), with content and frequency determined by the Contractor in alignment with overall project goals.
  • Disseminate printed or digital promotional materials to local civilian and military-facing community bulletin boards and networks, at the Contractor’s discretion regarding timing and method of distribution
  • Identify and steward potential relationships with local parks and outdoor organizations to increase opportunities for engagement, exercising independent judgment in outreach and collaboration efforts.

Required Qualifications

  • Proven success in outdoor recreation and event coordination
  • Ability to effectively manage administrative responsibilities required for program execution, including scheduling, documentation, communication, reporting, and follow-up.
  • Strong familiarity with Google Suite, Canva, and Zoom
  • Experience in planning and executing events, including logistics and project management.
  • Demonstrated ability to build relationships with military families, local community members, and key stakeholders.

Deliverables & Payment Terms

All services shall be delivered in accordance with agreed deadlines and milestones. Payment structure to be outlined in a separate contract. BSF shall not direct how services are performed — only that deliverables meet agreed results.

title: Psykolog til fast stilling i Team 1, Psykiatrisk Afdeling Odense-Svendborg
description:
Vores gode kollega har fået job andet sted i huset og vi søger derfor en ny kollega i hendes sted i Team 1, Lokalpsykiatri Svendborg med opstart snarest muligt.

Om Team 1

Team 1 udreder og behandler patienter med personlighedsforstyrrelser, traumer og ADHD. Udredning foregår med bl.a. DIVA-5, SCID-5-PD, PSE og WAIS. Ved behov udredes også for autismespektrumsforstyrrelse. Behandlingen består af psykoedukation, psykoterapi og medicinsk behandling. Behandlingsforløbene er organiseret i overensstemmelse med sundhedsstyrelsens pakkeforløb. Teamet arbejder tværfagligt og består af overlæge, specialpsykolog, psykologer, sygeplejersker, ergoterapeut, fysioterapeut, SSA og sekretærer.

Dine opgaver i teamet vil være

  • Visitationssamtaler
  • Udredninger, herunder med PSE, SCID, DIVA, WAIS og andet ved behov
  • Støttende eller terapeutiske forløb individuelt eller i gruppe
  • Aktiv deltagelse i behandlingskonferencer og anden mødeaktivitet
  • Opgaverne og din funktion i teamet afhænger af dit uddannelses- og erfaringsniveau og vil blive tilpasset dette
Dine kompetencer

  • Det er ønskeligt, om du har uddannelse, erfaring og interesse for at arbejde med mennesker med, personlighedsforstyrrelser, ADHD og traumer
  • Det er ønskeligt, om du har uddannelse, erfaring og interesse for psykopatologisk udredning
  • Det er ønskeligt, om du har uddannelse, erfaring og interesse for psykoterapi
  • Du er tilpas med at arbejde selvstændigt og samtidig indgå i respektfuldt tværfagligt samarbejde
  • Vilje til at bidrage til at skabe et positivt og godt arbejdsmiljø
  • Fagligt engagement og vilje til fortsat faglig udvikling og forandring
  • Du er robust, fleksibel og god til at skabe tillid med troværdig adfærd
Vi tilbyder

  • Varierede arbejdsopgaver
  • Tværfagligt samarbejde på tværs af alle faggrupper
  • Fagligt og socialt fællesskab både i teamet og psykologgruppen
  • Supervision rettet mod autorisation eller specialist afhængigt af uddannelsesniveau
  • En del af universitetshospitalet med mange specialer og mulighed for vidensdeling på tværs af teams
Organisatorisk

Psykiatrisk Afdeling Odense-Svendborg er et stort hus i evig forandring med mange hjørner og afkroge af psykiatrien, som man som psykolog stifter bekendtskab med gennem psykologgruppen, som består af ca 55 psykologer fordelt i Odense og Svendborg og repræsenteret i de fleste teams og afsnit på de to matrikler. Psykologerne har en ledende psykolog som nærmeste leder, men er samtidigt placeret i teams og afsnit, hvor de følger den daglige drift, der er ledet af en funktionsleder og overlæge, som psykologerne refererer til i det daglige arbejde. I psykologgruppen tilstræber vi samarbejde gennem faglig åbenhed og nysgerrighed på tværs af matrikler, teams og afsnit.

Yderligere information hos

Ledende psykolog Maria Kristensen tlf. 23 64 54 27 (ift personaleforhold)
Specialpsykolog Guro Mikalsen tlf. 61 36 17 84 (ift klinisk arbejde i Team 1)

Løn- og ansættelsesforhold

I henhold til overenskomst mellem den faglige organisation og Danske Regioner – se: . Psykologers løn forhandles ud fra Akademikernes overenskomst 33.01.

Såfremt du ikke allerede er ansat i Region Syddanmark, vil der være en prøvetid på 3 måneder.

Afdelingen har en rygepolitik og rygning er ikke tilladt i arbejdstiden.

Ifm. ansættelse vil der blive indhentet straffeattest jf regionens personalepolitik.

Ansættelsessamtaler forventes afholdt 18/9 om formiddagen.

title: Stagiaire, développement de logiciel | Intern, Software Development
description:
Pourquoi joindre les rangs de Grass Valley?

Chez Grass Valley, nous donnons vie aux moments qui rassemblent le monde. Des plus grands événements sportifs en direct aux dernières nouvelles de l’actualité, en passant par les productions de divertissement haut de gamme, notre technologie et nos équipes sont au cœur des environnements médiatiques les plus exigeants de la planète.

Nous sommes l’Équipe GV : une équipe mondiale d’innovateurs, d’opérateurs, de bâtisseurs, de résolveurs de problèmes et d’agents du changement œuvrant dans les domaines de l’ingénierie, de la fabrication, de la chaîne d’approvisionnement, du succès client, des activités commerciales et des fonctions corporatives. Ensemble, nous façonnons l’avenir des technologies médiatiques.

Avec plus de 65 ans d’histoire, Grass Valley allie une expertise reconnue en matériel de haute performance à un écosystème infonuagique natif axé sur les logiciels en pleine expansion, grâce à l'Univers médiatique de Grass Valley (GVMU). Nous croyons que l’avenir ne repose pas sur un choix entre l’un ou l’autre, mais plutôt sur l’intégration intelligente de matériel conçu sur mesure et de plateformes logicielles modernes. Cette approche permet à nos clients de bénéficier de la flexibilité, de l’évolutivité et de la performance dont ils ont besoin pour réussir.

Notre culture repose sur cinq valeurs fondamentales : l'équipe avant tout, l’engagement envers nos clients, la volonté de gagner, grandir avec un but, et l’intégrité en tout temps. Nous visons l’excellence, assumons nos résultats et nous nous soutenons mutuellement afin d'avoir un impact à l’échelle mondiale.

Si vous souhaitez accomplir un travail porteur de sens, faire progresser votre carrière et contribuer à façonner l’avenir des médias, il y a une place pour vous chez Grass Valley. En rejoignant l’équipe GV, vous ne ferez pas simplement partie d’une entreprise : vous contribuerez à bâtir l’avenir.

Pour de plus informations, veuillez consulter notre site .


L’opportunité

Nous sommes ravis d’offrir un stage à temps plein au sein de notre département de Recherche et Développement pour l’hiver 2027, d’une durée de quatre (4) mois (Possibilité de prolongation).

Le ou la stagiaire rejoindra l’équipe SCRUM de GV Engine, qui développe, met à jour, documente et améliore les moteurs de traitement vidéo, audio et de données auxiliaires au cœur de plusieurs produits Grass Valley, notamment la plateforme GV AMPP. La collaboration avec les équipes de développement intégrant ces composants de base fera également partie intégrante du rôle.

Les services GV Engine sont développés en C++, il est donc essentiel de maîtriser le langage C++ et la programmation orientée objet. Une bonne compréhension du traitement audio et vidéo facilite le travail.

L’OS principal pour GVE est Linux, il est donc essentiel d’être confortable avec cet OS.

Le ou la stagiaire contribuera au développement des moteurs audio, vidéo, des microservices et assurera le maintien des tests automatisés garantissant la stabilité des fonctionnalités. Surtout, la volonté d’apprendre, de s’adapter et d’appliquer de nouvelles compétences est indispensable.

Votre rôle

  • Développer et maintenir des interfaces logicielles en collaboration avec l’assurance qualité au sein d’une équipe Scrum ;
  • Maintenir un haut niveau de qualité du produit et en garantir la stabilité ;
  • Assurer le support des utilisateurs internes et externes des composants livrés ;
  • Intégrer des tests automatisés utilisateur dans l’environnement de test Jenkins existant.

Votre personnalité et vos compétences

  • Inscrit dans un programme de stage et en cours d'obtention d'un baccalauréat en informatique, technologies de l’information ou en ingénierie ;
  • Expérience en développement logiciel sous Linux ;
  • Expérience de travail au sein d’une équipe de développement logiciel Agile SCRUM ;
  • Solides compétences en programmation orientée objet avec le langage moderne C++ ;
  • Familiarité avec les outils de codage basés sur l’IA ;
  • Capacité à écrire du code hautement performant ;
  • Expérience en dockerisation ;
  • Motivé(e) et passionné(e) par le développement logiciel de haute qualité ;
  • Expérience démontrée de travail en équipe ;
  • Capacité à travailler dans un environnement collaboratif multi-sites ;
  • Tout code démontrable renforce votre candidature : GitHub, SourceForge, TopCoder, HackerRank, contributions open source, etc ;
  • Maîtrise du français et de l’anglais, à l’oral comme à l’écrit ;
    • Une connaissance de l’anglais adaptée aux fonctions est requise, car le ou la titulaire devra collaborer avec des membres de l’équipe situés dans divers pays tels que les États-Unis, le Royaume-Uni et la Pologne.
  • Connaissance des technologies de diffusion et des médias, un atout ;
  • Connaissance des technologies de diffusion télévisuelle (SDTV, HDTV, RGB/YUV, espaces colorimétriques, entrelacé/progressif, VBI/VANC, AFD, etc.), un atout ;
  • Connaissance des codecs audio/vidéo, des conteneurs de fichiers et/ou des formats de diffusion en continu, un atout.

Vos Conditions de Travail

  • Une rémunération concurrentielle
  • Un environnement de travail accueillant et dynamique
  • Stage à temps plein (37.5 heures par semaine)
  • Cette description de poste a pour but de décrire la nature générale et le niveau du travail qu’implique cet emploi. Il ne s’agit pas d’une liste exhaustive de toutes les responsabilités, tâches et compétences requises pour celui-ci.
  • Grass Valley est un employeur qui adhère au principe de l’équité et prend ses décisions en matière d’emploi sans tenir compte du sexe, de l’état civil, de la race, de la religion, de la couleur, de l’âge, du handicap, de l’orientation sexuelle ou du statut de vétéran protégé.

Why Join Grass Valley?

At Grass Valley, we power the moments that bring the world together. From the biggest live sporting events to breaking news and premium entertainment, our technology and our people sit at the center of the most demanding media environments on the planet.

We are Team GV - a global team of innovators, operators, builders, problem-solvers, and change agents working across engineering, manufacturing, supply chain, customer success, commercial, and corporate functions. Together, we are leading the evolution of media technology.

With more than 65 years of heritage, Grass Valley combines deep expertise in high-performance hardware with a rapidly expanding software-defined, cloud-native ecosystem through the GV Media Universe (GVMU). We believe the future isn’t either/or - it’s the intelligent integration of purpose-built hardware and modern software platforms that gives our customers the flexibility, scalability, and performance they need to win.

Our culture is grounded in five core values: Team First - Customer Commitment - Play to Win - Grow with Purpose - Integrity Always. We set high standards, we own outcomes, and we support one another in delivering impact at global scale.

If you’re looking to do meaningful work, grow your career, and help shape the future of media - there’s a place for you at Grass Valley. At Team GV, you won’t just join a company, you’ll help build what’s next.

For more information, please visit .


The Opportunity

We are excited to offer a full-time internship in our Research & Development department for Winter 2027 lasting four (4) months (Possibility of extension).

The intern will join the GV Engine SCRUM team, which develops, updates, documents, and improves core video, audio, and ancillary data engines used in multiple Grass Valley products, including the GV AMPP platform. Collaboration with development teams integrating these base components is also a key part of the role.

The GV Engine services are written in C++, so strong C++ and object-oriented programming skills are essential. Understanding of audio and video processing helps.

Linux is our first environment for GVE so familiarity with it is an important requirement.

The intern will help develop audio, video engines, microservices and maintain automated tests to ensure feature stability. Most importantly, a willingness to learn, adapt, and apply new skills is essential.

Your Role

  • Develop and maintain software interfaces in collaboration with quality assurance within a Scrum team;
  • Maintain a high product quality standard and ensure its stability;
  • Support internal and external users of the delivered artifacts;
  • Integrate user automated tests in the existing Jenkins test environment.

Who you are

  • Enrolled in an internship program and currently working toward a bachelor's degree in computer science, information technology, or engineering;
  • Experience in Linux software development;
  • Work experience in an Agile SCRUM software development team;
  • Strong object-oriented programming skills with modern C++ language;
  • Familiarity with AI coding tools;
  • Ability to write highly performing code;
  • Dockerization experience;
  • Motivated and passionate about higher quality software development;
  • Proven teamwork experience;
  • Ability to work in a collaborative multi-site environment;
  • Any demonstrable code strengthens your application: GitHub, SourceForge, TopCoder, HackerRank, open-source contributions, etc;
  • Fluency in French and English, both oral and written;
    • Knowledge of English appropriate to the duties is required, as the incumbent is expected to work with team members in different countries such as the United States, the United Kingdom, and Poland.
  • Knowledge of broadcast and media technologies, an asset;
  • Knowledge of television broadcast (SDTV, HDTV, RGB/YUV, color spaces, interlaced/progressive, VBI/VANC, AFD, etc.), an asset;
  • Knowledge of A/V codecs and file containers and/or streaming formats, an asset.

Working Conditions

  • Competitive Compensation packages
  • Energizing and supportive work environment
  • Full-Time Internship (37.5 hours per week)

  • This job description is intended to describe the general nature and level of work involved for this job. It is not an exhaustive list of all responsibilities, duties and skills required of this job.
  • Grass Valley is an equal opportunity employer and makes employment decisions without regard to gender, marital status, race, religion, colour, age, disability, sexual orientation or protected veteran status.

title: Federal Fiscal Analyst (Fiscal Analyst 4)
description:
Description

Federal Fiscal Analyst (Fiscal Analyst 4)
At the Department of Commerce, we’re reimagining what’s possible in government. We’re builders, thinkers, and change-makers, working at the intersection of innovation, community, and impact. From unlocking critical funding to fueling inclusive economic growth, we’re turning big ideas into real-world solutions that uplift people and places.

Our agency’s strength lies in the diversity of our workforce and the breadth of the lived experiences and perspectives employees bring to the work. We believe equity is not just a value but a practice, which is reflected in how we design programs, engage communities, and deliver outcomes. We foster a workplace culture where curiosity is encouraged, bold thinking is welcomed, and collaboration drives our impact.

Behind every community that Commerce supports is a strong financial foundation that makes the work possible. The program Accounting Manager leads the people and systems that ensure compliance with both State and Federal requirements. This job is a commitment to strong internal controls, data accuracy and thoughtful leadership.

Let’s build what’s next, together.

The Financial Services Division (FSD) provides professional accounting, budget, contracting, and internal control services that support Commerce’s financial health and compliance objectives and ensures financial compliance with state and federal regulations and accurate financial reports for the Annual Comprehensive Financial Report (ACFR).

Reporting to the Federal Accounting Supervisor, this Federal Fiscal Analyst is provides professional journey level financial review and analysis of fiscal data in accordance with Generally Accepted Accounting Principles (GAAP), OFM Regulations including the State Administrative and Accounting Manual (SAAM), contract and grant terms and conditions, federal regulations ensuring compliance with Chapter 2 Part 200 of the Code of Federal Regulations (CFR), and agency fiscal policies and/or procedures. This position manages state and federal grants for assigned Commerce programs. These activities include grant management, ensuring the agency meets federal financial reporting requirements, preparing and/or completing federal funding reimbursement requests, and providing expertise and customer service to Commerce programs, employees and other governmental agencies and customers.

Duties

Performs financial report analysis and monitoring of grants.
Tasks include:
• Serves as a principal assistant specializing in Federal Grant accounting, management and reporting. Provides professional journey level financial review and analysis of fiscal data, specializing in Federal Grant Management for the agency.
• Establishes, integrates, analyzes and maintains accounting sub systems (subsidiary records) and methods. Reconciles or reviews the reconciliation of grants to AFRS General Ledger Accounts monthly. Maintains tracking systems and records, corrects discrepancies and resolves differences. Ensures that exceptions and un-balanced items are cleared on an on-going basis and appropriate regulations are followed.
• Initiates, develops, and monitors fiscal and federal management reports as required for effective accounting and management practice. These include both reports that are required for federal grantor agencies and required internally to manage state and federal appropriations.
• Prepares and monitors federal and local expenditures and revenue. Assists in reviewing federal grant agreements, requests for draws, advance payments, federal receivables and quarterly federal reports. Ensure that federal draws are done accurately and timely to support the cost recovery.
• Initiates assigned financial status reports and federal cash transaction reports as required according to specific federal grant terms and regulations.
• Tracks, monitors, evaluates, analyzes and resolves issues with overall assigned program award balances, revenue and expenditure analysis and reconciliation.
• Reviews, analyzes, verifies and corrects the accounting data into the Agency Financial Reporting System (AFRS).
• Analyzes grants to ensure compliance with terms and conditions stated in these agreements, noting special draw billing requirements, special budget/expenditure tracking, and ensures compliance with standard accounting procedures.
• Performs fiscal grant payable and receivable reconciliations. This includes, reviewing federal awarding agency due to and from balances and ensuring, accuracy per the federal program.
• Provides information and support for federal single audit.
• Complete federal reconciliations on a monthly basis. Complete corrections as needed.
• Prepare and initiate federal wires through the State Treasurer’s Office.

Provides fiscal technical assistance and consultation to program staff.
Tasks include:
• Provides fiscal technical support and training to co-workers, and program staff on fiscal related activity and financial reporting systems.
• Act as the backup to other Federal Fiscal Analysts.
• Assists with the development and analysis of financial and accounting systems, accounting procedures, tool development, and any Lean activities to help streamline Commerce, save resources and assist the public more efficiently.

Provides guidance and expertise regarding the Office of Management and Budget (OMB) Uniform Guidance for federal award administration
Tasks include:
• Maintains current knowledge and understanding of the Office of Management and Budget (OMB) Uniform Guidance on Administrative Requirements, Cost Principles and Audit Requirements for Federal Awards.
• Maintains current knowledge and understanding of assigned federal award requirements.
• Implement Uniform Guidance as necessary to administer federal awards.

Performs state fiscal year and federal fiscal year closing activities.
Tasks include:
• Prepares fiscal year end closing adjustments and accrual journal vouchers for contract, grant payables and revenue.
• Assists other staff in determining the type of correction needed on contracts and/or grants. Assists staff with the reconciliation of federal expenditures with federal revenue and prepares adjusting entries to ensure these net to zero or provide valid footnotes as required by OFM.
• Uses Contract Management System (CMS), AFRS, ER, WebI and Excel to accurately record financial data on the ACFR financial statements.
• Consults with program and divisional staff and provides fiscal technical assistance on assigned grants.

Other duties as assigned
Tasks include:
• Participates in the AFRS table maintenance.
• We value teamwork and strive for workload balance. Duties are assigned/reassigned temporarily and/or permanently to accomplish overall goals and/or to assist the Unit, Accounting Office or the agency accomplish business needs.
• Other duties as assigned.

Qualifications

Required Qualifications:
Seven (7) years of combined experience and/or education as described below:
Education involves accounting, accounting principles, finance, auditing or budgeting from an accredited institution or related field.

Experience must include the following areas or work related to the position:
• Experience with Generally Accepted Accounting Principles (GAAP)
• Excellent written and oral communication skills
• Demonstrated ability to provide excellent customer service and maintain confidentiality
• Demonstrated experience in process improvement and problem solving
• Demonstrated detail-oriented and analytical thinking
• Demonstrated creative, collaborative and trustworthy behavior
• Demonstrated ability to consistently follow applicable financial rules, regulations, and standards
• Intermediate skill level in the Microsoft Office suite of products including Excel, Word, and Outlook

Qualifying education post High School or equivalent may be substituted year for year for experience.

Education to Experience Equivalences:
Associate degree = 2 years | bachelor’s degree = 4 years | Masters or Higher = 5 years

Examples of how to qualify:
• 6 years of experience and one year of education
• 5 years of experience and two years of education
• 4 years of experience and three years of education
• 3 years of experience and four years of education
• 2 years of experience and five years of education
• 1 year of experience and six years of education

And:
• Intermediate skill level in Microsoft Excel and Word.

Preferred/Desired Qualifications:
• A bachelor’s degree from and accredited institution which includes 18 quarter or 12 semester hours in accounting, auditing or budgeting
• Two years of experience with governmental accounting and Washington state financial systems
• Experience using State and federal policies and laws including the State Administrative and Accounting Manual (SAAM)
• Knowledge of accounting theories and practices, such as internal controls, separation of duties, and cash handling
• Demonstrated knowledge of federal programs, grants, and 2 CFR Part 200 requirements
• One year professional experience working with federal awards
• Knowledge of Chapter 2 Part 200 of the Code of Federal Regulations
• Experience reconciling general ledgers to subsidiary accounts and preparing corrections

Required Position Competencies:
• Federal Award and General Ledger Accounting Expertise: Monitors high-volume of federal awards, ensuring accuracy, timeliness, and adherence to policies and regulations. Applies GAAP, SAAM, principles to complex reconciliations, interpreting GAAP, SAAM, PEBB rules, WAC and RCW to ensure accurate accounting and regulatory compliance.
• Problem Solving & Process Improvement: Resolves complex accounting and federal award issues, identifies root causes, implements corrective actions, and presents ideas to streamline workflows for efficiency and accuracy.
• Accurate & Timely Work Completion: Makes sure responsibilities central to the role meet all requirements and expectations. Finishes tasks promptly and critically reviews work to ensure quality and accuracy. Considers impact of work to others and takes steps to mitigate.
• Change Management & Collaboration: Adapts to change and research regulatory updates as required. Collaborates with internal customers to implement change in the most effective and efficient manner.
• Time Management and Prioritization: Allocates time and attention based on what is most important to achieve key goals and objectives. Effectively organizes and balances tasks and priorities to keep multiple projects on track.

To be considered for this position the following are needed:
  • A complete and detailed online application.
  • A cover letter (enter online).
  • At least three professional references (enter online).
For questions about this recruitment, please contact our recruitment team via email: comrecruitment@commerce.wa.gov - please reference the job number in your message.

Supplemental Information

Work from Anywhere in Washington State
This position may be located anywhere within Washington State though occasional travel to a Commerce office building or in-state travel to attend events or meetings may be required. If selected, you will need to travel to pick up equipment and receive instruction. Many Commerce employees work remotely or have a hybrid schedule.
This recruitment may be used to fill future vacancies over the next 60 days.

Technical support is provided by NEOGOV, 855-524-5627 (can't log in, password or email issues, error messages). DES job seeker support may answer general questions regarding the recruiting system at careershelp@des.wa.gov.

Our Commitment to Equal Opportunity
The Washington State Department of Commerce is an equal opportunity employer. We strive to create a working environment that includes and respects cultural, racial, ethnic, sexual orientation and gender identity diversity. Women, racial and ethnic minorities, persons of disability, persons over 40 years of age, veterans or people with military status, and people of all sexual orientations and gender identities are encouraged to apply. title: GTM Systems Architect
location: San Francisco, CA • New York, NY • United States
description:
Figma is growing our team of passionate creatives and builders on a mission to make design accessible to all. Figma’s platform helps teams bring ideas to life—whether you're brainstorming, creating a prototype, translating designs into code, or iterating with AI. From idea to product, Figma empowers teams to streamline workflows, move faster, and work together in real time from anywhere in the world. If you're excited to shape the future of design and collaboration, join us!

The GTM Systems Architect is responsible for optimizing, scaling, and governing Salesforce to support various cross functional teams. This role combines business analysis, systems expertise, data stewardship, and cross-functional partnership to drive operational excellence across Sales, Customer Experience, Marketing, Legal, Product and Finance.

This individual operates independently, understands complex initiatives end-to-end, and serves as a trusted advisor to business stakeholders on CRM automation, reporting, and process design.

This is a full time role that can be held from one of our US hubs or remotely in the United States.

What you'll do at Figma:

  • Serve as a subject matter expert for Salesforce-related operational and process inquiries from the partnership team and other cross-functional partners
  • Respond to and triage complex process questions, identifying root causes and recommending scalable solutions rather than one-off fixes
  • Partner with stakeholders to refine and evolve workflows based on business needs
  • Drive and coordinate User Acceptance Testing (UAT) for Salesforce enhancements, releases, and system changes
  • Validate that implemented solutions meet functional requirements and business objectives prior to release
  • Focus primarily on maintaining the Salesforce Partner Ecosystem (Experience Cloud), sitting at the intersection of GTM Systems and Partnerships
  • Build and maintain scalable processes for partner onboarding, engagement tracking, and revenue attribution
  • Drive Salesforce adoption and optimize the user experience while maintaining documentation of how our systems are configured

We'd love to hear from you if you have:

  • 7+ years of experience as a Salesforce Systems Administrator with Salesforce Partner Ecosystem Management, including experience supporting Sales or Revenue organizations
  • Deep understanding of the Salesforce platform and how it can integrate with other tools, along with the ability to build custom apps and objects, formula fields, flows, custom views, and other content of intermediate complexity
  • Outstanding ability to maintain Salesforce documentation and communicate at all levels of the organization
  • Strong data management abilities, including working knowledge of SQL/SOQL, and a strong understanding of the core Salesforce data model, along with advanced reporting and dashboard development experience

While it's not required, it's an added plus if you also have:

  • Familiarity with a SaaS Go-To-Market business model
  • Previous experience working in a SCRUM or agile environment

title: Studentermedhjælper til bæredygtighed i byggeriet og energiledelse - DTU Campus Service
description:
Har du interesse for bæredygtighed, energioptimering og udvikling af værktøjer, der gør en reel forskel i bygge- og driftsprojekter? Vil du være en del af en enhed, hvor vi arbejder både strategisk og operationelt med den grønne omstilling?

Så er denne stilling måske noget for dig.

CAS Bæredygtighed søger en engageret studentermedhjælper til arbejdet med bæredygtighed i byggeri og anlæg samt energiledelse på DTU’s campusser.

Dine opgaver og ansvarsområde
Du kommer til at arbejde tæt sammen med kolleger inden for både byggeprojekter og energiledelse. Vi forestiller os, at du vil have lyst til at tage del i forskellige typer opgaver afhængig af din motivation og erfaring. Dine opgaver vil bl.a. være at:
  • Assistere med at udvikle værktøjer, retningslinjer og lignende til at understøtte vores strategiske arbejde med bæredygtighed i byggeprojekter, f.eks. en LCA-retningslinje
  • Udføre simple LCA- og klimavurderinger, f.eks. baseret på EPD’er
  • Understøtte dokumentation og dataindsamling til vores ISO50001-certificerede energiledelsessystem samt arbejdet med at kvantificere bæredygtighed i byggeriet
  • Strukturere nøgledata og bidrage til at udpege mulige energioptimeringer
  • Koordinere erfaringsindsamling og driftsdata
  • Opbygge og vedligeholde temasider på SharePoint om energiledelse og bæredygtighed i byggeriet
  • Hjælpe med planlægning af faglige oplæg og øvrige tværgående aktiviteter i DTU Campus Service

Hvem er du?
Hvis du synes ovenstående lyder spændende, og samtidig kan genkende dig selv i flere af nedenstående punkter, er du måske den rette kandidat. Du er i gang med en relevant uddannelse, der understøtter følgende:
  • Vi forestiller os, at du har mindst et år tilbage af dit studie og læser en relevant uddannelse (f.eks. ingeniør, miljøteknologi, energiplanlægning eller lignede)
  • Du har kendskab til LCA, EPD’er og energiberegninger
  • Du er struktureret og analytisk
  • Du har mod på at tage ansvar for selvstændige opgaver (selvfølgelig med sparring)
  • Du trives med at løse opgaver i tæt samarbejde med dine kolleger i og uden for sektionen – og du er imødekommende og bidrager med en god energi
  • Du har lyst til at lære om det komplekse arbejde med forandring i en stor organisation
  • Du motiveres af at gøre en forskel og at komme med ideer

Hvad tilbyder vi dig
Du bliver en del af en lille sektion der arbejder med bæredygtighed på DTU’s campusser på mange forskellige områder, herunder bæredygtighed i byggeriet og systematisk energiledelse. Vi arbejder med bæredygtighed på flere niveauer – fra strategisk udvikling og systemopbygning til den praktiske håndtering af inventar og materialer, og vi har store drømme for fremtiden.

Vi er som sektion lyttende, reflekterende og sociale. Vi er værdidrevne mennesker med forskellige baggrunde, aldre og køn, og vi er forbundet af, at vi gerne vil udfordre status quo.

Du kan se frem til at få en udfordrende og udviklende arbejdsplads med høj faglighed. Vi sørger selvfølgelig for, at du samtidig får den nødvendige sparring og kompetenceudvikling.

Løn og ansættelsesvilkår
Løn- og ansættelsesvilkår i henhold til OAO-S-fællesoverenskomsten og organisationsaftale for kontorfunktionærer m.fl. §35 (HK/Stat).

Arbejdstiden er gennemsnitligt 10 timer om ugen og kan tilrettelægges fleksibelt ift. ferier, eksaminer mv. Stillingen ønskes besat pr. 1. november 2026 eller snarest derefter. Ansættelsen løber, så længe du er aktiv studerende.

Arbejdssted er DTU Lyngby Campus.

Ansøgning og kontakt
Vi skal modtage din online ansøgning senest den 18. september 2026. Åbn linket "Ansøg nu", hvor du udfylder ansøgningsformularen samt vedhæfter din motiverede ansøgning, CV og dokumentation for studieaktivitet. I ansøgningen vil vi gerne høre lidt om dig, dine kompetencer og hvorfor du søger stillingen.

Ønsker du flere oplysninger om stillingen, er du velkommen til at kontakte udviklingskonsulent indenfor bæredygtighed i byggeriet Nanna Overgård på nabl@dtu.dk, projektleder for energiledelse Rikke Andersen på rhoan@dtu.dk eller sektionsleder Lotte Klinte på 2061 9249. Læs mere om Campus Service (CAS).

Vi afholder 1. samtale den 25. og 28. september 2026. 2. samtale afholdes den 1. oktober 2026.

Ansøgninger modtaget efter ansøgningsfristens udløb tages ikke i betragtning.

Alle interesserede uanset alder, køn, handicap, race, religion eller etnisk tilhørsforhold, opfordres til at søge stillingen. Da DTU arbejder med forskning i kritisk teknologi, hvormed der gælder særlige regler for blandt andet sikkerhed og eksportkontrol, kan der blive foretage open source-baggrundstjek af kvalificerede kandidater til stillingen.

Campus Service – Sammen skaber vi campusser i verdensklasse
DTU’s Campus Service skaber fysiske rum og inspirerende miljøer, hvor idéer kan gro, forskning kan blomstre, og studerende kan udvikle nye måder at ændre verden på. Med ca. 200 ansatte fungerer Campus Service som koncernstab for DTU. I Campus Service samarbejder vi som én enhed med en bred vifte af kompetencer. Vi er eksperter på hver vores område lige fra byggeri, forsyninger, arbejdsmiljø og beredskab til beplantning, belysning og bæredygtighed. Vi har et stærkt fællesskab, hvor faglige og personlige forskelligheder ses som en styrke, og hvor alle bidrager til at løfte DTU. Sammen med resten af DTU finder vi frem til de bedste løsninger – til gavn for samfundet.

DTU – Til gavn for samfundet siden 1829
DTU er et af Europas førende tekniske eliteuniversiteter. Med forskning og uddannelser i international topklasse skaber vi løsninger på tidens store samfundsmæssige udfordringer og bidrager til at sikre Europas globale førerposition inden for bæredygtig teknologiudvikling. Siden H.C. Ørsted grundlagde DTU for snart 200 år siden, har vores mission været den samme: Vi udvikler og nyttiggør naturvidenskab og teknisk videnskab til gavn for samfundet. DTU har 13.800 studerende, 1.600 ph.d.-studerende og 6.500 ansatte. Vi arbejder i et internationalt miljø og har en inkluderende, udviklende og uformel arbejdskultur. DTU har campusser i hele Danmark og i Grønland og samarbejder med de bedste universiteter verden over.

title: Senior Recruiting Coordinator
description:
Please Note: To conform with the United States Government Space Technology Export Regulations, the applicant must be a U.S. citizen, lawful permanent resident of the U.S., conditional resident, asylee or refugee (protected individuals as defined by 8 U.S.C. 1324b(a)(3)), or eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State.

At CesiumAstro, we are developers and pioneers of out-of-the-box communication systems for satellites, UAVs, launch vehicles, and other space and airborne platforms. We take pride in our dynamic and cross-functional work environment, which allows us to learn, develop, and engage across our organization. If you are looking for hands-on, interactive, and autonomous work, CesiumAstro is the place for you. We are actively seeking passionate, collaborative, energetic, and forward-thinking individuals to join our team.

In this position, you will play a critical role in creating a thoughtful, organized, and high-quality recruiting experience from the first candidate interaction through the interview process. You will partner closely with our Talent Acquisition team to coordinate interviews, manage candidate communications and logistics, and keep the hiring process moving.

Our Senior Recruiting Coordinators play an important role in shaping how candidates experience CesiumAstro. For many candidates, you will be one of their first interactions with the company and one of the first faces they meet onsite. How we communicate, how prepared we are, and how we show up throughout the process matters. We are looking for someone who takes ownership of those details and represents our culture with professionalism, urgency, and care.

This is a fast moving role that requires exceptional organization, attention to detail, and strong communication. The ideal candidate is a true team player who can quickly understand business needs, stay ahead of competing priorities, and take pride in delivering a high quality experience for candidates and internal teams alike

JOB DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Coordinate and schedule interviews between candidates and CesiumAstro staff, ensuring a positive experience for all parties.
  • Manage job postings on various platforms, including the company website and external job boards. This will include drafting job postings and other recruitment-related materials as well as posting and maintaining job listings on state job boards in alignment with Affirmative Action (AA) and compliance guidelines.
  • Maintain and update the applicant tracking system (ATS) with candidate information and status updates.
  • Communicate with candidates throughout the recruitment process, providing timely updates.
  • Support the onboarding process by conducting pre-employment background checks, drug screens, and coordinating start dates.
  • Pull reports on recruitment metrics through our ATS, Lever.
  • Collaborate with the recruitment team on candidate experience.

JOB REQUIREMENTS AND MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS

  • Associate's degree or equivalent relevant experience.
  • Minimum of 5 years of experience in recruiting or related business administration.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Word, Excel, PowerPoint, etc., and familiarity with ATS systems (Lever preferred).
  • Ability to multitask and prioritize in a fast-paced environment.
  • A positive attitude, team-oriented, and a passion for recruitment.
  • Excellent organizational skills and attention to detail.
  • Exceptional written and verbal communication skills.
  • A high level of integrity and respect for confidentiality.

PREFERRED EXPERIENCE

  • Passion for the space industry.
  • Experience working in a start-up or small company.
  • Experience at high-tech companies.
CesiumAstro considers several factors when extending an offer, including but not limited to, the role and associated responsibilities, a candidate’s work experience, education/training, and key skills. Full-time employment offers include company stock options and a generous benefits package including health, dental, vision, HSA, FSA, life, disability and retirement plans.
CesiumAstro is an Equal Opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability, protected Veteran Status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local law.

Please note: CesiumAstro does not accept unsolicited resumes from contract agencies or search firms. Any unsolicited resumes submitted to our website or to CesiumAstro team members will be considered property of CesiumAstro, and we will not be obligated to pay any referral fees.

title: Handicaphjælper søges af 61-årig kvinde med ALS, bosiddende i Haderslev. Der er tale om en fast stilling på 31 timer i gennemsnit pr. uge, fordelt på minimum 5 døgnvagter pr måned, plus nogle kortere dagvagter.
description:
Jeg søger en handicaphjælper, som skal indgå i et team af kompetente og engagerede kollegaer.

Om mig

Jeg fik diagnosen ALS i december 2014 og har stærkt nedsat muskelkraft i både arme og ben og sidder permanent i el-kørestol. Jeg har meget sparsom tale, men mine kognitive evner er ikke påvirket af min diagnose.

Min mand og jeg bor i eget hus i Haderslev, hvor der er installeret loftlift i soveværelset samt på badeværelset.

To gange om ugen har jeg fysioterapi, hvor der kommer en fysioterapeut hjem til mig.

Om stillingen:

Der er tale om en fast stilling med minimum 5 døgnvagter pr måned (klokken 8:30-8:30), samt nogle kortere dagvagter (klokken 8:30-15:00). Desuden vil du skulle træde til i forbindelse med ferie og sygdom.

Du skal således være indstillet på, at der både er nogle døgnvagter samt nogle kortere dagvagter.

Jobbet består af personlig pleje, praktiske opgaver i hjemmet samt af og til ledsagelse ud af hjemmet i handicapbil.

Der vil være oplæring inden jobstart.

Om dig

Du skal have en positiv indstilling og have stor tålmodighed og empati. Det vil være en fordel, hvis du har erfaring fra lignende job. Selvom der ikke er en masse løft i forbindelse med jobbet, anbefales det, at du har en god fysik.

Derudover forventer jeg, at du er mødestabil, ikke-ryger (da jeg ikke kan tåle røg), fleksibel og har respekt for at arbejde i et privat hjem. Samt at du har et gyldigt kørekort.

Du skal desuden kunne tale og forstå dansk, da jeg har en øjenstyret computer, som jeg bruger til at kommunikere med.

Ansættelsesvilkår og løn

Det er LOBPA, som er arbejdsgiver og står for selve ansættelsen. Aflønning sker efter BPA-hjælperoverenskomsten.

Skriv til:

Hvis du har lyst til at søge stillingen, skal du sende en mail med din ansøgning, dit cv, eventuelle anbefalinger og gerne et foto til: elsebet.kjaergaard@gmail.com

Jeg ser frem til at modtage din ansøgning. Der vil løbende blive afholdt samtaler. Hvis du ikke har hørt fra mig senest en måned efter, du har sendt din ansøgning, kan du betragte stillingen som besat til anden side.

Tiltrædelse hurtigst muligt.

title: Application Security Engineer
description:
Who is Sonar?

Sonar is driving the future of agent-centric software development. As the leader in AI code review and verification, we solve a critical problem: ensuring that software generated by AI-assisted developers or autonomous agents is reliable, secure, and maintainable.

Integrating seamlessly with Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, GitHub Copilot, Gemini, and Devin, we help over 75% of the Fortune 100 build trusted, reliable, compliant software. Customers who use Sonar are 44% less likely to report an outage due to AI-generated code.

We believe code verification is the critical missing link in the Agent-Centric Development Cycle (AC/DC). Industry giants like Nvidia, ServiceNow, Booking.com, Goldman Sachs, AstraZeneca, and Ford Motor Company.count on us to provide independent, explainable, consistent review and governance of their AI-generated code via products like:

  • SonarQube: The world’s leading AI code review and verification platform.

  • SonarQube Foundation Agent: Currently topping the leaderboards for agentic software repair.

  • SonarSweep & Sonar Context Augmentation: Providing the enterprise-grade context and constraints agents need to be truly effective.

Our team operates across global hubs in Austin, Bochum, Dubai, Geneva, London, Singapore, Tokyo, and Washington D.C. We move with a mindset we call CODE:

  • Committed to our customers and community.

  • Obsessed with quality.

  • Deliberate in our decisions.

  • Effective as one team.

With over $400M in revenue and profitable, fast-paced growth, we are building the backbone of the AI software revolution. If you’re hungry to have an impact, want to build at a fast pace, and ready to work at the forefront of AI, we want to hear from you.

Position description

The primary goal of the Information Security team is to earn deep trust with our rapidly growing customer base by relentlessly safeguarding Sonar products and the supporting cloud platforms, while consistently demonstrating that Sonar meets demanding, industry‑leading security standards.


You will champion security by design, partnering with product, platform, and infrastructure engineering teams so that our products and cloud platforms are imagined, built, and operated to Sonar’s high security bar.

What you will do

  • Shape secure products and cloud architecture

    • Partner with product and engineering teams from the earliest design stages to build secure, resilient solutions by design.

    • Review product architectures and AWS environments, ensuring security requirements meaningfully inform technical decisions and final designs.

      • Lead security assurance and improvement

      • Deliver high-impact initiatives from the strategic security plan, from evaluating new approaches to deploying modern security tools and capabilities across the organization.

      • Plan and manage independent security assessments, penetration tests, and red-team exercises; translate findings into practical improvements and customer-facing trust artifacts.

      • Investigate complex product and internal security findings, identify root causes, and help teams implement durable remediation.

        • Strengthen customer trust and incident readiness

        • Lead the investigation and resolution of customer security concerns with rigor and empathy, using each engagement to reinforce confidence in our security program.

        • Serve as a security subject-matter expert during incidents, helping teams understand, contain, and learn from emerging threats. Occasional on-call participation may be required.

          • Anticipate threats and scale the security program

          • Monitor and interpret threat intelligence, turning changes in the threat landscape into prioritized risks and actionable recommendations.

          • Continuously improve and automate security processes, increasing the quality, speed, and visibility of information that informs the security strategy.

Experience and qualifications

Secure product and cloud architecture

  • Extensive experience with application and cloud architectures, predominantly AWS, and a strong interest in how modern cloud patterns can strengthen or weaken security.

  • Extensive experience conducting application security assessments, including code review and evaluation of authentication and authorization designs.

  • Experience assessing and securing AI and agentic AI capabilities, with the curiosity to experiment, learn, and help define emerging best practices.

  • Experience applying threat-modeling approaches, such as STRIDE, to improve design discussions and identify risks early.

    • Security assurance and remediation

    • Experience with penetration testing, red-team engagements, and bug-bounty programs, with an attacker mindset focused on protecting what matters most.

    • Experience investigating and managing vulnerabilities, from triage and prioritization through to remediation and organizational learning.

      • Threat awareness and security automation

      • Practical experience using AI to automate repeatable security work, along with enthusiasm for building small tools and experiments that make security teams faster and more effective.

      • Familiarity with Azure, GCP, and Google Workspace is a plus, as is the appetite to learn new platforms and ecosystems as Sonar evolves.

Additional comments

This role is based in Austin, TX. We are unable to consider candidates unwilling to be in Austin, but we are willing to relocate the right candidate.

Benefits

  • Flexible comprehensive employee benefit package.
  • We encourage usage of our robust time-off allocations. You will receive 23 days of PTO per calendar year (on a pro-rated basis depending on your employment start date), with additional time provided for sickness, life events and holidays.
  • We offer an exciting 401(k) plan that has a 4% match.
  • Generous discretionary Company Growth Bonus, paid annually.
  • Fully paid parking in the heart of downtown Austin, Texas.
  • Global workforce with employees in 20+ countries representing 35+ unique nationalities.
  • We have an annual kick-off somewhere in the world where we meet to build relationships and goals for the company.
  • Monthly catered events, and team events.

We value diversity, equity, and inclusion

At Sonar, we believe that our diversity is our strength. We are a global company that values and respects different backgrounds, perspectives, and cultures. We are committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive work environment where everyone feels valued and empowered to contribute their best. We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer and welcome all qualified applicants, regardless of race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, or veteran status.

If you need any accommodation, please reach out to us at hiring@sonarsource.com.

All offers of employment at Sonar are contingent upon the results of a comprehensive background check and reference verification conducted before the start date.

Applications that are submitted through agencies or third party recruiters will not be considered.

title: Product Loader

title: AI & Business Intelligence Program Manager
description:
AI & Business Intelligence Program Manager I Tripadvisor

About Tripadvisor

The Tripadvisor Group connects people to experiences worth sharing, and aims to be the world’s most trusted source for travel and experiences. We leverage our brands, technology, and capabilities to connect our global audience with partners through rich content, travel guidance, and two-sided marketplaces for experiences, accommodations, restaurants, and other travel categories. The subsidiaries of Tripadvisor, Inc. (Nasdaq: TRIP), include a portfolio of travel brands and businesses, including Tripadvisor, Viator, and TheFork.

The AI & Business Intelligence Program Manager leads the end-to-end execution of data strategy and AI initiatives across Tripadvisor’s Travel Experiences. Positioning yourself at the intersection of business intelligence, product, and customer operations, you will translate complex machine learning models, predictive traveler trends, and generative AI features into tangible operational strategy. You will maintain program momentum, unblock technical and cross-functional teams, and regularly deliver high-level BI and performance updates to executive leadership.

Job Location: Hybrid

This role is a hybrid position that requires 2/3 days per week in our London Office.

Key Responsibilities

  • Drive Executive & Business Updates: Establish clear reporting cadences for leadership, translating AI model performance, traveler engagement trends, and BI dashboard metrics into executive-ready status updates.

  • Orchestrate AI & BI Roadmaps: Direct complex, cross-functional programs spanning Data Engineering, AI/ML, Product, and Traveler CX teams to ensure business intelligence initiatives land on time.

  • Deliver Operational Momentum: Maintain project management rigor across data pipelines, predictive search features, dynamic pricing models, and AI support systems—tracking milestones and holding dependencies accountable.

  • Translate Data into Strategy: Partner with CX and Product leadership to convert traveler behavior data and BI reporting into actionable operational changes that reduce friction across the booking and trip lifecycle.

  • Unblock Technical & Organizational Friction: Proactively identify bottlenecks in data availability, BI tool integrations, or cross-team alignment, delivering clear resolution paths before project schedules slip.

Qualifications

  • Experience: 4–6 years of program management experience leading technical AI, business intelligence, or data strategy initiatives.

  • BI & AI Competency: Strong command of business intelligence frameworks, visualization tools (e.g., Looker, Tableau), SQL, and practical understanding of AI/ML lifecycles (including Generative AI and predictive modeling).

  • Cross-Functional Leadership: Proven ability to manage complex technical roadmaps involving data engineers, data scientists, product managers, and business stakeholders.

  • Executive Communication: Exceptional talent for synthesizing data-heavy technical concepts into compelling, structured updates for non-technical executives.

  • Domain Empathy: Deep interest in online travel, marketplace dynamics, and traveler journey optimization.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Background in travel tech, e-commerce marketplaces, or consumer-facing digital platforms.

  • Certifications in program management (PMP, CSM) or advanced credentials in Business Intelligence / Data Strategy.

What We Offer

  • Competitive compensation packages (routinely benchmarked against the latest industry data), including base salary and annual bonuses
  • “Work your way” with flexibility to suit your lifestyle. Tripadvisor Group takes a remote-friendly approach to collaboration across a worldwide team, with the option to join on-site as often as you’d like or as required by your team.
  • Flexible schedule. Work-life balance is ingrained in our culture by design. Trust and accountability make it work.
  • Donation matching. Give back? Give more! We match qualifying charitable donations annually.
  • Tuition assistance. Want to level up your career? We love to hear it! Receive annual support for qualified programs.
  • Lifestyle benefit. An annual benefit to spend on yourself. Use it on travel, wellness, or whatever suits you.
  • Travel perks. We believe that travel is employee development, so we provide discounts and more.
  • Employee assistance program. We’re here for you with resources and programs to help you through life’s challenges.
  • Health benefits. We offer great coverage and competitive premiums.
  • Generous referral scheme. Help us grow and be rewarded with generous awards for referring successful candidates.

Our Cultural Pillars:

Traveler first

We exist to create value for our customer, the traveler. We enable our suppliers and partners to unlock this value. Their collective behaviors and insights are what drives us.

Execution is our edge

We act fast, experiment, learn from failure, iterate, and improve the solutions of tomorrow across every aspect of our business. Our execution is agile, data-driven, prioritised, and built to scale. We assume no problem is someone else’s problem and finish what can be done today, knowing tomorrow will bring fresh challenges.

We succeed together

The best outcomes are driven by empathic, humble, and diverse subject matter experts working toward shared goals. We collaborate relentlessly, challenge assumptions, give actionable feedback, and set each other up for success through empowered teams with a clear charter. We transparently take ownership of our growth, individually and as a team. We celebrate the quality of our effort, our learnings, and our collective achievements.

We strive to create an accessible and inclusive experience for all candidates. If you need a reasonable accommodation during the application or the recruiting process, please make sure to reach out to your individual recruiter or our team at AccessibleRecruiting@tripadvisor.com.

If you have any additional questions about careers at Tripadvisor you can email us at recruitment@tripadvisor.com. We have all the answers!

title: Senior Product Manager, Money
description:
What the Role Is

Babylist Money is a new line of business built on a simple insight: the families Babylist serves don't stop needing guidance after the registry is done. Early Investor — the team's first shipped product — gives parents a way to connect a college savings account to a child’s Babylist fund for loved ones to contribute directly. It launched in July 2026 and now the focus is growing it. This PM will own the Early Investor product experience — defining the monetization strategy, driving top-of-funnel growth, and building the sticky product hooks that bring families back to Babylist long after the baby shower. The role sits within the Babylist Money org, reporting to the PM/GM leading the business on a growing team.

Who You Are

  • Outcome-obsessed — you think in terms of revenue impact and measurable results, not shipped features; you can point to at least one project and say exactly what it drove for the bottom line
  • Owned a roadmap — not just executed someone else's priorities; you've had to sit with the blank page, decide what matters, and defend it
  • Comfortable with zero-to-one — you've built or co-built something new, not just optimized an existing product
  • Growth-minded by instinct — you see a metric that needs to move and you immediately start generating hypotheses; you energize your team to begin experimentation with clear ways to measure
  • Technically hands-on — you work directly with engineering daily, can QA your own work, ask smart technical questions, and move fast without waiting for answers; engineering is your partner, not your resource
  • Data-driven by default — when you see a problem, your first instinct is to find the number that defines it and propose ways to move it
  • Strong communicator with a clear point of view — you can present to leadership, defend your work, and know when to acquiesce; you have strong opinions, loosely held
  • Organized and systematic — you keep stakeholders informed without being asked, and you have a clear system for how you track progress and communicate plans
  • B2C experience is a plus — understanding how to work with a large consumer audience is helpful, though strong product instincts and growth experience in any context can translate
  • You naturally reach for AI in your work — at Babylist, every team uses AI daily; you use it to make your job more effective, not to showboat; you're already reaching for it to get answers yourself rather than waiting on someone else

How You Will Make An Impact

  • Own Early Investor end-to-end — take ideas from start to finish, define success metrics, ship, measure, and iterate without waiting to be told what comes next
  • Drive top-of-funnel growth for Early Investor — identify the levers, run the experiments, report on outcomes with clarity, and keep going
  • Identify and test monetization strategies beyond transaction fees — partnerships, physical products, integrated experiences — and build the case for what to prioritize
  • Build sticky product features that give postpartum families a reason to come back to Babylist — think birthdays, college savings milestones, and seasonal moments
  • Work daily alongside an engineering manager and a team of engineers as a true partner — if they fail, you fail, and vice versa
  • Communicate wins, failures, and learnings to leadership in a structured, consistent way

Why This Role

  • Early Investor is live and showing real signal — you're not starting from zero, you're accelerating something that's already working
  • Babylist Money is early enough that your fingerprints will be on everything — the monetization model, the growth playbook, the product hooks that define what this becomes
  • There's a clear path to something big — the team lead grew a comparable zero-to-one business to $60M; the ambition here is the same
  • Leadership moves fast and expects the same, giving the team real autonomy to build the roadmap bottoms-up.

About Compensation

We use a market-based approach to compensation. The starting salary range for this role is:

C$ 179,800 to 224,700 + target 15% annual bonus

Your starting salary will be based on your location, experience, and qualifications, with increases over time tied to performance, role growth, and internal pay equity.

Who We Are

Babylist is the leading platform for expecting and new families. More than 10 million people shop with Babylist every year, making it the go-to destination for seamless purchasing, guidance, and expert recommendations. As a modern, AI-forward tech company, Babylist has expanded from a universal registry into a full ecosystem — the Babylist Shop, Babylist Health, Babylist Money, NYC and LA showrooms, branded content, and more — generating $750M in revenue in 2025. Building the generational brand in baby, Babylist is reshaping the $235B kids and baby market and helping parents feel confident, connected, and cared for at every step.

Our Ways of Working

Babylist is remote-first with team members across the U.S. and Canada who move fast, think smart, and use AI as part of how they work every day — not as an experiment, as an expectation. We come together twice a year to build the relationships behind the work, and we hire people who are genuinely excited about what's possible and prove it through how they show up.

Why You Will Love Working At Babylist

Our Culture

  • We work with focus and intention, then step away to recharge
  • We believe in exceptional management, and we invest in the tools and the time to connect with colleagues
  • We build products that positively impact millions of people's lives
  • AI is part of how we work, not a side experiment. You'll have leading tools like Claude and ChatGPT from day one, with no waiting on access, so the busywork gets handled and your judgment goes where it counts

Growth & Development

  • Competitive pay and meaningful opportunities for career advancement
  • We believe technology and data can solve hard problems
  • We're committed to career progression and performance-based advancement

Benefits

  • Company-paid medical, dental, and vision insurance
  • Retirement savings plan with company matching and flexible spending accounts
  • Generous paid parental leave and PTO
  • Winter Wonder Week: the whole company takes a paid week off at the end of the year, whether or not you celebrate anything, so everyone's out at once and comes back refreshed
  • Remote work stipend to set up your office
  • Perks for physical, mental, and emotional health, parenting, childcare, and financial planning

Important Notices

Recorded Interviews. Babylist uses an interview recording tool to record and transcribe interviews for evaluation purposes in accordance with applicable privacy laws. By participating in an interview, you consent to this recording and transcription.

Interview Integrity. AI is part of how we work at Babylist — we expect you to use it too. Your application and interviews should still reflect you and your own thinking. We'll tell you when AI is encouraged. Misrepresentation at any stage may result in removal from consideration for this and future roles.

How We Review Applications We use AI throughout our hiring process to help review, screen, and assess applications. These tools support our team's review; they do not replace it, and every hiring decision is made by a person.

Connections at Babylist. If you have a family member or close personal relationship with a current Babylist employee, please let your recruiter know. This helps us keep our process fair and transparent for everyone.

Protect Yourself from Scams. All official outreach comes from the Babylist Talent Team via @babylist.com email addresses only. We will never ask for payment or personal financial information. If you receive outreach via WhatsApp, Telegram, or a non-Babylist email — it's not us. Verify open roles at babylist.com/careers.

title: [Job - 31330] UX/UI Specialist, Brazil
description:

As a UX/UI Specialist, you will take on a consultative role within a large, complex client organization. Your primary focus will be on shaping how clients think about their products and customers, navigating a multi-layered stakeholder environment, and delivering high-quality user experiences. You will operate with a high degree of autonomy, acting as both an advisor and a practitioner.

Required Skills and Qualifications

Nice-to-Have Skills

CI&T is a global digital transformation company that combines design, data, and engineering to build end-to-end business solutions for large clients around the world. We are driven by Collaboration, Innovation & Transformation, leveraging AI to enhance the experiences we create.

Join us at CI&T and be part of a team that shapes the future through design and technology. Apply now to make an impact!

title: Senior Software Engineer! Build production software – and raise the engineering bar around you
description:
If your definition of seniority is more than simply having written code for many years, this could be interesting.

Cubris develops software that helps rail operators run smarter, safer and more sustainable railway services.

As part of Hitachi Rail, we are now strengthening our engineering organisation and developing Cubris into a high-performing technology competence centre around our GreenSpeed® platform.

We are therefore looking for a Senior Software Engineer who combines strong hands-on development skills with technical ownership.

This is not a role where you receive a Jira ticket, implement it and move on.

You will take ownership of delivery within a product area – from understanding requirements and making implementation decisions to coordinating development, identifying risks and getting robust software into production.

What you will do

You will:

  • Design, develop and ship production-grade software

  • Translate requirements into clear technical tasks and solutions

  • Take ownership of technical execution within a product area

  • Coordinate development across multiple engineers when required

  • Identify dependencies, blockers and technical risks before they affect delivery

  • Challenge unclear requirements constructively

  • Participate actively in design discussions and technical reviews

  • Design and document architecture at component level

  • Develop and maintain release pipelines

  • Work closely with Product and Quality Engineering

  • Support colleagues through technical sparring, reviews and coaching

  • Improve code quality, testability, maintainability and delivery practices

The role is deliberately broader than coding alone. Cubris expects senior engineers to take responsibility for outcomes, not just assigned tasks.

What you bring

We are looking for substantial software engineering experience and a strong track record of taking software from requirements into production.

Your technical foundation should include:

  • Strong C#/.NET experience

  • Docker/container experience

  • Azure DevOps Cloud

  • Solid software design fundamentals

  • Testing and code-quality practices

  • CI/CD and modern delivery workflows

  • Debugging and performance thinking

  • Database and data-access experience

Experience with .NET MAUI, Blazor, Android/device-based UI or embedded UI solutions is relevant for parts of the GreenSpeed® environment and would be an advantage.

But technical skills alone are not enough.

You should also be comfortable creating momentum when requirements are ambiguous, making sound engineering decisions and helping other developers become better. The formal role description specifically calls for experience leading technical initiatives without necessarily having formal people-management responsibility.

Why Cubris?

You join at a point where your experience can make a visible difference.

You will work close to Product, Quality Engineering and experienced technical colleagues while helping define the standards, tools and engineering practices of the organisation Cubris is becoming.

You get:

  • A technically meaningful product

  • Direct influence on engineering decisions

  • A focused Danish technology environment

  • International reach through Hitachi Rail

  • The opportunity to help build the engineering culture rather than simply become part of an established one

Location: Ballerup, Denmark
Company: Cubris – a Hitachi Rail company

Interested?

Reach out for an informal and confidential conversation.

Please note that work permit needs to be in place before applying and that there is no relocation package included. You must be able to commute to the office in Ballerup every work day.
